TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0001.text: Well… There's no help to it, then. I need your help, hero of Hasla.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0002.text:
My name is #&$#$.
 Haha, I'm sure you've seen me around.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0003.text: Or rather, think you've seen me around.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0005.text: But let's stop the small talk. We're here at L.C,

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0006.text:
the mysterious company nestled deep within the lands of Hasla.
Usually the place should be bustling with devs,

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0007.text: busy developing the features for the next update…

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0008.text: But… an unfortunate turn of events resulted in an infestation of 'bugs,'

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0009.text: contaminating all the devs and ruining their schedule.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0010.text:
I'm here to make a small request:
save all the developers from these 'bugs'

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0011.text:
Simple, right?
How to save them, you ask?

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0013.text:
Hey, don't worry too much. I'll be helping you,
 in the form of a Goddess nice enough to lend me her physical form.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_0014.text: Now, if you use a 3-chain, the Gatekeeper will open the way for you.

TEXT_A_WR_DG_BUGLC_INIT.text:
Huh? How did you…?
 Is it because of 'them' that you arrived here…?

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_1.text: A crude ring given to all new students of the Roman Republic Military Academy. Nobody - not even the professors, and certainly not the students themselves - knows the reason behind its bestowment. A faint aura of mana shrouds the ring's red stone.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_2.text: A red bejeweled ring given to the best students of the Roman Republic Military Academy. The mana held within the glowing scarlet jewel is much greater than that of other red rings, and amplifies the owner's strength and courage.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_3.text: "Ares's Rage" is an enchanted ring given to the senator of the Roman Republic Grand Council who succeeds the name of "Ares," as well as Ares's troops, the "Golden Galeas of the Battlefield." The ring intensifies its owner's fighting strength, but simultaneously makes him excessively belligerent.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_4.text: With its beautiful red jewel overflowing with mana and decorated with elaborate golden engravings, this ring is given to all "Golden Galeas of the Battlefield" whenever Senator Ares claims victory in battle. While it does heighten one's physical strength to the utmost, the ring has been nicknamed "Ares's Wrath" for the excessive cruelty it awakens within the heart of its owner.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_5.text: Ares despairs over how inhumanely violent "Ares's Wrath" makes him and his troops, and asks for Hades's blessing over the ring as to minimize the effects of its madness. Ares then gives the ring a new name - "Ares's Awakening" - and asks Athena about the truth behind their rings.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_ATK_6.text: It is revealed that the rings of Roman had beeen made by the Goddess Chronos, who had foreseen the resurrection of Manacar. The rings, made of manatium, would leech on the mana of the Apostle and to keep its power at bay. After realizing the significance of his ring, Ares trains both his body and mind to expel the evil aura that the ring holds. He succeeds and the ring is thus reforged into "Ares's Transcendence," a ring of pure strength.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_1.text: Zeus was famous from his infancy for having been born with the powers of lightning. Despite his parents' wishes for him to attend Roman's Military Academy, the ever liberal Zeus instead creates his own fan club, "Thunder Worshippers," giving noble rings with the power of lightning to the members.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_2.text: Out of the Thunder Worshippers, who are comprised of those who admire Zeus's strength, Zeus picks the best and most trustworthy warriors as members of his own guard, and presents them with noble azure rings.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_3.text: After many victories on the battlefield, Zeus is eventually elected as a senator of Olympus. He officially incorporates the Thunder Worshippers into the "Thunderstorm Troops," and bestows upon them the azure ring passed down generations of Zeuses and their subordinates. Everyone, including Zeus himself, is quite pleased with their new rings, named "Zeus's Lightning."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_4.text: Senator Zeus and the Thunderstorm Troops claim victory over every battle and hunt they participate in, as a result, become the most popular of senators and their armies in Roman. As a reward, Zeus receives rings of "Zeus's Thunderstorm," which he passes out equally among the elite of the Thunderstorm Troops.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_5.text: Both "Zeus's Lightning" and "Zeus's Thunderstorm" grant immense courage to their owners - but simultaneously render them excessively free-spirited. When his soldiers begin refusing to follow orders, and even desert the army, Zeus instills his own powers of lightning into the rings to alleviate their effects: the rings of "Zeus's Fulmination."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_6.text: Yet when even the provision of "Zeus's Fulmination" does not stop Zeus's soldiers from deserting the Thunderstorm Troops, the concerned Zeus searches through the confidential documents of the Council for a solution. When he realizes that the rings of Olympus have been made of manatium to restrain the Apostle Manacar, Zeus - declaring that he cannot lose to a mere Apostle - pours all his powers of lightning into the rings to make the perfect "Zeus's Radiance."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_1.text: A ring given only to students of the Special Training class of the Roman Republic Military Academy. As its name forbodes, omnious occurences - strange accidents, or cases of sleepwalking - affect the owner of the ring, but the students think of them merely as part of an initiation process. There has been a rumor that the ring is somehow related to the Tower of Manacar.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_2.text: Only the best students of the Special Training class - those who have survived the intense training and have been informed of the secret special forces troop, the "Styx" brigade - receive this ring. The grim mana concentrated within the ring's amythest stone simultaneously strengthens and tortures its owner.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_3.text: It is revealed that the ordeals caused by the "Ominous Amethyst Ring" are, in fact, part of the entrance exams of Roman's Special Forces. Those who overcome their ring's trials are recruited into the "Styx" Special Forces, led by Senator Hades of the Roman Republic Grand Council "Olympus." Hades himself gives his blessing over the ring in order to neutralize the ominous spirit within; this "Hades's Blessing" is the telling mark of Styx members.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_4.text: A ring given only to the veteran members of the Styx Special Forces, who have carried out countless missions of assassination with Senator Hades. While the ring's amethyst jewel is much bigger and more beautiful, and thus carries much more mana, Hades's blessing prevents any bad luck from harming its owner and instead strengthens one's courage and fortitude.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_5.text: Despite Hades and the Styx Forces' efforts to stop the fallen Persephone, her evil spirit corrupts all who come near her. Hades despairs over being unable to protect his troops, and climbs the Peaks of Glory to pray to the spirits of his ancestors. Hades finally manages to exorcise the shadow of evil through the light of his ancestors, and creates the ring of "Hades's Auspice" to give to his subordinates.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_6.text: The spirits of Hades's ancestors reappear in his dreams, and asks Hades to judge and punish the new evil, Persephone. In order to repay his debt to his ancestors, Hades engraves an amethyst jewel with much stronger mana to create the ring of "Hades's Judgment." Over their newly forged rings, he and the members of Styx vow to punish Persephone to the end, and begin their long search for the Hermit Queen.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_1.text: A golden and very durable ring given to students of the Defense Guardian class, the hardest course at Roman's Military Academy. Competition to enroll in this course is very harsh, as students get first priority to enlist in the "Guardians of the Sun," the army led by Senator Athena of Olympus.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_2.text: Only the best of the Defense Guardian class of the Military Academy receive the "Hard Ebony Ring." The mana within the ebony jewel embedded in the middle of the ring helps the wearer retain a heart of honor and pride, and so immerse themselves even more in their training.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_3.text: A ring given to Senator Athena and members of the "Guardians of the Sun." The obsidian jewel of "Athena's Guardianship" shines brilliantly with mana, but as the jewel is small, so not to bother handling one's shield, only a few are aware of its beauty. The jet mana strengthens both body and mind of the wearer, as if becoming a living shield.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_4.text: Athena begins to question why wearing "Athena's Guardianship" induces her to forget everything at times. After much research, she finds the records left by the first Athena of Roman, and discovers the truth: that the rings passed among the generations of Olympus senators were made of manatium, in order to keep Manacar at bay. In order to continue her ancestors' will, Athena envelops the ring with an aura of protection.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_5.text: Yet the light of protection with which Athena bound "Athena's Protection" did not prove to be eternal. While foraging through ancient parchments, Athena discovers that one can concentrate the will of protection and light into the holy laurel stone. She embeds such a gem in the newly forged ring in order to restrain its aura of obliviousness.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_DEF_6.text: Yet Athena does not stop at forging "Athena's Tutelage." After training to revive her sense of iron justice and strong pride, Athena succeeds in imbursing her will into the ring and binding the evil spirit of Manacar within. Athena names the newly made ring "Athena's Glory," and it is said that the ring always brings Athena proud victory.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_1.text: The first senator to be granted the name of "Hera" was the queen of Roman, who, in the stead of the runaway king, stayed behind on the battlefield with her ladies-in-waiting to deliver relief supplies and nurse the injured. The queen always insisted on wearing very plain clothes - save for the ornate ring on her finger.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_2.text: When people of Roman discover that the queen's silver ring had been bequeathed to her by her mother, they collect silver in order to forge it into a much more elegant design. Ornate silver rings, fashioned after that of the reigning Hera of the battlefield, becomes something of a fad among the nobility of Roman.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_3.text: After the end of the Apostles' War, the first Hera is elected to the Olympus Council by her people. After hearing the story of Manacar from Goddess Chronos, Hera decides after long council to accept responsibility over manatium: the element that absorbs Manacar's mana and weakens its power. So the first manatium ring is created: the ring of "Hera's Breath."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_4.text: The realization that Manacar's Fury seeps out of "Hera's Breath" drives the first Hera to seek Goddess Chronos's help. The goddess infuses both the strength of Cora and the gentle will of Hera into the ring to restrain the Fury. Naming the newly forged ring "Hera's Caress," Chronos requests the queen to pass down the ring and its responsibility to the future lineage of Heras.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_5.text: The passing of years weakens the spirit of Cora within "Hera's Caress." The present-day Hera decides that the ring must be protected with more will of light, and - together with members of the "Rainbow of Benevolence," who have served "Hera"s for generations - imbues benevolence and love into the ring, which becomes the gently glowing "Hera's Benevolence."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_RST_6.text: When Manacar's Fury began to seep out from even "Hera's Benevolence," Hera heads to the Temple of Mount Olympus. Extraordinarily, all monsters of the mountain flee before the light of benevolence that shines from her. After Hera's long prayer, the desire for peace of all the Heras throughout the years becomes a brilliant azure gleam that encompasses the ring and creates "Hera's Prayer."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_1.text: A rusty ring whose original owner and identity are a mystery. It was discovered near the Tower of Manacar, and is presently being researched by the Styx Special Forces, led by Olympus senator Hades of the Roman Republic Grand Council. A faint aura of mana can be felt from the ring's round ebony stone.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_2.text: When a Styx member cuts his finger and spills a drop of blood on the rusty ring, the ring's stone absorbs the blood and starts emitting a gentle sheen. The Council issues a vow of secrecy against discussing this strange occurence, and begins the long search to find the ring's original owner.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_3.text: One day, Persephone, the last hidden Olympus senator dubbed the "Hermit Queen," awakens from her long slumber. Due to her incredible hold of mana, she had been asked by Goddess Chronos to go to sleep under the influence of the manatium ring "Persephone's Thirst." Yet the numerous rings on her fingers taint Persephone with their odious aura, and so the Hermit Queen wakes lusting for blood and mana.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_4.text: It was through her mana that Persephone managed to stay alive during her slumber within a pool of blood, and through her ring that she recovered her spent mana. Yet through the years the spirit of Manacar ate away at her sleeping soul, whispering of greater power and bloodlust. It was only after Persephone succumbed to the darkness that the spirit informed her of a way to infuse greater amounts of her mana into other rings - through sacrificing blood.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_5.text: The fallen and bloodthirsty Persephone ambushes the Council, stealing the remaining rings and fleeing to the Tower of Manacar. In return for delivering the rings to the spirit of Manacar, she obtains and absorbs some of the great amount of mana contained within them. And so the ring of imperfection is created: "Persephone's Lust."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_NEW_RING_ALL_VAMP_6.text: Thus due to Persephone the Tower of Manacar gradually regains its powers and begins shaking. Even before the abnomalies of the Tower Persephone is preoccupied only on accumulating more and more mana, evolving the ring into even more grotesque proportions. Yet even the new ring "Persephone's Folly" fails to satisfy her lust, and so Persephone disappears into the shadows - forever searching for stronger and more beautiful mana.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_ATK_5_KURENAI.text: In the ancient eastern lands, where mystical flames danced and wars blazed, a strange tale is told. A legend of a wandering swordsman who appears in the dark of night, wearing a demon mask blacker than shadows. Hushed whispers spoke of the carnage and slaughter wrought by the demon, and the people begin to wear rings engraved with that very demon's visage to keep themselves safe from his blade.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_ATK_5_KURENAI_H.text: The remains of the first Priestess of Ryu, buried on the slopes of the Primal Volcano. The ring is very old, but the engraved flames dance as if they are alive. On the inside is etched the words: "For thee I light the way to hidden truths."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_ATK_6_KURENAI.text: Years pass and the rings become a talisman against not only the demon-swordsman, but all misfortune. They are now carved in holy silver for that very purpose. Do the rings really have such power? The answer is unknown, but the demon-swordsman slowly fades both into legend and from the people's memory. Forgotten, but real.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_5_KURE.text: For years the swordsman in the black demon mask has been fighting the screams of the spirits that haunt him. Again and again he struggles to lower his blade, but each time, he is drenched in red. The swordsman loses himself to despair - until one day he meets a maiden, clothed in a garb of white and crimson.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_CRIT_DMG_6_KURE.text: The maiden, without revealing her name, silently begins to pray. With her hands clasped tight, her prayer silences the spirits for the first time. The swordsman, trembling in relief, looks upon the maiden who immediately weaves white and crimson threads into a talisman. After imbuing it with her life and blood she hands it to the swordsman. "You must go," she said. "Go to the Primal Volcano."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_5_KUR.text: The swordsman of the vile mask knows not where the Primal Volcano is. The maiden thinks for a moment, and then with a gentle gesture, calls forth from the heavens a lone bird. She speaks with the same gesture to the swordsman: follow that bird. The swordsman hesitates, he does not wish to leave her. Yet he must follow the bird, and so he begins his journey.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_CRIT_PROB_6_KUR.text: The road to the Primal Volcano is a difficult one. The bird, made of the maiden's power, slowly begins to fade into the sky with each step taken away from her. Days pass, and the bird is nothing more than a shade, a faint outline in the sky. So, the swordsman only looks to the sky as he journeys, terrified of losing the bird. Yet not even his desperation could bind a bird of the heavens to earth and it vanishes before his eyes. Lost, the swordsman stops... and despairs.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_DEF_5_EVENT_FUG.text: A ring given by a thankful Fergus to mercenary leaders who helped him test out his Ent Robot. Despite its name, wearing the ring doesn't actually increase chances of getting great success. How unfortunate.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_DEF_5_KURENAI.text: In a village lives a boy, living off the trinkets he makes. One night he dreams of a bird whose thunderous arrival splits the heavens before transforming into a Fire Dragon. It  asks the boy to, "guide the one who seeks the Primal Volcano." The boy thinks nothing of this dream at first, but the bird-dragon visits him night after night and slowly... the boy begins to believe.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_DEF_6_KURENAI.text: On the fateful night, the boy dreams once more, but this time the dragon, with its eyes blazing, says... "It is time." The night was silent as the boy awoke and as he cut through the dark in the pale moonlight. The light shattering against the brilliance of his white clothes. When at last he came face to face with the swordsman in the demon-mask he was strangely unafraid.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_RST_5_KURENAI.text: Who was the swordsman in the stories of old? The reaper haunting the darkest shadows of the night? The swordsman finally knew what he was. A vengeful spirit, the revenant of a bloody war in the eastern lands, long ago. Death had embraced him but he had not known. Sword in hand, he WAS the demon painted on his mask. In the crimson light the swordsman wept, in shame and resentment, until the light set his soul free. The boy realized only then that he too, had been weeping, and knew what he had to do.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_RST_6_KURENAI.text: The boy returns and begins to forge rings. Into it he engraves his sincerest desire for the souls sacrificed in war to find peace. The rings, awakened by his passion, glow with a crimson hue and become talismans against corruption. Yet, at the highest peak of the eastern lands, a vengeful spirit...

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_VAMP_5_KURENAI.text: The boy guides the swordsman and paves a path with the moon lighting the way. It was a path he had never trod before but it was strangely familiar. Halfway up the Primal Volcano the boy smells the acrid tang of blood over the scent of the moonlit grass. He turns and sees the blood dyeing each step of the swordsman. The boy gasps, but the swordsman shakes his head and gestures, "onward."

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_ALL_VAMP_6_KURENAI.text: The boy swallows his fears and presses on toward to the peak of the Primal Volcano. With every step the scent of blood thickened, and the swordsman's form faded. Not knowing how many dusks and dawns had passed, the pair reached the peak. In the flickering crimson of the volcano, the boy turns around to face the swordsman only to see his mask melt away.

TEXT_BACKGROUND_RING_FUGUS.text: A ring given by a thankful Fergus to mercenary leaders who helped him test out his Ent Robot. Despite its name, wearing the ring doesn't actually increase chances of getting great success. How unfortunate.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_ATTACK_PHYSICA.text:
Damage caused by physical attacks. It is affected by the enemy's armor.
Higher armor penetration deals physical damage more effectively.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_BLOCK_SPSKILL_.text: Number of special skills used in battle.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_BLOCK_USE_BLOC.text: Number of blocks used in battle.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_ALL_IN.text: Total sum of <physical, magical, and neutral> damage taken from the enemy.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_BARRIE.text:
Damage blocked by shield.
Counted separately from damage taken.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_HEAL_I.text:
Amount of allies' HP healed.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_MAGIC_.text:
Magical damage received from enemy.
Higher resistance lowers this damage.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_NEUTRA.text:
Damage that ignores the hero's armor and resistance.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_DEFENSE_PHYSIC.text:

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_TEAM_ATTACK_AL.text: Total damage dealt by team to enemy.

TEXT_BSTATISTICS_CATEGORY_TEAM_ATTACK_DP.text:

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_DESC.text: The Guardian of Ryu, one of the three countries of the East. Kurenai is an incarnation of flame, born long ago from the embers of Primal Flames that the Tsukino family brought from the Primal Volcano. Kurenai has spent long years doing relatively nothing  - until she meets Himiko, the daughter of a family of warriors, and starts to interact with humans for the first time.

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_RYU_ACTIVE_LV1_NAME.text: Slash of the Red Lotus Lv1

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_RYU_ACTIVE_LV2_NAME.text: Slash of the Red Lotus Lv2

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_RYU_ACTIVE_LV3_NAME.text: Slash of the Red Lotus Lv3

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_RYU_ACTIVE_LV4_NAME.text: Slash of the Red Lotus Lv4

TEXT_CHAMP_EAST_RYU_ACTIVE_LV5_NAME.text: Slash of the Red Lotus Lv5

TEXT_CHAMP_FREE_DESC.text: The organization was composed of various warriors with self interests. There is a battle chariot in this organization but due to it's unstableness, only highly trained archers can ride it. Archers can shoot arrows steadily, thanks to horseman Winchester. It is common knowledge that a superior warrior is serving the horseman in the chariot.

TEXT_CHAMP_FREE_FREE_EXCLUSIVE_LV1_DESC.text: When leader uses special skill, Winchester's extraordinary boss, Joanne, appears and uses ^Lv1 'Overdrive!'^. (Once every 15 seconds; Joanne's stats are equal to ^1.5 times those of the leader^)

TEXT_CHAMP_FREE_FREE_EXCLUSIVE_LV2_DESC.text: When leader uses special skill, Winchester's extraordinary boss, Joanne, appears and uses ^Lv3 'Overdrive!'^. (Once every 12 seconds; Joanne's stats are equal to ^1.7 times those of the leader^)

TEXT_CHAMP_GODDESS_DESC.text: A mysterious lady born within the Order of the Goddess and raised among the Divine Cavalry, under the guardianship of Priestess Maria. Her elegant and mature personality is betrayed by bouts of strange fits, during which she shows symptoms of an unstable mind. Unknown to all save for a selected few within the Order, Noa - and the secret of her identity - is revealed to the world when Maria, trusting Lednas, decides to send her to Hero Town.

TEXT_CHAMP_GRAN_DESC.text: The protector of the Grancia Empire, Galahad received his name from Emperor Alexander. It is said that only the knight with the greatest virtue and combat abilities is deemed worthy of receiving the name Galahad. So to be bestowed the name is a very honorable thing for the knights. However, after receiving the name, the knight has to abandon his own past and only live as the new Galahad. Since this makes finding the successor difficult, the 1st Galahad is still on duty.

TEXT_CHAMP_HAN_DESC.text: A rare rabbit patron mountain saint among the many tiger patron mountain saints of Han. Hanee Baram is loved among her people. Usually she is cheerful and will willingly approach others, but at times she suddenly turns shy and hides out of sight.

TEXT_CHAMP_MINO_DESC.text: The first Elf King to lead the haughty Elf Tribe to communicate with other races, Aindel has embarked on many journeys throughout the continent with the intention to meet various tribes of Hasla. On every one of his visits to the Animal, Woopa, Devil, and other tribes, the Elf King strived to provide aid in solving each peoples' conflict. Afterwards, Aindel forms Minor Tribes' Confederation to protect all minorities who have no allegiance to a particular country, and is crowned the leader of the group. However, the striking differences among the four tribes render the alliance shaky at best, and susceptible to external influences who threat its existence. When Aindel learns from Sigruna of a town where many races live in harmony, he immediately sets out on the road, hiding his royal identity. A king must always protect his people, and all of the Confederation has become his.

TEXT_CHAMP_NETH_DESC.text: The genius lead engineer of Mecha Robot Project A.M.K., a confidential project undertaken by the Neth Empire Army. When the project is canceled due to the tyranny of various corporations and the oppression of collaborating officials, the disappointed Frantz leaves the Neth Army to be unheard of for years, until one day he returns with a prototype named AMK-001, eagerly participating in various missions as if to prove the superiority of his model.

TEXT_CHAMP_NOS_DESC.text: Lia is a young girl with the ability to control ice and blizzards, which wins her the respect and adoration of many in the kingdom of Nosgard. She strives to be well-liked by everyone, smiling brightly regardless of her private feelings and taking note of everyone's every word and action. Her bright and cheerful countenance may not be exactly what it seems to be...

TEXT_CHAMP_PUMP_DESC.text: A witch from Pumpkin City, Remi acts as a veterinarian for the familiars of her hometown. Highly interested in animals and other creatures, she volunteers for the 'Champion' program for Pumpkin City in order meet various creatures from different cities and cultures. Remi shares a special relationship with her familiar cat Taro, who accompanies her not only in battle but everywhere she goes.

TEXT_CHAMP_ROMAN_DESC.text: The descendant of the Beast King, a legendary figure who ruled over all beasts in the world. Accompanied by Palor the Chimera, Agrius led a reclusive life in the Peaks of Glory - until the onset of the war, started by the Apostle of the Tower of Manacar, which drove him to cooperate with the Olympus Council of the Roman Republic. Agrius is awkward at communicating with others save for Palor, but is not at all unsociable or aloof. He is a champion who always strives to be the true Beast King.

TEXT_CHAMP_ROMAN_PASSIVE_LV1_NAME.text: Guardianship of the Beast King Lv1

TEXT_CHAMP_ROMAN_PASSIVE_LV2_NAME.text: Guardianship of the Beast King Lv2

TEXT_CHAMP_ROMAN_PASSIVE_LV3_NAME.text: Guardianship of the Beast King Lv3

TEXT_CHAMP_WEST_DESC.text: A mysterious woman leading both the knights of Valencia and the outlaws of the Wildlands. Dressed in a fine suit while hiding behind an elaborate mask with an enigmatic smile, Ibelin easily grabs attention and respect through her confidence and natural charisma. Yet, she never talks about herself, frequently disappears from town, and sparsly deals with Trista. There may be more to this champion than meets the eye...

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_10_DESC.text: A gardener who is learning from Prestina, on how to care for trees and flowers. Impressed by Prestina's wisdom, he is currently persuading the villagers to start calling her 'The Goddess of the Forest.'

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_1_DESC.text: Dato che ha paura anche della sua ombra, mette a segno solo piccoli furtarelli. Soddisfatto dell'arco che ha rubato un giorno, ora si dedica solo alle frecce.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_2_DESC.text: Una ragazza che desidera diventare un'esploratrice e si allena molto duramente per essere la migliore.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_3_DESC.text: Sigruna fa parte del clan degli Elfi d'argento e per questo conduce una vita molto dura, poiché appartiene alla classe sociale più bassa.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_4_DESC.text: In realtà è una ragazza di città che voleva lasciarsi alle spalle il caos e lo stress, per cui si è rifugiata in campagna, dove si allena con l'arco del fratello.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_5_DESC.text: Una ninja che crede di essersi infiltrata di nascosto in città... Peccato che tutti conoscano la sua vera identità.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_6_DESC.text: Centuries ago, the Apostles brought demons from another dimension to destroy Hasla, and those demons wrecked havoc using humans as hosts. Demona was one of these human hosts.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_7_DESC.text: Assistance force dispatched by Nosgard to Grancia Empire. He is a talented soldier, but he does not seem to get used to war weather in Grancia.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_8_DESC.text: Normal archer subordinated in the Grancia Empire Army. They always act in groups due to lack of individual abilities.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_9_DESC.text: A country lass whose dream is to join the Divine Cavalry. Despite her dreams being thwarted each time by the difficult entrance exams, she never despairs but always dreams of a brighter tomorrow.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_10_DESC.text: Demona battled against the evil inside of her, until one day, a saintess exorcised the demon from her, leaving only the power behind. This was the birth of the first devil.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_11_DESC.text: The famous trouble maker in the 12 Zodiac Army. For no reason, he hates the Roman Republic representatives. He always bullies Pisces, the son of a Roman representative.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_12_DESC.text: A mass produced android produced by Neth Empire with the data from Road insutry. It resembles R-0, but its capabilities are limited compared to the upgrades that R-0 has received.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_13_DESC.text: Mir, the manager sister in charge of the Eastern Kingdoms. She may be shy and a little reserved, but she has a beautiful smile and is always willing to help those in need.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_14_DESC.text: Mia, the manager sister in charge of the Roman Republic. She lives as a flower would, with a dreamy beautiful smile and faraway look. Mia is a subject of concern for her sisters, who always take turns looking after her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_1_DESC.text: È un esploratore delle guardie cittadine, un lavoro stancante che richiede molta esperienza di combattimento. Non è ancora molto abile, ma è una parte fondamentale del corpo di guardia.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_2_DESC.text: Guerriero di una tribù dell'area desertica nei pressi dell'Impero centrale, fedele alla dea del deserto. Da tempo immemore, questa tribù protegge la Scheggia degli Apostoli.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_3_DESC.text: Fa parte di un gruppo di ladri che mira al denaro dei nobili corrotti. Non derubano mai i comuni cittadini e condividono sempre il bottino con gli abitanti della città.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_4_DESC.text: A Roman c'è un esercito composto esclusivamente da donne, rivale di un'altra armata al femminile: le Arciere di velluto.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_5_DESC.text: Per tendere un'imboscata a un mercenario, è rimasto appostato per un mese con l'arco di sua sorella, ma non l'ha ancora arrestato e lei rivuole il suo arco.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_6_DESC.text: Un giorno, i suoi genitori sono stati attaccati dai mostri. Sigruna, per sostenere la sua famiglia, tenta l'ascesa sociale ma ha un solo modo per riuscirci: entrare nelle guardie d'élite del re. La ragazza si allena duramente per avere successo.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_7_DESC.text:
Nato dall'unione di elfi e umani. Gli elfi non amano molto
i mezzelfi, i quali in genere vivono con gli umani.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_8_DESC.text:
Gruppo di arcieri guidato da Magnus, una delle guardie d'élite
del re. Sono rivali del gruppo capeggiato da Sigruna.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_9_DESC.text: Cacciatore della foresta nosgardiana. Il recente conflitto ha decimato la fauna silvana e il cacciatore rischia di morire di fame, ma almeno ha un tetto sopra la testa.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_10_DESC.text:
Un elfo dispettoso che lancia bastoncini di zucchero ai bambini a Natale,
senza però mai colpirli.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_11_DESC.text: Le Elfe del Gelo di Nosgard non sono munite di corna che consentano loro l'uso della magia, per cui si sono specializzate nell'arte venatoria e nel tiro con l'arco.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_12_DESC.text: Humans associated the demons with evil. Demona fought a lonely fight against humanity. However, more and more demons were born, and Demona gathered them together.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_13_DESC.text: The most beautiful soldier in 12 Zodiac Army. Due to his beautiful appearance, Sagittarius confessed his love toward him claiming that he doesn't care whether he is a man or not.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_14_DESC.text: An archer subordinated under the Neth Resistance Army. He uses arrows with attached bombs and is excellent at counter attacking Neth magicians and machines. His combat specialty guerilla warfare.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_15_DESC.text: A follower of the Order of the Goddess who takes the yearly pilgrimage to the Holy City. He has a dogged faith in the Order and believes that his pilgrimage will take him closer to the Goddess's side, one step at a time.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_16_DESC.text: One of the Twelve Cobalt Knights of the Order of the Blue Blood. Emilia, being a commoner of the Roman Republic, who never had the chance to properly learn archery. However it didn't prove to be an obstacle in relation to her natural talent. Victoria too thought highly of Emilia's aptitude, and brought her to Grancia to officially knight her as one of the Twelve Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_1_DESC.text: Una volpe dall'aria contrariata, che sostiene che la sua espressione serva soltanto a cogliere di sorpresa la sua preda. Insiste di chiamarsi Volpemord, ma il suo vero nome è Volpe mordente.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_2_DESC.text: Il modello di maggiore successo della "Famiglia di androidi" prodotta nell'Impero Neth. Dovrebbe comportarsi come una sorella, ma la maggior parte delle persone non ha idea di cosa comporti portare a casa un robot del genere.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_3_DESC.text: Un pagliaccio specializzato nel tiro con l'arco. Dato che non si è potuto esibire al circo a causa della comparsa dei mostri, ha deciso di combatterli personalmente.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_4_DESC.text: Famoso gruppo di arciere che indossano abiti di velluto rosso. Sono tutte bellissime, quindi la gente fa a gara per riuscire ad ammirarle quando le incontra.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_5_DESC.text: Avventuriero che va pazzo per gli animali, e non solo per quelli docili, ma anche per le bestie selvagge e i draghi. Per inciso, odia Gon.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_6_DESC.text: Cadetto spaziale giallo, probabilmente il più pigro del gruppo.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_7_DESC.text: Esperta maga e cacciatrice ingaggiata da Scienza estatica a scopo di ricerca, per catturare Sasquatch. Tuttavia, dopo che questa creatura l'ha salvata dall'attacco di un mostro, è combattuta sul da farsi.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_8_DESC.text: Le piace un ragazzo del club di kendo, così vi si trasferisce, ignara del fatto che egli a sua volta era entrato nel club di tiro con l'arco per starle vicino.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_8_NAME.text: Club privato di tiro con l'arco

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_9_DESC.text: Dopo aver fallito l'esame per la settima volta, ha perso la speranza. Ma i suoi genitori, guariti dall'attacco subito, l'hanno incoraggiata a perseverare, così ora Sigruna ha di nuovo fiducia in se stessa.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_10_DESC.text: Aristocratico e lontano parente del Re, ha sfruttato il proprio lignaggio per salire a capo del gruppo degli Arcieri dorati. Ama tutto ciò che è bello ed elegante.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_11_DESC.text: After the war with the Apostles, the Goddesses started to hunt the Demons for their crimes. Demona summoned the Demons together and began a war against the Goddesses.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_12_DESC.text: Altair is the only son of an aristocrat. He is very kind-hearted and handsome and although he is not as strong as most men, he was taught the ways of archery by Giparang. When Chen invaded Han, he volunteered for the battle to fulfill his obligation as an aristocrat.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_13_DESC.text: A famous hunter of the Roman Empire. At a young age, she won the first place in the Roman Empire hunting competition. She is very proud of her hunting skills, and is dreaming of hunting a great quarry that will surprise and impress everyone.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_14_DESC.text: A young warrior of the Woopa tribe, tired of his dull life in the village. One foreboding day, the Primal Volcano mysteriously erupts and threatens the Woopa tribe to extinction. In the confusion and mayhem that follows, Mamba runs away from the village.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_15_DESC.text: Lee is from an island country in the East Empire. Her mother dreamed to become the top dancer in Chen but she gave up due to hardship. Successing her mother, Lee also dreams to become a great dancer but her mother is firmly against her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_16_DESC.text: Rahima is the daughter of nomadic tribes, wandering the wilderness of Hasla to an undeveloped land. When the tribe attempts to move to another area, they are attacked by cateran. The tribes' archery helps Rahima to resist, sadly she is separated from her family.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_17_DESC.text: A girl who resides in a convent with her elder sister Violet. One day she develops the special ability of seeing and talking with ghosts. Her sister and the other nuns, however, think she has gone mad, and pity her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_18_DESC.text: Her father is a lord of the countryside region of Ryu. He used to be of a royal family who could succeed the throne, but he hated fighting for the throne, so he decided to step down. Kaguya loves her new peaceful life.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_19_DESC.text: An orphan of war, Chiron is saved by mercenary captain Heth who teaches him the art of battle. Under Heth's tutelage, young Chiron learns everything there is to know about archery and hammer throwing, and begins his own mercenary career soon after.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_1_DESC.text: Giovane membro di una tribù in cui i guerrieri collezionano le ossa delle bestie: più ne accumulano, più sono potenti.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_20_DESC.text: A skilled archer who dreams of winning glory on the battlefield. Instead of the honor and fame he dreamt of, however, Hansung receives a critical injury to his eyes and is forced to return home.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_21_DESC.text: An archer succeeding the lost necromancy of the Desert, Set has protected Osiris together with Isis from his youth. When Osiris, older but headstrong as ever, declares that he will set out on a journey in search for the past, Set expresses his disapproval against the futility of his mission and vows not to follow him.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_2_DESC.text: Famoso ninja, noto per i movimenti estremamente agili. Come secondo lavoro, consegna i giornali la mattina.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_3_DESC.text: Gli sforzi di Sigruna hanno finalmente dato frutto. Grazie alle sue eccellenti abilità con l'arco, è entrata nelle guardie d'élite e ora è un'arciera esperta.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_4_DESC.text: Robin Hood è un nuovo membro della Mela verde, che ruba ai ricchi corrotti in nome della giustizia ma, nel profondo del suo cuore, sa che anche questo è sbagliato.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_5_DESC.text: Androide femminile sviluppata da Road Industry. Si dice che i suoi dati di sviluppo siano stati rubati da Scienza estatica, ma la verità è ignota. In qualità di prototipi, a tutti gli androidi è stata affidata la medesima missione, ma solo uno di loro è riuscito a compierla.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_6_DESC.text:
Guerriero di una nazione orientale ricca di storia e tradizione.
È così abile nel tiro con l'arco che chiunque lo osservi ne rimane incantato.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_7_DESC.text: Studentessa che proviene dall'Oriente. Ha una sorella di nome Kaori, ma non ha la sua stessa capacità di adattamento allo stile di vita occidentale.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_8_DESC.text: Niven era un'Elfa del Gelo nata con un corno magico, la cui famiglia venne uccisa dalla Tribù dei Lupi. Per questo l'elfa, assetata di vendetta, uccise numerosi lupi in battaglia.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_9_DESC.text: Una donna bellissima ma timida, cresciuta in una terra che non aveva mai conosciuto la guerra. Una notte, fuggì di casa e si innamorò di Mondrian. Ora cerca ogni possibile opportunità di incontrarlo segretamente.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_10_DESC.text: Magnus è convinto che solo un nobile sia degno della sua posizione, per cui ritiene la leader degli Arcieri d'argento Sigruna una spina nel fianco, dati i suoi umili natali. Magnus odia Sigruna e propende per lo scioglimento degli Arcieri d'argento.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_11_DESC.text: Demona grew weary of the constant persecution of the demons, and decided to lead them to a new land. This marked the beginning of a new dawn for the demons.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_12_DESC.text: Altair shoots Rebecca's horse out from under her and she is thrown to the ground. However, Altair is surrounded by the Chen army and although he escapes, he is wounded in the process. Rebecca comes to his aid and he is able to get away.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_13_DESC.text: After a long chase, Atalante captures a great lion. However, that lion was a pet of an aristocrat. Atalante goes to jail for hunting the lion but Athena saves her. After that, Atalante pledges her loyalty to Athena.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_14_DESC.text: Mamba's initial excitement of arriving at the Grancia Empire soon fades before cultural and linguistic differences. He barely makes it day by day by working as a repairman, at which he thankfully shows natural talent. One fateful day, Mamba meets Viper who has come to enhance his weapon, and decides to follow him out of sheer intuition.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_15_DESC.text: Lee is recognized as a dancer after performing in front of her mother. She gets a job as a dancer in the Royal dance company of Chen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_16_DESC.text: Rahima woke up in Hawk's nest. She regards Hawk as her savior and decides to reside there. Lahima constantly practices archery so that she can keep the tribe's faith. She also learns how to hunt with Hawk.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_17_DESC.text: When nobody believes her to speak the truth, Viola instead finds sympathy in her ghost friends. The ghosts too find comfort in Viola, through confessing their unfulfilled desires and unresolved woes.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_18_DESC.text: Kaguya grew up like a tomboy and nobody could stop her. She enjoys running through fields and hunting with her bow. She sometimes gets into trouble, but everybody likes her because she has a friendly nature.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_19_DESC.text: Chiron's fame as a mercenary heightens daily - to the point of diminishing the reputation and work of other mercenaries. A mercenary named Nessus, especially irritated by Chiron's reputation, spreads a vile rumor that defames his master, Heth. Heth falls ill after hearing of the rumor, and Chiron sets out to seek revenge.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_1_DESC.text: Gon si decora il capo con le ossa del temibile urk ed è rispettato dalla sua tribù perché è il primo che sia riuscito ad abbattere quella possente creatura... e anche a capire che cosa fosse un urk.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_20_DESC.text: Although Hansung ends up losing his vision to his injury, he does not despair, instead opting to train against his blindness through long rounds of hunting. After years of effort, Hansung finally gains an 'inner sight' that lets him aim his arrow.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_21_DESC.text: When Osiris remains unfazed by Set's disapproval, and Isis additionally insists on following Osiris on his journey, Set realizes that he has no choice. Grumbling an excuse about his own search for a powerful scroll of necromancy, Set grudgingly follows the two with a worried eye.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_2_DESC.text: Le entrate del suo secondo lavoro sono discrete, ma ha deciso di ampliare l'area di consegna ed è così che incontra il leggendario fattorino Raffica.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_3_DESC.text: Sigruna continua a esercitarsi, anche dopo essere diventata una guardia d'élite e, date le sue umili origini, cerca di non sprecare neanche una singola freccia. Secondo la tradizione elfica, gli alberi sono sacri, per cui il fatto che Sigruna non sprechi le frecce la rende un modello per gli altri. Per questo ora viene denominata 'arciera divina'.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_4_DESC.text: Robin Hood diventa il capo della Mela verde. Ben presto, l'oscurità ammanta il suo cuore e giura di derubare tutti i nobili.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_5_DESC.text: L'unico prototipo di serie R sopravvissuto. R-1 è frutto delle instancabili analisi dei dati recuperati dai prototipi.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_6_DESC.text: Nei paesi orientali, ogni 4 anni si tiene un torneo di tiro con l'arco, quando la luna è più splendente. Tale competizione dura dalla mezzaluna fino alla notte successiva, quando sorge la luna piena. Il titolo di Mezzaluna viene conferito al vincitore del torneo. Giparang ha affascinato tutti con le sue abilità e nessuno dubita che sarà insignito di questo titolo onorifico.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_7_DESC.text: Vivendo sempre nell'ombra della sorella, Hikari non ha mai accettato il proprio talento nel tiro con l'arco.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_8_DESC.text: Niven assassinò la principessa degli Elfi del Gelo per impedire l'unificazione del suo clan con la Tribù dei Lupi e per questo fu arrestata e bandita ma, all'arrivo dei Vaporis, fu riammessa al fine di affrontarli.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_9_DESC.text: Un magistrato locale, innamorato di Arona, scoprì i suoi incontri segreti con Mondrian e lo fece arrestare. Con il cuore spezzato, Arona giurò di vendicarsi e di liberare il suo innamorato.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_10_DESC.text: Durante l'attacco dei mostri, Magnus è rimasto colpito dalle abilità di Sigruna e ha cambiato idea sul suo conto, pur rifiutandosi di ammetterlo. Da quando ha scoperto che le piace mangiare la corteccia degli alberi, gliela fa avere in forma anonima.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_11_DESC.text: The demons that remained in Hasla were hunted down as the Order of the Goddesses grew, and Demona knew she had to return. She entered the Primal Volcano and awakened the power of Primal Flames.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_12_DESC.text: After the war, Altair's father sends him to recuperate in a small village. While living in the village alone, Altair remembers Rebecca and the aid she gave him. He realizes his love for her and leaves the village to find her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_13_DESC.text: Athena orders Atalante, to go after the apostle who disappeared. As she was the only one who could chase after the apostle Manacar without leaving any trace behind, she begins the hunt without hesitation.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_14_DESC.text: Codename: Black Mamba. One of the aces of the Neth Resistance Army and Viper's right-hand man. Enemies fear him for his exceptional skill and silent demeanor, but he is in reality a very naive young man whose hobbies include admiring Viper and repairing weapons. Sometimes he adds '-woompapa' at the end of his sentences-woompa.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_15_DESC.text: An assassin appears during Lee's performance but at the critical moment Lee defends assassin's attack with her fans. Lee gets recognized as the royal savior and gets promoted as the principal dancer who secretly guards the royal family.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_16_DESC.text: Rahima enters into human society after leaving the nest. She is always with her friendly companion, Yumir, the hawk. Hawks will always be there for Lahima whenever she is in danger during the journey to return to her tribe.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_17_DESC.text: Viola increasingly spends her free time with the ghosts of the convent. Other ghosts, curious of the living girl who has become friends with so many spirits, come seeking Viola's company as well. However, the increased number of ghosts start disrupting the convent with their supernatural powers, causing the nuns to shiver in fear every night.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_18_DESC.text: On a day when cherry blossoms were particularly beautiful under the moonlight, a monster appeared and attacked the village. Many people got hurt and the village was in chaos. In that moment, Kaguya knocked the monster down with one arrow. That day is now a holiday to the people of the village.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_19_DESC.text: Chiron challenges Nessus to a duel, which he wins and restores his teacher's honor. He is bestowed the 'Hammer of Glory' for his victory, and appointed the master training teacher of the Zodiac Army.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_1_DESC.text: Gon è riuscito ad abbattere il temibile Tiga, dimostrando di essere il guerriero più forte della tribù. Ora ha decorato la testa di un urk con il corno di Tiga e il dorso con le ossa delle sue ali.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_20_DESC.text: When Hansung returns to the battlefield to achieve his lifelong dream, the other generals ignore him as a senile, blind old man. Yet when the blind archer kills the enemy general with but a single arrow of his quiver, others come to recognize his true mastery over his bow. Hansung's many victories afterwards spread his fame far and wide throughout the lands, and he is made one of the Five Tiger Generals of Chen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_20_NAME.text: Hansung of the Five Tiger Generals

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_21_DESC.text: Set discovers a Rosetta Stone within the temple, and on it the words 'Only the Necromancer of the Kingdom, with the Guide of the Lost, shall lead the lost souls back to life, from the chasms of the underworld.' Set, realizing that he is the 'Necromancer of the Kingdom,' nervously glances at the determined Osiris.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_2_DESC.text: Hanzo vince la battaglia contro Raffica di un solo giornale, per cui viene insignito di questo titolo e diventa il capo del 23° squadrone di fattorini.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_3_DESC.text: Un giorno, il clan viene attaccato dai demoni e Sigruna ne abbatte moltissimi, maneggiando l'arco come se fosse nata per questo scopo. Poco dopo, una dea compare davanti a lei, chiedendole di usare il suo potere per salvare il mondo.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_4_DESC.text: Il re ha notato la capacità di Robin Hood di sradicare la corruzione, così gli chiede di prendere di mira i suoi amministratori disonesti.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_5_DESC.text: Grazie al successo di R-1, Road Industry riceve un grande sostegno dall'impero e infine crea l'androide supremo, R-0, il quale però conserva i ricordi di R-9999 e quindi si mette in cerca della verità sulla sua esistenza.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_6_DESC.text: L'ultima notte del torneo, quando viene annunciato il vincitore, Giparang tende l'arco mentre tutti trattengono il respiro. Per tutta la competizione, non ha mancato un solo bersaglio e ora gli resta un'ultima freccia. Tutti osservano ipnotizzati i suoi movimenti. Con un sibilo, scaglia la freccia verso la luna. Nessuno sa perché abbia compiuto questo gesto, ma poco dopo comincia a diffondersi la leggenda che Giparang abbia abbattuto la luna.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_7_DESC.text: Hikari confessa la propria invidia alla sorella Kaori, la quale le dice di seguire la propria strada. Da quel giorno, Hikari ripone tutte le speranze nel suo arco e non manca mai un bersaglio.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_8_DESC.text: Dopo la guerra, Niven fu nuovamente imprigionata, ma evase insieme ai suoi seguaci, i quali cominciarono a chiamarla lo Spettro dei Gelomonti.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_9_DESC.text: Arona sposò il magistrato e usò il figlio Sworden per liberare Mondrian di prigione. A quel punto, Arona e Sworden denunciarono il magistrato corrotto e lo fecero esiliare.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_4_1_DESC.text: Hong-Ran could never forget about the beautiful fireworks she watched at a festival when she was young. She decides to become a great fireworks craftsman. She always quotes, "I will become the greatest Queen of fireworks!".

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_5_1_DESC.text: Hong-Ran becomes the disciple of a famous fireworks craftsman. While she was training, she met Jin-Kyung and had a deep conversation about each other's future. Being inspired by Jin-Kyung's vision and diligence, she decided to work even harder to achieve her dreams.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_6_1_DESC.text: Hong-Ran becomes the best fireworks craftsman in the empire. One day the emperor himself asked Hong-Ran to prepare for the national festival for Jin-Kyung. Excited to hear that, Hong-Ran works her hardest for Jin-Kyung to present the best festival. However, she was accidentally sucked up by the dimensional portal which opened up mysteriously.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GG_4_1_DESC.text: He almost got murdered by the Assassin's Guild, but a healing master saved his life and Chipp became his disciple. However, there was an attack from the Assasin's Guild and the master sacrificed himself to save Chipp. Since then Chipp's life is all about revenge.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GG_5_1_DESC.text: During his trip he met various people, and realized that having more power is necessary to get rid of infelicities. In order to be the most powerful person, he decided to become the chief of the nation, the president.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GG_6_1_DESC.text: Chipp became a president of East Chipp Kingdom, the unauthorized state. To be recognized as an authorized state he seeks Ramlethal, who is fighting against the world. Finally he finds Ramlethal, but due to the unexpected change in dimension, he and his fellows arrived at Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_KOF2_MAI_4_DESC.text: A kunoichi of the Shiranui clan, a family of a long line of ninjas. Mai becomes infatuated on sight with Andy Bogard, her grandfather Hanzo's disciple, but Andy remains uninterested and shies away from her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_KOF2_MAI_5_DESC.text: Mai comes to hear of a tournament called "The King of Fighters," in which famous fighters come to test their strength. Mai too enters in hopes of proposing to Andy after winning the tournament. Yet it is revealed that "The King of Fighters" is a part of a greater scheme to revive Orochi, the eight-headed snake entity.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_KOF2_MAI_6_DESC.text: The tournament falls apart in chaos due to Orochi's revival. However, Mai does not flee but instead searches for Andy in the uproar. At that moment, there is a brilliant explosion, resulting in a crack in the dimension which transports Mai to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_10_DESC.text: A resident of Elandia, the Holy City of the Order. She herself is not religious, but settled down in the Holy City for its peaceful neighborhood and excellent accommodations.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_1_DESC.text: Nuovo arrivato, che ha appena imparato a maneggiare un'arma da fuoco. Nessuno sa se diventerà uno sceriffo o un fuorilegge.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_2_DESC.text: Un avventuriero che porta sempre con sé una pistola, anche se non è capace di usarla.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_3_DESC.text: Pistolera appena arrivata nell'area del deserto. Non si è ancora abituata a usare la pistola, ma sogna di diventare uno sceriffo.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_4_DESC.text: Proprietario di una taverna nell'area occidentale, dove scoppiano spesso delle risse che lo costringono a tenere sempre un fucile a portata di mano.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_5_DESC.text: Poeta che canta le avventure degli eroi. Ogni tanto va ad assistere di persona alle loro avventure.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_6_DESC.text: Born in a slum in Trista. She made her living by stealing and begging, but she was quick-witted and dexterous. People say that her father used to be a legendary hunter.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_7_DESC.text: A soldier from Han, a member of the East Alliance. A veteran of past wars with Chen, but he cannot participate in battles these days due to political conflict.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_8_DESC.text: Tristan soldiers. After defeating the invasion from the Neth Empire Army, are now stuck in a civil war. As Cardinal decides to be on Neth Empire's side in the recent great war, they are seriously worried about the situation.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_9_DESC.text: One of the guardians who protect the desert along with the Desert Warriors. Concerned for Anut's well-being, they followed her to Hero Town.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_10_DESC.text: Teresa got caught stealing from a Western outlaw. She tried to escape by grabbing the outlaw's weapon but accidently shot him.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_11_DESC.text: So called Romantist in the 12 Zodiac Army. He was once beat up by Athena after messing with her. However, his true identity is a spy sent by Achilles. He sneaked in to dig up information on Athena.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_12_DESC.text: The resistance force raised by Yuria in order to resist the Neth Empire. They are not so powerful yet, but they are eager to raise a revolution and found a new Neth Empire.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_13_DESC.text: Misa, the manager sister in charge of the Southwestern Alliance. Usually elegant and sophisticated, she has become rather tough due to the outlaws of the desert she has had to deal with as of late.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_14_DESC.text: Mika, the manager sister in charge of Neth Empire. Although a quiet introvert, she eagerly volunteered to manage the Neth Empire branch when the exchange department was first established. There are rumors that she is secretly a huge fan of the Empire's androids.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_1_DESC.text: Criminale che saccheggia l'area desertica a ovest. Per ovvie ragioni, non va d'accordo con gli sceriffi.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_2_DESC.text: Incaricato di proteggere l'area desertica e di amministrare la giustizia. I fuorilegge combattono spesso tra loro, ma ogni ostilità cessa non appena arriva Maxi.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_3_DESC.text: Criminali che vendono gli oggetti saccheggiati dai fuorilegge sul mercato nero. La loro influenza si estende dalla Nazione occidentale al Regno meridionale, creando gravi problemi a entrambe le regioni.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_4_DESC.text: Studioso dell'Impero Neth dotato di un'irrefrenabile curiosità. Tra gli scienziati pazzi dell'Impero Neth che rinuncerebbero a ogni etica in favore della ricerca, egli è dotato di una mentalità più rigorosa, ma stenta a produrre risultati.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_5_DESC.text: Un giovane che pensa solo a bigiare le lezioni e mangiare schifezze. Getta tutti i rifiuti davanti alla Scuola reale e, dopo un anno trascorso dedicandosi a questa attività, ha trovato 108 modi diversi per lanciarli.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_6_DESC.text: Dopo un addestramento lunghissimo, ha finalmente imparato a maneggiare la pistola e ora è nota per aver arrestato innumerevoli fuorilegge.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_7_DESC.text: Un soldato Falcon. Tutti i pistoleri della Nazione occidentale appartengono alla brigata dei Falcon.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_8_DESC.text: Istruttore dell'area occidentale. Non si sa perché, ma sembra particolarmente gentile con le reclute del gentil sesso, le quali comunque non ricambiano.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_9_DESC.text: Un ragazzino che combina un guaio dietro l'altro. Ha deciso di rinunciare alla sua fionda e di passare a un'arma vera e propria.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_10_DESC.text: Travestito da vecchio bonaccione che ogni anno consegna i regali ai bambini, Babbo Natale in realtà è un sicario e i regali sono i trofei sottratti alle sue vittime.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_11_DESC.text: A Occidente, i Falcon scelgono i più forti tra i loro guerrieri, che entrano a far parte della truppa d'élite denominata Divisione Zero. Tra costoro viene eletto il capitano dei Falcon.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_12_DESC.text: With blood on her hands, Teresa ran away. Teresa struggled to survive with all her might.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_13_DESC.text: A twin soldier in the 12 Zodiac Army. They became orphaned after their mercenary parents died in a war, and spent their childhood in an orphanage. Due to that experience, they never trust anyone except Athena and themselves.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_14_DESC.text: The sheriff force consists of moguls from Trista and Valencia to control the lawless wilderness. Leopard Girls are also a part of that force, conducting operations individually after their leader Rochefort disappeared.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_15_DESC.text: A thief of the back alley. One day she is caught red-handed while stealing Carl's belongings, but Carl, instead of handing her over to the sentry guards, brings her to the Order of the Blue Blood and starts training her. Having grown both in body and mind in Carl's care, Jacie is knighted as one of the Twelve Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_16_DESC.text: One of the Twelve Cobalt Knights of the Order of the Blue Blood. Lahire comes from a famous family of merchants, as prominent as the distinguished Pelancia family. True to his family name, Lahire has long been the treasurer of the Cobalt Knights. Strangely, his personality is reversed whenever a gun falls into his hands.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_1_DESC.text: Un panda inferiore che ha deciso di vendicarsi dei cacciatori che hanno rapito la sua amata: Pan inferiore.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_2_DESC.text: Cadetto spaziale verde. In realtà, sarebbe il cadetto spaziale rosa, ma ha fatto cambio dopo che quest'ultimo l'ha supplicata per ore. È l'unica donna del gruppo, ma nessuno lo sa, ora che ha cambiato colore.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_3_DESC.text: Guardia del Regno meridionale. Queste guardie brandiscono sempre una pistola, ma se la cavano meglio con la spada.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_4_DESC.text: È incaricata della sicurezza dell'Impero Neth. Pare che il tasso di arresti di fuorilegge sia più alto nell'Impero rispetto all'area desertica.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_5_DESC.text: Ricercatore di ingegneria magica. Pochi nell'Impero Neth si dedicano a questa professione, la cui popolarità è però in ascesa.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_6_DESC.text: Gruppo di ragazze che indossano un mantello rosso. Hanno un aspetto innocente, ma in realtà sono una banda di ladre, che celano le loro vere intenzioni sotto il cappuccio.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_7_DESC.text: Criminali in combutta con la mafia, ma meno violenti. Spesso si ritrovano alla taverna locale a tracannare birra.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_8_DESC.text: Musicista non apprezzato dalla propria scuola che, per hobby, ha realizzato strumenti che sembrano armi. Ora è noto come esperto in tecniche di sopravvivenza, ma nessuno sa che suona ancora di nascosto.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_9_DESC.text: Abilissima con le armi e nel catturare i fuorilegge, D'Artagnan combatte nella guerra tra l'Impero Neth e la Nazione occidentale, dove attira l'attenzione dei moschettieri, i quali le chiedono di unirsi a loro. Nonostante il numero ristretto, sono una potente forza della Nazione occidentale.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_CHOCOLA_HW_DESC.text: Chocolat prepared a lot for Halloween. When Bridget visited her shop, she sighed deeply. Bridget gave Chocolat a special gift, mentioning that it may help her chase off the naughty kids and increase sales. It was a pumpkin shooting gun!

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_RUNAWAY_FUGUS_DESC.text: Fergus became very poor after his Ent Robot, ate up all of his fortune, and was destroyed by mercenary leaders. On the run from angry mercenary leaders, he disguises himself with a cloak, but insists on wearing his broken pair of goggles as if to prove something.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_10_DESC.text: Abile cacciatore che si guadagna da vivere cacciando piccole prede. Nonostante sia un abile tiratore, ha un animo buono e cerca sempre di evitare i conflitti. Si è ritrovato coinvolto nella lotta contro i mostri, ma la cosa lo mette a disagio e gli causa grandi sensi di colpa.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_11_DESC.text: Teresa met Melissa, who was on a mission in the wilderness. After listening to Teresa's story, Melissa took Teresa to the Order of the Goddesses.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_12_DESC.text: The captain of a small mercenary in Ryu. He is a leader of both exceptional skill and leadership, but - sick and tired of the political chaos of the Eastern kingdoms - spends his days quietly in the countryside, hiding his abilities.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_13_DESC.text: A girl who joined Tristan's mercenary soldiers when she was very young. At first she was just a messenger, but she soon became recognized for her outstanding ability with weapons. Her fist mission was to assassinate Victoria who is the Chief Knight of Grancia in the Central Empire. To accomplish her mission, she secretely infiltrates Grancia.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_14_DESC.text: She used to be just an ordinary girl but loses her parents during the Neth-Trista war. She was in a great despair waiting for her death right before the last bombardment, but a man in black with gas mask on dramatically saves her at the moment. Following that man, Spiny becomes a soldier as well.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_15_DESC.text: A rookie detective Dox. He is enthusiastic but doesn't have enough deductive reasoning to capture criminals. To hide his lack of skill, he often quips 'The criminal is...! I will tell you later.' Recently, he's heard rumors that traveling merchants are selling a potion that will make him a great detective.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_16_DESC.text: Lorelei may be one of the greatest archaeologists of Hasla - but a lack of subsidies means she must always worry for her next meal. In order to make a sufficient living, Lorelei publishes her travel journal under the title of "The Chronicles of Hasla: the Book of Desert."

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_17_DESC.text: A valiant soldier of Valencia who has a habit of picking up strange people. Her extraordinary skill in gunmanship as well as leadership raises the expectations of many, but Scarlet refuses to adhere to them and instead runs away from home to become a pirate hunter. Her target this time is a pirate named Drake.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_18_DESC.text: A Frost Elf of mixed blood (her father was a human). For her mixed heritage, Raven is ostracized in her tribe; to overcome her loneliness she often leaves the village to go explore the landscapes of Nosgard. One day, Raven sees for the very first time a human with a gun, and coincidentally succeeds in acquiring a gun for herself.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_19_DESC.text: A boy who grew up in a country village of hunters. Strangely popular among the animals, Momotaro becomes surrounded by dancing pheasants and fruit-offering monkeys whenever he enters the forest.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_1_DESC.text: Durante la guerra, le forze dell'Impero Neth lasciavano freddamente indietro i soldati feriti, mentre D'Artagnan si occupava di proteggere i propri amici, divenendo così un baluardo di compassione e giustizia.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_20_DESC.text: A young girl whose family was killed by 'cultists.' When their home was attacked, Luicilla hid under her bed and had to watch her parents murdered at the hands of the 'cultists.' With the sound of one final gunshot, Luicilla closed her eyes and lost consciousness. When she came to, she found a gun in her hand and all the assailants dead and strewn across her home.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_21_DESC.text: Despite being the heir to the noble house of La Fer of Trista, Athos is more interested in finding the next delicious restaurant, rather than care for matters of his household. While on his way to Valencia for the exceptional seafood cuisine, he stumbles upon the Musketeers in the Desert, and eagerly accepts their invitation to share  lunch.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_2_DESC.text: L'unica donna sceriffo che combatte i fuorilegge in un'area desertica; è molto popolare non solo tra gli sceriffi, ma anche tra i criminali, alcuni dei quali si fanno arrestare apposta pur di starle accanto.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_3_DESC.text: Membro dell'organizzazione segreta Neth N.D.D., nella quale è entrato perché ammira molto Viper.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_4_DESC.text: Membro dell'organizzazione segreta Neth N.D.D., convinto che lavorando sodo per il proprio paese potrà portare la pace nel mondo.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_5_DESC.text: Cacciatore di mostri che indossa una maschera bianca con una sorta di becco. Non si conosce il suo vero nome, ma tutti lo chiamano Corvo. Nonostante la sua abilità, adotta metodi troppo brutali, per cui i suoi clienti esitano prima di commissionargli un incarico.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_6_DESC.text: Pistolero che prova un grande senso di colpa per la perdita dei familiari per mano dei demoni. Non ha più voglia di vivere e vaga per le strade di notte.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_7_DESC.text: Era a capo della nona divisione delle truppe dei Falcon, finché il suo battaglione è stato spazzato via dall'Impero Neth. Sopraffatta dal dolore, fa un patto con il diavolo per ottenere proiettili che non mancano mai il bersaglio.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_8_DESC.text: Un robot progettato per aiutare le persone, ma modificato da Stein per renderlo una macchina da guerra. La Sentinella diviene il modello di base per una serie di robot chiamati Vaporis.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_9_DESC.text: Mandy venera gli eroi dei suoi fumetti preferiti e si è perfino messa in lista d'attesa per entrare nel distaccamento locale dell'Associazione dei supereroi di Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_10_DESC.text: Il battaglione di Wilhelm è stato spazzato via dal cavaliere oscuro Vane, che nemmeno il grande guerriero è riuscito a sconfiggere. Svenuto dopo la disfatta, al risveglio scopre di essere stato accecato dalla spada di Vane.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_11_DESC.text: Teresa joined the calvary at Melissa's recommendation. With outstanding skills and strong obedience, Teresa soon became a true soldier. One day, she heard a rumor that Melissa was murdered by a demon.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_12_DESC.text: While carrying out a mission assigned by Oda, a new shogun of Ryu, Saiga feels drawn to him and his values and becomes one of his men. Siaga comes to dream of ending the civil war in the Eastern kingdoms once and for all, together with Oda.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_13_DESC.text: From outside the castle Tia is always seeking a chance to assassinate Victoria, but she can never catch Victoria alone. So Tia disguises herself as a maid for the Blue Blood Knights and sneaks in.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_14_DESC.text: After being fatally wounded in battle, the girl wakes up in the laboratories of Rapture Science... but no past nor memory of her former self remains. Only the cold steel of the mechanical parts replacing her tattered body, and unconditional loyalty towards her savior, remain. And so Code Name Spiny is born.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_15_DESC.text: Dox took a mysterious medicine and falls asleep. When he woke up, he was turned into a dog-man with outstanding sense of smelling and hearing! However, his sense of vision also became like that of a dog, so he cannot distinguish people's faces anymore.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_16_DESC.text: The Chronicles of Hasla becomes a bestseller throughout the continent, and Lorelei succeeds in making a lot of money. Armed now with better equipment, Lorelei embarks on a long journey to explore the lands of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_17_DESC.text: When Drake, for his service of protecting Valencia, is honored by the king with a title of nobility, Scarlet is forced to renounce her intentions of capturing the pirate. Arguing that the sins of the pirate still remain unforgiven, the furious Scarlet departs from Valencia.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_18_DESC.text: Raven soon becomes used to her new gun, and goes out hunting. Since the Frost Elves strictly forbid contact with "the outside," Raven is banished from the tribe. Raven, then heads for the outside world leaving behind her parents graves.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_19_DESC.text: Although Momotaro learns to hunt as according to the customs of his village, he cannot bring to harm his animal friends. As a result he cannot make a living, and finds himself poor and deserted. One day, a white dog visits the saddened Momotaro and gives him a piece of paper - which turns out to be a treasure map.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_1_DESC.text: Sopravvissuta a numerose battaglie senza perdere la propria fede, è divenuta un simbolo di devozione per il popolo e la sua fama si estende ormai ovunque.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_20_DESC.text: The orphaned Luicilla joins the Order of the Goddess. For years she trains for her revenge, but her trauma keeps her from even aiming her gun properly at the mark. At last the opportunity arrives to fulfill her role as the Grand Inquisitor and execute the pagans who murdered her family - only for her to fall into a trap, putting the Grand Inquisitors in danger of annihilation.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_21_DESC.text: Tears of gastronomic exhilaration run down Athos's cheeks after the first ginger taste of the Musketeers' lunch. On his way home, Athos vows upon his taste buds to become a Musketeer. After that eventful day Athos begins to train for his dreams, ignoring his family's disapproval. Athos's reknown as a surprisingly talented combatant gradually grows, until he is admitted into the Musketeers.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_2_DESC.text: Il fatto che il tasso di arresti sia inferiore nel deserto rispetto all'Impero Neth la motiva a impegnarsi al massimo. Vuole colpire un grosso covo di fuorilegge con un'operazione che ha denominato "Transumanza".

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_3_DESC.text: Dopo la promozione a ufficiale dell'N.D.D., Spyro vuole diventare perfino migliore di Viper.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_4_DESC.text: Viper ottiene rispetto grazie alla sua grande abilità, ma l'Impero Neth lo vende a un'altra nazione in cambio di un'ingente somma di denaro. Sentendosi tradito, Viper giura di combattere contro l'impero.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_5_DESC.text: Dopo aver sentito le voci sulle proprie gesta, Corvo decide di dare la caccia ai mostri in modo più cavalleresco, così ora la gente lo chiama Corvo gentiluomo. Stranamente, questi suoi metodi l'hanno reso ancora più temuto tra i suoi nemici.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_6_DESC.text: Vincent incontra il demone che ha sterminato la sua famiglia e lo attacca furibondo, ma viene gravemente ferito. Riesce comunque a sopravvivere e, da quel momento, la vendetta diviene il suo unico scopo di vita.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_7_DESC.text: Accecata dalla rabbia per aver perso la propria famiglia, prende di mira l'Impero Neth, indebolendolo mediante l'eliminazione di una persona alla volta.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_8_DESC.text: Durante l'invasione di Nemesi, Stein acquisì un'imponente mole di dati, che gli consentì di migliorare la Sentinella e di spingerla fino ai limiti delle conoscenze attuali.

TEXT_CHA_HU_5_9_DESC.text: Finalmente, Mandy può combattere il male al fianco di un misterioso supereroe, ma scopre che non potrà diventare a sua volta un'eroina finché un altro eroe non si ritirerà dall'Associazione.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_10_DESC.text: Wilhelm si sente oltraggiato. Dato che non può curare la propria cecità, decide di assassinare colui che ne è la causa. Dopo essersi ristabilito parte quindi in cerca di Vain. Il suo dolore è un monito costante del suo desiderio di vendetta.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_11_DESC.text: Teresa was ordered to abandon her search for Melissa's killer, but she refused and left the Order to join the 'Night Witches.'

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_12_DESC.text: Yet Saiga comes to question Oda's policies before soon. He leaves Oda, and returns to his peaceful life in the countryside. However, when he hears that Oda has earned the powers of the Primal Flames and is now calling himself 'Dark Lord of the Sixth Heaven,' slaughtering all who come before his way, Saiga returns to stop him.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_13_DESC.text: One day, another faction attempts to murder Victoria but Tia accidentally saves Victoria's life. Tia gets promoted to an official armed maid and becomes Victoria's personal assistant. However, Tia is still seeking a chance to assassinate Victoria.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_14_DESC.text: With no fear of death or war, Spiny lives and dies to fight. After her defeat to Viper and Mamba of the Neth Resistance Army, the frustrated Spiny continues to replace her own bone and blood with steel and blade - and so a human girl dies only to be reborn as a fighting machine.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_15_DESC.text: A request from a secret company in Hasla 'L.C' is sent to Dox. The request is to return the stolen L.C 1st anniversary party invitation from the phantom thief 'Lupeow'. It is now up to Sherlock Dox's sense of smell, to penetrate the outstanding disguse of Lupeow!

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_16_DESC.text: Having explored many ruins and discovered numerous artifacts, Lorelei finally completes "The Chronicles of Hasla." Containing not only newly discovered facts but the true and complete history of Hasla, Lorelei's journal becomes a book of legend: the ultimate guide to truth for the archaeologists and historians of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_17_DESC.text: Yet before long Drake resumes his life of piracy, and Scarlet returns to Valencia to enter the navy, finally capturing her long-awaited rival. Proficient and confident in her goal, Scarlet rushes through the ranks to become the admiral of the Valencian navy. The seas of Valencia shall be peaceful as long as Scarlet guards their waters.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_18_DESC.text: In order to survive the hostile cold of the Nosgard mountains, Raven hunts down animals with her sharp hawkeye. She sometimes comes across Neth soldiers and acquires various guns and artillery from them, disassembling and studying them in her spare time. With her newfound knowledge, Raven invents a gun of her own creation to withstand the wilderness of the North.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_19_DESC.text: Momotaro sets out to find treasure with his animal friends: the white dog, a pheasant, and a monkey. He succeeds in arriving at an island with their help, where he finds a scary demon guarding the treasure. Momotaro defeats the demon and brings back the treasure that it had stolen and accumulated for years, becoming the richest man in the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_1_DESC.text: Non si arrende mai e la sua tenacia è leggendaria. Ogni uomo della Nazione occidentale la invidia.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_20_DESC.text: When the last gunshot rings over the battlefield, Luicilla loses her consciousness - as she did on the day of her parents' death. The unconscious Luicilla kills all the pagans with deadly precision, and the last thing her enemies see before their deaths is her cold, blood-red eyes. Luicilla only regains her senses after the death cry of the last pagan fade away into the distance, and she sits amidst the blood and the corpses, puzzled over her current situation.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_21_DESC.text: Despite his initial happiness, Athos quickly discovers that nothing good lasts forever, and that there can be too much of a good thing: he finds himself tired of the same 'Musketeer cuisine' day after day. When Rochefort remarks on the need for a trustworthy scout patrolling the land of Hasla, Athos eagerly offers himself up, all  while planning out what he calls 'the Complete Cuisine Adventures, Continental Edition.' Watch out, chefs of Hasla, Athos is coming to town!

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_2_DESC.text: Grazie al successo della sua operazione Transumanza", riceve una decorazione "Testa di cavallo onoraria" che andrebbe esposta in casa... Lei invece se la porta sempre dietro, per incutere terrore nei fuorilegge.

TEXT_CHA_HU_6_3_DESC.text: Quando Viper decide di lottare contro l'Impero Neth, Spyro rimane molto deluso, così si offre volontario per affrontarlo e viene promosso comandante dell'N.D.D.
