Therefore it comes as a very big surprise when Harpya comes face-to-face with the ruthless Ares, who has been poaching on the mountain. She is immediately captured and taken to the Republic of Roman.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_21_DESC.text: A warrior succeeding the lost occult swordsmanship of the Desert. Having protected Osiris from a very young age, Isis regards him as a younger brother and her own kin, dousing him with affection at the slightest chance. Their companion Set, however, disapproves of Isis's rather suffocating attachment, and the two argue quite often.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_2_DESC.text: Ragazza che vuole diventare cavaliere per vendicare la morte dei genitori, pur sapendo che si tratta di un'ardua impresa per una donna. Per questo ha deciso di rafforzarsi e smentire questo pregiudizio.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_3_DESC.text: È diventato un guerriero dopo aver ucciso un mostruoso serpente gigante. Di certo era molto forte anche prima, e il titolo di guerriero ne è il riconoscimento formale.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_4_DESC.text: Diretta discendente della famiglia reale dei diavoli, Devilius. Il padre l'ha cacciata di casa perché se ne stava sempre sul divano. È forse l'unica che si può "mandare al diavolo" senza rischiare di offenderla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_5_DESC.text: Nell'Impero Neth vi sono numerosi gruppi scientifici. Scienza estatica ha avviato il progetto Monte dopo aver rubato i dati di ricerca di Road Industry sulla serie R. Proto Monte è un prototipo, il cui obiettivo è trovare R-0 e ottenere ulteriori dati.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_6_DESC.text: Studentessa internazionale del Regno orientale. Viene discriminata nel club di kendo solo perché proviene da un altro regno, ma lei prosegue dritta per la sua strada. Ha una sorella di nome Hikari.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_7_DESC.text: Principe della Nazione occidentale che è salito al trono con l'aiuto di un nobile sacerdote. Tuttavia, il suo regno è stato breve: infatti, i suoi avversari gli hanno rubato l'anima con un infame rituale. Il sacerdote gli consiglia di recarsi nell'Impero Neth per cercare aiuto, ma ormai non ha più alcuna capacità decisionale.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_8_DESC.text: Tempo addietro, la Tribù dei Lupi era in costante conflitto con gli Elfi del Gelo. Allora Uzimant era un giovane guerriero lupo e si innamorò della principessa elfica.

TEXT_CHA_WA_4_9_DESC.text: Figlio di un ricco magistrato, precipitò nella miseria più nera dopo che il padre abbandonò moglie e figlio. Spinto dalla rabbia, partì in cerca di vendetta.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_10_DESC.text: Isabel thought her twisted appearance would curse her to forever walk alone, so she was shocked to meet people who were kind enough to take her in despite her appearance. Little did she know, that the evil lingering in her body had other plans. It slaughtered the kind folk, driving Isabel into a mindless frenzy.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_11_DESC.text: Rochefort's exploits could no longer be ignored, and he was allowed admission into the Musketeers.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_12_DESC.text: To resist the Tristan army invading the Eastern sea, Koxinga leads the navy force himself through great danger. When he gloriously returns to the nation after defeating the army, the King grants him the title, Aqua king.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_13_DESC.text: Victoria does not spare herself from battle. She leads her knights from the front and her armor is rarely not stained with blood. However, she slowly gains the respect of Alexander and he appoints her to the position of Chief Knight of the Kingdom.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_14_DESC.text: From his journey, Lionel finds out about his family's sins and hears the criticism from around the world. He keeps traveling to gather the scattered remnants of his family's power in order to revive them and recover their honor.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_15_DESC.text: Arita wakes up from a deep sleep and finds out that her family has collapsed. She decides to trail after the witch and leaves on a long journey. However, she is able to do without any sleep. After arriving the witch's house, she reveals the truth from her diary.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_16_DESC.text: Although Sien and Faust promise to marry after one last expedition against fighting monsters, Sien is killed in battle while defending Faust's life. Sien, however - cannot rest in death - for Faust casts a forbidden spell to revive her as an undead monster, a "jiangsi."

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_17_DESC.text: Before long, Borgos realizes that people only love him when he plays the role of the villain. Desperate for attention, Borgos volunteers himself as a henchman to an evil villain. Armed with a face that strikes fear into the hearts of others, Borgos finds himself to have unwittingly become the Evil Lord of Darkness himself.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_18_DESC.text: One day, Bihyeongrang hurt his eyes. While he was distressed with his injury, he saw the death angel and ghost. The death angel was surprised that she could be seen. Eventually, the two became close and spent time together. Bihyeongrang felt pitty towards the death angel working so hard, and decided to help her.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_19_DESC.text: One day, a young witch named Dorothy visits the hermitic Shasha. Recognizing her as human, Shasha attacks Dorothy, but the young witch only asks to be taught the magic of fire. The fire witch accepts Dorothy as a pupil, but only to be spiteful.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_1_DESC.text: Le dee hanno incaricato Leon di salvare il mondo. Finalmente potrà dare sfogo alla sua sete di avventura!

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_20_DESC.text: Ares takes note of Harpya's strength and forces her into battle as his soldier. In spite of her initial reluctance, Harpya finds herself being drawn more and more into the world of war and death with every bloody battle.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_21_DESC.text: When Osiris declares that he will set out on a journey in search for the past, Isis insists on following - because who else would protect Osiris against all the dangers of the road? Set, however, becomes enraged at Isis, arguing that overprotection never results in a good outcome, and that Osiris must take this opportunity to learn how to be his own man.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_2_DESC.text: Dopo un rigoroso addestramento, Giovanna d'Arco è diventata cavaliere, ma ha dovuto nascondere la sua identità di donna. Per fortuna, l'armatura da uomo l'ha aiutata a mantenere il segreto.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_3_DESC.text: Da quando è diventato un guerriero, Susanoo non ha perso una sola battaglia e la gente non riesce ancora a capacitarsi del fatto che abbia ucciso quel serpente mostruoso.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_4_DESC.text: Vivian si è addestrata incanalando la rabbia verso il padre. Intende invadere l'oltretomba e spodestare il genitore, ma quando arriva a casa, trova soltanto un biglietto che dice: "Sono andato a pesca".

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_5_DESC.text: Il nuovo Monte, prodotto usando i dati ottenuti da Proto Monte distrutto da R-0. Al fine di acquisire ulteriori dati, è stato prodotto in serie e l'obiettivo di tutte queste unità è R-0.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_6_DESC.text: Kaori diventa la nuova leader del club di kendo sconfiggendo il capo precedente. A molti la cosa non va giù, ma hanno troppa paura per ribellarsi.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_7_DESC.text: Pur avendo perduto l'anima, continua a odiare il fratello Caino. Dedica la sua vita allo sterminio dei demoni, nella speranza di riconquistare la propria anima.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_8_DESC.text: Uzimant vuole dimostrare la sua abilità in battaglia per ascendere al trono del suo popolo e unificare il suo clan con quello degli Elfi del Gelo.

TEXT_CHA_WA_5_9_DESC.text: Sworden fece carriera e divenne magistrato, ma ben presto scoprì che il potere l'avrebbe corrotto e così, rifiutandosi di diventare come il padre, giurò a se stesso di trovare un nuovo scopo nella vita.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_10_DESC.text: Isabel is haunted by dreams of what she did during her mindless quest for vengeance. She resolves to turn her hatred toward the Necromancer who ruined her life. She learns to master the evil inside her and use it for her own goals.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_11_DESC.text: His name became a symbol of victory in Trista, and his legend grew among the people. However, his heart belonged to a single person.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_12_DESC.text: As he gains more support throughout the nation, some treacherous forces deceive the King in order to maintain their power. As a result, the King sends him to an uninhabited island crowded with pirates. He continously develops the island while defeating pirates, and gains great public support. People praise him as the Ocean king.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_13_DESC.text: Victoria leaves the battlefield due to Alexander's decision. However, she gives her word that she will come back if the soldiers need a victory. Her position as Chief Knight of the Kingdom causes her to become the target of enemies abroad. Those enemies start to come from within, as the kingdom grows to include nations that were once enemies.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_14_DESC.text: Lionel becomes renowned as the dark knight. He decides to head toward Edenberg, a city in Neth Empire to make a contribution to the war which may help him revive his family. At Edenberg, he meets the woman of destiny.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_15_DESC.text: Arita was chosen as the test subject for an experiment conducted years ago in the Neth Empire, which was to modify a human with magical talent into an android. Arita's parents tried to protect her by making a contract with the witch, and in return Arita was selected as the 2nd Forest Witch.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_16_DESC.text: Despite having been revived, Sien is not Sien - for she has lost all her memories in life. She does not react to anything save for the allure of darkness, and she often disappears, always wandering after its trail...

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_17_DESC.text: The new Evil Overlord Borgos of Darkness is pleased to hear his enemy, the Gatcha Rangers, have vowed to never leave him alone until he is defeated. Touched by the Gatcha Rangers' unfailing perserverance, Borgos vows to meet up to their expectations by becoming the best Evil Overlord of Darkness that Hasla has ever seen.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_18_DESC.text: Bihyeongrang was invited to the underworld for helping the death angel. The king of the underworld proceeds to tell Bihyeongrang that he is actually a descendant of the Ghost King and was born to become a ruler of ghosts. Bihyeongrang accepts his fate and decides to help humans by controlling ghosts.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_19_DESC.text: But as time goes by, Shasha comes to acknowledge Dorothy's genius and kind spirit, and starts to wholeheartedly teach her. After Dorothy finishes her studies and leaves her side, Shasha begins to ponder over the human race. She finally decides to set out into the world and go see for herself the true spirit of humans, unclouded by her long hatred.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_1_DESC.text: Ogni volta che Leon affronta il male, una luce accecante circonda il suo corpo, irradiando un'impenetrabile energia. I mostri tremano alla vista di Leon della luce.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_20_DESC.text: As time passes, Harpya becomes increasingly horrified at her change into a belligerent killer, even as her pure enjoyment of fighting spurs her to continue. Her transformation is complete: she is now the dreaded monster of the battlefield, preying on the death in the shadows, looking forward to every battle that each break of day will bring.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_21_DESC.text: After much bickering, the three companions set out on their journey, at the end of which they at last discover the Rosetta Stone. Isis notices that on the Stone are engraved the words 'Only the Loyal Warrior of the Desert shall pave, for the Guide of the Lost, the road to all that is forgotten and bygone.' At that moment, a mysterious power flows into Isis - an ancient power that she feels to be somewhat familiar...

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_2_DESC.text: Pur avendo rivelato la sua identità femminile, il suo comportamento stoico e la sua calma in battaglia le hanno fatto meritare l'appellativo di Cavaliere d'acciaio.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_3_DESC.text: Grazie alle notevoli doti in combattimento, Susanoo è divenuto uno shogun. Gli altri guerrieri sono invidiosi delle sue capacità, ma lo ammirano al punto da accettarlo come loro condottiero.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_4_DESC.text: Per chiarirsi le idee, Vivian scatena una guerra, ma sorprendentemente gli altri diavoli si arrendono all'istante. Così acquisisce il titolo di Diavolo supremo.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_5_DESC.text: Il sacrificio di migliaia di Monte in serie ha consentito di completare l'acquisizione dei dati. Ora Scienza estatica ha affidato a Monte Cristo la missione di distruggere R-0.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_6_DESC.text: Kaori primeggia nei tornei di kendo in tutto il regno ed è così brava che ora tutti vogliono entrare nel suo club.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_7_DESC.text: Finalmente Abele affronta il fratello Caino e, dopo un faticoso duello, entrambi sono gravemente feriti. L'Impero Neth recupera il corpo di Abele e lo cura con magia e tecnologia avanzata, per cui può continuare a perseguire la propria vendetta.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_8_DESC.text: Uzimant diviene il capo del suo clan e sposa la figlia del re degli Elfi del Gelo. Inconsapevole dell'animosità serpeggiante tra i due clan, un giorno Uzimant trova la propria sposa assassinata in camera da letto. Accecato dalla rabbia, Uzimant muove guerra agli Elfi.

TEXT_CHA_WA_6_9_DESC.text: Deciso a fare ammenda per la malvagità del padre, Sworden divenne capitano delle guardie. Questo, però, gli fece scoprire che nella vita non è tutto bianco o nero, come credeva.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_1_DESC.text: Genius prosecutor from the Holy Knights. His looks, charisma and talent as a fencer make him popular among the citizens. He thinks of Sol as a rival, and he has to compete against Sol's outgoing personality.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_2_DESC.text: A researcher who studied high-end technology in another dimension. His coleague 'That Man' betrayed him. Sol lost his lover and was converted into a human/machine weapon as a result of the betrayal. He vowed to use his newfound power to get revenge upon 'That Man'. He wanders the land in search of gears so that he may complete his revenge.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_3_DESC.text: Assassin from another dimension. Millia became an orphan during the Holy War. 'Jato', the Assassin leader has raised her since then. She is now a decent Assassin member, mainly because of Jato and has used prohibited spells gaining the ability to handle her hairs quite freely.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_4_DESC.text: The leader of the Jellyfish air pirates from another dimension. He became an orphan during the holy war and has stood alone since then. He finds out that there are many other people facing the same circumstance. To save them he organized the Jellyfish air pirates.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_5_1_DESC.text: Ky was recognized for his contribution during the Holy War and became the King of Iryulia. However, Iryulia faces collapse after the attack from 'Ruthless Revelation'. Ky managed to save Iruylia and his wife Dizzy with the help of his colleagues.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_5_2_DESC.text: Sol brought down Ramlethal, after she declared war against mankind. However, Sol was just bait to revive Justice the Destroyer. With the help of Ramlethal and her twin sister Elphelt he won over Justice, but Elphelt was caught by 'Ruthless Revelation'.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_5_3_DESC.text: Millia is distressed because of what Assassins do. She betrays the Assassin group which leads to her being hunted. Meanwhile Jato the leader has lost his ego, and his shadow "Eddie" who ruled after him. Unfortunately, he has perished too. As a result this Millia is free, but suffers from hatred and guilt.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_5_4_DESC.text: Johnny journeys off to find a doctor who cures diseases to save May, who is suffering from mysterious headaches. In one village he finds the doctor, and succeeds in asking him to cure May.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_6_1_DESC.text: Ruthless Revelation has continously threatened mankind, leading Ky to investigate how he could stop them. At the moment when he finally found clues about 'Ruthless Revelation', a mysterious magic square led him to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_6_2_DESC.text: As Sol was preparing to go after 'Ruthless Revelation', 'That Man' came to him and asked him to help defeat 'Ruthless Revelation'. Sol was conflicted by this turn of events, and while he was contemplating these complex thoughts, a mysterious magic led Sol to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_6_3_DESC.text: Millia hears a rumor that Jato might still be alive, and starts looking for him. She is attacked by Bed Man the mysterious guy. However Jato appears and saves Millia. Millia and the Assassins start searching for the mysterious guy, when all of a sudden Millia is ditched at Hasla due to an unexpected change in dimension.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_6_4_DESC.text: Johnny contacts 'Liberator' who is essential for curing May and any Japanese who suffer from the same pain. While heading to Colony where Japanese live to meet Liberator, Johnny is ditched at Hasla due to an unexpected change in dimension.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_IORI_4_DESC.text: A member of the Yagami clan, which is at odds with the Kusanagi clan. Iori is both the lead bassist of a popular band and a skilled fighter. He is usually quiet and uninterested in his surroundings, but his hatred for Kyo renders him unstable and belligerent whenver Kyo is around.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_IORI_5_DESC.text: Iori receives an offer to fight in a mysterious fighting tournament, "The King of Fighters," and enters in his animosity against Kyo. It is revealed, however, the tournament is no ordinary competition: it is part of a greater scheme to revive Orochi, the eight-headed snake entity.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_IORI_6_DESC.text: The Yagami clan, known long ago as the Yasakani clan, was one of the three families that sealed Orochi. Yet after being tricked by one of the Hakkesshu, the leader of Yagami clan ended up swearing a blood oath of loyalty to the snake entity. Its descendant and heir, Yagami, is thus controlled by Orochi in an attempt to kill Kyo and Chizuru, the other descendants of the Three Sacred Treasures... But at the last moment Iori awakens and binds Orochi, who directly receives Kyo's final blow - which ends up in a brilliant explosion that transports Iori to the dimension of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_KYO_4_DESC.text: A pyrokinetic student of the Kusanagi clan. Although lazy and rebellious, he is a born fighter of natural skill. Recently he became the champion of the national martial arts competition in Japan.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_KYO_5_DESC.text: Kyo receives an invitation to a mysterious fighting tournament called "The King of Fighters," and once again forms a team with Benimaru Nikaido and Goro Daimon, whom he met during the national martial arts competition. Yet Kyo soon discovers that "The King of Fighters" is no ordinary tournament: it is part of a greater scheme to revive Orochi, the eight-headed snake entity.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_KYO_6_DESC.text: Long ago the three clans of Kusanagi, Yasakani, and Yata succeeded in sealing Orochi. Facing the revived Orochi as his ancestors once did, Kyo gains full control over the Sacred Treasure of Kusanagi. With his final blow against Orochi, Kyo and Orochi's powers collide in a brilliant explosion that transports Kyo to the dimension of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_RUGAL_4_DESC.text: An extremely rich arms dealer of the black market, wealthy enough to own an enormous aircraft carrier. In his youth, Rugal lost one of his eyes in a fight against Goenitz, one of the Hakkesshu, but acquired the power of Orochi in its stead. Ever since then he has been expanding his influence through his powers.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_RUGAL_5_DESC.text: Rugal has a peculiar hobby: defeating strong fighters and making their bodies into "trophies." In order to satisfy his desires, Rugal hosts the fighting tournament "The King of Fighters" and attempts to turn its participants into statues, but is defeated by Kusanagi Kyo. The enraged Rugal, gone mad by his defeat, blows his own aircraft carrier up into flames..

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF1_RUGAL_6_DESC.text: ... but Rugal, believed to be dead, returns much stronger than before: he has replaced his body with mechanical parts and unleashed the power of Orochi. Although he attempts revenge against Kyo, he is once more defeated. Rugal goes beserk, and just before the moment of his self-destruction, a brilliant explosion transports him to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF2_CHRIS_4_DESC.text: A member of the popular rock band 'C_Y_S,' Chris is loved for his cute appearance and innocent smile. He is polite towards everyone, but certain instances betray his seemingly darker nature. His motivation in entering "The King of Fighters" is vengeance towards Iori, who ruined their very first concert.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF2_CHRIS_5_DESC.text: After entering "The King of Fighters," Chris reveals his true self: One of the Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi, and a user of dark flames in opposition to those of the Kusanagi clan. Chris defeats the fighters of the tournament and uses their energy in order to revive Orochi.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF2_CHRIS_6_DESC.text: Chris's plans are foiled by other fighters. However, Orochi succeeds in reincarnation through Chris's body and the energy of defeated contestants. At that moment, the fighters of the Three Sacred Treasures deliver their final blow against Orochi, who flees from Chris's body. The resulting brilliant explosion transports Chizuru to the dimension of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_KOF2_CHRIS_NAME.text: Chris of the Destiny of Flames

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_BLAKE_4_DESC.text: A quiet girl with black hair and amber eyes, Blake has a cynical and quiet personality, and a voracious appetite for books. Her motives for enrolling in Beacon Academy is unknown as Blake seems uninterested in making new friends - or interacting with anyone in general.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_BLAKE_5_DESC.text: Although Blake quickly becomes close to her teammates after entering Team RWBY, she does not hesitate to take the side of the faunus in any faunus-related incidents, causing a rift between herself and Weiss. It's eventually revealed that Blake herself is a cat faunus, explaining her fierce loyalty. After the revelation, Blake and Weiss reconcile their differences, and Team RWBY promises to protect Blake's secret.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_BLAKE_6_DESC.text: When it is decided that Team RWBY will travel to another dimension at Professor Ozpin's behest, Blake decides to prepare for the unknown world and any situation that may arise. She spends the night before their departure reading every book she can find in the library about other worlds. On the day of their departure, Blake is awed by the dimensional rift, but bravely jumps in to the mysterious world of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_WEISS_4_DESC.text: A proud and icy girl with long white hair and pale blue eyes to match. Weiss, the heiress to the Schnee Dust Company, the largest producer of refined Dust in Remnant, has been raised to be the best in everything she does. Her status however, renders her very lonely and prompts her to enroll in Beacon Academy to find her true self - in the form of a Huntress.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_WEISS_5_DESC.text: Weiss's pride often exhibits itself in bossy and selfish behavior, creating conflict even after she becomes a part of Team RWBY. However, she begins to grow close to her teammates who truly care about her and finds herself starting to care about them as well. Her actions these days don't match her nickname "Ice Queen."

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_WEISS_6_DESC.text: Weiss notices anomalies in Vale near Beacon Academy and reports them to Doctor Bartholomew Oobleck. After the Academy's investigation into the phenomenon, Professor Ozpin gives Team RWBY a mission to capture Roman Torchwick in another dimension. Weiss, true to character, begins to meticulously prepare for their journey in the new world, but is dragged into the rift by Ruby before she is ready.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_10_DESC.text: A master of everything from cleaning to cooking. It's thanks to the Church Volunteer that the members of the Order can go about their business!

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_1_DESC.text: Era uno studente modello, finché non ha letto il libro sbagliato... ed è diventato un mago.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_2_DESC.text: Studentessa di arti mistiche. Sostiene che diventerà una grande maga, ma non sa lanciare nemmeno un incantesimo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_3_DESC.text: Nata con un talento latente e una grande affinità con la magia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_4_DESC.text: Un vecchio saggio il cui ginocchio malandato preannuncia l'arrivo della pioggia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_5_DESC.text: Proprietario di un'orologeria in città. Nel tempo libero studia la magia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_6_DESC.text: She was not only smart and polite but she sung very well so everyone liked her. The only problem was that she looked very ordinary...

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_7_DESC.text: A group of magicians named the 13 Management Team in Grancia central Empire. It is not clear about what exactly they are working for.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_8_DESC.text: Soldiers empowered with magical ability due to Neth Empire technology. They can handle various magical weapons. Also, they are famous for annhilating Falcon troops during the Tristan war.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_9_DESC.text: A member of Aubrey's fan club. So far they have successfully hid their identity from Aubrey. It is rumored that they have a rather embarrassing fan club name, but no one knows what it is except for the members themselves.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_10_DESC.text: Cano studied hard to enter the School of Magic. She concentrated on her study to the point of isolation. Still, the people of the village sent her letters to keep her company.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_11_DESC.text: The youngest soldier in the 12 Zodiac Army. He is the son of Aphrodite, with an emotional and fragile characteristic who loves animals. He cries a lot due to bullying by Scorpion. However, there is a woman soldier who pays attention to their relationship.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_12_DESC.text: A researcher who always works hard in order to increase the survival rate of the Neth Resistance Army. He researches and manufactures weapons, which are supplied to resistance troops everywhere in Neth land.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_13_DESC.text: The Library of the Order is open to everyone, but nobody actually dares to visit as they are too scared of the librarian. It's another lonely day for the Order of the Goddess Librarian.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_14_DESC.text: Miki, the manager sister in charge of Pumpkin City. A rebel who loves to play, she is considered the black sheep of the family. There is no place in Hasla that she has not yet visited.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_1_DESC.text: Una giovane che effettua consegne con la scopa mentre si addestra per diventare una vera strega.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_2_DESC.text: Abitante del villaggio con qualche rudimento di magia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_3_DESC.text: A differenza di maghi e streghe comuni, alcuni studenti vengono addestrati fin dall'infanzia per diventare incantatori d'élite. Sono creature solitarie, che però bramano la compagnia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_4_DESC.text: Splendido abitante della foresta. Chi lo incontra continua a tornare nel bosco sperando di rivederlo, ma l'elfo druido non si mostra volentieri agli estranei.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_5_DESC.text: La bibliotecaria reale indica i libri giusti agli studenti della Scuola reale. Si dice che sia la ragazza più bella della scuola ma, dato che tutti i membri della Biblioteca reale indossano grandi occhiali, è impossibile verificarlo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_6_DESC.text: Oltre ad avere un'affinità per la magia, Dorothy ne apprende i concetti con grande facilità. Ha una mente davvero geniale.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_7_DESC.text: Tutti la considerano cordiale e gentile, ma in realtà è una strega malvagia.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_8_DESC.text: Ballerina del famoso saloon imperiale "Giostra al chiaro di luna".

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_9_DESC.text: Ingegnere che realizza i Vaporis. Tutto quello che sa, l'ha imparato da Stein.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_10_DESC.text: Simbolo del Natale. Purtroppo, a causa della crisi economica, non riesce a consegnare i regali a tutti i bambini buoni, così per l'anno prossimo ha pensato di adottare criteri più severi...

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_11_DESC.text: Gli Elfi del Gelo maschi nascono con delle corna che permettono loro di entrare in contatto con la natura e di controllare la magia. La peggiore disgrazia che possa capitare a un Elfo del Gelo è di perdere le corna.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_12_DESC.text: Cano received the highest score on the school's entrance examination. She attended the school talent show and won by singing. However, she accidentally tripped on her way off the stage and her glasses broke... Surprise! She was the most beautiful girl in school!

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_13_DESC.text: A soldier in the 12 Zodiac Army and an old friend of Athena. He knows about the shameful past of Athena, but never talks about it. He is the only soldier who knows the real name of Athena.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_14_DESC.text: A passionate anchor working for the NDW corporation. He is a very talkative person, so reporters often dislike him. However the viewers are attracted by his silver tongue.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_15_DESC.text: A magician formerly of the Thirteenth State of Grancia. An experienced veteran in warfare, she once fought side by side with Victoria to lead the Empire to victory on the battlefield. Afterwards, she leaves the Thirteenth State and follows Victoria to the Order of the Blue Blood, and immediately becomes a Cobalt Knight.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_16_DESC.text: An Inquisitor who captures and punishes those deemed "heretics" in the eyes of the Order of the Goddess. He is not very meticulous in his judgment and tends to prosecute even those who are clearly innocent. He is not very welcome among the residents of the Holy City. The Inquisitor, of course, does not even remotely care, too blinded by his dogged belief that he serves the will of the Goddess.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_1_DESC.text: Un ninja che però se la cava meglio con la magia. Si dice che lanciare incantesimi sia più facile perfino della tecnica ninja più basilare.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_2_DESC.text: Dirigente dell'esercito Neth segretamente innamorata di Spyro. Sostiene che i suoi occhi spenti siano affascinanti.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_3_DESC.text: Si ritiene che bevano sangue, ma in realtà è solo succo di pomodoro. Hanno anche trovato un modo per mangiare l'aglio, nonostante le leggende al riguardo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_4_DESC.text: Quando si sente una voce che canta "do-re-mi... do-re-mi..." tra i monti, gli abitanti del villaggio affermano che si tratti di uno spettro, invece è il pianto della ragazza di montagna smarrita.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_5_DESC.text: Il cadetto spaziale B passa il tempo a rimediare ai guai causati dal cadetto spaziale rosso.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_6_DESC.text: Lontra marina che ha raggiunto il nirvana.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_7_DESC.text: Prototipo di ragazza meccanica ancora in fase di collaudo. Presenta diversi errori... tra cui l'autodistruzione.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_8_DESC.text: Un mago che non potrà lanciare incantesimi finché non avrà offerto un sacrificio al drago Nerofiamma.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_9_DESC.text: Dorothy è molto brava con tutti i 4 elementi magici, ma la sua sete di potere non si è ancora placata.

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_CHOCOLA_VT_DESC.text: Chocolat ha regalato i suoi prodotti da forno a tutti gli eroi, finché non è rimasta al verde. Così, ha chiesto aiuto a Bridget, che le ha dato questo costume...

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_10_DESC.text: Necron studied the forbidden art of necromancy and was cast out of his home by his fellow sorcerers. Swearing revenge, he continues to research necromancy on his own while hiding in a remote village.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_11_DESC.text: Cano became famous as a beautiful genius wizard. One day, a producer from popstar entertainment offered her a chance to be a popstar. Cano became a popstar spreading hope and happiness to people.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_12_DESC.text: The daughter of a rich farmer. She has a great talent in magic but is only interested in baking. She opens her own bakery right on the other side of Chocolat's bakery to compete with her.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_13_DESC.text: An Aristocrat in the local area of Grancia. For some reason, he believes that he is the chosen one of a Goddess and swears to slay the evil opposing the law of the Goddess. As a result, he becomes the judge of the law of the Goddess.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_14_DESC.text: A man who appeared in the world with a bright light from the sky. As soon as Rapture Science in the Neth Empire recognized that Benjamin knows amazingly advanced science technology, they took him to their country secretly. As a result, only few people know about the existance of him.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_15_DESC.text: Lupeow aims to become the perfect phantom thief, but often frustrates due to limitation in human body. One day, she gets inspired by swiftness of a cat, and decides to meet Cat Master Mew to acquire cat's physical capability.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_16_DESC.text: Vesper is one of the longest living demons like Demona, and is a talented magician specialized in water magic. In contrast to Demona who leads the demons, Vesper prefers to live a life in seclusion as she hates any hassle.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_17_DESC.text: A girl who lives in a small village with her younger sister Viola, and has been making dolls from her childhood. Dreaming of creating dolls with lives of their own, Violet immerses herself in studying the art of dollmaking and voodoo magic. Unfortunately, none of the magic dolls she creates succeeds in moving.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_18_DESC.text: She was born with a small flare on her head. The flare couldn't be touched and had warmth. Since she was young, Yichui has been researching ways to get rid of the flare.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_19_DESC.text: One of the direct descendants of the royal lineage of the elven race, Wolfram is also a master of wind, one of the four elements of magic. Weary of life at court, Wolfram has fled her tribe to pursue a life of teaching the art of magic. A city is naturally formed by the many young witches who come to receive her teachings.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_1_DESC.text: Mago e archeologo che studia l'antica magia attraverso le reliquie. Dopo aver sentito parlare di un reperto su un'isola a sud del Regno meridionale, vi si reca immediatamente.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_20_DESC.text: The Enlightened Otter returns home to spread his teachings. A mysterious symbol appears behind his back, and the startled animals, fearing some dark magic, kick him out of the village.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_21_DESC.text: The lone descendant of the Osiris Tribe, one of the three tribes that ruled the Ancient Desert of Hasla. Having lost his own name, Osiris lives by the name of his bygone people, wandering the lands in search of their forgottten history.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_2_DESC.text: A Est, si dice che un uomo in nero venga a prenderti quando stai per morire. Molti non ci credono e Korin è una di questi.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_3_DESC.text: La brama di magia di Dorothy non è sazia, così decide di diventare apprendista delle 4 grandi streghe e di approfondire la magia oscura proibita.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_4_DESC.text: Ragazzo dispettoso che si diverte a travestirsi da pupazzo di neve per sorprendere i passanti ignari.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_5_DESC.text: Lilith sopravvive mutando forma continuamente. Nessuno lo sa, ma in realtà è una strega leggendaria che vive tra gli esseri umani, usandoli come tramite per l'assorbimento del suo potere magico.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_6_DESC.text: Vivian ha una sorellastra di nome Rachel la quale, a differenza della sorella purosangue, è mezza demone e mezza diavolo, per cui non viene riconosciuta dai demoni in quanto è figlia del Sommo diavolo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_7_DESC.text: Indecisa tra gli studi all'Accademia magica e la passione per il famoso gioco di carte "Super Fighting Monsters", lascia gli studi per diventare una giocatrice professionista.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_8_DESC.text: Gli Elfi del Gelo maschi nascono con delle corna che permettono loro di entrare in contatto con la natura e di controllare la magia. Nazrune viveva in pace insieme agli animali.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_9_DESC.text: Primogenito di una famiglia sventurata, Mondrian rimase schiavo dell'alcol finché non conobbe Arona. Ispirato dal suo amore, giurò di riportare la famiglia alla gloria di un tempo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_10_DESC.text: Necron's studies finally led him to summon the hungry dead, but he quickly loses control of them. Even as the spirits devour the people of the village, Necron couldn't help but feel the thrill of his new found power.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_11_DESC.text: Cano became a famous popstar. She studied hard and learned a new spell which can convert the love and hope of her fans into her own power.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_12_DESC.text: Demeter's bakery is experiencing a depression due to Chocolat's sweet desserts. Demeter chooses to develop some healthy food, and starts producing super nutritious wheat for her new products.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_13_DESC.text: As a judge showing outstanding performance Uriel starts working in the Grancia palace. One day, he meets Victoria, and falls in love at first sight. Uriel believes that Victoria is the present incarnation of a Goddess and begins to watch and follow her every move.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_14_DESC.text: Benjamin starts to produce androids with a great support from Rapture Science. After the android production project is coplete,for some reason he discards all the related data regarding on the project. However, some parts of the data secretly flows to Road Industry.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_15_DESC.text: After eating the secret fish bread which Cat Master Mew gave, Lupeow transforms into a part cat.With outstanding ability to disguise and cat-like swift movement, Lupeow soon becomes famous as a notorious thief who can never be arrested.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_16_DESC.text: After a long period of time, Dorothy suddenly visits her. Vesper tries to kick Dorothy out but she soon becomes persuaded by Dorothy's strong enthusiasm. Vesper decides to teach water magic to Dorothy.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_17_DESC.text: One fateful day, monsters ambush Violet's village. Despite the efforts of many heroes, the village defenses crumble due to one warrior's arrogance, leaving the village to the mercy of the rampant monsters. In desperation Violet attempts to protect her sister with her voodoo dolls, but fails. Yet at the very moment of crisis, the magic dolls move for the very first time to protect them both.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_18_DESC.text: As Yichui grew up, so did the flare. It had two little ears and blazing arms that moved without intention. Yichui continued to study very hard to get rid of this flare.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_19_DESC.text: Wolfram names the city 'Pumpkin City,' and declares it a haven for all races, with no tolerance for racial prejudice. But the new and prosperous city draws in many criminals from around the continent, and Wolfram decides to form a security unit composed of witches of Pumpkin City: the 'Night Witches.'

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_1_DESC.text: È riuscito a ottenere un'arcaica magia, ma la sua reliquia e quella appena trovata cominciano a risuonare, facendolo assorbire dall'Arconte.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_20_DESC.text: The Otter, alone and deserted, goes to sleep in a lone cave. That night, he wakes up to see a clam before him, and eats it ravenously. However, upon waking up the next morning, the Otter discovers it to be rotten. The Otter realizes that everything is up to one's mind.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_21_DESC.text: It is in the Anubisis Temple that Osiris discovers an ancient scroll from the days of the Apostles' War. Yet even the scroll does not mention the reason for the Osiris Tribe's extinction, and Osiris turns back, distressed. Yet at the moment that he attempts to leave, a brilliant light suddenly radiates from the Rosetta Stone within the temple.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_2_DESC.text: Un giorno, Korin perde la vita in un incidente. Mentre la sua vista comincia ad appannarsi, compare quella figura vestita di nero...

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_3_DESC.text: Dorothy diventa l'apprendista delle quattro grandi streghe e si reca a nord, a est, a sud e a ovest, addestrandosi con impegno.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_4_DESC.text: Un giorno, seguendo una luce misteriosa, trova delle particelle di ghiaccio che gli fluttuano intorno. Sasquatch, nel panico, cerca aiuto presso gli abitanti della città, i quali fuggono terrorizzati da quel mostro.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_5_DESC.text: Appena recuperati i poteri magici, Lilith torna in sé. Per ripristinare la sua vera forma, tuttavia, ha bisogno di molto mana, per cui va a cercarlo ogni notte.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_6_DESC.text: Rachel, stanca delle attenzioni ricevute dai demoni, si imbatte in un'opera teatrale al femminile chiamata Succube, che le piace fin da subito. Cerca disperatamente di entrare a far parte della compagnia, sostiene un'audizione e la supera.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_7_DESC.text: Dato che "Super Fighting Monsters" consente l'uso della magia, Alice si dimostra ben presto tra i migliori al mondo e viene invitata a prendere parte al campionato mondiale.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_8_DESC.text: Venuto a sapere dell'imminente guerra con i Vaporis, Nazrune negoziò un trattato di pace con la Tribù dei Lupi per salvare entrambi i clan.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_9_DESC.text: Mondrian studiò per diventare un ricercatore e fece ritorno al villaggio natio da uomo rispettabile, ma poco dopo il magistrato scoprì la sua relazione con Arona e lo fece arrestare.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_10_DESC.text: Necron made a pact with the great beyond and sought vengeance on those who had expelled him from his home. With his enemies destroyed, Necron now travels the land in search of new victims.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_11_DESC.text: Cano became the mascot of 'The Night Witches'. She received a mission to slay Demona. Reminded of her vocation, she started her new journey.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_12_DESC.text: Demeter's wheat becomes so famous that even Chocolat admires its quality. Satisfied by public response, Demeter decides to study magic in order to work further on improving the quality of wheat .

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_12_NAME.text: Demeter in the Golden Wheat Field

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_13_DESC.text: Uriel becomes anxious about Victoria as she does not obey him. Uriel's obsession gradually turns into madness, which makes him execute people around Victoria under the false accusation of heresy.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_14_DESC.text: Benjamin holds lectures on developing new technologies, other than android production. He becomes the chief researcher in Rapture Science. One day, a creature named 'R-0' comes to meet him. Benjamin is very surprised due to the fact that the android from the past came to see him again.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_15_DESC.text: Lupeow figures out that 'L.C' the secret corporation in Hasla is preparing for its first anniversary party. To test her limitation, she sneaks in to L.C and succeeds in stealing the party invitation letter. However, she does not recognize a dog-man chasing after her...

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_16_DESC.text: Dorothy leaves Vesper after finishing all the lessons. Vesper tries to get back to her hermitry but suddenly realizes a strange atmosphere in Hasla. She concludes that there is great danger approaching Hasla, so she decides to go on a journey to find Demona.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_17_DESC.text: Violet just barely escapes from the mayhem of the village. After wandering for days in despair and fatigue, she requests sanctuary from a byway convent, where the abbess lets her stay after hearing of her predicament. In gratitude Violet creates magic dolls to help the nuns in their everyday chores.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_18_DESC.text: Day after day the flare grew, and it became bigger and fancier. Yichui tried very hard to find out what the flare is, but she failed to do so. Instead, she decides to help others with the knowledge she has gained from her studies.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_19_DESC.text: Wolfram succeeds in reigning in the criminals of Pumpkin City with the newly formed Night Witches. Yet when more criminals arrive from outside the city, the tired Wolfram leads the Night Witches around the continent to destroy the seed of crime once and for all.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_1_DESC.text: Quando riprende i sensi, si rende conto che gli sono spuntate delle ali sulla schiena. Inoltre, ora controlla meglio la magia, il cui potere è notevolmente aumentato.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_20_DESC.text: The more enlightenment the Otter receives, the more elaborate the symbol on his back becomes, until all animals of the forest come to fear him. But the Otter only smiles and spreads his even deeper teachings to the animals, who eventually realize his wisdom and become his disciples.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_21_DESC.text: In the radiant light, Osiris reads the words 'the Temple of Illusions.' The inscriptions of light tell Osiris that it is only there that he will be able to find the lost past of his people, but that only 'the Seeker of the Truth' shall be able to find the Temple. Osiris leaves with a newfound determination to find the Seeker of the Truth - and the past of his people that he never knew.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_2_DESC.text: Korin, mietitrice veterana che conduce i morti a destinazione grazie al suo aspetto straordinario. Il Re degli inferi è soddisfatto del suo lavoro e la promuove a messaggera di morte.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_3_DESC.text: Dorothy apprende gli incantesimi delle quattro grandi streghe, nonché la magia oscura proibita, a causa della quale viene scacciata dalle altre streghe e definita "strega nera". Ma Dorothy vuole solo aumentare le sue conoscenze magiche, per cui la dea le affida la missione di usare il proprio potere a fin di bene.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_4_DESC.text: Deluso, Sasquatch non esce più di casa, ma un giorno, sentendo un gran baccano, sbircia dall'uscio e vede che la città è stata attaccata dai mostri. Sapendo di non potersi tirare indietro, usa i suoi cristalli di ghiaccio per sconfiggere i nemici, poi si rende conto che il suo aspetto è mutato. I cittadini si scusano con lui e gli chiedono di continuare a proteggere la città. Ora lo chiamano 'Sasquatch gelato'.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_5_DESC.text: Finalmente Lilith recupera tutto il suo potere magico e torna alla sua vera forma. Le streghe rabbrividiscono per la paura e dicono che Lilith dea della notte è tornata.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_6_DESC.text: Dopo essersi esibita con le Succubi, Rachel ne diventa il membro più famoso a cui, secondo la tradizione delle Succubi, spetta il titolo di regina. La regina è molto rispettata dalle sue compagne.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_7_DESC.text: Alice vince a mani basse il campionato e viene insignita del titolo di "regina di picche".

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_8_DESC.text: Riuniti sotto il vessillo della Tribù dei Lupi del Gelo, i due clan riuscirono a fermare l'armata meccanica. Nazrune guidò il primo assalto contro i robot e ne fece strage.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_9_DESC.text: In prigione, Mondrian continuò a studiare e, quando fu scarcerato, mise a frutto le conoscenze acquisite per il progresso del suo popolo.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_DEEMO_4_DESC.text: The Little Girl's endless fall is broken by the warm embrace of a dark figure in a suit, Deemo, who has been playing the piano all alone in the strange dimension. Deemo promises the Little Girl that he will help her return home.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_DEEMO_5_DESC.text: The Little Girl sees a sapling growing in tune to Deemo's performance. Deemo tells her that if they grow it into a tree, it will reach the window in the ceiling through which the Little Girl will be able to return home. True to his word, Deemo ceaselessly plays the piano for the relieved Little Girl.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_DEEMO_6_DESC.text: However, when the tree reaches a considerable height, the Masked Girl pushes Deemo and the Little Girl into the dimension of a mysterious book in order to keep the tree from growing. The Little Girl and Deemo together fall into Hasla, once again coming face to face with a strange new world.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_4_1_DESC.text: One of the 'Valentine' twins created by 'Ruthless Revelation', the unknown existence of another dimension. As her only mission is to destroy mankind, she declares war on mankind.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_4_2_DESC.text: Valentine' is from another dimension. Jack-O' was created to stop the convergence of Elphelt and Justice. Jack-O' was awakened much earlier than planned, just to stop the conspiracy of 'Ruthless Revelation'.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_5_1_DESC.text: Ramlethal's declaration was just a bait to revive Justice, the destroyer. Ramlethal tried self destruction to get rid of Sol and her party, but was stopped by Elphelt, the other twin. Since then, Ramlethal is being protected by Sol.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_5_2_DESC.text: Jack-O' was awakened in an incomplete state, so he needs a mask and candy to function. Suddenly, without permission Jack-O' runs outside to have a look at the world.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_6_1_DESC.text: Ramlethal begins to feel emotional after interacting with Sol and others. She and Sol's party start a journey to save her twin sister from "Ruthless Revelation", but all of a sudden the unknown magic brought them to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_6_2_DESC.text: Raven, the close associate of 'That Man' finds Jack-O' and takes him back to where he should be, with 'Sold Badguy'. When Jack-O' sees Sol's face, a mysterious change of dimension leads Jack-O' to Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF1_CHIZURU_4_DESC.text: The second daughter of the prosperous Kagura clan, which serves the Japanese royal family. The Kagura clan's real name is the Yata clan, one of the families who used the Three Sacred Treasures to seal Orochi long ago. But as Chizuru's older twin sister, Maki, bears the responsibilities of guarding the sealed Orochi, Chizuru is free to live as she pleases.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF1_CHIZURU_5_DESC.text: Chizuru's older twin sister Maki is murdered by one of the Four Heavenly Kings, Goenitz, who breaks the seals of the other Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi. Swearing to avenge her sister's death, Chizuru hosts and enters "The King of Fighters" in order to find a fighter who can kill Goenitz.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF1_CHIZURU_6_DESC.text: The unleashed Four Heavenly Kings begin the ritual to revive Orochi. Chizuru decides the three clans who sealed Orochi long ago must fight together once more, and so brings together Kyo Kusanagi and Iori Yagami. As Kyo delivers the final blow against Orochi in their final battle, the resulting brilliant explosion transports Chizuru to the dimension of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF2_SHERMIE_4_DESC.text: A member of the popular rock band "C_Y_S," Shermie is loved for her compassionate nature and amiable smile. Her motivation in entering "The King of Fighters" is vengeance towards Iori, who ruined their very first concert.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF2_SHERMIE_5_DESC.text: After entering "The King of Fighters," Shermie reveals her true self: One of the Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi. Shermie defeats the fighters of the tournament and uses their energy in order to revive Orochi.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_KOF2_SHERMIE_6_DESC.text: Shermie realizes that the energy of the contestants alone is not enough, and decides to sacrifice her own life to revive Orochi. She asks her fellow team member, Yashiro, to kill her, and it is due to her sacrifice that Orochi succeeds in revival... Yet their plans are foiled due to other fighters, and Shermie, who was waiting only for death, is transported to the dimension of Hasla in the brilliant explosion that results from their clash.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_BARREL_01_DESC.text: A wooden bucket for all your storage needs, whether they be for solids, liquids, or even gases.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_BED_01_DESC.text: A bed with a wooden frame, topped with piles of hay. It's surprisingly comfy.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_BOOKCASE_01_DESC.text: An old bookshelf. Its age adds to its elegance.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_CHAIR_01_DESC.text: An old wooden chair. Not made for long sessions of sitting, as it doesn't have a backrest.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_CHAIR_02_DESC.text: An old wooden chair. Despite having a backrest, it doesn't look very comfortable.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_CHEST_01_DESC.text: A chest wrought of wood and iron. It looks very old.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_DESK_01_DESC.text: A desk piled with endless stacks of documents. By a mysterious force, you are drawn into grabbing the feather pen and signing them off.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_DRAWER_01_DESC.text: A wooden dresser with three drawers. There are signs of usage.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_HAY_01_DESC.text: An ordinary pile of sun-dried hay. It could be more useful than you think.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_LAMP_01_DESC.text: Its light is barely enough for nighttime reading.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_NOTICEBOARD_01_DESC.text: A notice board where you can check for various news and announcements. At the moment, there seems to be more pizza flyers.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_SHOWCASE_01_DESC.text: An old display cabinet filled with various miscellanea.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_SHOWCASE_02_DESC.text: An old display cabinet filled with wooden crates.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_STAGE_01_DESC.text: A small wooden stage. Upon standing on it, you strangely feel like bursting into song.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_STATUE_01_DESC.text: A stone pedestal. Suitable for placing things on top.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_STATUE_02_DESC.text: A statue of a gladiator carved out of stone. Majestic as the mountains.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_STATUE_03_DESC.text: An gigantic stone statue. It seems familiar for some reason.

TEXT_FAME_BOTTOM_WEAPON_01_DESC.text: A bucket filled with an assortment of weapons.

TEXT_FAME_CENTER_CLOCK_01_DESC.text: A grandfather clock as old as its name.

TEXT_FAME_CENTER_HANGER_01_DESC.text: A coat of arms with two intercrossing swords. Now you can boast about your swordfighting skills with more authority.

TEXT_FAME_CENTER_HANGER_02_DESC.text: A coat of arms with two intercrossing halberds. Strictly for decorative purposes, which they fulfill most handsomely.

TEXT_FAME_CENTER_WINDOW_02_DESC.text: An old wooden window. No light can penetrate its dusty shutters.

TEXT_FAME_PORTRAIT_BORDER_GET_DESC.text: You have unlocked a new portrait frame.

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_FOREST_BODY_LV2_DESC.text: (When Divine Beast is attacked 10 times) the entire party heals for 25% of the Divine Beast attack power every second for 5 seconds.\n-This can only occur once every 5 seconds -

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_FOREST_BODY_LV3_DESC.text: (Tranquility enhanced) Healing increased by +10% for 10 seconds and the entire party becomes immune to neutral damage for 5 seconds

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_FOREST_HEAD_LV1_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) affected enemy receives magical damage equal to 5% of one's maximum HP every time the enemy tries to attack

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_FOREST_HEAD_LV2_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) the Divine Beast is shielded for 1500 damage.

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_FOREST_HEAD_LV3_DESC.text: (Root of the Yggdrasil enhanced) the Divine Beast is shielded for 750 damage and redirects the damage that allies take to the Divine Beast

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_ARM_LV1_DESC.text: (Divine Beast is buffed, once in every 5 sec) Entire party's attack power increases as much as Divine Beast's armor for 5 seconds

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_ARM_LV2_DESC.text: (Ally's chain-3 skill activated, once in every 4 sec) Summons 3 tridents which deal neutral damage equal to 75% of Divine Beast's attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_ARM_LV3_DESC.text: (Justice of the Sea enhanced) damage +50%, activated when Divine Beast is buffed

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_BODY_LV1_DESC.text: (When Divine Beast is buffed, once in every 5 sec) Entire party's (armor / resistence) is increased by the amount of 25% of Divine Beast attack power for 5 seconds

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_BODY_LV2_DESC.text: (When Divine Beast is debuffed) -Can only occur once every 5 sec- The Divine Beast becomes invincible for 2 sec

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_BODY_LV3_DESC.text: (Mild Explosion! enhanced)When the invincibility ends, attack power is increased by 75% for 3 sec

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_HEAD_LV1_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated, once in every sec) Divine Beast dash gage acquired by 4 when Divine Beast receives buff during the efffect activation

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_HEAD_LV2_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) Activates a water cannon, 5 times, that deals neutral damage equal to 40% of the Divine Beast's attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_SEA_HEAD_LV3_DESC.text: (Law of the Sea enhanced) Ally hero becomes immune to damage for 5 times when effect is activated while Divine Beast is buffed

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_ARM_LV1_DESC.text: (When Divine Beast auto-attacks) additional neutral damage equal to 50% of attack power by 30% chance

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_ARM_LV2_DESC.text: (chain-3 skill activated) -can only occur once every 3 sec- has a 30% chance to summon 3 meteors that deal neutral damage equal to 80% of attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_ARM_LV3_DESC.text: (Destruction of Worlds enhanced) Freezes the enemy Divine Beast and has a 40% chance of reactivating

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_BODY_LV1_DESC.text: (When ally hero deals 10 critical hits) The next 2 attacks against the party are nullified.

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_BODY_LV2_DESC.text: (When Words of dragon : Outrage is activated 3 times) Activates Dragon's Claw, which deals neutral damage equal to 150% of attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_BODY_LV3_DESC.text: (Dragon's Claw enhanced) damage +50%, chance of evasion +75%

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_HEAD_LV1_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) Ally's HP cannot fall below 1 during activation (lasts for 1 sec)

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_HEAD_LV2_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) summons the Volcano Cannon which deals neutral damage equal to 250% of attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_VOLCANO_HEAD_LV3_DESC.text: (Volcano Whip enhanced) freezes the enemy Divine Beast and increases damage by 50%

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_ARM_LV1_DESC.text: (After every 20th attack by Divine Beast and allies) Party's critical strike chance increases by 15% for 5 seconds

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_ARM_LV2_DESC.text: (chain-3 skill activated by ally) Activates Raging Storm which deals neutral damage equal to 300% of Divine Beast attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_ARM_LV3_DESC.text: (Raging Storn enhanced) Freezes enemy Divine Beast, re-activated after every 10th critical hit by Raging Storm

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_BODY_LV1_DESC.text: (After every 10th attack by enemies) Party's chance of evasion increases by 25% for 5 seconds

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_BODY_LV2_DESC.text: (Every 10th critical attack hit by enemy) Activates the Eye of the Storm which deals neutral damage equal to 250% of enemy attack power

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_BODY_LV3_DESC.text: (Eye of the Storm enhanced) critical damage +100%, entire party's received damage is reduced by 50%

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_HEAD_LV1_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) Divine Beast dash guage increased by 6

TEXT_GUARDIAN_SIS_WINTER_HEAD_LV2_DESC.text: (Goddess skill activated) Activates Fatal Blow! which deals neutral damage equal to 250% of Divine Beast attack power
