TEXT_SKILL_PR_ORDER_TEAM_DESC.text: Upon using block, heals all allies equal to (100/150/200)% of hero's attack power. Using 1-chain increases affected ally's attack power by 20%, 2-chain increases affected ally's armor by 30%, and 3-chain dispels debuffs.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ORDER_TEAM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Of the allies affected by Yuria's block skill, the hero with the lowest HP will be vitalized, immediately activating the vitalized ally's block skill under the same count as Yuria's passive trigger chain, and recovering HP equal to (100/150/200)% of Yuria's attack power. Passive is not activated when Yuria heals herself. (Once every 4 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ORDER_TEAM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Of the allies affected by Yuria's block skill, the hero with the lowest HP will be vitalized, immediately activating the vitalized ally's block skill under the same count as Yuria's passive trigger chain, and recovering HP equal to (100/150/200)% of Yuria's attack power. Passive is not activated when Yuria heals herself. (Once every 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_PLAY_LIRA_DESC.text: Hero heals the entire party by (42/152/275)% of Hero's attack power according to the chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_QUAKE_TOTEM_DESC.text: Evoca un totem che infligge #danni magici# ogni secondo per 4 secondi ai nemici vicini, pari al 50% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_QUAKE_TOTEM_LV2_DESC.text: Evoca un totem che infligge #danni magici# ogni secondo per 4 secondi ai nemici vicini, pari al 60% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_QUAKE_TOTEM_LV3_DESC.text: Summons a totem that deals @magical damage@ equal to 70% of hero's attack power to the nearby enemy every second for 4 seconds. During activation, block skill of the ally at the back will be activated as 3-chain skill. (once per 4 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_QUAKE_TOTEM_LV4_DESC.text: Summons a totem that deals @magical damage@ equal to 85% of hero's attack power to the nearby enemy every second for 4 seconds. During activation, block skill of the ally at the back will be activated as 3-chain skill. (once per 4 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_QUAKE_TOTEM_LV5_DESC.text: Summons a totem that deals @magical damage@ equal to 100% of hero's attack power to the nearby enemy every second for 4 seconds. During activation, block skill of the ally at the back will be activated as 3-chain skill. (once per 4 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RESURRECTION_DESC.text: Immediately resurrects 1 ally to 30% HP and casts a shield that absorbs damage equal to 100% of their maximum HP for 3 seconds. If there is no ally to resurrect, casts a shield over the entire party that abosrbs damage equal to 30% of the caster's maximum HP for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RESURRECTION_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately resurrects 1 ally to 30% HP and casts a shield that absorbs damage equal to 175% of their maximum HP for 3 seconds. If there is no ally to resurrect, casts a shield over the entire party that abosrbs damage equal to 50% of the caster's maximum HP for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RESURRECTION_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately resurrects 2 allies to 30% HP and casts a shield that absorbs damage equal to 175% of their maximum HP for 3 seconds. If there is no ally to resurrect, casts a shield over the entire party that abosrbs damage equal to 50% of the caster's maximum HP for 5 seconds. Additionally cancels all debuffs affecting the party and grants all allies immunity to debuffs for 1.5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SEIMEI_DESC.text: Seimei draws a magic circle 'Human Spirit: Yang' that lasts 3 seconds. If the an ally is within the range of the magic circle, Seimei summons 'Human Spirit' that heals the nearby allies by [50/150/275]% of his attack power 3 times for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SEIREN_DESC.text:
Upon using a block, Seiren casts a shield over allies for 5 seconds that absorbs damage up to 50% of Seiren's maximum HP + 5000.
 
 1-chain: Seiren casts her shield over an ally with the lowest HP.
 2-chain: Seiren casts her shield over the frontmost and rearmost allies.
 3-chain: Seiren casts her shield over the entire party.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SEIREN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block, Seiren casts a new shield over allies affected by 'Ocean's Tears.' 'Ocean's Vanity' lasts 5 seconds, and absorbs damage up to a sum of 5000 and 50% of Seiren's maximum HP. When 'Ocean's Vanity' disappears, Seiren recasts 'Ocean's Tears' over the ally.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SEIREN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block, Seiren casts a new shield over allies affected by 'Ocean's Tears.' 'Ocean's Vanity' lasts 5 seconds, and absorbs damage up to a sum of 5000 and 50% of Seiren's maximum HP. Additionally, the shield generates 5 SP with every hit the ally receives. When 'Ocean's Vanity' disappears, Seiren recasts 'Ocean's Tears' over the ally.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SHIELD_DESC.text: Immediately decreases all damage received by the entire party by 30% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SHIELD_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately decreases all damage received by the entire party by 35% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SHIELD_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately decreases all damage received by the entire party by 40%, and reflects 10% of the damage to the enemy for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SHIELD_LV4_DESC.text: Immediately decreases all damage received by the entire party by 45%, and reflects 20% of the damage to the enemy for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SHIELD_LV5_DESC.text: Immediately decreases all damage received by the entire party by 50%, and reflects 30% of the damage to the enemy for 7 seconds. Additionally, the entire party becomes immune to debuffs for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STARFALL_DESC.text: Scaglia 5 meteoriti che infliggono #danni magici# pari al 40% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STARFALL_LV2_DESC.text: Scaglia 5 meteoriti che infliggono #danni magici# pari al 50% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STATUEHEAL_DESC.text:
Cura gli alleati vicini 8 volte del (10/25/52)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.
È grande e di una bellezza incredibile.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STATUEHEAL_SUBDESC.text: un alleato recupera 5 PA ogni volta che viene attaccato mentre è sotto l'effetto di Montagna di muscoli. Se tale alleato usa un'abilità combo da 3, anche Rudolph utilizzerà un'abilità combo da 3. (Una volta ogni 2 secondi).

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STICK_AND_CARROT_DESC.text: Infligge #danni neutri# pari al 120% della potenza d'attacco a un nemico e recupera la stessa quantità di PS dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STICK_AND_CARROT_LV2_DESC.text: Infligge #danni neutri# pari al 140% della potenza d'attacco a un nemico e recupera la stessa quantità di PS dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STICK_AND_CARROT_LV3_DESC.text: Infligge #danni neutri# pari al 160% della potenza d'attacco a un nemico e recupera il doppio di PS dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STICK_AND_CARROT_LV4_DESC.text: Infligge #danni neutri# pari al 180% della potenza d'attacco a un nemico e recupera il doppio di PS dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_STICK_AND_CARROT_LV5_DESC.text: Infligge #danni neutri# pari al 200% della potenza d'attacco a un nemico e recupera il doppio di PS dell'eroe. Il danno dell'attacco degli eroi curati aumenta del 50% per 5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SYRINGEHEAL_DESC.text: Summons a construction based on the chain number and heals the ally in range equal to (50/130/300)% of hero's attack power. Summons another construction that spreads potion that heals the ally equal to (5/13/30)% of hero's attack power every second for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SYRINGEHEAL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Deals @magic damage@ equal to the healing amount to the enemies who are effected by hero's attack, and spread potion that deals @magic damage@ equal to the healing amount of potion. When ally uses block skill after 3-chain, the block skill will work as 3-chain, dealing $neutral damage$.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_SYRINGEHEAL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Deals @magic damage@ equal to the healing amount to the enemies who are effected by hero's attack, and spread potion that deals @magic damage@ equal to the healing amount of potion. Attack power of ally effected by potion will increase by 10% for 5 seconds, and damage from the enemy effected by potion will decrease by 10%. When ally uses block skill after 3-chain, the block skill will work as 3-chain, dealing $neutral damage$.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_TRI_TOTEM_DESC.text: Crea un oggetto che cura i PS dell'intero gruppo 4 volte del (20/55/95)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_TRI_TOTEM_LV2_DESC.text: Crea un oggetto che cura i PS dell'intero gruppo 4 volte del (35/80/80)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_TRI_TOTEM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: armatura e resistenza magica di tutti gli alleati aumentano di 100 quando viene attivata un'abilità combo da 2; inoltre, la potenza d'attacco dell'intero gruppo aumenta del 30% per 5 secondi quando viene attivata un'abilità combo da 3.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_TRI_TOTEM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: armatura e resistenza magica di tutti gli alleati aumentano di 200 quando viene attivata un'abilità combo da 2; inoltre, la potenza d'attacco dell'intero gruppo aumenta del 35% e le probabilità di colpo critico aumentano del 15% per 5 secondi quando viene attivata un'abilità combo da 3.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_AIR_SLASH_DESC.text: Con grande maestria nell'uso della spada, lancia in aria i nemici e infligge #danni fisici# pari al 525% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_AIR_SLASH_LV2_DESC.text: Con grande maestria nell'uso della spada, lancia in aria i nemici e infligge #danni fisici# pari al 700% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_AIR_SLASH_LV3_DESC.text: Con grande maestria nell'uso della spada, lancia in aria i nemici e infligge #danni fisici# pari al 875% della potenza d'attacco. Durante l'impiego di questa abilità, l'eroe diviene invulnerabile a danni fisici e penalità.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BLACKMOON_DESC.text: Maneggiando la spada alla maniera orientale, infligge #danni fisici# pari al (56/178/271)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHRISTMAS_TREE_DESC.text: Colpisce la prima linea con un albero di Natale, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al (56/178/322)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. Inoltre, riempie i cuori di gioia.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHRISTMAS_TREE_SUBDESC.text: Using skill blocks increases the Hero's attack power by (100/100/200) for 5 seconds. When an ally uses a chain-3 skill, the next #Deck the Halls# will count as #chain-3# skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CRESCENT_RAMPAGE_DESC.text: Fa mulinare rapidamente la spada, proiettando un'energia che infligge #danni fisici# pari al 240% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CRESCENT_RAMPAGE_LV2_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# pari al 270% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe proiettando energia dalla spada.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CRESCENT_RAMPAGE_LV3_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# pari al 300% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe proiettando energia dalla spada. La potenza d'attacco dei nemici colpiti da questa abilità viene ridotta di 20 per 5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CRESCENT_RAMPAGE_LV4_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# pari al 330% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe proiettando energia dalla spada. La potenza d'attacco dei nemici colpiti da questa abilità viene ridotta di 30 per 5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CRESCENT_RAMPAGE_LV5_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# pari al 500% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe proiettando energia dalla spada. La potenza d'attacco dei nemici colpiti da questa abilità viene ridotta di 40 per 5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DANCING_SWORD_DESC.text: Infligge #danni magici# pari al 350% della potenza d'attacco e recupera il 25% della potenza d'attacco sotto forma di PS.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DANCING_SWORD_LV2_DESC.text: Infligge #danni magici# pari al 455% della potenza d'attacco e recupera il 50% della potenza d'attacco sotto forma di PS.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DANCING_SWORD_LV3_DESC.text: Infligge #danni magici# pari al 630% della potenza d'attacco e recupera il 437% della potenza d'attacco sotto forma di PS del gruppo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DARKJUSTICE_DESC.text: Evoca una spada demoniaca che infligge #danni magici# pari al (56/178/322)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DARKJUSTICE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: effettuando una combo da 3, evoca Richiamo della spada demoniaca e infligge #danni magici# pari al 380% della potenza d'attacco. In seguito, riduce del 50% i danni subiti per 3 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DARKJUSTICE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: effettuando una combo da 3, evoca Richiamo della spada demoniaca e infligge #danni magici# pari al 380% della potenza d'attacco. In seguito, riduce del 50% i danni subiti per 3 secondi. Quando il nemico attacca, evoca di nuovo la spada demoniaca suprema. (Fino a 2 volte).

TEXT_SKILL_WA_DEVIL_ARM_DESC.text: Every time Isabel reaches the enemy, the demon in her arm deals #physical damage# equal to [78/100/138]% of her attack power. Upon using her own 3-chain, Isabel's evasion is increased by 35 for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FINAL_JUSTICE_DESC.text: Colpisce la prima linea con la massima potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 300% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FINAL_JUSTICE_LV2_DESC.text: Colpisce la prima linea con la massima potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 375% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FINAL_JUSTICE_LV3_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# alla prima linea nemica pari al 450% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. L'attacco riduce di 100 l'armatura del nemico.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FINAL_JUSTICE_LV4_DESC.text: Infligge #danni fisici# alla prima linea nemica pari al 525% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. L'attacco riduce di 200 l'armatura del nemico.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FINAL_JUSTICE_LV5_DESC.text: Strikes the frontline with all its power, dealing #physical damage# equal to 600% of hero’s attack power. This attack ignores enemy’s armor by 300, and gives $neutral damage$ equal to 300% of hero’s armor.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FIREBLADE_DESC.text: Sweep with a huge Flame sword. This sword deals (x/x/x)% of @magic damage@ equal to attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_JOHNNY_DESC.text: When Johnny’s block is used, Mist Finer is activated dealing #physical damage# equal to (280/400/600)% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_KY_DESC.text: Launches (Stun Edge/Stun Edge(Charge Attack)/Sacred Edge) that deals @magical damage@ equal to (80/155/255)% of the Hero's attack power according to the chain length. Damaged enemy can't move for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_KY_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When an enemy hit by Sacred Edge comes into contact, uses 'Ride the Lightning,' charging forward and dealing @magical damage@ equal to 600% of attack power. Blocks used after an ally's 3-chain become Sacred Edge (only 1 time).

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_KY_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When an enemy hit by Sacred Edge comes into contact, uses 'Ride the Lightning,' charging forward and dealing @magical damage@ equal to 800% of attack power. While using 'Ride the Lightning,' Ky takes 25% reduced damage. Blocks used after an ally's 3-chain become Sacred Edge (only 2 times).

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_MILLIA_DESC.text: When a block is used it activates Lust Shaker that deals @magic damage@ equal to (75/150/300)% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_MILLIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Millia immediately uses 'Winger' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of her attack power. (Cooltime: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_MILLIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Millia immediately uses 'Winger,' dealing @magical damage@ equal to 900% of attack power, and increases the entire party's critical chance by 20% for 4 seconds. (Cooltime: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_SOL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Using a block after an ally's chain-3 skill, activates Gun flame and Grand viper consecutively.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GG_SOL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Using a block after an ally's chain-3 skill, activates Gun flame and Grand viper consecutively.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_HARPYA_DESC.text: Harpya charges forward and deals 6 hits that deal #physical damage# equal to [75/300/500]% of her attack power according to the chain number used. For the duration of 'Deadly Division,' Harpya cannot be knocked back.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_HARPYA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Harpya increases the speed of two allies by 50% for 3 seconds and her own attack power by 15% for 5 seconds. This buff cannot be stacked.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_HARPYA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Harpya increases the speed of two allies by 80% for 3 seconds and her own attack power by 30% for 5 seconds. This buff cannot be stacked.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_HEART_SWORD_DESC.text: Brandisci l'anima della spada per infliggere #danni fisici# pari al (50/125/250)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ISIS_DESC.text: Isis summons a 'Desert Tide' that deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/300]% of attack power according to chain number and knocks back hit enemies.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_JUSTICE_DESC.text: Evoca la spada sacra che infligge #danni fisici# pari al (56/178/322)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_CHRIS_DESC.text: Uses ‘ТАЙЁ О ИРУ ХОНО’ (Taiyou o Iru Honoo) that deals @magical damage@ equal to [90/215/320]% of attack power. Resistance of hit enemies decrease by 30% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_CHRIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
If enemies hit by 'ТАЙЁ О ИРУ ХОНО' (Taiyou o Iru Honoo) are under harmful effect, additionally uses 'АНКОКУ ОРОЧИНАГИ' (Ankoku Orochinagi) that deal @magical damage@ equal to 360% of attack power. 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, attack power is increased by 400 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_CHRIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If enemies hit by 'ТАЙЁ О ИРУ ХОНО' (Taiyou o Iru Honoo) are under harmful effect, additionally uses 'АНКОКУ ОРОЧИНАГИ' Ankoku Orochinagi) that deals @magical damage@ equal to 360% of attack power. The resistance penetration for said attack is increased by the amount of Chris's armor.

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, attack power is increased by 400 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_CHRIS_NAME.text: ТАЙЁ О ИРУ ХОНО (Taiyou o Iru Honoo)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_IORI_DESC.text: Releases ball of energy that deals @magical damage@ equal to [80/190/360]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_IORI_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
If enemy attacked by "108 Shiki: Yami Barai" is outside normal attack range, uses "Kin 1211 Shiki: Ya Otome" to stun one enemy, and deal @magical damage@ equal to 350% of attack power. Cannot be pushed back during attack. 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, resistance penetration is incrased by 300.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_IORI_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If enemy attacked by "108 Shiki: Yami Barai" is outside normal attack range, uses "Kin 1211 Shiki: Ya Otome" to stun one enemy, and deal @magical damage@ equal to 610% of attack power. Cannot be pushed back during attack. Becomes immune to all damage except @magical@. 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, resistance penetration is incrased by 300.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_KYO_DESC.text: Releases a ball of energy that deals #physical damage# equal to [80/190/360]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_KYO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 3 blocks, next block is changed to "Ura 108 Shiki: Orochi Nagi," and deals additional #physical damage# equal to 450% of attack power. 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, armor penetration is increased by 250 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_KYO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 3 blocks, next block is changed to "Ura 108 Shiki: Orochi Nagi," and deals additional #physical damage# equal to 450% of attack power. If last explosion damage does not kill enemy, attack is reactivated. (Once every 5 seconds) 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, armor penetration is increased by 250 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_RUGAL_DESC.text: Deals an upper kick that deals #physical damage# equal to [60/115/200]% of attack power 2 times.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_RUGAL_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Rugal cannot be pushed back. After normal attack, releases a ball of gravity that deals #physical damage# equal to 185% of attack power. (Once every 6 seconds) 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, motion speed is increased by 40% for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KOF_RUGAL_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Rugal cannot be pushed back. After normal attack, releases a ball of gravity that deals #physical damage# equal to 275% of attack power. Also, attack power increases by 5% of remaining HP, and life steal in ratio to lost HP for 3 seconds. (Once every 6 seconds) 

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, motion speed is increased by 40% for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KURENAI_CHARM_DESC.text: Casts [1/2/3] barrier(s) before frontline enemies for 5 seconds according to chain number. Enemies who are affected by the barrier receive @magical damage@ equal to 128% of caster's attack power, and a debuff that decreases critical damage by 25%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_KURENAI_CHARM_SUBDESC.text: With every 3-chain of (ally/enemy), Kurenai's (attack power increases/armor decreases) by 25%. This effect can be stacked maximum 3 times. Upon using 3 auto-attacks, Kurenai releases a powerful force that deals #physical damage# equal to (100 x attack power buff stack)% + 300% of armor.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_BLAKE_DESC.text: Upon landing a hit, Blake immobilizes the enemy for 3 seconds, then engages in a wild dance that deals $neutral damage$ equal to [630/1050/2100]% of her attack power according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_BLAKE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon receiving damage that would provide fatal, Blake produces a 'shadow clone.' (Activates once every 15 seconds) Upon the clone's activation, Blake retreats, leaving behind a shadow of herself and healing 100% of her HP. She becomes invulnerable for 2 seconds afterwards.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_WEISS_DESC.text: Shoots [1/2/3] projectiles of ice dust that each deals @magical damage@ equal to 120% of her attack power according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_WEISS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Weiss immediately pierces the enemy twice, each dealing @magical damage@ equal to 1500% of her attack power. Upon activation of 'Barrage,' Weiss's evasion is increased by 100 for 1 second. Weiss cannot be pushed back for the duration of the attack.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REJECT_THORN_DESC.text: Through Magic of the Forest, summons "Thorns of Refusal" that deal #physical damage# equal to [35/80/100]% of hero's attack power per hit for [1/2/4] seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REJECT_THORN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: During the activation of Thorn of Refusal, when enemies make attacks from outside of auto-attack range, Thorn of Refusal deals @magical damage@ equal to 50% of the hero's attack power with every hit. (Once every 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHASHA_DESC.text: Dashes forward and deals @magical damage@ equal to [125/250/500]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SOLTAR_SLASH_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to (75/165/315)% of attack power according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SOLTAR_SLASH_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Whenever the hero is attacked 4 times, the attack power increases 10% each (Maximum 5 stacks) for 3 seconds and summon Demonic Sphere that deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of hero’s attack power. (Activated once every 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_DESC.text: Evoca un mantello. I nemici che vi vengono avvolti subiscono #danni magici# pari al (33/147/275)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDFLASH_DESC.text: Attacco perforante che infligge #danni fisici# pari al (49/150/271)% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDFLASH_LV2_SUBDESC.text: infligge #danni neutri# aggiuntivi pari al 100% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe quando un nemico viene colpito da Colpo di spada.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDFLASH_LV3_SUBDESC.text: infligge #danni neutri# aggiuntivi pari al 100% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe e riduce l'armatura del nemico della stessa percentuale per 5 secondi quando un nemico viene colpito da Colpo di spada.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE2_DESC.text: Lancia un'onda energetica che infligge #danni fisici# pari al (100/200/300)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE_DESC.text: Evoca un'onda energetica che infligge #danni magici# pari al (49/122/221)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating 'Sonic Wave,' Joan immediately receives all damage targeted at the entire ally for 5 seconds and increases the leader's SP by 15.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating 'Sonic Wave,' Joan immediately receives all damage targeted at the entire ally for 5 seconds and becomes immune to physical damage for 0.25 seconds. Additionally, she increases the leader's SP by 30.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WATER_SWORD_DESC.text: Deals @magical damage@ equal to (100/150/250)% of the hero's attack power based on the length of the chain skill used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WATER_SWORD_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When hero uses Water God's Dragon Wave, ally's chance of evasion increases by 20 for 4 seconds. During the activation when ally succeeds in evading an attack, hero summons Water Dragon which deals @magical damage@ equal to 30% of hero HP. (Activated once in every 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_DESC.text: Attacca velocemente 3 volte, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 240% della potenza d'attacco; inoltre, attira il nemico.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV2_DESC.text: Attacca velocemente 3 volte, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 300% della potenza d'attacco; inoltre, attira il nemico.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ARCHON_DESC.text: Summons a thunderbolt that deals #physical damage# equal to [49/150/270]% of attack power according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ARCHON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using 3-chain, the entire party's armor penetration and resistance penetration is increased by 20% of Archon's attack power. If Archon is already receiving a buff, she summons 2 additional 'electric spheres', and each of them deals @magical damage@ equal to 65% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ARCHON_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using 3-chain, the entire party's armor penetration and resistance penetration is increased by 30% of Archon's attack power. If Archon is already receiving a buff, she summons 3 additional 'electric spheres', and each of them deals @magical damage@ equal to 80% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BATSTORM_DESC.text: Evoca innumerevoli pipistrelli che infliggono #danni magici# pari al (56/175/280)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BATSTORM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: se l'eroe usa il suo blocco o è curato da un'abilità, la sua potenza d'attacco aumenta del 10% per 5 secondi. (Si attiva una volta al secondo)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BATSTORM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: se l'eroe usa il suo blocco o è curato da un'abilità, la sua potenza d'attacco aumenta del 10% per 5 secondi e recupera 4 PA. L'effetto del/dei blocco/chi usato/i dopo un'abilità combo da 3 alleata sarà triplicato. (Si attiva una volta al secondo)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BEAMBURST_DESC.text: Lancia 5 raggi magici consecutivi che infliggono #danni magici# pari al 60% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BEAMBURST_LV2_DESC.text: Lancia 5 raggi magici consecutivi che infliggono #danni magici# pari al 75% della potenza d'attacco.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BEAMBURST_LV3_DESC.text: Lancia 5 raggi magici consecutivi che infliggono #danni magici# pari al 100% della potenza d'attacco. Per 1 volta, l'abilità blocco del nemico danneggiato si attiva sempre come combo da 1.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLACKHOLE_DESC.text: Immediately pulls in nearby enemies and deals @magical damage@ equal to 200% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLACKHOLE_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately pulls in nearby enemies and deals @magical damage@ equal to 250% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLACKHOLE_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately pulls in nearby enemies strongly and deals @magical damage@ equal to 300% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLACKHOLE_LV4_DESC.text: Immediately pulls in nearby enemies strongly and deals @magical damage@ equal to 350% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLACKHOLE_LV5_DESC.text: Immediately pulls in nearby enemies very strongly and deals @magical damage@ equal to 400% of attack power. Enemies hit by attack lose 10 SP with each hit.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLIZZARD_DESC.text: Drops [8/12/20] icicles that deal @magical damage@ equal to [5/13/22]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLIZZARD_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Freezing Blizzard' become 'frozen,' which decreases their attack power by 25% for 5 seconds. If an enemy becomes 'frozen' 10 times during 10 seconds, he or she becomes 'frostbitten,' which decreases their motion speed by 10% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLIZZARD_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Freezing Blizzard' become 'frozen,' which decreases their attack power by 35% for 5 seconds. If an enemy becomes 'frozen' 7 times during 10 seconds, he or she becomes 'frostbitten,' which decreases their motion speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BREAD_METEOR_DESC.text: Dei cioccolatini esplosivi (max 10) cadono dal cielo, infliggendo #danni magici# pari al (10/25/50)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. Più lunga è la combo, maggiore sarà il numero di cioccolatini!

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BREAD_METEOR_SUBDESC.text: il blocco abilità successivo attiva una combo da 3 se viene usato dopo una combo da 3 alleata. Ogni volta che i cioccolatini infliggono dei danni, la potenza d'attacco di tutti gli alleati aumenta del 5%.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CARD_SOLDIER_DESC.text: Usando una combo da 1 o da 2, evoca dei soldati di quadri, mentre con una combo da 3 si ottengono soldati di picche. Essi infliggono #danni magici# pari al (50/1230/240)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CARD_SOLDIER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: evoca un soldato di picche potenziato che infligge #danni magici# pari al 210% del danno d'attacco dell'eroe. Esso viene evocato quando i soldati di quadri infliggono danni in seguito all'attacco iniziale (si attiva solo una volta ogni 2 secondi).

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CARD_SOLDIER_LV3_SUBDESC.text: evoca un soldato di picche potenziato che infligge #danni magici# pari al 532% del danno d'attacco dell'eroe e indebolisce l'abilità successiva del nemico del 35%. Esso viene evocato quando i soldati di quadri infliggono danni in seguito all'attacco iniziale.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEAD_SUMMON_DESC.text: Summons Demon servant with attack power as 50% of hero's HP, armor/resistance as 100% of hero's armor/resistance and has HP equal to (80/120/170)% of hero's attack power when using a block skill(Demon servant lasts for 10 seconds). The hero can order the servant to (recover/berserking/attack) according to the chain. This order reacts to ally's chain too.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEAD_SUMMON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Based on an ally's chain length, orders the summoned spirits to (Heal 10% of an ally's HP and takes all damage for that ally for 5 seconds / increase attack power by 30% up to 2 times / deal @magical damage@ equal to 120% of the Spirit's attack power).

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEAD_SUMMON_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Necron orders the summoned ghoul a particular action according to the number of own or allies' chains. The damage and effect of every second order are increased by 50%. 

[Receives all allies' damage for 3 seconds (once every 5 seconds), heals ghoul's HP by 10%
/ Increases attack power by 30% for the next 2 skills
/ Deals @magical damage@ equal to 120% of attack power)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEEMO_DESC.text: Activates a different effect with each chain. [1-chain 'Friction' : Deals @magical damage@ equal to 150% of attack power] [2-chain 'Utopiosphere & Reverse-Parallel Universe' : Pulls in nearby enemie sto deal @magical damage@ equal to 100% of attack power] [3-chain 'I hate to tell you & Entrance' : Decreases all enemies' resistance by 25% for 10 seconds]

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ENERGYBEAM_DESC.text: Lancia un raggio magico che infligge #danni magici# pari al (34/122/221)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG_JACK_DESC.text: When a block is used, "Drop the Guillotine" activates dealing @magic damage@ equal to (60/130/320)% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG_JACK_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When hero uses a block skill twice, a ghost spawns next to the hero. Ghost deals @magic damage@ equal to 250% of the hero's attack power when it gets too far from an ally, or touches an enemy. When a block skill is used with an active ghost, a Knight, Lancer, or Magician Servant will be summoned from the ghost sequentially. Servant will rush to the enemy dealing @magic damage@ equal to (100/230/450)% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG_JACK_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When hero uses a block skill twice, a ghost spawns next to the hero. Ghost deals @magic damage@ equal to 250% of the hero's attack power when it gets too far from an ally, or touches an enemy. When a block skill is used with an active ghost, a Knight, Lancer, or Magician Servant will be summoned from the ghost sequentially. Servant will rush to the enemy dealing @magic damage@ equal to (100/230/450)% of the hero's attack power. When Servant attacks an enemy, additional effects will trigger. (Knight : Attacked enemy's resistance decreases by 20% for 5 seconds, Lancer : Jack-O`s attack power increases by 30% for 5 seconds, Magician : stuns the hit enemy)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG_RAMLETHAL_SKILL_DESC.text: Deals @magical damage@ equal to [120/240/450]% of hero's attack power according to chain number. When an ally uses a block skill after Ramlethal's block skill, Ramlethal casts the same attack of the same chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_HAEDAL_DESC.text: Shouts to deal @magical damage@ equal to [90/190/310]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_HAEDAL_LV1_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using his special skill after 9 blocks, Otter enters 'Nirvana' for 10 seconds. In 'Nirvana,' the Otter uses a different attack with each block.

[1-chain: Pushes a large hand into the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 250% of attack power and knock them back.]
[2-chain: Summons a large hand on the ground that deals @magical damage@ equal to 250% of attack power, and knocks them into the air.]
[3-chain: Summons a large hand in front that deals @magical damage@ equal to 310% of attack power, stuns the enemy and knocks them far back into the air.]

TEXT_SKILL_WI_HAEDAL_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using his special skill after 9 blocks, Otter enters 'Nirvana' for 10 seconds. In 'Nirvana,' the Otter uses a different attack with each block.

[1-chain: Pushes a large hand into the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 250% of attack power and knock them back.]
[2-chain: Summons a large hand on the ground that deals @magical damage@ equal to 250% of attack power, and knocks them into the air.]
[3-chain: Summons a large hand in front that deals @magical damage@ equal to 310% of attack power, stuns the enemy and knocks them far back into the air.]

Upon reaching 'Nirvana,' the Otter casts a shield that absorbs damage equal to 70% of his attack power, and heals all allies' HP by 100% of his attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ILLUSION_MAPAE_DESC.text: Evoca un clone ombra che infligge #danni magici# pari al (50/150/240)% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_JUDGE_CROSS_DESC.text: Hero drops Cross of the Blade which deals @magical damage@ equal to (85/150/270)% of Hero's attack power according to the chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_JUDGE_CROSS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Using blocks will change auto attack to Cross Blade that deals magic damage equal to (100/150/220)% of the hero's attack power for 6 seconds. Using Cross Blade 6 times will activate Blade of Execution that deals magic damage equal to 350% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_JUDGE_CROSS_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Using blocks will change auto attack to Cross Blade that deals magic damage equal to (100/150/220)% of the hero's attack power for 6 seconds. Using Cross Blade 4 times will activate Blade of Execution that deals magic damage equal to 600% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_CHIZURU_DESC.text: Projection of self dashes forward and deals @magical damage@ equal to [145/194/285]% of attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_CHIZURU_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Activates additional "Rimen 85-Katsu: Reigi no Ishizue" every second block, and decreases enemy's SP by 40.

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, attack power is increased by 300 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_CHIZURU_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Activates additional "Rimen 85-Katsu: Reigi no Ishizue" every second block, and decreases enemy's SP by 40. Also deals one additional hit.

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, attack power is increased by 300 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_SHERMIE_DESC.text: Uses ‘МУГЭЦУ НО РАЙУН’ (Mugetu no Raiun) equal to [180/234/234]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_SHERMIE_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon hitting 10 times with ‘МУГЭЦУ НО РАЙУН’ (Mugetu no Raiun), additionally uses 'АНКОКУ РАИКОКЭН' (Ankoku Raikouken) that deals @magical damage@ equal to 320% of attack power 3 times. (Once every 2 seconds)

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, critical chance is increased by 12% for 8 seconds, and 1 block is automatically generated.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_KOF_SHERMIE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon hitting 10 times with ‘МУГЭЦУ НО РАЙУН’ (Mugetu no Raiun), additionally uses 'АНКОКУ РАИКОКЭН' (Ankoku Raikouken) that deals @magical damage@ equal to 475% of attack power 3 times, and has a 50% chance of dealing additional @magical damage@ equal to 200% of attack power. (Once every 2 seconds)

Power MAX Effect: Upon activation, critical chance is increased by 12% for 8 seconds, and 1 block is automatically generated.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIGHTNING_BALL_DESC.text: Evoca una sfera elettrica che avanza verso la prima linea, infliggendo #danni magici# pari al 30% della potenza d'attacco a ogni colpo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIGHTNING_BALL_LV2_DESC.text: Evoca una sfera elettrica che avanza verso la prima linea, infliggendo #danni magici# pari al 40% della potenza d'attacco a ogni colpo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIGHTNING_BALL_LV3_DESC.text: Evoca una sfera elettrica che avanza verso la prima linea, infliggendo #danni magici# pari al 50% della potenza d'attacco a ogni colpo. I nemici colpiti dalla sfera vengono respinti.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIGHTNING_BALL_LV4_DESC.text: Evoca una sfera elettrica che avanza verso la prima linea, infliggendo #danni magici# pari al 65% della potenza d'attacco a ogni colpo. I nemici colpiti dalla sfera vengono respinti.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIGHTNING_BALL_LV5_DESC.text: Evoca una sfera elettrica che avanza verso la prima linea, infliggendo #danni magici# pari all'80% della potenza d'attacco a ogni colpo. I nemici colpiti dalla sfera vengono respinti. Se un nemico viene colpito 4 volte, rimane stordito per 1 secondo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LOVE_IMPACT_DESC.text: Deals @magic damage@ equal to (85/125/250)% according to the chain length and charms the enemy for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAGIC_SCAN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Scanned enemy receives @magical damage@ equal to 360% of Benjamin's attack power for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAGIC_SCAN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Scanned enemy receives @magical damage@ equal to 360% of Benjamin's attack power for 3 seconds. When scanned enemy is located on the scanning area, enemy receives @magical damage@ equal to 100% of Benjamin's attack power and Benjamin's SP will increase by 5. (Activated once every 0.5 second)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANACHARGE_LV2_DESC.text: Crea immediatamente due blocchi e l'abilità successiva viene attivata con una potenza d'attacco aumentata del 25%.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANACHARGE_LV3_DESC.text: Crea immediatamente due blocchi e l'abilità successiva viene attivata con una potenza d'attacco aumentata del 40%.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANACHARGE_LV4_DESC.text: Crea immediatamente due blocchi e l'abilità successiva viene attivata con una potenza d'attacco aumentata del 55%.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANACHARGE_LV5_DESC.text: Crea immediatamente due blocchi e le due abilità successive vengono attivate con una potenza d'attacco aumentata del 70%; inoltre, il nemico colpito viene stordito per 1 secondo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANA_SHIELD_DESC.text: Immediately forms a shield around the entire party that lasts for 10 seconds and absorbs 500 damage

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANA_SHIELD_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately forms a shield around the entire party that lasts for 10 seconds and absorbs 1000 damage

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANA_SHIELD_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately forms a shield around the entire party that lasts for 10 seconds and absorbs 1500 damage. Upon activation, the entire party's attack speed is increased by 35% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANA_SHIELD_LV4_DESC.text: Immediately forms a shield around the entire party that lasts for 10 seconds and absorbs 2500 damage. Upon activation, the entire party's attack speed is increased by 35% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MANA_SHIELD_LV5_DESC.text: Immediately forms a shield around the entire party that lasts for 10 seconds and absorbs 3500 damage. Upon activation, the entire party's attack speed is increased by 35% for 5 seconds, and all allies become immune to debuffs for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_5_DESC.text: Summons black thorns that deal #physical damage# equal to (49/150/270)% of attack power according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_5_LV2_SUBDESC.text: il terzo blocco usato si attiva sempre come combo da 3. Questo si applica anche quando un altro eroe alleato attiva una combo da 3.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_5_LV3_SUBDESC.text: il secondo blocco usato si attiva sempre come combo da 3. Questo si applica anche quando un altro eroe alleato attiva una combo da 3.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_DESC.text: Evoca una pioggia di meteoriti dal cielo, che infligge #danni fisici# pari al (49/150/270)% della potenza d'attacco, in base alla combo.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_LV2_SUBDESC.text: l'utilizzo di un'abilità combo da 3 aumenta la difesa e la penetrazione magica del gruppo del 20% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. Se c'è già un buff attivo, evoca 1-2 sfere elettriche, ciascuna delle quali infligge #danni magici# pari al 30% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_METEOR_LV3_SUBDESC.text: l'utilizzo di una combo da 3 aumenta la penetrazione di armature del gruppo del 125% della sua resistenza magica per 5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_OSIRIS_DESC.text: Osiris summons an 'Ancient Magic Circle' that lasts [2/4/6] seconds according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_OSIRIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Ancient Magic Circle' gives off 'Light of Illusions' every second, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 100% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PAIN_FOG_DESC.text: Immediately summons a thundercloud that deals @magical damage@ equal to 50% of the caster's attack power upon contact.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PAIN_FOG_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately summons a thundercloud that deals @magical damage@ equal to 55% of the caster's attack power upon contact.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PAIN_FOG_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately summons a thundercloud that deals @magical damage@ equal to 60% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Every time the enemy in the thundercloud attempts to attack, the thundercloud throws down lightning that deals @magical damage@ equal to 100% of the caster's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PAIN_FOG_LV4_DESC.text: Immediately summons a thundercloud that deals @magical damage@ equal to 70% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Every time the enemy in the thundercloud attempts to attack, the thundercloud throws down lightning that deasl @magical damage@ equal to 125% of the caster's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PAIN_FOG_LV5_DESC.text: Immediately summons a thundercloud that deals @magical damage@ equal to 80% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Every time the enemy in the thundercloud attempts to attack, the thundercloud throws down lightning that deals @magical damage@ equal to 150% of the caster's attack power and also has 30% chance of dealing 300% of the caster's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SHADOW_CALL_DESC.text: Immediately summons a shadow that copies the caster's attacks for 10 seconds. The shadow receives 75% of the caster's stats. (A maximum of 2 shadows can be summoned at once.)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SHADOW_CALL_LV2_DESC.text: Immediately summons a shadow that copies the caster's attacks for 10 seconds. The shadow receives 100% of the caster's stats. (A maximum of 2 shadows can be summoned at once.)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SHADOW_CALL_LV3_DESC.text: Immediately summons a shadow that copies the caster's attacks for 15 seconds. The shadow receives 125% of the caster's stats. (A maximum of 2 shadows can be summoned at once.)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SOCKSDROP_DESC.text: Crea una grandinata di calzini sporchi che infligge il (5/13/22)% di #danni magici# in base alla potenza d'attacco dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SOCKSDROP_SUBDESC.text: Each sock reduces the target's SP by 5. When an ally uses a chain-3 skill, the next Maelstrom is counted as chain-3 skill. (Once every 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_SUMMON_BEAST_DESC.text: Evoca un (lupo/lupo/toro) che infligge #danni magici# pari al 150% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe. Ogni animale riduce la (velocità d'attacco/potenza d'attacco/difesa) del nemico del 30%.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TEMPEST_DESC.text: Evoca 2 potenti tempeste magiche per 3 secondi, ciascuna delle quali infligge #danni magici# pari al 55% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe ogni 0,2 secondi, inoltre lancia in aria i nemici.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TEMPEST_LV2_DESC.text: Evoca 2 potenti tempeste magiche per 3 secondi, ciascuna delle quali infligge #danni magici# pari al 70% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe ogni 0,2 secondi, inoltre lancia in aria i nemici.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TEMPEST_LV3_DESC.text: Evoca 2 potenti tempeste magiche, ciascuna delle quali infligge #danni magici# pari al 90% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe ogni 0,2 secondi, inoltre lancia in aria i nemici. Vengono causati ulteriori #danni neutri# pari alla resistenza magica dell'eroe.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_VIOLET_DESC.text: When the hero uses a block, a Marionette is summoned that deals #physical damage# equal to (60/80/300)% of hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_VIOLET_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block, the number of Violet's magic dolls increases by 1 (maximum 2). Each magic doll deals #physical damage# equal to (60/180/300)% of Violet's attack power. Once reaching the maximum number of dolls, the next block skill will consume the existing dolls and summon a new one.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_VIOLET_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block, the number of Violet's magic dolls increases by 1 (maximum 2). Each magic doll deals #physical damage# equal to (60/180/300)% of Violet's attack power. Once reaching the maximum number of dolls, the next block skill will consume the existing dolls and summon a new one.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WATER_BOUNCE_DESC.text: Hero shoots a magical water drop which deals @magical damage@ equal to (50/100/150)% of hero's attack power, and renders the hit enemy to a absorptive status.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WATER_BOUNCE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: In 'absorptive mode,' Vesper forms 'waterdrops' according to the number of chains used by herself or other allies. Upon forming 3 'waterdrops,' Vesper shoots them upon her next auto attack to deal @magical damage@ equal to 200% of her attack power with each 'waterdrop.'

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WATER_BOUNCE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: In 'absorptive mode,' Vesper forms 'waterdrops' according to the number of chains used by herself or other allies. Upon forming 3 'waterdrops,' Vesper shoots them upon her next auto attack to deal @magical damage@ equal to 250% of her attack power with each 'waterdrop.' The attack ignores the enemy's resistance by 100% of Vesper's own resistance.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WOLFRAM_DESC.text: Throws the nearest enemy into the air and summons a wind that deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/350]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YICHUI_DESC.text: Deals @magic damage@ equal to (90/180/290)% of hero's attack power to the enemy hit by Rabbit Punch.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YICHUI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses Rabbit Punch, stack will pile up (2/4/6) based on chain number, and ally also gain 1 stack after using block skill. When hero reaches 6 stack, rabbit-feet shape sphere will launch from the sky, dealing @magic damage@ equal to 250% of hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YICHUI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses Rabbit Punch, stack will pile up (2/4/6) based on chain number, and ally also gain 1 stack after using block skill. When hero reaches 6 stack, rabbit-feet shape sphere will launch from the sky, dealing @magic damage@ equal to (350% of hero's attack power plus 1000% of entire enemies defense). When Yichui enters into battle, she starts with instant shield. (Shield : 3000, on/off unable)

TEXT_TIP_BREADFRUIT.text:
The more berries heroes consume, the darker the color of their 
training labels become (maximum being orange).

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_1.text: Heroes with mechanical bodies are weak to bugs!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_2.text: There are rumors of a secret dungeon in the lairs of the mysterious company 'L.C,' with a very particular purpose…

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_3.text: Even the most ordinary of heroes can possess mighty power here!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_4.text: Bugs have infested 'L.C,' the mysterious company of Hasla! Help 'L.C' get rid of them, Crusaders!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_5.text: Check out the story behind the dungeon on the Season 2: Inheritance Update Pre-Registeration page!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_1.text: Your entire play data may disappear if you do not sync your account!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_2.text: Google Play Service is only used for Ranking, Achievements, and Multi-Play, so make sure to sync your account separately!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_LEADER.text: Your main hero represents your account.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BREAD.text:
Earn bread to train your heroes at the Chilly Bread Storage,
which opens every Tuesday and Saturday.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BUFF_1.text: The buff item 'milk' affects the entire team.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BUFF_2.text: Did you know that you can simultaneously use Elixir of Goddess and Milk of Growth to double their effects?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_CHAMPION.text: Champion stats are proportionate to the sum of the stats of your current team's heroes.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_CHAMP_CUTIN.text: You can control your champion cutscene mode in the Settings menu.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_2.text: Ingredients to forge Soulbound Weapons can be obtained at the Fortress of Souls.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_1.text: You can view your fame information in the Mercenary Information menu.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_2.text: You can earn more fame through various achievements, and splendid portrait frames!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_3.text: Discover secrets of Hasla and receive hidden artifacts!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_1.text: Trade meat and honor everyday with other crusaders after adding them as friends!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_2.text: Heroes accompanied by a Friend Hero in a scenario stage will earn 50% additional exp.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_FAVORITE.text: Bookmark other Crusaders in your friend list to manage them in groups!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GOLD.text:
Running out of Gold? Go from rags to riches at the Goblin's Secret Storage, 
which opens every Sunday!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_1.text: Training heroes requires Bread and Gold.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_2.text: In order to promote a hero, both the hero's level and training status must be maxed out. Honor is required to promote a hero.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_1.text: The scars of the Apostles' War one hundred years ago will not heal easily for the continent of Hasla.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_2.text: For long years have the Goddesses protected the Soul Stones, which confine the Apostles within...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_3.text: In the dark corners of Hasla sleep the Apostles who succeeded in escaping the confines of the Soul Stones.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_4.text: Apostles are beings who seek to return the universe into darkness, whence they were born.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_MANACAR_2.text: For what reason has Manacar woken from its long slumber?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_PUMPKIN_1.text: In Pumpkin City dwells Dorothy's former masters, the Four Grand Witches.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_PUMPKIN_2.text: In Pumpkin City dwells Dorothy's former masters, the Four Grand Witches.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_1.text: The white cat that accompanies Mew everywhere is named "Navi."

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_10.text: The hero Crow does not think of himself as human...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_11.text: Having been tranformed into a cyborg, Spiny no longer ages.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_12.text: Dorothy disguises herself as an elf to hide her identity.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_13.text: Surprisingly, Lilith has never been in a relationship for all these years.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_14.text: In the lands of Roman, a legend of the Beast King, lord of all animals, has passed down for generations...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_15.text: Across the southern seas of Hasla lies another continent, shrouded in mystery...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_2.text: The village cat that dwells before the hero pavilion is named "Lavi."

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_3.text: The name of Dorothy's familiar is "Oz."

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_4.text: Did you know? The name of Vivian's father is Gordian.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_5.text: Will Rochefort's love have a happy ending?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_6.text: Is Maria aware of Roland's feelings towards her?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_7.text: The engine Stanya carries on her back is made from newly developed, high-tech material, and is said to be much lighter than it seems.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_8.text: The Animal Lovers' Club has issued a first-class bounty against Gon.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_9.text: Uziment's fiancee is the daughter of the Frost Elf Tribe Chief, a Frost Elf named Alisha.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_INFO.text: Touch and hold your hero or icon to view more information.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_INTERACTION.text: Have you tried tapping the heroes in town?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_MAXLV.text: Reach the max level of a hero, regardless of category or grade, to receive 1 Jewel.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HONOR.text: Running out of honor? You can earn honor and additional exp at the Ancient Training Grounds dungeon!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_HEROSTORY.text: Curious about heroes' background stories? Read them at the Library of Time!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_HW.text: Read more about heroes and weapons at the Library of Time!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_ILLUST.text: View your heroes' magnificent illustrations at the Library of Time!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_SCENARIO.text: You can replay scenario cutscenes at the Library of Time.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIMITED_HERO.text: Secret Heroes can only be acquired through particular events.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LOADING_OPTION_1.text: You can choose to see only pixel art loading images in the Settings.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_PASSIVE.text: Tap your name tag in the upper left corner to view your account information.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_PVP_1.text: Participate in the Colosseum to earn weekly Jewels!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_RING_1.text: Rings can be acquired through clearing the Tower of Manacar and weekly quests.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_RUNE.text: You can transfer various special skills to heroes at the Skill Lab.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_SKILL_INFO.text: Did you know that you can view each hero's skill information by pressing and holding their portraits in the Battle Preparation Menu?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_SUPPORT_HERO.text: Supply Heroes are used to supply forces (Champions), and cannot be trained or promoted.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_TEAM.text: Try saving and editing frequently used combinations in the Team Formation Menu!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_WEAPON_1.text: You can use Gold to unlock higher weapon upgrade options.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_WEAPON_2.text: Check the Weapons Management Menu for available options before you upgrade your weapons!

TEXT_TIP_DG_ACCEL_1.text: You cannot use special skills or Goddess abilities in the Time Acceleration Magic Dungeon.

TEXT_TIP_DG_ACCEL_2.text: Blocks are generated at a very fast pace in the Time Acceleration Dungeon!

TEXT_TIP_DG_BREAD.text: Monsters of Chilly Bread Storage only receive damage from particular chains.

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_1.text: Race against a flying witch in the Witch Race!

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_2.text: Some obstacle pumpkins in the Witch Race are immune to either physical or magical damage.

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_3.text: Heroes dash forward upon using Goddess skills in the Witch Race.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_1.text: It seems Pandora has made a grave mistake.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_2.text: Deemo and the Little Girl earned special powers after coming to Hasla... And so did the Masked Girl.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_3.text: The Masked Girl wishes to keep Deemo and the Little Girl from growing the tree and returning to their own world.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_4.text: The higher the tree grows, the more anxious the Masked Girl seems.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_5.text: Will the tree help the Little Girl and Deemo back to their homes?

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_CHAIN_1.text: Using higher chains will help the tree grow faster.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_CHAIN_2.text: Using higher chains will earn more coins.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_1.text: Touch blocks of the same color when Masked Children and shadows of the Masked Girl approach the line before the tree.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_2.text: Help Deemo finish playing his piece!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_3.text: It is recommended that you turn up the volume while playing the DEEMO dungeon.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_4.text: Listening to music in the DEEMO dungeon will surely yield better results!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_1.text: Fergus's dream of building a transforming robot was foiled by the long war and resulting shortage of iron.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_2.text: The Ent Robot was born through the combination of Fergus's hammer and Celine's magic.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_3.text: Fergus's first prototype of the Ent Robot was so small that it could only be controlled by a remote control.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_1.text: Deal as much damage as you can to the Ent Robot for 60 seconds!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_2.text: The Ent Robot is highly resistant to neutral damage.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_3.text: The Ent Robot has low HP but a very strong shield.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_4.text: Champions do not deal direct damage to the Ent Robot.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_1.text:
The 'Feel' criterion of the scoresheet
changes with Fergus's current mood.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_2.text: Even the smallest factors can affect your final score.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_3.text:
The judges won't like common recipes - 
they'll give a low multiplier number if they are bored.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_4.text: As much as you hate Fergus, please do not poison our only blacksmith.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_1.text:
Fergus is searching the 'food of the heavens' he ate
in his years of training as an apprentice blacksmith.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_2.text:
The ingredients are always fresh
thanks to Celine's preservation magic.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_3.text:
The judges' table is quite expensive,
as it has been made with thebest technology of the Neth Empire.

TEXT_TIP_EXCEED_4.text: Soulbound weapons can only be equipped by the relevant hero.

TEXT_TIP_HOUSE_2.text: Some decorations possess special features or interactions. Be sure to check them out!

TEXT_TIP_HOUSE_3.text: Try placing your monuments in your Hero Home!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_1.text: Different paths can be taken in the Legend of Primal Flames dungeon.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_2.text: Every playthrough (and rewards!) can turn out different depending on what path you choose to take.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_3.text: Some paths lead to a dead end, so be careful!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_4.text: Fulfilling certain requirements will reveal hidden paths.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_5.text: Monsters that appear from the Hidden Waves are stronger than Normal Wave monsters.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_6.text:
Listen carefully to what the Goddesses say:
they may give clues to finding a hidden path!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_2.text: Susanoo, Saiga, and Oda were close friends in their childhood.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_4.text: All rings from the Legend of Primal Flames dungeon possess a background legend.

TEXT_TIP_LOADING_TIP.text: Here you can find useful tips for playing Crusaders Quest.

TEXT_TIP_LOBBY_FRUIT.text: The training mark gradually turns from white to purple the more berries you feed your hero.

TEXT_TIP_MEDIA_1.text: Check out other news from Crusaders Quest in the Media menu!

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_1.text: The better the scarecrow, the sturdier it is.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_2.text: The scarecrow is reset whenever you restart Practice Mode.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_3.text: Scarecrows are unlocked as you progress through Scenario Mode.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_4.text: Conduct various experiments with scarecrows' cutting-edge technology!

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_5.text: You can select the scarecrow in Practice Mode.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_LOBBY_1.text: Learn to work with heroes and test your skills in Practice Mode!

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_3.text: The time limit of each Colosseum ticket is 1 hour.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_4.text: The Colosseum is reset every Monday, 9 A.M.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_5.text: You can use honor to find another opponent.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_REWARD.text: The Statue of Honor that stands at the village entrance shows the main hero of last week's colosseum rank no.1.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_1.text: Heroes become more sturdy in the Colosseum!

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_2.text: If duel time exceeds 1 minute, heroes become stronger but cannot be healed from that point.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_TIME.text: The time limit for a colosseum round is 3 minutes.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_TIMEUP.text: After 3 minutes, the winner of the colosseum round is decided by the sum of heroes' remaining HP.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_CONTENTS_1.text: The especially strong Apostles among those created by Destalos are called by a different name.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_CONTENTS_2.text: Fenriruth used to be a section of the 13th Apostle Ouroboros, who was made up of five sandworms.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_META_2.text: If you cannot find a partner, a random AI hero team will appear to help.

TEXT_TIP_RING_1.text:
Essence of Mana can be acquired by
extracting rings from Fergus.

TEXT_TIP_RING_2.text:
Essence of Mana can be used to reset
rings' subsidiary options.

TEXT_TIP_RING_3.text: Essence of Flames can be used to convert rings' ranks.

TEXT_TIP_RING_4.text: Converting a ring's rank requires Essence of Flames and will change the ring's option to maximum grade.

TEXT_TIP_RING_5.text: Converting a ring's option will not yield the same option.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_ATK_PURE.text: Neutral damage ignores the opponent's armor and resistance to deal true damage.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_ATK_TYPE.text: All heroes' attack can be divided into four categories: "physical," "magical," "neutral," and "fixed."

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_BLOCK_CHAIN.text: Higher chains mean stronger block skills!

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_BOSS_GET.text: Clear stages with corrupted hero bosses, and they may decide to join your company.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_BOSS_SP.text: Boss monsters use powerful attacks once their SPs are fully charged. Be careful!

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_GAMEOVER.text: Rewards already acquired are retained even if your heroes die.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_LEADER.text: Leader heroes have 50% more chance of generating blocks than non-leader heroes.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_PENET.text: Penetration is important if you want to deal more damage to enemies with high armor or resistance.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_STATUS_BUFFDEBUFF.text: Did you know? In battle, your Heroes' Accuracy rate and Evasion rate cannot be lower than 5% or higher than 95%.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_1.text: The boss heroes of the Fortress of Souls are constituted of heroes belonging to last week's Colosseum ranked Crusaders.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_2.text: Each hero can participate only once per day.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_3.text: Use Jewels to retry an already cleared stage and reset heroes.

TEXT_TIP_STATISTICS_1.text: You can check detailed battle statistics in the Battle Results menu.

TEXT_TIP_THANKYOU.text: Thank you for playing Crusaders Quest!

TEXT_TIP_WEAPON_3.text: You cannot convert options of normal weapons.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_CHRONOS.text: Blizzards. Do not panic and use my power.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh, di nuovo?!
Lo farò a pezzi.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_DOG.text:
Attenzione, una tempesta di neve!
Presto, usa il mio potere!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_FOREST.text:
Sta per scatenarsi una tempesta.
Usa il potere della dea!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
A snowstorm is approaching. 
Let my powers help you.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:

Let my powers help you.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Umpf, nevischio!
Usa il mio potere, se ne hai bisogno!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_WINTER.text:
Una tempesta di neve davvero imponente.
Calmati e usa il mio potere.

TEXT_WR_EP7_DIONNE_BOSS_DIONNE.text:
Kukuku... You rotting piece trash! 
Fight to your deaths! Kukuku!

TEXT_WR_EP7_DIONNE_BOSS_DIONNE_NOFACE.text: A forboding gloom enfolds the enemy.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_BOSS_ELTALOS.text: Here all light shall be quenched.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
My abilities are being repressed, 
but they shall return before long. Fear not.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_DESERT.text:
What? My powers aren't working! 
T-time out!

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_DOG.text:
I...I think I spent all my powers. 
Whew...

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_FOREST.text:
... My powers are not returning. 
Is it possible to rest a little?

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SEA.text:
... That being... 
has swallowed my powers...

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
The void has swallowed the light... 
Yet it shall surely return.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
The void has swallowed the light... 
Yet fear not, it shall return.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
I-I'm just a bit tired! 
Protect me in the meantime!

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_WINTER.text:
A worthy foe, to have stolen my powers. 
Wait... they will return!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
No SP? I see.
Let us calmly see to the situation.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_DESERT.text:
Woah?! What's this?
Our SP isn't recharging!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_DOG.text:
The SP isn't recharging at all!
What's happening?!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_FOREST.text:
It is true we cannot obtain SP,
but don't be afraid.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SEA.text:
...This darkness. It's
keeping us from gaining SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
We shall not be able to obtain SP
before this darkness passes.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDD.text:
We shall not be able to obtain SP
before this darkness passes.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Hmmph. The SP isn't recharging!
Maybe it's due to this darkness...

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_WINTER.text:
Oho, our SP has been sealed off, I see.
Yet we shall not fall back!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Fear not. 
1-chain and 3-chain attacks generate SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_DOG.text: Eh? Using 2-chains won't fill up our SP!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_FOREST.text: Only 1-chain and 3-chain attacks will generate SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SEA.text:
... You can only earn SP 
through 1-chain or 3-chains here...

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
To earn SP you must use 
1- or 3-chain attacks.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
To earn SP you must use 
1- or 3-chain attacks.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
If you want SP, 
you'll need to use 1-chain or 3-chains!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_WINTER.text:
So 2-chains do not generate SP. 
An interesting ability indeed!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Use my powers.
This heat could be used to our advantage.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ooh, hot.
But my powers are stronger!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_DOG.text:
Ouch, hot! 
But I can block it with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_FOREST.text:
Oh, what a fiery wind.
Use my powers; I shall block it for you.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SEA.text:
... This hot wind is uncomfortable.
Use my powers... I'll cool us down.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
This… volcanic wind…? 
Use my powers. It may come in handy.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SILUNIS_HI.text:
This… volcanic wind…? 
Use my powers. It may come in handy.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Use my powers. I'll show you
the real goddess of the volcano!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_WINTER.text:
Ha, what a pitiful attack with hot air!
I can just blow it away no problem.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_HIDDEN_BOSS.text:
Will cutting down that revenant give me answers?
Then I shall burn it with my flames!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_HIDDEN_START.text:
A mysterious power seeps out from the ring...
Perhaps it has something to do with the spirit we just saw.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
... Ensnared by the vines, I see.
Break free by rapidly using blocks.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh! I can't move anymore!
Let's escape by rapid firing blocks!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_DOG.text:
We're trapped!
Press the blocks quickly to escape!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_FOREST.text:
Oh dear, we're trapped. It is alright though;
will you try pressing your blocks?

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_SEA.text:
... We can't move...
Let's try using a bunch of blocks...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
These vines are trapping us.
Press blocks in succession to escape.

These vines are trapping us.
Press blocks in succession to escape.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
These insolent vines! Tying us up!
Quick! Use your blocks!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_WINTER.text:
Hahaha! We're trapped... interesting.
But there's no time for this. Press the blocks.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
These are not normal plants.
I feel something ominous about them, be careful.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ah! Something's grabbing my feet!
These vines are so gross!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_DOG.text:
Huh? There's something wriggly...
These vines are giving me the creeps...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_FOREST.text:
These are mischievous vines,
to be clutching my feet like this.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SEA.text:
... How rude,
you should be careful of these vines...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
These vines do not mean well.
Be careful where you step.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SILUNIS_H.text:
These vines do not mean well.
Be careful where you step.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
What are these annoying things?
Ha, they have some nerve, grabbing me!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_WINTER.text:
Grabbing ME? These plants have nerve!
These are worth keeping an eye on!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Stop flailing about in such an disgraceful manner.
I can release you from the binds.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh, it's hard to move in this rain.
Let's get through with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_DOG.text:
It's cold and sludgy…
Use my power to shake it off!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_FOREST.text:
Rain is good for plants, but not now.
Won't you try using my powers?

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SEA.text:
... Water is good, but this rain...
I'll make it stop with my powers...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
This rain binds the feet.
It can be washed away with the power of light.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
This rain binds the feet.
It can be washed away with the power of light.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Mere rain won't extinguish me.
I'll burn it up with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_WINTER.text:
Impediments, tsk.
Let me give you a hand.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
The torch might go out.
Protect the torch with my power.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_DESERT.text:
Gee! It's icy!
Use my power to fire up!

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_DOG.text:
Oops! Such cold rain!
I will protect the torch from the rain with my power!

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_FOREST.text:
Rain helps trees grow,
but puts fire out. Please use my power.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_SEA.text:
... I don't hate rain...
But not now... I should make it stop with my power.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
Protect the torch from the rain with my power. 
The flame must be protected.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
Protect the torch from the rain with my power. 
The flame must be protected.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
This much rain won't stop me.
Captain, show them my power!

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_WINTER.text:
Tickling. 
I can blow them away with my power.

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_END_AIRBOOM.text:
Gasp... What is this devilry...? 
It is as if my powers have been drained.

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_END_OPENING.text:
So it has completely revived its powers... 
It is the end if we do not stop it here.

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_RUIN_GARDEN_LV2.text:
There are more flowers.
Watch out!

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_VOID_REGACY.text:
That is... indeed very dangerous.
Destroy it!

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_VOID_WEAKNESS.text:
Feels like all the power is 
leaving me... What is this...!

TEXT_WR_RAID_BS_MANACAR_VOID_WORLDRULES.text:

hero with higher SP first.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_CHRO.text:
You are in need. 
Use my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_DESE.text:
Stronger that expected! 
But... I’m stronger!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_DOG.text:
I feel... something scary... 
Please use my power!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_FORE.text:
Something’s coming... 
Use the power of the Goddess.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_SEA.text:
... Use my power. 
I... can protect you.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_SILU.text:
There is an ominous spirit in the air... 
We must prepare against it.

There is an ominous spirit in the air... 
We must prepare against it.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SISTER_SIS_WINT.text:
Don’t worry. 
It’s time to use my power!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_DASH_SOLTAR.text:
Bodies to dust...
Souls to darkness...!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_CHRO.text:
We don’t have to deal with this. 
Let’s escape from here with my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_DESE.text:
Whoa, this is too much! Let’s flee!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_DOG.text:
Let's block this together!
One, two...!

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_FORE.text:

Use my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_SEA.text:
... We should get down now. 
We can evade this by using my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_SILU.text:
This... is a rather dangerous situation. 
Let my powers take you out of harm's way.

This... is a rather dangerous situation. 
Let my powers take you out of harm's way.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_VOLC.text:
Ha, I can’t just watch you die. 
You are allowed to use my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SISTER_SIS_WINT.text:
I do not usually avoid battles,
but this I cannot fight. Use my power.

TEXT_WR_SOLTAR_LORD_LAST_SOLTAR.text:
I... I will not fall... 
Argh...!

I’ll deal with it. 
Keep calm during the battle.

YEAAAHH!!
I won't lose to the likes of you!

I’m not good enough 
but I will protect you!

Don’t worry. 
I will be there for you.

How dare you 
try to block my way?

Oh, how interesting. 
But I have no time for this.

TEXT_WR_SOUL_REGION_ATTACK_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Darkness is coming.
Everyone, be prepared!

TEXT_WR_SOUL_REGION_ATTACK_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh, questo posto mi mette i brividi.
È davvero inquietante!

TEXT_WR_SOUL_REGION_ATTACK_SIS_SEA.text:
C'è qualcosa che non va...
Qui non siamo al sicuro...

TEXT_WR_SOUL_REGION_ATTACK_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Che cos'è?
Sta cercando di ucciderci!
