TEXT_CHA_HU_LIMITED_YS8_6_HUMMEL_DESC.text: Hummel thanks Adol and company after he finishes his 'job' at the northern regions of the Isle of Seiren. Declaring that a safe return home is also a part of his 'job,' he wholeheartedly joins Castaway Village in their mission to escape the island. During their explorations, however, the company is teleported by a mysterious Energy Crystal to the land of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_PA_1_11_DESC.text: A scholar who lives in the forest to collect plant samples more easily. He has a habit of talking to himself, the villagers say.

TEXT_CHA_PA_1_12_DESC.text: This merchant comes from a long line of skilled and clever traders who have lived in the Desert for generations. It's a pity that every generation of the family suffered from a very poor sense of direction, which is not the best quality to have when your career requires traveling long distances.

TEXT_CHA_PA_1_13_DESC.text: If there's a castle wall to fix, the Castle Repairman is your man! Widely admired for his skills, he emits an aura of a proper artisan when he holds up his hammer.

TEXT_CHA_PA_1_14_DESC.text: The latest android released to the public, with brand-new functions. The android oversees security at Road Industry and will automatically tackle and hold down anyone it deems an intruder. Unlike its prototype, it does not cause serious malfunctions such as self-destruction... except it will occasionally recognize all objects within a 100-meter radius as 'the enemy.'

TEXT_CHA_PA_1_15_DESC.text: Byuljooboo has come to the Taebaek Mountains in search of a hare's liver. He saw Dongsamo's back and mistook him for a hare and chased him, but was unable to catch up. He's still chasing after him, though.

TEXT_CHA_PA_2_15_DESC.text: A nameless knight who silently carries out the requests of his village while others clamor for fame and renown.

TEXT_CHA_PA_2_16_DESC.text: A renowned plasterer who is famous for the quality of his bricks. He travels to the Temple of Illusions with dreams of studying the renowned yet lost techniques of Ancient Desert architecture. Upon coming face-to-face with the Temple, Fukhu is immediately stricken by its beauty and enters in wonder.

TEXT_CHA_PA_2_17_DESC.text: A specialist of snow removal specially stationed by the Neth Army for a "top-secret mission." Ever since he experienced a terrible blizzard of the northern lands, however, he becomes hysterical whenever the clouds start to darken.

TEXT_CHA_PA_2_18_DESC.text: A test subject experimented upon by scientists before they reconstructed a soulless body from the Kingdom of Trista. As no safety measures were taken into consideration in the process, the unstable subject became more and more violent as the experiment progressed. It was eventually locked up in an abandoned lab somewhere in Rapture Science.

TEXT_CHA_PA_2_19_DESC.text: The top chef of the palace that can make all sorts of delicacies. Even if the same ingredients are used, those dishes show hallucinations. Scorched rice soup is his top dish!

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_17_DESC.text: Nothing is known about this mysterious protector of the Ents - save that he is enraged at a certain Elf for daring to eat Ent bark. How barbaric!

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_18_DESC.text: A woman who volunteered for an experiment for eternal youth in order to live forever with her lover. Unfortunately, the experiment fails - but not without yielding the partial success of aging immortality. Immediately after the experiment, the undying test subject is brainwashed and turned into a living sample for researchers to study.

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_19_DESC.text: It is the Snow Mountain Climber's ambition to climb the snowy peaks of Nosgard, infamous as they are among mountaineers. She hasn't succeeded in conquering a single peak as of yet, but she'll get there someday!

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_20_DESC.text: A security guard who works the graveyard shift at Road Industry. She's afraid of the dark, but she needed the extra money.

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_21_DESC.text: A gatekeeper that guards the entrance of the palace. He became a gatekeeper in order to see the Five Tiger Generals he admires so much from up close. He is bright by nature, but maintains a stern expression at the job.

TEXT_CHA_PA_3_FUGUROID_DESC.text: An experimental android devised by Fergus in hopes of inventing an automated domestic robot. It runs on the power of Old Weapons and can even activate some of their skills. Fergusroid is still in its initial stages of development, however, and can't really be used for anything practical. ..... is what Fergus told you, but scrawled on the back of its head, you find the words 'Ent Robot Skill Test, No. 32.'

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_22_DESC.text: The son of a house of warriors on the outskirts of the Kingdom of Chen. Although his family wishes for Mengqi to become a scholar and thus obtain fame and wealth more easily, Mengqi only wishes to become a warrior like his father. A strained relationship with his father quickly escalates to an outburst, which leads to Mengqi being kicked out of his home. Mengqi leaves with his beloved stallion 'Fierce Dragon' to seek the path of the warrior.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_23_DESC.text: A run-of-the-mill mercenary of Nosgard. One day, Heim happens to hear a rumor of great treasure hidden deep in the forbidden Sacred Ground of Nosgard. Ignoring the fact that no one is allowed to tread into the sanctuary, Heim persuades some of his friends to follow him on what should be his most lucrative adventure.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_24_DESC.text: A magical girl idol produced to compete against Cano. Despite her slogan "Magical Girl with Magical Powers that Hunts Down Villains," some say she pushes around the special effects team to make her look like an actual magical girl.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_25_DESC.text: On the way to the capital of Grancia to receive his knighthood training, Caeneus stumbles upon a group of bandits. At the moment of despair, a figure of light and mercy arrives to save the day: Lady Victoria of the Cobalt Knights. Caeneus is instantly moved by the graceful knight and vows to enter tha ranks of the Cobalt Knights at all costs.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_26_DESC.text: Thor's elder brother and a member of the Nosgardian royal family. While Odin does retain every right to the throne as Thor's brother and regards his position to the kingdom with kingly love and responsibility, he often clashes with Thor due to their opposing political values and views on ruling the kingdom.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_28_DESC.text: A girl who grew up in the Junkyard of Neth Empire and has, like all children who grow up there, joined 'the Scrappy Gang.' After fixing a discarded TV and seeing a broadcast of Colosseum battles, Fireaxe comes to revere the sweaty, glorious world of gladiators.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_29_DESC.text: The reason I gave up my place as one of the Five Tiger Generals? Well, I 'spose I hafta tell you about that day those damned monsters came attacking our small town. It may be forty years ago, but I sure do remember it clear as crystal. It was one of those summer days when the sun is a-shinin' and you can feel the heat rising from the earth, and you think to yourself well this summer is going to be mighty hot indeed! And I, a green beansprout I was back then, I was preparing for the autumn harvest with the village elders. It was then those monsters came trampling over our hard work, two Goblins and three Ents, and was I surprised to see them just charging forth like bulls before red! But I told myself, well Shuwen if you were born a man then you hafta act like one before you're dead and regretting you never did, so I summoned up all the courage I had and faced them straight. Turns out my fist was a force to be reckoned with - those monsters fell to the ground before they could step on another potato! 'This young'un was born strong,' was what the village elders said, and I reckon this strength comes from my mama's side of the family. After this day I began to train under ol' 'Drunken Fist,' who they say was quite the somethin' in the old days of war (though I thought he was just an old drunkard before I started training). Anyway, I couldn't concentrate on my training since rumors spread of my fight with those two Goblins and three Ents, and our quiet town was bumblin' with people who thought they could fight - I couldn't take one step out of my hut without someone challenging me to a duel! One of them was the sole descendant of a famous clan - we became good friends after this and that happened but this is a story for another time. But those challengers were more bark than bite and everyone fell to one punch of my fist - I was a little sorry because they had traveled all this way to our village and they didn't stay long after they lost, even when everyone offered a good hot meal that wouldn't have gone to waste, no sir. I wonder what they were doing now, now that I think of it, the saints bless them wherever they are. And then a few years passed and

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_30_DESC.text: Those who value their strength flock to the Arena of Roman in the hopes of being crowned the Gladiator Champion. With the onset of a new season, a man donning a lion mask comes towering over the other applicants. Many belittle the contrast he depicts, standing bare-handed and lightly armed among other monstrous warriors heavily equipped—only to watch on in amazement when he easily defeats his competitors and passes the preliminary rounds. ‘Lion Mask,’ as he comes to be known, attracts many new fans with his extraordinary performance of equal parts agility, experience, and brute strength: all executed with a sensational streak never seen before by even the experts on the long tradition of Roman gladiators. Envious of Lion Mask’s newfound popularity, many gladiators challenge him. Yet all fall before the beast’s visage.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_31_DESC.text: An apprentice inquisitor of the Order of the Goddess. Taken in by the Order after being orphaned at an early age, Cecilia has grown up a devout follower of the Goddess. She is famous for her utter devotion to any command from the Order as well as her merciless punishments. However, when a new faction emerges from within the Order and quickly dominates the Holy City of Elandia with their different doctrines, Cecilia's faith too begins to falter.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_32_DESC.text: As an inquisitor of the Order of the Goddess one hundred years ago, Luci was sworn to the holy task of hunting down the nefarious race of Devils who had sold their souls to Demons. She captured and sent more Devils to the executioner than anyone else in the Order, a feat by which she became known as ‘the Guardian of Light.’ One day, Luci is attacked and possessed by a lone Devran, who had been wandering in search of a host. The inquisitor successfully resists the creature with her divine powers of light, but she could not prevent her physical body from transforming into that of a Devil.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_33_DESC.text: Otis may have been born as the eldest son of a noble house of Trista, but neither prestige nor wealth guaranteed as his birthright can truly restrain his rebellious nature. When he is finally cut off by his family for his reckless feats, Otis settles in the slums of the borderlands, threatening funds from the nearby merchant guild under the excuse of a 'protection fee.' After some time, Otis receives a formal request from the same guild to be true to his word: apparently, the merchants' stores have recently been terrorized by foreign thugs. Otis easily rounds up the villains and returns home, not realizing that one of those 'foreign thugs' was the son of an infamous gang leader.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_35_DESC.text: An ancient spirit found wandering near the Sanctuary of the Elder Edda. He can remember neither who he is nor what regrets he still has in the world to be haunting it. He only knows that he cherishes his tombstone, of which time has eroded the inscription - all except for the words 'Snorri,' his name... Or at least, cherishes enough as a weapon to pummel the ice spirits he meets while meandering aimlessly through the tundra.

TEXT_CHA_PA_4_36_DESC.text: The forest guarded by the Deer Spirit Neulsolgil is always crowded with visiting spirits. Whenever Neulsolgill starts beating out a rhythm with her hammer, the animals of the woods respond with their own music, and the other spirits revel in the joyful harmony, forgetting - for a short moment - the troubles of the outside world. The Forest of Spirits is hence a place of jubilation and bliss, hidden away from unfriendly eyes through Neulsolgil's powers. Yet a darkness grows outside the woods, a darkness that they cannot avoid forever...

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_22_DESC.text: In the foggy depths of the mountains Mengqi trains alone, never looking back. When he finally steps forth to take the performance exams of Chen, his prowess and skill with his spear makes him an instant favorite with the generals of Chen. Yet Mengqi regards his success as short-reached, and leaves for the frontlines of the battlefield to perform great feats his father may acknowledge.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_23_DESC.text: Heim and company barely defeat the Guardian of the Sacred Ground before entering the forbidden sanctuary. They soon realize that the sanctuary is guarding something under its seal, but before they can escape they fall under a cursed sleep. Doomed to become the new Guardians of the Sacred Ground, they slumber...

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_24_DESC.text: She would always have a chat with villains ahead of the match, during which they would surrender. This makes fans raving over Yuna calling her an "Icon of Peace," however, those who had "the chat" with her could not particularly agree with that nickname.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_25_DESC.text: True to his word, Caeneus works hard to overcome the difficult training and exams required to enter the Cobalt Knights, led under Victoria's flag. He volunteers for the position of flag bearer to stand at the vanguard and to aid Victoria at a closer distance. Over the years, Caeneus shows his worth at the front of the troops and is promoted to Vice Captain of the Cobalt Knights. However, his days of fulfillment come to a sudden end when Victoria receives Alexander's summoning and leaves for 'greater tasks.'

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_26_DESC.text: Odin proposes to his younger brother that they must unite the kingdom to a single, central power, with the royal line maintaining a firm hand over their immense territory. Yet Thor disagrees, claiming that such centralization is not only realistically impossible, but also inconsistent with his own values on ruling the kingdom.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_28_DESC.text: Fireaxe finally manages to arrive at Roman, intent on becoming a gladiator. Yet her skinny physique and meager strength do not help her in the ruthless arena, and Fireaxe loses battle after battle. The one fateful day, Fireaxe happens to see an interview of Achilles, the legendary gladiator of Roman.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_29_DESC.text: I thought that I had done some good with my training under ol' 'Drunken Fist,' and it seemed my fist was ready to do something in the world. I asked myself, what can I do for my country? because I may not be much more than a country bumpkin but even a country bumpkin can fight for his king if he puts his mind to it! It was then that Lil' Buddy told us a rumor he had heard from the village down yonder. Seemed there had been some scuffling at the borders with the neighboring lands over some problem or other, and it was likely that the fight would blow up into war. Well, what better cause was there for me to use my years of training to do some good? I decided there and then that I would devote myself to the country I was born and raised and loved like my own mama. 'Goodbye,' I said to the people listening to Lil' Buddy's story, 'I reckon I can use my fists for some good there.' I didn't even bother packing and just headed straight for the borderlands, where I found out that Lil' Buddy's rumor had been true all along and war had begun. It was an interesting part of life, because you meet all sorts of people in war, you see. We won some battles and lost some too, but the records I kept still show that I won all the 300 duels I fought by myself. 'The Undefeated Fighter,' my comrades called me, and I gotta admit that made me feel pretty special - not just 'cause of the name but the fact that I could feel my comrades loved me as much as I loved them. Blessed souls, every one of them. So I fought for years and years, protecting the borders of our country, until a man from the Royal Court came looking for me. Wanted me to take me out of war and into the palace for some reason he wouldn't say, and I admit I was curious, but I refused if that meant I had to leave my comrades behind. So you can imagine my surprise when those very comrades came crowding around me and the man from the Royal Court. 'Shuwen, a man's gotta know his true calling when it comes for him.' Wise words from blessed souls. So I followed the man to the Royal Palace, where I shocked to discover that the king himself wanted to make me one of his Five Tiger Generals! Ain't that something! I thought to myself, well, this must be my true calling then, and I said yes, Your Majesty, all grand and important-like. You see, it wasn't just because of fame and honor that I accepted. A grand title means that you can do more things, it opens doors for a man to pursue greatness. And I was confident that I could do great things for my country and its people. But after some time I became a Tiger General, I found that not everyone thinks the same. Was pure tomfoolery, what they were doing at the Palace, and they sure didn't 'preciate a country bumpkin bumping shoulders with them. I went through some things a man shouldn't have to go through, not if he respects his fellow countrymen, but since that's another story I won't talk about it here. Anyway I left, because what's a grand title if you can't do great things with it? It was more disappointing as

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_30_DESC.text: Who is Lion Mask? What illustrious warrior stands behind the disguise? None of the numerous theories surrounding Lion Mask’s identity can place him: is he a new prototype developed by the scientists of Neth Empire? Perhaps a messenger from the mysterious floating islands above? Or perhaps (this is one of the more fanciful theories) he is an Ogre suffering dwarfism. At any rate, Lion Masks claims victory after victory amongst the wild cheer of the crowd, reaching the final round of the Arena. The Arena’s current Champion Achilles and his mysterious challenger Lion Mask face each other—and begin a ruthless battle that lasts for hours. Lion Mask’s light feet easily evade the heavy blow of Achilles’s infamous ‘Thanatos,’ but Achilles’s golden armor also proves resilient to Lion Mask’s punches. At last, the victor emerges: Achilles. Yet many agree that he “got lucky” as Lion Mask forfeited after spraining his lower back.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_31_DESC.text: Under the new faction's lead, a Holy War breaks out in the Holy City of Elandia. Cecilia is also called to battle as a 'fighter nun.' Yet after seeing the chaos and hatred dividing the people who once all worshipped the same Goddess, Cecilia becomes overwhelmed with doubt and dejection. She finds that she cannot wield her hammer in battle, even at the risk of failing her comrades. After the war, the nun is even more horrified to witness many followers of the Goddess being executed for heresy, branded as pagans and dissidents. Cecilia finds her faith completely dissolved before the sight.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_32_DESC.text: During the harsh interrogations by the very comrades with whom she once fought side by side, Luci demonstrates that she still retains full control of her divine powers. Yet despite proof of her innocence, the other inquisitors fail to see her as more than a mere demon with hideous horns and a tail. When she is condemned to burn at the stake, Luci loses all hope. She closes her eyes and waits for death… but moments before the flames engulf her, she is freed by Demona.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_33_DESC.text: Now targeted by dozens of infamous gangsters, Otis finds himself on the run. Otis's displays of daring and strength, however, gain the interest of the gang leader, who - to Otis's surprise - hands over a smuggling route with which he should "prove himself." Otis so ends up pledging a blood bond with the Boss. Now in charge of escorting the Boss's wagons that smuggle in black tea - the most valuable contraband luxury good in the whole desert - Otis must face battle after battle with righteous sheriffs and other greedy gangs. No one is a match for Otis, however, and the legend of the 'invincible outlaw' continues for days, weeks, and years. In the end, Otis wins from other outlaws the respectful epithet of 'Bloody Sunset' - supposedly for the color of the black tea for which he has developed a taste and insists on sipping even in battle.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_35_DESC.text: One day, Snorri finds himself face-to-face with Wolfgang, who has come to Elder Edda to rebuild it. When the spirit notices the emblem of the Royal Guard on the man's armor, he is flooded with a certain powerful memory of his bygone life: that of a dear friend with whom he used to hunt deer dogs together. In hopes of remembering more, Snorri continues to haunt Wolfgang, who initially considers him a will-o'-the-wisp attempting to lure him away. However, Wolfgang gradually realizes that the spirit means no harm whatsoever and begins to accept the strangely familiar presence. After spending much time around Wolfgang, Snorri finally comes to recall his true identity: the first king of Nosgard.

TEXT_CHA_PA_5_36_DESC.text: One day, a pungmul party - a band of traditional musicians from Han - passes by the Forest of Spirits on their wanderings through the Eastern Kingdoms. The lively, rousing songs sung by the pungmul musicians are like nothing that Neulsolgil and the other spirits have heard before, and an excited Neulsolgil opens the entrance to her forest. Unbeknownst to the Deer Spirit, the pungmul party are hunters in disguise, intent on hunting down the Guardian Spirits. Once they gain entrance to the sacred forest, the hunters use their advantage of surprise to immediately ensnare Neulsolgil and her friends in their traps. Neulsolgil sees her friends, unaccustomed to war, cry out in fear and helplessness. She will not forgive herself if anyone is hurt for her mistake. Enraged, Neulsolgil shatters the ground, causing a great earthquake and scaring away the hunters. Shattered too are her trust in humans and her love of music. Neulsolgil lays down her hammer and walks back into her forest.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_22_DESC.text: Mengqi fights at the vanguard of his army for five long years, achieving one victory after another until the war is won. His glorious return home is met by a heartfelt reunion and acknowledgement from his father. Mengqi, renewed by his father's approval, goes on to perform greater feats and victories, winning for himself the title of the Five Tiger General of Chen.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_23_DESC.text: ...Until one day, after hundreds of years, when a break in the seal of the sanctuary finally awakens Heim. Heim accepts the curse of the Guardian and, his determination renewed, begins searching for the disturbance. Through his yet hazy mind memories of a clown flash by now and then, and Heim closes his eyes in confusion.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_24_DESC.text: One day, a villain who requested to remain unnamed talks to media that Yuna's magic is fabricated and she is in fact so violent and such a bully that even the worst villains do not want to get into a fight with her. The potential publicity nightmare, however, does not effect her popularity, yet she becomes even more famous for being the bad girl. And rumor has it that nobody has heard of or seen the villain who leaked the truth about her.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_24_NAME.text: Yuna, the Rookie of the Year

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_25_DESC.text: Caeneus does not falter, however, and continues his onward march at the front of battle lines, boosting his allies' spirits and striking fear into the hearts of his enemies. To the rest of the Cobalt Knights, the valiant and loyal Caeneus is the best Captain a knight could ask for. Only Caeneus fully feels the emptiness left by Victoria's departure, and he wonders if he can ever fill her shoes...

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_26_DESC.text: Odin's disatisfaction towards his brother only grows when Thor rejects his proposal. Thinking that he could lead Nosgard to its second golden age, Odin furtively gathers forces under his flag. There have been odious rumors that he has been spotted conjuring dark plans with the Einherjar, the Nosgardian elite army.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_28_DESC.text: With her new epiphany, Fireaxe decides to collect scraps from the Junkyard to design her own armor and weapon. Although she is still far from becoming the greatest Colosseum Champion, her creative and original style of fighting has come to gather many fans.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_29_DESC.text: I had been aiming for greatness my whole life. Now what was the point to my years of training? That's what I thought as I traveled the country after leaving the Palace, but I remembered ol' Drunken Fist's words and continued to train as often as I saw fit along the road. Then one day I had what some people call an enlightenment. Felt like a bright light suddenly going pop! in my head, and suddenly I saw answers to problems that had troubled me all these years, up to just the day before. The world seemed clear and simple. We humans only live once, but why were we fighting all the time? Weren't we happy enough just living in peace? Not just on the battlefield, but even among our countrymen we were hating each other and fighting until it seemed the world was gonna end. And the king! I have the greatest respect for His Majesty but during my time at the palace he showed his face just once, spending most of his time cooped up in his chambers like a sick rooster. Why should he worry his royal self to death when everything was so simple? So with my newfound wisdom I went back to the Palace, intent on telling His Majesty that he needn't worry all the time and could just stop the war if he put his mind to it. People along the way kept recognizing me and asked me where I had gone all this time. Said they'd thought I was dead or had gone mad somewhere. Well, I was impatient to see His Majesty and walked straight up to the Palace Doors without really answering - where a new face stopped my way. Turned out that my absence had been a little long and they had picked a new Tiger General to replace me, and this was the man. His name was Mengqi and he was young enough to be my son, if I had ever thought to get married! Master Hansheng on the other hand was still there, his blind eyes seeing everything as always. I explained the whole situation to young Mengqi, who first refused to budge, but I reckon my words had some truth to them for he relented in time and let me in. Before the Palace Doors I thought it would be polite to knock, since I'm no longer a Tiger General and I had left without a word. So I knocked - and the doors suddenly toppled over as if they were made of paper! I was so flabbergasted and embarrassed that I just mumbled a few words and left. I admit, I was scared for a few days that I would be deemed a traitor for insulting the king or some reason of that sort. And why had the Palace Doors been so weak? Don't they build palaces to be sturdier than that? I came out after a few days, telling myself that a man's gotta do what a man's gotta do. Imagine my surprise when people began calling me the 'Fist King' and celebrating my strength! And that's the story of how I began to be called 'Fist King.' It's an embarrassing story, but you know it now. But now I 'spose I gotta tell you about my friend - remember that sole descendant of the famous clan I told you about? Well now, I remember our first meeting as clear as yesterday...

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_30_DESC.text: Achilles, drinking in the frenzied cheer of the crowd around him, triumphantly rips away the subdued Lion Mask’s disguise—to come face-to-face with the aged face of the former Beast King, who had abdicated his position to Agrius and disappeared into oblivion some years ago. Achilles numbly stares at Lion Mask’s face reddening with embarrassment and rage. Coming to his senses, he submissively returns the mask to the greatest warrior and soldier Roman has ever known, mumbling a word of apology… when the Beast King, or rather Lion Mask, suddenly executes a chair shot against the champion. After a moment of utter silence, Lion Mask fixes his mask back on once more, and raises his arms in victory. The audience haltingly claps in bewilderment. A new Champion is born… Or that’s what Lion Mask insists, anyway.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_31_DESC.text: Cecilia, aware that she can no longer follow an order she knows has grown corrupt, decides to leave the Order once and for all... That very night, however, she receives a prophecy from the Goddess in her dreams. The Goddess whispers that true peace will only come by eradicating the false beliefs that are terrorizing Hasla - that she, Cecilia, devote herself to the Kalard, the true Goddesses, and the way of the light and punish the deceptive Elard and their followers in their stead. After waking up, Cecilia feels a new passion coursing through her soul. Her hammer is prepared to answer the true Goddess's calling as her defender!

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_32_DESC.text: Even after she is rescued by Demona, Luci remains wary of the Devil. It is only after she reaches Hell Island and sees the peaceful lives led by the Devilish race that she comes to realize the error of her ways. Unlike the evil Demons, Devils were people who had overcome temptation with strong will and the pure goodness of their hearts. Enlightened by the truth, Luci swears to protect Hell and its residents until the day she dies, hoping that she can repent for her sins of sending innocent people to burn at the stake.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_33_DESC.text: After many years pass and around the time that Otis comes to learn that the bottles used to contain black tea, made durable to prevent breaking during their journeys in the harsh environment, can be used as a good bludgeon in battle, the gang is dismissed due to financial difficulties. Otis, who had been irritated by the constant flow of unwanted visitors, takes the opportunity to feign his own death. Aiming now for a peaceful and quiet life in which he can spend his old age, Otis sets up a small tea house in a secluded corner of the desert. Yet fate does not allow him the peace he desires: rumors of the store that sells contraband tea spread throughout the wildlands, and outlaws and thieves flock to Otis's home in hopes of striking gold. Of course, the moment any bold outlaw steps into his beloved tea house, Otis makes sure that the last thing they see is his bottle of treasured black tea… Save for the few brash newcomers now and then, 'Hideout' thus becomes the most peaceful area in the desert, where even the most infamous outlaws dare not start even the smallest squabble under the tea master’s keen gaze.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_35_DESC.text: His eyes now filled with the light of his old life, Snorri grieves over the ruins of his lost kingdom. Despair and guilt flood his soul as he recalls his failure to save his people from a devastating snowstorm hundreds of years ago. When Snorri offers his strength in rebuilding the Elder Edda, Wolfgang gladly takes him to Odin, the overseer of the restoration. Odin, a radical fundamentalist who vies for revival of the old ways, almost faints in ecstasy when he meets the soul of the first king of Nosgard. Upon waking, he resumes his work to restore Elder Edda with even more enthusiasm. Snorri, grateful that he can at the very least alleviate the long burden on his heart, heads to the Sanctuary to finally meet the being who gifted him his second life.

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_35_NAME.text: Snorri the Spirit of the Sanctuary

TEXT_CHA_PA_6_36_DESC.text: What is life without singing and dancing? Having lost her love of music, Neulsolgil becomes a shadow of her former self. The other Guardian Spirits too come to fear or despise the human race, and the once joyful Forest of Spirits withers away in silence and solitude. Years pass, until a cheerful melody resounds from beyond the forest. Neulsolgil and the other Guardian Spirits initially try to ignore the music, believing that it could be another attempt at invasion. Yet the power of music proves too strong after such a long period of silence, and the spirits find themselves unable to resist their curiosity. They run out of the forest to find the pungmul party that had once deceived them, as well as other humans from the local villages. The humans were asking the spirits for their forgiveness; they regretfully recount how the darkness that had overclouded the entire kingdom had also driven them to greed and violence. Neulsolgil gazes at them quietly. She steps forward... and begins to dance. The humans and the spirits smile, first among themselves, then at each other. Time may pass and history may take its course, but human and spirit alike will always remember the ensuing celebration of forgiveness and friendship that did not stop for ten days.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_APFOOL_4_NARI_DESC.text: Nari is an ordinary high school student like any other in the country of ‘Korea’ – that is, until she is hit by a speeding truck on the first day of the new school year! Shocked by the painful moment of her own death, she becomes even more startled when she finds herself standing unharmed before a beautiful Goddess. The clearly uninterested Goddess, however, only glances at the stunned girl before snapping her fingers. Before her last echoes of pain ebb away, Nari is once more flung into the air and across the dimensions—straight into the middle of a battlefield of a strange new world. She has arrived in the dimension of ‘Wulin’: a world of martial artists engaged in an ongoing war between the orthodox sects and the ‘Mo Jiao,’ a demonic cult.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_APFOOL_5_NARI_DESC.text: On the harsh battlefield where even the most experienced warriors easily lose their lives to the enemy, Nari crosses paths with 'Jin Zhonghua,' master of the 'Forsythia Berry Technique.' Jin Zhonghua, due to Nari's strange appearance and even stranger mode of arrival, comes to believe the girl a genius "sent by the heavens" and takes her under her wing, even transferring to her the secret of the 'Forsythia Berry Technique." For better or for worse, Nari turns out to have true talent at martial arts: decades of training turns a formerly ordinary high school girl into an invincible master. In the last battle with 'Mo Jiao,' Nari defeats the Cult Master 'Demonic Sky Dragon King Sula.' The emperor of 'Wulin' praises her achievement of bringing peace to the world and appoints her as a Great General, rewarding her the title 'Dragon Slaying Fists' in acknowledgement of her mastery over the art.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_APFOOL_6_NARI_DESC.text: After sixty years as a warrior in 'Wulin,' Nari comes to forget much of her time as a high school student of Korea. At her deathbed, she looks back at her past and smiles in the satisfying knowledge that she has led a full and eventful life. At the very moment of her death, however, Nari once more finds herself before the Goddess who had sent her to the dimension of 'Wulin' many years ago. Any confusion dissipates as Nari recognizes the Goddess and throws a punch in her direction, mustering all the enraged energy she has built up through decades of her training. The powerful blow destroys the Goddess - who vanishes without a trace - and simultaneously warps the dimensional field. Nari's internal force of 'ki,' coursing through her physical body at utmost power, rejuvenates it before dissolving. Having recovered her youthful self, Nari suddenly feels nostalgia for her old home that she had forgotten for many years. Maybe regaining mastery over her strength and 'ki' may help her return to Korea - who knows? Taking Haruki who has somehow resurrected after the crash, Nari jumps headlong into the only exit: the crack created by the dimensional warp. Whatever world awaits her, she knows she will do well.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_4_02_DESC.text: Hols is the second member of the Eto Rangers, defenders of the Novel Worlds. The kind hearted Hols is usually very gentle, but has a tendency to go berserk when seeing red objects. Upon hearing of the Jyarei Monsters' invasion of a new world, he readily joins the other rangers to warp to the world of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_4_03_DESC.text: The third Eto Ranger Gao, unlike his intimidating outer appearance, has a warm heart that cares deeply about his comrades. He isn't the official leader of the Eto Rangers, but is the leader in spirit with his strength and loyalty.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_4_09_DESC.text: The ninth member of the Eto Rangers. Monk likes to kid and play a lot, and will pull pranks on other members whenever he sees the opportunity. Often banters with Pochiro but deep inside really cares about his friend.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_4_10_DESC.text: The tenth member of the Eto Rangers. May act tough and rough on the outside most of the time, but is really one of the most caring in the group. Rushes in to help after hearing the news that the Jyarei Monsters invaded Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_4_12_DESC.text: The twelfth member of the Eto Rangers. As the youngest member of the Eto Rangers, the other members dote on him often. However, due to also being the biggest coward as well as a crybaby, his explosive crying keeps the other members on edge.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ER_5_02_DESC.text: Hols is the second member of the Eto Rangers, defenders of the Novel Worlds. The kind hearted Hols is usually very gentle, but has a tendency to go berserk when seeing red objects. Upon hearing of the Jyarei Monsters' invasion of a new world, he readily joins the other rangers to warp to the world of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GG4_4_01_DESC.text: A doctor from a dimension different from Hasla's. Once a highly renowned surgeon, a mishap that caused the loss of a young patient's life during an operation sent him into a downward spiral of madness, turning him into a murderous psychopath. In hope of atoning for the people he killed, he puts on a paper bag and tries to save people suffering from diseases, under the name of 'Faust,' while trying to uncover the truth of the mishap from his past.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GG4_5_01_DESC.text: Faust finds out that the young patient's death back then was not due to his mishap but a ruse led by the Assassin's Guild. However, it turns out the Assassin's Guild is also just a puppet of the Conclave. Faust confronts the Conclave to prevent future victims a similar fate as his, and then learns the truth of the accident from the revived 'Zato-1'.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GG4_6_01_DESC.text: Faust moves to stop the Conclave's plans. Meanwhile, he receives a request from 'Johnny' and investigates the mystery surrounding the Japanese, and as a result, he accompanies the 'Jellyfish Pirates'. After everything is over, he interrogates 'Chronus', a member of the Conclave, about the Japanese, but learns of a conspiracy that even the Conclave is unaware of. Then, while seeking the truth about the Japanese Colony, he gets caught up in a mysterious dimensional shift and falls into Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GS_4_02_DESC.text: A legendary Gold Rank adventurer who defeated the Demon Lord years ago. Sword Maiden now serves as Archbishop of the Temple of Law in Water Town. When she attempts to contact Goblin Slayer for a new quest, she discovers that he has gone missing. Upon hearing that the warrior and his party teleported to a world called Hasla to chase after a Goblin Lord, Sword Maiden throws herself into the magical mirror out of concern and affection for him.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GS_5_02_DESC.text: A legendary Gold Rank adventurer who defeated the Demon Lord years ago. Sword Maiden now serves as Archbishop of the Temple of Law in Water Town. Upon hearing that the warrior and his party teleported to a world called Hasla to chase after a Goblin Lord, Sword Maiden throws herself into the magical mirror out of concern and affection for him.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_LASTSOUL_4_PUMPKING_.text: A pumpkin that has come to life through the magic of Pumpqueen the Pumpkin Witch. Pumpking wishes to explore the wide world, but the magic marker embedded in his head begins to fill him with uncontrollable fury against the Four Great Witches.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_LASTSOUL_5_PUMPKING_.text: Pumpking grows grouchier as the days pass, his once amiable personality distorted by the angry energy radiating from his magic marker. He stalks the streets of Pumpkin City, refusing to listen to the orders of his creator and scaring young witches instead. Eventually, the Night Witches decide that they cannot let the scarecrow roam free any longer, but Pumpking easily eludes them with the powerful magic of his magic marker.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_LASTSOUL_6_PUMPKING_.text: When even the Night Witches fail to capture Pumpking, the Four Great Witches set out to hunt him down themselves. What meets their eyes is an abomination feeding on the terror of witches, but the Four Great Witches – with proficiency befitting their position – manage to chase him to the edge of Pumpkin City. Pushed to the very brink, Pumpking and the Four Witches face each other. The Four Witches attempt to land the final attack when Pumpqueen the Pumpkin Witch, who had been waiting at that very spot, helps Pumpking escape. After that day, a rumor is born of a terrifying pumpkin monster that devours any foolish witch who dares to treat pumpkins with less respect than they deserve.
Pumpking and the Pumpkins of Wrath

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_OT_4_06_DESC.text:
Age 21, male.
An apothecary treating the wounded and sick in a small village in the Riverlands.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_OT_5_06_DESC.text: Stricken ill as a child, he was saved by a traveler who asked for nothing in return.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_OT_6_06_DESC.text:
「I want to save everyone, just like that person...! 」
Then, one day, hesitant to leave the only home he's known, his best friend convinces him to follow his dream.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RZ_4_03_DESC.text: The younger sister of the twin maids working at the Roswaal Mansion. While she has achieved perfection at everything she does, her respect for her older sister has gone unchanged. She is currently suspicious of Subaru, who has come to Roswaal Mansion under strange circumstances.

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RZ_5_03_DESC.text: The younger sister of the twin maids working at the Roswaal Mansion. TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_SH_4_02_DESC.text: Naofumi, the Shield Hero and one of the four Legendary Heroes, arrives at the Cal Mira Islands to prepare for the oncoming Waves of Destruction. Yet when the dimension unexpectedly starts cracking before him and his companions to reveal the Rift of Dimensions, Naofumi finds himself separated from his comrades, everything around him sucked into the vortex and into a strange new world...

TEXT_CHA_PA_LIMITED_SH_4_03_DESC.text: Shield Hero Naofumi's Filolial comrade. While waiting for the Waves of Destruction with Naofumi in the Cal Mira Islands, the adventurers unexpectedly came face-to-face with a great crack in the dimension that began to suck in everything around it. Filo too was swallowed by the vortex into the Rift of Dimensions, separated from the rest of the company...
