She has not had much luck in persuading anyone to believe her, however; ridiculed as a superstitious conspiracy theorist, the witch has had to face many sarcastic (but also difficult-to-prove) questions, such as "If Hasla is flat, why don't people fall off at the edge?"

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_32.text: His mind now a conduit for the strange voice of the Book, Shu Gwi now looks without seeing and eats without tasting. But what's this? The impressions that once imprinted on his consciousness are now curiously transferred onto the pages of the Book, his swirling sensations reduced to the clean cuts of language. Shu Gwi finally understands what he has been craving after all along, and departs. His desires and the Book's are now as one.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_33.text: After she nearly destroyed her forest with her overconfidence in her own magic, Éfendére took Linné's advice to heart and adopted more organic agricultural methods. Her obsession with vibrant, soil-depleting flowers has not faded, however. Éfendére's recent attempts to create a more potent "fertilizer cocktail" resulted in hours and hours of lecturing from Linné.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_34.text: As a child, Caroline Ludovico wanted to become a singer. Those of the noble House of Ludovico, the presiding aristocratic family of the Neth Empire, would not hear of it; how could their dynasty member devote herself to a passion as undignified as music? Caroline's genius in the sciences further sealed her fate. She would have all but forgotten her childhood dreams years later, when she would have gained tremendous prestige and renown as the leading research officer of the Neth Army. But when a chance melody found its way into her heart and impelled her to sing once more, Caroline's life was changed - forever.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_35.text: Medea has become madness embodied, tarnished by the grief of losing her sister and a thirst for vengeance. Yet a fragment of her compassionate nature yet remains, and shines forth, when she meets those who are humble in their abilities. Yes, she will become the silent patron of the gifted, the guardian of the blessed. The wretches who in their greed exploit her innocent benefactors shall receive the punishment waiting in her poisoned chalice.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_36.text: The currents of time have not washed away his longing for the nameless girl he lost long ago, whose ocean-colored hair he still sees in the darkness of his dreams. To bear his sorrows, he turns to his words. He writes poetry, verses and verses veiled with regret. One day, Eungaram thought that he could share his poems with the other Guardian Spirits, and that a tiger spirit's birthday would be the perfect occasion. What should have been a joyous celebration quickly filled with tears and wails, and from that day onwards, Eungaram vowed to keep his verses to himself.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_4.text: When he is surrounded by the warmth of his new family, Sasquatch feels as if he could forget the crippling loneliness that once overshadowed his past. Now, he is happy. He was especially surprised to encounter Lakias, the only blood relation he has ever met (the older sister of his great-great-grandmother) and whom he now calls ‘Auntie.’ Before chance brought them together with those of Elder Edda, Sasquatch and Lyudmilla were always on the run from the dangers that hunted them without end; now, he and everyone precious to him can be together, safe in the ancient city: their new home.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_5.text: The denizens of the night whisper that their queen returned through her mastery of dark magic... but in truth, it was her rigorous skin care routine and plenty of exercise that did the trick. Quiet and reserved, Lilith has no intentions of pursuing a romantic relationship or interests that require her going outside. She would much rather dwell in the comfort of her own home, reading books or researching unchartered territories of magic. As of late, the witch has purchased a film projector from the Neth Empire, engrossed with their recent invention called 'movies.'

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_6.text: The Succubus troupe is renowned not only in the island of Hell but also the entirety of Hasla; everyone in the continent has either seen or heard of their performance. It is rumored that even the Holy City of Elandia in the Grancia Empire, the religious capital of the Order of the Goddess, has unofficially lifted its prohibition against demons only for the dancers of the Succubus. Rachel is proud of her troupe's achievements and does everything in her power to make every performance the best one.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_7.text: To the world, she is known as the Queen of Spades, the reigning champion of Super Fighting Cards. To her parents, she is known as the Queen of Failures, the black sheep of the family, a problem student who repeated a grade not only once, but twice due to her "silly video game addiction." Yet it seems addictions can easily become talents and gifts, especially when Alice buys her parents an entire mansion with her winnings as their wedding anniversary present.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_8.text: Although he feels most at home in nature with his wilder friends, Nazrune also enjoys reveling and drinking in town together with the other Frost Elves. Everything changed, however, after he received nature's prophecy heralding the dangers that loomed ahead...

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_9.text: Official records state that Mondrian was banished from his village due to the political machinations of a corrupt magistrate. The villagers, on the other hand, whisper another version of the story. According to the witnesses, it was Mondrian who brought on himself his own dismissal. On the magistrate's birthday, Mondrian stormed into the party and began shouting that he "shouldn't be holding such an extravagant feast in the midst of a famine": an entirely just accusation, of course. But when, to everyone's horror, Mondrian knocked off the magistrate's wig to reveal a shiny bald head... Well, let's just say that some lines aren't meant to be crossed. Nobody - not even the most odious of officials - should suffer such humiliation on their own birthday; that is how the villagers see it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTO_6_N.text: Nicola loves children more than anyone. It is her dream in life to protect their happy smiles from the corruption of the world. For instance, for a little girl who cried over her "disappearing" sweets, she developed a candy that can be sucked on without ever growing smaller. Disregarding Nicola's good intentions, the Department of Weapons Development of the Neth Army has taken great interest in her latest invention. It seems they've found ways to use the surprisingly light and durable candy for their newest line of tanks.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTUMN_6.text: Anzu is actually the heir to a noble house of Ryu. 'The Protection of the Wind Blade' that guards her is, in truth, the power of a household deity that has been protecting their ancient lineage for generations. After the flames of war swallowed her home, the young Anzu - the sole survivor of her line - lost her memories from the shock. She wandered through the ravished lands, until she stumbled upon the entrance of the Forest of Eternal Autumn.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EAST_6_F.text: He only exists to become a vessel of pure light. He thinks and acts with only that sole purpose in mind. After years of education at the Order, Fredrick has been forged anew - and he must keep it that way. His unhealthy obsession with cleanliness and purity drives him to wash his clothes if brushed with the smallest speck of dust and forgo stew and soup for less messy food. His room he keeps an immaculate, gleaming temple where even the faintest contamination is forbidden.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_FIFTH_6_.text: The embodiment of Pandora's negative emotions, Anesidora made a grand entrance to Hasla... but has had nothing much to do since then. To pass the time, she started traveling on foot to various destinations in Hasla. The landscapes, cultures, and peoples she had initially known only as preexisting information in her mind became suddenly very real to her. Life, on foot, began to move with her. Anesidora now thinks she can even call her physical existence in this plane of dimension - happy. Lately she has been working odd jobs throughout the city of Impalis, earnest to experience everything life sends her way.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SIXTH_6_.text: The forbidden magic infused Camilla with strength like that of the old gods, lost and forgotten. But strength always asks for a sacrifice, which she was forced to give in the form of her memories before she entered the experiment. She still wonders about the man who appeared to her in her dreams, his hand in hers, dancing away the night. She does not dream of him anymore, not after she received her bindings as the Guardian of the Ruins. She has forgotten him, completely - but what of this tear that falls down her cheek?

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SPR_6_AN.text: The most powerful telekinesis user in Gotruvin, Ana was born with a physical disability that paralyzed her legs, rendering her unable to walk. For more than a decade, however, no one noticed the child's disability. It was revealed only later that Ana's telekinesis moved her lower body where her muscles failed. After reaching adulthood, Ana harnessed her powers to the mechanized muskets for which the House of Heinkel was renowned, successfully mobilizing and commanding an entire brigade. From that day on, Ana became known as the "Bane of Tasitte," and her name came to rouse fear in the hearts of her enemies.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_LOVIATA.text: The nature of her inherent magic may have formed her current personality: reserved and undemanding, much like the mushrooms that grow in shaded woods. And like those mushrooms, Loviatar is unfazed by external factors and patiently continues to do the things that she must do. As she does not need to sleep, the witch has been using the extra hours to organize the results of her research into a book on earth magic. The resulting work, 'An Elementary Guide to Elemental Magic,' remains decades later a must-read classic for even wizards attuned to other elementals.

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_1.text: Protests of the Animal Loving Adventurers, wildfire

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_10.text: Undesirable emotions, any damage to my reputation

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_11.text: Raisins in desserts; vegetables with strong smells, such as cucumber and celery

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_13.text: Marching drills, being reminded of my age

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_15.text: Efficiency-oriented thinking, conventional and uninspired dances

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_17.text: Talking loudly, church bells, loud noises

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_18.text: Sewing, Papa's lectures on being ladylike and securing a good marriage

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_19.text: Nessus, any damage to Master Heth's reputation

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_2.text: Being slower than yesterday, being in a slump

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_20.text: Those who judge a book by its cover, Shuwen

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_23.text: Prejudice and judgement against single dads

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_26.text: Nightmares of bygone memories, the feeling of damp cloth against skin

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_3.text: Immoderation, the excessive and lavish Empire style and aesthetics, official uniforms and ceremonies during which I have to wear them, Leon's babbling

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_30.text: The subject of Captain Magnus's unwavering attention, my age

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_32.text: Defective bullets, misfired shots, shaky hands

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_33.text: Fliers, false witnesses who claim they have seen Arche, Arche's absence

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_4.text: Injustice, the incomprehensible caprice of the whimsical Emperor to whom I have vowed my allegiance, a noble young lady who despises me for some unknown reason, my archers refusing my party invitations

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_5.text: Unpredictable actions, incomprehensible expressions of emotion

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_7.text: Criticism for the sake of criticism, bigotry, greasy food of the Neth Empire

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_8.text: The Wolf Tribe, any danger that threatens my people

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BEARS_.text: Selfish Beron hogging all the salmon, selfish humans hogging all the salmon

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_6.text: Remaining content with the status quo, Delrien's mischief

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_HU_6_10.text: PTSD of losing to Vane, ocular neuropathic pain

TEXT_RARE_3G_STONE_1_DESC.text: Georgia's mineral tattoo that she had on her back. It's shaped like the scythe of a reaper.

TEXT_RARE_3G_STONE_2_DESC.text: Gujarat's magnifying glass that he used to aim his shots. It seems to be a product of the Neth Empire.

TEXT_RARE_ACCURACY_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Accuracy of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_AMMUT_STONE_1_DESC.text: Hmm, could this be chicken? Or does it taste more like pork?

TEXT_RARE_AMMUT_STONE_2_DESC.text: Legend has it that soup cooked with this scale grants immortality. Unfortunately, its foul smell eliminates any thought related to food.

TEXT_RARE_ANUBISIS_STONE_1_DESC.text: Created out of the finest cloth and used only by royalty. It is comfortable beyond measure.

TEXT_RARE_ANUBISIS_STONE_2_DESC.text: A pectoral decorated with lapis lazuli. A lone ancestral spirit seems to be lingering within...

TEXT_RARE_ATK_POWER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Attack Power of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_BLOODHOUND_STONE_1_DESC.text: A small air conditioner found in Blood Hound’s coat. Especially useful if you’re equipped with a lot of overheating machines.

TEXT_RARE_BOUILLABAISSE_STONE_1_DESC.text: The core of the machine Bouillabaisse used to increase his acceleration force.

TEXT_RARE_CHANGGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A barrel cover with an animal-print that Changgwi decorated his gun with. It's actually made of cowhide, but it feels great.

TEXT_RARE_CODEVV_STONE_1_DESC.text: A heat tile made of mercury and unobtanium alloy, the latter of which leaks out of Rapture Science in small amounts. It dissipates heat so well that it even withstands V’s Slash attacks.

TEXT_RARE_CODEVV_STONE_2_DESC.text: Excellent head gear recovered from V’s old body frame. Recorded within are V-Berserk’s history data. Although the data consists of only unnecessary actions, it still seems to increase androids’ attack power when applied.

TEXT_RARE_CRIT_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Critical Resistance of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_CRIT_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Critical Chance of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_DALGI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A hairpin made with poisonous wood. Turn the golden ornament to see the sharp end.

TEXT_RARE_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Armor of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Evasion of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_DOMPERIGNON_STONE_1_DESC.text: A fragment of "humanity." Holding it in your hand evokes many emotions: happiness, guilt, sorrow, despair, rage, death…

TEXT_RARE_ENBYEONG_STONE_1_DESC.text: A poster scroll of Five Tiger General Hansheng and Shuwen discussing about strategies. It shows the artist's ulterior motive.

TEXT_RARE_EVE606_STONE_1_DESC.text: It may seem like ordinary wreckage, but it boasts tremendous durability and weight as it once constituted Galatea’s physical body.

TEXT_RARE_EVE606_STONE_2_DESC.text: The one eye of EVE-606, said to predict the future. It is actually a computing device equipped with a high-performance camera.

TEXT_RARE_FREYJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Allegedly, this necklace is supposed to grant immense beauty to its wearer. But maybe it's just a rumor, and Freyja is exceedingly beautiful even without it? Or at least that's what the warriors of the Einherjar think, anyway.

TEXT_RARE_FREYJA_STONE_2_DESC.text: Rumored to be one of the secrets to Freyja's beauty, this golden essence is said to create flawless skin. Needless to say, it is coveted by countless people.

TEXT_RARE_GAPGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A lump of rock salt that Guard Captain Gapgwi carries for Ochu. It's absolutely needed for a cow's health.

TEXT_RARE_GENERALWINTER_STONE_1_DESC.text: If there is one thing General Winter is proud of, it's his beard: seemingly rough and coarse, but velvety soft upon touch. He took care of it quite diligently.

TEXT_RARE_GENERALWINTER_STONE_2_DESC.text: It may resemble an ordinary conch, but 'Ahh!' is actually the roar of General Winter frozen into physical form. If you put your ear to it, you can hear the echoing shouts and war-cries.

TEXT_RARE_GG_STONE_1_DESC.text: The controlstone that Georg and Geralt used to regulate their synchronization level. The default amount is 30%.

TEXT_RARE_GG_STONE_2_DESC.text: Georg's necklace. On it are engraved the words 'Best friends forever, GG.'

TEXT_RARE_JANGPO_STONE_1_DESC.text: A poster scroll of Five Tiger General Hansheng when he was young. How handsome!

TEXT_RARE_JANGSANBEOUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Jang San Beom's fluffy fur. It feels like a cloud, but it's heavier than expected.

TEXT_RARE_JERAPHIM_STONE_1_DESC.text: A device that controls energy within the Temple. It loses all power outside, becoming nothing more than an oddly durable rock.

TEXT_RARE_JERAPHIM_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fragment of Jeraphim's halo. How on earth did one break this sturdy thing?

TEXT_RARE_LEESIN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ratoichi's eyepatch, which he began to wear after he lost his sight to the filth of the sewers.

TEXT_RARE_LEESIN_STONE_2_DESC.text: The belongings of the Warrat who taught Ratoichi all that he knew. It helped to control his senses, which perceived a single drop of water as loudly as thunder.

TEXT_RARE_MATAHARI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mark that Matahari held in her possession. It is given to the Musketeers of Trista.

TEXT_RARE_MAX_HP_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Maximum HP of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_NATI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A precious crystal of Ishimi. It was thought to be a dragon ball, but it was just a gallstone.

TEXT_RARE_OMEGA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A crystal eye attached to the mask of Test Subject Omega. It provides the wearer with all-penetrating vision.

TEXT_RARE_OMEGA_STONE_2_DESC.text: An organ of sixth sense attached through surgery. It lets one see things that cannot be usually seen.

TEXT_RARE_PANDEMONIUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Pandemonium’s mighty claw. On the inside are engraved an ornate pattern and the words “Developed by the greatest genius scientist Gunther, who threatens the power of the Goddesses themselves."

TEXT_RARE_PANDEMONIUM_STONE_2_DESC.text: Pandemonium’s left arm component. Open it to see the words “I am now death, the destroyer of the world.”

TEXT_RARE_PENETRATE_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Armor Penetration of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_PENETRATE_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Resistance Penetration of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_QIONGQI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A claw of Qiongqi, one of the four evils. Good-hearted people will face a misfortune if they get close to this claw.

TEXT_RARE_RAVENLEADERRAN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Anxious about being the only white-haired assassin in the Night Ravens, Ran has been secretly using hair dye to fit in with the rest of her troop. Recently she has given it up after discovering the excessive damage done to her hair.

TEXT_RARE_RAVENLEADERRAN_STONE_2_DESC.text: The white mask worn by Captain Ran. Rumor has it that she was rescued by a passing 'evil spirit' and afterwards vowed to wear this mask to honor him.

TEXT_RARE_RECEIVE_DMG_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Damage Reduction rate of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_RI_DELTASQUAD_STONE_1_DESC.text: The official equipment of Road Industry’s private troops. As the soldiers often face wizards in battle, it has high resistance to magic but is ironically more vulnerable to bullets.

TEXT_RARE_RSFLAMETANK_STONE_1_DESC.text: A fragment of a Rapture Science Upgraded Flame Tank’s gun barrel. It is composed of a special alloy made to withstand the flames of synthetic spirits.

TEXT_RARE_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Increases the Resistance of a Soulbound weapon.

TEXT_RARE_SEKHMET_STONE_1_DESC.text: The essence of fire concentrated through Sekhmet's powers. It is blazingly hot, but can still be touched.

TEXT_RARE_SEKHMET_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fragment of the horn headdress always worn by the Queen on the battlefield. It boosts morale.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_1_DESC.text: A liquid found running through Narmer's joints. It regularly glows.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_2_DESC.text: A levitating stone bearing the wear of time. It still weakly floats above your hand.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: Don't let its simple appearance fool you - this material is essential to the mobility of the armor.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: The blue blood spilt by the Incarnate. It is of a strange color and texture, almost as if intangible.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_3_DESC.text: One of the many steel plates that fell from Bjorn's shield. Arraying it into layers provides protection that no weapon can penetrate.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_4_DESC.text: A fragment of armor weathered by the harsh winds that ravished the northern lands long ago.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_HEAL_1_DESC.text:
Heals ally HP by 1000 per second
(This effect cannot be stacked.)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_HEAL_2_DESC.text:
Entire team's Armor and Resistance +150
(This effect cannot be stacked.)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP2_MAGIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 15 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, resistance penetration is increased by 1625 for 1 second

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP2_PHYSIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 15 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, armor penetration is increased by 1625 for 1 second

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP3_AIR_1_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 10 seconds)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP3_AIR_2_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 10 seconds)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP4_MAGIC_1_NAME.text: Shining Intuition of the Ancient God

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP4_PHYSIC_1_NAME.text: Shining Fragment of the Ancient God

TEXT_RARE_SET_HEAL_STONE_1_DESC.text: Machinery found in Khasekhemwy's core. The light at its center cannot be quenched.

TEXT_RARE_SET_HEAL_STONE_2_DESC.text: The crown from Banoub's head. Shattered yet still beautiful in its pride.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAGIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: A shard emanating blue light. Holding it in your hand, you are vaguely comforted.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAGIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: A blade found within Narmer's tail. You probably shouldn't run around while holding it.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Durable cable used to hold incomplete Battleloids' frames in place. The cable is made of technology as advanced as that used in constructing the main robot.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A handmade Night Witch badge, with the words 'Loviatar, Night Witch Third Division' sewn in the back.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: The ribs of a luminous moray that inhabits the deep waters of the mystical sea. They are of extraordinary hardness and, in the hands of an excellent swordsman, will serve as a valuable weapon against enemies from other dimensions.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A jewel carrying a part of the consciousness of the 'Deepest Abyss,' as used when they imitated Habaek's dream. Hold it and fragmented memories of another dimension will flow into your mind.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mask once known throughout the continent as the feared face of an Apostle. Sometimes its eyes will light up for seemingly no reason at all...

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A torn piece of a robe that belonged to a king whose name cannot be mentioned. On the back the reason for his notoriety is written: 'You must not call his name. The king of yellow will come and destroy your kingdom. The last of a doomed land leave this final warning to you.'

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A block of ice that cracked off Logi's body. It coldly burns with a blue flame.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fragment of Bjorn's broken hammer. Its unimpressive size hides its massive weight.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Moss that can be found growing on the metal coverings of Battleloids. Containing great quantities of pure mana, it is a valuable research material.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_SP_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mysterious powder that allows one to see things that usually go unseen. Those who use it report sightings of terrible creatures that continue to exert their influence in nightmares.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: A shard emanating red light. It makes you rather anxious...

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fractured rock that used to be a part of Khasekhemwy. You can feel a mysterious power within.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A cylinder alloy specially built to withstand the power of Battleloids that have been upgraded with all kinds of magical engineering weapons.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: One of the power sources that fuel Battleloid ST006. Turning the crank will generate power at surprisingly efficient rates.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: The mucus exuded by an otherworldly creature crawling the lowest floors of the deep sea. It refuses to dry or adhere to anything, almost as if it cannot mix with anything of this world.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: The fragment of an extremely durable glass mirror that used to serve as the door between worlds, but was destroyed by the power of light.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A voice changer tuned to the voice of the Apostle Nemesis. If you turn off the settings, it will instead play the voice of a lonely old man.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A stone on which the Deros, the residents of 'Lemuria,' carved their likenesses. Their ghoulish faces may resemble that of a vile serpent, but one can discern traces of delicate intelligence.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A transparent blade almost wholly enveloped in ice. Could it be changing shape?

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A blue mane that shines with a transparent light, as if it were made out of ice. It is tougher than it looks.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A chipset made with magic engineering technology. It boasts of a conductivity rate of 100%.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_SP_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A flask imprisoning an intelligent creature captured by a forgotten ancient race. Even after the fall of the ancient civilization, the creature is said to have survived and continues to suffer today.

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_1_DESC.text: The core of power that the Hybrid Shadowdemon had been holding.

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_2_DESC.text: A shrunken head decoration piece that belonged to the Order of the Shadow Rose. You can observe veins and nerves entwined within it. Curiously enough, this head is still "connected" to its body.

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_3_DESC.text: A solidified fragment of "shadow." If not properly dealt with, it attempts to enter the beholder's mind and body.

TEXT_RARE_SKIRIMIR_STONE_1_DESC.text: An icy cold yet surprisingly soft paw obtained from Skrymir's footprint.

TEXT_RARE_SKIRIMIR_STONE_2_DESC.text: A leg bone that Skrymir picked up before he completely faded away. It is made of pure ice.

TEXT_RARE_SVENJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The pointy fangs of the smaller Warhound models. Svenja cleans them herself before every battle campaign.

TEXT_RARE_SWORDEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Black sesame rice cake that has an unbelievable smell and is rock solid.

TEXT_RARE_TAOIST_STONE_1_DESC.text: A copy of a forbidden spell that the imperial Taoist copied from a scroll of magic. It's encoded so it cannot be read, but it's ominous.

TEXT_RARE_THIALFI_STONE_1_DESC.text: SIGYN was the most popular brand of running shoes in Ancient Nosgard. This pair had been carefully packaged, as if meant to have been given as a gift.

TEXT_RARE_THIALFI_STONE_2_DESC.text: A token bestowed upon Thjalfi by Ancient Nosgardians as acknowledgement of his extraordinary speed. It becomes translucent at certain angles.

TEXT_RARE_TOMBKING_STONE_1_DESC.text: A piece of cloth dyed in the color reserved only for the royalty of the Desert Kingdom. It may be a mere imitation, but at least it's durable.

TEXT_RARE_TOMBKING_STONE_2_DESC.text: A poorly crafted Uraeus decoration made out of wood.

TEXT_RARE_TRUEGULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: Elaborate lies deceive even those who are lying. But truths get in the way and remain as weights in the conscious.

TEXT_RARE_TYRANT_STONE_1_DESC.text: A durable bundle of artificial muscles modeled after Galatea’s physical body. It bestows the user with superhuman power, but it will quickly shrivel up if not infused with energy through its tube.

TEXT_RARE_TYRANT_STONE_2_DESC.text: It seems like mere tattered leather, but due to the various drugs saturating the material, it cannot be stretched or folded.

TEXT_RARE_VAJRAPANI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Deva King's eyebrow. It looks shiny, but it's just plated.

TEXT_RARE_VALKYRIESTONESTATUS_STONE_1_DE.text: The letter of a powerful lord who, long ago, divided Nosgard into two and fought to dominate both halves. Yet its recipient also received the fury of the king.

TEXT_RARE_VALKYRIESTONESTATUS_STONE_2_DE.text: Only this fragment remains of the sword of a fabled warrior who knew no defeat. Legend has it that fate, in the form of a one-eyed man, came and finally broke the undefeated blade.

TEXT_RECORD_HIDDEN_23_1_DESC.text: Took care of baby Draco and proudly watched it spread its wings for the first time.

Restarting the song will reset your current progress.
Your ticket will remain spent.

Restart anyway?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_1_2.text: Baby, baby, baby, oh~ I'm only yours~ Your one and only chocolate gentleman~

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_1_1.text: ... Do you even know what a Music Festival is?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_1_2.text: It's on, Caroline! But how do we decide the winner? By volume?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_2.text: Wow, someone clearly hasn't gotten over her emo phase. Seeing this was worth the long walk.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_2_2.text: Do you fear the rapid evolution of the android race? Soon humanity will become obsolete, and what is obsolete must be eradicated... Oh, I was simply making a 'joke.'

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_1_1.text: Come on, the only song you manage to sing is the national anthem.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_1_2.text: Can you feel the difference? Uncle always did tell me I have a powerful voice.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1.text: So what? Want me to stick a gold star on your armor?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1_1.text: I've heard you sing at office parties. Your entire repertoire consists of military music. How did you ever pass the preliminary rounds?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1_2.text: Huh, but Commander Spyro said my singing was cute!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2.text: Ahem, I too sang in the choir before I received my knighthood.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2_1.text: Judging from that grin on your face, I'd say you're enjoying this much more than you let on.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2_2.text: Well~ I originally wasn't planning on entering, but Spiny kept begging me to...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1.text: So, are you a wolf or a hyena? You can't be both.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1_1.text: Yuria... How unexpected of you. I never knew you wanted to become a popstar.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1_2.text: T-the same goes for you! Stop looking at me like that!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2.text: Yeah, I'm the lone wolf of Pumpkin City! A hyena who hunts for the beat, YO!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2_1.text: I can't believe I'm performing with THE legendary popstar, Cano - at the Hasla Music Festival, no less!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2_2.text: Let's do our best to perform a never-before-seen show!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_1_2.text: Through music... my soul is reborn from the ashes...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1.text: Weren't you on the phone with your wife back there?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1_1.text: Levine... I've changed for the better. And I'm sure you can, too.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1_2.text: Grr... Have you forgotten that this was your plan from the beginning, not mine? What's wrong with you?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2.text: I hail from the ancient lands of Nosgard. The god of music himself has led me forth.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2_1.text: The world is beautiful, full of love and hope!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2_2.text: This confirms my suspicions that those strange weeds growing around the Hero Town farm are much more than what meets the eye.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_1_1.text: Cano... I dedicate my debut to you!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_1_2.text: Let's make this the best show ever - together!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1.text: I don't believe it... I'm speaking to THE Cano, the legendary pop star...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1_1.text: I refuse to follow your orders any longer. I reclaim my freedom!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1_2.text: Why are you doing this? Your employee welfare benefits were better than anyone else's; your paychecks were always on time!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2.text: We're the same age, aren't we? Let's be friends!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2_1.text: ... I saw it with my own eyes. The terrible icon that stood in the chambers of every Hero, drowning out all other sounds with its terrible song...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2_2.text: What horrors have the humans of this world suffered to survive the fatal melodies of D-CAT?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_1_1.text: I... I won...? I beat Cano...?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1.text: I won! End of Round Three!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1_1.text: What was that? On second thought, I don't think I want to know.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1_2.text: We won! We're the winners of the 4th Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_3_1.text: Okay, tour starts now! You're going to tag along, right? Here, catch!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_START_2_1_1.text: Even if I'm a substitute, we still can try our best to win the competition!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_START_2_1_2.text: ... So this is Hasla Music Festival...

TEXT_S1_GROUP1_DESC.text: The Goddess of the Forest loses the shard of the Apostle she had been protecting to the attack of a mysterious figure. In dread of the assailant, she sends Sera, her future successor and Goddess-in-training, out of the forest to flee. Consumed by the darkness of the shard, what was once a Goddess becomes a monster that threatens the very things she vowed to protect...

TEXT_S1_GROUP2_DESC.text: After forming the Fellowship, the company receives a report that the monsters around the Soulstone Sanctuaries have grown more hostile than ever. The Fellowship, as their first official quest, leaves to conquer the lost territories and uncover the reason behind the monsters' sudden belligerence.

TEXT_S1_GROUP3_DESC.text: The Fellowship of the Soulstone receives news from the Empire about strange monsters in the north. A month after sending their own scout, the Fellowship decides to head to the icy northern lands to discern for themselves the truth of the baffling report.

TEXT_S1_GROUP4_DESC.text: The fellowship must head north to defeat the robots, who continue to terrorize the tundra despite the broken warp gate.

TEXT_S1_GROUP5_DESC.text: After the events in the north, Prestina and the company enjoy leisurely days researching about the Soulstones. Peace is shattered, however, when they hear shocking news from the village merchant Bridget: the Neth Empire has declared war, and its soldiers are nearing the village.

TEXT_S1_GROUP6_DESC.text: The Alliance, hearing of remnants of the Neth Empire Army still lurking in the city, gathers forces throughout Grancia to defeat them once and for all. When Lednas too leaves for Edenburg, Chronos suggests the fellowship to aid the battle as well.

TEXT_S1_GROUP7_DESC.text: Everything had been a lie. The Goddesses had not won the Apostles' War one hundred years ago - for Destalos, the final Apostle, had been waiting in the dark all these years, desiring to quench Hasla of its light and life. Sylunis too emerges from the shadows, followed by a divine army. The company must recover the strength of light and save the world - before everything falls into darkness.

TEXT_S1_GROUP8_DESC.text: In the days of relative peace following the war, Sylunis lingers on her memories of the final moments of battle. She wonders why the spirit of Elanuma saved her from certain death and darkness, and vows to find her meaning in the world. Meanwhile, darkness still remains in the Holy City despite El Thalnos's defeat, and Sylunis suggests creating barriers around the city to keep the shadows from escaping.

TEXT_S2_GROUP1_DESC.text: Three years have passed since the last battle of the Apostles. After the confinement of El Thalnos and the Soulstones in the Rift of Dimensions, the human race gradually heals the wounds of war and attempts to recover its long-desired peace. The Elards, their duties fulfilled, too depart - all save Prestina, who waits at Hero Town for Sera's return. Yet when no news of Sera is heard for three years, Prestina and company decides to finally accept Emperor Alexander's request, and move to the capital of Grancia: Impelis.

TEXT_S2_GROUP2_DESC.text: The Guardian of the Ruins proves to be a difficult foe. In order to treat their wounds, the Captain and company return to Impelis, where they receive an urgent letter from Lorelei. The Captain and Ellie decide to accept the archaeologist's request that they help with the excavation of the mysterious Temple of Illusions in an attempt to uncover its dark history.

TEXT_S2_GROUP3_DESC.text: Loki, his true form revealed, is barely captured and sealed back into the Seal of the Sanctuary by the Captain and company. Yet they cannot stop the storm of destruction from ravaging the kingdom, as it did hundreds of years ago. Under the advice of the Goddess Dionne, the Captain hastily departs for Snorri Edda, the capital of Nosgard, to save its people from the ancient chaos.

TEXT_S2_GROUP3_TITLE.text: A Myth of Ice and Snow

TEXT_S2_GROUP4_DESC.text: Having fled to safety from the Laboratories of Rapture Science, Captain and company turn to their unexpected accomplice: Benjamin, the Chief Office Researcher of Rapture Science himself. Benjamin reveals that someone from the House of Nobles is orchestrating the inhumane experiments of magical engineering, and they must be stopped at all costs. The trail seems to lead to Road Industry Headquarters...

TEXT_S2_GROUP5_DESC.text: The master of the Mysterious Sea, Habaek, is unable to awaken due to the weakened veins. The Oracle of Water, Haerang, and our Heroes are headed to Han of the Three Eastern Countries in order to meet the patron saints who control the energy of the mountains and find the culprit behind the weakening of the veins and find a way to awaken Habaek.

TEXT_SHOP_SUBSCRIBE_BUY_INFO_DESC.text:
This package is a Subscription product and can be purchased with other Subscriptions.

It will be automatically renewed every month on the date of the purchase until you choose to cancel your Subscription. If you decide to cancel your Subscription, all items of the purchased package will stay in effect until the next billing date.

If you want to cancel your Subscription, please do so at least 24 hours before your next billing date to prevent automatic renewal of the Subscription.

You can undo your cancellation by restoring your Subscription. Please note that you must do so before the next billing date.

Captains who continue their Subscription for 3 / 6 / 12 consecutive months will receive a Loyalty Bonus with the original contents of the package.

Please note that your Subscription information can be lost if the automatic renewal process fails.

Unused contents of the package can be returned within 7 days of purchase.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ALMAEL_DESC.text: Upon pressing her block skill, Almael deals @magical damage@ equal to [200/500/800]% of her attack power to the enemy before her, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ALMAEL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally leader's 3-chain, Almael uses 'Morpho's Wings' for 8 seconds. (Cooltime: 9 seconds) During 'Morpho's Wings,' Almael does not use her normal attacks. If her block skill deals a critical hit during 'Morpho's Wings,' Almael generates 'Azure Fantasy' around the hit enemy for 5 seconds, decreasing enemy armor and resistance by 10%. (Cannot be stacked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ALMAEL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally leader's 3-chain, Almael uses 'Morpho's Wings' for 15 seconds. (Cooltime: 16 seconds) During 'Morpho's Wings,' Almael does not use her normal attacks. If her block skill deals a critical hit during 'Morpho's Wings,' Almael generates 'Azure Fantasy' around the hit enemy for 5 seconds, decreasing enemy armor and resistance by 15%. (Cannot be stacked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ARACHNE_DESC.text: Arachne shoots a 'spider web' at the farthest enemy within her range to deal #physical damage# equal to [75/136/288]% of her attack power. Enemies hit by Arachne's 'spider web' lose 30 of their evasion and cannot move for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ARACHNE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a 3-chain, Arachne additionally summons 'baby spiders' that deal #physical damage# equal to 300% of her attack power to the farthest enemy within her range.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ARACHNE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a 3-chain, Arachne additionally summons 'baby spiders' that deal #physical damage# equal to 300% of her attack power to the farthest enemy within her range. Enemies hit by 'baby spiders' receive a 'spider bite.' Enemies with a 'spider bite' lose their armor for 10 seconds by 5% of Arachne's attack power, and receive #physical damage# equal to 100% of her attack power per second. (Maximum 12 stacks)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_AUREA_DESC.text: Aurea deals #physical damage# equal to [120/180/280]% of her attack power to the rearmost enemy, according to the chain number used. The hit enemy receives the 'Ranger's Mark' for 3 seconds. 'Ranger's Mark' affects only one enemy at a time.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_AUREA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Golden Rain' over the nearest enemy to deal 7 hits of #physical damage# equal to 200% of the Hero's attack power. (Cooltime: 0.5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_AUREA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Golden Rain' over the nearest enemy to deal 7 hits of #physical damage# equal to 1500% of the Hero's attack power. (Cooltime: 0.5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BERA_DESC.text: The Hero summons fresh salmon that deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/400]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BERA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Fresh Salmon Run' become 'bait' and lose movement speed by 10% for 5 seconds. Duration of the effect renews with reuse. (Maximum 5 stacks)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BERA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Fresh Salmon Run' become 'bait,' losing movement speed by 10% and receiving @magical damage@ equal to 100% of the Hero's attack power every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds. 'Bait' ignores all enemy evasion and effects that receive damage in place of others. Duration of the effect renews with reuse. (Maximum 5 stacks) Additionally, when enemies have maximum 'bait' stacks, they receive 30% more magical damage.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BOOMERANG_DESC.text: The hero throws a boomerang that deals #physical damage# equal to 30% of the attack power with every hit.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BOOMERANG_LV2_DESC.text: The hero throws a boomerang that deals #physical damage# equal to 45% of the attack power with every hit.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BOOMERANG_LV3_DESC.text: The hero throws a boomerang that deals #physical damage# equal to 60% of the attack power with every hit. The boomerang's critical chance increases by 30% on its return route.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BOOMERANG_LV4_DESC.text: The hero throws a boomerang that deals #physical damage# equal to 90% of the attack power with every hit. The boomerang's critical chance increases by 30% on its return route.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_BOOMERANG_LV5_DESC.text: The hero throws a boomerang that deals #physical damage# equal to 120% of the attack power with every hit. The boomerang's critical chance increases by 30% on its return route. Upon the boomerang's return, the hero instantly generates 1 block.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_CONDEMN2_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero shoots an arrow that pierces the enemy and deals @magical damage@ equal to [34/122/250]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_CONDEMN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using the ally leader's 3-chain, Gon shoots 4 arrowheads towards the enemy in the rear to deal #physical damage# equal to 225% of her attack power. Afterwards, she uses 'Resolute Shot' to deal #physical damage# equal to 414% of her attack power. Enemies hit by 'Resolute Shot' lose 50% of their armor for 5 seconds and are dispelled of all of their buffs. This debuff is only applied to 'Resolute Shot' activated as Gon's passive. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ELF_ARCHER_DESC.text: High Elf Archer shoots an arrow to the enemy in the front to deal #physical damage# equal to [200/300/400]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ELF_ARCHER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's chain, High Elf Archer deals #physical damage# equal to 1250% of her attack power to all enemies within her range. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_ELF_ARCHER_LV3_SUBDESC.text: High Elf Archer's evasion and accuracy are increased by 25. Upon using another ally's chain, High Elf Archer deals #physical damage# equal to 1250% of her attack power to all enemies within her range. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FASTSHOT_SPIRIT_LV1_DESC.text: Awakens 'Rapid Firing Soul' for 10 seconds. Attack is increased by 50% and critical chance is increased by 10%.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FASTSHOT_SPIRIT_LV2_DESC.text: Awakens 'Rapid Firing Soul' for 10 seconds. Attack is increased by 75% and critical chance is increased by 20%.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FASTSHOT_SPIRIT_LV3_DESC.text: Awakens 'Rapid Firing Soul' for 10 seconds. Attack is increased by 125% and critical chance is increased by 40%. Upon reactivating before termination, motion speed is increased by 10%, evasion by 30 for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLAME_BLAST_LV3_SUBDESC.text: An enemy damaged by Thorns of Hell is lit on fire and receives $neutral damage$ equal to 50% of the Hero's Attack Power for 5 seconds. Every 3 times this effect is stacked, the hero shoots the ultimate flame arrow that deals @magical damage@ equal to 350% of attack power and $neutral damage$ equal to 1000% of attack power. (Activates once every 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLOATNSTING_DESC.text: The caster's attack power is increased by 15% and critical chance by 10% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLOATNSTING_LV2_DESC.text: The caster's attack power is increased by 25% and critical chance by 15% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLOATNSTING_LV3_DESC.text: The caster's attack power is increased by 35% and critical chance by 20% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLOATNSTING_LV4_DESC.text: The caster's attack power is increased by 45% and critical chance by 25% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FLOATNSTING_LV5_DESC.text: The caster's attack power is increased by 55% and critical chance by 30% for 7 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_FROZEN_THORN_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero shoots an ice arrow that deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/400]% of their attack power at enemies in the rear. Hit enemies are pulled in towards allies.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GENEVIE_DESC.text: Hero throws daggers that deal #physical damage# equal to [100/150/200]% of her attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GENEVIE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Genevie leaves a 'Mark of Mana' that lasts 5 seconds to an enemy hit by 'Dagger Throw.' The mark decreases the enemy's evasion by 20 and increases the damage by 50%. Only one enemy can be marked at a time.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GG_CHIPP_SKILL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If 'Y Blade' hits an enemy, Chipp Zanuff generates 1 block at a 50% chance at the cost of 5 SP.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GG_CHIPP_SKILL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If 'Y Blade' hits an enemy, Chipp Zanuff generates 1 block at a 75% chance at the cost of 5 SP. Additionally, using a block after an ally's 3-chain activates 'Throwing Daggers,' dealing @magical damage@ equal to [80/100/120]% of attack power each, and generates 1 block.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GHOST_ARROW_DESC.text: The Hero deals 5 hits of @magical damage@ equal to 250% of their attack power to the farthest enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GHOST_ARROW_LV2_DESC.text: The Hero deals 5 hits of @magical damage@ equal to 500% of their attack power to the farthest enemy. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GHOST_ARROW_LV3_DESC.text: The Hero deals 5 hits of @magical damage@ equal to 800% of their attack power to the farthest enemy. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies, and generates 1 block for the caster and the ally leader.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HAERANG_DESC.text: Haerang shoots [1/2/3] water projectiles that each deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HAERANG_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon hitting the enemy 4 times with her normal attack or block skill, Haerang uses 'Ocean's Tears' on the frontmost enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of her attack power. (Cooltime: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HAERANG_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon hitting the enemy 4 times with her normal attack or block skill, Haerang uses 'Ocean's Tears' on the frontmost enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 700% of her attack power. (Cooltime: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HANSEUNG_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using his own block after another ally's 3-chain, Hansheng releases his 'Inner Sight' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 400% of his attack power. 'Inner Sight' targets the farthest enemy in Hansheng's range and ignores their evasion. If another ally's block is pressed during the skill, Hansheng releases 2 additional streaks of 'Inner Sight.' This skill ignores enemy effects that absorb damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_IRIS_DESC.text: This letter was first started in Pumpkin City and penetrates the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to [350/400/450]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BOMBING_WATERS_LV2_DESC.text: The caster triggers successive explosions to deal @magical damage@ equal to 350% of their attack power. This attack knocks hit enemies into the air.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BOMBING_WATERS_LV3_DESC.text: The caster triggers successive explosions to deal @magical damage@ equal to 400% of their attack power. This attack knocks hit enemies into the air, decreases their resistance by 20% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BOMBING_WATERS_LV4_DESC.text: The caster triggers successive explosions to deal @magical damage@ equal to 475% of their attack power. This attack knocks hit enemies into the air, decreases their resistance by 25% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BOMBING_WATERS_LV5_DESC.text: The caster triggers successive explosions to deal @magical damage@ equal to 525% of their attack power. This attack knocks hit enemies into the air, decreases their resistance by 30% for 3 seconds, and dispels all enemy buffs.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BRAVERYROAR_DESC.text: The caster immediately increases the entire party's maximum HP by 2000 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BRAVERYROAR_LV2_DESC.text: The caster immediately increases the entire party's maximum HP by 3000 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BRAVERYROAR_LV3_DESC.text: The caster immediately increases the entire party's maximum HP by 4000 and armor and resistance by 100 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BRAVERYROAR_LV4_DESC.text: The caster immediately increases the entire party's maximum HP by 5000 and armor and resistance by 150 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_BRAVERYROAR_LV5_DESC.text: The caster immediately increases the entire party's maximum HP by 8000 and armor and resistance by 200 for 5 seconds, and receives all damage dealt to the party for the same amount of time.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CAENEUS_DESC.text: Caeneus raises his flag, removing all ally and enemy shields. He also prevents any subject from receiving shields for [3/4/5] seconds according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CAENEUS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
During his shield canceling debuff, Caeneus decreases the damage he receives by 20%.
 (Block Skill Altered) If pressing his block during his block skill, only the duration of the shield canceling debuff is renewed.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CAENEUS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
During his shield canceling debuff, Caeneus decreases the damage he receives by 25% and increases his armor and resistance by 500.
 (Block Skill Altered) If pressing his block during his block skill, only the duration of the shield canceling debuff is renewed.
 If only Caeneus remains standing during battle, he enters 'Courageous Fury' mode. (Only activates once per round)
 'Courageous Fury': Caeneus immediately heals 100% of his HP. His attack speed is increased by 50%. His normal attacks are enhanced to deal #physical damage# equal to 100% of his resistance.
 (Block Skill and Passive Altered) Caeneus's original Block Skill and Passive do not activate during 'Courageous Fury.'

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CECILIA_DESC.text: The Hero charges forward and smashes their hammer to deal #physical damage# equal to [250/500/750]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CECILIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Immolation' for 10 seconds.
Immolation: The Hero sacrifices 20% of their maximum HP. In return, the Hero's block skills are enhanced to deal #physical damage# equal to [500/1000/1500]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used. (Cannot be dispelled; duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CECILIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Immolation' for 10 seconds.
Immolation: The Hero sacrifices 20% of their maximum HP. In return, the Hero's block skills are enhanced to deal #physical damage# equal to [750/1500/2250]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used, and additional #physical damage# equal to 100% of the Hero's attack power every 0.2 seconds to all enemies within range. (Cannot be dispelled; duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CHAIN_BINDING_DESC.text: Siegfried binds the enemy within his range for 2 seconds and deals #physical damage# equal to [200/300/400]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CHAIN_BINDING_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every 4 times Siegfried binds the enemy with 'Chains of Confinement,' he charges forward and uses 'Cry of the Dragon' to deal #physical damage# equal to 600% of his attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_CHAIN_BINDING_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Every 4 times Siegfried binds the enemy with 'Chains of Confinement,' he charges forward and uses 'Cry of the Dragon' to deal #physical damage# equal to 600% of his attack power. Enemies bound by 'Chains of Confinement' lose evasion by 100 for 8 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_DOCKING_ANCHOR_LV5_DESC.text: Strikes the enemy with a big anchor, dealing #physical damage# equal to 500% of attack power, and fixes the target's chance to get hit to max for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FENRIR_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using another ally's block, Fenrir pulls in the enemy with the highest HP. (Cooltime: 5 seconds) If Fenrir uses her own block within 3 seconds of using an ally's block, she leaves a 'Wolf's Mark' on the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. 'Wolf's Mark' decreases armor and resistance by 30% and prevents enemy buffs. If Fenrir used a 3-chain to leave her 'Wolf's Mark,' she enters the 'Day of Sol' phase.
 
 'Day of Sol' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Sol' is in the sky, Fenrir's armor and resistance are increased by 50%. Upon using her own block, Fenrir receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 4 seconds. If pressing her block at the moment 'Sol' shines, her evasion is increased by 15 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FENRIR_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using another ally's block, Fenrir pulls in the enemy with the highest HP. (Cooltime: 5 seconds) If Fenrir uses her own block within 3 seconds of using an ally's block, she leaves a 'Wolf's Mark' on the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. 'Wolf's Mark' decreases armor and resistance by 50% and prevents enemy buffs.
 
 If Fenrir used a 1- or 2-chain to leave her 'Wolf's Mark,' she enters the 'Day of Sol' phase; if she used a 3-chain, she enters the 'Night of Mani' phase. Each phase cannot be changed for the other until it ends.
 
 'Night of Mani' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Mani' is in the sky, Fenrir's resistance is decreased to 0, while her armor is increased by 300. Upon using her own block, Fenrir scratches the frontmost enemy with her claws to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of her attack power; if the hit enemy is marked by 'Wolf's Mark,' Fenrir deals additional #physical damage# equal to [160/320/640]% of her attack power. If pressing her block at the moment 'Mani' shines, her critical chance is increased by 30% for 6 seconds, and the duration of the phase is increased by 6 seconds. When 'Night of Mani' ends, Fenrir is stunned for 2 seconds.
 
 'Day of Sol' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Sol' is in the sky, Fenrir's armor and resistance are increased by 100%. Upon using her own block, Fenrir receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 4 seconds. If pressing her block at the moment 'Sol' shines, her evasion is increased by 30 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FIREAXE_DESC.text: The hero swings her burning weapon to deal #physical damage# equal to [110/220/330]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FIREAXE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: With every 5 hits she receives, Fireaxe uses 'Feel the Heat!' to increase her damage reduction rate by 12% for 5 seconds. (Maximum 5 stacks)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FIREAXE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: With every 5 hits she receives, Fireaxe uses 'Feel the Heat!' to increase her damage reduction rate by 12% for 5 seconds. (Maximum 5 stacks) Upon receiving a critical hit, Fireaxe immediately activates her 3-chain skill. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FUGUROID_DESC.text: Fergusroid pounds its hammer three times to deal #physical damage# equal to [40/70/100]% of its attack power per hit, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FUGUROID_SUBDESC.text: Upon accurately dealing all hits of its block skill, Fergusroid enters 'Overheated' mode. In 'Overheated' mode, Fergusroid deals all hits with 100% critical chance, and its attack activates as 'Everything's Great Success' to deal #physical damage# equal to 200% of its current attack power. If it succeeds in attacking, Fergusroid's 'Overheated' mode turns off, and enemies hit by 'Everything's Great Success' are stunned for 2 seconds and knocked back.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_HEIM_DESC.text: Heim leaps forward and deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/300]% of his attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_HEIM_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero leaps forward and deals @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/300]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_HEIM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using his block after another ally's 3-chain, Heim summons ice shards from the earth to deal @magical damage@ equal to 300% of his resistance.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_IRON_HAMMER_DESC.text: Rebecca swings her iron mace 2 times to deal #physical damage# equal to [150/200/260]% of her attack power according to the chain number she used. Enemies hit by this attack receive a 'Mark of the Sun' that lasts 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_IRON_HAMMER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Rebecca cannot be pushed back for 1 second after using block. If an ally hits an enemy with the 'Mark of the Sun' 5 times, the enemy receives additional #physical damage# equal to 200% of Rebecca's attack power and the 'Mark of the Sun' disappears afterwards. (Cooltime: 0.5 second)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_IRON_HAMMER_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block, Rebecca becomes resistant to knockback for 1 second. If allies hit an enemy with the 'Mark of the Sun' 5 times, the mark disappears as they deal additional #Physical damage# equal to 500% of Rebecca's attack power. (Cooltime: 1 second) When the 'Mark of the Sun' is activated, Rebecca's maximum HP is increased by 15% while armor piercing increases by 1500 for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_02_DESC.text: Hols uses 'Hols Super Punch' to charge forward and deal #physical damage# equal to [120/220/350]% of attack power according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing his block skill, Hols takes damage in place of his allies for 3 seconds. This effect cannot be cancelled.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing his block skill, Hols takes damage in place of his allies for 4 seconds and decreases his own received damage by 50%. This effect cannot be cancelled.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_03_DESC.text: Gao uses 'Tiger Punch' to deal #physical damage# equal to [300/400/500]% of attack power according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_03_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain block skill and then using his own block, Gao uses 'Tiger Claw' to deal #physical damage# equal to 500% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_03_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain block skill and then using his own block, Gao uses 'Tiger Claw' to deal #physical damage# equal to 600% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_09_DESC.text: Runs quickly to the front and kicks the enemy to deal #physical damage# equal to [250/500/1000]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_09_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The Hero's movement speed is increased by 50%. This effect cannot be cancelled. Upon pressing their own block after another ally's block, the Hero's next block skill is changed to 'Vocoder.' (Cooltime: 3 seconds)
'Vocoder': The Hero decreases the frontmost enemy's movement speed by 25% and evasion by 25 for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_09_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Hero's movement speed is increased by 100%. This effect cannot be cancelled. Upon pressing their own block after another ally's block, the Hero's next block skill is changed to 'Vocoder.' (Cooltime: 3 seconds)
'Vocoder': The Hero decreases the frontmost enemy's movement speed by 50% and evasion by 50 for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_10_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [150/250/350]% of attack power according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_10_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 'Tart Power,' Tart's next block skill is changed to 'Kick,' which deals #physical damage# equal to 800% of attack power and stuns the enemy for 1 second.
Upon using 'Kick,' Tart's next block skill is changed to 'Body Slam,' which deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_10_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 'Tart Power,' Tart's evasion is increased by 40 for 4 seconds, and Tart's next block skill is changed to 'Kick,' which deals #physical damage# equal to 800% of attack power and stuns the enemy for 1 second.
Upon using 'Kick,' Tart's next block skill is changed to 'Body Slam,' which deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of attack power and stuns the enemy for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_12_DESC.text: Urii explodes into tears for 5 seconds, decreasing the enemy's attack power by [45/50/55]% according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_12_LV2_SUBDESC.text: While 'Urii is Scared' is active, for every 5 hits, the Red Hatted Sister appears and deals physical damage equal to 300% of Urii's resistance and stuns for 1 second. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_ER_12_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
While 'Urii is Scared' is active, for every 5 hits, the Red Hatted Sister appears and deals physical damage equal to 300% of Urii's resistance and stuns for 1 second. (Cooltime: 1 second)
While 'Urii is Scared' is active, Urii takes damage in place of his allies.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_GG4_01_DESC.text: The Hero charges forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of the Hero's attack power, according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_GG4_01_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon activating their own block skill, the Hero randomly takes out and throws one of the below items.
Hammer: Deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of the Hero's attack power to one hit enemy.
Bomb: Deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the Hero's attack power to hit enemies.
Weight: Deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of the Hero's attack power to all enemies, and lifts all allies and enemies into the air.
Banana: Heals all allies' HP by 30%.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_GG4_01_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon activating their own block skill, the Hero randomly takes out and throws one of the below items.
Hammer: Deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of the Hero's attack power to one hit enemy.
Bomb: Deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the Hero's attack power to hit enemies.
Weight: Deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of the Hero's attack power to all enemies, and lifts all allies and enemies into the air.
Banana: Heals all allies' HP by 30%.
Mini Faust: Deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the Hero's HP to one enemy with the lowest HP. This attack ignores effects that take damage in place of others as well as evasion.
Meteor: Deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the Hero's HP per hit to hit enemies. This attack ignores enemy evasion.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_OT_06_DESC.text: The Hero strikes down with an axe to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/300]% of the Hero's attack power, according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_OT_06_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon pressing the Hero's own block, the Hero activates 'Grapewood Curative.'
'Grapewood Curative:' Increases the Hero's own HP by 2x for 3 seconds. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_OT_06_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon pressing the Hero's own block, the Hero activates 'Grapewood Curative.'
'Grapewood Curative:' Increases the Hero's own HP by 2x for 6 seconds, and takes damage in place of all allies. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)
Upon pressing the Hero's own block while 'Grapewood Curative' is active, 'Grapewood Curative' is changed to 'Pomegranate Panacea.'
'Pomegranate Panacea:' increases all allies' SP by 20, and generates 1 block for the Leader.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_02_DESC.text:
1-Chain: Naofumi uses 'Air Strike Shield' over the entire team. 'Air Strike Shield' receives damage up to 200% of Naofumi's HP and changes Naofumi's Shield into 'Small Shield.'
2-Chain: Naofumi's Shield changes to 'Dog Bite' Shield. 'Dog Bite' deals #physical damage# equal to 300% of Naofumi's armor to enemies before him and decreases enemy accuracy by 50 for 3 seconds. After the attack, Naofumi's Shield changes to 'Small Shield.' (Cooltime: 1 second)
3-Chain: Naofumi's Shield changes to 'Soul Eater Shield.' Enemies who attack Naofumi during 'Soul Eater Shield' will lose 3 SP per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally block, Naofumi receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 3 seconds. This effect cannot be canceled. Reusing the skill before its termination will reset its duration.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally block, Naofumi receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 5 seconds. This effect cannot be canceled. Reusing the skill before its termination will reset its duration.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_02_NAME.text: Air Strike Shield / Dog Bite / Soul Eater Shield

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_03_DESC.text: Filo transforms into her 'Filolial Queen' form. This transformation cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_03_LV2_SUBDESC.text: 'Filolial Queen' Form: Filo's block skill is changed to 'Full-Powered Kick,' through which Filo deals #physical damage# equal to [180/320/460]% of her attack power by stomping upon the enemy from the air.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_SH_03_LV3_SUBDESC.text: 'Filolial Queen' Form: Filo's block skill is changed to 'Full-Powered Kick,' through which Filo deals #physical damage# equal to [180/320/460]% of her attack power by stomping upon the enemy from the air. Upon using 'Full-Powered Kick' 5 times, Filo uses 'Fast Tornado' to deal #physical damage# equal to 2000% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIONMASK_DESC.text: Lion Mask dropkicks the enemy to deal #physical damage# equal to [200/400/600]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used, and stuns the hit enemy for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIONMASK_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When the enemy comes within his range, Lion Mask generates a 'Wrestling Ring' for 10 seconds. (Cooltime: 13 seconds) If no enemy is in the Ring, the Ring disappears and its cooltime is reset.
Wrestling Ring: Whenever Lion Mask receives a hit in the ring, his armor is increased by 20% and his damage reduction rate is increased by 4%. This effect is canceled only when Lion Mask leaves the Ring or the Ring disappears. (Maximum 3 stacks; effect cannot be dispelled)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIONMASK_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When the enemy comes within his range, Lion Mask generates a 'Wrestling Ring' for 10 seconds. (Cooltime: 13 seconds) If no enemy is in the Ring, the Ring disappears and its cooltime is reset.
Wrestling Ring: Whenever Lion Mask receives a hit in the ring, his armor is increased by 40% and his damage reduction rate is increased by 8%. This effect is only canceled when Lion Mask leaves the Ring or the Ring disappears. (Maximum 5 stacks; effect cannot be dispelled) Upon using his block while in the Ring, Lion Mask activates his block skills as 'Chair Shot' that deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of his attack power and stuns the hit enemy for 2 seconds. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LUCY_DESC.text: The Hero dashes forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/300]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_MAENGGI_DESC.text: Mengqi leaps on his horse and charges forth for [1/3/5] seconds according to the chain number used, spinning his spear to deal #physical damage# equal to [75/225/750]% of his attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_MAENGGI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's block after the Hero's 3-chain, the Hero leaps off their horse and uses 'Fierce Dragon Slash.' 'Fierce Dragon Slash' dispels all enemy buffs and deals #physical damage# equal to 575% of the Hero's attack power. If the Hero's HP is less than 50%, their armor and resistance are increased by 300.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_MAENGGI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's block after the Hero's 3-chain, the Hero leaps off their horse and uses 'Fierce Dragon Slash.' 'Fierce Dragon Slash' dispels all enemy buffs and deals #physical damage# equal to 1500% of the Hero's attack power. If another ally's block is used during 'Fierce Dragon Slash,' the Hero uses 'Fierce Dragon Charge' to deal #physical damage# equal to 500% of their attack power per hit for 3 seconds. Additionally, every time an ally receives damage, the Hero deals #physical damage# equal to 500% of the Hero's attack power to the enemy that attacked. If the Hero's HP is less than 50%, their armor and resistance are increased by 300.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NARI_DESC.text: The Hero charges forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [100/150/200]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NARI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If an enemy is within the Hero's range, the Hero's block skill is changed to 'Fourth Stance - Force of the Penetrating Palm' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 700% of the enemy's armor. 'Fourth Stance' ignores all enemy evasion and effects that receive damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NARI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If an enemy is within the Hero's range, the Hero's block skill is changed to 'Fourth Stance - Force of the Penetrating Palm' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1000% of the enemy's armor. 'Fourth Stance' ignores all enemy evasion and effects that receive damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NARI_NAME.text: First Stance - Way of the Gale

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NARI_SUBNAME.text: Fourth Stance - Force of the Penetrating Palm

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NEULSOLGIL_DESC.text: The Hero swings their weapon to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used, and knock back hit enemies.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NEULSOLGIL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Forest's Blessing' to increase their own armor and resistance by 50% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NEULSOLGIL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero activates 'Forest's Blessing' to increase their own armor and resistance by 50% and receive all damage targeted at the entire team for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ODIN_DESC.text:
Odin wields [1/2/3] spears that deal #physical damage# equal to [400/400/400]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used. Each of Odin's spears activates different effects, in the order they are used.
First Spear: Knocks back enemies within its range.
Second Spear: Pulls in enemies within its range.
Third Spear: Knocks enemies within its range into the air.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ODIN_DESC_S2EP3.text:
The Hero wields [1/2/3] Odin's Spears that deal #physical damage# equal to [400/400/400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used. Each of Odin's Spears activates different effects, in the order they are used.
First Spear: Knocks back enemies within its range.
Second Spear: Pulls in enemies within its range.
Third Spear: Knocks enemies within its range into the air.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ODIN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by Odin's block skill receive the effect of 'Odin's Eye' for 5 seconds. 'Odin's Eye' decreases 5% of its subject's armor.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ODIN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by Odin's block skill receive the effect of 'Odin's Eye' for 5 seconds. 'Odin's Eye' decreases 10% of its subject's armor.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ORBITAL_HAMMER_DESC.text: The caster summons spinning hammers around their body that deal @magical damage@ equal to 30% of the caster's attack power upon contact.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ORBITAL_HAMMER_LV2_DESC.text: The caster summons spinning hammers around their body that deal @magical damage@ equal to 35% of the caster's attack power upon contact.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ORBITAL_HAMMER_LV3_DESC.text: The caster summons spinning hammers around their body that deal @magical damage@ equal to 40% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Enemies that receive 5 hits by this skill become stunned for 1 second. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ORBITAL_HAMMER_LV4_DESC.text: The caster summons spinning hammers around their body that deal @magical damage@ equal to 45% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Enemies that receive 5 hits by this skill become stunned for 1 second. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ORBITAL_HAMMER_LV5_DESC.text: The caster summons spinning hammers around their body that deal @magical damage@ equal to 75% of the caster's attack power upon contact. Enemies that receive 5 hits by this skill become stunned for 1 second. Stunning an enemy will heal the leader ally by 5% of their HP. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OTIS_DESC.text: The Hero swings their bottle to deal #physical damage# equal to [120/240/320]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OTIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally’s 3-chain, the Hero increases their own and another frontmost ally’s attack power by 20% for 5 seconds. (Reusing skill will reset duration)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OTIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using an ally’s 3-chain, the Hero increases their own and another frontmost ally’s attack power by 25% for 5 seconds. (Reusing skill will reset duration)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OVERPOWER_DESC.text: Esplode con grande potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 250% e stordisce l'ultimo nemico colpito per 1,5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OVERPOWER_LV2_DESC.text: Esplode con grande potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 300% e stordisce l'ultimo nemico colpito per 1,5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OVERPOWER_LV3_DESC.text: Esplode con grande potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 350% e stordisce l'ultimo nemico colpito per 1,5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OVERPOWER_LV4_DESC.text: Esplode con grande potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 425% e stordisce l'ultimo nemico colpito per 1,5 secondi.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OVERPOWER_LV5_DESC.text: Esplode con grande potenza, infliggendo #danni fisici# pari al 500% della potenza d'attacco dell'eroe e stordisce l'ultimo nemico colpito per 1,5 secondi. 50% di probabilità di attivare due volte l'abilità.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PAINWHEEL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon attacking an enemy under a debuff with 'Whirlwind of Pain,' Cain stuns the hit enemy for 3 seconds. The last hit of 'Whirlwind of Pain' decreases the hit enemy's attack power by 60% for 5 seconds, and has a 65% chance of activating Cain's 3-chain one more time.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PALA_HEAL_DESC.text: The caster immediately heals the hero with the least remaining HP by 250% of the caster's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PALA_HEAL_LV2_DESC.text: The caster immediately heals the hero with the least remaining HP by 300% of the caster's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PALA_HEAL_LV3_DESC.text: The caster immediately heals the hero with the least remaining HP by 350% of the caster's attack power. Healed allies receive 25% less damage for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PALA_HEAL_LV4_DESC.text: The caster immediately heals the hero with the least remaining HP by 400% of the caster's attack power. Healed allies receive 30% less damage for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_PALA_HEAL_LV5_DESC.text: The caster immediately heals the leader ally and the hero with the least remaining HP by 450% of the caster's attack power. Healed allies receive 50% less damage for 7 seconds.
