TEXT_SORRYINHERIT_MAIL_CONTENT.text: Here is the bonus reward for contracting a duplicate hero.

TEXT_SOUL_HARD_REWARD_01_HELP.text: Obtain all six types of Old Weapons.

TEXT_SOUL_HARD_REWARD_01_MESSAGE.text: An Old Weapon Bundle has arrived!

TEXT_SOUL_HARD_REWARD_02_HELP.text: A chest containing Danan's Fragments, used to forge Soulbound Weapons.

TEXT_SOUL_HARD_REWARD_02_MESSAGE.text: Your Danan's Fragment Bundle has arrived.

TEXT_SOUL_RESET_FALSE_NOTI.text: This floor cannot be purified with Archon's Holy Water.

TEXT_SOUTHSEA_FISHING_DESC.text:
I hear it's now possible to fish
in the tropical waters of the South Sea, nya!
Heroes say it's a lot cooler there than the Volcano!

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_BAR_01_DESC.text: It turns out that 'the desert oasis' really refers to this saloon.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_BONE_01_DESC.text: The remnants of a poor animal that failed to survive the harsh conditions of the Desert.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_BOTTLE_01_DESC.text: A bottle that once held the finest whiskey in the Southwestern Desert. You can still smell the distinctively smoky notes lingering inside.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_CACTUS_01_DESC.text: A wild cactus commonly found in the Southwestern Desert.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_CACTUS_02_DESC.text: A wild cactus commonly found in the Desert. Ouch, don't get too close!

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_CARRIAGE_01_DESC.text: Handy for transporting large piles of luggage across the harsh Desert.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_MONEY_01_DESC.text: Ooh, what a nice, plump bag full of money. Finders, keepers!

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_TUMBLE_01_DESC.text: A diaspore that rolls to and fro with every breath of wind. The suspense produced by its unpredictable trajectory is almost nerve-wrecking.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_VULTURE_01_DESC.text: A rapture species that inhabits the Southwestern Desert. Once it has chosen its prey, it will patiently remain perched on a high place while waiting for the weak to fall.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_WINDMILL_01_DESC.text: A windmill that uses wind energy to pump groundwater.

TEXT_SOUTHWEST_BOTTOM_WINDMILL_02_DESC.text: A windmill that uses wind energy to pump groundwater.

TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_DESC.text: Set out to uncover hidden memories!

TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_STORY.text: Since the beginning of time, light and darkness have warred against each other in endless struggle. The first three ‘Apostles’ who invade Hasla and the three ‘Daughters of Cora’ who have followed them prepare for the final battle that will put an end to the eternal war. The Daughters of Cora create a new generation of Goddesses, the ‘Elard,’ by bestowing them the Daughters’ own powers, as well as human soldiers who will help them fight in the battle: the ‘Chrona Heroes.’ The Apostles besiege the continent with unrelenting forces of darkness, controlling monsters as pawns against the warriors of light. In the face of a seemingly hopeless war, the Chrona Heroes forge a contract with the Goddess Chronos. They relinquish the eternal rest that comes with death and instead sacrifice their souls for the greater good, vowing to be reincarnated again and again as need calls them. After much strife and struggle – with Dionne disappearing from the battlefield, deceived by Nemesis’s trickery – the persevering two Goddesses and Heroes fight the last remaining Apostle, Destalos, and succeed in binding their soul. The war is finally over, and the victorious battle comes to be known as the ‘Apostles War.’ All praise the courage of the Goddess and her Heroes. Yet as the years pass by in idle peace, dust settles on the scars of the war, and the glorious feats of old are forgotten…

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_9.text: Your Arena Rank cannot be downgraded. Losses will only result in the decrease of your Arena Tier.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_1.text: Stages that have been cleared once can be played again with Battle Delegation.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_2.text: During Battle Delegation, main Heroes use 3-chains, and support Heroes use 1-chain block skills.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_1.text: Illustrations of your team Heroes will be shown when entering battle.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_2.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from Settings > Game.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_3.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from the battle Settings menu.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_1.text: Play Ordeals to get special Sticker rewards!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_2.text: Ordeals are a difficult Adventure mode that open every 3 weeks for a week at a time.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_3.text: Defeat powerful Bosses from the twisted dimension of an alternate Hasla!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_4.text: Freely experiment with different teams in the Practice Mode.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_5.text: The Boss's stats increase according to the stage difficulty. Harder levels will activate even more harmful debuffs to Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_1.text: Add [Slots] and [Sigils] to Soulbound Weapons to strengthen your Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_2.text: Adding Slots requires other ★4~6 Soulbound Weapons and Fergus Points as materials.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_3.text: In order to add a Sigil to a Soulbound Weapon, you must first upgrade it to ★6 and add a Slot.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_1.text: Defeat Champion Monsters in Challenge Mode to earn Books of Inheritance and powerful Sigils!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_10.text: Buff Potions cannot be used in Challenge Mode.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_2.text: Be careful of Champion Monsters' unique attacks! Each Monster must be defeated through different methods.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_3.text: It is said that Sigils obtained by Champion Monsters each contain a piece of lore…

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_4.text: There are rumors of a terrifying being slumbering in the deepest chamber of the underground sewers.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_5.text: The Palace is currently being guarded by remnants of the Order of the Lion who had not left for the battlefield of the Holy City.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_6.text: You will not receive any rewards if you die in Challenge Mode. Think wisely, and escape when you need to!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_7.text: You can choose to either continue going or escape after defeating each Champion Monster. You will keep the rewards you have found if you escape.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_8.text: Attacks to Champion Monsters cannot deal more than 20% of their maximum HP with every hit.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_9.text: You cannot use Ads to continue your play in Challenge Mode.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ADVANCE_HERO.text: Promotion Heroes can be randomly recruited through promoting ★3 Heroes of the same class.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COLLABO_HERO.text: Otherworld Heroes come from other dimensions, drawn by a strange power to Hasla.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COMMON_HERO.text: Normal Heroes range from ★1 to ★3 and promote to a random Hero of the same class upon promotion.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_1.text: Use Danan's Fragments, Iron, and Gold to forge Soulbound Weapons and unlock the true power of your Heroes!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_3.text: When heroes are equipped with their 6-star Soulbound Weapon, their class icon shines brilliantly.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GACHA_HERO.text: Contract Heroes can be recruited through Premium Contracts.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_3.text: ★6 Heroes can eat Berries to gain additional stats.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_5.text: Cora, the first goddess, is known to have dispersed powers to fight against the darkness across the whole universe.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_MANACAR_1.text: Manacar is a mass of greed that devours whatever contains the faintest trace of magic.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_SOUL_1.text: The bloodline of Soltar, the Apostle who once drove the southern lands of Hasla into deathly terror, still remains standing...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HELP.text:
Having trouble? Go to [Town] > [Menu] to access the Help Guide,
or touch the [?] button in each screen to get more information!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_RANKING.text: See which Heroes participated the most in Raid dungeons before you try it yourself!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_VALUE.text: Heroes of Crusaders Quest are divided into seven categories: Legendary, Contract, Promotion, Normal, Hidden, Otherworld, and Supply.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LEGENDARY_HERO.text: Legendary Heroes are fixed in their promotion from ★1 to ★6. Their stats are higher on average than other Heroes of the same grade.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_POPO.text: Successfully bargain with Popo to get deals on all items.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_STAGE_1.text: In the Scenario Selection Menu, you can touch the book icon on Hero Bosses' portraits to check whether you have recruited the Hero.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_TEAM_RECORD.text: Go to the [Record] menu in the Scenario selection screen to look up team combinations of other Captains!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_1.text: Help Adol and company to rescue Castaways and build a boat to escape the deserted island!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_2.text: A mysterious power brought Adol and his company to Hasla during their journey to recover Dana's memories.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_3.text: The Hasla passenger liner was attacked and destroyed by a Kraken that suddenly appeared before them.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_1.text: Fishernyan has come to Hasla to spread the joys of fishing.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_2.text: Fish Coin can be acquired through fishing and traded for various items at the Trading Post.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_4.text: The Best Record for each fish in the Fish Collection Album is reset once a day.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_5.text: Complete your Fish Collection for all fishing spots and earn valuable rewards!

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_6.text: While fishing does not increase your Account Level, it will increase your Fisher Rank (FR).

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_7.text: The 'Big Fish Chance' of your Fishing Equipment increases your chances of catching bigger fish while Auto-Fishing!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_1.text: Deal damage to Giant Bosses and receive rewards!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_2.text: A Hero can fight only one battle a day.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_3.text: You can receive additional rewards by defeating the Boss within the event period.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_4.text: Devilish Coins can be acquired through Hasla Wars events and traded for rewards.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_5.text: The longer you survive, the more Devilish Coins you receive.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_6.text: 'Bloody Rose Jack' is one of the Elite Four, the most loyal subordinates of Gordian, the Devil King of Hell Island.

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_1.text: 6-Star Heroes who have also maxed training can become stronger through Inheritance.

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_2.text: Books of Inheritance can be obtained through Champion Rewards, Contracts, Challenge Mode, and more!

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_3.text: The levels of Inherited Heroes are marked in purple.

TEXT_TIP_ITEM_INFO_LONG_PRESS.text: Press and hold an item in your Inventory to check its information.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_1.text: The house of Tsukino is one of the three founding clans of the Ryu Kingdom.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_3.text: The peak of the Primal Volcano has been devastated by heat, but the Woopa Tribe lives in the jungle at the foot of the mountain.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_1.text: Pandora is looking for a competent Captain who will help her manage records in the Library of Dimensions.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_2.text: You must enter your record into the Library of Dimensions in order to receive its reward.

TEXT_TIP_LOW_INHERITANCE_1.text: Inherit to a certain extent ★6 Heroes who have reached maximum level and training.

TEXT_TIP_ORCHARD_1.text: Heroes working in the Orchard are marked with a round tree icon.

TEXT_TIP_PASSIVE_DESC.text: Heroes over grade 4 have additional $passive skills$. They are either #main# or %support% types.

TEXT_TIP_PROMOTION_EXCEPTION.text: Certain★3 Secret Heroes cannot be promoted.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_2.text: In the Colosseum, you will fight against other Captains' A.I. Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_3.text: Heroes receive reduced healing during matches.

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_1.text: Complete Rank Quests to increase your Quest Rank (QR)! The higher your QR is, the more appearances of quests with better rewards!

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_2.text: You can reject a Rank Quest to replace with a new quest. There is a set limit of times you can reject a quest per day.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_META_1.text: The Apostle of the Raid changes every Monday.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_1.text: Tap the screen multiple times to break your heroes' stun!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_2.text: The tribespeople of the Ancient Desert were masters of rock and stone - the creators of a technology that became lost through time.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_3.text: The Guardian of the Lost Kingdom, created through forgotten ancient technology, continues to revive in various shapes even after its defeat.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_4.text: According to the Prophecy of the Rosetta Stone, the secret of a lost kingdom lies buried within the depths of the Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_5.text: You can earn special Sigils with set options in the "Guardian of the Ruins" raids.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_1.text: The current capital of Nosgard is Snorri Edda, named after the first Great King of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_2.text: Only the silent ruins beyond the Crossing of Frost Wolves remain of Elder Edda, the old capital of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_3.text: Any true Nosgardian would be proud of their heritage. There are many who disapprove of Thor's attempts to unite the diverse traditional tribes of Nosgard into a single, central nation.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_4.text: Be careful not to let your screen freeze over in battle! Use Goddess Skills to prevent the oncoming frost.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_5.text: Quickly cut through frozen shackles to destroy the summoned chains!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_6.text: Bosses of the Sanctuary regularly cast buffs on themselves while canceling Hero buffs. Make sure to cancel Boss buffs!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_1.text: In the Laboratory, Heroes will not be able to generate shields due to a powerful electromagnetic field!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_2.text: Shields generated by Boss Monsters will absorb all damage targeted at them.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Boss Monsters' laser beams!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_4.text: When Battleloid NS000 attempts to self-destruct, tap on the screen repeatedly to help Stanya deactivate the attack.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_5.text: The science companies that lead the Neth Empire are currently being dominated by the country's House of Nobles.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_6.text: Levine, the former Chief Research Officer of Rapture Science, is the granddaughter of the legendary scientist Ludvico, Hasla's greatest expert on Battleloids.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_1.text: Heroes who gaze into the Eye of the Abyss will be temporarily weakened.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_2.text: All buffs and debuffs cast by the Boss can be dispelled.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to block the Boss's giant tentacles!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_4.text: There are old legends that in the depths of the mystical sea dwells an ancient monster that feeds on light.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_5.text: All experienced sailors know that one must not anger the 'Elder Sister of the Sea" if one values one's life.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_6.text: Due to her responsibility and toil of having protected the ocean for decades, Maré, "Elder Sister of the Sea," is seldom found content.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_1.text: Tap the notes in time with the music as they approach the center from both sides of the screen!

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_2.text: Different notes require different modes of tapping, such as tapping in succession or holding down the screen.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_3.text: Go to 'Calibration Settings' to manually synchronize the music and input.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_4.text: You can customize the speed of the notes before starting a song.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_5.text: If you succeed in consecutively hitting notes in a combo, you will enter Fever Mode and earn bonus points.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_6.text: You can continue the stage even if you reach Game Over, but your record will not be registered.

TEXT_TIP_RZ_1.text: Clear Stages to fill the progress bar and receive rewards!

TEXT_TIP_RZ_2.text: Entry tickets refill every day at 4PM PST.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_1.text: Some monsters must be fought with Monster Bombs. Use them wisely!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_2.text: Hyro Forest is located near Hero Town.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_1.text: Disarm enemies with smoke grenades, found in chests!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_2.text: Trista is suffering under the tyranny of the Order of the Shadow Rose, who mysteriously appeared one day to seize the power of the kingdom.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_1.text: Flash Grenades do not only light up a path - they also deal damage to enemies!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_2.text: The Ratmen have lived furtively in the Sewers for a very long time.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_1.text: Use mana drifting around the Palace to deal stronger damage to enemies!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_2.text: The Palace, once used by the former King of Trista and his concubine for secret rendezvous, has been deserted ever since their deaths.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_1.text: In order to improve the worsening conditions of Nosgard, King Thor formed an alliance with Emperor Alexander of Grancia.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_2.text: The capital of Nosgard, 'Snorri Edda,' is named after its first king.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_3.text: The 'Einherjar' are an elite troop of warriors with a long tradition. They deem strength and glory in battle the highest values in life.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_4.text: Many stories lay buried underneath the pure snow of the northern lands.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_1.text: Not only is Levine Ludvico the current head of Road Industry, she is also the designer of Neth's magical engineering troops: soldiers who annihilated Trista's Falcon No.9 Brigade in the previous war.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_2.text: Arart is the Goddess of Judgement and the former Goddess of the Volcano - as well as Bella's former teacher.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Bosses' powerful attacks!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_4.text: Attacking from outside the range of the Boss's shield will decrease the damage you deal.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_1.text: Use the goddess' power to escape from the influence of the corrupted veins.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_2.text: If you are not able to escape after the wanted list is out, the amount of damage you receive will get stronger.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_3.text: Use a focus block to cancel the shadow of phantasm.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_4.text: Collect 3 focus blocks and delete them to cancel the shadow of phantasm for all Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_1.text: Arart's, the Goddess of Judgment, was the one who fought and sealed the corrupted Sylunis one hundred years ago.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_2.text: After Camilla Banoub was defeated, many raiders have snuck into the Temple in hopes of stealing some treasure.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_3.text: Although the descendants of the Desert Tribe are scattered across the land, they firmly believe that the legendary Three Kings will someday return to lead them once more.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_4.text: Elise and Arart's are the former Goddesses of the Desert and the Volcano, respectively.

TEXT_TIP_SET_CARVESTONE_1.text: Add slots and inlay two Sigils from the same set into a Soulbound Weapon to trigger their unique Set Options.

TEXT_TIP_SKILL_DELETE.text: You can delete Special Skills from Heroes at the Skill Lab.

TEXT_TOPDEALER_RANDOM_EXCLUSIVE_WEAPON_4.text: Great Success! Fergus has given you a random 4-Star Soulbound Weapon!
A chest holding a random ★4 Soulbound Weapon.

TEXT_TOPDEALER_RANDOM_FUGUS_BOX_HELP.text: A chest given by your favorite blacksmith. It seems to hold a variety of items.

TEXT_TOTAL_DAMAGE_RANKING_DESC.text: Listed are the Hero Captains who have dealt the most damage in total. This list is renewed every {0} minutes.

TEXT_TQ_008_GOAL.text: Play a Stage with a Mercenary

TEXT_TRADE_HISTORY_EMPTY.text: There is no history to be found.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_BAR_01_DESC.text: A special bar on wheels. Even plain spring water tastes special here.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CART_01_DESC.text: A cart filled with various drinks and snacks. Very difficult to pass up when it comes by your compartment.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CHAIR_01_DESC.text: Recline and relax on our comfortable seats as you journey towards your destination.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CHAIR_02_DESC.text: Recline and relax on our comfortable seats as you journey towards your destination.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CUP_01_DESC.text: There's not much in life a cup of hot chocolate won't make better.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_KETTLE_01_DESC.text: Full of hot tea for the journey ahead.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_PARTITION_01_DESC.text: Divides passenger cars into compartments for private seating arrangements.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TABLE_01_DESC.text: Convenient for doodling, reading, snacking, and other pastimes on your train journey.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TABLE_02_DESC.text: Convenient for doodling, reading, snacking, and other pastimes on your train journey.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TOILET_01_DESC.text: For number ones and twos on the road.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_BAG_01_DESC.text: Travel light so that you may bring back more memories with you.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_BARTENDER_01_DESC.text: A special cabinet specially built for the bartender's use. One may think that it only contains bottles and other concoctions, but nobody knows for certain...

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_DRINKINGWATER_01_DESC.text: The key to any bartender's trade: know your drinks.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_LIGHT_01_DESC.text: Perfect for some quiet travel reading.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_SHELF_01_DESC.text: For storing luggage. Bigger trunks don't fit, however, and must be stored somewhere else.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_01_DESC.text: A window looking out on grassland plains and, farther beyond, the sea on the horizon.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_02_DESC.text: A window looking out on a vast landscape filled with and... sand... and more sand.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_03_DESC.text: A window looking out at the cold, bleak tundra in a state of eternal winter. When will spring arrive?

TEXT_TRAIN_TOP_CEILINGFAN_01_DESC.text: A ceiling fan with lights. Please don't stare at it for too long, lest your eyes start to hurt.

TEXT_TREASURE_GOBLIN_BARRIER_DESC.text: Immune to Physical and Magical Dmg

TEXT_TREASURE_GOBLIN_BARRIER_KING_DESC.text:
Immune to All Dmg
Cancel with Goddess

TEXT_TROPICAL_FISHING_DESC.text:
The jungle between the country of Ryu and the Primal Volcano
is wild territory, scarcely trodden by human feet.
There should be many strange species inhabiting its waters.

TEXT_TUTO_BOX_SIS_SKILL_1.text: Press the Sera Button on the screen!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_01.text: I'll teach you the basics of fishing, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_02.text:
This is the Fishing Menu, nya.
You can go find a fishing spot or check your equipment or collection.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_03.text:
This is your Fisher Rank, nya. It's the official standard set by
the Hasla Fishing Association to judge your fishing skills, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_04.text:
The higher your rank, the better gear you can get 
and fishing spots you can challenge, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_05.text: Catch fish to increase your Fisher Rank, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_06.text:
Practice makes perfect, after all! 
Catch more fish to become a better fisher, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_07.text:
Here you can check your fishing gear
and your fish collection album, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_08.text: In the Gear Menu, you can buy and equip fishing equipment, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_09.text:
In the Fish Collection Album, you can check all the fish 
you can catch at each fishing spot, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_10.text: HFA will give you a special reward if you complete your collection!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_11.text: Here you can choose your fishing spot, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_12.text:
It's a little early for you to start fishing just yet.
Let's go here first, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_13.text:
Here's your first fishing spot, nya!
This is the place you can fish to your heart's content.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_14.text:
Well, I guess you'll first need
a fishing pole, a float, and bait to fish, nya...

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_15.text:
Remember, one bait for one round of fishing, nya. 
You won't catch anything without bait!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_16.text: You can go to the Gear Menu by touching your fishing gear, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_17.text:
Now let's try some real fishing, nya!
Press the Reel button to cast your rod.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_18.text:
You have just cast your rod, nya!
Tap the Reel button one more time to stop the moving bar.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_19.text:
You have a better chance of catching bigger fish
the closer you stop to the center of the Casting Bar.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_22.text:
Now that you've cast your rod, 
we have to wait until the fish start biting, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_23.text:
We have a bite!
Tap the Reel button and show that fish who's boss, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_24.text:
Now comes the fun part: the actual fight, nya!
I'll give you a few important tips before you give it a go.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_25.text: Here you can see the tension of your fishing line, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_26.text:
If the tension of your line is too high, 
it will break and the fish will escape, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_27.text:
On the other hand, if the tension is too low, 
the fish will be let loose and escape more easily.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_28.text:
Holding the Reel button will reel in your line
and increase its tension,

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_29.text: while letting go will decrease the tension, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_30.text:
Simply put, you must maintain a fine balance 
and slowly lure in the fish, nya! Fishing is delicate business!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_31.text:
The line tension is high, nya. You can reel in fish faster like this,
but if you reach the maximum limit, the line will break!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_32.text:
The line's tension is too low. The fish is getting away!
Here, let me give you a hand, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_33.text:
When the line tension is "green," 
the fish will come toward you.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_34.text:
You must loosen the reel at this point, nya.
Let me give you a hand.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_35.text: The fish has leapt out of the water! Quickly move the reel to the left!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_36.text:
This fish is putting up a good fight.
Press the blocks in order to weaken it!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_37.text:
Strong fish will sometimes use special skills to resist capture.
Don't let them succeed, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_38.text: You caught a fish! I say it's the cat's MEOW!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_39.text:
It looks like there's nothing left to teach you, meow!
I hope you've realized the joys of fishing. Good luck, fellow fisherman!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_40.text: Now you try fishing on your own. Here's a rod, nya.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_1.text: This is where Heroes' Block Skills are generated.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_2.text: Tap the generated block to use a @1-chain@ Block Skill!

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_3.text:
Three @1-chain@ blocks belonging to the same Hero
combine to make one #3-chain# block.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_4.text: Tap the #3-chain block# to use a stronger skill!

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHAMP_1.text:
It seems very agile.
Do you think we could attack it?

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHAMP_2.text:
Now's the chance!
Use the bomb!

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHIEF.text:
We need to take care of the others
before we attack the leader.

TEXT_TUTO_MAGIC_BALL_2.text:
We must take precautions
before we fell it.

TEXT_TUTO_OGER_MINI.text:
It's a small but sturdy monster.
How can we pierce through its defense?

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_BIG.text:
That small Rat is 
acting very suspiciously.

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_BOMB.text:
That rat with the bomb…
Do you think it will react to flames?

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_DECAY_SPORE_1.text:
What are those spores…?
We should be careful of them!

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_DECAY_SPORE_2.text:
They are going to explode!
Use a flash grenade, quickly!

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_GIANT.text:
That Ratman seems strong…
Be careful!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWDEVIL_CONFUSE.text:
That is demonic power.
Let's stop him together!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWDEVIL_FINAL.text:
That monster is using demonic powers…!
Use my Goddess abilities!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWROSE_GUN.text:
Hmm… Why don't we use the grenade
when that fellow is preparing his bomb?

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWROSE_RIDER.text:
If we don't use the smoke grenade,
that Hound will raise an alarm…!

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_1.text: Using a Hero's block will charge the Goddess's powers!

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_2.text:
Using a 3-chain block generates more Goddess power
than using a 1-chain block, so use them wisely!

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_3.text:
That hurt!

TEXT_WISH_REWARD_DESC_2.text:
#[How to Acquire Golden Quill Pens]#

- Enter the Bingo Event after 00:00 UTC every day to receive 5 Gold Quill Pens.

- Complete Rank Quests.

- You can purchase up to 10 Golden Quill Pens per day from the menu on the upper right.

- Purchase the Bingo Pass to receive 10 additional Golden Quill Pens per day for the duration of the Event. (The Golden Quill Pens acquired through the Bingo Pass accumulate daily and can be immediately received upon purchase.)

#※ Golden Quill Pens can be stored. However, you cannot acquire or use Golden Quill Pens after the end of the Bingo Event. Any Golden Quill Pens remaining in your Inventory will be reset after the Event period.#

TEXT_YS8_DUNGEON_LOCK_DESC.text: You must rescue more Castaways to enter the dungeon.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_02_T.text: Let’s hang our stockings on the tree!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_04_T.text: Good to see everyone looking happy!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_05_T.text: Shall we bake some Christmas cake?

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_06_T.text: Always so excited... during this time of the year.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_01_TITLE.text: I smile when I see children playing happily.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_02_TITLE.text: Well! Why don't you try something? Smile like me!

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_03_TITLE.text: If everyone can smile together, of course I will join them.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_04_TITLE.text: What did the mama cow say to the baby now? It's pasture bedtime! Hahaha!

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_05_TITLE.text: I give the pitiful people who chase me my happy mocking smile.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_06_TITLE.text: Maria's smile is so precious that it must be protected at all costs.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_07_TITLE.text: I cannot stop smiling when people fight each other out of hatred.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_08_TITLE.text: *Chuckles* Oh, this isn't actually a smile?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_01_TITLE.text: Ah... Family... Marriage... I should start...

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_02_TITLE.text: We are all in a family! Let's be a good one!

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_03_TITLE.text: My sister's sins are mine to bear as well.

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_04_TITLE.text: Perhaps one day, I could patch things up with Odin and have a pint or two as well?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_05_TITLE.text: I'm worried every day that my younger sister might get into trouble.

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_06_TITLE.text: Anzu! We are family forever! Right!?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_07_TITLE.text: Can providence of artifice make a family too...?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_08_TITLE.text: What is a family indeed? I don’t know what a family should look like just by looking at others.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_01_TITLE.text: Such a fine weather to go on a picnic.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_02_TITLE.text: A picnic full of pleasant events!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_03_TITLE.text: I hope everyone enjoys the picnic...

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_04_TITLE.text: A picnic... Well, a musical motif comes to my mind

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_05_TITLE.text: I will pack lunch for everyone!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_06_TITLE.text: A picnic? I will join with my younger sibling.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_07_TITLE.text: I want to go on a treasure hunt!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_08_TITLE.text: What about a picnic with your friend?

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_01_TITLE.text: Listening to the sound of rain soothes me.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_03_TITLE.text: The rain is becoming more acidic.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_04_TITLE.text: The rain is a blessing to the forest.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_05_TITLE.text: It’s too dangerous to set sail.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_06_TITLE.text: I don't like rain since it melts beautiful snowflakes.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_07_TITLE.text: Ahh! My boots are completely soaked!

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_08_TITLE.text: It’s a good day to clean up the blood spilt from the game.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_01_TI.text: You did a good job this summer as always.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_02_TI.text: Don’t procrastinate and then blame the hot weather!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_03_TI.text: Where water is, Death always awaits.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_04_TI.text: Water activities are the best in hot summer!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_05_TI.text: Enjoy the hot oven as hot as summer heat!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_06_TI.text: Only if I had a friend to enjoy water activities together...

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_07_TI.text: (Water activities? No way, those are for little kids.)

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_01_TITLE.text: It would be nice to take some time off training to get some reading done.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_02_TITLE.text: Picture books are quite fun too!

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_03_TITLE.text: Reading? I don’t need to read. I can get all the answers online.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_04_TITLE.text:
The smell of trees seeping through the pages, and the refreshing wind.
Autumn is here at last.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_06_TITLE.text: It’s never too late to learn. Try to make reading into a habit.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_07_TITLE.text: I acquainted books to learn about love, but here I am, in love with books themselves.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_08_TITLE.text: It is nice to flip through the pages on a street bench covered in fallen leaves.

TEXT_202211_LIMIT_QUEST_HW_07_TITLE.text: Don’t be lazy just because it’s Halloween.

TEXT_202211_LIMIT_QUEST_HW_08_TITLE.text: Excuse me... Can I get some... c-candy?

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022SNOWFLOWER_0.text: Shall we go outside to enjoy cherry blossoms together when spring comes?
It is still cold out there. Be careful not to catch a cold.
Butterflies will usher in the spring.
Let's focus on developing a new menu for the spring, shall we?
Seeds of life began to sprout.
I wish spring would come faster so that flowers can bloom...
I can't wait to have a party with my friends!

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_01_TI.text: It must be really cold outside.

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_02_TI.text: Cold weather is also a part of nature.

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_03_TI.text: My fire does not go out easily.

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_05_TI.text: Try using the brazier in this cold winter!

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_07_TI.text: It's too early to be hunching your shoulders like that.

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_08_TI.text: Strangely, your ice is not cold.

TEXT_202301_LIMIT_QUEST_2023RABBIT_01_TI.text: Hope you enjoy another great new year!

TEXT_202301_LIMIT_QUEST_2023RABBIT_05_TI.text: Where should we explore in the New Year?

TEXT_202301_LIMIT_QUEST_2023RABBIT_06_TI.text: Shouldn’t you buy something to celebrate the New Year? Well! Come on

TEXT_202301_LIMIT_QUEST_2023RABBIT_07_TI.text: I’ll pray for a prosperous New Year

TEXT_202301_LIMIT_QUEST_2023RABBIT_08_TI.text: I hope you don’t bother me as much in the New Year

TEXT_202304_LIMIT_QUEST_2023SSPICNIC_03_.text: It’s springtime! Let’s watch the spring bugs scatter!

TEXT_202304_LIMIT_QUEST_2023SSPICNIC_04_.text: It’s great going on a spring picnic with everyone.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_16_DESC.text: An influential landlord who owns many plots of land and buildings in Impelis. He fights alongside the Cobalt Knights to end the war that caused his land to drop in value.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_20_DESC.text: A guard that protects the castle and its garden. He fell in love with the royal gardener at first sight, hence the reason he volunteered to work as a castle guard.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_22_DESC.text: A member of the Silver Archers led by Sigruna. Although Laura has a quiet personality, she is highly respected by her peers as she is an honest, hardworking member. But in truth, Laura is just too shy to share her true feelings with everyone. Laura didn’t want to follow Sigruna when she formed the Silver Archers, but she was simply too shy to say no. The same thing can be said for the war in Impelis.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_35_DESC.text: Devoted to seeking justice, Nottingham applies to be enlisted as a new member of the Green Apple. But he is denied enlistment because Robin Hood, the head of Green Apple, doubts his conviction. This is because Robin Hood has been paying close attention to House Lowell, considered the symbol of aristocratic corruption, and their eldest son, Nottingham. Nottingham, determined to prove his resolution towards justice regardless of his family, makes a difficult decision. He decides to hand over to the Green Apple the ledger with the names of corrupt aristocrats associated with his own family. Thanks to this ledger, the Green Apple is able to successfully eradicate aristocratic corruption, earning the trust of the Emperor, and Robin Hood officially accepts Nottingham as a member of the Green Apple.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_36_DESC.text: Famous for their acquired immunity to poison, the members of House Tang of Sicilian grow resistance to poison by neutralizing it inside their bodies in the course of burning body fat. Xiaohui Tang, however, could not be trained to become poison immunity in the way secretly known to the house. Naturally born resistant to poison, she instantly neutralized any poison infiltrated into her body, so the body fat she accumulated for poison training only made her more unhealthy. As Xiaohui Tang's health degraded to receive even the basic trainings, her parents looked for nutritional medicine in the Chen region, but nothing worked on her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_37_DESC.text: Thehyss, an inquisitor working for the Order of the Goddess, was an exemplary follower, but she was notorious for being excessively cruel when interrogating unbelievers. Many followers did not like her for her bloody affairs, but Uriel, her immediate superior, trusted her and her decisions. One day, Thehyss was sent to the Cathedral of Elandia and found the traces of heresy in the basement. Others dismissed her claim, but she was certain of her findings. She conducted inquisition against the bishops of the cathedral and found out that they were in fact a group of heretics called the Followers of Arart.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_39_DESC.text: The nephew of Ryu’s greatest Onmyoji, Yuki. Hina was born with immense spiritual potential, so the people of Ryu had plans to raise her as a powerful priestess to exorcise ‘Seimei’ that possesses Yuki’s body. However, Hina hated her priestess studies - she would often skip class to make various origami crafts such as paper airplanes with the priestess talismans. Whenever she was caught by the adults, she was heavily scolded, but it only increased her hatred towards the profession.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_35_DESC.text:
Even after Nottingham becomes an official Green Apple archer, Robin Hood still has doubts about his conviction and wants Nottingham to prove himself. 
Then, Emperor Alexander orders the assassination of a corrupt aristocrat, and Nottingham volunteers for the task in order to prove himself. He successfully assassinates the target. But then, he finds out the target was his own childhood friend, and he becomes flabbergasted. How was it that the arrow of justice ended up at the heart of an innocent citizen! Nottingham, convinced something is fishy, suspects for the first time the justice that the Green Apple supposedly serves.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_36_DESC.text: Upon hearing the rumors of Xiaohui Tang, Lazie thought of making a fortune. He immediately brewed a strong medicine and visited House Tang to administer it to Xiaohui Tang. However, the medicine was too potent to be safely used and Xiaohui Tang was knocked unconscious. Afraid of retribution from House Tang, Lazie ran away in the middle of the night. Surprisingly, the poison in the medicine began to increase the metabolism of Xiaohui, and she became healthy in just a few days. After she woke up, she wanted to thank Lazie for changing her life, but he was long gone already.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_37_DESC.text: But she couldn't continue the pursuit. The evidence she found was completely destroyed and the bishops she interrogated sent a letter of appeal to Grancia in rage. Despite Uriel's protection, Thehyss was sent to an orphanage in the countryside to spend the rest of her days there, barely avoiding excommunication from the order. There, she wore an apron and began teaching orphans, facing unfamiliar limitations for the first time in her life. Her students, the orphans, were not as bright as she was in their age and they too often burst into tears for nothing! Thehyss felt the urge to run away from the orphanage several times a day, but managed her life at the orphanage thanks to the trust Uriel gave her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_39_DESC.text: Unlike the other adults of Ryu, Hina’s parents were against raising Hina to be a priestess. They wanted Hina to follow her own dreams - not become trapped by the traditions of Ryu to live a dangerous life of an exorcist. Eventually Hina’s parents were able to send Hina to Neth as an exchange student. They wanted Hina to experience the world so she can decide what she wants to become for herself. Hina felt lonely at first, but she quickly adjusted to her new life in Neth and began enjoying the various education the empire offered.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_35_DESC.text: That very night, Robin Hood praises Nottingham for the assassination and appoints him as deputy head. Nottingham finally receives the recognition he wanted, but he finds no joy. Unable to free himself of the questions he has about the assassination, Nottingham sneaks into Robin Hood’s library, where he comes across an order from Alexander. After reading the order, Nottingham realizes the purpose of the assassination was to lay a political foundation for Alexander. His childhood friend was not a corrupt aristocrat. The Grancia Empire and the Green Apple were. Feeling betrayed and distanced by the degenerated Green Apple, Nottingham pledges to never again be used by the powerful, and takes with him the order of Alexander as he goes on to gather his own group of just men.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_36_DESC.text: Since then, she began to chew potent poisonous grass instead of Lazie's medicine and acquired resistance to various types of poison. Once she became more active, she showed aptitude to martial arts and many thought of her as a strong candidate for the next house leader. However, she refused to become the leader and wandered beyond the Chen region to find her benefactor, Lazie.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_37_DESC.text: Several years later, Thehyss found the orphanage burning in flames on her way back from the market. In the courtyard of the orphanage, an icon of the Order of the Goddess stood tall and she knew that it was a message from the Followers of Arart. Restraining her rage, Thehyss took off the apron and turned into an inquisitor who began to track down the heretics. When she caught up with the heretics’ cart, she saw something incredible. The children whom she had been teaching for years now grew so much stronger and they were defeating the heretics. After all is done, the orphanage came back to its normal life. However, only Uriel knew that Thehyss was actually training the young kids as the next-gen inquisitors at the orphanage.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_39_DESC.text: Then one day, the shikigami of sparrows, ‘Suzume’ came to Hina. Suzume tells Hina that Seimei is using Yuki’s body for a dangerous ritual that can wipe out the exorcists of Ryu. All the renowned exorcists have failed to stop Seimei, and Hina was Ryu’s final hope. Remembering all the hardships Hina experienced back in Ryu, she refused to help. However, Suzume slightly altered the story and told Hina that he would help her become a ‘Magic Girl’ that stops evil and not a priestess. Excited to become a Magic Girl, little Hina decides to head back to her hometown.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_4_07_DESC.text: A thief boy who dreams of making a name for himself with his sword one day. He comes across Guts' prowess and strength, which he came to admire enough to follow him.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_5_07_DESC.text: A thief boy who dreams of making a name for himself with his sword one day. He comes across Guts' prowess and strength, which he came to admire enough to follow him.
