TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_4_LEONIA_DESC.text: Once upon a time, Leonia used to be one of the heroes protecting Hasla. Leonia took out the heart of a dying star, grabbed the holy sword 'Caliburn' forged with light, and defeated the Transcendent who was aiming for her goddess, who was still young and did not have a mature ego. Many begged Leonia to rise to the rank of the Transcendent and rule Hasla herself rather than defend her child divinity, but Leonia did not answer, only to wield her Caliburn and slay her enemies. To the dark beings, Leonia’s presence was like a torch ever burning fiercely. The Eight Great Dragon Kings appeared from beyond the void and entered Hasla, as if guided by that light.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_5_LEONIA_DESC.text: Leonia fought against the Eight Great Dragon Kings who invaded Hasla. After a long battle that swept the entire continent, Leonia succeeded in piercing the heart of the Dragon King ‘Nanda’ with her Caliburn, but she lost her left eye to the ‘Lowest of All Beings’. Determining that she would not be able to defeat the rest of the Dragon Kings with her wounded body and protect Hasla, she chewed the heart of Nanda she had pierced with Caliburn, and absorbed her power into her own body. Leonia managed to defeat all Eight Great Dragon Kings in the end. Worried they might resurrect in the distant future, she piled up the bodies of the Eight Great Dragon Kings in the north of Hasla, naming them ‘Insurmountable Mountains’, and sealed herself whose body was now one with Nanda, together with the other Kings.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_6_LEONIA_DESC.text: Who knows how much time has passed since then? Feeling her heartbeat, Leonia awoke inside a pitch-black cave. Seized by an anxiety provoked by deep darkness, Leonia reflected on the emotions welling up inside her. Her longing to return to the ‘Sea of Stars’. Her sorrow for the brothers who had been sealed. Her anger at the hero who had defeated her. It was then she realized that she was not Leonia but the Dragon King Nanda, who had put on Leonia’s body. Overwhelmed with sorrow for the end of her nemesis and the power she had lost, she made a firm decision after a moment of silence. She would return to the Sea of Stars along with her brothers. Whatever the cost is.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_4_02_DESC.text: She's had strong power and ambition ever since she was young, and she gave all of her heart and strength whenever she's fighting for something she believed in. However, this trait caused her to part ways with her team and family.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_5_02_DESC.text: She is the biological mother of Yang Xiao Long. She appears to be more concerned about her tribe than the safety of her daughter.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_6_02_DESC.text: She is the leader of Branwen Tribe, and always accompanies the Spring Maiden named Vernal.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_4_ASMODEUS_DES.text: Like Demona and Luci, Asmodeus is a first-generation Demon who immigrated to the Demon Realm. With her charms cultivated over the years as an ageless demon, she stole the hearts of numerous males. Uninterested in trifling romances, she fled from barrages of gifts and courtship and spent her years hiding away in her abode reading books from Ryu over and over again. She corresponded with no one for decades, the only exception being Gustav the Familiar to do her chores and keep her company.

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_5_ASMODEUS_DES.text: One day, her Familiar went on a no-chore strike, resulting in an unprecedented shortage of supplies from the outside world. Anxious to find out how the next installment of her favorite literary series will unfold, she stepped out of her house for the first time in more than ten years to head into a bookstore downtown As she was reading through and nearing the book's ending, the door bell rang to signal someone entering: a boy stepping in with rays of the sun. "Incredibly charming..." Might this be a love at first sight? During her long years of reclusion, the Demon Realm was perhaps growing this charming flower of paradise. Asmodeus' eyes were irresistibly fixed on the boy, and her tactless heart was beating hard as if it would devour her. His slightly jaded yet sorrowed eyes, his two rosy and soft cheeks, and his delicate hands turning the pages. All of them came to her at an indescribable wavelength. Until he left, she could not move an inch as if bound at her feet. What was it that he was looking into with so much interest? Unable to suppress her curiosity, she found a pamphlet for a performance from a Succubus troupe. The title was "The Magical Girl Chronicles".

TEXT_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_6_ASMODEUS_DES.text: After that day, feverish love took over Asmodeus night and day. Such an anxious yearning she had to endure. Determined to make herself known to the boy she fell in love with, she started formulating a plot with her Familiar. However, plans coming from a Familiar and a reclusive centenarian could only be so delightfully romantic and rose-tinted. She has been courted but never the one to court, and the boy was 90 years her junior at best. Temporarily wrapped in despair, she could not let this feeling for the first time in her 110 years of life slide and suddenly thought of the pamphlet he was reading. "Magical girl..." Yes, that will definitely grab his attention. Donning a perfect magical girl attire, she stepped out the door to find the traveling Succubus Troupe in search of the boy, her first love.

TEXT_CHA_WI_1_16_DESC.text: A part-time cashier at a convenience store that Ashely frequently visits. This particular store is much busier than the others, but it is still a very highly sought-out job as the employees can see and talk with Ashley. Out of the thousands of applicants, this lucky man was chosen for the job. He gets to see Ashley blush while buying at the store - up close. Best job on the planet.

TEXT_CHA_WI_2_20_DESC.text: A janitor who works for the royal gardener. He was devastated when the attack happened right after he finished his annual large-scale cleanup. “Ugh! Right as I finished cleaning!”

TEXT_CHA_WI_3_22_DESC.text: The head of the Impelis palace. His family served the emperor of Impelis for generations. Alexander has a lot of trust in this butler, as he is strict and has great work ethics. However, deep inside, he is actually an adventurous soul, burdened by his family duties. He wants to one day leave the palace and travel the vast land of Hasla. “I have no choice but to work hard! I have mouths to feed!”

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_37_DESC.text: Born a member of the high nobility in Neth Empire, Winston exercised powerful magics that lived up to his house's name and everyone had high hopes on him. He graduated the Neth Royal School with distinguished achievements. Afterwards, he joined the Magic Academy of Pumpkin City for higher education and graduated the elite school as the top student. Disappointed and dissatisfied with the restricted and confined life of the elite, he ran away from his house to wander all over the lands of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_39_DESC.text: A human experiment that uses magical powers to express the ability to ‘substantiate delusions’. Affogato, who used his own brain as a test subject to overcome the limits of human beings, suffers from a side effect that prevents him from falling asleep. For this reason, his brain will die without periodic supply of caffeine. He once admitted himself to a hospital in Neth, in an attempt to treat the side effect only to fail despite numerous efforts. He now has no choice but to inject caffeine into his body so that he doesn’t fall asleep.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_40_DESC.text: Thalia showed talent in magic while growing up as the only daughter of ordinary parents who worked as dry cleaners. Her parents used their life savings to send Thalia to the Magic Academy of Pumpkin City. Unfortunately, Thalia didn't do well in school and had trouble with other students. She ended up dropping out of school and returned home. Her parents wanted to see what Thalia learned from school, but the only thing she was able to show them was just bubbles. They were very disappointed at her for not learning practical skills that might help support the family, and their neighbors offered words of comfort.

TEXT_CHA_WI_4_41_DESC.text: Originally from the Eastern Kingdom of Han, Deokpal Choi was an “ipjajang,” or master craftsman of gat. He had a very strict and subjective ethical code. And although he made hats fine enough to be sold to the royal palace, he lived a very humble life, as he drove away customers with his incessant nagging and lecturing. One day, he was at a government office delivering some hats, when he witnessed a local magistrate ridiculing a woman in broad daylight. Although those around him begged him to turn a blind eye and bite his tongue, he couldn’t suppress his outrage. In a fit, he yelled at the official, calling him corrupt. He ended up being executed for his outburst.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_37_DESC.text: When he got caught by a blizzard while passing through the snowy lands of Nosgard, he managed to survive the initial crisis by creating a spherical barrier around him. However, he was eventually covered and buried under the enormous amount of snow that fell around the barrier. He was dying from hypothermia under the snow, and that is when a group of Nosgardian warriors miraculously appear to sweep away the snow. It was the moment when Winston began to admire the braveness and wild spirit of the warriors removing snow with only a shovel.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_39_DESC.text: Unable to sleep, Affogato had twice as much time to spare as others. He had been pessimistic about his situation and loathed coffee, but now he had no other choice than to drink it if he wanted to stay alive. The only things remaining in his life now are impending death and lonely nights. After countless nights of agony, he finally made up his mind to find joy in drinking coffee. He started studying how to make more satisfactory coffee, and sold his research data on sleepless brain to Ned. With the money he received in return, he opened his own coffee shop becoming a professional barista.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_40_DESC.text: Unable to do anything but making bubbles, Thalia was branded as a worthless loser at home. Feeling out of place among adults and the friends who had become established members in the community, she mostly spent time alone at a playground near her house. While spending time alone at the playground, she met a little child. The child was crying so sadly, so she made up some bubbles to comfort her. Upon seeing the bubbles, the child stopped crying and smiled so happily. Soon other kids gathered around them out of curiosity and asked her to show them more bubbles. She was at the center of attention. Discovering her worthiness, Thalia felt hopeful for the first time in her life.

TEXT_CHA_WI_5_41_DESC.text: The spirit of Deokpal, who had died an unjust death, sat down the Grim Reaper who came to guide his soul to the afterlife, and implored for three days and nights. The Reaper, although whether moved or annoyed by his cries no one can know for sure, vanished. Deokpal became a wicked Spirit of Darkness and rose from the grave. Blending in with the shadows, he made his way to the magistrate who had ordered his execution. He then began to nag and rant like he had never been free to do in life. The magistrate, plagued for days by terror and shame from the ramblings, wasted away and died. However, even in death he was unable to find peace, as Deokpal raised his spirit from the grave to continue his ranting. The magistrate lost all rationale, and became an evil spirit that did Deokpal’s bidding.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_37_DESC.text: Admiring those burly Nosgardian warriors, Winston stopped wandering Hasla, settled in the area to live with them. So inspired by their strong physical abilities and spirit, Winston did his best to be like them for years. However, he couldn't have a strong body like them because he was born weak by nature. Realizing this fact, he came to devise spells that could transform his body and finally succeeded in making his body look buffy like the warriors. The only problem was that it was only for the looks and without any real physical strength. To research new spells that would actually enhance his strength as well, he resumed wandering all over the lands of Hasla.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_39_DESC.text: Affogato began to like coffee more and more, which he initially regarded as only hot and bitter. Once he accepted the fact that coffee is inseparable from his life, he found peace of mind and began to devote himself to research to brew more satisfying coffee. And when his love for coffee exceeded his love for life, he was finally able to substantiate his delusions.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_40_DESC.text: She hung around only with children every day. But one day, she found no children in the playground when they were supposed to be there. The children were her only friends and hope. Feeling anxious, she started looking for the children before anyone else. Eventually, she found out that the children were kidnapped by thieves. In a rush, she headed for the den of thieves on her own. Once arrived, she sent in many bubbles into the den. The thieves found the bubbles entertaining, not feeling threatened at all. So they approached the bubbles to watch them more closely. Right at that moment, Thalia busted all bubbles to irritate the eyes of the thieves. Now temporarily blinded, the thieves were lost in bewilderment, and the slippery floor made them fall down. During the commotion, Thalia was able to safely evacuate the children and bring them back home. Her tale of heroism eventually spread all over the town, and her parents and neighbors started praising her. They now claimed that her magic training at school was worth every penny. People began to show interest in her bubble magic.

TEXT_CHA_WI_6_41_DESC.text: Deokpal repeated his process of seeking out those who he judged as bad and sinful, and nagging them to the point of becoming evil spirits. Tormented by Deokpal’s unappealing face and his incessant nagging, audible even through covered ears, the citizens of Han began living under a dark cloud of fear. As rumors of Deokpal’s behavior spread, a tiger deity of the mountains, the then head of the patron saints, Taebaek, sought him out. Once he found him, he let loose a torrent of reprimands loud enough to send Deokpal scurrying to the ends of the Earth. They say Gordian, who was planning his conquest of the demon realm, found him there, trembling in a cave. No one knows what the two spoke of, but Deokpal, greatly admiring Gordian’s character, declared himself to be a member of the Elite Four. From then on, the two became like brothers in personal affairs.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_4_03_DESC.text: Flora the Witch's favorite apprentice. A young and gifted witch in training, who is often too serious for her own good... She has joined hands with Guts’ party under her mentor’s order.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_5_03_DESC.text: Flora the Witch's favorite apprentice. A young and gifted witch in training, who is often too serious for her own good... She has joined hands with Guts’ party under her mentor’s order.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_6_03_DESC.text: Flora the Witch's favorite apprentice. A young and gifted witch in training, who is often too serious for her own good... She has joined hands with Guts’ party under her mentor’s order.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_4_GORDIAN_DESC.text:
Gordian’s demonic army was extremely powerful; it had no equal. Settling all conflicts and bringing all opponents to their knees, Gordian was able to unify the land and usher in a reign of peace.
But with peace came indolence. With no reason to fight, the demons grew weak. Even Gordian’s daughter, Vivian, was affected. In fear of losing the prestige that Gordian had worked so hard for, he stepped down from the throne and forced Vivian to take his place - to force her to work. Then, with Jack, Gordian disappeared without a trace. Gordian’s plan was to use his absence as a cause of another civil war amongst the demons. He expected Vivian to take things more seriously if her people tried to overthrow her.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_5_GORDIAN_DESC.text: Not long after he left the castle with his advisor, Jack, Gordian heard the news that Vivian had become the ‘Absolute Devil’ without shedding a single drop of blood. Contrary to what Gordian had believed, the demons who were all weary of fighting gave in to Vivian’s lordship without complaint. Then, to make matters worse, due to a mistake from Jack, they lost all their travel funds. With a groan at the laziness and incompetence of the demons and an attitude of “Que sera, sera,” he turns his back on the demon realm and embarks on a journey through the mortal realm.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_6_GORDIAN_DESC.text: During his travels, Gordian meets a figure who calls herself a ‘consultant.’ Through her, Gordian learns about the world outside of his realm. After hearing and learning about the situation that Hasla is in, Gordian came to firmly believe that the Demon Realm was doomed for. Gordian pondered and began searching for ways to save his people.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_4_NEBULA_DESC.text: Nebula was originally some remnants of the creation of Great Star. Nebula was at first a small concentration of gas with no self-consciousness, but still it could create gods. Manasa, the Dragon King, caught Nebula, which was drifting in the space, and began to research it. Nebula also learned a lot from Manasa and soon began to construct its physical body. Time passed and Nebula became the lord of the world in the name of Duchaga, yet it didn't have any self-consciousness yet. It just concentrated on helping Manasa build a huge city in the dimensional rift. However, Manasa was no longer a smart and spirited being by that time. Abandoning his physical body, Manasa instead took a mechanical body and electronic brain. Nebula showed no response to Manasa's such transformation.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_5_NEBULA_DESC.text: Over time, the city grew into a mega city named Mechatronics and became a mechanized fortress. Manasa talked about the existence of other Dragon Kings and the importance of winning the endless war against them. Nebula couldn't understand the importance of such war, but prepared for the war regardless. The war broke out and, as the result of losing the war, they were exiled into an outer rim dimension. Nebula returned to a concentration of gas, its original form, and was locked under rocks. Nebula didn't have any qualms about its fate, but over the years, a desire grew inside it. Nebula wanted to see and feel Manasa again.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_NEBULA_DESC.text: When someone’s heart began beating again, Nebula was freed from its rocky prison. Without hesitation, Nebula began to track the traces of Manasa and soon found Djura, a fraction of Manasa in the form of a humanoid corpuscle. Nebula was happy to see Djura again and touched it without hesitation, but didn't know what to say. For better or worse, Djura stumbled and they were thrown away to somewhere in Hasla. Nebula and Djura ended up in Edenburg, the capital of the Neth Empire. Nebula waited for Djura to restart itself, as it was turned off due to the effect of space jump. Nebula wanted to see Djura regain consciousness, but at the same time, it was afraid of the event. Nebula was now self-conscious enough to know the emotion of happiness and shyness. Overwhelmed by such emotional experience, Nebula ran away from the scene without knowing why.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_NEBULA_NAME.text: Nebula the Giver of the First Breath

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_4_LIVEA_DESC.text: Opening her eyes in the middle of the pitch-black darkness, Livea had nary an inkling of fear in her heart. Livea, the ruler of fate who brought death to its knees, the great master of the void. Darkness and solitude were not only familiar to her; they were also testaments to her achievements. Incredulous from her awakening and about to close her eyes once more, Livea woke back up from a perplexing sense of cold and hunger. The senses of skin and flesh, abandoned as she became a being of the void, felt again? In her confusion, she unconsciously touched the wall to realize that she is in a cave instead of her familiar void rift, and began to wander aimlessly on the appendages presumed to be arms and legs.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_4_MAMMON_DESC.text: One day, an unknown businesswoman by the name of Mammon appeared in Devil Island. She opened Devil Island’s largest resort in the downtown. The resort featured a hotel, performances, a casino, and restaurants, which were enough to capture the hearts of people. ‘Casino of Lust’ was the most eye-catching of all. Using the slogan ‘One sexy shot to turn your life around’, Mammon planted a dream of success and money in the minds of people, who came from all corners of Devil Island in hopes of becoming the lucky winner. Her business was a jackpot indeed.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_5_LIVEA_DESC.text: How long has she walked? With the unfamiliar sense of fatigue weighing down her body, Livea heard someone weeping across the darkness and froze. Not knowing how weaker she has become, she wondered if she had to turn back and run, but she soon remembered her status as the great ruler and was filled with anger. When she got herself together and ready to bellow at the being across the darkness, light poured in out of nowhere and engulfed them. Her surroundings suddenly brightened, and she fainted from shock and awe when she saw Lacrimoso's blue face that was closer to her than she thought.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_5_MAMMON_DESC.text: She invited the millionaires of Devil Island and offered complimentary performances, lodging service, and drinks. The wealthy, who needed entertainment in their monotonous life, gladly accepted her invitation and enjoyed a frantic time, eating, drinking, and having fun. The common people, on the other hand, became more and more anxious to get their hands on a big fortune when they saw the wealthy squandering money in front of their eyes, and went all-in with everything they had. In the meantime, Mammon started a mortgage loan service for those who lost all their stakes, and people put up as collateral Ogrenology's new products, royal farmland, and dairy ranch, making their last bet with the money borrowed from Mammon. This allowed Mammon to expand her business by attracting more tangible assets.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_6_LIVEA_DESC.text: Waking up on her bed, Livea locked eyes with Lacrimoso taking care of her. Unable to bear the sunlight and the others' looks for the first time in millennia, Livea ran away from him. Or, she tried to. Livea leaped from the bed only to fall face-down on the floor and could not get back up in embarrassment. As if he had not noticed such an unbecoming sight, Lacrimoso told her that they are now in the nation of Valencia under King Ferdinand's protection. Livea could not comprehend his bright, grateful smile. Weakened as they may be, he would deign to smile over the indignity of being helped by an usurper of the throne. Just like he was before. That Anavatapta... Anavatapta? Unfamiliar face but familiar name. Realizing that she was acquainted with the being before her yet has no whole memory of it. Livea once again felt fear. Her powers had to be recovered as soon as possible. For her to be herself again. For that, she needed complete darkness nearly close to the void. Livea got on her feet, left the room, and ran off as fast as she could. Toward that tall, ominous tower over the grassland plain.

TEXT_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_6_MAMMON_DESC.text: One day, 'Iris' came to visit Mammon's resort. Mammon approached the new guest Iris, who seemed rather lost in an unfamiliar place. Offering her a drink, she started a conversation. Quite buzzed, Iris told Mammon that she came looking for Arche, who ran with her money, and asked Mammon if she had ever heard of the name. ‘I’m not sure,’ Mammon offered Iris a drink instead of a clear answer. Iris, now relaxed and drunk after sipping on the series of drinks Mammon offered, fell into a deep sleep. Mammon whispered something into Iris’s ear and disappeared into the noise of the casino with a small smile.

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_4_PRYDWEN_DESC.text: Long ago, a wandering mage’s cat was turned human when it was caught in an accident during a magic experiment. The mage panicked at first, but quickly took advantage of the situation and made her his servant, as he was actually in need of someone to run errands for him. He named the tattered girl, ‘Prydwen.’ However, Prydwen’s soul was still that of a cat. Rather than doing chores, her curiosity got the better of her, and she ended up destroying several pieces of lab equipment and jeopardized multiple experiments.

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_4_YAMA_DESC.text: One of the Ten Kings of Hell, Yama is the judge of the Underworld. He is also the leader of the Death Angels of the East, such as Korin. Or so Korin thinks. In fact, Yama is the ancient guardian deity Chantico, who protects the Primal Volcano where all of Hasla’s mortal souls end up after death, by guiding them in different forms, as Judge Thanatos of the Death Angels of the West or as Quaxolotl, the God of Death and Ashes, worshiped by the Coatl tribe.

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_5_PRYDWEN_DESC.text: One day, when the mage was out on an errand, Prydwen mixed various magical substances that were left out on the counter. In just a few seconds, half of the lab was blown away in a fiery explosion. Prydwen sustained a severe injury on one of her eyes from this incident; nevertheless, it sparked a flame inside her heart. “I created such a big explosion, despite being such a small and frail human!” When the mage returned home, he was in shock. He quickly tended to Prydwen’s wounds and got rid of all the dangerous substances. But Prydwen had hidden away some of them, and she began studying explosive magic in secret. As time passed, Prydwen was able to master the art of explosive magic that she so much adored. She then left on a journey to further hone her craft and test the limits of her magic.

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_5_YAMA_DESC.text: Chantico intervened in the lives of humans more actively than any other ancient guardian deities. Chantico, the controller of Primal Flames, was responsible for making sure the impure energy remaining in human souls did not reach Hasla’s heart. After all, a less chaotic world meant less work for her. But the weakness of humans was beyond one’s imagination. Even Chantico’s ‘successors,’ whom she approved and entrusted with the Legend of Primal Flames, had long been fallen and corrupted after misusing their power. Having given up any hope in humans, Chantico cut off communications with all except Death Angels responsible for guiding the dead, and fell again into a deep sleep, deep inside the Primal Volcano. After hundreds of years pass by, Chantico was woken up by a sense of something unusual.

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_PRYDWEN_DESC.text: Prydwen traveled to various areas of conflict in Hasla and sold her hand-crafted bombs to the soldiers at war. Eventually, her bombs ended up taking out an entire platoon of soldiers in explosive fashion. In no time, a huge bounty was placed on Prydwen’s head. “I let them see such a marvelous explosion, and this is how they repay me?” Utterly confused and in fear of being captured, Prydwen began running for her life. But just when she was about to make it to safety, she ended up bumping into a group of elite Grancia soldiers who were returning from their patrol. Tied and muffled, the soldiers carried Prydwen back to the palace and presented her to Emperor Alexander. But instead of passing judgment, the emperor began laughing uncontrollably when he heard Prydwen’s story. Then, after pardoning her, Alexander titled her the ‘Palace Mage’ of Grancia despite the disapproval of his followers. Now with money and fame to support her passion for magic, Prydwen went on a rampage collecting and testing various magical entities. However, it didn’t take long before Prydwen began noticing the glares she received from the noblemen of the palace, not to mention the discrimination that existed towards beast-people. To recover her confidence and to prove her mettle to the people, Prydwen locked herself in her lab to create a truly magnificent explosion, a type that the world has never seen. Years have gone by, and even Alexander began forgetting about her existence...

TEXT_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_YAMA_DESC.text: Waking up from a long sleep, Chantico panicked as she realized the boundary of the living and the dead had been collapsed in the three nations of the East. The energy of the land was greatly disturbed unleashing the Legend of Primal Flames in an uncontrolled state. Her ‘master’ was nowhere to be found. Even other ancient guardian deities went missing. Chantico gathered Death Angels and heard about what happen in Hasla. Chantico, after learning about the Crusader who had saved Hasla, transformed into Yama and gave orders to Korin to follow the will of her master, who went missing. She command Korin to bring her master back to the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_COMMON_ALEXANDER_STONE_1_DESC.text: A log detailing the “Legendary Sea” that Alexander dreamt of visiting when he was a child. After he was crowned emperor, Alexander actually went on an expedition to see it for himself. Although the Legendary Sea turned out to be just an ordinary sea, Alexander still cherishes the log.

TEXT_COMMON_ARART_STONE_1_DESC.text: The flesh of the Goddess of Judgment, Arart. During her lonely quest of vanquishing sin and darkness from the world, Arart’s purity was tainted by evil, and she was torn apart as a result. With that said, you can still feel her powerful, stout will from this sigil.

TEXT_COMMON_GWEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A physical training guide book for adults. Maybe the author expected his readers to have read the kid’s version of the book beforehand, as there are less pictures and a lot more text. Well, as a result, the book barely made any sales.

TEXT_COMMON_JOANOFARC_STONE_1_DESC.text: A teabag for drinking tea during travels. There’s nothing really special about it in terms of taste and class. The nobles of Grancia will never drink such an ordinary tea. But it’s exceptionally popular amongst the Steel Knights as they appreciate simplicity and affordable prices.

TEXT_COMMON_LAPORTE_STONE_1_DESC.text: An empty can that once contained food for animals. Every guardian beast, regardless of size and age, wag their tail in excitement when they hear the pop of a can opening.

TEXT_COMMON_LEONSIGRUNA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Bark that has been marinated in the highest-quality acacia honey. It is made from the barks of oak and elm trees raised by an elf artisan. No matter how you look at it, it doesn’t look very delicious... but strangely, it apparently has a lot of demand.

TEXT_COMMON_PRYDWEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A book of more than 2,000 pages detailing the reasons why explosions are at the pinnacle of artistry and how fascinating they are. Prydwen paid big money to print more than 10,000 copies of this book. Only 2 copies were sold.

TEXT_COMMON_ROBINHOOD_STONE_1_DESC.text: A seal held by a small number of nobles in Impelis. Only the nobles appointed by Emperor Alexander carry this seal; thus they’re still seen as ‘commoners’ to the noblemen who have had a long line of noble heritage. However, these nobles who were once commoners receive direct orders from the emperor himself, so their impact on the nation far exceeds the more traditional nobles.

TEXT_COMMON_ROLLANDMARIA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A physical training guide book for kids. Every step of exercise in the book is drawn in detail. It’s the perfect book for people who just began working out. Long ago, Roland received this book as a gift from Maria. Roland must’ve prized this book and read it often as the book is in tatters.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_ATK_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: An orb that contains the embers of hellfire. Hellfire burns the guilty who came to Hell. This fire cannot be put out.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_ATK_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: Remains of boiling magma erupted from the deep inside the Primal Volcano. It is sought after by collectors as these rocks contain rare metals sometimes.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: Feathers used to decorate participants in a shamanic ritual of the Woopa and Coatl tribes. More powerful shamans are, more flamboyant their feathers are.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_SP_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: A talisman used to neutralize the spirits who refuse to follow the grim reaper. The spell infused in the talisman makes spirits more docile.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: A research log written by an unknown person. Some of its pages are torn off and the remaining pages are burnt so its content cannot be discerned.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: A piece of stalactite slowly formed on the ceilings of a deep cave somewhere inside the Primal Volcano. This rock has a characteristic similar to the growth rings of a tree, so anyone can guess the age of this rock.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: An urn that feels cold when touched. They say that this urn is used to contain incorporeal beings. When one puts their ear to the urn, they could hear someone's voice.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_SP_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: The Coatl tribesmen use this jug when they go deep into the caves of the volcano. The jug contains refreshing water that quench thirst when going through hot areas.

TEXT_COMMON_TECTUS_STONE_1_DESC.text: A part of the Guardian Golem, Tectus’ armor. When the armor is fueled by enough mana, the wearer becomes as stout as an iron wall.

TEXT_COMMON_THEGATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: A popular kit for practical use in war. These high-quality kits are produced by the Saintess of the Battlefield and are issued to the soldiers of Grancia. Caeneus didn’t want to use the kit he received from Victoria, so he endured all injuries without using the kit even during the most gravest of situations.

TEXT_COMMON_VICTORIA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Black tea extract from expensive tea leaves. It almost looks evil due to its blackish appearance. But once mixed in hot water, a sweet aroma arises from it. Even during the midst of war, taking a tea break can boost your spirit... but it comes with a risk of the enemy finding your location due to its strong aroma.

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_VOLCANOCORE_DESC.text: The Primal Volcano is pulsating with the unstable power of Red Lotus. Go into the core of the volcano and stabilize the power of Red Lotus.

TEXT_EPIC_ALEXANDER_STONE_1_DESC.text: A golden stamp held by the Emperor of the Grancia Empire. It has various unique engravings on it, so that the authority can better distinguish it from the counterfeits. The seal also has magical properties that protect the document it stamps.

TEXT_EPIC_ALEXANDER_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: Tracks left by Emperor Alexander’s powerful steps. Soldiers gain courage and the fighting will upon seeing such a powerful man leading the troops.

TEXT_EPIC_ARART_STONE_1_DESC.text: An artifact harboring the authoritative powers of Arart, the Goddess of Judgment. This artifact is able to distinguish lies and measures the sins of all living things. However, the artifact is ruthless in its judgment; how can it be useful if it considers even ‘living’ itself a sin? Arart chose to keep one of her eyes closed.

TEXT_EPIC_ARART_STONE_2_DESC.text: A crystallized form of pure malice that was purified by the power of the Goddesses. It now holds holy properties that harm those who are evil.

TEXT_EPIC_GWEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A crest carried by the meisters of the ‘Lion Knights.’ The hierarchy system of the Lion Knights is entirely based on the combat skills of individuals. Only a very select few are bestowed with this crest. The number of meisters dropped significantly from the War of the Holy City.

TEXT_EPIC_GWEN_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: Fragment of a Lion Knight meister’s armor found at the Abandoned Palace in Trista. Lion Captain Gwen is willing to spend big money to recover the various remains of the Lion Knights spread throughout Hasla.

TEXT_EPIC_JOANOFARC_STONE_1_DESC.text: A token carried by the captain of Grancia’s ‘Steel Knights.’ This token is crafted with the finest steel so that it can be melted during an emergency to forge a blade. Those who hold this token can present it at various commercial businesses in Impelis including: restaurants, coffee shops, book stores, and workshops for a 10% discount.

TEXT_EPIC_JOANOFARC_STONE_2_DESC.text: A rose that was cross-bred by a dame from the Steel Knights with a hobby for gardening. She was inspired to do so by captain Joan of Arc’s beautiful violet hair. The dame took pride in her work, as the rose was bred naturally with no use of magic.

TEXT_EPIC_LAPORTE_STONE_1_DESC.text: A fang from the guardian beast Laporte. It’s thick and sharp, sturdy enough to pierce armor. But its shape suggests that this is a baby tooth. How powerful Laporte will become when fully mature is a mystery.

TEXT_EPIC_LAPORTE_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: The mane from the Guardian Beast Laporte. The fur is warm - almost like a dog’s - despite its tough-looking appearance.

TEXT_EPIC_LEONSIGRUNA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The core of ‘Crystal Blade Danan,’ which is considered the symbol of the legendary hero, Oren. Long ago, it was shattered into countless shards. It lost its purpose as a blade, but it still radiates an aura that sows courage in its wielder’s heart.

TEXT_EPIC_LEONSIGRUNA_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: An arrow shot by Sigruna, a member of the Chrona Heroes. Sigruna always tries to not harm anyone. As such, this arrow is also in perfect condition.

TEXT_EPIC_PRYDWEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: The epitome of Prydwen’s explosive ‘art.’ It is an essential device for methodically controlling explosions, as Prydwen herself put it. However, when the scientists from Pumpkin City and Neth Empire investigated this device, they found nothing but melon soda inside.

TEXT_EPIC_PRYDWEN_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: An eye patch that Prydwen used to wear. When she first acquired these patches, Prydwen frantically warned everyone to never remove it from her, as the eye patch kept her, quote on quote, “extremely powerful and explosive magic” from rampaging and destroying the entire empire. But when it was removed, nothing of that sort happened. Only thing that came out of it was a tan line of an eye patch on Prydwen’s face.

TEXT_EPIC_ROBINHOOD_STONE_1_DESC.text: A list of assassination targets that Robin Hood, the captain of the ‘Green Apples’, accidentally dropped. It is written in code, so at a glance, it looks like an ordinary shopping list. “Potato x1, Onion x2, Carrot x1, Pork 200g...” Today’s menu must be curry.

TEXT_EPIC_ROBINHOOD_STONE_2_DESC.text: A model of an apple that has been used traditionally by the ‘Green Apples’ for archery practice. It is covered in specially-made wax; if you don’t hit it dead-center, the arrow will simply deflect off the side of the apple.

TEXT_EPIC_ROLLANDMARIA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A lump of energy that embodies the prayers of Saintess Maria. It radiates light that calms those who follow the Order of the Goddess. It’s sometimes given as a prize for singing contests during Sunday prayer meetings.

TEXT_EPIC_ROLLANDMARIA_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: A part of the goddess statue that Saintess Maria used to pray to. This sigil has holy properties that protects its holder from evil.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: Orb of Yama that contains the powers of Red Lotus. It is said that anyone who stares at the mysterious red glow of this orb would see the flitting images of their past.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fragment came off of Chantico's armor. The fragment is still hot, as it contains the heat from Chantico's smoldering breath. This item should be handled with care because it's hot enough to burn careless hands that touch it.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: A head dress found in a place where the Festival of the Dead was hosted. It is said that whoever wears this head dress would hear an incomprehensible chaotic voice. If anyone could discern the voice, they would know that it is actually someone's prophecy.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_SP_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: The flaming flower that appears in the legends of the Woopa and Coatl tribes. Legends tell that the goddess of Hasla picked off this flower and gave it to ancient humans who hadn't yet discovered fire.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: The dragon scale that came off of Chantico. It glows menacingly red. They say that any wound caused by this scale would not be healed. It is thought to be fell off when Chantico shed its skin.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: A lump of rock found in the core of the Primal Volcano. From inside the rock still oozes hot lava. This rock pulsates in red as if it is the heart of a living creature.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: A fragment of a tablet containing the records of a civilization that previously existed. The text is written in a language long forgotten and some claim that it contains a forbidden spell.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_SP_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: This golden skin is created when the shed skin of a lava bug is overly heated. Although this fell off the bug, it still glows in red with heat. More precious than gold, but only a few who witnessed this survived to tell others about it.

TEXT_EPIC_TECTUS_STONE_1_DESC.text: A Tectus’ mana core that is manufactured in Pumpkin City. It functions like a battery. Although the core is only for single-use and is unsuitable for mass production, it is constantly manufactured and provided for free as an ‘offering’ to guarantee Pumpkin City’s independence.

TEXT_EPIC_TECTUS_STONE_2_SET_DESC.text: A wing from the Guardian Golem Tectus. It’s made from floating stones that are found in the wastelands. Even if you let go of it, it stays afloat in air for a while.

TEXT_EPIC_THEGATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: A token carried by the captain of Grancia’s ‘Cobalt Knights.’ This token is crafted with some of the heaviest materials, as if to show that not anyone can carry the burden of a captain’s responsibility. Those who hold this token can present it at various commercial businesses in Impelis including: restaurants, coffee shops, book stores, and workshops for a 10% discount.

TEXT_EPIC_THEGATE_STONE_2_DESC.text: The remains of the Impelis gate. There are hints that suggest the gate was destroyed by an extremely powerful force. However, the investigation on the materials used for building the gate suggests that there is corruption within the Grancia’s military.

TEXT_EPIC_VICTORIA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A token carried by the captain of Grancia’s ‘Central Knights.’ Despite its simple look, it’s actually crafted from very valuable materials, fitting for a knight that is responsible for protecting Impelis. TEXT_FISH_AUTOFISHING_DESC.text:
1. Leave behind your fishing rod and come back after a certain amount of time to collect fish.
2. During Auto Fishing, you have a higher chance of acquiring items other than fish.
3. Auto Fishing automatically ends when you run out of Bait.
4. You can stop Auto Fishing any time you choose.
5. During Auto Fishing, you can move to your device’s home screen. The app will continue to run Auto Fishing in the background.
6. Once the app is minimized and running in the background, Auto Fishing will continue to fish for up to 100 times.
7. Once you reopen the application and exit background mode, the 100 count will refresh.
8. If the application is forcefully closed during background Auto Fishing, you won’t be able to claim your rewards.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_JANGPO_SKILL_DESC.text:
Taoist Mask protects his right to consume mint chocolate with three colors:
Red: Pierces through the enemies who undermine the right to eat mint chocolate with a spear according to the number of chains.
Blue: Teaches the people who do not appreciate the taste of mint chocolate according to the number of chains.
Yellow: Slices and dices mint chocolate haters to purge their unholiness when using his 3-chain skill.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_JANGPO_STORY.text:
Zhang Bao does not understand people with dull palate who hate the taste of mint chocolate.
And he doesn't understand people who pour the sauce on sweet and sour pork. 
And of course, he doesn’t approve people who do not sprinkle lemon nectar on fried chicken.
However, the biggest mystery for him is why some people cook bacon as crisp as crackers.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_MASK_SKILL_DESC.text:
Taoist Mask shows the power of air force with three colors:
Red: Attacks enemies with beams, helped by masked soldiers according to the number of chains.
Blue: Uses the Curse of Mask regardless of the number of chains.
Yellow: Avoids attacks by jumping higher than normal when using his 3-chain skill.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_MASK_STORY.text:
Taoist Mask is a lone survivor of an atrocity committed by a group of Heroes and he learned the importance of air force.
Taoist Mask now calls himself as... 
the Top Gun.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_35.text: If I don’t do something, the world of cats will never come!

I don't like this. This doll is too cute.
 I need to fix it somehow.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_35.text: I shall fight until the end for the world of cats!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_4_.text: I suppose you can borrow my shoulders. This was not my intention, but...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_6_.text: If it cannot be cut, it can still be hoisted.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_RB_4_RU.text: I will become a Huntress to restore peace!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_RB_5_NO.text: So tingly, and I love it! Let's get it on!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_34.text:

I can now join the hunt with others!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_37.text: I'm Uzume, the queen of the hill.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_39.text: I want to go to Neth. It looks fun there.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_40.text:

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_37.text:
One day, I will become an all-rounder idol

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_39.text: This energy drink really helps dealing with fatigue!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_40.text:

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_34.text:
Oops, it's too bright!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_37.text: I want to be recognized for my singing, not my dancing!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_39.text: I want to play all I want! I want to sleep all I want!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_40.text:

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_5_.text: Words are worthless! I dare you to break through!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_6_.text: Such blade! Such skills! I must see more to come!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_.text: Huhuhu... Beautiful. Just like the stars.

My world falls apart whenever I see you...
And it’s falling apart even as I speak.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ENT_4_E.text:

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ENT_5_E.text: Kek... just kill me! How could I lose to a devil?!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ENT_6_E.text: I don’t want to say mean things to Vivian anymore... but... as an elf... ugh! Why did I start this!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RB_4_YA.text: I will smash anyone who tries to mess with my sister!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RB_5_PY.text: You don't have to be strong to be a leader.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RB_5_YA.text: Why don't we try to talk this out first?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_RB_6_PY.text: It's not time for you to die yet. Well, I'll be back.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_41.text: It doesn’t matter when, from where, or what you order, from day-to-day items to missiles, deliveries guaranteed within 3 minutes!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_AUCTION.text: I was once the head of the Sect of Tian Mo... A true martial art master that has perfected his craft...! Why was I reincarnated as a girl?!
Pft♡ You can’t feel my presence despite being a seasoned fighter. Hilarious.♡ The adults of this realm are all losers♡... Augh! Why am I talking like this?!
You losers don’t even know how to channel your inner spirit?♡ Come follow me handsome.♡ I’m hungry, so bring some bombs!♡

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_4_.text: I want to take the most familiar weapon to the battlefield.
Swords before words it is. Reminds me of you when we first met.
Let us just say I hold a grudge against the five of the Godhand!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_5_.text: Been a while since I last slayed 100 men... No, 100 monsters?
Looks like I am free now.
Retreat not, for the sword of yours will do.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_6_.text: I never thought I would need friends once again...
I never turn my back to my dream. That is all.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_.text: I will protect you until the day I die.

If I were to return to the vast sea of stars...
 I must make a decision.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_4_0.text: We have a lot to talk about.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_5_0.text: Family. Only coming around when they need something.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB2_6_0.text: The weak die, the strong live. Those are the rules.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_4_BL.text: Blake Belladonna. That's my name. You should remember it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_4_WE.text: No more strange nicknames like Ice Queen.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_5_BL.text: Faunus are intellectual beings, too. You must not resort to violence for everything.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_5_WE.text: Don't settle for this. You can grow even stronger.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_6_BL.text: I'll show them what I can do.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_RB_6_WE.text: There's room for improvement because we're not perfect.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_4.text: Don't even bother with your confessions of love...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_5.text:
I am getting butterflies in my stomach... 
for the first time... in 110 years... Could this be... Love...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_6.text:
So why am I not telling you how old I am? 
That☆ is a secret, hiya-!☆ (* ˊ-ˋ)/~* +☆˚♬

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_37.text:
I aced the test again...
Studying is hardly a challenge for me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_39.text: Too early to die, too late to sleep.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_40.text:
Whoa, look at this...
 Bubble bubble, wohoo... How pretty are they!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_41.text: Hrrmph, tsk tsk... you young whippersnappers these days have no respect! How dare you look me right in the eyes and go on about contract this and business that? Hm!? Avert your gaze!! Why, I oughta just suck your eyeballs right out of your head...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_37.text: Whoa... How wild and strong they are... I can feel their raw power.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_39.text: One coffee bean, one spoon of sugar, and one plate of fatigue.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_40.text:
I... I'm not a weirdo...
 I just happen to like bubbles...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_41.text: Back in my day, handling this work in this way was unacceptable. I understand you’re young and probably don’t know anything, but this is not how you operate and run an organization. It’s not as easy as it looks. I’m telling you all this to help you out, so don’t get all snowflake-y on me. You see, a leader is supposed to...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_37.text:
Well, if I can't have a body like that,
I can create one up with my spell.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_39.text: I have no choice but to enjoy the scent of coffee since I can’t escape from it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_40.text:
Hehe... I'll make bigger
bubbles for you!
 Huff ..oO

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_41.text: Our Great King Gordian was a fine man indeed. There is no one like him. But... his insolent daughter, always running around, playing with her younger sister. Gordian had poor luck in the offspring department, I suppose... With the demon realm in the state that it is, I don’t know what she plans to do. And whenever I try to give her advice, she huffs and puffs and rolls her eyes, and I can’t even give her a good spanking. Whew...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_4_.text: My name is Schierke, a witch-in-training.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_5_.text: I must stay on my toes...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_6_.text: A sorcerer builds a temple in her mind.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_4_G.text: Vivian, take the throne and change the Demon Realm for the better.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_5_G.text: The Demon Realm has fallen from glory.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_6_G.text: Is our realm truly doomed for?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_4.text: I don't see a lack of self-consciousness as a problem. Why is that a sad thing? I don't understand.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_6.text: Glad to see me? Long time no see. Missed me? ... I can’t decide my greeting line.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_4.text: Wait, what is this soft body? It's going to break at the slightest application of strength!

Jackpot!
Are you the lucky winner?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_5.text: I hate whining. So stop right now, or face severe punishment.

I guess no one realizes that...
only the ‘owner of the casino’ is the one who always wins.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_6.text: The ruler must stay dignified, always and everywhere. So… Hey, do not come any closer with your tears!

Iris, still gullible as ever?
The Arche you're looking for is right before your eyes.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_4_YAMA.text: Today’s meeting schedule... Grim Reaper first, and then Korin and Anubisis? How boring...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_5_PRYDWE.text: I will show you an explosion you’ve never seen before!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_5_YAMA.text: Humans are always causing such an inconvenience. They feel no shame for undermining their own value? I’d rather sleep than get more of this nonsense.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_PRYDWE.text: Nyah... I need something bigger... much, much bigger...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_YAMA.text: What happened here while I was asleep? I shall have all the details.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_TEXT_CHA_PR_LIMITED_DM.text: I believe that the Composer saved me.

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_04.text: Congratulations! Yichui evolved into a giant rabbit!

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_05.text: What's going on! Yichui, can we have the room?

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_07.text: I never knew this kind of bug existed.

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_09.text: Nothing is more important than power!!!

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_10.text: I didn’t expect this to work...

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_11.text: Why... Why is all of this real...?

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_12.text: Where has everyone gone?... Argh! What in the world is this?!!

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_13.text: Are you all excited to see my huge and beautiful balloon?

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_14.text: Well, then... I have no choice but to burn my bridges...!

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_15.text: How dare you bring Fleck... You're going to kill everyone!!!

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_16.text: You'd better fix it before the end of the day unless you want to get hurt.

TEXT_GIANT_LOBBY_18.text: With great power... comes great responsibility...

TEXT_HELP_10213_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You can manage or view weapons, rings, and accessories.
2. You can equip gear for heroes.

TEXT_HELP_20110_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Trade Hero allows you to send 3 Heroes of Inheritance Level 30 or higher to acquire a random 4★ Hero.
2. You can only send Contract Heroes, Limited Heroes, and Otherworld Heroes as Material Heroes. 
3. Heroes acquired are Contract Heroes, and you have a low chance to acquire Trade-Only Heroes.
4. You must select a Trade-Only Hero before trading a Hero, and the number of Ceilings is bound to the Trade-Only Hero whom you selected for the hero trade.
5. Heroes selected as Material will not appear when a new Hero is acquired.
6. When using heroes of inheritance level 30 or higher as Material Heroes, you get back Ancient Books equivalent to the exceeding inheritance levels.

TEXT_HELP_20201_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Heroes can eat bread and train to reach the next training stage.
 2. Heroes require gold and bread to train.
 3. A Hero can eat up to 6 pieces of bread at once for training. On ‘Great Success!’, the training amount is increased by 150%.
 4. The required training amount varies depending on the training stage of the Hero.
 5. When you select the bread you want to feed the hero, the green gauge represents the training amount.
 6. The total training amount required for promotion depends on the star-rank of the hero. Once a hero reaches max training, they can be promoted to the next star-rank. (Up to 6 stars)
 7. Bread can be obtained from the bakery, scenario, dungeons, event, shop, and quests.

TEXT_HELP_20203_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. ★6 heroes can eat berries to acquire bonus stats.
 2. The type and amount of berries that a hero can eat will vary depending on the hero.
 3. You need gold to feed berries to a hero.
 4. A Hero can eat up to 6 berries at once. On ‘Great Success!’, the stat bonus is increased by 150%
 5. The berry progression is shown as a percentage (%) on the growth page.
 6. The color of the hero training stage text in the hero list will change depending on the hero’s berry progression.
 7. A hero that reaches MAX training and MAX berries will have an ‘orange’ colored training stage text.
 8. Berries can be obtained from the garden, scenarios, shop, and quests.

TEXT_HELP_20204_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. ★6 heroes who have MAX training can read pages or books of inheritance to increase their inheritance level.
 2. Books/Pages of Inheritance are required to raise a hero’s inheritance level.
 3. The stats boosted by inheritance depends on the inheritance level.
 4. Once a hero begins reading inheritance books/pages, their level will change to inheritance level.
 5. Inheritance Level is displayed as purple text.
 6. Pages/Books of Inheritance can be obtained from challenges, events, shop, and quests.

TEXT_HELP_30401_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Raid is a content in which two Captains can work together to bring down a powerful foe.
2. Raid can also be played alone.
3. “Fast Battle” becomes available for Raids that have been completed at least once.
4. Meat is consumed upon entry.
5. Each Raid has stages. Bosses in the later stages are more powerful, and they yield greater rewards.

TEXT_HELP_30505_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Leave behind your fishing rod and come back after a certain amount of time to collect fish.
2. During Auto Fishing, you have a higher chance of acquiring items other than fish.
3. Auto Fishing automatically ends when you run out of Bait.
4. You can stop Auto Fishing any time you choose.
5. Big Fish Chance of equipment gives you a higher chance of catching big fish.
6. During Auto Fishing, you can move to your device’s home screen. The app will continue to run Auto Fishing in the background.
7. Once the app is minimized and running in the background, Auto Fishing will continue to fish for up to 100 times.
8. Once you reopen the application and exit background mode, the 100 count will refresh.

TEXT_HELP_30506_DESC.text:
1. You can exchange Fish Coins that you’ve acquired at the shop for various items.
2. Depending on the item, the purchase limits are reset either daily or weekly.
3. Some items’ purchase limits cannot be reset.

TEXT_HELP_ACCESSORY_01_DESC.text:
1. Accessories are given as rewards for playing or participating in the Total War. 
2. Accessories can only be worn by ★6 warriors.
3. Accessories are separately worn as necklace and earrings.        
4. The grade of accessories is one of the following: ★4, ★5, or ★6.        
5. All accessories have at least 1 basic option and 2-4 additional options can be added.        
- ★4: 1 basic option + up to 1 variable option        
- ★5: 1 basic option + up to 2 variable options        
- ★6: 1 basic option + up to 3 variable options        
6. The options of all accessories are randomly chosen within a certain range.        
7. To see the details on the available options, check the Accessory Info.        
8. All options except basic option can be converted.        
9. The basic and variable options default to Petty-grade values when acquired for the first time.        
10. The option stats are raised by enhancing accessories.

TEXT_HELP_ACCESSORY_02_DESC.text:
1. Convert Accessory is a function that changes accessory options.
2. Antimatter is required to convert accessories.
3. Antimatter can be acquired by extracting accessories.
4. Accessories can be converted up to 5 times regardless of the grade.
5. You can use antimatter to reset the accessory conversion count.
6. Converting an accessory affects all variable options.
7. You can lock any variable options to keep them.
8. Basic options cannot be converted.

TEXT_HELP_ACCESSORY_03_DESC.text:
1. Enhance Accessory is a function that enhances accessory stats.
2. Enhancing accessories requires Gold.
3. You can spend Jewelry or Antimatter to raise the success rate.
4. Enhancement can succeed or fail based on the success rate.
5. Total enhancement points are accumulated whenever enhancement fails.
6. When the total enhancement points reach the limit, the next enhancement is guaranteed to succeed.
7. A random option out of all available options will be enhanced upon successful enhancement of the accessory.
8. You can use Auto-Enhance Accessory.

TEXT_HELP_BOSSRUSH_DESC.text:
[Basic Info]
1. During Ordeal, you can receive rewards based on your rank after defeating the boss.
2. Once open, Ordeal becomes available for 1 week. Once it’s over, and after a day of a ‘Calculating Period,’ Ordeal will become available again after 3 weeks.
3. Captains can participate in Ordeal up to 4 times a day. Even if you fail to clear the level, it will count as an entry. 
4. Practice mode has no entry limits. However, your score will not be saved, and you won’t be able to challenge higher levels.
5. If you defeat the boss of a level, you will be able to challenge the level of a higher difficulty.
6. The boss’s stats increase with difficulty. Certain difficulties carry effects that are harmful to your heroes.
7. The type of boss and the effects they carry are different for each Ordeal.

[Rank]
1. You are given a rank based on your score/performance during Ordeal.
2. Your score is based on the difficulty of the level you clear.
3. You are given 3 team slots during Ordeal. The sum of the scores of the 3 teams is used to grade your rank.
4. When you form a team in a slot and start the level, that slot will become locked. You will not be able to change the assigned Heroes, Goddesses, and Champions once locked.
5. Heroes who are locked into a slot cannot be used for any other slots. They will not be assignable to other teams even if you have multiples of the same heroes.
6. You can reset a team slot that has a registered score. Once reset, the team will no longer be locked in. However, that team’s acquired score and rank registration will be reset as well. (Cleared level/difficulty will remain)
7. Captains with the same score will be placed in the same rank. They will receive the same rank reward.

[Reward]
1. Once the Ordeal Period is over, you will not be able to enter again until the next Ordeal Period.
2. Once the Ordeal Period ends, a day of ‘Calculating Period’ will take place.
3. Once the Calculating Period is over, and until the next Ordeal Period, you can enter the Ordeal Lobby to acquire Ordeal Tokens. (The number of tokens you obtain is based on your rank)
4. You can spend Ordeal Tokens at the Ordeal Shop to exchange them for various rewards.

[Hall of Fame]
1. The Captain with the highest score at the end of Ordeal is registered at the Hall of Fame.
2. If there are multiple captains with the same score, the Captain who has the fastest clear time will be selected for the Hall of Fame.

TEXT_HELP_BOSSSOULRUSHEVENT.text:
[Basic Info]
1. The number of times the player can enter the Fortress of Ordeal resets at 17:00 PT every day. This number is equal to the number of stages the player can currently play.
2. Heroes of the same type cannot be used.
3. The Hero used to clear a stage is bound to that stage and cannot be used for a different stage.
4. A Hero who is bound to a stage can continuously be used for that stage.
5. If the player clears a stage using a new Hero, the Hero previously bound to that stage will be replaced with the new one.
6. The player can freely use any Hero in Practice mode and does not have to pay the entrance fee, but no reward is given for clearing a stage.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_LUCKYSHOP.text:
1. Mammon’s Lucky Shop is divided into three categories: [Shop], [Prize], and [Benefit].
2. At [Shop], you can spend Currency to buy the rewards you want. The prizes have the daily purchase limit, and the limit will be reset everyday at 17:00 PM PT.
3. The items sold at [Shop] are either 'Daily Products’ or ‘Random Products.’
      - Daily Product: Products change at the reset time. You will acquire the designated product.
      - Random Product: This is a non-renewed product. Rewards can be acquired at a certain rate.
4. In the [Prize] category, you can use your Lucky Draw Tickets to apply for a reward of your choice. The winners are announced at the end of the event.
5. In the [Benefit] category, you can claim a reward when you meet certain conditions required by the event.
6. The event is held for seven days, and you may claim your rewards during the subsequent seven days after that. During the reward claiming period, you cannot use the shop for purchasing; you can only use it for reward claiming purposes.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_01_DESC.text:
1. The Mad Pantheon last for a total of 14 days, and the reward period lasts for 7 days after the end of the event. During the reward period, you can only use the store and get your reward.
2. The Mad Pantheon has two modes, namely [Normal Mode] and [Challenge Mode]. You can acquire more rewards in the Challenge Mode.
      - Normal Mode: This mode lasts from the initial entrance until clearing the first 20 stages. With every stage cleared, you can select a buff for the ally.
      - Challenge Mode: This mode automatically starts after clearing the first 20 stages. You can select a buff/debuff for the ally every time you clear a stage.
3. Your party gets fixed once you enter Stage 1 of the Mad Pantheon, and the party cannot be changed until reset.
4. Any heroes who die in a battle stage battle cannot be used in the following stage. However, you may use ‘Pantheon Coins’ to revive dead heroes.
5. You can obtain ‘Pantheon Coins’ and ‘Pantheon Points’ every time you clear a stage. ‘Pantheon Coins’ are used for purchasing store goods and reviving heroes, and ‘Pantheon Points’ are used to perform upgrades per class.
6. In the Mad Pantheon, the level of a hero is displayed in a Mad Pantheon-specific level. At 0LV, their basic stats default to 60LV, Max Bread, and Max Fruits, and Soulbound Weapons. Upon raising the level of a class, the stats of the corresponding heroes increase by a certain amount. These levels are only applicable in the Mad Pantheon.
7. The Mad Pantheon consists of 20 stages, which are repeated afterwards. The stage is reset to Floor 1 if your party is wiped out during a stage, you clicked the ‘Start Again’ button in the lobby, or when you clear 20 stages. When the stage is reset, all the buffs/debuffs acquired so far and your fixed party will also be reset.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_02_DESC.text:
1. The basic amount of blocks generatable is limited when engaging in a battle at the Mad Pantheon Blocks cannot be generated above the limit.
2. Priests' healing skills are not available when engaging in a battle at the Mad Pantheon.
3. Two random buff choices are given when you clear a stage in the Mad Pantheon, from which you can select a buff to apply.
4. The maximum number of stacks per buff is limited, and any buffs with maxed-out stacks do not appear in the selection window.
5. The buffs you select are stacked and applied until the stage is reset. You cannot change the buffs you selected until the stage is reset.
6. The combination of two specific buffs creates a more powerful 'Synthetic Buff'. Synthesizable buffs are automatically synthesized when both reach the maximum number of stacks.
7. ‘Pantheon Points’ can be used to change the change the list of buff options. However, the cost of changing the list rises every time you change it. (the cost is reset upon the stage reset)
8. You will select both a buff and a debuff in the [Challenge Mode]. Synthetic debuffs do not exist.

TEXT_HELP_ORCHARD_02_DESC.text:
1. The Orchard has a fixed number of 5 plots. Plots do not disappear even if you finish growing berries or cancel cultivation.
2. When you finish harvesting berries, the plot used to grow them is rerolled randomly into a plot with different traits and effects.
3. Plots of different traits appear randomly by chance. Some plots are much rarer than others.
4. Plots can appear carrying one of the three traits: [ATK/DEF/FUNC]. Growing and harvesting berries that match the plot’s trait yield bonus rewards.
- ATK (Sword): Attack Power, Critical Damage
- DEF (Shield): HP, Defense, Resistance
- FUNCTION (Crosshair): Critical Chance, Accuracy, Evasion

TEXT_HELP_OZTALK_01_DESC.text:
1. Oztalk is 1:1 chatting between Heros and Captains.
2. To use Oztalk, you need to acquire the Heroes available for this content, and raise your Friendship.
3. More conversation content becomes available at higher Friendship levels.
4. Status updates can also change based on Friendship level.
5. You can check owned Heroes on the Recommended Heroes list.
6. Pictures sent by Heroes during an Oztalk conversation can be seen at once in the Picture Collection.
7. Additional Stories for Heroes can be unlocked depending on the progression of Oztalk conversation with that Hero.

TEXT_HELP_OZTALK_02_DESC.text:
1. Friendship can be accumulated after acquiring the hero.
2. You can gain Friendship for that hero by playing Scenarios, Dungeons, and Challenges while including the said hero in the team.
3. Including multiples of the same hero in the team will accumulate more Friendship.

TEXT_HELP_S2_EP5_RAID.text:
1. You can enter after clearing Kalard Chronicles Episode 5.
2. ★5 Set Sigils can be obtained by clearing the Raid.
3. Reduces Attack Power by the number of current friendly units when Brand of Hellfire is cast.
4.  The 'current friendly units' include summoned creatures, shadows, and mirror images.
5. The fireball the boss rolls at you is destroyed when it is thrown in the air.
6. Interrupt the boss with the goddess skill when it raises its sword to gather orbs. Doing so will nullify its attack.

TEXT_HELP_TOTALWAR_01_DESC.text:
[Basic Info]
1. Total War can be participated with 4 parties of 3 heroes, totaling 12 heroes.
2. Only one of each hero can be used.
3. You cannot use heroes who are a member of the “Reinforcement.”
4. Heroes from different parties are not regarded as allies. (Hero skills and effects that react to/buff allies do not trigger.)
5. Champions and Goddesses are not permitted.
6. Hero blocks are used automatically. Support Type Heroes prioritize 1-chains and Main Type Heroes prioritize 3-chains.
7. The battle ends if you fail to defeat the boss in 20 seconds.
8. Upon defeating the boss, the boss enters its next level, resetting the boss’ HP and the battle duration.
9. The *quantity* of rewards is increased by reaching and defeating higher boss levels.
10. The *quality* of rewards is increased based on the Total War difficulty.
11. The Total War Leaderboard ranks players based on the Total War levels cleared. If two or more players have cleared the same amount of levels, the player who dealt the most amount of damage during the final level will be placed higher.
12. The Leaderboard is reset every 28 days on Mondays.
13. The Boundless difficulty features unlimited number of boss levels. However, the number and quality of accessories you can obtain is the same as Inferno difficulty.

TEXT_HELP_TOTALWAR_02_DESC.text:
[Reinforcements]
1. Three hero factions are chosen randomly every 28 days on Monday. 
2. The faction from the previous month is not available for this month.
3. You can select heroes with 4★ stars from the designated faction to join the reinforcements.
4. A hero of the same type cannot be included.
5. The total HP of the heroes in battlefield affects the attack damage of the reinforcements.
6. Heroes without a faction can be included at any time, but only half their HP affects it.
7. HP boost from set effects is not reflected.
8. The bond level of the heroes from the designated faction affects the attack damage of the reinforcements.
9. The reinforcements are recharged in proportion to the damage dealt by the heroes during the gameplay.
10. Reinforcements are recharged more when 3-chain instead of 1-chain is triggered.
11. You can always touch to trigger the fully recharged reinforcements.
12. Reinforcement in the Boundless Difficulty is not charged by the amount of damage dealt.
13. When reinforcement is activated in the Boundless Difficulty, the damage received by the enemy temporarily increases, allies' HP is restored, and becomes immune to damage.
