The enemy in this state receives $neutral damage$ equal to 500% of its attack power 1 second after it inflicts damage on the Hero's ally. This damage ignores evasion, critical damage, and the effect of taking damage for others.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SNORRI_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon activating Snorri’s block skill, the hero receives all damage targeted at the team for 5 seconds and generates 30 SP for all allies. Snorri is always in the state of the ‘Living Dead,’ and this state cannot be blocked or dispelled. On death, Snorri’s soul explodes, dealing $neutral damage% equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power and generates 30 SP for all other allies. After death, the hero is revived with 100% HP when an ally defeats an enemy unit.
‘Living Dead’: The hero receives 80% more damage and cannot receive heals or shields.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_05_SP.text: Uses Nosedive, which deals physical damage to the enemy in the front after spreading his wings and soaring up into the sky.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_DESC.text: Spins once in place to swing the fan at the enemy to deal @magic damage@ equal to [400/600/800]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero pulls all the enemies in the area towards her and activates 'Dance Time' for 20 seconds. The duration resets if re-activated within duration. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

Dance Time: Uzume starts dancing. Reduces received damage by 35%, and captivates the audience to reduce all enemies' resistance by 35% within the concert area and then increases damage to the enemies by 30%. The block skill pulls all the enemies in the concert area towards her, and is changed to 'Behold!' to deal @magic damage@ equal to 321% of resistance 5 times. This effect cannot be canceled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero pulls all the enemies in the area towards her and activates 'Dance Time' for 20 seconds. The duration resets if re-activated within duration. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

Dance Time: Uzume starts dancing. Reduces received damage by 35%, and captivates the audience to reduce all enemies' resistance by 35% within the concert area and then increases damage to the enemies by 50%. The block skill pulls all the enemies in the concert area towards her, and is changed to 'Behold!' to deal @magic damage@ equal to 321% of resistance 5 times. This effect cannot be canceled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_DESC.text: Chows down on a delicious meal, healing all allies by [130/250/370]% of Anton’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When Anton activates his block skill, he throws his eating utensils at the enemy. All enemy targets hit by Anton’s utensils are afflicted with ‘Hunger’ for 5 seconds. ‘Hunger’ reduces the afflicted targets’ resistance penetration by 500 and magical damage by 3%. This effect can stack up to 3 times. At max stacks, applying hunger will simply refresh the duration of the debuff.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Anton activates his block skill, he throws his eating utensils at the enemy. All enemy targets hit by Anton’s utensils are afflicted with ‘Hunger’ for 5 seconds. ‘Hunger’ reduces the afflicted targets’ resistance penetration by 1000 and magical damage by 5%. This effect can stack up to 3 times. At max stacks, applying hunger will simply refresh the duration of the debuff.

Targets afflicted with max stack of ‘Hunger’ also becomes afflicted with the ‘Hungry for Stew’ debuff.
‘Hungry for Stew’: for 5 seconds, the target afflicted with this debuff takes #physical damage# equal to 200% of Anton’s maximum HP every second and have their animation speed reduced by 30%. Duration of the debuff is refreshed on repeated use.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_DESC.text:
Recovers all ally Heroes' HP by [100/170/280]% of her attack power according to the number of chains, and then uses ‘Elegant Tea Time’ for [3/4/6] seconds.
When ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is activated, she recovers all ally Heroes' HP every second by 30% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When Ashley’s Block Skill is activated while ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is still active, Ashley falls and spills what she is holding in front of her.
Oops, my bad! : Pushes aside all enemies that were attacked at first, and then inflicts $neutral AoE damage$ equal to 200% of her attack power every 0.3 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Ashley’s Block Skill is activated while ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is still active, Ashley falls and spills what she is holding in front of her.
Oops, my bad! : Pushes aside all enemies that were attacked at first, and then inflicts $neutral AoE damage$ equal to 500% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_DESC.text: The Hero heals his HP and the ally with the least HP by [150/300/450]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When an ally is attacked, Baharha charges at the nearest enemy and inflicts #physical damage# equal to 100% of attack power. After that, damage to allies is redirected to Baharha for 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When an ally is attacked, Baharha charges at the nearest enemy and inflicts #physical damage# equal to 100% of attack power. After that, damage to allies is redirected to Baharha increasing the defense and resistance of all allies by 50% of his defense and resistance for 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_DESC.text: Heals the entire ally by [100/125/150]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Water Serpent' every time the ally leader hits an enemy. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Water Serpent: Deals $neutral damage$ equal to 50% of attack power to the enemy with the highest Max HP. The 'Water Serpent' ignores effects that take damage in place of others and Evasion.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Water Serpent' every time the ally leader hits an enemy. (Cooldown: 1 second)
Water Serpent: Deals $neutral damage$ equal to 50% of attack power to the enemy with the highest Max HP and heals the entire ally by the amount equal to the damage dealt. The 'Water Serpent' ignores effects that take damage in place of others and Evasion.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_DESC.text: Heals the ally with the least remaining HP by [80/100/125]% of the Hero's attack power, depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Additionally recovers the ally leader's HP equal to 100% of attack power when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Additionally recovers the ally leader's HP equal to 150% of attack power when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_DESC.text: Becomes resolved and recovers the HP of all allies by [250/275/300]% of attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_LV2_SUBDES.text: When the allies including herself are hit, she dashes forward and slashes the sword to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of attack power. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_LV3_SUBDES.text: When the allies including herself are hit, she dashes forward and slashes the sword to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of attack power, and recovers the ally with the lowest HP by 500% of attack power. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_DESC.text: Uses the Magic Bottle to grant a protective shield that absorbs the surrounding damage equal to [100/200/300]% of attack power, according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When Echo or the leader of the ally is attacked with a critical hit, she recovers the physical strength of the leader equal to 100% of Echo's attack power by playing the piano. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When Echo or the leader of the ally is attacked with a critical hit, she recovers the physical strength of the leader equal to 100% of Echo's attack power by playing the piano, and the attack power, armor, and spell resistance of the entire ally increase by 10% of Echo’s attack power, armor, and resistance for 8 seconds. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_DESC.text: Rie taps the drum to heal friendly units by [120/250/380]% of their Attack Power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: 'Dum Dum Drrum!' Stuns all enemy units for 1 second when triggered.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: 'Dum Dum Drrum!' When activated, stuns all enemies for 1 second. When another ally activates a 3-chain skill, additionally recovers 200% of attack power of all allies except self.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_DESC.text:
Deals @magical damage@ equal to 100% of the attack power to all enemies within range according to the chain number used, and uses [Lovely Hearts/Magical Blessings/Bright Stars].
Lovely Hearts: Generates 10 SP for the entire ally.
Magical Blessings: Dispels debuffs for the entire ally. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Bright Stars: Generates a block for all allies. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to 'Aura of Charms'.
Aura of Charms: Generates an Aura of Charms around the self. All enemies within the aura have motion speed increased by 5% while evasion and accuracy decreased by 15 each. (Every second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to 'Aura of Charms'.
Aura of Charms: Generates an Aura of Charms around the self. All enemies within the aura have motion speed increased by 5% while evasion and accuracy decreased by 15 each. (Every second)
Enters 'Exhausted' when stayed inside 'Aura of Charms' for 5 seconds. 'Exhausted' enemies have motion speed decreased by 20% and their rate of decrease in evasion and accuracy increases by 2 times.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_DESC.text: Charges forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Inflicts a stack of 'Paralytic Poison' to the attacker when pressing Block right before getting attacked.
Paralytic Poison: Decreases the target's accuracy by 5 and critical chance and attack speed by 5% for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be removed or blocked. (Stacked up to 5 times, duration resets upon reuse)
The special skill changes to 'Unexpected Being. 
Unexpected Being: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.25% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Inflicts up to 3 stacks of 'Paralytic Poison' to the attacker and increases the caster's SP by 60 when pressing Block right before getting attacked.
Paralytic Poison: Decreases the target's accuracy by 5 and critical chance and attack speed by 5% for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be removed or blocked. (Stacked up to 10 times, duration resets upon reuse)
The special skill changes to 'Unexpected Being.
Unexpected Being: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.5% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds and applies 2 stacks of Paralytic Poison.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_SPDESC_LV1.text: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.25% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_SPDESC_LV2.text: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.5% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds and applies 2 stacks of Paralytic Poison.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_DESC.text: The hero hops on her flying blade for [3/4/5] seconds, attacking and dealing #physical damage# equal to 400% of her attack power per hit. (Skill duration is extended on reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Tian Mo is the leader when ‘Reigning Blade of Tian Mo’ is activated, and she has the highest attack power out of every other unit, the hero activates ‘Greatest of All’ for 2 seconds. The hero’s armor penetration is also increased by 2000 for the same duration. Reactivating the skill during its duration will further extend its duration. This effect cannot be dispelled but is removed if stunned.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If Tian Mo is the leader when ‘Reigning Blade of Tian Mo’ is activated, and she has the highest attack power out of every other unit, the hero activates ‘Greatest of All’ for 2 seconds. The hero’s armor penetration is also increased by 5000 for the same duration. Reactivating the skill during its duration will further extend its duration. This effect cannot be dispelled but is removed if stunned. Whenever the hero’s block is pressed during the duration of ‘Greatest of All’, the hero fires [1/2/3] ‘Tian Mo Desu Beam(s)’ towards the enemy, dealing #physical damage# equal to 4000% of the hero’s attack power. (Cooldown: 0.1 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_DESC.text: Upon using a block, Rochefort, according to the chain number used, deals #physical damage# equal to [100/150/250]% of his attack power, and has a 50% chance of blocking attacks for the next 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Rochefort succeeds in blocking or evading an attack within 5 seconds of using a block skill, he counterattacks to deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of his armor. (Maximum 10 times) Using a block after Rochefort's counterattack will summon 3 'hawks' that each deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of his armor. (Activates 1 per second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If Rochefort succeeds in blocking or evading an attack within 5 seconds of using a block skill, he counterattacks to deal #physical damage# equal to 800% of his armor. (Maximum 10 times) Using a block after Rochefort's counterattack will summon 3 'hawks' that each deal #physical damage# equal to 5000% of his armor. If this attack deals a critical hit, Rochefort will generate 1 block for himself. (Triggered once every second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_DESC.text: Swings Magic Balloon to deal @magic damage@ equal to [150/210/300]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Majestic Arts' state for 5 sec when using ally's block. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)
Majestic Arts: Takes damage on behalf of all allies and reduces received damage by 20%. 'Majestic Pride' is activated for 3 seconds upon receiving additional damages 1 time. The effects of taking damage on behalf of all allies and damage reduction do not get blocked or disabled.
Majestic Pride: Increases critical chance, armor, and resistance by [20/40/40]%. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Majestic Arts' state for 5 sec when using ally's block. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)
Majestic Arts: Takes damage on behalf of all allies and reduces received damage by 40%. 'Majestic Pride' is activated for 3 seconds upon receiving additional damages 1 time. The effects of taking damage on behalf of all allies and damage reduction do not get blocked or disabled.
Majestic Pride: Increases critical chance, armor, and resistance by [40/80/80]%. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GWEN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating the 3-chain skill of another ally leader, her next block skill will activate with the power of a 3-chain once.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GWEN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating the 3-chain skill of another ally leader, her next block skill will activate with the power of a 3-chain two times.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_DESC.text: Inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to [200/350/500]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)
When using Guide of Starlight, transforms to ‘Avatar of Ananda’ by fusing with Dragon Jade - Nanda. (Cannot be canceled) Takes damage for allies after the transformation, receives 10% more damage, and becomes immune to stuns.
Avatar of Ananda: Cannot receive the heal effect because the law of the world does not apply, and receives #physical damage# equal to 5% of attack power per second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_DESC.text: Charges to the enemy in the front and deals $neutral damage$ equal to [200/300/650]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV2_SUBDES.text: When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 3,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Whenever Guts uses his normal attack and block skills, his attack power increases by 7% every 5 seconds. Can be stacked up to 10 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_DESC.text: Charges forward and thrust down the sword to deal #physical damage# equal to [3,200/3,300/3,400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 50% while on the White Horse.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, his critical resistance increases by 25% for 5 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 80% when on the white horse, and does not retreat.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, critical resistance increases by 25%, attack power by 40%, and damage received decreases by 25%, all for 10 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [5,00/1,000/1,500]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 100%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 150%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$. 
When Sword of Actuation is reactivated, he cuts the space and deals $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of attack power every 0.1 seconds. (Lasts 1.7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_DESC.text: Raven teleports to the front and swings the Black blade to deal #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 1500% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 3000% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_BLAKE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon receiving fatal damage, Blake uses 'Shadow Clone.' (Activates once every 15 seconds). Upon activating 'Shadow Clone,' Blake retreats, leaving behind a shadow of herself and heals 100% of her HP. She becomes invulnerable for 2 seconds afterwards. Additionally, Blake's attack power and evasion increase by 150% and 150 respectively for 10 seconds after the skill's activation.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_DESC.text: The next two auto attacks will inflict additional #physical damage# equal to [100/200/500]% of attack power according to the number of chains, and the motion speed of the attacked enemy is reduced by 75% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.
Weapon Upgrade: Increases one’s attack power by 50% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. (Max. upgrade: +2)
Weapon Upgrade 1: Increases one’s attack power by 100% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.
Weapon Upgrade 2: Increases one’s attack power by 250% and significantly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 50%.
The damage received by the entire ally is reduced by 50% while the weapon is being upgraded.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_DESC.text: Charlotte quickly claws the front with her fingernails 2 times, each inflicting #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 3% and attack power by 500 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times and the duration is reset when reused.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 5% and attack power by 1000 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 10 times and the duration is reset when reused.
In addition, when the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect is stacked 5 or more times, the motion speed increases by 30%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Reflects all damage taken within 1 second after using a block by 100% and then reflects 50% of all damage taken as $neutral damage$ to the target for 2 seconds. When this attack is successful, the caster recovers 2% of their max HP. Reflection cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When a block skill is used, for the next 2 seconds, Abel reflects 150% of the damage taken as $neutral damage$ to the target, and reflects 75% of the damage taken for the next 3 seconds as $neutral damage$ to the target. When a block skill hits the target, Abel recovers 15% of his max HP and decreases the amount of damage taken by 30% for 5 seconds. Reflection cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_02_SP.text: Increases his critical resistance and attack power and decreases damage received.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_04_SP.text: The Knight of Skeleton's weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_DESC.text: Take off quickly and deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Special Skill is changed to ‘Wheel Spin.’ Wheel Spin deals #physical damage# equal to 100% of the hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill is changed to ‘Wheel Spin.’ Wheel Spin deals #physical damage# equal to 300% of the hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. Upon activating her own 3-chain block skill, Tramontana gains a stack of ‘RPM.’ Upon activating her Special Skill, Tramontana gains 3 stacks of ‘RPM.’
RPM: For 10 seconds, the hero’s movement speed is increased by 100%, attack power by 40%, and armor penetration by 100%. This effect cannot be blocked or dispelled but is removed if stunned. (Stacks up to 5 times; duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When a block is used, the Ensign of Victory is summoned at the front line of the ally for 7 seconds once every 10 seconds. All allies near the summoned flag ignore amount of damage equal to 1000% of Victoria's armor. During the Djuration of the effect, her auto attack changes to Empire Swordsmanship that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1280% of her armor.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_DESC.text: Affogato shoots Latte Art that deals @magic damage@ equal to [300/600/900]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Drinks coffee whenever he uses a special skill. Generates 1 block for himself whenever drinking coffee.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Drinks coffee whenever he uses a special skill. Generates 1 block for himself whenever drinking coffee.
Also, obtains the following effect when drinking coffee a certain number of times. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.

1 time: Increases critical chance by 20% and resistance penetration by 1500.
3 times: Increases motion speed by 30%
5 times: Increases the number of ‘Latte Art’ to 2, which is unleashed upon using a block.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_DESC.text: Binds the first 3 enemies with shadows and deals @magical damage@ equal to [1000/1500/1800]% of attack power per chain, roots them for 3 seconds. (Duration is reset on reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block skill, ‘Back In My Day’ will activate for 5 seconds at the location of the 5 frontmost enemies. (Cooldown: 6 seconds) Enemies within the range of the skill will receive @magical damage@ equal to 250% of Deokpal Choi’s attack power every 0.2 seconds. When the duration of ‘Back In My Day’ is over, enemies within range will receive @magical damage@ equal to 2000% of attack power. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block skill, ‘Back In My Day’ will activate for 5 seconds at the location of the 5 frontmost enemies. (Cooldown: 6 seconds) Enemies within the range of the skill will receive @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Deokpal Choi’s attack power every 0.2 seconds, and have their resistance reduced by 50%. When the duration of ‘Back In My Day’ is over, enemies within range will receive @magical damage@ equal to 6000% of attack power. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEEMO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: After using the 3-chain 'I hate to tell you & Entrance', the following 1-chain and 2-chain's block skill damages increase by 50% for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEEMO_LV3_SUBDESC.text: After using the 3-chain 'I hate to tell you & Entrance', the following 1-chain and 2-chain's block skill damages increase by 100% for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_DESC.text: Deal $neutral damage$ equal to [1000/1100/1200%] of the hero’s attack power to the frontmost enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
At the start of battle, the hero sits on his throne. The hero’s special skill is changed to ‘Lord’s Pledge’.
Lord’s Pledge: The hero’s damage is increased by 30% for 7 seconds. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
At the start of battle, the hero sits on his throne. The hero’s special skill is changed to ‘Lord’s Pledge’.
Lord’s Pledge: The hero’s damage is increased by 50% and critical chance by 30% for 7 seconds. Ally heroes with the same armor and resistance values also receive the effects of ‘Lord’s Pledge’. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_DESC.text: Summons [1/2/3] waves that deal @magical damage@ equal to 300% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_LV2_SUBDES.text:
When using chains, she enters the Spirit Possession for 4 seconds. She cannot move when in the Spirit Possession state. This state cannot be blocked or disabled, and duration is reset upon reactivation.
Spirit Possession: Decreases damage received by 15% and becomes immune to debuffs.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When using chains, she enters the Spirit Possession for 4 seconds. She cannot move when in the Spirit Possession state. This state cannot be blocked or disabled, and duration is reset upon reactivation.

Spirit Possession: Decreases damage received by 30% and becomes immune to debuffs.
In addition, she deals @magical damage@ equal to 150% of attack power to enemies in the front every 0.1 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_DESC.text: Uses sharp bones to deal @magical damage@ equal to [220/310/390]% of the Hero's resistance per hit, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Hero's Special Skill changes to 'Dragon Fang'. 'Dragon Fang' lasts for 15 seconds, and if the leader block is skill is activated while  'Dragon Fang' is active, activates 'Dragon Ribs' with the power of a 1-chain.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The Hero's Special Skill changes to 'Dragon Fang'. 'Dragon Fang' lasts for 15 seconds, and if the leader block is skill is activated while  'Dragon Fang' is active, activates 'Dragon Ribs' with the power of a 1-chain. When activating 'Dragon Ribs' while 'Dragon Fang' is acive, enemies who have a lower Max HP than Livea will be put in the 'Gap in the Subspace' state, where they will @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Livea's resistance for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LOVE_IMPACT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Whenever allies use a block chain 4 times, the hero shoots out a ‘Love Beam’ for each ‘Charmed’ enemy unit, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 200% of the hero’s attack power per beam.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LOVE_IMPACT_LV3_SUBDESC.text: All 3-chain skills penetrate enemy units. Whenever an ally uses a block chain, the hero shoots out a ‘Love Beam’ for each ‘Charmed’ enemy unit, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 2000% of the hero’s attack power per beam. The Accuracy and Evasion of units struck by ‘Love Beam’ are reduced by 50 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_DESC.text: Unleashes betting chips that inflict @magic damage@ equal to [200/300/400]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When using one’s block skill, creates a ‘Lawless Area’ that cannot be canceled in front of the ally for 15 seconds. Up to 1 ‘Lawless Area’ can be created in a battle. (Cooldown: 15 seconds)
Lawless Area: Decreases the moving speed of the enemy within range by 20%

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When using one’s block skill, creates a ‘Lawless Area’ that cannot be canceled in front of the ally for 15 seconds. Up to 1 ‘Lawless Area’ can be created in a battle. (Cooldown: 15 seconds)
Lawless Area: Decreases the moving speed of the enemy within range by 30% while inflicting 50% more damage.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_DESC.text: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 500% of resistance penetration every 0.1 seconds for [1/2.5/5] second(s) according to the number of chains with a breath weapon. Increases resistance penetration by 4000 while using the breath weapon. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the caster uses 3 of their own blocks, Genesis creates a Constellation in the current spot for 5 seconds. (Duration Reset) Constellation: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 250% of resistance penetration for every second.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the caster uses 3 of their own blocks, Genesis creates a Constellation in the current spot for 10 seconds. (Duration Reset) Constellation: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 500% of resistance penetration for every second.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_DESC.text: Create and throw a bomb that deals @magical damage@ equal to [10/30/60]% of the hero’s attack power 12 times, based on the chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Whenever Prydwen uses her Special Skill, ‘Bomber’ is activated for 10 seconds.
- Bomber: Prydwen’s Critical Chance is increased by 15% and her accuracy is increased by 15.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Whenever Prydwen uses her Special Skill, ‘Bomber’ is activated for 10 seconds.
- Bomber: Prydwen’s Critical Chance is increased by 30% and her accuracy is increased by 30.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_DESC.text: Fires bubble to deal @magic damage@ equal to [300/600/900]% of her attack power according to the chain number used. This attack is done 3 times.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Uses 'Passionate Handling' to increase critical damage by 100% for 5 seconds every time the caster presses the Block. The effect is stacked up to 3 times, and the duration is renewed upon reactivating the skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Uses 'Passionate Handling' to increase critical damage by 100% for 5 seconds every time the caster presses the Block. The effect is stacked up to 3 times, and the duration is renewed upon reactivating the skill.
Additionally, her @magic damage@ increases by 150% when the 'Passionate Handling' effect is in full stacks.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_DESC.text: Winston inflicts @magical damage@ equal to [200/300/600]% of his Attack Power to enemies in the front.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Winston's Critical Chance is increased by 20% for 3 seconds when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Winston's Critical Chance is increased by 20% and maximum HP by 100% for 3 seconds when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_DESC.text: Sets off fire that inflicts @magical damage@ equal to [350/400/450]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Special skill is changed to ‘Moment of Justice.’
Moment of Justice: Increases the hero’s critical damage by 50% and resistance penetration by 1000 for 7 seconds. (Djuration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Special skill is changed to ‘Moment of Justice.’

Zodd: Zodd jumps out at the target that damaged an ally, dealing neutral damage equal to 22,000% of Griffith's attack power. (Cooldown: 1.5 seconds) This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of others. When Zodd is activated, his SP increases by 30.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_BRSK_02_6_NAM.text: Badge of the Band of the Hawk

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_BRSK_04_4_DES.text: (Passive Enhanced) Does not retreat from using the Sword of Actuation

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_BRSK_04_5_DES.text: (Passive Enhanced) Does not retreat from using the Sword of Actuation

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_BRSK_04_6_DES.text:
(Passive Enhanced) Does not retreat from using the Sword of Actuation
Additionally increases critical chance by 50%, accuracy by 30, and evasion by 30 while in the state of using Sword of Actuation.
When reusing Sword of Actuation, the amount of damage from cutting the space is changed to neutral damage equal to 600% of attack power every 0.1 seconds.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_RB2_02_4_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) Increases critical damage by 50% and critical chance by 20% for 5 seconds when entering 'Iaido Stance' state.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_RB2_02_5_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) Increases critical damage by 50% and critical chance by 20% for 5 seconds when entering 'Iaido Stance' state.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_LIMITED_RB2_02_6_DESC.text:
(Passive Enhanced) Increases critical damage by 50% and critical chance by 20% for 5 seconds when entering 'Iaido Stance' state.

(Passive Added) Unleashes 'Maiden Powers' to swing a large ice sword in the front to deal magic damage equal to 6000% of attack power and to reduce the target's SP by 60 when using the Black, Red, Green, and Yellow blades a total of 5 times.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_SPR_TWILLY_6_DESC.text:
Upon pressing another ally's 1- or 2-chain, Twillie responds by using her own 1- or 2-chain, respectively.
During Earth Shaker, Twillie receives all damage targeted at the entire team increases her damage reduction by 50%.
Earth Divider, Strike of Faith, and Last Stand are enhanced. (Deals 100% more damage over a wider range)

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_TRADE_ASMODEUS_4_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) The range of 'Aura of Charms' increases by 100%.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_TRADE_ASMODEUS_5_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) The range of 'Aura of Charms' increases by 100%.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_SW_TRADE_ASMODEUS_6_DESC.text:
(Passive Enhanced) The range of 'Aura of Charms' increases by 100%.
(Block Skill Enhanced) The block skill deals 300% damage, and [Lovely Hearts/Magical Blessings/Bright Stars] is enhanced as below:
 Lovely Hearts: Generates 30 SP for the entire ally.
 Magical Blessings: Cancels all debuffs affecting the entire ally and grants a 50% chance to become immune to debuffs for 3 seconds. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
 Bright Stars: Generates a block for all allies. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
(Passive Added) Uses Star 'Light-Slash' to deal magical damage equal to 3000% of the attack power to all enemies within range over 5 hits when using the Hero's Special Skills while 'Aura of Charms’ is activated. 'Exhausted' enemies take double damage.

TEXT_WR_S2_EP6_CH1_01.text: The citizens are shaking in fear...

TEXT_WR_S2_EP6_CH2_01.text: There are archers on the castle walls... I can help...

TEXT_WR_S2_EP6_CH2_03.text: Don’t worry, I will burn it all to the ground!

TEXT_WR_S2_EP6_CH3_SCALECURSE_DESC3.text: Heroes take more damage. The position of the scale is fixed (level 3).

TEXT_WR_S2_EP6_CH3_SCALECURSE_DESC4.text: Heroes take more damage from the enemy. The position of the scale is fixed (level 4).

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0001.text:
.... Huhu.
A bright and honest soul.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0002.text:
I am Noa.
I come from the Order of the Goddess.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0003.text:
I fear I have wasted your time
as you waited for my arrival.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0004.text:
I ask for your forgiveness,
Lady Knight.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0005.text:
Ah... Oh, no, no!
There is nothing to forgive, Lady Noa.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0006.text:
I am Lednas,
a knight in charge of local security.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0007.text:
This is {PLAYER_NAME},
the mercenary captain of this town.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0008.text:
It is an honor to meet you all.
Where lies the vale of Hero Town?

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0009.text:
I have waited long
to see where you call home.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0010.text:
Ah, yes. The town is this way.
Uh, Lady Noa.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0012.text:
Before we enter the town,
perhaps you could... uh, conceal your wings.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0014.text:
Maria did warn me,
but I forgot in my excitement.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0015.text:
I suppose my existence is to be hidden
until the proper time comes.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0016.text:
Please wait a moment
while I hide my wings.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0018.text: Yes, I will guide the way.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0019.text:
Hmm... That's a good smell.
I have gotten hungry.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0003.text:
The... the person from the Order!
What's her name... oh, Lady Noa!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0004.text: Lady Noa suddenly fainted and won't get up!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0005.text:
I... I just received a carton of fresh apples
and was preparing to bake an apple pie.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0006.text:
Lady Noa was curious about what I was doing,
so I gave her a slice, and...

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0010.text:
......
A sweet taste and delicate texture.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0013.text:
Finished from heat of the 'oven.'
The name of this existence... Apple pie.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0014.text:
Apple pie...
A heaven, complete! Crescendo!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0016.text:
.... I... Excuse me.
I am sorry, everyone.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0017.text:
At the Order, everyone is taught
the virtues of patience and control.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0018.text:
Thus all food was
white and bland... I mean, healthy.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0019.text:
I never knew food could taste like this.
I simply thought them meaningless.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0020.text:
Yet Miss Chocolat's apple pie....
It was a taste of heaven.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0021.text:
I have embarrassed myself
in my surprise.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0022.text:
..... I'm really happy
that you liked my bread that much!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0023.text:
Next time, I'll bake you 
very, very rich chocolate cake!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0024.text: Oh, I'm already looking forward to it.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0003.text:
I... 
Why was I created like this...

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0004.text:
... ... Lady Noa.
You do not look well.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0005.text:
Please do not be too concerned
with what happened last time.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} too says
it is alright, a forgettable mistake.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0007.text:
I... decided to tell Saintess Maria
of what happened, however.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0008.text:
She sent you this holy water
after reading my report.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0009.text:
I simply wished to help, and meant no offense.
But I beg your forgiveness for acting on my part.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0010.text:
...... No.
I should thank you instead.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0011.text:
You forgave and helped me...
when I could wound {PLAYER_NAME}

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0012.text:
in a way that could not be healed.
Thank you.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0002.text:
As you witnessed...
A darkness dwells within me.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0003.text:
A darkness that wishes to destroy all in my path,
bestowing a violent death to all who come near.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0004.text:
The name of the darkness 
that the people of the Order have discovered...

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0005.text:
Yes. I would like to reveal it to you,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0007.text:
A grim darkness forced upon me,
coded into my very being for war and destruction.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0008.text:
......
I am scared of that darkness, {PLAYER_NAME}.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0009.text:
I fear that one day I will be unable to control myself
and fall prey to my inner shadows...

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0010.text:
... and ultimately push
those I love and cherish into peril.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0011.text: It is a fear that always haunts me.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0013.text:
Yes. This battle with my darkness...
is my own battle.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0014.text:
Yet your aid will bestow me
great strength, {PLAYER_NAME}.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0015.text:
I ask you to bless me,
in the stead of Saintess Maria.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0004.text:
...... I have finally found the answer
to all my questions and doubts.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0007.text:
My will and desire
to not harm you, against my nature,

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0008.text:
won over the darkness that dwelled in my heart.
It was with your aid that I could win my dark battle.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0009.text:
Thank you... Thank you most sincerely,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0010.text:
I am a being incomplete.
Thus I shall concentrate on my training.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0011.text:
It is the only way that I can possibly hope
to repay my debt to your kindness.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0012.text:
Should you ever fall in dire danger,
{PLAYER_NAME},

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0013.text:
I shall save you, no matter what the cost.
This I vow, with the honor of the Egelan.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_11_.text:
It was quicker than I thought.
Forgive me for my rudeness,{PLAYER_NAME}.

I have heard about you since before,
that you are an outstanding commander.

I was trying to test you to check whether
you are a reliable person or not.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_12_.text:
You're an outstanding commander,
also very trustworthy.

Then, I hope to see you again. Perhaps
without this mask next time.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_1_0.text:
It's good thing that the enemies are
exhausted as well. Great work.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_3_0.text:
I am glad that you found them.
Were they all right?

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_4_0.text:
Wow, so many! Haha.
Well I knew you could do it.

Why don't you leave first? I will 
follow you soon with my soldiers.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_6_0.text:
The Neth Army should be scared of you.
You seem to be satisfied.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_7_0.text:
Good job,{PLAYER_NAME}.
You are much stronger and wiser than I thought.

Hmm? How do I know about you?
Haha...

{PLAYER_NAME}, did you forget about
what you did at our land?

That place is under my dominance.
Of course I know what happens in my land.
Oh, don't give me that look.

If I were to punish you for what you did,
you would have died already.

Oh by the way, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Grancia was looking for you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_8_0.text:
Thank you. Now we can easily win the battle
since they lost their commander.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_9_0.text:
So there is nothing harmful in there?
Great. Then we can keep fighting.

Great work, thank you.
I hope you keep giving us a hand.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_EPIC_QUES.text:
Thank you so much for your help.
You did a wonderful job.

Hmm, that was such a charming demon.
But it's still a demon, our enemy.
Well, it was worth coming. Haha!

Now please, keep this a secret from Joan of Arc,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

Thank you very much, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You are a true hero.

Great job.
They were really hard to find.

Finally we got rid of all the magic squares.
I am relieved now. Thanks, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_10_.text: Things will get much easier that way.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_13_.text:
Hmm... I am not quiet sure...
I think I need to work further on my research.

I really gotta study more!
There are so many things to study on!

Oh well, I better go back to my lab.
Thanks for your kind help!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_15_.text:
Hmm... Finished already?
How was it? Are you satisfied?

Too bad that I couldn't join the fight.
I have too many people to take care of.

I am glad that at least you 
enjoyed yourself.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_16_.text:
Good job, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Thanks for your kind assistance.

This is a token of my appreciation.
Please accept it.
Then, hope to see you again.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_1_0.text: Hmm... I need something more than this!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_2_0.text:
Argh....!!
No, nothing!!! There is nothing!!

All right, I guess I can't help it.
{PLAYER_NAME}, be my interviewee!

Are you running away from me?
{PLAYER_NAME}!!!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_5_0.text:
This... Thank you very much, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I hope this unnecessary war ends soon...
I will be waiting for the day.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_7_0.text:
So this is the brainwashing machine!
I shall break and dismantle it!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_8_0.text:
Great work.
Thanks to you, I could purify the darkness.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_9_0.text:
Great job, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Please find me when you get hurt!
I shall heal you as best I can.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_SUB_QUEST.text:
That demon... must be affected by
the dark energy in the battlefield.

As long as there is dark energy, 
demons won't disappear...
You have done a wonderful job, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_10_001.text:
Thank you! I have to report this
to the captain as soon as possible!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_001.text:
Wow! Way to go, {PLAYER_NAME}!
I can now get the flame spirit powers again.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_12_001.text:
Phew, I'm glad they were not badly hurt.
Only a few products were stolen...

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_12_002.text: Well, at least they are safe!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_13_001.text:
Great job, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Justice prevails in the end!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_15_001.text:
That demon... Should it be the subject
of Hellad's experiment? Or... Oh nevermind.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_15_002.text:
Great job.
Can I request you again if anything comes up?

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_1_001.text:
Phew! Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
We can use the trade route again.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_1_002.text:
Thankfully, all products arrived safe in time!
This is my token of appreciation! Take it!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_002.text:
Huh? Where am I going to use all these?
Hmm, it's a secret... but...

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_003.text:
to tell you, I am giving those to orphans who
lost their parents during the war.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_004.text:
Huh? What's that look on your face?
Hmm? Nothing? Hmm...!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_001.text:
Is this it?
Wow, this is so precise!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_4_001.text:
Oooh, the structure seems fine!
Great, let me take a look.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_001.text:
Oh, those are the sources?
Here, give them to me!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_003.text:
Something is strange.
This source uses a different kind of energy.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_004.text:
I think I remember hearing something about
dark energy, used by the Neth army.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_005.text:
That should be the source of this power.
Hmm, too bad that I can't get it.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_006.text:
...Still, the robot technology in the Neth Army
is amazing. Although the purpose is not good.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_007.text: Thank you very much for doing me a favor, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_7_002.text:
Hmm, it would have been better if you had killed him.
Well, it's okay you taught him a lesson.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_7_003.text:
That is enough. Thanks!
He won't bother me for a while.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_001.text:
Wow, this much...!
Thank you very much.

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_9_001.text:
Thank you.
These will be useful. Hmm? This...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_1_00.text:
Wow, this much?
Thanks, I gotta work hard!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_2_00.text:
Huh? Did you purify the dark energy?
Hmm, but as long as enemy keeps using it...

Then we must fight the Neth army!
That would prevent demons!

Well, yes you are right.
But why do you keep interrupting me?

All right then, {PLAYER_NAME}!
I must go. See you later!

Huh? Stop there soldier!
Let me finish talking!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_3_00.text:
Demon won't appear for a while, I suppose.
But I am still worried about it...

In that case, I will call you again.
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0001_1.text:
Grazie mille! Ahhh...
È cooosì beeello...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0002_2.text:
Non ho mai realizzato una spada prima d'ora, ma se la
farò con amore, dovrà accettarla!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0003_1.text:
Wow! Finalmente è finita!
Non mi rimane che consegnarla...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0003_2.text: Arrossisco al solo pensiero! Sono troppo agitata!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0003_3.text: Ma... devo dargliela io di persona, vero?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0004_1.text:
Uh? Non è nella foresta... Non si allena
oggi? Chissà dove potrebbe essere...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0004_3.text:
Tu rimani qui,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Augurami buona fortuna!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0004_6.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! Ce l'ho fatta!
Ha detto che è stato un pensiero gentile...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0004_8.text:
Wow, è un sogno che si realizza!
Non so come ringraziarti...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0004_9.text:
Oh sì! Se mai avessi bisogno del mio aiuto,
conta pure su di me,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0005_1.text:
Dove sarà...?
Spero che stia bene...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0010_1.text:
Q-Questo è... il cappello di Giparang!
Dev'essere passato di qui!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0011_1.text:
Yeowoodong...
Spero che tu stia bene...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0011_2.text:
Oh,  {PLAYER_NAME}, sei qui.
Ehm, stavo solo riflettendo...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0011_3.text:
Sta per cominciare il torneo di tiro con l'arco.
Andiamoci subito.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0011_4.text:
La luna splende... è così brillante.
Che nostalgia...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0011_5.text:
Se scagliassi una freccia verso la luna,
forse mi sentirei un po' meglio?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0013_1.text:
Fiuu! Sembra che la febbre stia scendendo.
Spero che si svegli presto.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0015_1.text: Grazie! Spero che a Sasquatch piacerà...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0016_2.text:
Ma se l'Impero lo volesse, potrebbe
trovarci. Non posso abbassare la guardia.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0016_3.text:
Ho deciso di proteggere Sasquatch.
Non ne posso più di dare la caccia ai maghi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0016_4.text:
L'Impero potrebbe mandare a cercare anche te,
ma ti proteggerò io,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0017_1.text: ... Mi spiace, non ricordo ancora nulla.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0018_2.text:
Negativo. Negativo. L'operazione di distruzione
dell'obiettivo è stata interrotta.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0018_3.text:
... L'errore di memoria... è dovuto a
questo robot nero. Perché...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0019_1.text: Mi aiuterà a effettuare le riparazioni.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0020_1.text:
Uh...? Perché non funziona?
L'energia in teoria è giusta...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0021_2.text:
Mentre eri via, è successo qualcosa.
Ho provato a usare una parte dell'energia di R-0...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0021_3.text: Ma all'improvviso il robot ha attaccato R-0!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0021_4.text:
R-0 l'ha neutralizzato in un secondo, per fortuna.
Ora ho riparato il circuito della memoria, quindi dovrebbe essere a posto.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0021_5.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, l'ho impostato in modo che ti consideri
il suo padrone: niente male, eh?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0021_6.text:
Uhm, ma da allora non ho più visto R-0.
Dove sarà finito?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0027_3.text: Uah! E chi sarebbe questo ragazzino?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0027_4.text:
Ragazzino? Sono una signora! E ora dimmi
perché hai bisogno del mio aiuto.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0029_1.text:
Uhm, ok, direi che può bastare.
Aspetta un secondo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0030S_1.text:
Bene! Con tutto l'impegno che ci abbiamo messo,
deve piacerle per forza!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_1.text: Ah ah ah, com'è andata la passeggiata,  {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_2.text:
Il fatto è che le ho dato il regalo, ma lei
ha detto che avrebbe preferito un'avventura.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_4.text:
Ho cercato di rifiutare, ma mi ha fatto quel
suo sguardo e... ho ceduto, ah ah.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_5.text:
Mmm, dunque,  {PLAYER_NAME}!
Potresti occuparti di mia sorella?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_6.text: So di potermi fidare di te.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0031_7.text: Occupati di lei finché non si sarà stancata.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0034_1.text:
È più emozionante della prima conquista
che ho portato a termine come re!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0037_1.text:
Ora ricordo dove ho già visto le creature
degli abissi... sulla mia tavola!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0038_1.text:
Ah ah, non sapevo che le avventure fossero
così emozionanti... Non ne avevo proprio idea.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0038_2.text:
Grazie a te, ho realizzato il mio sogno.
Ti ringrazio, ma non intendo ancora fermarmi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0038_3.text:
Continuerò ad andare avanti, come sempre.
E lo stesso vale per te, vero?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0038_4.text:
Spero che potremo vivere altre avventure insieme.
Mi sono divertito moltissimo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0040_1.text:
Immagino che tu ci tenga a vedere i fantasmi, eh?
Ok, prova a indossare questi occhiali.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0042_1.text:
Ho chiesto al Re degli inferi di scoprire
se tu fossi ancora in vita,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0042_2.text:
Pensavo che potessi vederci
perché eri già tra le schiere dei defunti...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0042_3.text: Invece è per via degli occhiali che indossi!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0042_4.text:
Meno male, altrimenti avrei liberato la tua
anima mentre dormivi,  {PLAYER_NAME}. Ah ah!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0043_2.text:
Ma ci sono ancora delle anime da
liberare, quindi dobbiamo perseverare!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0044_1.text:
Ci è mancato poco: se fossimo arrivati più tardi,
le anime si sarebbero trasformate in spiriti malvagi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_1.text:
Fiuu! Finalmente tutte le anime
sono state condotte nell'oltretomba.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_2.text:
Uh? Aspetta, c'è un messaggio
del Re degli inferi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_3.text:
Korin, ascoltami: la corruzione impedisce la
liberazione delle anime. Devi restare lì.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_4.text:
E  {PLAYER_NAME}, ti è stata concessa una vita extra
per ciò che hai fatto, quindi aiuta Korin.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_5.text:
Ciò significa che... devo restare qui...
a lavorare... Oh, che mal di testa...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_6.text:
Beh, non ho altra scelta.
Non si può dire di no al Re degli inferi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0045_7.text:
E dato che ci sei tu al mio fianco... So
che ce la posso fare,  {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0046_2.text:
Dammi quella pelle,
te la pago bene!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0047_1.text: Ecco a voi il celebeeeeeerrimo Andre!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0048_1.text: Ecco come si fa amicizia da queste parti.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0050_1.text: Fantastico! I miei guanti sono insuperabili!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0051_1.text: Mmm, questo robot è in grado di auto-ripararsi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0052_1.text:
Mmm, questo robot ha un corpo piccolo,
ma è molto potente.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0054_1.text: Questo robot è dotato di una funzionalità inspiegabile...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0054_2.text: Il suo creatore dev'essere un tipo davvero strambo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0055_1.text: Questa dev'essere la loro artiglieria a lunga gittata.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0056_1.text: Fiuu, è forte per essere un sosia...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_0056_2.text: Gli antichi Apostoli erano davvero così potenti?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DART_0002_.text: Thanks a lot. You are my savior.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DART_0003_.text:
The unknown specter in the desert is actually the captain of 
unit 9 in Trista Falcon army.

It is said that she was an outstanding soldier 
during war between Trista and the Neth Empire.

However she was trapped and has lost all other soldiers, 
her being the sole survivor.

She chased the enemy all alone right after she recovered,
maybe because she felt guilty about being the only survivor.

Everyone thought she went missing, but actually she was 
wandering around the continent to hunt down the Neth army.

The Neth Empire has protested to Trista for it,
and I was sent here to stop No.9.

I don't know why I have to help Neth empire,
but order is order.
Hmm... You seem to have a story too.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DART_0004_.text: Oh, I think we are already late.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DART_0005_.text:
We could not stop her.
But at least the desert is safe now.

That was the last military facility of Neth army in the desrt. 
No.9 will move to another region.

I should do this by myself from now on. 
Thank you for the help so far.
I hope to see you guys again sometime.

She has left! She's sharp as knives!
Well... Let's close the case!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DORO_0001_.text:
Don't worry about the pay.
I have plenty of money.
I 4 elementi: Terra, Vento, Fuoco e Acqua.

Le 4 streghe che padroneggiano ciascun
elemento sono le mentori che cerco.

Mi hanno detto che, se otterrò i 4 elementi,
mi consentiranno di diventare loro discepola.
Ma ottenere gli elementi è davvero difficile.

Quando li ricevo, divento vulnerabile.
Se venissi attaccata, non so cosa succederebbe...
Mi serve qualcuno che mi protegga.
Comunque, tu mi sembri un tipo affidabile.

Ora devo procurarmi gli altri elementi.
Spero che continuerai a proteggermi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DORO_0002_.text: Non ne comprendo il motivo, ma la foresta sembra corrotta.

Per fortuna c'erano alcuni punti incontaminati
in cui ottenere l'elemento.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DORO_0003_.text:
Ma sì, non è poi messo tanto male. 
Non serve che me ne procuri un altro. Andiamo a cercare il prossimo.

Ti spiace affrettarti?
Se tergiversiamo, il prossimo elemento potrebbe corrompersi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DORO_0004_.text:
Per fortuna, l'elemento Acqua 
non è stato contaminato.
Sono felice che ci sia tu con me, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Senza il tuo aiuto, non ce la farei mai...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_DORO_0005_.text:
Fiuu, ho raccolto tutti gli elementi.
Ti ringrazio, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Ma c'è ancora qualcosa che mi turba...

Tutti gli elementi sono stati contaminati e i mostri
sembrano diversi. Ho un brutto presentimento.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0002_1.text: Gon non vede cattiva ragazza coniglio rovina-caccia.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0003_2.text:
Volpe non mangia carne.
Mangia pane.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0004_2.text:
La squadra Corteccia robusta degli ent!
Sono i migliori quest'anno!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0004_3.text:
Il team vincente si aggiudica 30 milioni!
Congratulazioni!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0004_4.text:
Non fate quei faccini tristi!
Anche le altre squadre riceveranno dei premi di consolazione.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_GON_0004_6.text:
Gon triste...
Io compra pane di volpe.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_LEON_0001_.text: Ma quel tizio non mi ispira fiducia...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_LEON_0004_.text:
Siete tornati! Sembrate esausti.
Ma l'importante è che siate sani e salvi.

Sì, non è niente, sono solo un po' stanco.
Vado a riposarmi, ci si vede...

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_LEON_0005_.text:
Adesso ricordo.
Sono diventato un eroe per aiutare le persone.

Ma ho perso di vista il mio obiettivo.
Mi sono lasciato tentare dalla ricchezza e dalla fama...
E stavolta ho fallito nel mio intento e non ho salvato il villaggio.

{PLAYER_NAME}, se avessi accettato il tuo aiuto...
Avremmo potuto salvarli.

Ma posso ancora rimediare.
Diamo una mano a riparare il villaggio!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_MARIA_0001.text: Wow! Long time no see, Lednas!

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_MARIA_0002.text: Yes! Doesn't this toast look just like Lednas!?

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_MARIA_0004.text: I have no idea of what she's thinking.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_MARIA_0005.text: Where can she be? Is she mad at me?
In our old days, I used to hide somewhere and Lednas always found me like that!
I had a good time. But, I should go back.
To be honest, like Maria said, I wasn't like this before.
I hope to see her again.
I served Maria when I was young.
I always appreciated her kindness while I had a hard time getting along with everyone else.
However, it became a problem for me to maintain a close relationship with Maria since I'm a commoner.
As a result, Maria was punished.
I didn't want to cause any trouble.

TEXT_COMPLETE_EPIC_QUEST_HERO_SIGRUNA_00.text:
Thank you so much.
The bark of Blazing Ents is now mine.
I can't wait to taste it.

...!!!
Wha... what did I just say? Nevermind.

It's all burnt... 
What is wrong?

Blazing Ents bark just tends to burn up due to its 
high temperature if you just leave it.
However, if we cover the barks with the cold scales of Anglerfish...?
It cools down the bark and prevent it from burning up.
Done! Would you like to try it?
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}. I am so excited.
I hope I could repay your kindness one day. Farewell.

TEXT_COMPLETE_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0003_1.text: Great, I can work on a new recipe!

TEXT_COMPLETE_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0005_1.text:
Don't you like your new skill? You can
pay and learn other skills! Hehehe.

TEXT_COMPLETE_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0006_1.text: Thank you, this should be enough.

TEXT_COMPLETE_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0009_1.text:
Looks great. Please keep in mind that
weapons must be checked regularly.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_100_1.text:
Oh my... Is that the leather?
It's so pretty...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_100_2.text: I wonder how the bags will turn out...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_101_2.text: I can make great bags with these!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_102_1.text:
Hmm, I think I should fix the handle.
You were a lot of help, thanks {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_103_2.text:
I brought it especially for you, Goddess Anut!
You always worry about us every morning.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_103_4.text:
Hmm? Morning? Uhm.. I was just 
thinking about breakfast.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_103_6.text:
Worrying about everyone's breakfast!
You're so generous Goddess!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_103_7.text:
Yeah I think I am too.
Haha!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_104_2.text: I have a good feeling about this.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_105_1.text:
This is a great wand! 
It sure is inspiring.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_107_1.text:
Thank you so much. 
The desert will be much safer now.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_107_2.text: Join us for a drink, how about it?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_108_2.text: Shall I introduce you to my favorite pub?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_109_1.text:
Is this the thing? I can't read it.
I gotta study the ancient language.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_109_2.text: THX bro! Uhm... why do I talk like this?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_109_3.text:
I thought this was the NEWEST TREND!
I ain't gettin behind the times!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_109_4.text:
Oh wait it's out of style?! 
Aww, I can't believe it!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_DESERT_QUEST_110_1.text:
Ahhh! Thank goodness I found this! 
Thanks so much {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_100_1.text:
Wow! Bushels of apples!
Thank you so much {PLAYER_NAME} !

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_100_2.text: Soon, I'll be rolling in dough!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_101_1.text:
Wow, so many! Now I have a chance
to speak to her!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_101_4.text:
Don't worry, I have a plan in case this happened!
Run, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_101_5.text:
You idiots! 
Guards, take him away!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_102_1.text: The village is much safer now.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_103_1.text:
Mmm, the bark is so chewy
this time...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_103_2.text: What! What are you looking at?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_103_3.text: What's with that look on your face?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_104_1.text:
Oh! We can train by 
fighting strong monsters here.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_105_1.text:
You're really strong! I'd like to 
ask you to join us Space Cadets...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_105_2.text:
But I can't!
So maybe next time!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_106_1.text:
Wow, I did a lot of work today!
Thanks for your help!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_107_1.text:
Wow is this the axe?
It looks... kinda simple.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_107_2.text:
A bit different from what I've expected,
but thanks so much!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_108_1.text:
These golden seeds...! 
I've never seen such seeds before ..!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_108_2.text: Thank you so much for these precious seeds!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_109_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, you're still strong.
I think you're stronger than before.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_110_1.text:
This walk is to recover the peaceful state
of our mind! Not to goof around!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_111_2.text:
I met a scary werewolf on my way to 
deliver it and I lost my parcel...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_FOREST_QUEST_111_3.text:
I almost lost my job.
Thank you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0001_1.text:
Ci sono ancora molti mostri corrotti dall'energia
dell'Apostolo. Continuiamo a combattere!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0002_1.text:
Fiuu, almeno abbiamo guadagnato un po' di tempo.
Bel lavoro,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0003_1.text:
Argh, la mia vacanza! Dovrei lasciare tutto
nelle mani di Sera e andarmene...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0004_1.text:
È incredibile che non riusciamo a ucciderlo
definitivamente. Non c'è più decenza.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0007_1.text:
Mmm, che velocità... Speravo che avremmo potuto
trascorrere un po' più di tempo insieme.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0007_2.text:
N-No... Come non detto!
Non farci caso!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_QUEST_0008_1.text:
Uhm, ti sto tenendo d'occhio da un po' e
devo dire che fai cose decisamente strane,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0001_0001.text:
The number of enemy archers have greatly decreased
ever since you set out to help us, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0001_0002.text:
Thank you! We too shall continue to fight
to protect our town!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0002_0001.text:
Indeed... The other heroes
must have been lured by the light of the clerics.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0002_0002.text:
Had we been late,
they would have been trapped by this false light.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0003_0001.text:
Oho! Thank you.
I should have some fun with these.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0004_0001.text: So it was her who froze the barriers...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0004_0003.text:
I may be wrong, but...
somehow I feel as if the priestesses have grown stronger.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0004_0004.text: I only wish I am wrong...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0005_0001.text:
Huh... This is rather frightening.
How long has he been following me?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0005_0002.text: Thanks for warning me in advance.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0005_0003.text: Even if I could have defeated him all on my own.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0005_0005.text:
Well. I should hang around Bella in the future,
just in case. Haha.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0006_0001.text: Huhu, this should be enough to sell to Lednas...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0006_0002.text: Oh. Did I say something out loud?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0007_0001.text:
...Thank you.
It would have taken much longer had I been alone.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0008_0001.text:
Haha... I win! 
This is Goddess Anut for you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0009_0001.text: Ooooh! It's true! Spears are cooler than hammers!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_0009_0002.text:
From now on, I am going to train with a spear!
Wait for the next greatest lance master, world!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START.text:
Hmm... The barriers are safe.
For now.

They are mere illusions, but they are strong.
Perhaps some fragments of their will still remain within them...

Sigh... Thank you.
But I fear there are still more survivors left.

Mm, the barrier is safe.
Well done.

I must admit I am rather bothered...
that the illusion took the form of Goddess Dionne.
Thank you. The survivors are resting in the camp.
Whew, I must admit this is rather tiring.

Indeed even if it is only an illusion, it proves a hard enemy.
I cannot believe we must face it once more...

Ah, you have succeeded in your rescue mission.
Well done.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_100_1.text: Oh wow, this lunchbox is really old!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_101_1.text: Oh wow, it smells so fresh, Thank you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_102_1.text:
Oh that looks like octupus... How does
it taste? ... Yum!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_103_1.text:
Bring anything you find to me!
Finders keepers, losers weepers!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_103_2.text:
Wow! Look at the shiny polish! 
Fantastic!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_104_1.text: I am so excited! These look expensive!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_105_2.text:
Great! I'm sure this will be enough!
Dear Aubrey, please accept my proposal!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_105_3.text: Huh? How did he get in?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_105_4.text:
Not this time, Lednas!
Aubrey please...!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_105_7.text:
Ugh!!!
Goddess Sera, how could you...?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_105_9.text:
No Sera, you did a great job.
Let me kick this troublemaker out.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_106_1.text:
What? They were monsters, not pirates?
Perhaps it's just as well... Thank you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_107_1.text: Wow, those shells are really hard!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_109_1.text:
Yikes, they're soaking wet.
Why in the world would he need these?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_110_1.text:
Wow, heavy and black... and a bit red...
Wait, isn't this rusted?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_111_1.text: Wow great! The rust's all gone!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_111_2.text:
I gotta go to the blacksmith. 
Thank you sir!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_111_3.text: What? You don't think he'll like it?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_112_1.text:
The water is really cold. I hope this 
will help her wake up from her dream.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_113_1.text:
That's a lot of gold... I mean, you would make
a great treasure hunter!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_114_1.text: I think I miss the city...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_114_2.text:
Oh my, you werre eavesdropping on me?
That's rude, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_114_3.text:
I'll ignore it this time,
But you owe me!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_115_1.text:
How was it? Peaceful, right?
What?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_115_2.text: Hmm... No I didn't enjoy doing nothing.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_115_3.text:
Oh you still have that doubtful look on
your face... I know you enjoyed it!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_SEA_QUEST_115_4.text: You were even snoring when you fell asleep!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_100_1.text:
Wow it really moves! Amazing!
This is sure to be a hit!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_101_1.text:
Wow, so beautiful!
Am I going to sell it? No. I'm keeping it!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_101_2.text: Not this time, I want to keep it.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_102_1.text:
Wow! Let me taste it!
Yum yum...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_102_2.text: This... tastes like berry flavored ice cream!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_102_3.text:
I should try making a new snack with this!
It would be delicious!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_103_1.text:
Now they should understand that 
nature is precious! Thank you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_10.text:
Hmmph...! It's not because I like you!
What's with that look on your face!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_11.text:
Goddess Bella...?
Umm... May I place it...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_12.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I am tired of waiting!
Put it on me right now!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_14.text:
What? Who are you? 
Why are you disturbing me!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_15.text:
Excuse me, Goddess...
Sob... {PLAYER_NAME} I hate you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_2.text:
It looks sharp but it's soft and curvy,
just like her!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_4.text:
Hmm? What are you holding?
Give it to me!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_6.text:
You have good taste!
I'll keep it, nice job.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_7.text:
Ugh... That... I mean... 
Alright... Please keep it, Goddess Bella...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_8.text:
But may I have the honor of placing
the necklace on you Bella...?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_104_9.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, you may have the 
honor to do so.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_105_1.text:
This is larger than I thought, did you get it 
from a tank or something?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_106_1.text:
The tundra is freezing!
I wonder whether the others could handle it.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_107_1.text:
Achoo! So this is cold weather 
training... Huh... Achoo!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_107_2.text:
Real time training! Achoo!
I should work harder I guess... sniff...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_108_1.text: Thank you! I can work again!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_109_1.text:
You brought more than I expected!
Thank you so much!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_1.text:
Oh nevermind. How is it?
Don't you feel calm and relaxed?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_10.text:
Arghhh help me!! {PLAYER_NAME}!!
I don't want to go back!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_11.text:
Thank you {PLAYER_NAME}.
You helped me find my friend.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_12.text:
Was it you!? {PLAYER_NAME}!?
Did you betray me!? Let me go!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_13.text:
Foxie, Let's go now.
It is getting dark.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_14.text:
My name is Foxniper, not Foxie!
How many times should I tell you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_15.text:
Alright Foxie, we should leave now.
{PLAYER_NAME}, see you again.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_2.text:
I feel much relieved now, meditating in
the cold weather.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_3.text: Got you, Foxie. You were here.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_4.text:
...I think I am hearing things.
I guess I need more training.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_5.text:
Foxie, I was looking for you.
Let's go back to our home.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_7.text:
Foxie, stop talking nonsense and
let's go back. Gon is hungry.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_8.text:
How could you chase me all the way here!
I can't believe it, I escaped barely!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_110_9.text:
Let's go home Foxie.
I was very worried about you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_111_1.text:
Wow this much? 
Haha I am the Runner-up now!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_112_1.text:
Wow thank you sir!
What? Why am I calling you sir?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_112_2.text:
Well how do I know whether you are a man
or a woman? You are covered in armor!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_113_1.text:
