Wow, you brought a lot! I can even make 
a new watch with these! Thanks!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_114_1.text:
Can you get me a big shield? 
I need a strong, bign, and beautiful one!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_114_2.text:
Wow, this looks very solid!
Thank you very much!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_116_1.text:
I feel very much inspired from this 
beautiful white scenery...!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_117_1.text:
I can't believe I met the Iceflower Fairy!
It gave me a great inspiration!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_117_2.text:
I think I can write good novels now.
Hmm, the story I am thinking is this!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_117_3.text:
A story of a prince with ice magic ability!
Having conflict with his brothers...Huh?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_TUNDRA_QUEST_117_4.text:
What's the matter? You've heard of 
this story already? No way!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_100_1.text: I knew you could do it, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_101_1.text:
I love that pretty red light... Yay!
This sure is going to be a hit!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_102_1.text:
Wh..What? This is..! 
The Ultimate Charcoal!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_102_2.text:
Can I really have this? 
Thank you {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_1.text:
Hahaha, what a beautiful red flame!
The spirit inside must be very strong!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_10.text:
My...My ruby...
Oh this must be Lednas!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_2.text:
Now to give this to Goddess Bella...!
Bella!!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_4.text: Goddess Bella! Please accept my gift!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_5.text: Your hands are on fire! Let me help you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_8.text:
What? What is it? 
Why are you holding a rock? Weird.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_103_9.text: I am glad you're safe now!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_104_1.text: Oh it's just a stone? I see..

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_104_2.text:
Well I still like it! Very warm.
Thanks for your help!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_105_1.text:
Wow, this is really good metal! Great! 
I should make a weapon out of this.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_106_1.text:
I'm so sweaty! 
This was a really good place. Thank you!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_107_1.text:
Oh, they're fresh. Don't ask me what 
I am going to do with these.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_107_2.text: Hehehe, if I surprise them with these...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_108_1.text:
Wow, I feel so good after all the training. 
Thank you {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_109_1.text:
Blazing ents... Well it sure seems like 
good firewood!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_109_3.text:
I hope it doesn't burn to a crisp
before I can use it...

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_110_1.text:
What... is this? The horn of dragon? 
How did you get this? Give it to me!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_110_2.text:
Argh, I feel much stronger now! 
Mr. Fergus...! What is this power?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_110_3.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_111_1.text: Great job. Thanks for your help!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_111_2.text:
I must kill anyone who knows my identity...
But I won't kill you this time, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_111_3.text:
Please don't tell anyone about me.
What?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_111_4.text: I don't think you're cut out to be a spy.

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_112_2.text:
I'm hungry now.
Would you like to join me for some food?

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_112_3.text:
What? It's not lunchtime? Haha,
that doesn't matter!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_112_4.text: Okay, I gotta go help myself! Bye bye!

TEXT_COMPLETE_HARD_VOLCANO_QUEST_114_1.text:
Hmm... Nice polish and color.
Thank you very much.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0001_1.text:
Sapevo che ce l'avresti fatta!
Eccoti la ricompensa promessa.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0002_1.text:
Bel lavoro, le consegnerò non appena arriverà
il corriere dell'Impero.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0003_1.text:
Grazie a te,  {PLAYER_NAME},
l'area è sicura.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0003_2.text:
Ma non abbassare la guardia:
ci sono altre zone da sgombrare.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0004_1.text:
Guarda questi artigli! Sono perfetti!
Mi metto subito al lavoro. Ben fatto!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0006_1.text:
L'operazione è stata un successo.
Bel lavoro,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0007_1.text:
È proprio bello averti a disposizione. 
Ora posso studiare gli ent.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0008_1.text:
Mmm, nell'attesa prova questa.
Quando la crostata sarà pronta, ti chiamerò!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0009_1.text: Non mi aspettavo niente di meno. Bel lavoro,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0011_1.text:
Guarda queste venature:
è legname di alta qualità.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0011_2.text: Di certo avrò presto altro lavoro per te.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0012_1.text:
Mmm, forse la foresta è mutata in seguito
al risveglio degli ent?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0013_1.text:
Tieni, ecco il tuo meritato spadone
dell'officina Ferricus.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0015_1.text:
Se trasferisco la magia nella sfera...!
Ta-da!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0016_1.text: Grazie a te sono di nuovo nel giro,  {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0018_1.text:
Che cosa intendo fare con gli arbusti?
Li mangerò, ovviamente.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0019_1.text: Comincio subito a creare la tua arma.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0020_1.text: Ci sono più mostri di quanto pensassi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0020_2.text: Forse dovrei chiedere un compenso maggiore...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0020_3.text: Argh! Ignora quello che ho detto...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0021_1.text:
SOB... Ho fallito di nuovo...
I mostri mi fanno tanta paura...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0022_2.text:
Dovrò reclutare altri soldati per rafforzare
le nostre difese.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0023_1.text:
Che cosa è successo...? Avevamo sconfitto
il golem e salvato la dea...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0024_1.text: Una vittoria sudata ma meritata. Bel lavoro.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0026_1.text:
Dunque i cadaveri... si muovono davvero.
E attaccano anche...?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0026_2.text:
Oh, meraviglioso! Vorrei tanto vederli
con i miei occhi!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0028_1.text:
È stato stupefacente!
Come fanno a muoversi...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0028_2.text:
Per non parlare di quelle bende appiccicose
sulle mie braccia... Che esperienza memorabile!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0029_1.text:
Il nucleo dei sabbiosi ha una caratteristica particolare:
attira la sabbia nelle sue vicinanze!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0029_2.text:
In questo modo potrò produrre pietre
molto robuste!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0030_1.text: Wow! Ora mi sento molto più al sicuro!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0031_1.text:
Ho pensato a un nuovo modello in tua assenza!
Ta-dah!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0032_1.text:
Oh... Oh oh oh. Ricerca! È l'ora della ricerca!
Grazie mille!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0036_1.text:
Mmm, abbiamo cercato ovunque, ma
non l'abbiamo trovato. Che peccato.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0037_1.text:
Shhh! C'è un ispettore dell'accademia.
Lascia il cadavere laggiù, dietro la casa.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0038_1.text:
Che design favoloso! Se rattoppo questi
abiti e li ripulisco dal sangue, avrò un modello da urlo!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0039_1.text:
Ricordo di aver sentito parlare di un insetto gigante
che viveva nel deserto molto tempo fa...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0040_1.text:
Pare che il re del deserto della leggenda sia morto
combattendo contro un essere antico...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0040_2.text:
Chi potrebbe essere questa creatura?
Devo fare delle ricerche.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0041_1.text:
Wow, è oro purissimo!
Sogno o son desta?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0042_1.text:
Grazie,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Eh... Eh eh, il deserto è meraviglioso.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0043_1.text:
Ehi, tutto bene,  {PLAYER_NAME}?
Sapevo che saremmo stati attaccati da anubi e horus, ma...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0043_2.text:
Non immaginavo che ce ne fossero così tanti
nei pressi del tempio.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0044_1.text:
Oh oh! Che progettazione ingegnosa.
Come fa un mostro a escogitare una cosa del genere?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0045_1.text:
Un accessorio per rettili fatto di oro puro!
Andrà a ruba tra i nobili!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0046_1.text:
Ho sentito che ci sono altri templi come questo sparsi nel
deserto, quindi probabilmente non sarà l'ultimo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0048_1.text: Bel lavoro, il rituale è stato interrotto.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0049_1.text:
Come pensavo! Guarda che bestione! Se riuscissi
ad addestrarlo, sarebbe perfetto!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0050_1.text: Ora vediamo cosa c'è scritto in questo libro.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0051_1.text: Ok, liberiamoci di questo noioso incarico...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0054_1.text:
Questa volta mi assicurerò di
chiuderli a chiave!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0056_1.text:
Come? Non l'hai trovato? Magari è custodito
in un altro luogo, invece che nel deserto?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0056_2.text: Devo andare a fondo della questione!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0057_1.text:
Mmm... Ora sono certa che l'habitat sia identico
al deserto... Quale potrebbe essere il problema?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0058_1.text:
Mmm, questa pista era un vicolo cieco.
Beh, comunque hai fatto un buon lavoro.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0059_2.text: I miei occhi non mi ingannano... vero?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0059_3.text: Il verme delle sabbie esiste veramente!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0059_5.text:
Come?
Non posso parlarne con nessuno?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0059_7.text:
Oh beh, se lo dici tu...
Immagino di non avere scelta,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0059_8.text: Ma la prossima volta voglio saperne il motivo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0060_1.text:
Uh? Pesci carnivori e
stelle di mare che camminano...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0061_1.text:
Come fanno le stelle rosse a camminare...?
Mi sembra una ricerca degna almeno di un paio di saggi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0062_1.text:
Oh, guarda qui, è squisito!
Mondo, preparati: cucinerò un pasto memorabile!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0063_2.text: Sigh. Non importa. Farò le ricerche da sola...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0065_1.text:
Per un cuoco è un onore poter cucinare
con ingredienti tanto rari.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0066_1.text:
Wow, mandato al tappeto da una medusa...
Dovrò allenarmi di più!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0067_1.text:
Sei il mio portafortuna,
 {PLAYER_NAME}. Eh eh.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0068_1.text:
Wow... è una medusa?
Che gusto ha?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0068_2.text: E la consistenza? Sarà un cibo di altissimo livello!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0069_1.text:
Mmm, ora ho capito.
Grazie tante,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0070_1.text:
È... è tutto vero...?
Non sto sognando?

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0071_1.text:
Ok, ora ho finito!
Spero che ti piaccia.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0072_1.text:
Grazie! Ora potrò creare
un'arma migliore.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0073_2.text:
È davvero per me?
Wow, non osavo sperare tanto!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0074_1.text:
Cos'è questo?! Come farò a cucinare un
granchio così grande? Miao!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0074_2.text:
Miao! Sono le sue dimensioni normali?
Non sapevo che fossero così grandi, miao!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0075_1.text: Grazie a te,  {PLAYER_NAME}, abbiamo raccolto molti dati.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0075_2.text:
Speriamo che vorrai prendere parte anche
al prossimo esperimento.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0077_1.text:
Per cui, le voci erano vere...
Oh mamma... Devo cambiare lavoro...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0078_1.text:
Cosa? Il secchio si è fuso?
Che cianfrusaglia da due soldi!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0079_1.text:
Il mana è come la melodia della musica.
Naturalmente...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0079_2.text:
Che succede con l'addestramento?
Non mi allenavo da tempo e...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0079_3.text:
Temo di aver perso il mio tocco, ah ah.
Ho commesso degli errori stupidi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0080_2.text:
Bello rivedere te.
Ora Gon non preoccupato.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0080_3.text:
Gon ringrazia  {PLAYER_NAME}.
 {PLAYER_NAME} e Gon adesso amici.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0081_2.text:
Sigruna ricopre un ruolo importante tra gli elfi.
Se dovessero scoprire che è scomparsa, andrebbero nel panico.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0082_1.text:
...! Perché l'hai portato da me?
Corri da Poogus, prima che si fonda!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0084_1.text:
Che velocità! Non sto nella pelle per la creazione di
un'arma con questi materiali!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0085_1.text:
Visto? Avevo ragione!
Wow, risplendono come l'oro...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0086_2.text:
Vorrei raccogliere ulteriori informazioni sul
mostro da Hellad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0088_1.text:
Grazie mille! Il mio compito
è finito, ora tocca a Hellad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0089_1.text:
Così è più che sufficiente!
Mi metto subito al lavoro.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0090_1.text:
Hai la gratitudine del leader del nord.
Qualunque cosa farai, noi saremo con te.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0091_1.text:
Grazie! Dovrebbe bastare
per controllare la fiamma.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0093_1.text:
Mmm, quindi alla fine sono nati naturalmente
e il resto erano solo dicerie infondate.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0094_1.text: Ti pagheremo per il tuo tempo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0095_1.text:
Oh... Sì, percepisco il potere
di questa cenere.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0096_1.text:
W-Wow, che corno è? È di un drago?
No, no, non è importante. Aspetta.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0096_2.text:
Finalmente l'arma perfetta è pronta!
È l'arma migliore che io abbia mai creato!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0097_1.text:
Uah, è tantissimo!
Che cosa me ne faccio?! Comunque grazie!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0098_1.text: Fiuu, abbiamo evitato un incidente diplomatico.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0098_2.text: Tieni, l'avevo messo da parte per la tua cauzione, magari ti tornerà utile.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0099_2.text: Ok, potrai provare in anteprima la mia nuova ricetta!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0099_3.text: Ta-dah! È una torta gelato glassata!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0100_1.text:
Grazie! Ho rischiato di mandare a fuoco la fucina!
Ah ah!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0101_1.text:
Wow, questa neve è perfetta per le palle di neve...
È così soffice!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0102_1.text:
Oh, dove li hai trovati?
Avanti con i robot!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0102_3.text:
Cosa? Sei ancora qui?!
Ah già, non ti ho pagato...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0102_5.text:
Uh... Non funziona...
Una piccola parte di me è morta.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0104_1.text: Ora sì che sei forte. Tieni, prendi questo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0107_2.text:
Te l'avevo detto!
Un punto per il fabbro!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0108_2.text: E non sei un pupazzo di neve!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0109_1.text:
Se qui per riempirmi di nuovo di rottami?
D'accordo, ecco qualcosa per te.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0109_2.text: Avrei continuato a prenderli gratis, ma...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0109_3.text: Non fare quella faccia, gli affari sono affari!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0110_1.text:
Bel lavoro,  {PLAYER_NAME}!
Di questo passo, non riusciranno nemmeno ad avvicinarsi a Nosgard.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0111_1.text: Bene, ora non resta che creare la domanda...

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0112_1.text:
Sta andando tutto secondo i piani!
È un infuso fantastico!

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0114_1.text: È tutto per oggi? Li finiremo la prossima volta.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0115_2.text:
Ma non possiamo impedirgli di evolversi.
Ti chiamerò quando sarà il momento.

TEXT_COMPLETE_QUEST_0118_2.text:
Ma il loro esercito è ancora in attività
e tornerà, prima o poi.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_1_001.text:
The Order of the White Lion... Yes, the name is familiar to me. 
They are said to be the most orthodox within the Order of the Goddess...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_1_002.text: I only wonder what they have to do with our Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_2_001.text:
Hmm. A low-ranking soldier, ignorant of all matters of consequence...
We need to gather information from some other source.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_2_002.text: Perhaps a higher-ranking official has the answers we need.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_3_003.text: Are you comforting me? Haha, thank you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_3_004.text:
You are right. I know them well, they are knights of skill and courage. 
Comrades-in-arms who faced death as one. They will not fall so easily.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_4_001.text:
According to the report, most of the forces moved to the desert. 
I only wonder if the Cobalt Knights followed them there...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_5_001.text:
That man... surely... 
{PLAYER_NAME}, I'm seeing correctly, aren't I?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_6_001.text:
What was that aura? 
I apologize. This is the first time something like this has happened.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_6_002.text: I need some time to collect my thoughts.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_001.text: Whew... Now we leave the rest to Saintess Maria, and wait.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_002.text: Ah, do you know of a knight named Lednas?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_003.text:
Upon hearing that we are to go to Hero Town, Saintess Maria 
handed me a package of strawberry pies... and told me to give them to her.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_8_001.text: I only hope Vius and Jacie return to their senses soon...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_001.text:
It seems that David and Lawiya have been 
affected far more deeply than the other two.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_002.text: Even Saintess Maria is having trouble purifying the darkness from them...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_003.text:
There is nothing to do but wait. 
Let us go search for the remaining Cobalt Knights until their full recovery.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_START_1_0.text:
A grand success, 
as expected from the great {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_START_2_0.text:
Farewell for the time being.
I must report the outcome of this mission to His Majesty.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_QUEST_START_1_001.text:
Now they will regret ever threatening Miss Sera...!
Hahaha... Muhahahaha...!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_QUEST_START_2_001.text:
Well done. 
I only hope it does not reappear...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_QUEST_START_4_002.text:
I must say, these weapons are of a very fine caliber. 
Mister Fergus might get rather jealous when he sees them.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_QUEST_START_7_001.text:
That was a wonderful battle, {PLAYER_NAME}! 
Those scumbags... They'll be cowering in fear by now!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_002.text:
T-this is the strength and magnificence...
of a real transformer robot...!!!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_1_00.text: I only wish this was the end...

Yet with my powers as a Goddess drained, 
I do not know whether its total obliteration will be possible.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_2_00.text:
Hmm... I too should 
It will truly be a battle with my own self...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_3_00.text:
His illusion has disappeared...
Yet as long as this land remains defiled, it may return.
Should that day ever come, I ask once more for your aid.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_BLOCKSKILL_0003_.text: Wow, padroneggi molto bene le abilità di base!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_PVP_0001_1.text:
La mia fiducia in te era ben riposta.
È stato un grande spettacolo.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_PVP_0003_1.text: Eh eh! In questo modo, vinciamo entrambi!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_PVP_0005_1.text:
È rassicurante avere una persona come
te al proprio fianco.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_PVP_START_0001_1.text:
Come pensavo! Vederti in azione
mi fa dolere tutte le articolazioni!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_PVP_START_0001_2.text: Anche se non ho mai combattuto personalmente...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_SISDRAGON_SKILL_.text: Dopo tutto, immagino che tu non abbia bisogno del mio aiuto.
Mmm, cominci ad andarmi a genio...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_SISFOREST_SKILL_.text:
Sigh... Temo che non finirà mai.
Ma non possiamo arrenderci!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_SPSKILL_0002_1.text:
Se desideri cambiare le tue abilità speciali,
recati da Hellad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_SPSKILL_0003_1.text:
Il numero di combinazioni di abilità
speciali è praticamente illimitato!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_SPSKILL_START_00.text:
Com'è andata? Più eroi incontri,
più abilità potrai usare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_10.text:
I am the commander of Valencia,
the dark night.

We don't need your help, as we
can handle it ourselves.

Are you upset? I guess you must be 
very confident in yourself.

Then, show us your ability.
The goal is to destory the Neth tanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_11.text:
Don't boast about yourself for just destroying
some tanks. They are just underlings.

Neth scientists are the ones really behind
all this, by providing sufficient technologies.

I will surely recognize your ability if
you can succeed on this mission, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_12.text: I can trust you now, so let me tell you.

Did you know that Valencian soldiers 
arrived to support the alliance army?

Hmm, that would make it quick to talk.
We were attacked by Neth Army on our way.

We are suspecting a spy within Valencia
and we are going to start an investigation.

But before that, we must revenge them
for what they have done to us.

We are going to proceed with a surprise attack
from now on.

I know we can succeed if you will
lead my soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_1_.text:
Do you remember me? 
It's me, Joan of Arc the Steel knight.
I came to see you to ask a favor.

Our soldiers are too exausted after the battle.
If the enemy attacks at this moment....

...It would be very dangerous.
Can you please scout around nearby?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_2_.text:
We shall prepare for a counter attack
while the enemies are holding back.

Roman Army is on the way here to support the
alliance army right now,

but I lost contact with them. We have to
modify our mission in case of emergency.

Please search for the Roman Army.
At least some trace of them, if possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_3_.text:
This Roman flag is all torn up....
There must be something wrong with them.

We have no authority to search them
ourselves... We can't help it...

Pause for a moment, Joan of Arc.
{PLAYER_NAME}, hello there.

Sir, what brings you here...
Wait, you are still injured..!

Oh I am fine, it's all right.
So, I suppose the Roman Army is in trouble?

...Yes I think so.
We have to help them, but we can't.

But the Romans are here to help us.
It is not right to abandon them, we should help.

But sir, in that case we have to withdraw 
your guards! It is too risky!

Haha... You always become so emotional
when it comes to my safety.

I am strong enough to protect myself.
Also, I'm not talking about sending soldiers.

{PLAYER_NAME}, I know how capable you are.
Please, help us search for the Roman Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_4_.text:
You are..? Hmm, the Grancian Empire?
I see, thank you for your kindness.

But I'm sorry that you wasted your time.
We did not lose the battle.

We just moved our base after the fierce fight
to take some rest.

After taking a rest, we will join the others.
Oh wait, what was your name?

Hmm... Nevermind. We'll talk about this
later. First, do me a favor.

Although we defeated the Neth Empire,
we have many wounded soldiers.
I hope you can get some medical aid kits for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_5_.text:
Thank you so much for bringing medical kits
last time. I appreciate that.
It seems like the soldiers need more rest.

So we don't want the enemies to attack us
at this moment. Would you check on them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_6_.text:
All right, we should confuse the enemies first.
I will order a squad to support you.

Go and sweep them all!
I am behind you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_7_.text:
Thanks to you, things turned out to be
much easier for us the alliance army.

But, we need something more than this.
I will revenge them myself for hurting my soldiers.

Go ahead, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Enemies will experience fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_8_.text:
I was waiting for you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I have a favor to ask you.

Situation got better after you defeated the
Neth army together with the Roman Army.

However, there is a Neth executive
causing some trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_9_.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. We had some trouble
while confronting the Neth Army.

There are mysterious machines in the enemy tent,
so my soldiers are afraid to go in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_EPIC_QUE.text: How are you doing, {PLAYER_NAME}?

I am having a hard time sweeping the
Neth remnants.
Can you help me on that?

I received a report that Neth infantries
are causing trouble everywhere

I will be in charge of the West area.
Can you go to the South area, {PLAYER_NAME}?

Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Long time no see!

There is a demon in the battlefield
which looks beautiful.

How do I know? Many of my soldiers
are possessed by it already! Tsk tsk...

They were totally out of their minds!
I am so curious about that being.

I want to take a look myself.
Hopefully we can kill it on our way.

Oh, can you keep this a secret from Joan of Arc?
I don't want to be scolded by her.

Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Long time no see.
I am thankful for what you did last time.

Ah..! Oh dear.
I have to request something of you urgently.
Some of my resistance soldiers that were captured by the Neth army are still being held as prisoners.
Please rescue my soldiers, {PLAYER_NAME}.

According to the survivors, some of my soldiers
are still being held by the Neth Army.

They are at the center of the enemy base, and
reinforced soldiers are guarding the base.
Can I ask you to save them?

{PLAYER_NAME}, there are enemy's magic squares
still remaining in the Edenberg city.

I tried my best to destroy it, but some of them are
cleverly hidden.

Those may weaken the power of our Goddesses.
It must be destroyed as soon as possible.
Hmm, that is strange.

{PLAYER_NAME} and soldiers must have
destroyed all the magic squares...

I still feel the aura of remaining 
magic squares... Hmm.. How come?

I am sorry but can you please check once more?
I will check the East side, you check the West side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_10.text:
Oh you are here, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I was thinking about something.

We are confronting the Neth Soldiers,
but brainwashed monsters are in our way.

Can you please destroy their 
brainwashing machines?

If their machines are destroyed, monsters
will probably fight with Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_11.text:
Enemy soldiers are in chaos due to
freed goblins.

It's downhill from here. Oh, this time
please destroy the ogres' brainwashing machine.

As there are many ogres, I expect some
positive outcomes from them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_12.text:
I was thinking about the dark energy.
I think I've felt that somewhere before...

Oh whatever! I need to research on that!
Let's go together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_13.text:
I think I remember something...
But it's not so clear... What is this?
Oh I can't get it... Hmm... Oh!!

I think it was from the brainwashed monsters
where I felt that dark energy!

So, {PLAYER_NAME} !
Let's go to see the monsters!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_14.text:
Oh, it's you {PLAYER_NAME}.
I have a favor to ask you.

Did you know that there are some 
Neth remnants raving out there?

They are causing much trouble 
near my hometown, Roman Empire.

They should not enter my country.
Please clear them near the border.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_15.text:
I knew you could easily handle it.
Oh, by the way did you hear that?

A troublesome demon is raving the
center of the city.

I bet you want to challenge him.
How about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_16.text:
By the way, {PLAYER_NAME}.
There were some troubles while you were away.

I know you would gladly help me
clear the Neth Army remnants. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_17.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, a powerful demon appeared
in the Edenberg.

I think Hellad is experimenting with something again.
Please hurry up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_1_.text:
It was you! I knew it!
You are well known for your ability!

The honorable name, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Wow, a good expression. I need to take notes.

Yes! I am done!
Can I request something?

It may be a liittle dangerous, but
I want to interview the Neth Army!!
Their pain... How they had to numb their feelings on command...

...and how they had to point guns at people
they loved! War!! I want an interview!!

So, no time to hesitate! Take me to them!
Hmm? Is it too dangerous?

Oh come on, that is why I am taking you
along as my bodyguard...

...Ooops! Nevermind!
Good reporters take big risks for interviews!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_2_.text:
Hmm, no this is not it.
There must be a story! Like forbidden love!

Or some veiled enmity! Conspiracy!
Ambitious ruler! No! Nothing!

Is it because they are just normal soldiers?
Maybe commanders can tell me more about it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_3_.text:
Oh you must be famous {PLAYER_NAME}.
Glad to meet you.

Oh why am I sighing?
Eh... Umm... That's....

Well okay I will tell you.
It's about the Neth army we are fighting.

I always hear this music when fighting with them.
I used to like that song when I was young.

I just can't stop thinking about it.
I am curious who is playing that music.

It resembles my old friend in hometown..
Can you figure it out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_4_.text:
Hey..{PLAYER_NAME}. Is this...?
Is she in the revolutionary army...?

She is my old friend and my first love.
I used to play music thinking of her.

I am sorry but can you deliver
this letter to her?

I wish I could do it myself,
but I don't think it's the right moment.
I will be playing music here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_5_.text:
Oh, it was him! My old friend!
He was my first love as well.

I thought I could never see him again
after I moved away when I was young..

I am so touched! He kept thinking of me!
{PLAYER_NAME}, please do me a favor.

This is a snack we used to eat
together. Can you give this to him?

I am waiting for the day when I can meet
him again after this war..!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_6_.text:
Yo,{PLAYER_NAME}. 
Can I ask you a favor?

I am producing weapons these days.
But I need much more iron.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_7_.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Long time no see since that demon case?

Oh, I explained thoroughly to that soldier.
Hmm? What's that look on your face?

Hmm, well whatever.
I am here to request something of you.

Have you seen a brainwashing machine
used by the Neth Army to tame monsters?

I don't know whether it is a magical or
scientific machine,

but I am so curious!
I need to do research and find out how it works.

So, to study on the method... Hmm? 
{PLAYER_NAME}? Where are you going?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_8_.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I am a priest in the Order of the Goddess.

I have a favor to ask you.
Dark energy is overwhelming the battlefield,

and it is torturing the soldiers. I must help.
Please guard me while I purify the energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_QUEST_9_.text:
Have you heard of my name?
What a great honor. Hehe.
Oh, the reason I am here is that

I found some strange diseases infecting
soldiers while treating them.

All the infected soldiers had met
the Neth Scientists.

I am sure that Scientists had done
something bad to them.

We have to stop the disease from spreading
further. Please kill the scientists.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_HARD_SUB_QUES.text:
Where are they coming from?..
Oh we have no time to waste.

{PLAYER_NAME}, the Neth remnants are
causing trouble in the battlefield.

We must suppress them before they
cause more damage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_10_001.text:
This is... secret mission document!
Soldiers must have been hiding this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_10_002.text:
Hmm, part of the document was burnt.
I can't recognize it..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_10_003.text:
Can you bring me something similar to this?
Please.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_002.text:
Phew, {PLAYER_NAME}!
It's so hard to meet you these days

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_003.text:
You must be very busy!
You didn't forget about me, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_004.text:
Oh no, I was so happy to see you that
I almost forgot what to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_005.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! I heard that the 
Neth army is capturing flame spirits

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_006.text:
to exploit them in war! So mean..!
I can't get flame spirit powers easily now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_11_007.text: So, can you free the flame spirits for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_12_002.text:
A lot of traders got hurt by the Neth army
on their way here. I'm so worried about them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_12_003.text: Can you please look for them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_13_001.text:
Anyways, Neth Soldiers are so cruel.
How can they hurt innocent civillians?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_13_002.text:
Oh I am so upset about this.
{PLAYER_NAME}, can you beat them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_14_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, greetings.
I belong to the Neth Resistance Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_14_002.text:
I have a favor to ask you! Some mysterious 
demon was found in the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_14_003.text:
It looks just like Yuria, when she turned into
a demon! Well, of course she is fine now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_14_004.text:
Anyway, that demon keeps disturbing us!
I don't know why, but please slay it for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_15_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, a demon appeared
in the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_15_002.text:
It looks like Dike, when he turned into a demon.
Where did it come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_15_003.text:
Anyway, we should kill that demon.
We can't loose any more soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_1_002.text:
The upper trade route had been blocked by 
the bad Neth Empire...! Oh my..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_1_003.text:
They are so bad! Please teach them some lesson!
Hurry up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_002.text:
The trade route is safe now, but we lack
supplies due to war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_003.text:
Everyone is suffering from lack of supplies,
they became so scarce and expensive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_2_004.text:
So, can you bring us some of the supplies
from the Neth army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_001.text:
Yo, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You are helping the alliance army these days?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_002.text: Then can I ask you a favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_003.text:
Oh! Wow, thank you!
The mechanic soldiers in the Neth Army,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_004.text:
can you bring their mechanic arms for me?
I am so anxious to see those!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_3_005.text:
Hmm? Are you asking me why?
All men love robots!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_4_001.text:
Oh, the mechanic arm was too complex.
But I did find out about the structure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_4_002.text:
The problem is, how to move them.
It is so heavy, I need a power source.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_4_003.text:
Can you bring me the robot soldiers?
Destroyed ones are okay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_001.text:
Hmm... The structure of the robot is fine.
However,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_002.text:
can you see the empty space here?
The power source is missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_003.text:
This empty space looks very odd.
There must be something special that fits here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_5_004.text: Hmm, can you bring me some fine power sources?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_002.text:
Oh right!
It's an honor to meet you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_003.text:
My name is Viper.
I am the captain of Neth resistance special forces.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_004.text:
I was in another country for my mission...
I have a problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_005.text:
Some guy was searching for me in the battlefield.
So I went to kill him myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_006.text:
Well... he was too strong for me to kill,
but I did succeed in injuring him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_007.text:
I tried to join the main troops after the fight,
but I had trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_008.text:
He keeps following me everywhere I go.
I have no idea how he came in,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_009.text:
but he attacks my tent in the middle of night
or attacks me while I am having a meal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_010.text:
Even when I am in the bathroom! 
I do always chase him away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_011.text:
I have to join the main army soon,
but this guy is bothering me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_012.text:
I want to give him some lessons,
but I am just too busy to do that myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_6_013.text:
He should be taking a rest in the Neth Army base
by now. Oh, his name was Spiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_7_002.text:
Actually he attacked me last night again.
I was very angry, so I countered him violently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_7_003.text:
He was bleeding a lot while running away. Sigh..
So I thought he would be resting at his base...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_7_004.text:
Hmm, can you please look for him again?
He may be hiding somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_001.text:
Oh, hello {PLAYER_NAME}!
I belong to the Neth Resistance Army!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_002.text:
I am asking a favor to those joining the battle
against the Neth Army!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_003.text:
It may be something small, but it is
very important to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_004.text:
After battle, please pick up the weapons 
or supplies dropped on the ground!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_8_006.text: We are short of supplies due to the extended war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_9_002.text:
Can you do me a favor?
It is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_9_003.text:
I heard you fight with the Neth executives
from time to time, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_QUEST_9_004.text:
Can you bring me some of their clothes?
I am planning to use it when I sneak in as a spy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_1_0.text:
You must be busy these days, but
can I ask you a favor?

Bring me weapons dropped in the
battlefield. I think I can fix them.

It may be helpful to our soldiers.
I must at least do something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_2_0.text: A demon appeared again! What's going on?

I think that sounds similar to what I have been
researching.

My name is Celine, a magician.
Keep going about what you were saying!

Why is the demon appearing again?
The dark energy is assumed to be the reason!

Excessive exposure to dark energy seems to
transform the human body.

As Neth Army is using the dark energy,
they must be turning into demons.

Also, that demon...
Oh wait maybe no. I need to research more...

Well anyways! Yes, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Please purify the energy and slay the demon!

Wait!
I found a solution to purify the dark energy.

{PLAYER_NAME}, let me go with you.
We must hurry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BATTLEFIELD_SUB_QUEST_3_0.text:
Another demon appeared in the battlefield.
It is a very violent one this time.

{PLAYER_NAME}, please hurry.
We must stop it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_001.text:
I brought you here because Athena asked me to...
But can you really remove the curse?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_002.text:
It was the curse that was not dispelled
even after killing hundreds of devils for several years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_003.text:
Too suspicious...
Why don't you trust your friend a little more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_004.text:
I believe in Athena.
It's you that I can trust.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_005.text: Bitter like a North Wind of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_006.text: By the way... Let's have look...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_007.text:
Whoa. Is this the man.
It sure is the awful curse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_008.text: Why was this person cursed to sleep forever?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_010.text:
Is it.
Well... Let's look into his spirit...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_011.text:
Spirit of the devil and... what?
I see the trace of mysterious sorcery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_012.text:
It's the forbidden spell. He was cursed 
instead of somebody else. And I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_013.text:
I can feel this spirit from you too.
It is faint but yes. It's the same.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_015.text:
Seems like you have two lives.
How dare you speak like that in front of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_016.text:
You can never talk like that about us.
You don't know how hard it was to overcome this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_018.text:
I also have gone through hard times
with only the smallest hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_020.text:
By the way. You are indeed very brave.
I can see that from the weapon heading me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_022.text:
I don't trust you completely.
If you do something weird you are..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_025.text:
Swallowing your tears again...
I promised you that I will hide you when you want to cry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_027.text: Was I asleep for a long time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_028.text:
Yes. 
You were... for several years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_029.text:
Was I... Then what happened while I was in deep sleep?
Devils and devil dragons?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_030.text:
Siegfried... I'm feel sorry that this is the first thing 
you get to know after you've woke up from years of sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_031.text: But I'm the Warrior who destroys devils.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_032.text:
I hide here to protect you.
But I can't anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_033.text:
The world is in chaos.
More and more devils are waking up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_034.text:
Sieg... Saying goodbye right after saying hello...
I hope we meet again someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_035.text: Sieg, if you are trying to stop me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_036.text:
Um? Why should I.
I just won't let you go by yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_038.text:
I left you alone for so long.
I can't make you fight all alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_039.text:
I will go with you Kriemhild.
My spear is still sharp enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_040.text: Ah... Can't be happier than this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_10_041.text:
Sleeping Beauty, no, Sleeping Prince it is.
Warriors chosen by Goddess are sticking together eventually...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0001.text:
Ever since we lost contact with Roland
I've been worried about him, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0002.text:
I cannot believe that the Order has stooped as low as this.
Their ways are unnecessarily cruel and vile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0003.text:
Or perhaps it is because they think of me as a heretic,
and dangerous threat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0004.text: I fear there is no need or desire for further talk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0005.text:
I am sorry... but please continue sleeping
until we find Roland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0006.text:
Anyway, this particular fighting style
is different from that of Heaven's Cavalry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0007.text:
And yet the Holy City should be guarded by Heaven's Cavalry...
Then who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0008.text:
Wait. I know you. Were you not once a member of the Cavarly...?
Surely you deserted the army and left for good...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0009.text:
Finally we have caught you at last!
We have received orders to execute the devilish heretic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0011.text:
Gasp...! A demon...
This is demonic power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0012.text: Hmm, she should be around here somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0016.text:
This scene brings tears to my eyes. How touching.
Stop making that face. She's waking up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0019.text:
Well, you're usually so meticulous.
So when

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0020.text: I sensed right away that you were in danger! Ahem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0021.text:
Thank you.
It is thanks to you I still live.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0022.text: It's a relief that you're still alive, Mel...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0023.text:
Huhu... I apologize for making you worry, Teresa.
But I must ask what brought you two here...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0024.text:
Demona came to tell us that you were in danger, Melissa.
That's why Teresa and I came right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0025.text:
Mm? Demona.
Did you go see the Night Witches on purpose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0026.text:
W-what. Stop staring at me like that.
I couldn't help it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0027.text:
I'm a demon, so if I'm caught in a trap
after breaking into the Order alone... It could be very dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0028.text:
If that demon asked for help by herself...
I would have never helped her, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0029.text:
Since she told me you were in danger... Hmmph.
I couldn't help but follow her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0030.text:
Huhu, I see.
Thank you both, Demona, Teresa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0031.text:
Hmmph...
Don't treat me like a child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0032.text:
Both of you have been of great help,
and will be in what lies before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0033.text:
The current Order of the Goddess is tainted
by cruelty and dogma, like rotten water in a still pond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0034.text:
There is a very high chance that 
Roland too is in great danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0035.text:
Let's go right away, then!
Roland is our friend, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0036.text:
That makes me wonder 
why the enemy did not kill me

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0037.text: when I lay unconscious and helpless before them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0038.text:
Maybe they already knew that the great Lord Demona
was coming for you! Nyahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0040.text:
(How strange...
I felt as if something were protecting me.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0041.text:
Melissa! Come on! 
Let's go rescue that potato of a man!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_11_0043.text:
So she is a demon after all.
And I thought she was only cute, how disappointing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0002.text:
Oh! I was researching the records of the Manacar excavation team
along with Roland...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0003.text:
And yet... I was attacked. But why?
We were only searching for the truth of the Order...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0004.text:
Roland...
Roland? Roland! Where are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0005.text:
Oh, soldiers of the Order of the Lion!
Please free me at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0006.text:
A tragedy shall strike the Order!
We must stop it before it does!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0007.text:
So the Saintess doesn't remember anything yet.
You should be scared of us even without  "tragedy."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0008.text:
Huh? Whatever do you mean?
We are of different orders, yes, but we are all under the same...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0009.text: ...! It was you who attacked us...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0011.text:
Boohoo, we're sorry, Saintess.
Maybe we hit you too hard when knocking you out! Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0012.text:
So now that she is aware of her situation...
A little bit of pain shall keep her quiet, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0013.text:
Oh, we shan't kill you, so don't worry.
We haven't received such orders. ...Yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0017.text: We locked him up for sure, but...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0018.text: You... What did you do to Saintess Maria...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0019.text:
Oho!
You haven't recovered your strength, have you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0020.text:
We received orders not to kill the Saintess...
but as we heard nothing about you, off you go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0021.text:
No! Stop! Please!
Leave Roland alone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0022.text:
Y-you'll have to deal with me
before you do anything to him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0023.text:
Bingo.
It seems like we've arrived at the right place, Melissa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0024.text:
Yes. 
Luckily we are not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0025.text:
A demon and a priestess in black robes...
You... must be the Black Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0026.text:
If you are wise, O Saintess, 
you will know that we are not the enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0028.text:
Saintess Maria?
You... you do not look so well. Why...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0029.text:
... Be quiet.
You're an idiot, Roland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0030.text: Huh. You know, usually I'm a fan of romance movies,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0031.text:
but this isn't the time for all this.We have to leave now. 
This place has already fallen to the hands of the enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0032.text:
Oh... Yes!
But before that... Thank you, for rescuing us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0034.text:
But enemy reinforcements should come soon.
What are we to do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0036.text:
They are searching for you in other places,
but if we leave, we shall be able to escape together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0037.text:
You must be confused,
but I'll explain as we go. Let us leave now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0038.text:
Yes! Let's go.
We entrust ourselves to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0039.text:
The darkness...
is revealing its claws more and more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_12_0040.text:
But fear not.
It is not the fate of that Saintess for her light to be extinguished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_001.text:
The tribe is now safe. Yet I am a coward, 
a dishonorable warrior who fled for his life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_002.text:
I will never be allowed to return
to my tribe again-woopa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_005.text: I- I beg for forgiveness, Chief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_006.text:
I abandoned the tribe in its
greatest hour of need,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_007.text:
and with it my honor as a warrior.
I have no right to remain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_008.text:
I will regard it as my punishment
never to return-woopa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_009.text:
Mamba.
... Yes, it is true that you fled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_010.text:
But when our tribe fell in danger afterwards
you returned of your own will,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_011.text:
saving the Woopa Tribe
from the looming evil spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_013.text:
It was not I,
but the foreigners who saved us-woopa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_014.text:
Yes. The foreigners are the ones
celebrated as the saviors of the Mountain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_015.text:
Yet was it not you who aided them
in their quest to save us all from doom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_017.text:
Mamba. You are a proud warrior
of the Woopa Tribe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_018.text:
Always remember. You are the hero
of the Woopa tribe: Woompa Mamba!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_020.text:
Mamba. If you ever need the aid
of the tribe, do not hesitate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_021.text:
For you are Mamba:
the hero of the Woopa Tribe: Woompa Mamba!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_024.text:
I am a mighty warrior
of the Woopa Tribe-woopa!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_13_025.text:
Let's look forward to future feats
of the mighty warrior Mamba.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_001.text:
Hmm... The signal is pointing
in this direction...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_002.text:
Living organism detected.
Strong life signals present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_003.text:
Ha! It was you!
You were the one detected by my signal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_004.text:
Okay, where is that old geezer... I mean,
your creator, Doctor Stein?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_005.text:
Battle initiated.
Switching to attack mode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_007.text:
Data collect?
Ugh, it can't be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_008.text:
That old geezer... is still
collecting data?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_009.text:
Argh!
I've lost my trail again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_010.text:
Oh! I know, I could use the trail of data
to locate him in reverse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_011.text:
Hmm... this shouldn't be too difficult...
If I track the data signal back to its origin...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_012.text:
Yes! Hee hee hee,
I've finally collected all the data I need!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_013.text:
Now, I can finally complete
the ultimate Sentinel...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_014.text:
I've found you at last!
You stupid old geezer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_015.text:
Helllllooooo, Professor.
Long time no see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_016.text:
You know, I never expected 'time traveling'
to be in the curriculum.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_018.text:
Have you followed your professor
out of a deep and unfaltering respect?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_019.text:
Ha, your goodie good student
is here to correct her loony teacher's wrongdoings!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_021.text:
Stop trying to model Sentinel
into a battle drone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_022.text:
I created Sentinel
to help those in need,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_024.text:
Hee hee hee...
You're still very behind, Stanya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_025.text:
Technology and machine must develop and advance!
Such evolution requires much data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_026.text:
And waging war is the fastest way
to collect such data. Hee hee hee...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_027.text:
Did you not see how I evolved Sentinel
into a nearly perfect weapon of war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_028.text:
Hee hee hee... You are smart, I admit that.
Yet foolish for not choosing the easy path!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_029.text:
Science and technology exist for the purpose
of helping human beings!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_030.text:
It is wrong to harm people
for the sake of their so-called progress!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_031.text:
I'd rather break everything into pieces
if it meant there would be one less weapon of destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_032.text:
It is only obvious
to sacrifice for the greater good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_033.text:
You will not go very far with that line of thinking,
Stanya. Hee hee hee...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_034.text:
I have upgraded Sentinel to this level
with all the data I could collect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_035.text:
And I have finished the plans
to mass-produce Sentinel Type: A.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_036.text:
The Sentinel Type: A drones have already
collected all the data I need!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_037.text:
With the technology of the future, my own genius,
and this horde of precious data,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_038.text: I will create the ultimate Sentinel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_039.text:
Ugh, old geezer...
You just don't get it, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_040.text:
I guess it's the role of the student
to clean up after her professor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_041.text:
What's this? A student's rebellion?
Hee hee hee... Well, no matter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_042.text:
I can simply move my laboratory somewhere else
and continue with my divine work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_043.text:
Do you really think I will let you go,
Professor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_044.text:
Hee hee hee... Sentinel A,
go and play with my student in my stead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_045.text:
I'm a busy man, you see - 
I must be off to make the ultimate Sentinel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_046.text:
Then see you later, my dear pupil!
Ta-ta! Hee hee hee!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_048.text:
Hmmph... Did he already escape?
That old geezer... I'll follow him to the end of the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_14_049.text:
I have a feeling that the student and the teacher
have switched their roles in some way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_001.text:
Containing the Neth Empire keeps
Hasla peaceful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_002.text:
If you cooperate with us, I'll reward you
handsomely. How about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_003.text:
Support from the Emperor will be a 
great asset to Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_004.text:
No matter how big the fortress is, 
people will suffer from extreme cold.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_006.text:
Nosgardians have gone through 
harsher winters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_008.text: I don't know how I feel about this handout.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_009.text: It's not just about the money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_010.text: Let's move on to another topic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_011.text:
Ah, have you been to the far east?
I've always dreamed of seeing the east sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_012.text:
That sea is full of the essence of 
Eastern sorcery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_013.text: Yeah! So I went for a trip to see it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_014.text:
It was such a long journey.
But it was worth it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_015.text:
How can a lord leave behind his country for 
such a stupid reason?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_016.text:
That was the whole reason I founded 
this empire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_017.text:
Neglecting the empire after founding 
it is irresponsible!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_018.text: Then what did you do for your country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_019.text:
I sacrificed myself to survive the
harsh winter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_021.text: Really...? Oh my, what a perfect shave!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_022.text:
It's not from shaving... The roots 
have vanished!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_023.text:
Your passion has melted the coldness
of Nosgard... You are a true man!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_024.text:
You're so generous...! Sorry for my 
behavior....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_025.text:
I'm sure that we are looking for 
the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_027.text:
I'll do whatever you ask! Even if my 
hair doesn't grow back...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_028.text:
Whoa, thanks! The North is all on you.
I trust you, bro!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_2_030.text: I've never seen someone so bald.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_001.text: I said!!! No more on credit!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_002.text:
Hmm? I thought you said I can eat
whatever I want without money...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_003.text:
That.. was... All right!
Let me be honest with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_004.text:
I thought you were some high level 
government official in Trista!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_005.text:
Are you sure of that??
You are always fooling around every day,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_006.text:
never pay your bills on time, and all you do is
just flirt with women in the village!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_007.text:
I feel so sad that your cute face is full of anger,
you little cutie pie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_008.text:
Well, I was a high level official in Trista.
I was in charge of the whole desert area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_009.text:
I just got so tired of that old cardinal,
and decided to quit my job long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_010.text: ...Which means, that you are jobless now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_011.text:
Ahem! Listen further. As you insist, I was 
living... I mean, enjoying my idle life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_012.text:
Then suddenly, a war broke out by Neth Empire!
They invaded my country!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_013.text:
Making things worse, our king passed away during
the war. The tension was at its peak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_014.text:
So, I returned to support the situation.
However, I met my woman of destiny there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_015.text:
I made a resolve, to live the rest of my life with her!
After the war ended, I joined the Musketeers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_016.text:
Sigh... How was my story? Beautiful, right?
Now you may feel the greatness of myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_017.text: Aha, I see. So you are the Musketeers -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_018.text:
...Do you think I believe that? Musketeers?
One of the famous 4 people in Trista??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_019.text:
Yes!! Although I am living like this after 
Cardinal gave me some weird mission....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_020.text:
Yeah right! I am sure that you 
have a great talent in making up stories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_021.text:
I heard from the traveling merchant,
that he should be here somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_022.text:
...Am I seeing an illusion? 
My Goddess of dreams, she is here..!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_023.text:
Those sharp eyes, shiny lips...
Oh my Goddess, this better not be a dream!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_024.text:
What brought you all the way here,
my darling?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_025.text:
...Because you disappeared all of a sudden
and never came back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_026.text:
Did you worry about me, darling?
Awww, I am so touched.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_027.text:
Oh stop chatting, I have something important 
to tell you. Pssst, come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_028.text:
Ahh finally! You are whispering your love to me?
Darling?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_029.text:
Neth Empire soldiers are in Trista.
We need your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_030.text:
...What? They invaded again? I thought the Cardinal
signed a cease-fire agreement with them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_031.text:
No, it is a different case this time.
They came to ally with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_032.text:
Neth Empire announced war toward entering Hasla.
The Cardinal is on the Neth's side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_034.text:
Yes, Musketeers have decided to
resist the Kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_036.text:
Ah, so end of my idle life. Darling,
let's go back together to our homeland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_037.text:
What is King Abel thinking about?
Why is he letting the Cardinal have his own way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_038.text:
To resist the Kingdom, like darling said,
we need more ally. I am stopping by the deserts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_039.text:
As you say. I am going back to Trista first
and join the rest of Musketeers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_040.text: Wh..What? Was he really one of the Musketeers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_3_042.text:
Chessmen of the war are gathering up now...
Now the pain of the world will begin, soon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_001.text:
Thank you for answering my invitation, General.
I apologize for the lack of formality; the issue was urgent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_002.text:
Let me introduce myself:
I am Himiko, Priestess of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_003.text: And this is my guard, Susanoo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_004.text:
Greetings, Priestess. Although I must say 
this meeting is not the trialogue I desired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_005.text:
I did send an envoy to Chen, only to receive a reply
that attendance would be difficult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_006.text: Wait! Step aside! I am the delegate of Chen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_007.text:
Ah... the daughter of Chen's Chief General. She charges 
forth as she did as the vanguard, on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_008.text:
Oh? Did I? Trivial matters aside, 
I'm here today in the place of my father!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_009.text:
As the representative of all kingdoms have arrived,
I shall begin the conference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_010.text:
Long have our lands of the East been burdened by strife,
deteriorating under internal conflict and external threat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_011.text:
Perhaps that is why no one noticed beforehand
the seed of evil growing secretly among us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_012.text:
Priestess, please stop beating around the bush
and tell us the reason why we're here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_013.text: I don't know when they will be after me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_017.text:
It was amidst this turmoil that the shoguns of Ryu
were each claiming themselves as the owner of the lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_019.text:
His name is Oda Nobunaga. Before he used to be
an honorable lord of Ryu, respected for his abilities,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_020.text:
but ever since visiting the Primal Volcano
he has been calling himself 'Lord of the Sixth Heaven'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_021.text: declaring that he will conquer the East.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_022.text:
At first, I ignored him for a mere fool...Yet my intuition
continues to insist there is more evil to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_023.text:
The destiny of the Eastern lands is under evil threat...
And Oda is surely at the center of the flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_024.text:
For the sake of us all I ask you for an armistice.
We must unite to overcome this new evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_025.text:
I agree - peace has always been my desire.
Yet I am not so sure about Chen's motives...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_029.text:
But of course!
I'm just a girl who loves peace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_030.text:
Hmm, that is the funniest joke 
I have heard this entire year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_031.text:
Shhh!! General, please stop there.
You know we could become famil...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_032.text: Oh, excuse me. Never mind about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_033.text:
... I do not know what your motives are,
but dare not think of playing tricks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_034.text:
Oh, come on! You think too much, General!
Priestess! This way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_036.text: Are you fine with this, General?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_037.text: ....Alright. I will trust her this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_038.text:
Now, let us announce the armistice
of the Eastern kingdoms...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_040.text: Huh?! How did you find me here...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_042.text:
You must return home at once.
The General Most Honored is very worried.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_043.text:
I said, let me go!! I have to sign the treaty!
That's the only way I can marry Altair...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_045.text:
Thank you for your time, Priestess.
Let us see each other on the battlefield, next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_046.text:
Arrrrggghhh!!! It's ruined! Everything's ruined!
It was the best chance for the Eastern kingdoms to unite!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_048.text:
Sigh... Fine. I have to accept the fact
that the armistice was an unrealistic hope at this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_049.text:
Let us return to Ryu.
We must try to solve this by ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_051.text:
You must mean... Saiga.
Yes. Let us go, Priestess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_4_052.text:
Will the destiny of the East end as
an alliance? Or destruction?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_001.text:
Thank you for your help.
If it weren't for you,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_002.text:
the enemy would have invaded all the way
to the alliance headquarter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_003.text:
It was a matter of course, as the member of
alliance army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_004.text:
Oh you were that magician who helped to
save our King, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_005.text:
We always appreciate your hard efforts.
Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_006.text: By the way, the knight here is..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_007.text:
Hmm, that is very odd that I didn't 
recognize such a great knight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_008.text:
Excuse me, but who are you? 
Which family are you from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_011.text:
...And you had already been rude enough.
Excuse me for leaving first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_015.text:
Who are you..!? Why do you have the
same kind of aura like him..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_016.text:
I want to ask you first. Who are you? 
Why are you saying such nonsense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_017.text:
I would like to refuse it you want to
become friends with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_018.text: Wait! Aren't you related with Soltar!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_020.text:
I apologize to you for my rudeness.
Let me introduce myself first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_021.text:
My name is Archon. I can't tell you
everything but my mission is

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_022.text:
to stop Soltar, the demonic monarch
who became corrupted by evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_025.text:
Hmmph! How can my ancestors 
leave me with someone like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_027.text: Yes. I am the descendant of Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_029.text:
So you were a descendant of Soltar...
That's why...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_030.text:
...I fought with Soltar many times.
Your fencing skills were similar to his.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_032.text:
You want to fight with me too, just 
because my ancestor is a cursed monarch?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_034.text:
Sigh... I don't want you to misunderstand me.
So let me tell you first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_035.text:
I hate Soltar more than anyone. My family
scattered everywhere because of him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_036.text:
However, the only true owner of Valencia 
is the Ferdinando family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_037.text:
I will gather power and return to my homeland,
as the ultimate savior of Valencia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_038.text:
I can feel your strong will.
Soltar used to be like you long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_039.text: What do you mean by that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_041.text:
But do be careful.
You must not lose your faith from power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_5_043.text:
My age...?
Oh I feel sleepy, get out of here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_001.text:
I obtained power to defeat the demons
when I came back from death 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_002.text:
But my life destroyed by demons
never came back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_003.text: If I could rest in peace with all the demons...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_004.text:
I thought the world would be peaceful
as I sealed all the demons with myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_005.text:
I guess I was wrong.
The future is tough and hostile...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_006.text:
How can law or money stop the 
demon slayer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_007.text: We shall go back for now, Kriemhild.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_008.text:
But remember this.
The world is in a volatile situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_010.text:
I sense demons everywhere in this village.
Woman, what is going on here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_013.text: I am a dream walker and demon slayer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_014.text:
You are Beatrice..! I can't believe
I met you here. Interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_016.text:
I am Athena, the Saintess of Battlefield.
Also, the delegate of the Roman Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_017.text: I was looking for you, Beatrice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_018.text:
The saintess from 100 years ago,
let me ask you one thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_019.text:
According to a myth, you can slay
demons in human spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_021.text:
To answer that, yes I can.
...As long as I still remember the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_022.text:
Great to hear that. Then, please 
lend me your power Beatrice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_025.text:
Hmm, I see.
Okay, I will try to wake him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_026.text:
He is not interested in the human's war.
But the case of demons is different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_028.text:
Also, if you are okay, may I take you
Roman? Don't you feel uncomfortable here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_030.text: I can't do anything here without money.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_031.text:
Haha! Don't worry about that. Roman soldiers 
don't measure your value by money.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_032.text:
I see, Roman...
Still very honorable even without the King.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_033.text: Then, all right. Guide me please, Athena.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_034.text: ...Do I have the records of 100 years ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_035.text:
Of course. All events are recorded in the
Library of Time. Everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_6_036.text:
However this dimension....
Yes, this is a secret for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_001.text:
Lionel, you skipped your dinner today.
You also seem to have trouble sleeping...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_003.text:
What do you mean by that?
I raised you since you were young!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_004.text:
Oh my, what happened to you?
Your face looks so pale and tired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_006.text:
I know there is a problem.
What is it, Lionel?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_007.text: I lived my entire life abominating Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_008.text:
But, what if Soltar turned out to be somewhat
different from what I belived him to be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_010.text:
It's...
I met a woman in Edenberg...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_012.text:
Why didn't you tell me earlier?!
You are such a bad boy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_013.text:
Aria! I am not a boy anymore!
I thought I told you many times...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_014.text:
Hmmph! It's just between you and me. 
There's nobody around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_015.text: Anyway, I have something to tell you as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_016.text: What is it? Do you know anything about this, Aria?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_017.text: Lionel, everyone has their own star.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_018.text:
A person with a strong will can shine brightly
while others lose their power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_019.text: Aria, I don't really care about the brightness of stars...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_020.text:
...and Soltar's star,
must have been the brightest one recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_022.text: You mean that Soltar was in fact a great lord?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_023.text:
No, that is not true. Soltar's star has been
gone for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_024.text: However, for sure he had his brightest era.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_025.text:
Hmph! Anyways, he is the enemy of 
Valencia right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_026.text:
Aria, I don't really know much about the stars,
but I will never become corrupt as Soltar did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_027.text:
Of course. Your star is shining like the brightest star
in Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_028.text: I will be guiding your way forever as always.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_029.text: Then, why don't we go out for dinner today?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_7_030.text:
....{PLAYER_NAME}.
Please look for the star of Pandora if you go out at night.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_001.text:
Notice from the Empire...
Then they want to make the androids?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_002.text:
Yes sir! If there are newly developed
androids, our Empire can win the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_004.text:
I thought I told you that I am not making any more
androids. I will flee the country if you force me again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_006.text:
Hmph, humans are so self-centered.
They never think of the consequences of their power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_009.text:
Subject identified. Deactivating the booster.
Launch accomplished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_012.text: Nothing. I accidently pressed the emergency button.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_013.text:
What?
Okay, then I wlll deactivate the alarm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_014.text:
New android? Who are you?
Why are you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_015.text:
I am here of my own free will.
I was looking for you, my master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_017.text:
Hmm.. You do look similar to the android
which I created before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_018.text: But that android must have been destroyed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_019.text:
My name is R-0.
I woke up in Load Industry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_020.text: However, I had saved data regarding you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_021.text:
Hmm... must have restored the destroyed data.
What a waste of resources!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_022.text:
So, why are you here?
How dare you do that as an android.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_023.text:
I am an android.
Androids follow orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_024.text:
However, I can think and act by myself.
Then, I am not an ordinary android?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_025.text:
Who am I?
Why did you make me like this, Master?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_026.text:
Let me explain, R-0.
I did not program you like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_027.text:
You were just one of my ordinary 
android projects, which I had to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_028.text:
But humans are jealous of unidentifiable technologies.
So, I decided to stop the project and destroy you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_029.text:
...But how could you have developed yourself,
without any assistance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_030.text:
I shall acknowledge you, as a special being.
You are a special android, R-0.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_032.text:
Then, why am I so special?
Special means, being different from others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_033.text:
Being different from others means that I am lonely.
Why am I supposed to be special?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_035.text:
R-0, your speculative attitude proves the significance
of your existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_036.text:
I do not understand what you are saying.
Lack of data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_037.text:
You won't be able to for a while.
Even I do not understand the meaning completely…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_040.text:
You better leave, R-0.
Come back after you've gained some knowledge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_041.text:
Affirmative.
Expected return date is.... about 2897001 seconds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_043.text:
I feel like I have a new friend now,
in this boring world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_8_044.text: ...I hope there is a talking robot in Pandora as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_003.text:
R-0 appeared. This is a mission.
Destroyed. Completely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_004.text:
(Slight damage detected.
But assumes that power output is better here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_005.text:
89% chance of success when strike occurs before
the enemy attacks.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_007.text:
(New enemy has arrived. V Data loading...
... Madness confirmed. Strong.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_008.text:
(Only 35% chance to escape 
during 2:1 fight. Red alert.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_009.text:
I came here with no stop. 
After you have defeated me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_010.text:
This is a perfect time to destroy your wings
with my beam slicer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_011.text:
Just imagining it makes my power source go mad!!!
Might cause an error.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_012.text:
Obstacle.
High chance of failing the mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_014.text:
I'm Monte Cristo.
I will. Destroy. R-0.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_015.text:
What a dumb piece of tin...
Not every Android is the same dude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_016.text:
Get out of my sight. You are annoying.
It's my duty to destroy R-0!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_017.text:
Obvious interruption. Makes it impossible 
to destroy R-0. Target Change. Destroy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_018.text: I will smash this noisy tin robot fist!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_019.text:
(I'm out of their sight. Change plan. 
99% chance of win!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_020.text:
