Enemy. Out of control.
R-0. Disarm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_022.text:
Scanning enemy... Damage rate 89%.
It should have stopped operating. But why...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_026.text:
R-0. Battle-ready. Target. Berserk-V.
Destroy it completely this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_027.text:
R-0. No matter how many times you 
destroy me, I will keep coming after you!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_028.text:
You are in an abnormal state.
Why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_029.text:
The source of power is deep within my heart, 
if you need to know. I feel rage deep inside of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_030.text:
I have had this feeling since the moment I was created...
It won't stop until I destroy you!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_031.text:
I can't understand. That is not how Androids work.
You are just like humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_032.text:
Human...?
You can feel the actual anger...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_033.text:
YES!!!
I feel anger from every part of me towards you!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_035.text:
Are you fleeing again...
Let's end this now!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_036.text:
You have something that I don't have.
After I find it. I will come back and destroy you. V.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_9_037.text:
R-0. When she recognizes the meaning of her existence...
Every Android will face a great change...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0001.text:
Hey you! Are you ready? Your code 
name will be selected after this match.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0004.text:
Well, I'm always ready. 
Please start before I go insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0005.text:
Gee, you guys don't have any manners.
Well, let's start!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0010.text:
Yippee!!! I won!
I'm Space Cadet B!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0012.text:
Such a fiery showdown!
The blue one wins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0013.text:
I'm not the blue one anymore dude!
I'm Space Cadet B!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_1_0014.text: ...Huh. I always wondered why Black was K.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_2_0003.text:
How can you shirk your training 
and goof off!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_2_0007.text:
As the leader of the Space Cadets, 
I'm so disappointed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_2_0008.text:
Blah Blah Blah.
It's time to go home Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_2_0009.text:
Oh! Time to go home. Let's leave
the rest for tomorrow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_2_0010.text:
Bye captain! 
I'll be late tomorrow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0001.text:
Pink...! I like Pink! 
Please let me be Pink!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0003.text: Then you should've told me sooner...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0004.text: But...! The Captain already decided everything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0006.text:
It was all decided while I was at lunch,
this isn't fair!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0007.text: Pink!!! I want Pink or I'm leaving!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0010.text:
I want Pink!!! Pink!! 
Pink or I quit!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_3_0013.text:
Fine!!! I'll let you be Pink!!!
Please let go of my pants!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_1.text: So... you mean that person is the bad girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_11.text: And indeed, she really looks like the bad guy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_12.text: Well then let's get rid of her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_17.text:
We fight for good people!
We are here to punish the bad guys!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_19.text:
Ugh, don't pretend to be innocent.
Mark on your arms tell us that you are the bad one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_2.text:
Yes! 
I had a hard time finding the truth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_20.text: What do you know about  me!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_21.text:
Shut your mouth if you don't know 
how hard my life was due to this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_22.text:
Please don't get in my way again.
Or else...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_23.text:
What the!
You said she is the bad guy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_24.text:
Then why is she saying so!
Y! Was it the right information?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_25.text:
What? You don't trust me?
My information is always accurate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_26.text: Then tell me what she has done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_27.text:
She made all other girls sidekicks by her 
tremendously beautiful appearance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_29.text:
And that look. Eyes with tears and that touching smile, 
it captured every boy's attention!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_3.text: She has done so many bad things!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_31.text: Don't you understand how cruel she was?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_32.text:
OMG!
She is such a bad girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_35.text:
Well... 
Maybe... beauty can be a sin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_36.text:
If then... I'm such a heinous criminal...
What is that look!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_5.text: As I heard she is such a bad girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_6.text:
Look at her arms! 
You see that demon's mark?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_4_1_9.text: Gee, none of your beeswax girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_10.text: So, are you sure this time, Y?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_11.text:
I'm 200% sure!
I saw it by myself this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_16.text:
You can hold on to your hand 
if you want to kill your colleague... She might suffocate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_2.text: OMG! That must be the bad guy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_21.text:
Stop that noise!
We might get caught!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_22.text:
What's with that colorful tights...?
Are they dead to shame?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_23.text:
Seems like groups of idiots.
You guys are lucky today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_24.text: I'm not in the mood to fight someone today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_25.text:
Get out of my way immediately!
Then I will let you guys walk away alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_26.text:
That dialogue doesn't fit with bad guys.
That's what we are trying to say young man!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_27.text:
Come on! You dishonored us, Space Cadet! 
I can't forgive you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_32.text:
Feels like the devil's mark has been weakened.
Well... feeling is feeling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_37.text:
OMG. K, I thought you were strong.
But... I guess not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_39.text:
Why? Did I say something wrong?
What's wrong with him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_4.text: What is that attitude to your BFF!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_45.text:
Um... 
Space Cadet P indeed was a vituperator.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_46.text: Well... but this is not the important part.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_47.text:
They act like they have infinite life or something...
Sure they are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_5.text: FYI, I don't care what you think of me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_6.text: Ugh. Hope I can kill him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_8.text:
Be quiet!
We might get caught!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_5_1_9.text: Hey, you are the one who is yelling!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0001.text:
Ah... You know, I usually decline such requests,
but since Red went down on his knees for this... I guess I'll do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0002.text:
Oi, Red. What got into ya?
Aren't you usually high and mighty to the rest of us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0003.text:
Huhu... Guardians of justice
must know when to kneel for a greater purpose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0004.text:
If through my small sacrifice the rest of us can listen to Captain's 
famous lesson of justice...! Then I can kneel a thousand times over...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0005.text:
This is the true heart of the Gatcha Rangers!
This is what you call passion for justice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0006.text:
Yeah, well...
If you can call throwing a tantrum before your retired captain passionate....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0007.text: Uh, Red... That doesn't sound too mature, ya know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0008.text:
C-Captain! You broke our promise not to tell!
Can you call yourself a man after this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0009.text:
Eh? Oh, I guess I spilled the beans.
Sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0010.text:
Anyway, what you all came for is my lesson, right?
So what do you wanna know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0011.text:
Ya may be retired, but once a captain, always a captain.
Could ya maybe act like one and toughen the rest of us up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0012.text:
I'm embarrased to admit it, 
but among us there are slackers... and tattlers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0013.text:
But they should straighten up
if you tell them so as our Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0014.text:
We are the Gatcha Rangers - 
the guardians of peace, with a burning heart for justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0015.text:
We cannot forget our mission
to always think of justice and strive to protect peace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0016.text:
If anyone threatens to tarnish the honor of the Gatcha Rangers...
He will become the Friend Shield's sacrifice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0017.text:
G-gasp!
Please... I beg you, not that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0018.text:
Huhu.... You are fools, throwing away your lives for something silly
 like justice... I shall continue to spare you if only for that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_002_6_0019.text:
...The Evil Overlord of Darkness is very hardworking.
Is that why he can manage to be an Evil Overlord?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_1_0003.text:
We finally meet again...!
I'm so happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_1_0004.text: We've fulfilled our promise to each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_1_0006.text:
We've become the under bosses of 
our gang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_1_0013.text:
I'm Maxi! The world's most beautiful sheriff!
I chase bad boys!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0001.text:
Choose! If you become a sheriff, 
you'll be provided with a salary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0002.text:
Don't fall for it!
Let's be outlaws!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0003.text:
Uh... I've never thought about 
a career...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0004.text: You fool! Outlaws always end up in jail!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0005.text:
You'll never know how it feels 
to be an outlaw.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0011.text:
Three!!!
Hi, handsome boys, I'd like to join!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_2_0012.text: Oopsy! Maxi...? Why are you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_001.text:
Long time no see everybody!
Been in the desert a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_004.text: I missed you so much Anut!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_005.text:
Haha, you're lively.
The desert is all on you guys!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_008.text:
Oh, such a passionate reaction.
Let's work hard for world peace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_010.text:
When did they become stupid...?
Oh well, dinner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_013.text:
I'm not perfect you know.
I might say something... very stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_014.text:
Such as... I would like a Sandworm
for dinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_3_020.text: Feels like its getting hot in here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0001.text: Hello! I'm a reporter from Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0003.text: There's a real master in my neighborhood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0004.text: Let's have an interview with him!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0005.text:
Huh... are you sure that I won't get 
revealed right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0006.text:
I'm your elderly neighbor, the 
legendary magician!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0008.text:
I wandered around when I was young...
But finally I realized that family matters a lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0009.text: Oh. So you weren't fleeing someone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0010.text: Or just returning home after defeating your rival?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0012.text:
Ah ha! Then I think this will be it for 
the interview.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0013.text: He returned home all of a sudden!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0014.text:
For the real scope, let's have an 
interview with his neighbor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0015.text: Hello! You know a lot about the old man, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0016.text: Yep. I live right next to him. Obviously!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0017.text: Then why don't you tell us about him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0022.text:
Does he do bizarre experiments 
every night?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0026.text: I heard that Hasla Monthly had an issue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0027.text:
You guys distorted the facts for 
the publicity, huh???

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_1_0028.text: And that reporter seems to be the worst.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0001.text:
Hello, here comes the 
"Celebrity of the Month"!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0002.text: A round of applause for the winners!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0003.text:
We have two winners, and today, we will be having
a competition between the two winners!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0004.text:
What a joke. How dare you 
challenge my popularity!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0005.text: Whatever, you look like a talking pumpkin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0008.text: You're the ugliest boy I've ever seen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0011.text:
Make him or her make a choice 
between the two.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0016.text:
You've been chosen to be the one to pick
the most popular person in the village!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0018.text: So I have to pick between the two?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0019.text: Yep that's right! So, your choice is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0021.text:
No need to worry friend. 
Beauty lasts forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0022.text:
Don't listen to him. Just make 
your choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0024.text: A real man won't abandon me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0025.text:
Make a choice! My beauty can 
cure anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0026.text: Don't be tricked. Look at me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0029.text: I vote for you! You're my type.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0031.text: Haha. My beauty works for everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0032.text: This is it for you, pumpkin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0035.text: I know a perfect little bar for us. Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0036.text:
So the handsome youth became the 
most popular person of the month!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0037.text: Please give a round of applause!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_2_0039.text: I've never seen anyone like him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0001.text:
Hi, guard! You seem to be popular 
with the ladies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0002.text: So, here I am to interview you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0007.text:
The so called "Goddess fan club"!!! 
They're driving me crazy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0008.text:
It's such a tough job to guard the
Goddesses all the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0015.text:
Oops... There's always someone 
doing the dirty work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_3_0016.text:
Please cheer the guard up when 
you see him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0001.text:
I've heard that there is an 
extraordinary newspaper delivery man!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0002.text:
Hey there! Are you waiting for the 
newspaper?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0003.text:
Oh yes, today's newspaper hasn't 
arrived yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0005.text:
Ah, nope. I just wanted to get my 
newspaper as early as possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0006.text: If I stand here and wait...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0007.text:
And... Ta da! He vanishes after 
delivering the newspaper!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0010.text: I think he's as good as Gale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0011.text:
That warrior named Hanzo... 
He's great!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_4_0012.text:
Will he deliver newspapers all the 
way here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0004.text:
Uh? Did you say you want to spread 
your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0005.text:
My company is starting a
public relations firm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0006.text:
We're currently just a delivery company,
but that means we can spread the word really quickly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0010.text: We'll spread the word faster than anyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0011.text:
Come on!
Do you know the Succubus troupe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0014.text:
I don't usually tell people that...
It's just to help your decision...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0016.text:
I should get at least 20,000 gold...
But I'll do it for half!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0021.text: Wait! There's an illegal deal going on here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0023.text: You can't run a business without a license!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0024.text:
It's not illegal! I was just about to get a 
license!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0026.text: You're about to piss me off!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0028.text:
Always talk to your lawyer before you make that sort of
deal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_5_0029.text:
By the way... I thought the Witch delivery 
trainee was just some young girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0001.text: Today... My dream will come true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0003.text:
Viper gave me a present...!
What an honor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0004.text: You should take off your mask and eat it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0005.text:
Nope...! 
I will preserve this food forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0009.text: Punish me for being so rude...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0010.text:
No it's okay...
Just help yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0016.text: Viper, I thank you so much for the food.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0019.text: I think I fell in love...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_002.text:
Today, Hasla's number one dance 
festival, 'Just Dance!' is being held!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0020.text: Oh no! Mission code 321 has failed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_0024.text: Are you curious about Spyro's real face?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_003.text: Let's see how hot the dancers are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_004.text:
This dancer is dancing with her soul!
She's one of the top contenders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_005.text:
Next is... Miss Banshee!
Beautiful as always, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_006.text: Oh my, her dance is quite normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_007.text:
But her beauty is 
overwhelming the crowd!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_008.text:
That's not fair! This is a dance 
competition!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_009.text:
You should have made sure you were
pretty first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_011.text: I, as the defending champion, will show my stuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_013.text: Where is this song coming from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_014.text:
Uh.. can I join...?
Wait, Palaku???

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_6_016.text:
Then... Palaku the elephant wins the 
competition?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_001.text:
Hi! 
I'm back again with more pleasure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_002.text: I'm here to deliver a warm story.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_003.text:
Popular musicians of Hasla are
holding the fundraising live concert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_004.text:
So now!
I'll introduce you to the musical feast!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_005.text:
Is everyone here?
I'm really glad that so many people are here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_006.text:
I'm Kano, magician of dream and hope!
I'll sing sincerely with my heart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_007.text:
I'm Dara.I hope everyone is
happy with a beautiful melody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_008.text:
I'm Lee!
I'll dance like a beautiful butterfly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_010.text: We hope everybody will be touched by us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_011.text:
Thanks for your support and love...
Live.. Start!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_013.text:
You will never ever survive with
that tickling music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_014.text:
In this heartless, war-like world...
Music is our life! With our hot blood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_016.text:
I will show you the REAL music.
Everybody listen!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_7_018.text:
Where are you going!
Listen to my song!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0001.text:
Good morning, Hasla! It's the Reporter of Hasla Monthly, 
come to deliver news around the continent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0002.text:
Right now I am in the Headquarters of the Valencia Navy - 
yes, Valencia, the country famous for its beautiful ocean!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0003.text:
We have received reports of a mysterious, supernatural creature
living in this area...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0004.text:
Ah, here comes our informant now.
Please tell me more about your story!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0005.text:
Well. There is this... creature...
that looks very strange, neither a full human being or full fish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0006.text:
Our captain, Admiral Scarlet, returned with it one day
and now it dwells in the Navy Headquarters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0007.text:
Well! This sounds very interesting. 
Could we go and see for ourselves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0008.text:
The creature is very shy, but...
There is a way, as it loves all types of fruit. We could lure it outside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0011.text:
Miss Seiren!
Here is some fruit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0012.text: Hmnya nya... I like fruit! Fruit yummy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0013.text:
How fascinating!
Excuse me, do you have time for an interview?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0015.text:
What is all this noise?
The Navy Headquarters is not an amusement park, madam.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0016.text:
Ah, good afternoon! I'm the Reporter of Hasla Monthly.
I came after receiving a report of a fascinating creature!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0017.text:
"Report"?...
And who is the fool who made that "report"?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0018.text:
Uh. 
Th-the officer standing behind m...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0019.text:
"Mysterious creature?"
You insult her. Sir, Miss Seiren is my guest of honor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0020.text:
Is it the way of the Valencian Navy
that we treat guests of honor in such a rude way? Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0021.text:
I-I only thought Miss Seiren very fascinating... 
I-I meant no harm. I beg your forgiveness!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0023.text:
It seems you require more firm training. 
Sir, follow me outside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0025.text:
Oh, and Miss Reporter?
Throw away that "special" report.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0026.text:
If your report brings any harm to the Navy of Valencia
or Miss Seiren, you shall pay. Do you understand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0028.text:
Hmmm?
So what do I talk about? Heehee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0029.text:
Uh, n-nothing. Nothing at all.
H-have a good day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_8_0031.text:
Fruit...
Hmm. I feel hungry all of a sudden. Hmm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_1_0004.text: Pii pii!! Pii hee pii pii!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_1_0007.text: Thank you all for the opinions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_1_0008.text:
Gathering all the opinions is very 
important meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_1_0010.text:
Okay, meow!
I'll tell Lednas about the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_1_0011.text:
Meetings over! 
Let's eat something delicious meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0007.text:
I need your help!
This cat is trying to tell me something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0013.text:
Well, there appears to be a problem with the
tax collection and distribution network.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0014.text:
So to improve it...
Huh? What's wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0015.text: I didn't expect that to be the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0016.text: I thought the cat just didn't like the fish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0017.text: Never judge a book by its cover...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0018.text: Too smart to be a cat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_2_0019.text: And I thought I'd seen everything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0004.text:
My lovely cutie cats!
Come here, play with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0005.text: Are you insane! I'm not a cat meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0008.text:
What is it!!! 
I'm not a cat meow!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0009.text:
Are you talking, cutie???
So adorable...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0011.text: Stop human. I'm not a cat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0012.text: That tail... It's the cutest thing I've ever seen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0013.text:
You have a tail and cutie ears,
how can you say you're not a cat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0014.text:
Stupid human, I'm fox! 
I'm more of a dog than a cat!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_3_0016.text:
People are too stupid to notice 
that a fox is a canine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_011.text:
What is wrong?
Lednas seems to be somewhat confused!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_012.text:
Oh, PoPo!
Please help me out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_013.text:
I think sir Meowcat and Muscat seems to be very mad.
However, I just cannot understand what they are saying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_014.text:
Ah ha!
Let me give you a hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_015.text:
All right, what's the matter everyone!
I think I can help you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_019.text:
Oh, go somewhere else for a love quarrel!
I am single myself! Ha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_020.text:
Lednas, say something!
They are just having an argument!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_022.text:
Popo is mad! 
Take it easy! Whatever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_026.text:
....Since when were they together...?
Oh my god...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_4_027.text:
But... Who is male and who is female? 
Pandora doesn't know..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_001.text:
Meow, watch carefully before I come back!
Meeeoww...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_003.text: You should pay for it if something is lost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_005.text: Then, I'll be back soon! Meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_006.text: No wonder, PoPo is exploiting ToTo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_007.text:
This is animal abusing to wait forever 
until the owner comes back !!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_011.text: Yes, ToTo is free at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_012.text:
Let me run away before PoPo comes back...
ToTo, you run away too!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_015.text: No, this is not time to play around...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_017.text:
She came back already! 
ToTo, I am leaving now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_020.text: Hmm.. Is it just my feeling?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_021.text: Anyway, I bought a toy for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_5_024.text:
...That creature, is quite cute.
It's a little bit of a surprise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_001.text:
Lupeow! Long time no see!!
You look good meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_002.text:
Of course! Peow peow!
I'm the Phantom thief of the era.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_003.text:
In that sense.
I thank everybody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_004.text: I feel better now that you feel good meow!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_005.text: By the way what's up for today meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_006.text:
Well... 
I'm thinking of something very interesting peow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_007.text:
Interesting?
Is there a new mouse toy? Meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_009.text:
Lu...Lupeow are you serious...?
Transforming Kings of Hasla into Meowcats?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_010.text: Don't you think it's a great idea peow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_011.text:
If we team up with the Kings of Hasla...
Hasla will become Meow Meow Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_013.text:
So good peow peow.
Mew. Make a lot of fish bread!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_014.text:
Making fish bread is not a problem meow!
But how are you going to make the Kings eat it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_015.text:
Well, sneaking into the palace is just a 
piece of cake for me peow peow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_016.text:
Just let me do this peow.
First target is Thor of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_017.text:
Imagine cute cat ears on that 
smooth bold head!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_018.text:
Fine! Meow Meow.
Mew will start cooking fish bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_019.text:
Sniff Sniff!
Here it is bow wow!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_020.text:
Bow Wow! You are under arrest 
on suspicion of distributing illegal foodstuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_021.text:
Peow. Who is this...
Detective doggy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_022.text:
Meow!!! Mew's fish bread is not
an illegal foodstuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_024.text: That dog man is very annoying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_025.text:
Bow wow!!! Are you fleeing?!
I will arrest you by all means this time!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_026.text:
What an arrogant doggy man, meow.
You are after me? The Lupeow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_027.text:
What the..!! (coughing)
This was a coward blow!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_029.text:
Haha. Dog man can't put up with tear gas...
Too sensitive nose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_030.text:
So Mew.
Let's keep this plan for later on meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_031.text:
Stop you cowardly Kitty!!!
I will chase after you until I catch you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_6_032.text: Hasla becoming a Meow Meow Kingdom...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0001.text:
Yes, we've found it at last! Toto, look-meow!
It's a colosseum ticket-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0003.text:
Nya?! It's scary-meow!
I understand you're happy, but let me down-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0004.text:
Meow... Riding on your backpack is okay, meow,
but that just now was scary-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0006.text:
It's okay, Toto-meow!
Oh, have you discovered anything, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0008.text:
Nyaha! Isn't that frozen tuna? It seems delicious-meow!
Oh, but it's frozen stiff-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0009.text: Let's melt it and eat it later-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0011.text: Did you find something other than frozen tuna-meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0012.text:
Nyahaha! Good job-meow!
You're the best partner, Toto-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0013.text: The mercenary leader will surely liks this-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0015.text:
Meow? What's that?
That's a strange helmet-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0017.text:
Uhm... It does look cool-meow.
But the captain won't like it-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0018.text:
Let's just throw it away and go somewhere else-meow~
There may be some colosseum tickets lying around-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0020.text:
You didn't want to sell it in the first place-meow?
You want to keep it, Toto-meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0022.text:
Meow... But it looks rather heavy.
Toto's bag will become difficult to carry-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0026.text:
Mm...
If you like it that much, then you can keep it-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0027.text:
And it makes me happy as well
to see Toto so happy in a long while-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0028.text: Be careful not to lose it-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0030.text:
I have a good feeling about today-meow!
Just as if we are going to discover something great-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0033.text:
Hmm, I surely lost it near here...
Yet it is nowhere to be seen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0034.text: Perhaps it was somewhere else I dropped my helmet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0035.text: It's been some time since I've seen that Toto so happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_7_0036.text:
But who would have guessed that that helmet was Thor's?
Thor is going to have a hard time finding it again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0001.text: Hey, pretty girl. What a beautiful day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0002.text:
How about a drink? I know the perfect
place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0005.text: Oh my, you're not a girl?!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0006.text:
Boys also like pink, friend. You're 
so stubborn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0007.text: Haha. Let's go for a drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0008.text: Oopsy! I have things to do...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0009.text:
Oh! Space Cadet P. 
Long time no see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0010.text: Long time no see, cute boy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0011.text: Oh Andre! Long time no see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0012.text:
You know him? We're about to 
have a drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_1_0019.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_001.text: It's so hot here. I want to go home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_004.text:
Oh, it's so nice to meet someone from my
home country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_005.text: I might not look like it but I'm from Ryu...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_007.text:
My identity is top secret here! Anyway, I'd like to hear about
Ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_008.text: Let's go to a quiet place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_009.text:
Kunoichi! I'm so glad that I've met my 
perfect partner here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_011.text: Will you marry me? Let's go back together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_012.text: I want the same thing... but I have a mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_013.text: Then I will be here for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_014.text: I swore to my Lord but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_017.text:
I'm here as a spy. 
I might get caught.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_018.text: But... It seems so obvious that you're from Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_020.text:
I was so happy being with you... 
But I have a mission to accomplish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_024.text:
If you don't understand me... I think this 
is it for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_027.text: Where is Kunoichi? I think I saw her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_029.text:
She doesn't eat or sleep! She's always 
wandering around spying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_030.text: If you see her please tell her to visit the bakery!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_2_031.text:
Is she acting like she doesn't know that
everyone already knows who she is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_001.text:
Ha... When will I be able to train with
an actual sword...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_004.text: Ah, sorry. I accidentally heard what you just said...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_005.text:
I recognize you! We've met a few 
times near the fountain, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_006.text:
Kind of ashamed of what I've just 
said but... Nice to meet you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_007.text:
...it's so dangerous!
I can still feel it... Ugh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_009.text: It must have been a scary experience...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_011.text:
Why isn't Ms. Adventurer coming yet?
Perhaps...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_012.text:
What...! What happened!
Are you all right???

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_013.text:
I'm... I'm okay...
I was going to be late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_014.text:
I had to take a shortcut and a little
adventure happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_015.text:
Why are you pushing yourself so hard!
Take your time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_3_016.text: Well... It's nice to meet you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_002.text:
Well you can at least hold a hammer 
with one hand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_003.text:
Ah... A cup of cream soda 
served by that Clerk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_007.text:
Sigh... Men...
They just judge women by their looks...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_008.text:
Oh my god! It's her!!!
Why is she here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_009.text: She looks so normal.. What's such a big deal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_010.text:
Umm, excuse me.
I have to crush something immediately.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_011.text: Can I borrow a hammer and an anvil?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_012.text:
Yeah, whatever...
Feel free to use them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_017.text:
Handy with a hammer...
Look at those biceps...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_018.text: Wow, it feels like a girl crush..!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_020.text:
I want to learn how to handle a hammer
from that hot sister!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_4_021.text:
People feel attractiveness from different points.
Well, mine...? Hmm, I am not so sure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0001.text:
Ah, forest is peaceful.
I hope it lasts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0002.text: Oops! Sorry, I was lost in thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0003.text: Sorry for sneaking up on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0004.text:
Nope! It's all right.
I'm the guardian of the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0006.text: By the way, who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0007.text: Ah, I'm just here to relax.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0009.text:
It's too deep inside the forest for such a 
delicate girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0010.text: Oops! I am here to relax...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0011.text:
But I'm starting to feel boring,
so I took up archery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0012.text:
I didn't think anyone was here...
Is archery not allowed here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0014.text:
So you're the one who's been leaving
arrows all over the place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0016.text:
Ah, it's just that I've never expected 
the archer to be so beautiful...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0017.text:
You seems to be a beginner, can I 
give you a lesson?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0018.text: Well, the forest is dangerous you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0019.text: Ah, then you'll help me out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_5_0023.text:
I'm sure that something's going on 
between those two! Congrats!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_001.text:
Sir Roland.
The reason why I asked you to see me here....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_002.text:
Please tell me quick.
Saintess Maria is waiting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_003.text:
Always Maria, Maria, Maria...
Is she the only one on your mind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_004.text:
Of course.
I am her guardian knight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_005.text:
Yes, you will never change your mind.
But still.... My heart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_007.text:
No, no no. You shouldn't say that. 
I devoted myself to Maria...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_008.text:
Roland, where are you?
We should get going, Roland!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_009.text:
Hmm? You two were having a conversation!
I'm sorry did I bother you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_010.text:
No, no! We weren't talking.
It's just... nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_013.text:
No, no problem at all.
Let's go Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_016.text:
I don't know what's going on here,
but she seems hurt because of you Roland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_017.text:
How can you pretend you don't know
after hurting a lady's feeling, Roland!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_018.text:
Ma, Maria!
No that is a complete misunderstanding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_6_019.text:
Is this a love triangle...?
{PLAYER_NAME}, have you experienced such thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_001.text: ... Do you Understand me so far?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_002.text:
Yes.
I can see that this mission is very important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_003.text:
You are the key in this mission...
Please...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_004.text:
Ah, I know that.
I don't usually make mistakes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_006.text: I hope it goes well this time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_007.text:
Sagittarius...?
What are you looking at...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_008.text:
Hey! Yes, you nice girl!
Have time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_009.text:
All like flowers.
Butterflies are always allured by flowers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_010.text:
I'm the butterfly, and you are flower.
Of course I'd go for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_011.text:
What is he?
Gee, Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_014.text:
Don't sigh.
It will make you age!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_015.text:
And I'm just pretending to like girls.
It's all for the mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_018.text:
Hey! Yes, you nice girl!
Have time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_019.text:
What a beautiful girl!
Oh my girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_020.text: I came here to meet you...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_7_025.text:
Um...
I knew it from that horse hat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_1.text:
There is one... two... several Grancian Ents...
Mm, they seem to be Flaming Ents from the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_11.text: What. Do you have more to say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_12.text:
Well... It's not that important...
But why are you collecting all these Ents?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_13.text:
Well I know that disposing them all at once 
is the most adequate way... But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_14.text: I think this is too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_15.text:
And... even though it's a rare phenomenon.
Dead Ents do revive naturally sometimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_16.text: Why don't we get rid of these Ents just in case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_17.text:
If it bothers you...
I can do it by myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_18.text:
I heard that Ent cuisine is quite tasty,
I wanted to have a taste once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_19.text: What do you think it is to be a noble!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_20.text:
Be Elegant, seek beauty, and try to reach perfection!
That's what a noble should be, young man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_21.text:
Golden Archer Group, which you are the member of is 
where those nobles are gathered together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_22.text:
Even though it became popular, 
how dare you get interested in those pleb foods!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_23.text: You should be ashamed of yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_24.text:
I apologize sir...!
I had forgotten what it is to be a noble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_26.text:
You are supposed to be expelled from the group
but I respect your devotion... So I won't punish you this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_28.text:
that if you disobey what I tell you today,
you can be expelled from the group anytime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_3.text:
Yes, Magnus.
These are Ents from other troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_30.text:
Thanks...!
I'll keep that in mind, I promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_32.text:
I fell in love with you from the first time I saw you on the battlefield.
Please accept my love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_35.text:
Even though you are from the lower class, 
I admire your courage and will take care of you forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_37.text:
Secretly loving the lower class girl 
who I used to ignore…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_39.text:
But I won't give up! 
A noble never gives up that easily!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_4.text: Thanks. I admire your hard work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_40.text:
Although I can't face her and show my love now...
One day I will tell her how I feel about her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_41.text: I hope that the day comes soon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_42.text:
One-sided love is always hard to endure.
I wonder how this story will end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_43.text:
...
And tree bark? Can that be delicious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_5.text:
Hmm... Two Ents from the Grancian forests
and another one from the Primal Volcano...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_6.text: ... I'm sure that she will like it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_7.text: Excuse me? What did you just say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_8_1_9.text:
You are free to go. 
I'll do the rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0001.text: Oh, Himiko! How I wished to see you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0002.text:
... I never remember us being on first name terms, but...
Fine. Okay, okay, let me go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0003.text:
It is delightful indeed to return to the capital!
I do love the countryside, but the capital is the best, after all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0006.text:
I am called Susanoo.
Greetings, Lady Kaguya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0007.text:
So your name is Susanoo...?
Your name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0008.text:
Even your name is incredible!
Oh! How nice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0009.text:
Um, is... is Lord Susanoo
betrothed, by any chance...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0010.text: ... I must admit I am not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0011.text:
Oh! Oh, I see. I see!
A man like you, not yet betrothed... Hee hee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0012.text:
Kaguya, if you are teasing my personal guard,
please don't go overboard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0013.text: You must think of your reputation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0014.text:
Oh? I am not teasing him, Himiko!
I really do speak the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0015.text:
Sigh... Sometimes I really do wonder if there can be anyone more
pure than you. Fine, but now we must part ways.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0016.text: Your father is waiting for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0018.text:
Oh, and ... Lord Susanoo. This is a present for you.
C-could we meet again? Heehee. Then - farewell!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0020.text: So, do you like her, Susanoo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0022.text:
I understand. It's not very strange if you did, you know.
A beautiful, noble young lady giving you flowers! Confessing love, even!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0023.text:
It must be very nice to be so popular, Susanoo!
I should really send you off so you could get married, isn't that right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0024.text:
I-I do not know why you speak this way,
but I am not ready to start a family of my own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0025.text:
Enough with your excuses and long-winded words.
I have no need of a guard today, so don't follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_9_0027.text:
It's very hard to know a woman's heart,
isn't it, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0001.text:
Hello! 
Are you here for a blood donation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0002.text:
A mysterious power in my soul is 
growing stronger and stronger...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0003.text:
If this power comes out the world will 
be in danger. Please help me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0004.text:
Uh... so you are here to donate 
blood right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0005.text:
If that's the way, yes. 
Please get rid of this power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0006.text: You'd get along with a vampire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0011.text:
I don't need it. Any more energy will make my
power go insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0014.text: Next? Are you here to donate blood?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0019.text: I will! I love tomato juice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0020.text:
Tomato juice...? 
Don't vampires drink blood?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0024.text: What? I thought vampires drink blood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_1_0025.text: I feel like I was lied to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_001.text: Who's the one keep making noise?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_004.text:
You're the perp! 
What are you doing?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_005.text: I... I was just so hungry...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_008.text:
I have to leave. 
I might get punished if I get caught!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_010.text: Hello! You little thief! I got ya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_012.text:
What? Are you insane?
I was just curious about the noise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_013.text: Then... did you see the thief?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_015.text:
Really? Hmm... not again.. 
I'll capture you no matter what thief!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_016.text:
Thief? That's a stretch. 
It's just food!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_017.text: I can't hang out with you anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_018.text:
Thanks for what happened yesterday.
I was this close to getting caught.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_2_019.text:
I did nothing. 
I just don't like a fuss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_001.text:
Yippee! Doing bad things makes me happy! 
Ice cream tastes better when you take it from a baby!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_007.text:
Did you really take away that little kid's 
ice cream?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_008.text: Ah... it was really mean but still kind of impressive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_009.text:
I heard that you throw trash at the royal 
school in 100 different ways, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_011.text:
Cruel, but not careful enough...
Everyone knows about you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_012.text:
Well, you're careful, but not you're
exciting enough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_013.text: If we team up... We can really do some damage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_014.text:
Good. I'm excited! Together, we can
paint the town red!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_3_015.text: Is there really honor among thieves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_001.text:
We used to work so hard to become a 
magician...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_002.text:
Nowadays anyone can be a magician. 
See? Nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_003.text:
But you dreamed to be a magician!
I wanted to be a mathematician!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_004.text:
I accidentally read the wrong book, 
and that lead me to magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_005.text: Are you guys making fun of me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_007.text: We are seriously reconsidering our lives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_009.text: Yes, it's not worth is anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_4_011.text:
Not all talent is distributed evenly,
Right? {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_001.text: It's time to try it out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_002.text:
The upgraded version of Black Flame Dragon!
"Real Black Flame Dragon wave"!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_003.text: Whoa, I can feel the power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_005.text: The Neth Empire is always so peaceful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_006.text:
Yes, I come to the Neth Empire annually, 
and I've noticed that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_007.text: I think we can return now... What?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_010.text:
Mother Superior! This person is filled 
with evil. We need to purify him!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_011.text:
Lucky that we found him. 
Let's get to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_014.text: Oh, I'm alive!!! I'm not dead!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_015.text:
I can't feel the Black Flame Dragon...
My magic...! No!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_007_5_016.text:
I'll be back with something even more 
terrifying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_004.text:
I can't think of any materials for my novel..!
Arghhhhh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_006.text: ... like that girl who gave me inspiration last time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_007.text:
Something... which can inspire me like a shock!
Something so attractive...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_009.text:
Great!
I should choose her as my next main character!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_012.text: Phew... Maybe I'll wrap up for today...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_013.text: I need to take a rest to continue training tomorrow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_015.text:
Hah? 
Oh my, who are you??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_016.text:
Thank you sweet girl. I am a novelist!
Thanks to you, I came up with a great story!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_017.text:
This is my gift of appreciation!
Thank you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_019.text:
You are the next main character for my new novel!
The title is, Card King of Tomorrow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_020.text:
Battling the card soldier and gaining victory at last!
Finally taking over the world...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_021.text:
Oh I should pull myself together and start working!
I will send you a copy of my book later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_10_024.text:
I kept thinking since last time...
Does she have a talent..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_002.text:
Hehehe... 
Shut up and give me all you've got!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_006.text:
...Yes I did.
I think we should help her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_008.text:
Wh..What? Who are you!
Where did you come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_009.text:
Hmph! 
Don't look down on me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_012.text: Hmm... I don't think Melissa did anything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_013.text:
...Be quiet, Demona.
Young magician, didn't you get hurt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_014.text:
Sob...!!
Sob Sob... I was so scared...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_016.text:
Hehe, since I saved her,
it's your job to take care of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_017.text: Well, I guess I have no choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_018.text:
I will give you this, so please calm down.
This is very sweet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_019.text:
Thank you..!
I appreciate it so much, and

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_020.text: thank you so much for saving me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_024.text: Hmm, I am just so tired from using my power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_025.text: I can't stand up.. I want something sweet too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_026.text:
...Demona.
How old do you think you are? Sigh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_027.text:
Huh? I don't know how old I am!
Don't I look like a child?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_028.text:
Great! I will just act like a 12 year old girl from today.
So, give me something sweet too!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_029.text:
Hurry hurry!
I feel so tired, Melissa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_031.text:
Hmm... is mental age similar to appearance?
Melissa should be having a hard time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_11_032.text: Hmm? What's that look on your face?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_001.text:
You! How much longer are you going to
live idle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_002.text:
Every single day, I am the only one working so hard!
You never help a bit, even the house chores!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_003.text:
How can a wife be working all by herself 
in the 21st century?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_004.text:
What? What's that look for?
Say something if you can!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_005.text:
I..I can hunt too! 
It's not difficult at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_006.text:
Oh yeah? Then go ahead!
You are just a beginner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_007.text:
You don't think I can make it?
Well, see this! It's magical power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_010.text:
Hmmph!
I didn't even expect a thing from you! Nerd!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_011.text:
Hands off! You just go to your room
and read books, you nerdy nerd!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_012.text: What's wrong? They look like fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_013.text:
Fighting is not good.
We should work it out through conversation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_014.text:
Hmm, I see why you are fighting.
I think it's because you are poor at magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_015.text:
Magics are good, but it's important to
commune with animals too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_016.text:
Let me show you how.
Watch closely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_017.text:
...Phew...
I should better get back to hunting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_018.text:
Hey you two there, 
PLEASE study hard on your magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_12_019.text:
Hmm, it's extradordinary to see 
Nazrune lose his patience. What a surprise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_001.text:
...Gasp. Since the war is not over, gasp....
My gas mask keeps wearing out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_004.text:
Oh, Spiny. I was about the replace my
gas mask...Gasp...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_005.text:
Replacing your mask? 
Then is that an old mask you are holding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_006.text:
Yes... Gasp....
I got a hole in the old one during a battle...Gasp...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_007.text: Then, I will go and throw this away... Gasp...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_010.text:
Give me your used mask!
I will throw it away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_011.text:
Hmm, is that so..? Gasp...
Then yes, please... Gasp...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_013.text: So, this is the mask used by Spyro...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_13_014.text: I can feel warmth from this...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_001.text:
Woo... Woompa....
Woomparu kupa doompa... Woompa... Woombaba...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_002.text:
Mamba! There you are.
Spending all night polishing weapons... Tsk, tsk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_003.text:
Wake up, Mamba.
It is time for the mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_005.text:
Are you talking in your sleep?
Mm? Sweating profusely.. Is he having a nightmare?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_008.text:
Rumparoom by! Woomparoo kupa doompa!!
Woopa woombaba!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_009.text:
What is wrong?
Hold yourself together, Mamba!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_010.text:
Mamba woom kanupa Rumparum Ba!!
Woompawoopa Apapapapapa!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_011.text:
Shh, shh...  Everything is okay.
Mamba, I am here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_013.text:
I have embarrassed myself.
Excuse me, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_014.text:
You seem alright now.
What nightmare did you have to be so bothered?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_015.text:
My people... My hometown... 
In evil flames... Woompa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_017.text:
It is nothing.
I will go now, for the mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_14_018.text:
Maybe it was not a simple nightmare,
but a premonition that he had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_001.text:
Thank you all for visiting Succubus troupe!
We will make the best show in return!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_002.text: Um... Is this the Demons' theater?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_003.text:
Hikari. I followed you for no reason...
But why are you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_004.text:
Sorry Kaori...
I know that this place is weird.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_005.text:
But I wanted to show you the performance
of my No.1 actor!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_008.text:
Isn't she pretty?
I'm so glad that I met her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_009.text:
Is she...? Not my type...
And indeed, you are prettier than her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_010.text:
Kaori!!! People might listen!
It's so embarassing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_012.text:
Fancy flowers seem to have a mild scent. 
And a delicate scent deep inside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_013.text:
Who's spitting this crap?
Hey you humans! What are you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_014.text:
Are you making fun of Rachel?
I'm her sister man!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_016.text:
I was just being honest.
And indeed! My sister is way more pretty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_019.text:
My sister is like Snow White.
And she has pink hair!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_020.text:
She has a nice body, dances well and earns lots of money.
She's the superstar among Demons!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_021.text:
Seeking beauty only from appearance...
How silly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_022.text:
My sister is clever, kind and is a great Archer.
She has everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_029.text:
Rachel wait!
I will make these humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_030.text:
Ah... It's nothing...
Please forget everything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_15_031.text:
Are you fleeing? You idiots.
I'll show you the power of Balrog!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0001.text:
Oh dear.
Such a polite young man. So rare these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0003.text: I did what I must do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0005.text:
...!!!
Well, I have to go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0006.text: Watch out so you don't fall down any more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0007.text: I felt an aura of scallywag somewhere...!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0008.text:
Um, excuse me!
Have you seen a young man with blonde hair?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0009.text:
Um...? No, I haven't seen someone like that.
But I saw a young man with black armor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0011.text:
Wait!
Stop bullying the kind people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0013.text: See you next time and I will..!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0014.text:
I'm sure they were here a moment ago...!!!
Darn it, did I miss again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0016.text:
Well thank you so much.
So glad I met you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0017.text: I couldn't move this load alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0018.text:
Not a big thing.
It's always good to help a woman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0019.text:
Oh, such good manners!
You are indeed quite different from the other guys!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0023.text:
Sorry girl!
I have to leave now..!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0027.text:
Have you seen a young man with old black armor?!
With a good voice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0028.text: He must have helped females saying that he is a knight or something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0029.text:
Uh... Um...
I think I was with him until a moment ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0032.text:
Hey lady!!!! Where has he gone to?!!!
Which way!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0034.text:
Yes!!!
Hey mister, wait for me!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0035.text: I'm coming for you runaway boy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0037.text:
He and she both are incredible indeed...
Always by a head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_16_0038.text:
Maybe because they both feel auras... 
They might know where each other is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_1.text:
Oh! Spyro!
Did you lose something again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_10.text:
Whoosh... What's happening these days.
Do they need more handkerchieves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_12.text:
Well, Spyro.
Here are your supplies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_13.text:
Oh, thank you so much, whew.
I won't lose them this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_16.text:
He will never know that 
I'm the one who took his handkerchief... right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_17.text: Um... By the way who took that laundry...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_18.text:
Bah, I had my eyes on them!
... Perhaps... her..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_2.text:
Yes, whew.
Recently, I have been losing my belongings so often, whoosh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_20.text:
Huh? What am I doing...?
I was checking my stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_3.text:
That's sad...
What have you lost this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_4.text:
Um... 2 pants that I hanged on a rack, 
1 shirt, 1 hat and 2 gas masks...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_17_6.text:
Whoa, that's a lot.
Nothing else?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_1.text:
Greetings!
I'm a member of the Neth Revolutionaries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_10.text: I think I should leave now... Bye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_11.text:
Ugh!
Why did you make that noise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_12.text:
It had been a long time since we've met someone from another country.
We should improve our image by being polite!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_13.text:
Well.
Why do we have to do that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_15.text:
Whoa...
Why did we do all the things that we have done then?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_16.text:
For the revival of your family!
We sometimes have to do what is necessary!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_17.text:
Be polite and friendly!
You need to improve your image!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_18.text:
...What are you looking at?!
Are you listening to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_20.text:
Why are you being pettish?!
What is it?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_23.text:
Ugh, that little boy...
When will he grow up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_24.text:
Did you see that girl?
Is she as pretty as people say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_26.text: She is actually more beautiful than that but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_28.text:
A scary dark knight is standing right behind her staring at...
Well I didn't actually see his eyes because of the helmet but....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_29.text:
I felt his stare... 
I was so scared..!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_3.text: By the way, what brought you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_31.text:
The rumor that the Dark Knight appears when someone 
glances at that silver-haired girl from Valencia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_32.text: Kinghts fall in love with their old friends...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_33.text:
But, why is he acting like that...?
She will never know if he keeps acting like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_4.text:
Ah! Yuria, the leader of our army has sent me 
to deliver this letter to the captain of the Valencia alliance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_5.text:
Thanks, young soldier.
Would you like a cup of tea?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_7.text:
Come on...
It's just a cup of tea!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_9.text:
Ah...!
I've been here so long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0002.text:
What? What is it?
Catch your breath and tell me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0003.text:
I'm in!!! I'm in!!!
I've been accepted to the Succubus troupe!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0005.text:
I knew it!!!
You are my sister!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0006.text: Who else will be part of the Succubus troupe?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0007.text: When are you joining the troupe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0009.text:
Next week!
I have to go to Pumpkin City!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0011.text:
Yes. The carnival is going on 
so they are hosting shows there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0012.text: They said I can join them there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0013.text:
Uh, really?
Then why don't we go there earlier and enjoy the carnival?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0015.text:
How was it, Rachel?
Did you like the carnival?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0016.text:
I loved it because I was with you!
I love you the most!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0017.text: I loved the cotton candy too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0018.text:
I think we've seen enough.
Let's go to the Succubus troupe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0019.text: Um... I want to hang out with you more...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0020.text:
We can hang out later!
You shouldn't be late on your first day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0021.text:
Let's ask that person
where the Succubus troupe is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0023.text:
Hello, little witch.
Do you know where the Succubus troupe is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0025.text:
Go straight, and turn left.
You'll see it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0027.text:
Rachel! What time is it?
Aren't you late?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0028.text:
Yes, I still have some time!
Thanks Vivian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0029.text:
I thought I might be late because we were lost.
But thanks to you, I'm right on time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0030.text: You are a good navigator! Haha

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0032.text:
Rachel, we will be apart for a while...
But I believe in you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0033.text: Of course! I'll be the best in the Succubus troupe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0034.text:
Rachel!
You might be late. Go in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0035.text: Don't forget to call me if someone bullies you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0036.text:
Yes, thank you for coming here with me!
Have a safe trip home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0037.text:
Well now...
That's the witch who told Rachel the wrong way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0038.text:
How dare you lie to my lovely sister...?
You will not get away with that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0041.text:
Irritating the sleeping demon...
Rest in peace...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_001.text:
Ah... how can I guard the 
next Saintess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_002.text:
Wow, you've come. I was really 
looking forward to meeting you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_004.text: Rednas! I've heard a lot about you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_005.text:
... Maria. Nice to meet you.
It's Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_006.text: Yippee! I'm so glad to meet you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_007.text: Ah, since you're here, let's go somewhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_008.text:
It will be okay if I'm with you, right?
This way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_009.text:
Before then, I hated this sort of thing.
However, the girl was so bright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_010.text:
So I promised to do my best
to protect this little girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_011.text:
Where is Maria again. 
What a prankster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_014.text:
It's all for you, Maria.
Stop hanging out with Lednas... if not...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_015.text:
What's wrong? She's a great knight.
She's protecting me perfectly...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_016.text:
Maria. You're the next Saintess.
Show some dignity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_017.text: You're making a fool of yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_020.text:
After that incident, I retired from 
Maria's guard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_021.text:
It might sound like an excuse, but 
that was my own way to protect her

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0001.text:
Y-yes, everything should be well.
I'll pray for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0004.text:
Y-you came home early today.
I... I missed you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0006.text:
I was a little lonely without you...
But I played with my ghost friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0008.text:
M-my friend... is going home to see her family.
So I told her... that I would pray for her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0010.text:
I know things have been difficult for us,
but it's time to see reality, not indulge in illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0011.text: Do you understand? Ghosts are not real.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0013.text:
My friends... when you weren't here and I had to be all by myself,
they sang songs and told me stories so I could go to sleep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0016.text:
Oh... okay.
Really? Is...Is that really okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0017.text:
Will you and the doll be okay
if you possess Violet's doll...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0018.text:
...!
If that's how Violet will believe me...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0021.text: Sniffle... It's a relief you're okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0027.text:
I wonder why she won't believe her own little sister
when she herself deals with magical dolls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0001.text: Yes, we found the right person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0002.text: Mm, let us now guide the soul to the underworld.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0004.text: I-I'll properly throw trash in the trash can from now on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0008.text:
Now look what you've done, Bihyeongrang!!
Your Vaisravana is scaring everybody away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0010.text:
Hmmph, whatever.
I'll guide these souls by myself, so don't follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0011.text:
So... there you were, Bihyeongrang.
King Yeomra of the Underworld is looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0012.text:
A-and... As for yesterday...
I'm sorry for speaking so harshly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0013.text:
I know you were only trying to help...
So... Sorry about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0014.text:
No...
I had not realized that the dead would be so afraid of Vaisravana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0016.text:
...that I asked Hanee Baram
for a way to make Vaisravana seem more... friendly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0022.text:
Oh, I laughed too loudly, didn't I?
But Vaisravana is so cute...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0023.text:
Ah, no.
It is a relief that it is so... "cute."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0024.text:
Haha, then shall we go search for the next soul to guide?
I don't think anybody will run away from Vaisravana now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0025.text:
What a nice story.
I do feel a little sorry for the Vaisravana, though...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0026.text: Well, it's cute, so I suppose that's that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0001.text:
Got it, Alice?
My Oz is the best cat in all of Hasla, no matter what anyone says.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0002.text:
Look at his luxurious black fur and lively expression,
and his perfect little wizard hat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0003.text:
He's the best of the witch's cat there is - 
no, he's the best cat in the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0004.text:
Hmmph! What expression?
His fur is too dark to see anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0006.text:
His charming smile and shiny teeth - 
do you think that's all?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0007.text:
Cheshire even memorizes different card types!
He's a genius cat fit for the Spade Queen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0008.text:
Is this Pumpkin City-meow?
I hear there are a lot of cats here-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0009.text: I want to meet all the witches' cats-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0010.text:
Ah! Cat Master Mew!
I've heard of your name - and fame as cat master!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0011.text:
My Oz and Alice's Cheshire!
Tell us whose cat is the best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0014.text:
So your name is Oz-meow!
Oz has pink paws that looks just like jellybeans-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0015.text:
They seem so squishy and soft-meow.
He's so very very very cute-meow!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0016.text:
And you are Cheshire-meow!
Cheshire's nose looks so nicely moist-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0017.text:
And the tips of his ears are so pointy and pretty-meow.
Also very very very cute-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0018.text:
Both Oz and Cheshire are healthy and cute-meow! It's clear they 
both received lots of love from their slav.. I mean owners-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0020.text: Mm? Why are you both quiet-meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0022.text:
I... I've always known Oz was cute,
but I had no idea he was this much...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0023.text: Ah! I spoke my mind out loud.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0024.text: I-I secretly thought Cheshire was adorable too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0026.text: It looks like glittering obsidian when he plays in the sunlight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0028.text:
I... I've always wanted to rub my face against Oz's jelly paws
whenever I saw him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0029.text:
Warm and nice and soft...
Don't you think it would be heavenly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0032.text:
Yes.... All cats are cute.
And so are their witches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0001.text:
Hmm...
Good, the table is clean.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0003.text:
Now that I think about it, I've worked for some time 
as a maid of the Knights. Cleaning is nothing now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0005.text:
Ah! But I mustn't forget my original mission - 
to assassinate Victoria. Not stay as her maid…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0006.text:
Lady Victoria is rarely by herself...
But I'll succeed in my mission... Someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0007.text:
But wait! This speck of dust!
I'll have to clean this right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0009.text:
T-this... This!
This isn't Lady Victoria's favorite blend of black tea!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0010.text:
Ah, Tia.
Hard at work today as well, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0012.text: Come here and look at this at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0013.text:
Hmm...
I do not know the reason for your urgency, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0014.text:
I see Lady Victoria's teacup and a case of black tea.
Is there a problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0015.text:
Huhu... Is there a problem? 'Is there a problem?' 
Do you not see the problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0017.text:
'Fine black tea, blended by Grancian artisans
by young tea leaves harvested by delicate fairy hands.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0020.text: I - I must admit I cannot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0021.text: The black tea that Lady Victoria drinks everyday!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0022.text:
Is 'the finest' black tea, made from the best young tea leaves 
harvested by fairies and blended by the finest artisans in Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0023.text:
As the head treasurer of the Knighthood,
your oversight is unforgivable!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0024.text:
Do you think you could ever win the Pelancia House with such 
neglectfulness? Or dare you think tea leaves to be 'insignificant'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0025.text:
While we are on the subject, wipe your feet at the doormat! 
And don't bother coming in before dusting off your clothes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0026.text:
Tidy the tables after sitting at them! And don't stain the couches 
with whatever filth you knights keep leaving behind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0027.text:
F-forgive me.
...Erm. I will reorder the tea leaves at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0028.text:
Y-yes. 
I should go right away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0029.text: I haven't finished with you yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0030.text:
Ahem, Tia,
do you have anything you want?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0031.text:
I will order anything of your desire
along with the order for the tea leaves - especially for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0034.text:
Now that you mention it, I would like the 'Wedding Blue Antique' 
limited edition tea set from the Grancia-certified Atelier de Royale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0036.text:
Go to the Atelier and ask for a teacup 
crafted in the shape of a blue flower petal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0037.text:
It should be just a tad expensive and maybe a little hard to find,
but it is the only tea set befitting Lady Victoria's grace and beauty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0038.text:
E, expensive? But by how much?
... Wait, Tia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0039.text: Well, I must be off now, to prepare Lady Victoria's tea time~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0040.text: She really is a first-rate maid... I suppose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0041.text:
But putting such matters behind us...
I wonder what Grancia's best black tea tastes like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0001.text:
Sigh... Numbers in the red again.
Our stores will go completely empty before soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0002.text:
Then... We must cut edges...
starting from our members' food and spending expenses...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0003.text:
And I must remind everyone again
to be more diligent in recording their bankbooks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0004.text:
Now then. I must recalculate how we will spend
the knighthood's money and resources...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0005.text:
Whew. More overwork.
I do love my knighthood though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0006.text:
...!
W-what is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0009.text:
Who came to the storage recently?
Tell me anyone who came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0011.text:
Nobody entered the stores save for Sir David,
who came quite frequently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0013.text:
Yes. Every time he left
with much gold and jewels,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0014.text:
and told me to record the expenses
for "managing weapons."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0015.text:
If David said so...I see. 
You may leave now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0017.text:
Hmm... David isn't one to lie.
But managing weapons shouldn't cost so much...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0018.text:
... I will have to follow him
and see what he is up to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0019.text:
Oh, I did like the feel of the hammer...
How unfortunate. I am sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0020.text:
Oh, no.
There are days like this, I am sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0021.text:
After all, did you not make my weapon good as new
with one ring of your hammer the other day?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0023.text:
Here, I have brought enough gold and jewels.
I entrust all our knighthood's weapons to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0024.text:
Haha... Then I suppose I cannot help it.
I'll swing my hammer as hard as I can!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0025.text:
Ah, there are many weapons to polish...
I'll need more iron for this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0026.text:
Hmm... There was some spare iron in the storage...
I shall go and see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0028.text:
Fergus is renowned as a skilled blacksmith
but for some reason frequently makes mistakes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0029.text: ... and the reason was his old hammer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0030.text:
Then there is nothing else to do
save for changing his hammer to a new one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0031.text:
Then I can save both the expenses for our weapons
and David's pride.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0032.text: Haha, this is a good idea indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0033.text:
Hmm... This hammer feels a little different, but...
Well, this glow means it is a great success!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0034.text:
And another strike... leads to another great success!
You are indeed the best blacksmith, Master Fergus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0035.text:
There is a reason why {PLAYER_NAME}
entrusts weapons only to you.
