TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0036.text:
Well, my hammer is on fire today for some reason!
Oh, another great success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0037.text: I really think that was the best turn of events...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0038.text:
But whoever would have thought that the hammer 
would have been the problem? Very strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0001.text:
Now, take a step into the 
wide world of adventure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0002.text:
Your first step will be the one 
that will change the world you look at.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0003.text:
(One year since I left home on an adventure
after reading Lorelei's travel journals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0004.text:
Which would mean one year since I started
picking up pennies on the streets to scrape by day after day...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0005.text: Sigh... When will my true adventure begin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0006.text: The Goddess is really petty, to think of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0007.text:
I pray at the church every weekend,
and even donate to the poor - even if it's only a penny!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0008.text:
And what do I get in return?
Nothing, no stroke of luck at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0009.text:
I mean, I didn't expect anything like
a large sack of jewels lying on the ground...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0010.text:
What am I doing.
There's nothing like a Goddess anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0012.text: T-that! That's the jewel goblin I heard about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0013.text:
People said that there are loads of precious jewels
in a jewel goblin's knapsack...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0014.text:
The Goddess must have answered my prayer!
I'll make sure to catch that jewel goblin and earn my fortune!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0015.text:
My broadsword I bought with the pennies I saved!
Well, even if I didn't have the guts to use it in case I broke it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0016.text:
But catching that goblin
will surely be worth it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0017.text: Wait up, jewels! I mean, jewel goblin!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0018.text:
Argh, I lost it again.
And to make things worse, even my broadsword's broken...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0019.text:
Am I really doomed to a mediocre existance,
devoid of skill or luck? Ugh!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0020.text:
.... I should stop my travels,
shouldn't I.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0022.text:
When I first read them.. my heart felt like it would burst...
I promised myself I would become a great treasure hunter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0024.text:
... When I picked up my first penny, I was so happy... 
I felt like it was a good start to a great adventure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0025.text:
And when I earned more and more pennies,
and bought my first weapon... That was another great day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0026.text: Even if that broadsword is broken now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0027.text:
Oh, and when I discovered that secret lair
while looking for treasure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0028.text:
I was really excited then.
I felt like a real adventurer, like Lorelei!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0029.text:
...Yeah... I guess just finding expensive treasure
doesn't mean everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0030.text:
But... that happiness and excitement I felt when I first
set out on my journey, and stepped into a new world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0031.text:
I guess that's the most important thing.
Even if it means picking up pennies every day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0032.text:
Good, I can't give up like this!
I'll keep going forward!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0034.text:
Many give up after encountering failure once...
But the Treasure Hunter is a strong one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0036.text: You too will meet such failure one day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0037.text:
When that day comes...
Do not give up. Keep going forward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_25_0038.text: Oh? Why I'm talking like this, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_001.text:
Alas! Day after day too many suffer
by my unattainable beauty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_002.text:
Who could ever understand
the suffering that comes with such a gift?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_003.text:
For beauty is also a curse.
But this hospital... is said to be able to cure everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_004.text: I'm sure it can also cure my suffering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_005.text:
Welcome to Hasla Hospital, the greatest medical 
institution in the continent. How can I help you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_006.text:
I heard that you can cure all kinds of diseases...
Even of the heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_007.text:
Huhu, don't worry!
They're our specialty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_009.text:
Every day I worry for the people
who must suffer by my incomparable good looks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_010.text:
Please cure this disease of the heart!
Oh, woebegone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_011.text: Oh, you've gone through a lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_012.text: Yes, yes. Can you make me better?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_013.text:
Of course! We're not the greatest hospital
in the continent for nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_015.text:
Huhu, of course.
It's... a difficult disease to treat

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_016.text:
but we'll try our best
to make sure to cure you of your illness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_017.text:
Thank you!
So... how do I start my treatment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_018.text:
Oh, your disease is quite severe.
We need to give you a shot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_021.text:
Uh... erm...
I think I'm already cured, ha... ha...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_022.text: Oh no. You've gone rather pale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_023.text: I think you really do need a shot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_024.text: I... I really think I'm better now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_025.text: You are free to enter as you choose...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_026.text: But you aren't free to leave. Huhu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_26_027.text: That 'shot' probably could cure any disease.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0001.text:
Hmmm...
What kind of game should I create this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0002.text:
Something simple but intriguing,
with rules that aren't too difficult...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0003.text:
Something - well, fun!
I need to create a fun game!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0004.text:
This isn't it! This isn't it, either!
Nothing's good enough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0005.text:
Sigh...
I should take a walk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0006.text: Maybe it could help me think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0007.text:
Not bad...
But it isn't good, either.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0008.text:
I'm the best student at 
the Royal Magic Academy, after all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0009.text:
So I can't stop at 'not bad' magic.
I need to think of more powerful spells...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0010.text:
...That's it!
Summoning cards and controlling them by magic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0011.text:
A card game 
in which you really fight with cards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0012.text:
Oh yes, 
I should go plan out the basics right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0013.text: ...So how do you find it, Miss Tapunyan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0014.text:
It's better than I expected!
How did the Circle of Sorcery react?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0015.text: Oh, they liked it very much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0016.text:
Card knights that follow your every order!
The ultimate in loyal servants for all your whims!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0017.text:
... Ahem. As I was saying, we are considering 
even holding a tournament for the game.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0018.text:
Everyone is training hard
in order to enter the competition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0019.text:
Oh, 
have you a name for the game by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0020.text:
The Head Sorceror of the Circle
was very curious about what to call it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0022.text:
Okay!
Let's call it 'Super Fighting Cards!'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0023.text:
As the main characters of the game
are cards who fight for the players

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0024.text:
against other cards in a life-or-death battle!
Super, right?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0025.text:
'Super Fighting Monsters'...It's a bit simple,
but straightforward and intriguing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_27_0026.text:
So that's how the game came into being...
Maybe we can play it together someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0001.text:
.....So it's that time of the month...
The full moon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0002.text:
Will I ever succeed in
controlling my accursed fate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0003.text:
At this rate, I'll have to live forever
alone in this dark forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0008.text:
(It's as if... looking into a mirror.
When the full moon rises.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0009.text:
Just like what Father told me...
the monster I became.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0012.text: I suppose... there is no other way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0015.text:
I will have you know she attacked me first.
I only stopped her from hurting me... or herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0017.text:
You....
are not a normal human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0018.text:
...!
How... how did you know that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0019.text:
I felt a darkness within you.
... But you are still human. Strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0022.text:
Do you know about werewolves?
How much do you know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0023.text:
D-do you know how to...
to control this - this darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0024.text: ...If I had, I would have... not wandered all this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0026.text:
No. But... in return for
not hurting my Sien,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0027.text: I shall give you something that will help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0029.text:
It is unstable and incomplete, but...
There is binding magic contained within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0030.text: It should keep the worst of ... your inclinations under control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0031.text:
Thank you.
Thank you so much...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_28_0033.text:
Whether an alchemist or a werewolf, 
all desire to fight against their predestined fates...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_001.text:
He must have understood the true 
meaning of green!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_002.text: He should be a Green Knight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_004.text:
Robin Hood... He's always
training to be a better archer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_005.text:
He used to train around now... 
Where is he...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_007.text:
Ah? Seems like this spot is taken.
Sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_010.text:
I'll make you regret on what you've 
done to Green!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_011.text: Hell hath no fury like a woman wronged.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_2_012.text: ... Why is green so important anyway?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_002.text:
No. It's all for our sisters.
Anything going on these days?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_003.text: Ah... right! Monsters attacked the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_004.text: I can't go to the village these days...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_006.text:
Oh it's okay. We always thank you for
your kindness! Ah, I think I have to go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_007.text:
... I'm not strong enough...
I'll become as strong as Joan of Arc!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_010.text:
Little late for your training.
You're really hard working.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_011.text:
Yes...! I will become the perfect knight!
...Like you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_012.text: The convent is safe with a knight like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_3_013.text:
Being recognized by your role model...
Seems rewarding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_001.text:
Shoot! What do I need to do to be an
archer!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_002.text: I didn't want to be half-blooded either!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_005.text: Is the half-blooded getting to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_007.text:
Are you ignoring me because 
I'm half-blooded? Bad elf...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_010.text:
You seem to be an elf.. 
You'll never understand me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_015.text:
Pure elves are not always happy...
There is severe hierarchy within elf society!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_016.text:
They only let me eat tree bark...
And now I'm addicted to the stuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_019.text:
Hey. Just because it seems like
the whole world has turned their back on you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_020.text:
Arrows... won't betray you. 
We're archers, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_022.text:
Oh, sorry for the speech...
But... don't forget!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_4_024.text: It's nice that they found each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_001.text: Hmm.. You want to become the true hero?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_002.text:
Yes!
Of course I had some immature days when I was young...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_003.text:
But the past is just the past!
I am not immature anymore! I will become the true hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_004.text:
Rochefort, I heard you are an outstanding hero!
A lot of people admire you so much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_005.text:
Please teach me!
How can I become a great hero like you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_006.text:
Hmm... A true hero... Well...
I don't remember doing anything particular...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_007.text: Well, I'll tell you one thing if you want to become like me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_008.text:
Ohhh! 
I can't wait sir Rochefort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_009.text:
Please teach me how 
to become a great hero like you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_010.text:
Good! 
To become like me... first...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_012.text:
You should be ready to sacrifice your life
for a beautiful lady like.. her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_013.text:
If you are a true man,
you should have a lady of your destiny!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_014.text:
My wounded eye... 
This is the wound of glory for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_015.text:
I sacrificed my eye for protecting my
goddess from the threat of death!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_016.text:
I'm not so sure about how to become a true hero.
However... the true power.... hmm

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_017.text:
...perhaps comes from protecting something precious.
The road to become a true hero....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_018.text:
...seems like my definition of "strength" seems similar to yours..
What do you think about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_019.text:
... I agree.
Betting my own life for a beautiful lady... Hmm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_021.text:
Haha! Right!
True hero must know how to sacrifce himself for a lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_022.text: Let me ask that beauty over there to become my lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_023.text:
You seem like a beauty with a strong will!
I think I fell in love with you at the first sight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_024.text:
Wow, I support you with all my might!
Go for it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_027.text:
Malicious group of people detected.
Converting to the battle mode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_028.text: Leon, I believe in your insight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_030.text: However.... I think that was somewhat a wrong choice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_031.text: I...I think the same way sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_033.text: A hero should... know when to retreat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_034.text: I see! I'll keep that in mind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_036.text:
...And this is the timing for retreat!
Run, Leon!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_037.text:
Whoooaa!!!
Don't leave me behind, sir Rochefort!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_6_038.text:
Uhh... Umm... 
What are they..? A comedy duet or what...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_002.text:
Long time no see, Teresa. 
You look good today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_003.text:
No, not really.
Are you still after Manacar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_007.text: Hey you demon. Stay away from her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_008.text:
Huh? But I am quite close with her actually.
You are still so impolite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_009.text: What do you know about sis Mel?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_010.text:
Well... I think I know quite a lot about her.
For example... she loves sweets!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_012.text:
You didn't know? Haha!
I guess I know her better than you do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_013.text: No way! I know more about Mel...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_014.text:
Yes, I know that Melissa looks lovely with 
a pig-tail hairstyle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_015.text:
Tsk tsk. You don't know anything.
It is not the pig-tail! She looks much better with...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_017.text: Hmm? Something fun going on here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_018.text:
... Well I think something rather 
disturbing is going on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_020.text:
Maybe you need some sweets!
Would you like to join me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_021.text:
Oh, thanks for your suggestion.
But I don't really like...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_022.text:
There is a great macaron shop near. 
Don't you want to go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_023.text:
I really want to talk with Melissa!
She is Teresa's favorite friend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_7_027.text:
... Some people are just born to be attractive.
I think she is the one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_001.text:
Finally, the day has come!
I was waiting for so long, Chocolat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_002.text:
Hmm? What's up?
Are you here to buy some cakes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_003.text: Oh I don't care about your cakes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_004.text:
I had been working on my best to produce
super wheat! Finally I am prepared to beat you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_007.text:
Vegetable morning bread baked with 
organic wheat and egg!!!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_008.text:
Wow that sounds great!
Shall we have some sweets then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_010.text: Don't put on airs! This is my best-seller bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_011.text:
No sugar, no butter, and no flour!
Great tasting whole-wheat bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_012.text: Some strawberry jam would be perfect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_013.text:
Crispy pastry with sweet jam inside!
A strawberry pie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_014.text:
Urgh, those look so sweet.
Then... It's my turn!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_015.text: Oh wait, I have some newly made breads as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_016.text:
Moistured cake sheets covered with sweetness!
A chocolate cake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_017.text:
That cake... I can't beat that one...
Is this another defeat ...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_018.text:
I was smelling something sweet!
Wow so many breads!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_019.text:
I was so hungry from working in the field..
Thanks for all the breads!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_020.text: Are you.. eating my breads as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_021.text:
Huh? Of course! Those are tasty as well.
Whether it's sweet or not breads are so delicious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_022.text:
...Yes this is what I've wanted.
Shame on me for treating a bread as a tool for battle..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_024.text:
We can't always be eating sweets. 
I love your healthy breads.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_025.text:
I am leaving now.
Don't be so bragging about yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_026.text:
I'm not leaving because I lost.
I am leaving to make breads for my customers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_028.text: Hope you bring some more bread next time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_8_029.text:
... I prefer unsweetened bread.
How about you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_001.text:
Sigh... 
I have no inspiration at all..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_002.text:
I visited all the way to the North country...
Urgh....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_004.text:
Urgh...
I don't think it would help me to just be here doing nothing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_005.text:
Okay, I should cheer my self up 
and look for materials for my novel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_007.text:
I must train my magic power
to win the card game battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_009.text:
Oh dear,
there is someone training here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_010.text:
Hmm.. I better not disturb.
I should move to somewhere else...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_014.text:
The main character for my next novel..! It should be 
that card soldier in wonderland adventure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_016.text:
Huh?
Oh my! Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_017.text:
Thank you so much! I am a novelist. 
Thanks to you, I think I can write a good story!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_018.text:
This is a small gift of appreciation. 
Thank you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_9_020.text:
A card soldier in a wonderland adventure...?
I think I've heard something similar before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0001.text: Then I shall leave you to the task, Capricorn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0003.text:
I vow to fulfill my task
and bring glory to the Twelve Zodiacs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0004.text: I shall sacrifice my life if need be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0005.text:
There is no need for sacrificing of lives,
but I compliment your valor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0008.text:
If you want something, then say it!
Stop bothering my training!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0009.text: And following me to the restrooms - not okay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0010.text:
...! Sharp are your eyes
to discern me in my hiding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0011.text:
What hiding?!
You were standing in plain sight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0012.text:
Indeed...
Your spirit is that of a true Zodiac.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0013.text:
Yet I am bound by secrecy by Lady Athena herself -
for it is I who must carry out her secret mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0014.text:
Fine, fine. I see what this is about. On the Beast King's honor,
I will never, never, NEVER tell Athena's secret to anyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0016.text:
H-how did you know....!
N-no. I cannot trust you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0017.text:
Wait, Cancer!
You shall never escape me...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0019.text:
This could provide a good 'ship'
different from that of Scorpion and Piesces...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0021.text:
That Zodiac Libra...
has a very ... erm, interesting hobby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0022.text:
What is it, you ask?
Er, I'm not very sure I should show you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_05_0023.text: ... Do you still want to know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_001.text:
Get out of here right now.
Zodiac army is sacred. How dare you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_002.text:
You are nothing more than a strong woman.
What happened to the Zodiac Army!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_004.text:
What? 
Ha! Look at you with that weird horn on your head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_005.text: Look at yourself before calling someone an idiot, you're stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_007.text:
What did you say?
All muscles and no brain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_009.text: Ha ha. I'm not afraid of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_010.text:
What? You were ambushed by Aries?
How cowardly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_012.text: She raid me and I've got a big bump on my head!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_013.text: She should be ashamed of being such a cowardly warrior.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_015.text:
You! Cowardly warrior!
I can't forgive you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_016.text:
As a senior in the Zodiac Army, 
I will teach you a warriors' attitude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_017.text: I'm saying that it's just a misunderstanding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_019.text:
Ha... 
I really didn't want to use my fist...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_023.text:
You are the problem!
You trouble maker!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_024.text:
Oh... sorry! I misunderstood.
Here's my apology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_025.text: You can hit me until you feel better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_026.text:
It's all right. It's all resolved, you apologized.
Everything's okay now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_027.text:
What a beautiful non-verbal communication.
Seems great!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_1_028.text:
It's like... some kind of... 
warriors' communication!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0001.text:
What the!
Who are these dirty soldiers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0002.text:
How dare you block my way...
So rude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0003.text: What? Who are you little kid?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0004.text:
Kid, we are in quite happy mood, 
so I'll let you go this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0008.text:
What do you think I'm doing!
I'm being aggressive!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0010.text:
You've woke up!
You've got to take a rest first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0012.text:
I'm the priest of Athena.
Now then, please take a rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0013.text:
..A..the..na?
Oh..! I'm getting out of here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0015.text:
Athena!
I told you not to bring that sort of person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0017.text:
Ha ha. That's enough.
I can't let a wounded beast to flee away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0018.text:
...Excuse me?
He is a human... if we're looking at the same thing... What's with the beast?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0019.text: Well, indeed he acts like a beast but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0020.text:
Is it?
He looks like a beast hurting from its wounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0021.text: Umm... I think Athena is correct.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_2_0022.text: Wounded beast, the perfect explanation for present Hector.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_001.text:
Whoa. Is this the city of witches?
It developed a lot during the centuries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_002.text: ... What is making me so sleepy by the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_003.text: What are you doing in the middle of the road in this broad daylight?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_005.text:
Um... I slept again.
I think it's become a habit or something...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_007.text:
How can you?
Why don't you value your time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_008.text:
It's just one of my physical attributes.
By the way, I can feel significant magic power from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_010.text:
Do you know something about my magic?
Do you know something about the former Goddess of the Forest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_015.text: Whenever I feel magic, I unconsciously have dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_017.text: To perishable mankind, sleep is such a waste of time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_018.text:
But it is the most effective way to cure our state of mind.
You won't have a clear state of mind without sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_019.text: Don't you think so too, maiden?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_021.text:
You were here Beatrice...!
You asked badly so we came out, but this is enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_022.text:
When... and if secular spirit corrupts your holy figure...
Athena will be so mad!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_023.text:
Stay still young fellow.
I have to teach her how precious sleep is
and how restless she could be without it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_024.text: How can a clumsy person who sleeps everywhere give me a lesson?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_026.text: Honorable saintess. In Hasla there is this saying, Beauty sleeps more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_027.text:
Beatrice is already beautiful enough. 
It's understandable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_028.text: Maybe the Goddess of sleep was envious of Beatrice's beauty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_030.text:
Hey! What do you mean!
Do you mean that a woman with no sleep can't be beautiful?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_031.text:
I'm Forest Witch Arita, one of the great 4 witches.
I'll punish you for the sake of people with insomnia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_032.text: Every beautiful rose has its thorn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_033.text: That thorn makes you more beautiful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_034.text: I can see your beauty underneath the face of sadness, happiness and madness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_035.text: Too beautiful to shade with the veil of sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_037.text: Then will you give me the honor to escort you to Rome?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_3_038.text:
How could he control those strong women...
Whoa, he is incredible!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0001.text: Well then, manage the case as you briefed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0002.text:
All right. And then I will report 
as I used to do in old times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0003.text:
Oh please.
Hmm. Anyway, nice weather today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0004.text: How about a short walk with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0006.text:
Well no.
Haha I hope you don't.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0007.text:
... Then I will.
I'll be your guard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0011.text:
Low voice. 
You know what I'm about to tell you, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0013.text:
...Well.
I will go and find out why the girl is being held captive like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0014.text: I feel so thankful that you are my right-hand man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0018.text: I'll be back soon with information you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0021.text:
In the first hand, it's aristocrat's fault to let lions wander around the street.
But... the girl is a commoner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0022.text:
You know what I mean.
Only because....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0024.text:
Now I know the reason,
I'll find out how to help the girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0028.text: Well, I don't need an answer for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0029.text:
I am always thankful for you always being by my side 
despite all that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0031.text: Please manage what I asked you before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0035.text:
Will the wounded beast...
long for someone who have taken him or...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0036.text:
Well the story ends here.
You curious about the next story?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_4_0037.text: Then... let's leave it for later on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_DEFAULT_1.text: Questa è la panetteria di Chocolat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_DEFAULT_2.text: Vieni a provare le nostre specialità!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_DEFAULT_4.text:
Mi piace tantissimo il Colosseo!
Mio padre era un grande guerriero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_RESULT_2.text:
Evviva, il tuo ordine è pronto!
Torna a trovarci per altri cibi!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_UNLOCK_2.text:
Lednas mi ha parlato di te.
Hai compiuto grandi gesta, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_UNLOCK_4.text:
Oh sì! Che ne dici se ti preparassi il #cibo# necessario
per l'addestramento degli eroi? Quando ti serve, fammelo sapere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_WAR_1.text:
I heard from Bridget. 
So the Neth Empire started this war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_WAR_2.text:
It is scary... However, Lednas promised us
that she will protect us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_WAR_3.text:
Also, we have you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
You are very reliable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BREAD_WAR_4.text:
I will bake yummy bread,
so come visit me any time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_1.text:
Monthly Hasla has prepared a special feature!
Pumpkin Carnival reporting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_10.text:
Aww, what a cute young woman!
Yes, I am the reporter from Monthly Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_11.text:
I would like to have an interview with heroes
participating in the festival,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_12.text: so would you please give us a moment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_13.text:
Yes, so the hero in the back?
How do you feel today?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_14.text:
Oh! My name is Sera!
I am here with {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_15.text:
It's my first time to visit here,
I am so excited to enjoy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_16.text:
We are aiming for the winner prize
for the whole mercenary soldiers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_17.text:
...I guess your accompany is a bit shy, haha.
So thank you young cute lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_18.text: I wish you luck on the competition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_19.text:
Yikes, the Carnival is about to start!
Stay tuned!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_2.text:
Every year, witches in the Pumpkin City prepares
a great festival to citizens in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_20.text:
This was the reporter from 
the Pumpkin Carnival Opening Ceremony.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_3.text:
I can't wait to find ouy what kind of traps
they had prepared for this year!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_4.text: We will have an interview with one of the participants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_5.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, look at those!
They are so colorful and pretty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_6.text:
We finished our registration, so we can now
enjoy ourselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_7.text:
Oh! There is a participant!
Let me interview her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_1_8.text:
Hello, this is Monthly Hasla!
How do you feel about this festival today?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_1.text:
Competition is about to start!
There are so many spectators!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_2.text: Ohh, I feel a bit nervous...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_3.text:
Well, I shall cheer up!
Go, {PLAYER_NAME}!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_4.text:
Yes! So the Carnival is now beginning.
Participants are preparing for their competition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_5.text: Huh? Is this voice from the sky...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_6.text:
Hello again!
This is the reporter from Monthly Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_7.text:
I am here at the special relay base in the air,
to give live broadcast on the carnival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_2_8.text:
Wow, what a great view from the sky!
I will do my best to relay this event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_3_2.text:
Witches' magic is so amazing.
I still feel like I am in magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_3_3.text: Hmm, was I the only one to be excited?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_3_5.text:
Honestly, I did really have so much fun
to be with you {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARNIVAL_3_6.text: Maybe we can visit again together next time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0003.text:
If you are Lednas, then
this must be {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0004.text:
I'm Winchester.
Nice to meet you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0005.text:
Um... This village is quiet.
Seems nice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0006.text:
By the way...
The warriors of freedom have contacted us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0007.text:
Why were you late?
Did you guys encounter something while coming...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_1_0015.text:
Don't ask.
Well... I should go and find him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_2_0002.text:
Wow! A walking cat! 
I will capture you this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_2_0007.text:
I've cleaned them and arranged them neatly!!! 
Where are they?!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_2_0008.text:
What is this sassy girl!!!
You!!! Stop!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_3_0003.text:
Yes.
My previous wagon was broken, so I asked for a new one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_3_0004.text:
The new wagon is just perfect.
Thanks to you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_3_0005.text: It's much better than the previous one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_3_0006.text:
Indeed it is.
I'm sure that it will be much more comfortable for Winchester.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0003.text:
Ah, Winchester.
Out for a walk?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0004.text:
Um. Joan hasn't been making trouble recently.
So, I have spare time to take a walk!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0005.text:
I'm not feeling good these days...
I feel refreshed just being free.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0006.text:
Joan is always vigorous.
It seems nice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0008.text:
Not that I work for her,
but she used to be very weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0009.text:
I'm so glad that she is now
healthy and vigorous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0010.text:
She was beautiful when she was sick, 
but now her rosy cheeks make her look lively!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0011.text:
And that smile... it's like the summer sun!
Well sometimes I want to kick her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_4_0012.text:
Hmm... Nevermind. Forget that.
Ah! And do you know what Joan did her last day?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0001.text:
Joan!
What are all these wounds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0002.text:
I was... chasing the walking cat...
It hurts! ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0003.text:
Thanks, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I might have lost her in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0004.text: How can I show you my appreciation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0005.text:
I should take her home first.
Sorry, I can't do anything for you immediately...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0006.text:
But Joan is the priority for me now.
I will stop by later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0007.text:
Thank you sincerely. Will it be okay?
Lednas, I will visit you soon too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0010.text:
I... like this place.
I like {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0011.text:
The people from this village are so nice.
We visited many villages while wandering...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0012.text:
but here, I feel something different...
I do want to stay here longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0015.text:
If they need our help,
we will be here, near them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_FREE_5_0017.text:
What is it... meow?
I feel freaky... meow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_1_1_0001.text:
Oh, are you the reinforcement from Han?
We were coming to greet you, but it seems we are late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_1_2_0001.text:
...The wind from the east...
thus passed flames, of scarlet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_1_3_0001.text:
I am... Hanee Baram.
And you are?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_1_3_0002.text:
Ah, I am called Lednas.
Greetings, Hanee Baram.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_1_0001.text:
Oh, West wind!
What were you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_3_0002.text:
Perhaps you follow your namesake (as Baram means 'wind')...
You seem drawn to the wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_3_0003.text:
Ah, I'm not saying that your name is strange.
It is unusual, but pretty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_5_0001.text:
Mountain patron saints of Han are not human beings;
thus they have strange and unfamiliar names.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_5_0002.text:
They have various abilities or form,
and they are named after what represents them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_5_0003.text:
One of my friends is named Eun Garam.
She is gentle, like the flowing stream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_5_0004.text:
Another of my friends is named Neul Solgil.
Like his name he is the patron saint of a mountain of pines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_6_0001.text:
I did not know they had such meanings!
That is very interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_6_0002.text:
What about yours, Hanee Baram?
May I ask the meaning of your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_7_0001.text: ...the cold wind... has changed its course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_2_7_0002.text:
You are called Lednas,
are you not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_1_0001.text:
Hanee Baram!
A present arrived for you just this morning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_1_0002.text:
A beautiful bouquet has arrived
from Han!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0001.text:
...Yum. I was eating flowers.
These flowers are very good for patron saints.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0002.text:
I get stronger when I eat these.
They've sent the flowers from my area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0004.text:
Do you wish to try some too?
I do not know if it shall have the same effect on humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0005.text:
O-oh no.
The flowers are specially for you, Hanee Baram.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0006.text: Thank you, but I do not think I could eat them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_3_3_0007.text:
Is that so?
How strange. They are delicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_2_0002.text: Yes, Hanee Baram. Those are our names.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_3_0001.text: By the way, did something happen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_3_0002.text:
I... I did not know, until now.
Is my way of speaking peculiar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_3_0006.text: You did sometimes trail off in the middle of the conversation, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0001.text:
In our lands... most patron saints are tigers,
but I am a rabbit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0002.text:
Such is the reason I am loved
among my people of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0003.text:
Everyone knew what I wanted, when I wanted...
even when I did not speak, I did not need to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0004.text:
That is why...
I did not feel the need to explain my thoughts or emotions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0006.text:
I wondered why some would stare so strangely,
ever since I left my homeland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_4_0007.text: I only realize now the question behind their gazes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_5_0001.text:
And so... I will try too.
To talk as others do, so my thoughts can reach theirs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_5_0002.text:
You must have been confused at times too.
Thank you for talking to me, even so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_5_0003.text:
Ah, no.
In fact, I must thank you for your words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_5_0004.text:
I feel much closer to you now, Hanee Baram.
I am glad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_4_6_0001.text: ...Were we not friends from the beginning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_1_0002.text:
Ah, Hanee Baram. 
You seem quite happy today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0001.text:
There are so many curious things in this town!
Things I have never seen before, in the mountains!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0002.text: Today I saw a heap of iron walking around!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0004.text:
So you call it a "robot"!
It was very interesting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0005.text:
How strange that something can walk around, without a soul...
Curious, curious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0006.text: I like this town more and more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_2_0007.text:
Huhu, is that so?
I am happy that you are enjoying your stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_3_0001.text:
So, I told Han that 
I would like to stay here longer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_3_0002.text:
I would like to dwell in this village for some time.
Thank you for having me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_4_0001.text: Thank you as well, Hanee Baram.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_5_0001.text:
The villagers must all be very good friends!
Playing as they do right now...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_5_0002.text:
I should ask to play as well!
Then, Lesduna, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_HAN_5_6_0001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
Is my name truly that difficult to remember...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0001.text:
Ah, I was waiting for you. 
You are the knight from... from...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0003.text:
I’m alright. By the way, seems like 
there are a lot of strong heroes here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0004.text:
I'm flattered. 
Oh, I don't know your name yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0006.text:
I'm Galahad, the knight.
The Emperor sent me here to help you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0007.text:
Ah! You are the Galahad!
I must show my appreciation to the Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0008.text:
Ah, sorry. {PLAYER_NAME}.
I was so excited that I forgot to explain this situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0009.text:
This is Galahad from the Knights Templar of the empire.
He has been working as a knight for long time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0010.text:
...and sure he made a big contribution. 
He earned a title, Shield of the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0011.text:
He is one of the most powerful men in Grancia,
being the envy of all knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0012.text:
I'm so excited to meet 
such a popular figure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0013.text:
That's an old story.
Don't brag.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0014.text:
Don't be so modest, sir.
You are still the best knight ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0015.text: Huh... Not bad to be a hero of somebodies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0016.text:
Then I should do my best 
to meet your expectations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0017.text:
Call me whenever you need my help.
I'll do my best to protect you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_1_0018.text: Looking forward to working with you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0001.text:
Sir, you seem to be happy.
Any good news?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0002.text:
Not really.
It's just that I've been living in turmoil,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0003.text:
it's been a while to be in such a quiet place.
I was just enjoying the mood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0004.text: Capital City is indeed always noisy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0005.text:
When I was there during my mission,
I was completely overwhelmed by the vibe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0007.text:
So vital with all those merchants and warriors 
with a bunch of dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0009.text:
Especially those thieves targeting Grancia merchants
and the scary monsters were always the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0010.text: The other knights and I had a hard time fighting them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0011.text: Well thanks to mercenaries we can now focus on our mission as knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0012.text:
Hmm, maybe I will feel relaxed 
because of your efforts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0014.text:
We are just doing what we think 
is right for seeking peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_2_0015.text:
Well, I like that mind. 
The Emperor has a good insight! Ha ha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0002.text:
You are losing your posture!
Try it again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0006.text:
Well nothing...
I just dropped by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0008.text: Recently, I received the Knights Templar training coursebook.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0009.text:
I was training your warriors 
so that our forces become stronger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0010.text: Oh, you didn't have to do that. I am humbled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0011.text:
Haha! Don't worry.
I like staying active more than resting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0012.text:
By the way, your warriors are good!
I like that desire within them. They were worth teaching!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_3_0013.text:
Let me know when you have spare time.
I will train you guys based on my own experiences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0001.text:
You're here. I got a letter from the Knights Templar.
There are stories of the heroes that you've sent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0002.text: I think they are doing quite well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0003.text: Hmm, what am I doing here while all of the other warriors are fighting on the battlefield?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0006.text:
Your training has been 
a big help for our mercenaries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0009.text: Haha! It makes me feel better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0010.text:
All right. I'll do my best to pull out 
the best potential from more warriors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_4_0011.text:
But, it will be a tough training. 
Better be ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0001.text:
Wow, better than ever.
You might win over me in the near future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0002.text:
I'm so flatterd, sir.
Your lesson was so precious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0003.text:
You said I was being modest.
But I think you are more than me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0004.text:
I'm not being modest. I should train much more
to become a figure like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0005.text:
I like that mindset. 
It feels great training warriors like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0006.text: Maybe you guys can be the next Galahad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0009.text:
You guys are getting better so fast...
I look forward to a better future!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_KNIGHT_5_0010.text:
Well, don't just stand there.
Let's move on to the next place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_001.text: … Sigruna's letter reads that to represent the Confederation of Minor Tribes,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_002.text:
King Aindel, the Lord of Elves himself,
 will visit our town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_003.text:
She… erm, wrote that he may be…
 quite… odd. Quite emphasized it, in fact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_004.text: Ah, Lord Aindel? Welcome. I am Lednas, and this is {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_005.text:
We are in charge of the security of this town,
 and {PLAYER_NAME} is the captain of our town's Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_006.text:
Ah, greetings! I am Aind…Er,
 I mean to say, who do you mean by this 'Aindel'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_007.text:
I am 'Elf Mask,'
 friend to all tribes of the Confederation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_008.text:
Er… The letter clearly mentioned that
 it would be Lord Aind - …

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_009.text: My apologies. There must have been a misunderstanding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_010.text:
No, no. 
I only ask for your clear distinction: Aindel is not my name, it is 'Elf Mask.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_011.text:
I came to your town in hopes of seeing how well 
the Confederation was doing, under your care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_1_012.text: My our alliance be true, Lednas, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_001.text: Lord Ai- I mean, Elf Mask, what brings you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_002.text: I only wished to see how the Confederation was doing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_003.text: My heart only worries for their sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_004.text: You seem very concerned about the Confederation… Perhaps confiding in us shall lighten the burden on your heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_006.text:
The Confederation consists of four different races,
 and exists solely to protect one another.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_007.text:
Other alliances are created for a particular purpose…
 Our Confederation, on the other hand, is built on an ideal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_008.text: Thus our bond… is not as strong as we desire it to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_010.text:
In the earlier days of the Confederation,
 many difficulties arose from the differences among races…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_011.text:
Difficulties that in time, the four races - the Devils, the Woopa Tribe,
 the Animals, and the Elf Tribe - came to acknowledge and accept.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_012.text:
Thus the Confederation stands here today, yet I still fear for its future.
 For I fear there are still many cracks to be found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_013.text: Ah, my Animal friends! How have you been, little masters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_014.text: It seems my presence is required elsewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_2_016.text: Lord Aindel… does cut a strange figure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_001.text:
Hoho, I wonder what are our friends of the Confederation
 doing in such a remote place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_002.text: Wait! This calls for Elf Mask, true friend to the Confederation, to stop fights among all tribes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_003.text:
Halt! Stop! Fighting serves no purpose!
 You must be patient, no matter how angry you are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_004.text: All of us would do better with more patience.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_005.text: I… believe this is a misunderstanding… Vee were just training, sir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_008.text:
Ah… My apologies.
 I seem to have misunderstood the situation…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_009.text:
Is something troubling you, Lord Aindel?
 You do not seem too well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_010.text:
Ah. I… saw tribespeople of the Confederation
 train amongst themselves, and in my concern

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_011.text:
stopped them, as I thought they are fighting.
 I fear I have caused discomfort where there was none before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_012.text:
I see. … May I tell you my true thoughts 
 concerning the matter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_013.text: Speak as you wish. Fear not against offense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_014.text: I… It is my belief that in your concern, you may be overprotecting members of the Confederation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_015.text: Overprotecting? I do not believe it! It is my task, as the ki- Elf Mask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_016.text:
Your concern and love for the Confederation
 are just and well-meant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_017.text:
Yet I fear too much protection on their behalf
 may instead suffocate their natural growth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_018.text:
As the leader of the alliance, it may prove wise at times
 to simply trust them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_019.text:
They must realize on their own
 the meaning of an alliance, of their bond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_020.text:
Trust them… I understand.
 I shall go reflect more upon the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_021.text: Oh, and I am not Aindel. I am Elf Mask, truest friend to all Minor Tribes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_3_022.text: Oh… Of course, Lord Aind- Elf Mask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_4_001.text:
("Yet I fear too much protection on their behalf
 may instead suffocate their natural growth.")

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_4_003.text:
("As the leader of the alliance, 
it may prove wise at times to simply trust them.")

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_4_005.text:
("They must realize on their own the meaning of an alliance, 
of their bond.")

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_4_007.text: Yes, the Confederation indeed continues to grow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_001.text: Ah, I was just asking after the two of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_002.text: The two of us? Whatever is the matter,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_003.text: Lord Ain… I mean, Elf Mask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_004.text:
I wish to give you my sincerest thanks…
 for the advice you bestowed upon me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_005.text: No. I only spoke out of admiration and trust for the love you showed for the Confederation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_006.text:
I did nothing to receive such thanks.
 Please, sir, raise your head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_007.text:
No, thank you. It was only through you that I realized 
 the Confederation needed trust, and not protection.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_008.text:
This hardly attests to my gratitude, but as a sign
 of my confidence, I shall reveal to you… my true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_009.text:
I am the representative of the Confederation
 of Minor Tribes, the King of Elves, Aindel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_010.text:
I pray you be not too alarmed!
 I did not mean to fool you so well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_011.text: Yes, we… were… very surprised, by the unexpected turn of events.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_012.text: And Lednas, {PLAYER_NAME}, I wish to ask you a small favor, if I may.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_013.text:
Tis my desire to lengthen my stay, 
 and remain by the side of my friends of the Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_014.text:
Of course, I shall provide my aid whenever you require it.
 Would it be too difficult a request?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_MINO_5_015.text: Oh, no! Please stay as long as you like. Isn't that so, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_1.text:
Miss Celine. The engineer arriving today 
is coming to reinforce our village,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_10.text: In ancient times, a vast civilization that specialized in machines...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_11.text: ...and so magical engineering was born as a result ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_12.text:
Ah, Miss Celine. I apologize for interrupting you,
but will you not look down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_13.text:
Huh! A shadow that has appeared out of nowhere!
How curious, very curious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_14.text:
Miss Celine. I sense danger...
I advise you to come out of the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_15.text:
Oh, no! Danger always accompanies true research!
And if need be, I'll just use magic and I'll be fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_16.text:
Oi, brat!
Get out of my way if you don't want to die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_17.text:
Oho! And a strange voice coming from nowhere!
This is a curious phenomenon indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_18.text:
Miss Celine! This is dangerous!
Get out of there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_19.text: You really want to die this early, brat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_2.text: so you do not have to wait out of concern...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_20.text: You would be dead by now had I not slowed down at the last minute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_22.text:
Whew... Thankfully I was not too late.
Miss Celine, please be more careful next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_23.text:
Are you the one coming from the Neth Empire to reinforce our village?
Welcome. My name is Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_25.text:
Frantz. 
The engineer who has come to reinforce your village, just as you said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_26.text:
Although I'm certainly not happy
about those blasted officials sending me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_28.text:
Oh, and this is {PLAYER_NAME}, leader of our company,
and Miss Celine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_29.text: We look forward to working with you, Master Frantz.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_30.text:
Yes, yes. I need to help you if I want my salary,
so let's get along without any trouble, alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_31.text:
I'm going to set up my workshop in the outskirts of the village,
so call me when you need my help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_32.text: And next time, make sure not to stand around my landing area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_37.text:
I have never seen such an enormous machine!
It must contain the very essence and crux of Hasla's history of mechanical engineering...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_38.text:
My research senses are tingling!
I must find out more about that machine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_39.text: I'll see you both later, then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_4.text:
I'm not concerned at all! But imagine, Neth Empire 
the very capital of mechanical and magical engineering!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_40.text:
Mm... Fortunately, she does not seem to be injured.
Then let us return to the village as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_5.text:
Aren't you curious at all 
about all the knowledge he has accumulated and will bring to this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_6.text: Well... I'm afraid such matters lie beyond my knowledge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_7.text:
Is that so...! Well, don't worry, Lednas!
Let me explain to you the concept of magical and mechanical engineering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_8.text:
We will start from the very beginning, step by step, history to concept!
You'll get a hold of it in no time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_1_9.text: First, let me begin with the relationship between magical engineering and mechanical engineering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_1.text:
We certainly did put a lot of preparation into it, but 
I am uncertain whether Master Frantz will like our present...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_10.text: I ask you to please not bother Master Frantz too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_11.text:
Oh, you have no need to worry about that!
Now, {PLAYER_NAME}, lead the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_13.text: Just toss it somewhere and I'll take a look at it later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_14.text:
Mister Frantz! Won't you tell me more about your machine?
Some secrets, maybe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_15.text: Don't call it "my machine" when it has a name: AMK-001.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_16.text:
And I'm busy right now.
Get out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_17.text:
So it's called AMK-001!
Even its very name sounds fascinating!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_18.text:
Then how does your machi... ah, AMK-001 work?
By what mechanism does it function?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_19.text: Can it be likened to android robots? Or does it have a central power core, like golems? Or does it use a completely different engine system?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_2.text:
Well, I wish you the best of luck,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_20.text: If it does use a completely different engine, what are its central components?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_21.text:
Or does it function under a totally idiosyncratic mechanism?
I'm curious, very curious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_22.text: Ugh... I did not sign up for this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_23.text:
Oi, you.
You. Talk. Too. Much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_24.text: And I have no responsibility at all to answer your questions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_25.text: I didn't come to be "friends," if that was what you were expecting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_26.text:
We are simply allies. A business transaction between two subjects,
so to speak. Nothing more, nothing less.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_27.text:
I've spent enough time chit-chatting as it is.
Now get out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_28.text:
I-I'm afraid I made matters much worse,
despite the warning Lednas gave me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_29.text:
My curiosity got the better of me.
I should... I should reflect on my actions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_31.text: I'll take a short walk before returning to the village, then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_4.text:
Are you going to visit the engineer from Neth?
Then I wish to go as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_5.text:
There shouldn't be a problem, but...
For what purpose, if I may ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_6.text:
I'd like to discuss some more about 
that interesting machine with Frantz!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_7.text: Even thinking about it makes my heart bounce!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_8.text:
A-ah. I see.
But Miss Celine, I must say this:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_2_9.text:
the aim of this visit 
is to establish a good relationship between Neth and our hero band.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_1.text:
I apologize. 
It seems that there has been a mishap in the delivery process...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_11.text: Stop. It's not something you can fix so easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_14.text:
Oh, it's simple
a slight variation of the spell I used while exploring that ancient tower!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_15.text:
It's a type of visualization magic
that structualizes the memory of the senses into particles

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_16.text:
and combines them with a particular magic wavelength 
to render them visible to the naked eye, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_18.text: Huhu, normally I would begin with explaining the very basic concepts, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_19.text: In short, the fundamental principle of using mana is the same.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_2.text:
First the brat of a magician, now this...
Nobody's of any help around this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_20.text:
The only difference is the medium of recovery:
either a past memory could be visualized, or matter could be restored!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_21.text:
But in order to restore an object to its previous state,
you must have perfect and detailed knowledge of the object itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_22.text:
With no knowledge of its mechanism and structure,
you can only fail!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_23.text:
and combines them with a particular magic wavelength 
to render them visible to the naked eye, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_24.text:
I... I'm sorry.
This is all quite beyond me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_25.text:
Hmm. So you had prior knowledge about this particular component...
Unexpected of a wizard brat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_26.text:
Go on, try it out.
There shouldn't be a big problem!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_28.text: Fine, I'll try it out right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_29.text: Huhu... I'm quite sure you'll be pleased with its results!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_3.text: Think I came here of sheer goodwill? A purity of heart to do volunteer work?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_30.text:
Don't get cocky.
You are the reason I had to order new parts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_31.text:
Fine, lets hope this works out perfectly fine,
just as you promised me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_32.text:
I'll specially invite you to my workshop.
And give you the privilege of asking me as many questions you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_34.text:
Whew... What a relief.
If it had not been for your timely help...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_35.text:
I fear to think of what would have happened.
Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_36.text:
Oh no... Think of it as a personal compensation of sorts
for the mistake I made last time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_38.text: Shall I continue on with my explanation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_39.text:
Huh? W-well, Miss Celine...
I... You see, I have other things to do... Perhaps at another time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_4.text: I... I ask for your forgiveness. I have no excuse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_40.text: Oh, Lednas! It'll just be a minute! A minute, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_5.text:
My, things seem to be tense around here!
What's the problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_7.text: Some supplies from the Neth Empire

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_8.text:
have arrived seriously damaged.
There seems to have been an accident during its delivery...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_3_9.text:
Unfortunately, among them
were some things that Master Frantz had requested quite urgently...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_1.text: So, Frantz. By what engine does this particular machine run?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_10.text:
Sigh...
Why did I ever make that stupid offer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_11.text:
Neth Empire must be a better place than I thought
to send such a great engineer like Frantz as reinforcement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_12.text:
Ha, they just wanted a good enough excuse
to send me somewhere far away from the empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_13.text:
Receive subsidies /and/ get an eyesore out of the way: 
two birds with one stone. Who would refuse such an offer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_14.text: Annoying bastards, the lot of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_16.text:
What exactly happened between you and those... government officials
for you to hate them so much?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_17.text: They tried to sell off AMK to a greedy corporation for its technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_19.text: But doesn't AMK-001 belong to you, Frantz?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_2.text:
It's a self-powered engine that uses the basic laws of thermal radiation.
I developed it myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_20.text:
It does, now.
But once it used to belong to the Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_21.text:
The original aim of the AMK project
was to strengthen the Neth Army, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_22.text:
Many engineers participated in the project...
and we were making good progress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_23.text:
But... a corporation envious of our technology
bribed the high-ranking officials into halting our project.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_24.text:
The day after they received contact from the corporation,
the government officially put the project into a hiatus.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_25.text:
Most engineers, including myself, left the army afterwards.
Some even left the country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_26.text:
But then...
Why did you remain in Neth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_28.text:
Revenge? Ha, they may be annoying bastards, 
but I'm not as petty as that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_29.text: I just wanted to show those idiots the final outcome of Project A.M.K.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_3.text: As the engine is located in the middle of the robot body,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_30.text:
And I wouldn't call it revenge,
but I did manage to give them some trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_32.text: It wasn't much. I just... changed the password of every single research data document as I terminated the project.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_33.text:
That stupid expression they had on their faces after they checked the files...
Ha, I still laugh when I remember them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_34.text: Did you use some sort of encryption magic that only the encaster can unravel? I remember using such a spell once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_35.text:
Hmm, the basic principle should be the same.
But I have a lot of good stories better than this one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_36.text: Ooh... I want to hear them all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_38.text:
Oi, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Don't just stand there staring, take a seat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_39.text: Let me tell you a funny story...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_4.text: I always wear a heat-protection suit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_5.text: Otherwise, I would literally be cooked inside my own creation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_6.text: Oooh, so it's a very dangerous machine, just as I expected from its power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_7.text:
And that novel engine you spoke of using thermal radiation,
that's very interesting indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_8.text:
Don't call it "machine." It has a proper name: AMK-001.
How many times do I have to say this? Ugh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_4_9.text: Oh, and I have couple of more questions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_1.text:
Ah, so all of you were here.
Good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_10.text:
So that's about it.
It's time for me to return to my workshop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_11.text: Come by my workshop any time, if you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_13.text:
... That... was rather a surprise.
For Master Frantz to have spoken thus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_14.text: I can only imagine what happened between the two of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_15.text: Haha, we had a very deep conversation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_16.text: Ah! Join us next time, Lednas!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_17.text:
Frantz always talks as if he's bothered by everything,
but in fact he is quite lonely!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_19.text:
Yes, I would like that,
the next time you visit Master Frantz.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_2.text:
But... Master Frantz,
what is this box...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_20.text:
Oh, good! Then I can continue with the explanation
I didn't finish last time! Very nice indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_3.text: Think of it as payment, for the present you gave me last time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_5.text:
As for you... I may have been rather rude last time.
Sorry about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_7.text:
I should have been more vigilant in supervising the delivery.
I am to blame -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NETH_5_8.text: - so I ask you not to dwell on it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0002.text:
Perhaps there is trouble on the road;
otherwise she should have arrived a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0003.text: I should send guards at on-...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0005.text:
Pant... Pant...
S-sorry I'm - pant - late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0009.text: Are you 'Lia,' from the kingdom of Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0010.text:
Yes, I'm she!
I've come to Hero Town as reinforcement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0011.text:
You must be Lednas and  {PLAYER_NAME}
seeing that you were waiting for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0013.text: Yes, I am Lednas, and this is {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0014.text: What a relief that you have safely arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0015.text:
We were waiting for hours,
and feared that something happened on the road.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0017.text: I took a wrong turn, and met a monster on the path...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0019.text:
I'm so sorry!
I was stupid, and dumb to even lose my way, and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0020.text: ...but I ran as fast as I could all the way here, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0021.text: and, I mean, um, that is... um -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0022.text:
We were only worried for your sake.
I did not mean to reproach you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0023.text: You have no need to apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0025.text: Yes, so please don't be worried.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0027.text:
Haha, why don't you take a look around the town
and take a rest from your travels?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0028.text: The long journey must have worn you out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0029.text: Oh, no, I was going to help you right away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0030.text:
I thank you for your eagerness,
but I really do think you need your rest, Lia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0031.text:
I see... Okay!
I'll rest as you told me to!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0032.text:
And... And...
I'll work hard! I'll try to be a great help to everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_1_0033.text:
Yes, we expect you will do a great job.
Thank you, Lia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I heard that someone new has come to town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0002.text: Rumor has it she's really cute...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0003.text:
I really want to meet her!
So...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0004.text:
Could you introduce me to her
if you have the time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0005.text:
I'll bake you reaaaallly good bread
if you do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0007.text: Then I'll get to baking right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0009.text:
What! There's someone who wants to meet me?
I'm really happy! She asked for my help, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0012.text: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to say that out loud...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0013.text:
O-oh, no!
Thank you for the lovely compliment...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0014.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0015.text:
I'm Chocolat.
I run the bakery of Hero Town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0018.text:
I don't know much about Hero Town so far, but...
I hope I'll be of some help around here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0019.text:
Oh, don't worry.
I'm sure you'll do fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0020.text: Oh, and I prepared a present for you, Lia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0021.text:
I baked it myself!
I took more care than usual, so it's bound to taste good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0023.text: Sweets are my forte, after all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0025.text:
And it's so pretty.
I never realized bread could be this pretty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0027.text: Hee hee, try it while it's still hot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0028.text:
It's a little sweet, but... um...
It's still really delicious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0030.text:
I baked enough to feed the whole town,
so feel free to take as much as you want!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0032.text:
Mmm... Okay!
Then... thank you for the meal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0033.text:
L-Lia?
You don't have to eat it all at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0034.text:
Cough - cough- ... No...
You baked it for me, though...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0035.text:
If I don't eat it now...
You'll... you'll be disappointed, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0036.text:
What? No! I won't be disappointed at all!
In fact, I'm happy that you're enjoying it so much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0037.text:
But eating this much bread at once shouldn't be good for you.
I'll bake you a new batch the next time you come around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_2_0042.text:
Oh! Um, I really have to use the restroom...
S-sorry! I'll be off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0001.text:
How was I today?
Did I bother you in any way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0002.text: Or... Did I make a mistake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0003.text:
Oh no, you did very well, Lia.
Thanks to you, we could entrust the rear without worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0004.text:
Um - even the smallest advice is okay.
It's for my own improvement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0005.text:
Hmm... You're doing well enough, but...
If you really wish for my advice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0006.text:
Building more stamina
could help you more in the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0008.text:
Then let 's call it a day. 
A job well done, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0009.text: Oh, Lednas! What brings you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0010.text:
Ah, a package arrived for you
from Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0014.text:
Heh heh, well, you told me I should build up my stamina
the last time I asked for advice,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0015.text: so I asked for some training equipment back home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0017.text: Then I should go train right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0018.text: Sigh... I should not have said such a thing without thinking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0019.text:
I had forgotten that Lia...
takes others' words to heart too deeply.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0020.text: I must go apologize to her as soon as she returns.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0021.text:
Lia! Are you alright?
How did you injure yourself so badly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0022.text:
Heh...
You advised me to build up my stamina, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0023.text: You don't mean that you kept training until now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0024.text:
This is not improving yourself at all, Lia.
You are harming your health and body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_3_0025.text:
B-but I did grow stronger!
Look. You'll be surprised...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0005.text:
You are right.
I cannot keep blaming myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0006.text:
Lia?! You shouldn't be outside.
You have yet to heal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0007.text:
I'm okay!
I'm sorry I was lying around useless!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0008.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0010.text:
Um, I don't mind, you know! I can clean, or move around stuff,
or - anything! Just tell me what do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0011.text:
You don't need to help us with anything. 
You must not worry about anythiing but yourself, so please rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0013.text: Why won't you let me help you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0014.text:
Tell me the truth. You were only friendly to me
because you thought my powers useful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0015.text:
Eh? This must be a misunderstanding.
We never regarded you as...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0017.text:
They only liked me because my powers
could be of use to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0018.text:
That's why I always worked hard to meet everyone's expectations...
to become useful to everyone and anyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0019.text: Lia, are you so foolish as to think thus?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0020.text:
Do you really think that we would have regarded you as an 'ally'
simply for your abilities and 'usefulness'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0021.text: That's the only reason you could be kind to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0022.text:
Even now you're only worried for my health
because it would affect your plans to use my powers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0024.text:
We like you not only as an ally,
but as a trustworthy companion

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0027.text: And I will give you advice as a friend:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0028.text: Why don't you try and be more useful for yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_NOS_4_0029.text:
Nobody's word is more important than your own.
