Ci hai salvato anche l'ultima volta!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_20.text: Quell'idiota continua a cacciarsi nei guai...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_29.text:
Eravate in pena per me?
Mi mettete in imbarazzo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_30.text:
Non preoccuparti, Bella. Mi hai ricordato ciò che mi ha
insegnato Cora anni fa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_32.text: Il nostro potere si manifesta quando lo usiamo a fin di bene.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_33.text: Ma Nemesi... Ha instillato il dubbio dentro di me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_34.text:
Per fortuna, tu mi hai indicato la strada giusta, quando
hai cercato di salvare Anut.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_36.text:
È tempo di farla finita con Nemesi.
Bella, ti prego, aiutami.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_4.text:
Sì, non lo dimenticherò mai!
Volevo ringraziarti.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_5.text: E invece mi hai salvato di nuovo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_8.text: Ma queste strane macchine mi impedivano di raccoglierle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ76_9.text: Erbe! Sai qualcosa dell'erba del gelo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_1.text:
Cucù... Dionne, mia Dionne.
Ti ho cercata a lungo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_11.text:
Sto sorridendo, in caso non lo sapessi.
Sai, dato che indosso una maschera...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_14.text:
L'hai tenuto nascosto per tutto questo tempo?
Non temere, l'avevo già messo in conto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_2.text:
Ma sei stata tu a venire da me.
Sono commosso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_20.text:
Blocchi perfino i miei attacchi...
Ma non è ancora finita!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_21.text: Guarda: è ora che tu perda tutto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_29.text: Questo enorme potere... è il potere di Cora?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_31.text:
Nessuno può sconfiggermi ora.
Né le figlie di Cora, né gli Apostoli!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_34.text: Nemesi ha usato gran parte del suo potere con Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_35.text:
Ricordi quando Sera è mutata?
Ora è il momento di combattere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_36.text:
Mmm... AH AH! Volete combattere con me?
D'accordo, collauderò i miei nuovi poteri!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_4.text:
L'ho già sentito dire...
Quando è stato?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_5.text:
Ah, sì!
E posso indovinare com'è andata a finire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_6.text:
Ti annienterò.
E sorriderò per la felicità.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_7.text:
E ti dirò che hai perso tutto.
Cucù...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ77_9.text: Mmm... Cucù! È ora di sorridere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_1.text:
Mmm... Urgh... Ho perso?!
Com'è possibile?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_10.text:
No, non è ancora finita...
Bella, conducimi al portale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_12.text:
Lo spirito di Nemesi non è ancora scomparso.
Ora è indebolito e lo sto tenendo sotto controllo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_13.text:
Ma non potrò resistere a lungo.
Devo tornare nel mio mondo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_18.text:
Bella, non essere triste.
Un giorno avrei comunque dovuto lasciarti... Quel giorno è solo arrivato prima del previsto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_19.text:
Te la sei cavata alla grande con Nemesi.
Sei la vera erede del potere di Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_2.text:
Ancora non capisci.
Il potere di Cora si manifesta solo quando è veramente necessario.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_21.text: Ci hai seguite fin qui con un corpo mortale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_22.text:
Uh, mi sento sollevata. Anche nel futuro, verrà tramandato il volere di Cora.
Grazie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_23.text:
Spero che ci rivedremo, un giorno.
Addio.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ78_5.text:
Mmm... Che cosa è successo?
Nemesi...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_15.text: Oh, Nosgard ci ha mandato questo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_17.text: Credo che sappiano che ci siamo sbarazzati dei robot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_19.text: Mmm... È una cosa buona, giusto?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_2.text:
"Allora"? Non so cosa sia successo dopo.
Comunque, perché tanta agitazione?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_20.text: Sì, ci saranno di grande aiuto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_21.text:
E, a quanto pare, è arrivata l'alleanza del Nord.
Volete andare ad accoglierli?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_23.text: Non è un gioco... Quando ti deciderai a crescere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_29.text:
Dionne... Mmm, è il nome del re di Nosgard?
Sapete qualcosa che io non so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_3.text: Non sei in ansia per le sorti di Dionne?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_6.text:
Oh sì, quasi dimenticavo.
Bella, ho saputo che mi hai salvato la vita?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_8.text: C-Cos... Non l'ho fatto per te, idiota!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ79_9.text: Sei così idiota che non riesci nemmeno a tenerti fuori dai guai!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ80_2.text:
I Vaporis non riusciranno più ad attraversare il portale.
Credo che sia stato distrutto dall'altra parte.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ80_4.text:
Ah, smettila di pensare al passato.
Concentriamoci sul futuro.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ80_5.text:
Non siamo riusciti a trovare Sylunis.
Nemmeno un'impronta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ80_7.text:
Lednas la sta cercando...
Presto riceveremo un suo rapporto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_1.text:
... Sì, ti contatto da un luogo sicuro.
Non preoccuparti.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_2.text: Sì, non si sono accorti che abbiamo creato i Vaporis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_3.text:
È stato un miracolo ingegneristico, riuscire a riprodurre questi
antichi Vaporis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_4.text: I dati che abbiamo raccolto ci torneranno molto utili.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_5.text: E... il portale non rientrava nei miei piani.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_6.text: Ma ci ha permesso di recuperare le spoglie dell'Apostolo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_7.text: ... Grazie. No. Sono felice di avere l'occasione di studiare il corpo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAPTER_5_SQ81_8.text: Sì. Allora ci vediamo più avanti, d'accordo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_DEFAULT_1.text:
What's your business?
Hope it's not a waste of time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_11.text:
The war was like any other war.
But Dionne's spirit was starting to break apart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_12.text:
The spirit of Nemesis began to take control.
Dionne became very fragile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_13.text:
She came to us, asking how to 
get rid of the spirit of Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_15.text:
However, it was impossible to remove 
the spirit completely with Cora's power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_16.text: We couldn't give her an answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_17.text:
We decided to find alternatives, 
but Dionne suddenly disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_18.text:
It was just too late when we found out that 
Dionne threw herself into the 
cracks of another dimension with the spirit of Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_19.text: When we were clearing her remains...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_2.text:
I want to hear about the last 
moment of Dionne...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_20.text:
We noticed a painful shadow 
beyond her smiling face...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_21.text: Afterwards, we studied the ways to seal Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_24.text: Without Dionne, we couldn't come up with the soulstone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_25.text: This is why we have to bring the soulstone back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_3.text:
I would at least engrave her 
last moment in my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_4.text:
All right. You are a Goddess. 
You have right to know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_5.text:
The story goes up to the moment when 
Dionne had arrived in the past 
with the spirit of Nemesis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_7.text:
The spirit of Nemesis has 
remained within Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_8.text:
But Dionne thought that she could 
overcome such evil with her will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_10_1_9.text:
So... She came to the South where 
me and Elanuma were residing, and 
we went entered the battle right away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_1.text: So... that means we are now allies right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_10.text:
I heard that there is the special force 
led by legendary mercenary and 
his right-hand man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_11.text:
I heard the unit is very strong, 
but why aren't they participating in this battle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_13.text: ... They are missing within the Resistance Army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_15.text:
They've leaved the country for another mission...
We are out of contact since then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_16.text:
We request for the emergency return, 
but they are not coming back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_17.text: Any possibility of being in danger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_18.text:
No. They will return sooner or later.
I believe in them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_2.text:
Let's work together for good. 
Bye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_3.text: Wait. Are you the leader of the Resistance Army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_5.text: Archon, maybe you can solve your curiousity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_7.text: Yuria, can I ask you something about your army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_8.text:
Of course. We are ally. 
Exepct fot the classified ones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_13_1_9.text:
I investigated a little about the 
Resistance army before meeting you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_1.text:
Roman Dike. 
The Commander in chief of Neth Imperial Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_2.text:
Even with that much military force, 
he kneel down for lunacy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_3.text:
Continuous death and sacrifices.
Human can't stand on that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_4.text:
But inspite of that, will they 
able to walk a road of Light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_5.text: That's the will to get closer to Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_15_1_6.text:
Dike has allied with the Dark energy. 
He is the enemy of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_2.text:
The journey with you guys 
was very meaningful for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_3.text:
The Road of Light which 
I believed in and tried to go for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_4.text:
The light shining at the end of the road 
won't come to me now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_5.text: I stood still, just spinning the wheels.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_6.text:
But I felt the light, when you and your 
friends came to me and Archon 
in the moment of crisis...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_30_1_7.text: That light gave me a new destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_1.text: Are you the leader of Elard, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_2.text: I'm Chronos, the only remaining daughter of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_4.text:
The more I change time, the more dangers of something going wrong increase.
So there is limitation for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_5.text: But it's possible to stop enemies' time for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_6.text:
I can also rewind to the time you've 
casted powerful attack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_7.text:
Warriors have pulled over number of 
enemies with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_8.text:
What we do... is to protect people from Dark energy, 
and it decides the destiny of this universe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_1_9.text:
I hope you have the resolution to 
carry out the burden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_1.text:
Chronos and Archon are from the
Chronos Hero Group right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_10.text:
If they are all awakened completely, they will be a 
big help to humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_11.text: The legend I've heard from Prima was true...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_12.text: It was the Chronos Hero group!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_13.text: O'ren, the Warrior of Light is called Leon now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_14.text: Sigrun the Arcane Archer, Black Witch Rosanna...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_15.text: They are now called Sigruna and Dorothy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_16.text:
Those three have recalled their memory 
decently, so they're working with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_17.text:
They are working seperately to help the 
alliance army on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_19.text: They also are born to fight the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_2.text: If it's a Hero group, where are the rest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_20.text:
I'm sure that they ard fighting for the 
sake somewhere. We will meet soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_21.text:
That's right.
I'm looking forward to meeting them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_4.text: To be honest, Chronos Hero Group is not complete yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_5.text: Members have been dead for over 100 years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_6.text:
Based on the pledge of the Goddess, they've revived in 
this universe, but I'm the only one who 
has awakened completely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_7.text: The rest are not complete with their memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_8.text:
Warrior of Light, Knight of Oath, Arcane Archer, 
Black Witch, Hunter of Iron Will, and Savior Saintess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_4_2_9.text:
100 years ago, they trained themselves 
to develop their skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_5_1_2.text:
I don't mind. 
I'm just surprised at your courage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_5_1_4.text:
100 years ago, Sylunis extorted the soulstone.
Then her power was taken away and she was imprisoned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_5_1_5.text: When the power is taken away, they go back to a normal human life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_5_1_6.text:
But... She's alive. 
Do you know the truth behind this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_5_1_7.text:
No...
Let's talk about this later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_1.text:
Archon. 
Seems like you're worried about something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_11.text:
Where are they? 
Why is the Resistance Army losing the battle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_12.text:
Yes. We should pay attention to that part too. 
Well done Archon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_2.text: ... I was thinking about the Resistance Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_3.text: Their death is distracting you from our mission?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_4.text:
No. It is very sad indeed, 
but I won't give up my mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_5.text:
But there are some curious 
aspects in the Resistance Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_6.text:
I investigated it seperately, 
and the Resistance Army was such a threatening force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_7.text:
Notably, the special forces led by the
legendary mercenary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_8.text:
But according to history, 
they've never joined the current battles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_7_1_9.text:
They are the main force. 
Why didn't they show up in the war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_1.text:
Their progenitors are the first beasts 
Elanuma had created for daughters of Cora.

Divine Beasts are the ones 
faintly related with them in blood.
Ah... I never knew that they had the progenitors.

If it was created for the daughters of Cora...
Do you have one...?
Of course I have one. My good fellow.
Must be beautiful and powerful like you.
As their destiny, they've went back to Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_2.text:
Well it would be interesting to watch 
Super Smash Battle once.

I might find the trace of my friend 
from those beasts.
I hope you find it Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_4.text:
Is there a problem?
I didn't expect you two coming together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_5.text:
Ah, I just came by after participating in 
Super Smash Battle with {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_7.text:
IT's a popular sports game.
Fighting while riding Divine Beasts is 
quite scary but amazing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_1_1_8.text: Ah... Are you aware of Divine Beasts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_24_1_.text: Um? Are you curious about the Demons?

All right. You should know more 
about your enemy anyway.

As I told you, Demons are made out of 
those captured by the Dark energy.

When they are consumed by the Dark energy , 
it brings change to their bodies.
Dike is not the first Demon in this universe.

But its rare to have control of one's 
mind and power after becoming a demon.

It's because humans have lack of light power.
Dike created the barrier to gain the power.
What happens if the Dark energy is not controlled?

They will go mad. 
Death would be waiting for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP6_ST_HARD_25_1_.text: I have more to say about Demons.

They've devoured the souls 
soaked by the Dark energy.

They were born pure, 
and they desired the purity to 
go back to its original state.
They are the Devran, Demons of Hevnia.

The only way to get rid of Devran that are latched on 
to the souls is us because we have 
the power of light.
They are our enemies. Don't forget that...

It's about Destalos, the Demon which the
Apostle had brought during the Apostles war.

Before coming to Hasla, me and the other sisters 
fought against the Apostles on the 
planet called Hevnia.
There was a tribe called Agelan on the planet.

They had an ability to share their 
psyche through their spirits.

Also, they were born to have 
better light power than humans.

So Agelans could control themselves even 
after being captured by the Apostles' Dark energy.

But they couldn't stop themselves 
from corrupting their soul.

They started to latch onto 
the souls of others with their powers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0002.text:
Have I ever recounted to you the arrival of the First Apostles? 
Three there were, in the beginning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0003.text: Ah, yes... So Dionne told you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0004.text:
You heard of Destalos
when we fought in the city of Edenberg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0005.text:
Our war runs long, and hostilities run deep. The conception of the
Soul Stones after Dionne's ... departure was in itself wise,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0006.text:
but we could not prevent Destalos, after realizing their potential, 
from fighting to seize them for his own purposes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0007.text:
I and the third and last Daughter of Cora, Elanuma, 
managed to trap him after a long battle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0008.text:
...but Destalos, dogged in his nefarious endeavours, 
killed the other Apostles and absorbed their life source to regenerate himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0009.text:
He then gathered the forces of darkness... 
and began what would come to be known as the Apostle's War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0010.text:
Thus after confining Destalos within the Soul Stone 
I thought that the worst had ended.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0011.text:
And yet...he has revived, through Sylunis's schemes. 
Can this truly be a coincidence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_10_1_0012.text:
Perhaps everything has to do with Sylunis's attempt, one hundred years ago, 
to merge herself with the Soul Stone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_11_1_0002.text:
She cannot reveal her name, she cannot reveal her identity. 
There is nothing about her that we can trust.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_11_1_0003.text:
Yet as long as she retains the power of light... 
There is nothing we can do but to accept her aid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_11_1_0004.text:
I did not think it would be wise to question support so desperately desired, 
especially in a situation as desperate as ours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_11_1_0005.text:
And it is but a premonition, and nothing but a premonition 
I sensed a familiar aura from her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_11_1_0006.text: A premonition. ...Haha... How very unlike me, to depend on such things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0001.text:
The figure we encountered in desert the may have been
somewhat unfamiliar in appearance, but I know it was Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0002.text:
Even though time may have passed since our last meeting,
I would never forget an old friend and companion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0003.text:
El Thalnos... Has he truly brought Dionne back 
from the crevice of dimensions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0004.text:
Judging from her changed appearance and tone 
I do not think Dionne is in control of her self.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0005.text:
What appears on the surface, through the medium of her body, 
must be Nemesis, the parasite of her soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0006.text:
The strange energy that radiated from the enemy in the desert... 
must have been his.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0007.text: ... You saw her in the forest as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0008.text:
It is a sad reunion to see her like this, 
but it may be an opportunity to recover her once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_15_1_0009.text:
Since I have lost my light, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
So... it is to you that I entrust her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0003.text: Ah, Sera simply wished to greet you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0004.text:
Mm... That is... Hello, my name is Sera! 
I'm the Apprentice Forest Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0005.text: I wanted to say hello, Goddess Chronos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0006.text: I see. I will remember your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0008.text:
My specialty is shield magic! 
My favorite food is pudding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0009.text:
...! Oh! Pudding! 
I left my pudding behind!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0010.text: Oh no, someone will eat it for sure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0012.text: I-I have to go hide my pudding before someone eats it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0013.text:
Goddess Chronos! 
Won't you try some pudding next time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0014.text:
Chocolat's pudding is the best in the world! 
You'll like it too, I'm sure of it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0018.text:
Ah...Yes, yes. 
A lively and blithe child, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0019.text:
Yes... 
That is Sera's greatest trait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0021.text:
She... rather reminds me of Elanuma. 
Elanuma too used to greet me with such a bright smile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0023.text: But it would be best if you warned her beforehand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0025.text: Too much pudding will not be good for a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_2_1_0026.text:
Huhu... But of course. 
I understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0001.text: Well done! You have defeated El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0002.text:
Are you aware of the magnitude of your actions? Of your deeds? 
They are worth stories, legends to be passed down to the children of men.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0003.text:
And you saved Dionne. 
It is not often that I give my compliments so generously.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0004.text: You should be happier, young one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0005.text:
...I heard about the White Goddess. 
... And I must beg her forgiveness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0006.text:
I remember that one hundred years ago, 
when we confined Sylunis for her actions, she was very angry at me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0007.text:
I understand now. From Sylunis I demanded duties, 
and yet I myself forsook mine to save Elanuma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0008.text: I am a fool, and a hypocrite, and deserve to be branded as one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_EP7_ST_30_1_0009.text:
...Haha. Do not attempt to console me, young one. 
My problems are mine to solve and ponder over. Now... farewell.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ01_1.text:
Tu devi essere il nuovo leader dei mercenari. Per sopravvivere
da queste parti, mi auguro che tu sia abile come si dice in giro.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ01_2.text:
Prima sbrighiamo le formalità.
Firma qui.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ01_5.text:
Ho mandato un esploratore a indagare...
ma non ha fatto ritorno.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_11.text: Incredibile. Beh, ormai non si può più tornare indietro.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_12.text:
Troveremo la tua dea dopo che avremo recuperato
il mio esploratore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_14.text: Per il momento, torna in città e recupera le forze.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_4.text: Sai dirmi esattamente cosa sta succedendo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_5.text: Qualcuno ha rubato la Scheggia degli Apostoli...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_7.text:
Io e la dea avevamo giurato di proteggerla...
Ma non ce l'abbiamo fatta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_8.text: È comparsa una donna vestita di blu e...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ06_9.text:
La dea della foresta ha combattuto da sola, mentre io 
sono fuggita e... Devo essere svenuta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ07_1.text:
Hai dormito bene?
C'è stato un andirivieni di sentinelle per tutta la notte.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ07_2.text:
Ho dormito benissimo.
Mi sentivo al sicuro, sapendo che c'eri tu a occuparti di tutto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ08_10.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, prima devi sconfiggerli.
Quando il loro corpo sarà inerme, potrò purificare la loro anima!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ08_11.text: Non sono certa di capire cosa stia succedendo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ08_12.text:
Ma non posso fare finta di nulla.
Andiamo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ08_4.text: Lasciate che i miei padroni vi ricolmino del loro potere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ08_7.text:
È il potere della Scheggia...
Controlla e corrompe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_3.text:
Non riesco a crederci.
Era tutto vero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_4.text: Questo spiega gli eventi accaduti di recente.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_5.text:
Io... non lo sapevo. Dee... Schegge...
Allora è tutto vero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_6.text: Grazie, il tuo aiuto è stato prezioso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_7.text: Ho solo cercato di proteggere il mio popolo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ09_8.text: D'accordo, è ora di trovare la dea della foresta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ13_1.text:
C'è così tanta energia oscura...
Devo purificarla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ13_4.text:
Sera? Che ci fai qui?
E lui chi è?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQ13_5.text:
Non possiamo rimanere qui. Mi racconterai
tutto quando saremo al sicuro.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0001.text: There is no end to the enemy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0002.text:
Yet we cannot falter now.
Keep to your places and prepare once more for battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0003.text:
No, you must not waste your strength.
I shall hold back the enemy lines. You must go and stop Destalos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0005.text:
We must listen to the Goddess. Kuhilim, Marin, and I shall remain.
Go with Dalton and Roxanne to stop Destalos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0006.text: Goddess of Light, I beg you to protect them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0007.text:
...Yes. I give you my blessing; may you remain safe.
As for us, let us hasten this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0009.text:
For I shall now borrow "time," the creation of Cora.
O heroes of Chrona, let us proceed forward!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0010.text:
This... this suffocating aura of darkness...
Th-then that being must be...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0012.text:
So you have come... 
beings that so pitifully struggle before the void,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0013.text:
those who lean so weakly against the ever-failing light...
Now you too must fall into darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0014.text:
Gasp... Dalton, Roxanne!
I ask for your protection!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP1_0015.text: O Darkness, you shall not prevail!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0001.text:
Can you not see, that "light" is a weak and fleeting thing.
Do you still wish to rebel against the darkness?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0002.text: Do not... dismiss what you cannot understand...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0003.text:
What I cannot understand...
Then tell me. What is light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0004.text:
You are an Apostle of Shadows;
perhaps it is only obvious that you cannot know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0005.text:
Light is what raises and supports us.
It was only with the strength of light that we made it this far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0006.text:
The will... The strength! To stand in the shadows and face 
what lies before us, to the end! Not only me and my companions

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0007.text:
- but of all those living in this world!
That is what we call light!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0008.text:
Will... Will, you say.
Such a petty thing cannot overcome the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0009.text:
No. It can. If it is the light that comes from him...
If it is now...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0012.text: Yes... We shall now bind the Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0013.text:
Ah...O human... who uses the strength...of light....
Now return... to darkness...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0014.text:
No...!
Then I shall stop you, Destalos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0016.text: ...And so the long war comes to an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0018.text: and through noble sacrifice the war came to an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0019.text:
The Lord of the Apostles was bound within the Soulstone,
and the Elard, or the Goddesses, divided the Soulstone to protect the pieces.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0020.text:
The only remaining Daughter of Cora fell into a long slumber.
And so Hasla came to forget, in the days of peace, the wounds of war...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_SQP2_0021.text:
...Until one hundred years later,
the darkness hidden within the Soulstone began to awaken...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_1.text:
Let me introduce myself again.
I am Yuria, captain of the revolutionary army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_10.text: I am looking for a person named Dike.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_12.text:
Yes. There is something exceeding the
power of humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_13.text: And Dike, is allied with that being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_16.text:
...Nevermind. Anyway,
this war is suspicious for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_17.text:
The Neth army and their commander are using
a whole new strange power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_18.text:
We, the revolutionary army is aiming for the
collapse of the Neth Empire. We will cooperate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_19.text: Great, we also needed your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_2.text:
I apologize for our mistake.
We didn't know that you were on our side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_20.text:
A new alliance.
I am at your service, Yuria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_3.text:
Strictly speaking, we are not allies yet.
As we said, we are looking for the headquarters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_4.text: Do you know anything about that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_5.text: That is stated in the letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_6.text:
The location of the headquarters and secret plans
were written in a special code.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_7.text: It was written in that letter..?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_8.text:
Hmm, we need more time to translate the code
on the secret plan part.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ100_9.text: Anyway, why are you looking for the headquarters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_1.text:
We never fall...
As long as we have this power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_10.text:
However, despite his efforts the war never ended
in the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_11.text:
Countless people died during the war.
Dike got tired of desperate situations day by day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_12.text: One day, a wizard came to meet him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_14.text:
I still do not know.
She was a mysterious wizard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_15.text:
The ancient technology and knowledge..
They were not human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_16.text:
After learning this, Dike decided to
conquer the world with that power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_17.text: The only power to stop the war, he thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_18.text:
...Is this war the result of that? That is so ironic.
A war brought on to stop war...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_19.text: How many more people should die for this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_23.text:
I organized the revolutionary army 
in order to stop Dike.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_24.text: However, my faith was too weak to reach him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_25.text:
Don't worry. We can do it.
Let's work together to stop Dike.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_26.text:
..Yes, I appreciate that.
We really must stop him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_3.text:
Dark energy.. this is dreadful.
All this was done by Dike..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_6.text:
When I was young, I was an orphan 
barely living in the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_7.text:
Every day it smelled like blood and steel.
Dike saved me one day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_8.text: He was fighting for a world without war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ101_9.text:
I wanted to be like him, fully agreeing with
his opinion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_1.text:
Stronger enemies are coming up against us.
The headquarters must be close.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_10.text:
Hurry! We don't have much time.
It's the best idea for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_11.text: ...All right. I will count on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_13.text:
Enemies will arrive in no time.
We must hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_15.text:
We will come back for sure..! 
Please be safe until then..!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_2.text:
We are receiving severe damage as well.
When will we reach the headquarters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_3.text:
Probably not too long.
Hopefully the information in letter is correct.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_4.text:
Captain! There are numberless enemies
approaching from the back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_5.text:
What...? Where did they come from
all of a sudden..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_6.text:
We are at the center of enemy territory.
We might get surrounded.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_7.text: We will do our best to block them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_8.text: Others, please break through the front.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ102_9.text: What..? But that is too dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_1.text:
Where is the headquarters...!
We must find Dike!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_10.text:
Do not be above yourself, human.
This is the end of your destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_2.text:
...No I think we are at the right place.
I can see, it's him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_4.text: Hmm, I was waiting for someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_5.text: But you are unexpected visitors. Welcome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_6.text: ...Although the feast for you all is not prepared yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_7.text: You are still keeping your composure?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_8.text: We will put an end to this here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ103_9.text:
I suppose it can't be helped.
Bring it on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_1.text: At last, it is all over now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_13.text: Well, I'm sorry to tell you that I was a spy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_14.text:
The wizard refered by revolutionary army leader...
It was you, Hellad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_15.text:
Revolutionary army? 
Oh those pushovers I played with? Hehe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_16.text:
.... You! It can't be..!
What did you do to them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_17.text:
Oh no worries I didn't kill anyone.
That is no fun at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_18.text: Let's say, that I did some experiments on them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_19.text: Stop chatting. What happened to the plan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_20.text:
Hmm, you are always so boring.
Plan is going on perfectly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_21.text:
Great. Then we get moving now.
You are making things so complicated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_22.text:
Giggles. No one can possess a great power
so easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_23.text: ...Then, everyone. See you at the center of the city!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_24.text:
I have made a great stage for us to have
the last battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_26.text: I won't let you run away with this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_4.text: No wonder... It doesn't seem to work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_6.text:
I will ask you once more.
How can you use the Dark energy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_7.text: Oh my! What is going on here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_8.text:
Hmmph. You are too late.
You have kept me so long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ104_9.text:
Hahaha, I am sorry.
I found something interesting on my way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_12.text: Yuria's destiny is defined by Yuria herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_13.text:
No one can define anyone's destiny.
We have to try before giving up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_14.text:
Foolish of you. Did you forget about the dead
revolutionary armies? The ineluctable destiny?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_16.text:
I do not want to define future 
as the extension of past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_17.text:
Whatever you wish.
Archon, follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_2.text:
I am all right.
Thank you, Archon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_20.text:
Thank you so much. 
I am sure Yuria will be safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_3.text: I can't believe Hellad betrayed us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_4.text:
They are going to the center of the city.
Let's go after them quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_5.text: Wait! We must save Yuria first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_6.text:
She said she didn't kill anyone.
We can save her if we hurry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_7.text:
No we can't do that. 
We have no idea what they are up to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_8.text:
...but we must stop them first.
That would be the way to respect sacrifce.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ105_9.text: Yuria must have accepted her destiny as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ106_1.text:
We've reached where we last pated.
Won't there be any clue...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ106_4.text:
Calm down! We are allies.
What happened here?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ106_5.text: A devil... Yuria became a devil...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ106_8.text:
And devil? What is he talking about?
He came from that way, let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_2.text: Archon, do you regret following me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_4.text:
I came all the way here through numerous
sacrifices by others, like you Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_5.text:
But, I do have to admit that I have a small
hope left somewhere in my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_7.text: But it's you who have lead me to the road of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_8.text:
We should keep proceeding further,
as we have been doing always.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ107_9.text:
Yes, we shall.
To the road of light, portraying our faiths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ108_2.text:
We found the devil...!
Would that be the one which soldier talked about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ108_3.text: I do have something in my mind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ108_4.text:
But we don't have time to hesitate!
We shall fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_10.text:
No we can't leave you behind.
We are here to save you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_11.text: I shall purify with my powers...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_12.text:
No.. Stop...
Dark energy is taking over...Arghhh!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_16.text:
This is my road of light,
I am going to move forward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_4.text:
...? How do you know my name?
You are...!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_7.text:
I remember now...
Argh my head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_8.text:
How can this happen... 
What Hellad talked about was...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ109_9.text:
No, don't come near me! Run!
Run away from me, now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_11.text: Chronos is on her way to stop Dike and Hellad's plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_12.text:
As you are safe now, we should hurry our way
to the center of city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_15.text:
The Neth army we fought in the headquarters
was lead by that wizard, Hellad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_16.text: In my last memory, she said something like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_17.text:
She talked about some experiment, that is
necessary prior to the plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_18.text:
For sure, Hellad seemed to have prepared for the
plan for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_20.text: I hope we knew what the plan was...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_21.text:
Hmm, there was some information about the plan
in the letter you've gave me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_22.text:
I tried my best to translate the code,
but I couldn't get it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_23.text:
The picture here looks familiar though.
I think I saw it somewhere before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_24.text:
If we had just a little more time...
Sigh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_25.text:
Well, we have no choice but to keep researching
on our way to the center of city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_27.text: Yes, let's return to the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_4.text:
Yes, thank you Prestina.
I can't believe I am alive...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_5.text: Of course, I promised to meet you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_6.text: No, I was prepared to die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_7.text: Death is inevitable during a war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ110_8.text: But still, thank you so much for saving me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_10.text: No wonder we couldn't read anything from it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_11.text: Wow, how did you find out about that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_12.text:
Because this method was often used by Dike,
to hide secret information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_13.text:
... The picture looks exactly the same after we
peeled off the fake paper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_14.text:
Moreover, we can read it!
Let's see what it says.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_15.text:
We've found a way to control the Dark energy.
We need the "Power of Light", the Pure energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_16.text:
To absorb the Power of Light from a Goddess,
we shall draw magicial square all around the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_17.text: Goddess? Power of Light? What is this all about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_18.text: Absorbing Power of Light from the Goddess?!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_19.text:
Then Chronos...! She is in danger!
It was a trap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_2.text:
This picture on the wall looks very similar
to the picture drawn on the letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_20.text: What? What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_21.text: I don't have time to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_22.text: Please trust me and follow me, Yuria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_23.text:
...Of course. You have saved me.
I owe you my life, Presitna.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_24.text:
Thank you. Yuria, please remove the
magical squares as much as you can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_25.text:
Then we may expect the magic shield to
weaken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_26.text:
We will go to the center of city
to help Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_27.text:
Yes, count on me!
Then, be safe on your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_28.text: Sure, hope to meet you again safely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_3.text:
Hmm, it was a picture drawn here and there 
within the city for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_4.text:
I wasn't paying attention to those before.
Maybe these are some magic squares!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_5.text: Would it be related with the "plan"..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_6.text: No but they are a little different from the letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ111_9.text:
I see. The letter should be divided into 2 seperate
papaers! It was intentionally overlapped!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_10.text:
It would have been better if two Goddesses
were here at once... Well anyways. Okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_11.text:
Urgh, what is this...? 
My powers are being drained...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_13.text: Stay still. It's already too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_14.text: You...! What have you done to her...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_17.text:
Archon...!! Damn it...
I have to destroy the magic shield...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_18.text:
It's helpless. 
We've prepared it with all the might.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_19.text:
Hehe, to activated the shield, we drew
magic squares all over the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_2.text:
I would have to admit that you gave me
quite a hard time, human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_20.text: Oh it was so hard to do that work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_22.text:
So you were wondering, how we were able to
use the Dark energy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_23.text:
I will tell you now.
It's the soul stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_25.text:
I found a way to transcend the ability
of human, which is demonization.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_26.text:
However, we needed power of Goddess
to control the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_28.text:
No way. 
I will absorb your Power of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_3.text: Now we really should put end to this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_4.text:
Hmm? Where is the other Goddess?
How come you are alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_5.text: That is none of your business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_6.text:
As you have invited us, 
go on with your plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_7.text: Of course, I am not afraid of anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_8.text: I guess you are underestimating us too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ112_9.text:
That is the weakness of Goddesses.
Hellad, activated the magic square.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ113_1.text:
We have to hurry!
Or else, Chronos....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ113_4.text: Urgh..... I feel my powers being drained...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ113_5.text:
Is the magic shield being activated now..?!
If so, Chronos must have.....!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ113_7.text:
Yes, we shall not give up so easily.
Let's go find Chronos...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_1.text: It is surprising, the amount of powers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_12.text:
Yes I am stubborn!
I won't listen to you whatever you say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_13.text:
I have found my road of light, 
and I will save you with my power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_15.text:
How dare you chat in front of me.
What did you say? Save her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_16.text: I will test you on that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_17.text: Haha so funny of you fools!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_18.text:
It feels great to have control over the 
Dark energy as I want...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_19.text:
I can accomplish my dream with this power!
I will conquer the world and eliminate war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_2.text:
(The power is under control..! 
Are there any side effect..?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_20.text: I won't let you do that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_21.text: Yes, and I will erase your hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_22.text:
With my superior power..! 
I will absorb your power as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_24.text: I feel my powers returning to my body...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_25.text:
What did you do...!
Why is my power being drained off...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_26.text: We know all about your plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_27.text:
Yuria is removing the magical squares
in the city at this moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_28.text:
You can't control the power anymore.
And you shall reveal yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_30.text: Hmph. I only have to defeat you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_32.text:
This is the last battle.
Be prepared, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_4.text:
Over the numberless sacrficies...
Now it is my turn to accept my destiny...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_5.text:
Chronos! 
We are here to save you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_7.text:
Hmm, another Goddess.
It's a good chance for me to test my power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_8.text:
No! Run away!
He is too strong for you to deal with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ114_9.text:
Archon and I can't make it...
Save it for the next chance...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_10.text:
As the magical shields were destroyed,
I could regain my Power of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_12.text:
I see. But he should be seriously injured
as the Dark energy overwhelmed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_14.text:
Cough.... Urgh...
Is that you, Yuria..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_15.text: Dike... How can you...!! How come..!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_16.text:
Hmph, I will not make any excuses. 
This was my way of achieving peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_17.text: I still believe in my faith, and that it wasn't wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_19.text:
Don't have such a dumb look on your face.
You are on your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_20.text:
This is the end for me,
but you can achieve your dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_21.text:
Yes, I sure will.
Please don't die, Dike...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_3.text:
No... I am not accepting my defeat...!
As long as I have the dark power...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_6.text: What..? I can't move my body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ115_7.text:
It's Now! 
Reveal the Dark energy with the light of Cora..!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_10.text: However, you proceeded to the next step.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_11.text:
...Yes. Destiny just tests us, and we are the
decision makers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_12.text: That is my road of light I have found out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_14.text:
Anyways, I am sorry about Dike.
Are you feeling all right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_15.text:
Yes, I am okay.
Dike told me,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_16.text:
to find my own way.
So, I have no time to stop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_17.text: Everyone is finding their own destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_19.text:
As you all know, the war is not over yet.
Moreover, we still have a big problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_2.text:
She is all right. Fortunately, the
injury is not life-threatening. She will recover.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_21.text: Hellad, that wizard fled in an instant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_22.text:
It should be her who gave the dark power
to Dike with that soulstone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_23.text:
Probably, Sylunis will be behind this as well.
Hellad and Sylunis are expected to be one team.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_24.text:
Then Sylunis will become able to control
the soulstone soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_25.text:
Correct. Is the old prophecy declared long ago
finally being realized...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_26.text:
We need cooperation from humans.
I will tell everything to Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_27.text: But would he believe the existence of Goddesses?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_28.text:
I shall at least give it a try.
Shouldn't that be the right thing to do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_31.text: Do you want me to believe that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_32.text:
As the emperor, I expect you have insight.
Didn't you feel the abnormal power of the enemy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_34.text: I can sense you are still doubtful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_38.text:
How many people in the world can show
such courage in front of me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_39.text:
I trust you.
What the late king said was true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_40.text: So, what am I supposed to do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_43.text:
Let me introduce myself, Alexander.
My name is Chronos...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_44.text: the daughter of Cora and Goddess of destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_45.text:
All the soldiers are fighting with the Neth army 
here at Edenberg and Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_46.text: I was defining their destiny arbitrarily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_47.text:
I thought that we would all face death 
if we fought together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_48.text:
However, that was my prejudice.
Destiny is determined by us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_49.text:
Even today, everyone in the world is
fighting for their own destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_5.text: Just like you wanted to prove.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_50.text: Now it is time to help them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_51.text: Alexander, tell them the name of Goddess Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_6.text:
Huh? No it's not...
I wasn't thinking like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_8.text:
As you told me, I was defining everything
in the context of inescapable destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ116_9.text:
I had no doubt that it was the road of light...
Perhaps that must have been my limitation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_10.text: Mopping up the Neth armys, maybe we should help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_11.text: Oh, then can we all go with Lednas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_12.text:
No, let's split up.
We have other things to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_13.text:
The wizard's laboratory must be
somewhere in the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_15.text: It will surely help us when fighting with Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_16.text: Hmm, really! Okay. We will get ready.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_2.text:
Oh hello everyone!
I couldn't see you during the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_3.text:
Phew, we received orders from the central government
to convene for a meeting. We should leave now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_5.text:
Yes, some Neth soldiers are still left in
Edenberg they say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_6.text:
To mop them up, Alexander himself ordered
the alliance army to gather.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_7.text: Also, they seem to have some important announcement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_8.text: Oh that announcement, hmm. Okay I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ117_9.text:
Anyways, see you all later.
I should get going now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_1.text:
We searched all over the city but can't even find any 
traces of the laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_10.text:
but Hellad kept researching the 
soulstone even before then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_11.text:
Probably, this wizard knows more than
I do about the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_12.text: Hopefully she didn't reach that fact yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_14.text:
...Nevermind. Anyway, I think there are more
demons created by her experiment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_15.text:
I have no idea why she created such things
but it would be better for us to eliminate them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_16.text: Okay, then let's find the demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_2.text:
No, I think we just found it.
Prestina, look at the door on your side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_3.text: What door? I don't see anything particular.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_5.text: I didn't expect the lab to be here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_7.text: No, confidential information has already been deleted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ118_9.text: According to the research journal, it wasn't until recently when Dike first received the Dark energy,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_1.text:
This demon is from the experiment...
It is similar to what Yuria had turned into.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_10.text: Maybe she is aiming for the Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_11.text:
That is an important fact.
I must quickly notify the other Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_12.text:
Yes, as soon as the other Goddesses return
we must tell them everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_2.text: This is a prototype made for military purpose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_3.text:
That wizard, what is she up to?
Why is she creating demons?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_4.text:
By the way, weren't the demons first brought by
the Apostles 100 years ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_5.text:
Even those demons were created by corrupting 
the lives from other planet, Heavenia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_6.text:
They were first brought by Thestalos,
during the Apostles war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_7.text:
So the demon is created 
when a life is corrupted by darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_8.text: Is Sylunis planning to become a demon herself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ119_9.text:
She might be. However, the amount of Power of Light
is necessary to control the energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_10.text:
Hahaha, lose my soul?
That is different, Hellad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_11.text: They just want... the true owner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_12.text:
If one cannot rule, 
one must be ruled by others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_13.text:
They keep whispering...
that the soulstone is incomplete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_15.text:
Chuckles... Can't you see?
Chronos... No wonder I can't look down on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_16.text: I can't believe that you hid the fifth piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_18.text:
Go my devoted servant.
Go and find the piece for men.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_19.text:
Until then, I shall absorb more power
from other Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_2.text:
Yes, Sylunis.
2 experiments were both successful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_21.text:
Now is the time to announce,
that the time of darkness is coming...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_3.text:
Evolution through Dark energy, 
and solution to control that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_4.text:
The reason for your failure was insufficient power in combining
the soulstone with the Power of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_5.text:
If you absorb other Goddesses' power,
you will become able to control the soulstone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_8.text:
Hush. Be quiet. The darkness from the soulstone,
is whispering to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ120_9.text:
You must be careful not to let your soul
be captivated by that stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_1.text:
Sigh...
It has been some time since we rested like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_10.text:
E-everybody! I-it's terrible!
What should we do?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_11.text:
Bridget, what is the matter?
You look pale...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_13.text:
A war! It's a war!
A war on Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_14.text:
War? ... Bridget, come here.
Calm down and please explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_16.text: The Neth Empire! They started a war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_17.text: The army is already marching toward our village!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_18.text:
Okay. Bridget, go tell Lednas 
about the situation right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_2.text:
Binding Soltar whenever he revived 
in the Fortress of Souls was exhausting, to say the least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_20.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, we should go and stop the enemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_3.text:
Do you know how difficult it was for us
when you disappeared, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_4.text:
Haha, do not look so serious.
It is alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_5.text:
So you went to Nosgard.
I heard of Dionne from Bella.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_6.text:
Daughter of Cora... It has been some time
since I last heard that name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_7.text:
Well, it reminds of my past experience
of meeting the ancient Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ82_8.text:
It was a long time ago, 
probably during the Apostles war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ83_1.text: Those soldiers are from the Neth army..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ83_3.text:
You are armed, are you an enemy?
We shall attack immediately as commanded!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ83_4.text:
I guess they are going to attack us.
{PLAYER_NAME}, prepare for a fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ84_2.text:
Why did we lose? 
We need more Dark energy... You'll see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ84_4.text:
That soldier over there.
Wasn't he corrupted with Dark energy..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ84_6.text: We should inform everyone about this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_10.text:
Huh? How do you know about the
Dark energy, Hellad?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_11.text: No no, I just received a request to run research on the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_12.text:
As soon as the Neth Empire started the war,
the Grancia Empire formed an alliance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_13.text: To end the war quickly, they marched toward the capital of Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_15.text:
As far as I know, that is right. 
Some mysterious weapons are being produced there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_16.text: What the weapons are generating is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_18.text:
Yes. The Neth army is sweeping the battlefield
with the power of Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_19.text:
However, when alliance approached to the energy,
it suddenly attacked the alliance soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_2.text:
You are here! I am sorry.
I guess I was a bit late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_20.text:
So to find out about that mysterious energy,
they are recruiting high rank wizards in Gracia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_21.text:
If you know anything about this,
would you come with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_22.text:
Sure. We need to do research on this.
{PLAYER_NAME}. you shall join me as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_23.text: Lednas, where are the other Goddesses?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_24.text:
They should be at the Colosseum in 
the Super Smash Battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_25.text:
Hopefully they will return as soon as they
have heard about the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_26.text: I will deliver them a message about the current situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_27.text:
Great. Join us later on.
Hellad? Let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_3.text:
Hehe, hello there.
Did you get hurt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_4.text: I am okay. How is the village?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_5.text:
We've strengthened the defense force.
Fortunately, we haven't found any other enemies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_7.text:
Oh right, the Neth army. They were 
tainted with dark power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ85_8.text:
They called it the Dark energy...
What is going on..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ86_2.text:
The battle has started.
Head of the alliance is Emperor Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ86_3.text: I expect him fiercely sweeping the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ86_4.text:
Let's join them as soon as possible.
We shouldn't be lagging behind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ86_6.text:
...This is the capital city of our enemy.
The base of the Neth Empire army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_1.text:
You must be Dike, 
the commander of the Neth army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_11.text: (We are on par with each other...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_16.text:
Glad that I am not too late.
I was looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_17.text:
Speak to me, human. 
How can you use the Dark energy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_18.text:
Pht, Goddess. 
I was looking for you as well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_19.text:
It's too bad that it isn't the right moment.
I will stop here for today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_2.text:
Your atrocities end here.
I shall put an end to both you and this war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_21.text:
Sorry for being late!
Where is the target?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_22.text:
He fled. There are too many soldiers for us
to chase after him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_23.text:
Above all, thank you. 
But who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_24.text:
We are the Chornos Mercenaries.
We will support you from now on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_27.text:
Don't worry about me.
I can handle much more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_3.text: I am surprised that you've reached me alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_4.text:
Haha... You foolish brat.
Dare you judge me in that manner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_5.text:
Bring it on. 
As you've said, we shall put an end to this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_6.text:
Hmm, I suppose you really mean that.
Come on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ87_8.text: Your attacks are weak. Are you trying your best?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_1.text:
I am worried that there are more 
corrupted people than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_10.text:
It's not the Neth army.
Reveal yourself...! Huh? Prestina?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_11.text: Archon?! How do you happen to be here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_12.text:
It's too long to explain. It's dangereous here 
so let's move to somewhere else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_13.text:
There is alliance base located at
the underground near somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_14.text:
Hmm.. This is their base? 
Maybe the situation isn't so favorable...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_15.text:
Anyway, what a coincidence to meet
someone I know here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_16.text:
Yes, it was a surprise.
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_17.text:
I am sorry to keep you waiting.
So, you are Hellad?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_18.text:
Head of investigation team is looking for you.
Please follow the guards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_19.text:
Oh is that so?
Oh well... I guess I have no choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_2.text:
By the way, how did you purify the
brainwashed people?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_20.text:
Then we should keep investigating
on our own way, Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_21.text:
Please tell me right away if you find out
anything about the Dark energy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_22.text:
Sure, I will,
See you later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_23.text:
She is quite a mysterious woman...
Chief wizard of the Grancia Empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_24.text:
I should have heard about her if she is
that famous...but... Hmm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_25.text:
Well, nevermind. By the way, 
I have someone to introduce you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_27.text:
I have told you before in the Fortress,
about the oath 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_28.text:
We, the Chronos Mercenaries took an oath
to fight with a Goddess in the Apostles war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_3.text: It was a power that I have never seen before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_31.text:
You must be 'Ellard',
the Goddesses of the present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_32.text: I am Chronos, the daughter of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_35.text:
Pleasure to meet you. I am the successor 
to former Goddess of Forest, 'Prima'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_36.text:
I am not sure whether you would remember,
but I have met you during the Apostles war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_37.text:
Is that so.
That would make things easier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_38.text:
Tell me.
How can humans use the Dark energy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_41.text:
By the way, why is our captain 
having a strategic meeting outside?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_42.text: It may be dangerous for a lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_43.text:
Haha, That's because...
the head of investigation is my subordinate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_44.text:
Haha, you are funny as ever,
Ms. Hellad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_48.text:
Hah? What is that outfit!
It doesn't help you to disguise at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_49.text:
Remember that you should act like
the head of investigation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_5.text:
Hmm? Maybe you can tell me later
if that is difficult to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_50.text:
Oh, my bad. But haven't we 
accomplished the mission already?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_51.text:
Hmmph, it was so boring. 
However, we've got some unexpected profit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_52.text:
Anyway. let's go back.
Mission success!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_6.text:
Yes, excuse me. 
I promise that I will tell you later on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_7.text:
Anyway, where are we now?
I have never been to this city before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ88_8.text:
As far as I know, there must be 
the alliance base nearby...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_1.text:
This village is our base. We supply necessary
equipments through the portal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_10.text:
I guess it was just a rumor that you have
disappeared after the war 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_11.text:
Cora foretold that Apostle will revive again.
I had to recover my power before that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_12.text: ...Since I am the only daughter of Cora left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_13.text:
I was supposed to find you as soon as 
I recover my consciousness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_14.text:
But, I decided to investigate the Neth army,
who were using the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_15.text:
I knew that enemy captain would be the key
to this problem, so I was chasing after him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_16.text: Anyways, is that true about Sylunis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_18.text: It is impossible for human to create such energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_19.text:
If what you've told me is true,
Sylunis must be behind the Neth army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_2.text:
I see. This base would be a good place
to hide our troops. Thanks for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_20.text: I would have to find Dike again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_21.text:
However, he is the commander of the Neth army.
It would be difficult to find him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_22.text:
Then why don't we investigate the weapon
creating the Dark energy together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_23.text:
If Dike is using that Dark energy,
I'm sure we will be able to get him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_24.text: Hmm.. I guess that would be the only way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_25.text:
Fine. The Chronos Mercenaries including myself,
will join you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_26.text:
Now we can officially fight together.
It is my great honor, Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_27.text:
Well, it is our honor. I feel like we have
gained thousands of troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_3.text:
...It would be better for us to keep the data on
Chronos Mercenaries confidential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_4.text:
Of course, it was inevitable when saving
the captain of alliance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_6.text: Well, now I see why Chronos was ordered to find you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_7.text: Prestina was the Goddess of forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_8.text:
I was surprised as well.
Do you remember, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ89_9.text:
The ancient Goddess I've seen.
She was Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_1.text: Phew, it would be safe near here now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_10.text: I asked Lednas to contact other Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_11.text:
Well, I forgot about it. 
Let's wait for Lednas in the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_2.text:
Yes for a while. But if our forces are not
occupying the area, it would become dangerous again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_3.text:
The alliance army consists of several nations in Hasla,
right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_4.text: Can't we expect any support from them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_5.text:
I have heard that we lost a lot of troops during
last battle with Dike.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_6.text: Thus it would be hard to expect..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_7.text:
That is true. 
Were are other Ellards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ90_8.text:
With Ellards, we will be able to occupy
much area with least amount of troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_1.text:
Long time no see.
You were in the village just in time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_10.text:
I believe it would be difficult to 
expect some assistance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_11.text: Lednas, is there any other information?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_12.text:
Hmm. I see. Well, this is the rumor 
that I have heard before the war broke out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_13.text:
There was a revolutionary army resisting the
Neth Empire within the nation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_14.text:
If they really exist, they would also aim for
the capital of the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_15.text: I see. Maybe we can look forward to ally with them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_16.text:
But there is no guarantee that they would actually
cooperate with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_17.text:
FIrst, we should look for that weapon
with current forces step by step.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_18.text:
Let's hurry.
I will leave first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_19.text:
We should get going as well.
Please take care of the village, Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_2.text:
I left my place for a while to build the
guard post outside the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_20.text:
Yes, count on me.
Be safe on your journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_3.text:
Oh I see. 
Are the other Goddesses at the post?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_4.text:
No, Goddess Aubrey and Sera are in Roman.
Anut and Bella are at the wilderness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_5.text:
They said they would not be able to come back
before the situation is defused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_6.text:
Hmm..? People behind you..? 
I haven't seen you two before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_7.text: I am Lednas, guarding this village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_8.text:
My name is Archon. 
I am the member of the Chronos Mercenaries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ91_9.text: And this is....Well... Let's say captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_1.text:
So we finished with this area.
Let's move on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_10.text:
Cough Cough!.. Please save my comrades.
They are not far from here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_11.text:
I barely escaped...
But my comrades...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_12.text:
He must be the revolutionary army, which
Lednas had mentioned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_13.text:
... He was worrying about his comrades
prior to himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_15.text: No, we are making a detour.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_17.text:
That soldier 'barely escaped' alone.
Others must have died already.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_18.text: But we don't know that for sure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_19.text:
...Don't know? This is war.
We face death as soon as we loose tension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_20.text:
There is no exception at all.
Don't be carried away by emotion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_23.text:
...Fine, as you wish.
But follow my order in case of emergency.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_24.text:
...Yes, I will.
Let's go before it's too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_27.text:
It would be almost impossible to fight against
large troops with our current force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_28.text: No, it would be better to show her the reality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_29.text:
It is true that there is high risk but we may seek
to enlarge our dominance if we win the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_3.text:
No, he is not our enemy.
That outfit.. It looks unfamiliar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_30.text:
Above all, I cannot reverse the decision
that has been already made. Let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_4.text:
Cough... Wh, Who's there?
I can't see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_8.text:
No we are not apart of the Neth army.
We are the alliance army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ92_9.text:
...Is that so..!
I.. am the revolutionary army. Please...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ93_3.text:
There are some things we cannot change
during a war. It's a destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ93_4.text: Do you understand? This is reality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ93_7.text:
This ... is a letter.
The addressee is... Yuria?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ93_9.text:
As expected. Everyone get ready for a combat!
Prestina. You take charge of the battlefront.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_3.text:
Don't get depressed. We couldn't help it.
It was never possible from the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_4.text:
I have experienced similar situations
so many times since long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_5.text:
I lost many comrades, friends...
I had to let them go, to Cora's side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_6.text:
However, that is how we won the war.
We have gained glorious victory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_7.text:
Over numerous deaths, one who can 
accept the Power of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ94_9.text:
We lose light and hope if we cannot
overcome the hardships.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_10.text:
Krr.... Do you think I will confess? 
Of course it's top secret!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_11.text:
I gave you a chance.
Well, I have no choice then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_13.text:
Krrrr... What is this?
There was a combat mode installed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_16.text:
No time for chatting.
Bring it on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_2.text:
Krr...
Keep in mind, don't take off your helmet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_3.text:
You will lose your mind to Dark energy
like that foolish alliance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_4.text:
Krr...... What a powerful energy.
I can never expect its limitation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_5.text:
How can this weapon create the Dark energy?
How does it work?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_6.text:
I want to research!! Research!!!
Krrrrr...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_8.text:
I am the one asking questions.
Where did you get the weapon from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ95_9.text: I will spare your life if you tell me the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_1.text:
Krrrr...... They are too strong!
What's this power!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_10.text:
...that's where Neth commander Dike is.
We have a clear goal now. Where is that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_11.text:
I don't know! The location of their headquarters changed
all of a sudden...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_12.text:
I don't know where it is until I receive
new instructions! All right?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_14.text:
Krrr... Really? 
I thought I would get killed by now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_15.text: I am not saying it twice. Go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_17.text: Headquarters... Sounds like an obvious information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_18.text:
That must be located the center of enemy.
We cannot just march there without any conviction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_19.text:
So now we have to find out about the location
of the headquarters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_2.text:
I said, I am the one asking questions.
I will ask you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_20.text:
Archon, figure out if there is any information
from the alliance army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_22.text:
Rest of you will wait for Archon
until she comes back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_23.text:
It would be better to take a rest.
We will continue again soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_3.text: Where did you get the weapon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_7.text:
Krrrr, it is from the headquarters!
The blueprint of the weapon is there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ96_8.text:
I just made a duplicate from that!
I don't know anything else!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_1.text:
You are thinking about something.
What is the matter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_10.text:
By the way, what happened to Dionne
after she went back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_12.text: There was no way to seal the apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_13.text:
Dionne thought that it was impossible to
eliminate Nemesis's soul from herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_14.text:
So she sealed herself within the crack
of the dimensions. That was the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_15.text:
Then, she have to wander around the dimensions
with the apostle..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_16.text:
That is her destiny.
She made a right choice as a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_18.text:
It was destined as soon as she became
a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_19.text:
It is not an exception for other Goddesses as well.
So we have to accept the destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_2.text:
Oh, I am sorry.
I just have something in my mind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_22.text:
The friend who Chronos sent to Cora... 
She was Dionne...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_23.text:
