Ineluctable destiny.
...I just don't get it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_25.text:
However, she seems to define the future 
in the context of destiny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_26.text: Can't we change the destiny by out efforts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_28.text: Oh hi there. Chronos is taking a rest now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_29.text: Any updates from the alliance army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_30.text:
Unfortunately, they had no idea about 
the location of the head quarter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_31.text:
I guess we have no choice but to find out
from our enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_32.text:
...I see. 
I will report that to Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_33.text:
What's wrong?
Prestina, you look down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_4.text:
The weapon which the Neth army had...
It resembled the Apostle Nemesis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_5.text:
Nemesis...!!
How do you know that name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_6.text:
I have not met him in person,
I just heard from other Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_7.text:
I do not know for sure whether that weapon
is really Nemesis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ97_9.text: I see, that's what happened to Dionne...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_11.text:
What...? 
Wait! We are not your enemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_13.text: No choice. Prepare for the combat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_14.text:
How can.... 
We should avoid killing them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_4.text: Both of you.. What is the matter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_5.text:
No, nothing. 
Let's move on to the next area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_8.text: That outfit, they are revolutionary army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ98_9.text:
We are the Chronos Mercenaries. We belong to the
alliance army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_1.text: Those people, they were very aggressive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_11.text:
I am Prestina and we our not your enemy.
Our goal is to find the Neth army headquarters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_12.text:
Also, I have a letter for you.
I acquired it from your dead army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_14.text:
No wonder... This letter contains
confidential information about the Neth army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_15.text:
That means...
Everyone! Put your weapons down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_16.text: Oh thankfully... they were not our enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_17.text: It is fortunate. We don't have much of a force left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_18.text:
We were reaching our limits after harsh
days of restless marching.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_19.text:
Then we would need a place where
everyone can take a rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_20.text:
There is a good place I know.
Let's continue our conversations there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_5.text:
Urgh. Our comrades...!
Let's kill them, Yuria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_6.text:
Calm down. The comrades just fainted.
They are not dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_7.text: That is why I did not order you to attack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_6_SQ99_9.text:
Are you our enemy?
If not, what is your purpose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0002.text:
It must be a tough task to gather armies from
all over the continent to fight against the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0003.text:
I haven't heard from Sera, Anut, Bella or Aubrey
since they left to the wilderness with Roman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0004.text:
Now Lednas is gone too...
I feel so lonely...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0005.text:
Chronos always told me that 
I should conceal emotions before the big event...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0006.text: Well, I don't think I'm good enough yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0008.text:
Well yes, I won't be depressed.
Everyone's doing their job, so I should too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0011.text:
Ah... You look pale.
What happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0012.text:
(Why did I dream about her... during this critical period..?
Indeed, it might be a precognition...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0013.text:
(We'll just leave it like this...
There is indeed a possibility of her revival.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0016.text:
Sylunis is trying to combine herself with the 
spirit stone to become the head of the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0017.text:
But... do you know why she failed to do so 
and keeps plotting things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0018.text:
Maybe that's because... she failed to
find a way to control the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0019.text:
We recently discovered that the key to control it was the 
power of light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0020.text:
That might be one of the reasons.
She will be seeking the the power again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0021.text:
Even if she succeeded in stealing the light of the Goddess,
she couldn't fuse herself with the spirit stone anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0022.text: The spirit stone that she owns is incomplete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0023.text:
100 years ago, I went into a resting period,
but I was worried about somebody trying to covet the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0024.text: I divided the spirit stone and let the former Elard to protect the four pieces.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0025.text:
But there was the fifth piece...
One with special but dangerous power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0026.text:
I hid the fifth piece in a secret place and went in to
the resting period...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0027.text:
The fifth piece of the spirit stone...?
I never knew of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0028.text:
You wouldn't have.
Sylunis is different, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0029.text:
She had been so close to the complete spirit stone.
She might have found out about the hidden piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0030.text:
... Then we should find the fifth piece 
before Sylunis does.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0033.text:
I wanted to reveal the truth when everyone was here
but I can't now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0035.text:
Chronos, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Why don't we go and find the fifth piece?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0036.text: I've never expected boldness from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0039.text:
If we can protect the last piece,
we might prevent a complete catastrophe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0041.text:
We should leave as soon as possible.
The last piece is at Elandia, the holy city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0042.text:
Elandia... is a head temple
of Goddessism, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ121_0043.text:
Yes. If the strong faith for Elanuma still remains...
The piece would be safely protected. I believe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0002.text:
A head temple of
Elanuma and its disciples...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0003.text:
Is this your first time here,
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0004.text:
This is my first time too.
It's nice and clean.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0005.text:
I hope Sera is here with us...
Hope she's doing good in Roman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0010.text:
I missed you so much,
Prestina!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0012.text:
Save hellos for later.
Somebody is chasing us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ122_0018.text:
I'll tell you later.
Prepare for the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0001.text:
I knew that 
{PLAYER_NAME} would save me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0002.text:
I'm so glad to see you guys again!
Prestina, {PLAYER_NAME} and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0003.text:
Hello! I'm Sera.
I'm Goddess of Forest! I'm the trainee at least...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0004.text:
I think this is the first time meeting you, right...?
If not...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0007.text:
This is Chronos.
Former Goddess and the daughter of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0008.text:
Goddess...? And the daughter of Cora...?
So you've got a mission directly from Cora?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0009.text:
Whoa! It's my honor!
So I should properly greet you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0011.text:
Sera. This is urgent now.
Calm down and come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0013.text:
Save hellos for later.
So, what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0014.text:
Aren't you supposed to be with Roman
with Aubrey, Sera?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0015.text:
Ah yes, right!
But Sylunis had...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0016.text:
What?
Sylunis? Why was she after you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0017.text:
I don't know...
I was attacked by Sylunis and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0018.text:
When I woke up I was here!
I was captured and imprisoned, but there was no guard so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0019.text:
Ah, Aubrey!
She didn't wake up yet. She is still imprisoned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0024.text:
Apostles of Elanuma controlled by the darkness 
have kidnapped the Goddess....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0025.text:
What is the correlation between
Sylunis and Goddessism?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0026.text:
So I can say that the fifth piece in Elandia
might not be safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0027.text:
Let's find the soldiers in masks who chased us.
I'm sure that they will know something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ123_0028.text:
Let's go back to the village and get prepared.
That young Elard should return too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0001.text:
This guy is soaked with the power of the Apostle too.
What has happened..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0005.text:
Are you all right now?!
Talk to us...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0006.text:
I still feel the power of the Apostle.
Move back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0010.text:
What has happened?
The purification was successful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0011.text:
How cowardly you are to bring friends...
Who are you guys? Saintess of Light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0012.text:
Well, I couldn't care less.
Everything other than the White order is a cult!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0013.text:
Wait!
I think there is a misunderstanding. We are not a cult!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0016.text:
I can't feel the power of El Thalnos from you guys.
You guys are a cult!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0017.text:
They are not corrupted due to brainwashing.
They voluntarily dedicated their soul to the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0018.text:
Goddess' purification won't purify them.
I should find out who El Thalnos is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0020.text: I'll let you live if you answer my question properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0021.text:
Why did you kidnap that girl? 
What is happening at the Order of the Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0022.text:
No matter what, 
our devotion toward El Thalnos won't drop!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0023.text:
Who is El Thalnos.
I don't think it's related to the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0024.text:
Goddess? 
What they believe is a fake idol.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0025.text:
El Thalnos is the one and only god 
who will redeem this world!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0026.text:
Fake idol... 
You are jangling my nerves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0027.text:
I think we have a lot to hear from him.
{PLAYER_NAME}. We should take him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0028.text:
Ha...
Do you think I will be cooperative?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0029.text: If not, what will you do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0030.text:
El Thalnos...
Please take my body and soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0032.text: Complete perishment of body and soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0035.text:
I think something more dangerous than we think 
is happening within the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0036.text: Let's go back to the village first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ124_0038.text:
(I'm sure I felt something...
Does the Order of the Goddess know the existence of...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0002.text:
Young Elard.
Did you hear what's happening now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0003.text:
Yes!
We have to find the fifth piece of the spirit stone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0004.text:
It was our sole purpose at first. 
But we have another mission now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0006.text:
Yes, Prestina as well.
Did you hear anything from other Elards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0007.text:
Bella and Anut you mean?
No, they are at the desert...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0009.text: They might have been attacked by Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0010.text:
The nightmare might repeat
if we don't rescue the other Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0012.text:
Finding the last piece and rescuing the Goddesses.
Both missions are very important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0013.text:
I think we should divide the party
to carry out both missions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0014.text:
We will go find the piece.
I'm the only one who knows about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0015.text:
You, trainee Elard should go rescue the other Goddesses.
You are from there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0016.text:
Yes! I'll rescue them all!
{PLAYER_NAME}, will you accompany me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0018.text:
What? But...
You are going there alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0019.text:
Don't be worried about me.
My loyal fellow will come back soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0020.text:
It's Archon, right?
I think Archon has been busy after returning from Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0021.text:
She was preparing for the big mission.
It will be a big help for you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ125_0022.text:
Anyway, time is running out.
We should get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0004.text:
Chronos.
The Chrona Hero group has returned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0006.text:
So Chronos Hero group
will be our support! Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0007.text:
Yes. They are not grouped completely yet,
but I hope they will be a big help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0011.text: Yes. His memory hasn't come back completely yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0012.text:
My name is Leon for now.
Long time no see. Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0013.text:
Like you said Archon.
This is my first time meeting Chronos... but I feel weird.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0014.text: Ah, you are the reincarnation of O'ren!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0015.text:
Prestina!
Did you meet him before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0016.text:
Well, this is the first time of meeting him face to face,
but I heard a lot of stories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0018.text: Yes. We are the leaders of Chronos Hero group

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0019.text:
We sealed the Apostle who attacked Valencia
with the last deathblow a century ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0020.text:
Valencia...? Ah!
You mean at the fortress?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0022.text:
Haha.
It's in my faint memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0023.text:
You might be confused for a while,
but you will remember everything if we work towards our mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0024.text:
I hope you heard everything about the past 
and our current situation from Archon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0025.text:
Do you vow to devote yourself once more 
to your fate of battle and war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0026.text: In fact, I don't know much about my past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0027.text:
However, I'm sure that despite my past
I would have chosen the same path.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0030.text:
They are coming.
But some are missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0031.text:
Are they? No time to wait.
Let's move on with the existing ones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0032.text:
Leon. You will participate in 
the party to rescue Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0033.text: Me and Archon will find the piece of the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0034.text:
A rescue mission.
Perfect for a hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0035.text:
I can see that you are the reincarnation 
of O'ren from your personality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0036.text:
Good.
I expect a decent performance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0037.text:
We should get going.
Archon, follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0040.text: It's a magic stone. We can keep in contact with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0041.text: It was used to communicate between me and Chronos, but I think you guys need this now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0042.text:
I have the other magic stone,
so let me know when you succeed in rescuing Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0043.text: I'll do the same when we succeed in our mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ126_0046.text:
Well.... I think we should work together from now on.
Let's do our best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0001.text:
Do you know anything about
other members of Chronos Hero group?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0002.text:
We are on the same mission but
I rarely see them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0003.text:
Well some are doing a reconnaissance mission
and some are eradicating evil spirits nearby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0005.text: I just wondered what the legendary heroes would be like!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0007.text:
Ah, would you explain some heroes
for us, Leon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0009.text:
Well I don't know everything,
but if you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0010.text:
We were chosen by Chronos to fight against 
Apostles including Soltar a century ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0011.text:
But we promised to come back 
any time when Chronos needs us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0012.text:
There are 8 heroes who recovered their memory
and are awakened again as heroes. Including me and Archon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0015.text:
Well members of the Chronos hero group have awakened
and have become powerful heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0016.text:
One can fight against hundreds of demons alone,
and one has become the youngest Saintess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0017.text: Power from the previous life has succeeded... Amazing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0018.text:
Oh, then you too?
What power have you got?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0023.text:
What did I get from the past...
Well. Is that important?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0024.text:
Even without that, 
the will to protect the world is in my soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0026.text:
I don't know about other heroes
but now I know what kind of person you are, Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0027.text: Um... I don't understand what you guys are saying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ127_0029.text:
Well, I think we had enough rest.
Sera, be our guide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0001.text:
Leon.
I'm back from the reconnaissance mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0002.text:
Sigruna, Kriemhild!
How's the front line?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0003.text:
There are some fanatic disciples of the Order of the Goddess
but other than that, it's dead quiet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0006.text:
I felt something ominous 
the moment I entered into this city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0007.text:
And I feel them stronger as we get 
closer to the point that Sera told us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0008.text:
What is this yucky smell.
I don't feel good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0009.text:
I think this energy is coming from the Apostle. 
Indeed the Order of the Goddess has...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0010.text:
Prestina, don't be so anxious.
I will rescue the Goddesses for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0014.text:
This is...!
I feel like my power is draining...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0015.text:
I've been fighting against countless demons but... 
This is so evil and cursed...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0016.text:
Power of the Apostle...
Way stronger than those we met before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0020.text:
Yes. We have a mission to rescue the Goddess.
A hero won't be frustrated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0022.text:
We've done more than this!
We didn't revive to stop here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ128_0024.text:
Ha...
Don't look down on me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0001.text:
They are at Elandia?
Hmm... Too fast for taking the bait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0002.text:
Hellad.
There is one thing you have to know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0004.text:
The party has split into two groups 
after entering into Elandia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0005.text:
Only two of them headed to another place,
while the rest of them are headed to the jail.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0006.text:
Weird.
Why aren't they heading to rescue the Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ129_0009.text:
I should find out what they 
want to take from this city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0002.text:
Yes. Thankfully.
But I'm worried about the near future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0003.text:
It must be this way if Sera's right...
The enemies are coming... I'm getting confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0004.text: I don't know if I'm remembering it right...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0005.text:
Are you guys all right,
Leon and {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0006.text:
So far, yes...
How about you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0010.text:
Leon! You are Leon, right?
Finally!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0011.text:
Why are you so peaceful Maria?
We have an emergency you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0012.text:
I knew you were in this city but...
Do you know how much I worried about you?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0013.text:
I had no contact from you and
crazy disciples are everywhere in the city... Whoa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0014.text:
But it's true that I feel so happy
meeting you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0015.text:
Wow. You have a lot of allies, Leon.
Nice to meet you. I'm Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0016.text:
Save the chatting for later.
Tell us what happened to Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0017.text:
What on earth is happening in this city, 
and among the Order of the Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0018.text: What is with that soldier from the White Order?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0019.text:
How do you know about the White Order?
They used to be little radical disciples...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0020.text:
One day Roland came and told us the truth.
And since then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0021.text:
I started to investigate the conspiracy within the Order of the Goddess, 
and I found out the mysterious existence of El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0023.text:
They deny Elanuma and 
became fanatic toward El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0024.text:
And when we found out their dirty secrets,
they detained me and Maria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0026.text:
Roland...
We can't hurt disciples from the same order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0027.text:
Then were you captured by them 
until now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0028.text:
Yes... Until people from the Black Order 
and Night Witch came to save me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0030.text: Excuse... me... Where are the other people?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0033.text:
You will believe me if 
you are members of the Chronos hero group.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0034.text:
I think other Goddesses are also 
detained at their jail.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0035.text:
If there's any clue 
it will be very helpful to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0036.text:
Indeed I feel the same aura I felt from Chronos.
Ha ha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0037.text:
Well the clue about the other Goddess...
Um... Let me see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0039.text:
Oh my god, Roland!
Are you serious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0040.text:
Yes. When I was looking for the way out
I saw a place with strict security.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0043.text:
We should go there!
How can we get there?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0044.text:
Oh, then let's go.
Roland will remember the spot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0046.text:
But Maria,
that place is too dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0047.text:
But saving the Goddess 
means saving the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0050.text:
So, we know where they are
and have reliable allies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ130_0051.text: Now we can go rescue the other Goddesses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0001.text:
There it is.
But enemies will come soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0002.text: I will guard the back. Go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0003.text:
Then I will go with Roland.
I can't let him be alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0004.text:
All right.
Sigruna, Kriemhild and Dorothy will come soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0009.text:
Wait, that girl!
She's the sacrifice victim we lost days ago!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0014.text:
Leave it to me. 
I would like to get an honor to save Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0016.text:
Yes. I'm not injured.
I was faint for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0017.text:
It's just that...
I can't feel the power of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0019.text:
(It feels just like the day when I was cursed by Hellad 
and felt like all of my power was escaping from me...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0022.text:
Sylunis and her followers tried to steal the power of the Goddess 
to control the corrupted energy of the Apostle at Edenberg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0023.text:
And I think they are planning 
the same thing here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0024.text: Then what will happen to those who were deprived of their power?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ131_0025.text:
I don't know exactly...
We should go to the village first so that they can rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0003.text:
When will they wake up?
They seem to be in deep sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0004.text:
Well...
I don't think it will take too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0005.text:
And there are tasks for us to complete 
while we wait for them to wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0007.text:
Archon.
It's Prestina. Can you hear me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0011.text:
Wait for me.
I will come for you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0013.text:
We've arrived at the spot where 
the fifth piece is sealed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0014.text:
Glad to hear you are all right.
Archon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ132_0015.text:
Chronos is waiting.
Let's use the dimensional port.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0001.text:
Chronos.
We are all here now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0003.text:
Yes.
I never thought I would hold this in my hand ever again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0006.text:
Oh my.
Why are you guys in such a hurry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0008.text:
Don't be fooled, Sera!
That's not the Hellad we used to know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0009.text:
Gee, Prestina. How can you be so cruel.
I was harsh on you at Edenberg indeed. Right? Ha ha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0011.text: You did a perfect job as bait, little Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0013.text:
How foolish... You could escape from us, 
because we set up the situation to gather all Goddesses to this city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0014.text:
If not, how could you escape from us?
You are just a mere Goddess with no power. Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0015.text:
Prestina...?
What... What have I done...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0017.text:
And I even find out that the fifth piece 
is at Elandia! Wow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0018.text: So now all the sacrifice victims are here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0019.text: You knew about the fifth piece...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0020.text:
Not a bad scheme.
But we already have the fifth piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0021.text: Do you think I will let you go like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0023.text:
A group of enemies are coming from behind!
Where are the other heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0024.text:
We should go guard the back first!
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0025.text: So... I'm gonna deal with you guys, the rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ133_0026.text:
So arrogant.
You should take your time instead of rushing in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0003.text:
There are a few left
and my allies are fighting with the rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0004.text:
Sera and Prestina are trying to 
purify them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0005.text: Let's get rid of that witch and go help them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0007.text: I would like to say the same thing you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0008.text:
My master is desperately waiting for 
that piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0009.text: Now it's time to end this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0012.text:
Prestina!!!
Why... Why is she becoming...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0014.text:
Hellad is trying to steal our power
for Sylunis!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0015.text:
Hellad planned everything!
She stole the power from Anut, Bella and Aubrey!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0016.text:
Haha... Sylunis?
That's an old name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0017.text:
My master will become 'El Thalnos'.
A perfect name for the ruler of this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0018.text:
By the way, I didn't want to use this power.
Well, I can just steal your power again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0019.text:
Sylunis...
How dare you covet the power of Death Thalnos!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ134_0020.text: You won't get away with this, witch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0005.text:
Prestina.
Let the young Elard relax, and come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0011.text: How can you be so strong...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0013.text:
Finally!
I've collected all the pieces!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0014.text:
El Thalnos! The master of world!
Take this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0017.text: Finally, the pieces are all in my hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0018.text:
It is definitely the fifth piece.
Finally I can merge with the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0019.text:
Sylunis! Stop!
Why are you... no!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0020.text:
Why are you being so obsessed with the past!
It was a century ago... Sylunis!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0022.text:
Do I need a reason?
Me and the spirit stone need each other. That's all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0025.text:
Now I can complete...!
The spirit stone is all mine now...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0027.text:
Look guys.
This is the birth of a new king!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0032.text:
I'm the one and only!
Yes, I'm El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0033.text:
... I see some death throes.
Useless...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ135_0034.text:
Shall we begin the trip to the void...
for this meaningless continent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0001.text:
I heard so...
Due to that Apostle, the entire continent is devastated...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0002.text:
I hope everything's okay...
Otherwise, this village will soon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0004.text:
We should patrol the village...
Let's get going man!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0005.text:
People are anxious.
Well the situation is not good but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0006.text:
Chronos! Do you feel better now?
How about the other Goddesses?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0007.text:
They are recovering
but they should relax for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0009.text: Do you think I'm the same as other Elards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0010.text: Just joking. Don't act so serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0012.text:
Well.
Now we should be prepared for the battle against El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0013.text:
To do so
we should know who El Thalnos is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0015.text:
Not everything.
But I can assume.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0016.text:
El Thalnos.
She seemed very similar to Death Thalnos, the first Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0017.text: Do you remember anything about Death Thalnos?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0019.text:
At the end of the Apostle war
I sealed him in the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0020.text:
But he is the Apostle of void and despair.
He looks deep into your mind and torments you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0021.text:
With that ability, he could still use power 
even if he is sealed in the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0022.text:
Sylunis and other Apostles might have
been consumed by Death Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0023.text:
Then what we are encountering is
Death Thalnos itself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0025.text:
And with the power of Sylunis and previous Apostles...
He must be much stronger than 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0028.text:
Death Thalnos is not the only one 
sealed in the fifth piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0029.text:
Nevermind that.
I will go back to church. I should rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0031.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
Do you think you can fight again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0032.text:
Well, that was a dumb question.
We have to do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ136_0034.text:
Let's take a walk to the forest
to chill out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0002.text: I used to... be so arrogant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0003.text:
I thought I was the one who will save the world,
and would never encounter failure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0004.text:
Due to my vanity, too many people fell into danger.
I regretted and blamed myself for it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0005.text:
I'm different now!
I've grown up and learned from my mistakes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0006.text:
... I thought... I did.
But I... I'm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0007.text: Maybe I've not changed at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0008.text:
Allies with talent are in despair...
I feel like walking in the dark...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0009.text: What can I, with no special abilities, do for them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ137_0010.text: I feel like I'm fighting with a broken sword against powerful enemies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0001.text:
Why are you chased by
the Order of the Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0002.text:
I am... well
I've got to meet Chronos immediately!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0005.text: It's so strange knowing Chronos is being chased by the Order of the Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0007.text:
I can't say that I'm not related to the Order of the Goddess...
but I'm not one of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0008.text:
How can I believe you?
I already have my suspicions of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0013.text:
Most of the Goddesses have lost their power,
and you are showing us the power of a Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0014.text:
Then it's better!
No one can gain the power of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0015.text:
If I was here to harm you I would come with 
an army and attack you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ138_0016.text: I would never act like a decoy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0002.text:
Ah! Yes! My power was not
stolen by El Thalnos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0003.text:
What...?
El Thalnos didn't steal your power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0005.text:
Sorry...!
Did I do something wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0006.text:
(That Elard is a trainee.
Is that why she could keep her power...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0007.text:
You are...?
Leon, who is she.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0008.text: I found her being chased by the Order of the Goddess in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0009.text:
She is a stranger,
but she asked me to take her to Chronos so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0010.text:
Long time no...
I mean, this is my first time seeing you, Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0011.text:
I can't reveal my name. I have my reasons.
I hope you understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0012.text:
Can't tell me your name?
How rude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0013.text:
Do I have to listen to what 
a stranger says?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0014.text:
A stranger showing us the power of the Goddess
while other Goddesses lost their powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0015.text:
Sorry for that.
But there are more important things than my identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0017.text:
El Thalnos is looking for a body that can 
handle his soul after reincarnation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0018.text:
Sylunis...
Her body is not enough to take the soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0019.text:
So she is heading to the desert to find 
a perfect body for her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0020.text: She is seeking the body of Chaos...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0021.text:
We have to stop her before she reaches the
desert and finds the body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0022.text:
The body of Chaos?!
How do you know that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0023.text:
And how can we believe you?!
You might be El Thalnos' follower!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0024.text:
I understand.
But there is no reason to not believe me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0025.text:
El Thalnos will get a
stronger body as planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0026.text: Why would she send me here then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0027.text:
She would've just attacked you guys
after getting the stronger body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0029.text:
... You remind me of
somebody I used to know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0030.text: Fine. Let's go to the desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0031.text:
But I will keep my eyes on you,
so don't try anything foolish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0032.text:
Of course.
Thanks for trusting me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0034.text:
... I won't tell the others about this.
Only we are going to the desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0035.text:
Young Elard. Be my ally.
I think you will be a big help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0037.text: Yes! But, what should I call her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0038.text: Hmm. White Goddess would be okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ139_0039.text:
White Goddess... Nice.
We should hurry up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0001.text:
Silly...!!!
El Thalnos is the one...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0002.text:
who will redeem our world...!!
Why are you interrupting us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0004.text:
Ha...
Never... let them... take... the body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0006.text:
Why are they so fanatic toward
El Thalnos?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0007.text:
When the faith becomes excessive,
they can't tell right from wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0008.text: What they believe becomes the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0009.text: That's why they are acting like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0011.text:
Well, if there are guards here,
I guess what El Thalnos wants is near here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0012.text:
Let's go,
we should get there faster than her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0018.text:
Even those who are devoted to the Order of the Goddess, 
which is wrong, have their own faith...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0019.text: I don't know if I'm going through the right path yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0021.text:
... I was just being a bit sentimental.
Haha. Sorry for being so emotional.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0023.text:
But no, Leon! 
You're a great hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0024.text: You've fought for, and saved many people's lives!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0025.text: You don't look miserable at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0027.text:
Days ago, I involuntarily worked as a bait of our enemy
and made my people dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0028.text:
If I am who I used to be, I might feel depressed...!
But not now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0029.text:
Don't give up Leon!
If not you will miss what you can actually achieve!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ140_0030.text:
I want to help others.
So don't be worried about such things and let's do it together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ141_0002.text:
Oh, haha, what am I doing now?
Are you curious about it? Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ141_0004.text:
I feel so powerful...
I don't know how to cope with this power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ141_0009.text:
What have you done to me!!
I can't go forward!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ141_0010.text:
Damn it!! Fine! I'll take it!
I'll take that body of Chaos with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0002.text:
Without you, I...
I wouldn't have realized it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0003.text:
I don't need great power to 
overcome despair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0004.text:
What I need is...
a will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0005.text:
Thanks for helping me realize 
what the most important thing is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0006.text:
I won't stand back,
Sera and {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0008.text: Now I know what I should do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0009.text: I should help my allies recover and gain a second wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0010.text: And of course help Goddesses too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0011.text:
With your help, 
they will overcome their difficulties soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0015.text:
Dorothy! Maria.
I have something to tell you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0016.text:
You've all paid attention to what Leon said!
Thanks for persuading them, Leon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0017.text:
Haha! It feels good to be together.
Thanks for listening.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0018.text:
I think everyone was touched
by your effort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0019.text:
Well... I think there is more than that.
My charisma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0021.text:
We failed to stop El Thalnos from
taking Chaos' body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0022.text: But we've got hope thanks to Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0023.text:
Our army has been disorganized 
since we had to fight with Apostles. El Thalnos has been decimated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0024.text:
If we work together and gather 
the army of light again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0026.text: By the way, are you all right, White Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0027.text:
... El Thalnos will hold a ritual to 
combine himself with the body she obtained.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0028.text:
The ritual could be happening right now!
We should hurry up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0029.text:
We will go to the holy city 
to stop El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0030.text: Okay. We will do our best too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0031.text:
Please take care of the White Goddess.
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0035.text:
If my sister's soul has left El Thalnos...
I might be helpful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0037.text:
I know I'm being so stubborn...
But please let me join.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0040.text:
Elards who lost their power including me
will go collect the army of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0041.text:
... I don't think I will have a chance 
to meet Dione.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ142_0042.text:
I will leave it to you guys.
Will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ143_0006.text:
Don't worry!
You will definitely get your power back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ143_0008.text:
Huh? Well, yes... I think so too.
If you realize the real meaning of the power of Cora...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ143_0013.text:
You know a way for us to get our power back?
Why didn't you tell me earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ143_0015.text: Sorry. I don't have a right to do this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ143_0018.text:
I will tell you some time.
Sera, {PLAYER_NAME}, be ready for the battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0001.text:
I know you might think this is a dumb story
but I would like you to believe me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0002.text:
Catastrophe will come!
Whoa, this is not my type... But!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0005.text:
Why are you so surprised?
Leave her to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0006.text:
Please pray to God
to keep the peace in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0008.text:
Go to the holy city. 
Find Lednas and she will tell you what to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0009.text:
Well you did me a favor...
so I will remain and help this country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0011.text:
Goddess and Apostle...? I think I've heard 
from Emperor Alexander. Interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0012.text: Hmm. I wouldn't have believed it but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0014.text:
But if what you said about the Apostle is true
we might not have enough power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0015.text:
There is an alliance force I fought with 
during the Edenberg war. I will find them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0016.text:
The Roman army is especially strong
so they will be a big help to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0018.text:
The Alliance army will gather at the holy city.
Find Lednas there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0019.text:
I fear I will not be of much help on the battlefield. 
I shall try to find additional reinforcements from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0022.text:
O Goddess grant the protectors of Hasla eternal courage,
and me the strength to protect them once more...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0023.text:
I know why you came here.
You want to know about the army of light, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0024.text:
Yes. You have great insight, as expected.
I won't say much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0025.text:
Lend us your power.
Hasla is experiencing a catastrophe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0026.text:
Humans with great will.
Now, it is time for the army of light to rise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0027.text:
I'm ready to fight.
This is the path I decided take.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0028.text:
Good. 
Go to Elandia, the holy city and find Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0029.text: She will tell you the details.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0031.text:
I will stay here.
I won't be a big help if I join the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0032.text:
I will lead the army 
so that every warrior survives the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0033.text:
... The situation seems more severe than I thought.
I'll leave soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0034.text: Please take care of my people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0036.text: Hmm, now I'll do what I can do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0037.text:
The apostles have revived after all,
and are devasting the earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0038.text:
Humans know that Apostles are much more powerful than them,
but they are still trying to fight against them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0039.text:
The hopes of humans always sparkle as light,
even when all the Goddesses have lost their power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0040.text:
Yes. Like 100 years ago,
it's the will of humans themselves to stop the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0041.text: Then as a Goddess of destiny I should...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0042.text: open the way for humans to the destiny of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0043.text:
If there is will, light given from Cora will never diminish.
Is this the lesson Cora gave us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_0044.text: ... I think I can fight again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0001.text:
Are you Alexander?
I hear that you are a great king!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0002.text:
Anut, you are being too rude.
Emperor, I apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0003.text:
Ha ha, I'm all right.
Tell me the details.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0004.text:
El Thalnos will gain 
complete power soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0005.text: Then Hasla will experience chaos, more severe than now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0006.text:
So to prevent such chaos,
we are planning to attack the holy city again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0007.text:
Me and Anut are here to gather the
army of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0008.text:
Please lend us the power of Grancia
to bring peace back to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0010.text: I would like to send my army to the holy city directly, but

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0011.text:
as you know, our armies are fighting 
with Apostles in seperate areas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0012.text:
Most of all, what would happen to the warriors fighting in the front line
if I, the captain of the army leave my spot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0013.text:
But emperor... If we are defeated in this battle
all of Hasla will be in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0015.text:
I'm sorry, but Grancia can't participate in 
attacking the holy city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0016.text:
What are you talking about?!
If we don't stop El Thalnos, we are all done!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0019.text: Calm down and listen to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0020.text:
Each person has a different abilty and mission.
Including me and you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0021.text: You guys can go save our world,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0022.text:
and we can protect our continent
so that the people who came back from the long war can rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0023.text: So I will stay here with my armies to support the front lines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0027.text: We will bring the peace back in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0028.text: Yes. I wish you the best, young hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0029.text: Huh? I will do my best too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0031.text:
Of course, I expect a lot from 
you too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0032.text: The situation is more severe here, though this place is far from the holy city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0033.text:
Apostles are 
everywhere in this continent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0034.text:
The Apostle's army is ruining 
every place in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0035.text:
Novice Knights are even participating in 
battles on the front line...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0036.text:
I understand why the emperor 
can't leave his place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0037.text:
We have to save a lot of lives.
Let's join {PLAYER_NAME} now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0039.text: Where is this sound coming from?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0041.text:
Jesus, the entire army was attacked?
Hey! Are you okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0042.text:
I'm injured a little, but I'm fine.
But other soldiers have...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0044.text:
Thank god I could save you at least.
Thank you for surviving.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0045.text: Anut! Take this Novice Knight to the safe place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0049.text:
I'll stay here.
Please... run away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0050.text:
What are you talking about?
You are injured!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0051.text:
Knights live to protect others. 
And you are the one, I, a knight, must protect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0052.text:
If I cannot even protect those before me, 
I do not deserve the title of knighthood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0053.text:
I may be inexperienced as of yet... 
But I too am a knight of Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0055.text:
Heck, if my power was not taken!
I... I want to protect everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0056.text:
Huh? 
Why.. Why did my power return?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ144_SUB_0059.text: Good, let's go save that knight right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0002.text:
There are more armies than other places.
I think El Thalnos is here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0004.text:
During the ritual,
El Thalnos will be defenseless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0005.text:
So the guard is more harsh
near the place where ritual is going on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0006.text:
And... do you feel this?
I feel the energy of the Apostle. I'm confident.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0009.text:
Aubrey? I understand you
but we need her help now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0011.text: ... I know. That's what makes me more mad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0012.text:
We should fight with the real enemy now.
I will shut my mouth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0014.text:
Whoa. There are too many enemies.
Why don't we join Leon and Lednas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0016.text:
If we waste time, more soldiers will come
to protect El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ145_0017.text:
Now, we don't have much time.
Let's be prepared!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0001.text:
Whoa.
Enemies are coming like endless zombies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0010.text:
What a relief.
I was worried about you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0011.text:
It's good to say hello...
but this is not a good time for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0012.text:
We've fought several battles on the way here...
Indeed, there seems no end to this battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0013.text:
We might be caught here.
So, we will fight here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0015.text:
Please escort the Goddesses,
Leon and {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0016.text:
I'll be a perfect escort!!
Let's go!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0017.text: May the blessing of Cora be with you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ146_0018.text: For the peace of Hasla!! Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0003.text:
But I'm here.
Boo... that coward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0005.text:
Dionne... Why are you here?
What about El Thalnos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0006.text:
Yes, El Thalnos is trying to combine with the body of Chaos. 
You might have expected that, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0007.text: I don't like to be ordered, but well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0008.text:
If I can destroy you guys with my power, then
I'm satisfied with that... yipee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0009.text: Huh? This was not the right sound.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0012.text: She seems to be out of her mind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0013.text:
Maybe she is being controlled 
by another person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0015.text: Then, do we have to fight with her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0016.text:
... Yes. This is inevitable. 
I think this means we still have time to stop her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0018.text:
Ha Ha! 
What are you chitchatting about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0019.text: Are you making fun of me?!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0021.text: Well, you won't find any weak spot from me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0025.text:
Um... haha! Such a rude human.
Then block this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0026.text:
Ha... You've beared this?
What a strong toy. Ha ha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0027.text:
Leon. I think highly of your courage
but she is too strong. You can't win over her by yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0028.text:
I wanted to spare my power for El Thalnos,
but we should do our best to win over her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ147_0031.text:
Leave it for later. Focus on the battle.
Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0001.text:
Shhss...
Um... Ha ha... Not yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0002.text:
I thought we've knocked her down...
What a monster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0006.text: Stop talking, just go to sleep Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0007.text: I think we've done it. I can only surpress spirit of Apostle though...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0010.text:
You mean our enemy who tried to 
combine herself with the spirit stone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0014.text:
We can't leave Dione like that.
We should go to the village and reorganize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ148_0015.text: I will tell you everything when we arrive at village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0003.text:
I was at...
the crack of dimension and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0005.text:
You are... Elanuma?
No... no you are not. Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0006.text:
I tried to put on a mask 
since I might cause confusion for you guys...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0007.text:
But I did have to come clean at some point,
and I think this is the perfect time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0009.text:
Who tried to become a king of the Apostle
by gaining power from the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0010.text:
When I was attempting to combine with the spirit stone,
I saw him in the dark abyss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0011.text:
Death Thalnos. I was trying to use his power to
become El Thalnos, the combination of all Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0012.text: However, Death Thalnos has snatched my soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0013.text:
I failed to control the spirit stone
and lost my mind in the dark.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0015.text:
The dim light remaining in the spirit stone
has come to be and woken me up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0016.text:
There was more than just the soul of Death Thalnos
in the fifth piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0017.text: Soul of Elanuma was in there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0018.text:
Right before I was about to perish due to Death Thalnos,
I merged with her soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0019.text:
I woke up, but I was so confused
because her memory and my memory were all mixed up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0020.text:
It took a while for me to recover my senses.
And I felt a sense of guilt. So hard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0021.text:
But Elanuma's memory told me that 
I should stop El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0022.text:
I followed her guidance
and I met Leon and {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0025.text:
So that's why you knew so many things
about El Thalnos...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0026.text:
Yes. Elanuma's soul has taught me
so many things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0027.text:
She was sealed in the spirit stone
with Death Thalnos for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0028.text:
His plan was all set up 100 years ago.
From the moment I touched that spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0029.text:
I have a lot to explain...
but I should go stop her first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0030.text:
El Thalnos. The king of the Apostles and 
the combination of Death Thalnos and a number of Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0031.text:
Let me ask you one question.
Are you really standing for the light side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0032.text:
My will is following Elanuma.
I won't impose you to trust me. But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0034.text:
I believe in you 
and your behavior against enemies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0035.text:
Above all, we've made it this far.
We can't retreat now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ149_0037.text:
Then... Let's join the force at the Holy City!
We came to the village with nothing in mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0002.text:
I'm not fully recovered,
but I will support.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0003.text:
Apostle within you is not completely eradicated.
You should take rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0004.text:
I heard that the enemy is so powerful.
You need help, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0005.text:
And I have a faint memory of the Apostle within me.
I know where they are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Seeing you makes me realize that
this is the future of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0007.text:
Time has passed
while I was captured in the crack of dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0008.text: Leave it to me. I won't be a burden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0011.text:
Thanks.
I should tell you the location.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0012.text:
I'm not 100% sure about my memory,
but I woke up at Cathedral.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0013.text:
Only El Thalnos can open 
the door of dimension to take me out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0014.text: She must have established a throne there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0015.text:
So, now we know where to go.
I'll let everyone know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_0019.text:
I can indeed rely on her.
Let's go! {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0001.text:
Tough enemies.
They are indeed different from what I'm used to fighting with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0002.text: We the army of light are just as strong! Ha ha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0005.text:
Sylunis.
I would like to ask you some questions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0007.text:
El Thalnos used me to buy time.
She will soon get the body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0008.text:
If El Thalnos revives completely
do we have a chance to win?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0010.text:
We've lost too many chances.
They took away the body and we couldn't stop their union.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0011.text:
We have one hope.
Leon, and he knows it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0012.text:
The power that made O'ren and Elanuma 
possible to knock DeathThalnos down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0014.text:
I didn't think of that because 
we need Elanuma to use the power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0017.text:
That is, 'the will of Cora'
The Cora itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0018.text:
Goddess power has come from Cora.
It's the foundation of power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0019.text:
We are bringing the great will of Cora.
You mean? Exciting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0020.text:
I never knew that there was such great power...
Why didn't you tell us about this before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0021.text:
It's quite uncertain. Even though I have 
the memory and power of Elanuma, I'm not her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0022.text: And I don't know if I have the right to use that power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0023.text:
So I tried to use Elanuma's knowledge to knock him down...
But I failed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0024.text:
Even though they look different,
we have O'ren and Elanuma here with us. We have a chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0025.text: Don't worry, let's step forward. My sisters and brothers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0029.text:
If you are my sister, 
I have something to tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0031.text: This is... not a good time for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0032.text:
Leon! we need to have a discussion about the will of Cora.
Follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0036.text:
Well yes... how should I explain this.
Quite complex.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0038.text:
Huh? But if we don't catch up with them 
they will be attacked by the enemies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ150_SUB_0039.text:
Trust me. I know what I'm doing.
I've seen those sisters' eyes before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0003.text: Why do you keep running away from me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0005.text:
You are still the same.
Me as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0006.text:
I know that you have a ton of things to say, 
but you never say anything when I'm standing in front of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0007.text:
I won't run away anymore.
So please tell me what is on your mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0009.text: I felt so confused when I became like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0010.text:
I thought I could not be forgiven for
what I've done after the Apostle's spirit took my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0011.text:
When I met you, I felt guilt
more than happiness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0012.text:
But while I was suffering from the sense of guilt
I only had one hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0013.text:
That was... to knock El Thalnos down.
It was my mission and what motivated me to live on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0014.text:
But I failed all the time
and that made me feel frustrated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0015.text:
I can't... achieve the only means 
to win over the enemies in this condition...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0016.text:
I don't know what to say.
The sense of guilt is weighing me down mentally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0017.text:
You can blame me.
I promised myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0020.text:
I won't blame you.
If I meant to do so, I wouldn't have waited such a long time for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0021.text:
I just wanted to see you face to face.
Thanks for telling me everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0023.text: ... Are you sure... to accept me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0024.text: This is not a good time for you, enemies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0025.text: Aubrey, since when were you so powerful...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0026.text:
Since a very long time ago. 
But I didn't know where to use my power. Like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0027.text:
I will use my power for you.
Use yours for those in need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0028.text:
Sin won't disappear.
But, I can save the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0030.text:
At least I forgave you my sister.
It's because you told me the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0031.text:
Standing still won't change anything.
You can change things little by little.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ151_0034.text: Let's go back to where we belong to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0001.text:
Where are they?
There are only enemies out there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0003.text:
Hmm. Maybe I'm just being too sensitive,
but the dark aura is getting stronger here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0004.text: Do you think El Thalnos has woke up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0005.text:
Perhaps. His power of void 
is spreading throughout the entire holy city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0006.text:
This will make 
his armies stronger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0007.text:
Sylunis! Aubrey!
I was looking for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0008.text:
My sisters.
Did you get rid of any hesitation within you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0009.text: I can't lie in front of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0010.text:
Well, it's not a mind reading or something like that.
Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0011.text: I have a feeling Elanuma and Chronos fought each other like you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0012.text:
Haha. I see.
Now I don't have any hesitation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0013.text:
Will of Cora... The foundation of this power 
does not only come from a single person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0014.text: Everyone with a will to fight against the darkness has it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0015.text:
Everyone in this world has 
a will to fight against El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0016.text:
When we gather all those wills, 
they become the will of Cora, the great light that can defeat the Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0017.text:
I thought I didn't have the right to use that power 
since I once put this world in chaos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0018.text:
However, if that's the only way to defeat the Apostle, 
I won't avoid it and run away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0019.text:
I can't deny what I've done, but I will step forward 
to save myself and others as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0020.text:
Everyone came together 
to fight the darkness 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0021.text: I'm sure we can collect our wills and bring the great light now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0022.text:
And I'm personally ready 
to accept that light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0023.text: What do you mean you are ready to accept the light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0024.text:
I have to really concentrate 
at the brief moment when the light gathers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0025.text: That's why we need a hero to use that light instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0026.text:
That's Leon. 
This is why he is called Leon of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0027.text:
Whoa... that's amazing! 
"Warrior of Light"  it sounds so fancy and heroic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0028.text:
Oh, Sera. 
It's heroic because I'm supposed to be a hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0030.text:
That's the spirit, young hero.
Now we are finally ready for battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0031.text:
We are almost there.
Brace yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0033.text: I need to tell you something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0034.text:
When we left to gather soldiers to form the army of light,
I knew that it would not be easy to persuade them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0035.text:
But popular heroes have lent their soldiers willingly
when I told them your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0036.text:
I realized how long and tough 
your journey was.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0037.text:
Thanks to you,
we all can keep our will and fight against the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0038.text:
Maybe... it is you who deserves
the name Warrior of Light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ152_0040.text:
Yes, we will win this battle.
Let's do this, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0001.text:
I can feel the endless void
across the cathedral.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0002.text:
He would have sensed us too,
but isn't moving at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0003.text:
El Thalnos is the reincarnation 
of the culprit who started the Apostle war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0004.text:
That Apostle I know 
is never afraid of anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0005.text:
He thinks everything operates under darkness,
and lets them go like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0006.text:
It might be obvious for him 
that we came here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0007.text:
Hurry up. My fellow heroes, the army of light are 
fighting against our enemies, even at this moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0008.text:
I'm flaming like a blaze.
I expect a number of enemies in our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0009.text:
I will lead, so that we do minimum fighting 
before we meet El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0010.text: I'll help. You do what you have to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0011.text:
Ah... Then I will...!
Go with {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0014.text:
We should never be defeated.
This world is about life or death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ153_0015.text: It's time to fight against the void. Let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0001.text:
I never expected such darkness.
I'm almost overwhelmed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0002.text: Whoa. I'm about to lose my mind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0005.text:
Now I've become a complete Apostle...
So, it's time for everyone to go back to the void.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0006.text:
Void... Why?
Why are you making the world like this again...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0007.text:
Your question is so meaningless.
I was born in the dark and should go back to the dark.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0008.text:
There is no reason for me to bring the darkness to this world.
That's what it's supposed to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0009.text:
I can't believe it. You are trying to 
destroy this world for no reason?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0010.text:
Originally there was only darkness in this world.
But all of a sudden the light came...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0011.text: The light has resisted the darkness consistently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0012.text:
But look. The darkness has come,
and I'm right here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0013.text:
Light can do nothing in front of the darkness.
The darkness will swallow everything and nothing will remain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0015.text:
As you said, the light might seem weak.
Sometimes the light was blocked by the dark.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0016.text:
However, the light has told me.
That I should keep going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0017.text:
Everyone has followed the light,
and come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0018.text:
Don't ever think that the light 
will vanish so easily!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0019.text:
The will to step forward 
even in this last moment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0021.text:
Will... That's what you've got?
Do you think you can defeat the darkness with that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0022.text:
You gave me the same answer 100 years ago...
So silly to repeat the same mistake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0023.text:
I know that Elanuma has 
run away from the spirit stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0024.text:
You are trying to rise the will with Elanuma's power, right?
But that light won't even touch me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0025.text: Because you will see the end of this world before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0031.text: Everyone living in this world has a will to fight against you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0032.text: One who lost light, has awakened again too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0033.text: Don't ever look down on the light! El Thalnos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0035.text:
The lights have been gathered here. 
Leon! The will of Cora!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0036.text: I said that light won't touch me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0038.text:
So powerless.
The light you believe in is so vain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0039.text:
Silly.
Do you think I will give up?!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0040.text:
Sylunis!
Don't ever make the will of Cora vain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0041.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Give him the light!
We can do this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0044.text:
Why... why is this happening.
It's not like what happened 100 years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0045.text:
Why are you not giving up?
I don't understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0046.text:
This is the will of Cora.
You won't understand it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0047.text: It's time to end this battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0049.text:
No way. I'm the mixture of all Apostles.
Don't look down on me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ154_0050.text: I will show you my true power...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0003.text: There is no light the dark can't swallow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0004.text:
This body and soul are exhausted.
That's all. I'm going back to the dark.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0005.text:
More darkness will swallow the light.
The end of this world is set. It's delayed. That's all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0006.text: But I am taking your body with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0007.text: To the dark... with this body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0009.text:
No... I can't move!
Everyone! Run away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0012.text:
Now it's time to show 
my determination.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0013.text:
You can only take my life here,
El Thalnos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ155_0014.text:
Crack of dimension...
You are always interrupting me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0002.text:
Are you all right now?
I hope I'm not disturbing you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0005.text:
If feels like I met you days ago
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0006.text: We fought in a number of battles together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0007.text:
Oh, I was being too sentimental.
Here, I came here to give you this letter from Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0010.text:
I might be out of the village 
when you wake up and read this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0015.text:
We've met many heroes and Goddesses.
We've undergone many critical situations too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0016.text:
However, I think I was always 
a burden for my allies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0017.text:
I wasn't a big help when we were fighting agianst El Thalnos...
So I thought I should train myself more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0018.text: I have decided to embark on a training journey!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0019.text:
Don't be worried about me.
Leon will help me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0020.text:
Thank you so much for everything.
I won't forget the day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0021.text: When you asked me to save Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0022.text:
Take care!
Hope to see you again in the near future!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0024.text: I think I saw this face during the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0026.text:
It was a tough battle.
But we've won it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0027.text:
I'm impressed.
How could you take the will of Cora in that situation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0028.text:
I think I said it before, but again,
thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0029.text:
You've proved the path of light.
What I regarded as my faith.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0030.text: Do you remember what I said before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0031.text: The name of light... may rightfully belong to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0032.text:
I wasn't joking about that.
Please go on with what you believe is right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0033.text:
By the way, where is Sera?
We should get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0034.text:
Ah, haven't you heard?
Sera and I are going for a training journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0036.text:
You were here, Sera!
It's time to leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0040.text:
I wrote letter to {PLAYER_NAME} 
because I thought I might cry if I meet him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0041.text:
I never expected to see him here!
Gee!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0043.text: Well, now we should get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ156_0044.text:
Wish you luck, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Until we meet again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0001.text:
(At that moment...
I only expected certain death.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0002.text:
(It was surely Elanuma who 
sacrificed her soul instead of mine.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0003.text:
(Why did she leave me behind
in this world?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0004.text:
(I only wished to disappear
along with the sins of my past...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0005.text:
... were searching the premises, uh,
that is... um...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0008.text:
I find it still awkward
to call you Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0009.text:
...No, I understand.
Do not mind me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0010.text: And it seems more important matters are at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0012.text:
Darkness still shrouds the Holy City.
No one can live there now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0013.text:
To make matters worse,
the darkness is spreading beyond the limits of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0014.text:
We cannot think of a way to stop the darkness...
And so we ask for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0016.text:
It shall take years to directly purify
the darkness spread throughout the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0017.text:
For the time being, we must cast
a barrier of light around the city limits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0018.text:
At the very least that shall stop
the shadows from spreading to other places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0019.text: ...Is that so...? I see. Then it cannot be helped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0020.text:
Please inform the other goddesses 
of this plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0021.text:
That shall be better than
if I go and tell them myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0023.text:
Casting the barrier itself is a crucial task;
they shall understand its importance with little persuasion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0024.text:
Yet the other goddesses shall not know
how to treat me, since you did not know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0025.text: I wish to avoid any conflict.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0027.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, 
let us go now to the Holy City before the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0028.text:
The enemy will bother me from casting the barrier.
Please keep them away from it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ157_0029.text: Thank you, Lednas. Please help me in this task.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0001.text:
The resistance of the remaining enemy is strong.
And... that enemy we just faced now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0003.text:
It took the form of Hellad,
but it was not Hellad herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0004.text:
It was merely an illusion, created from the shadows of the darkness...
Things are more dire than I thought them to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0005.text: Let us quickly cast the barrier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0007.text:
Mmmmm.... Well, now I must do something like this...
Or maybe it was that? Hmm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0009.text: You idiot! You got it all wrong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0010.text:
Ahaha... Heh heh.
Can you show me how to do it, Bella?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0013.text: What! You don't know how to do it, either!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0014.text:
I really did not want to meet them,
but... it cannot be helped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0017.text:
I'm sorry, but it seems
as if you two are struggling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0018.text: Could I give you a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0020.text:
Just to be clear, we're helping with the job
because we're members of the fellowship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0021.text: We certainly don't want to help you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0023.text:
Eh... Um... Well, thanks for the offer,
but we can't trust you just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0024.text:
I know that you and {PLAYER_NAME}
fought together to defeat the enemy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0025.text: ...but we were tainted once with the darkness at your hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0026.text:
And you destroyed our Holy Grounds
where we once protected the Soulstones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0027.text: Those things can't be easily forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0029.text:
G-gasp! Ahem.
Hmmph. So it does work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0030.text:
Now that we know how to do it,
let's go somewhere else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_7_SQ158_0035.text:
Let us also continue
our task somewhere else.
