TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0019.text:
Yet I fear this is only the calm before a storm.
He is recovering his strength as we speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0020.text:
Should he succeed in obtaining full power of the Flames
there will be no return to peace as we know it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0022.text:
A prophecy came to me in dreams
after the battle with Oda:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0023.text:
Those human and those surpassing humans
must receive the aid of the pure ones

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0024.text:
in order to subdue the blaze
of the Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0025.text:
And it was my guess that you were
the ones who 'surpassed humans' in the prophecy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0026.text:
I beg to lend us your strength
for the sake of humankind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0027.text:
(That human, dreaming such
an accurate prophecy... Perhaps she...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0028.text: You don't have to be that polite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0029.text:
In times like these, of course we'll help! 
Right, Bella?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0030.text:
... Fine.
I don't want such pure power being corrupted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0031.text:
We give you our sincerest thanks
for your cooperation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0032.text:
Oda will be in the Primal Crater,
where the power of Primal Flames is at its greatest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0033.text:
We have to climb to the top of the volcano?
Hmm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0034.text:
Our destination is the volcano, yes,
but we shall have to travel through the jungle for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0035.text:
We apologize for the inconvenience,
but I fear there is no other way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0036.text:
We aren't that weak, 
so you can stop your worrying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0037.text:
Now that I think about it... If you're the 'humans'
and we're the 'ones who surpass humans'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0039.text:
I had a vague idea,
so I have sent a scout to look into the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_2_0040.text:
I fear we have no time to waste, however.
Let us start for the Crater at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0001.text:
Whew! The road to the volcano 
is tougher than I expected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0002.text:
It's going to take some time to get to the top.
Hey, Bella, you okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0003.text:
So you ask the goddess of volcano.
You should be more worried about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0004.text:
… If you are worrying for my sake,
I am quite alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0006.text:
Priestess.
Your fever is getting worse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0007.text:
A general never leaves the battlefield
in the middle of war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0008.text:
I too will continue as long as I can.
Let me be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0011.text:
Hey, hey. Stop fighting, both of you.
But taking breaks doesn't sound like bad idea. Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0012.text:
Cliffs flowing with lava
aren't exactly the best resting places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0013.text:
And if we went off the path,
we could easily get lost.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0015.text:
Hello, Priestess.
Same as ever, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0017.text: Eh? Have you guys met before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0018.text:
Hmm. So he is the 'scout' you mentioned earlier.
I guess this expedition isn't as foolhardy as I'd thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0020.text:
You weren't there when I returned with what you asked for,
so I figured you'd rushed into the frontline like always.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0021.text:
I only found you thanks to this mister here.
A home is a home, I guess, no matter how long you've left it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0023.text:
I am Black Mamba.
A warrior born of the Woopa Tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0024.text: I heard what happened. And I came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0026.text:
Hey, simple is the best! Right?
So, will you accompany us then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0027.text:
It's the first time we've been to the jungle,
and we really need a guide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0028.text:
I too came to stop Oda. I will accompany you.
But that woman. She can die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0029.text:
The jungle and volcano are dangerous.
A small wound can result in death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0030.text: She must rest and regain her strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0031.text: Do you know of a place to rest?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0032.text:
Our tribe dwells not too far away.
There you could rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0033.text: A rational course of action, I should say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0034.text: ... Then we will retreat for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_3_0035.text:
Black Mamba.
Could you act as our guide?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0002.text:
Ooooh, so this is the healing magic of the Woopa Tribe!
Nice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0003.text:
Anyway, thanks for letting us rest here.
We were in a pickle back there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0004.text: Erm... Does he understand what I'm saying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0005.text:
Captain Viper taught me the Common Tongue.
But I do not think the Chief has learnt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0006.text: I will translate, so he can understand -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0007.text:
There is no need, Mamba.
For I too can speak the Common Tongue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0008.text:
Woomparoom woopa?
Bambad shuroombunida bi padrum?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0009.text:
You wouldn't know as you are uninterested in any matter
regarding the tribe, but Woopa chiefs learn from early on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0010.text:
And please talk in the Common Tongue, Mamba.
The others cannot understand, and it is impolite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0011.text: You are... very good at the Common Tongue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0012.text:
But of course. It is imperative for a chief of a tribe
to be able to communicate with the rest of the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0014.text:
And speaking of the Common Tongue, you must practice more.
Start by dropping the 'woompa' at the end of your sentences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0016.text:
I feel much better now.
Is this the village of the Woopa Tribe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0017.text: And what of Susanoo and Saiga?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0018.text:
Yes.
I am Woomparoom Woopa, the Chief of the Woopa Tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0019.text:
The two you spoke of 
have gone scouting for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0020.text:
I see... 
I thank you for your kindness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0021.text:
You are indeed the pure ones in my prophecy,
the ones who will aid us in our battle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0022.text: We will help you however we can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0023.text:
For your objectives will ultimately
protect the peace of our tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0024.text:
I have noticed that the volcano has grown restless.
Does it have to do with Oda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0025.text:
The Woopa Tribe has lived here for generations,
guarding the Primal Volcano from prying eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0026.text:
It is our purpose to protect it
quietly, from unwanted attention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0027.text:
Is it to abandon those
who pursue the power of Primal Flames?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0028.text:
To an extent, yes. But it is also because
the power of Primal Flame is not all good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0029.text:
I do not know why, or from when, but revenants
have been discovered, lured forth by the power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0031.text:
They are not whole souls of the dead,
but merely pieces of wandering spirits left in this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0032.text:
It seems that the Primal Flames are intentionally
luring them forth to feed on them,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0033.text:
for they are grow stronger day by day,
while the volcano grows even more unstable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0034.text:
Ugh, a mountain filled with ghost pieces.
That doesn't sound that good...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0035.text: You aren't scared, are you, Anut?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0038.text:
But your tribe are guardians of the volcano.
Why are you letting this situation be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0039.text:
We did attempt a cleanse of the revenants a few years ago,
but they were different from normal ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0040.text:
They possessed the bodies of our warriors
and pitted us against each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0041.text:
... Mamba. I ran away at that time-woompa.
I was scared that my tribe would destroy itself, woompa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0042.text:
So the enemy uses mind control...
Then I guess we won't have to face ordinary soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0043.text:
Yes. I am keeping the shadows at bay, but only barely.
Even now a heart of evil seeks the power of Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0044.text:
I fear the tragedy of my tribe may repeat itself
if something goes wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0045.text:
Thank you for your advice.
We should hurry even more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0046.text:
It is dangerous to go now.
The Volcano is... awake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0047.text:
I too can feel its rampant powers.
If only I could put it to sleep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0048.text:
I know of a way, but I cannot take you myself. 
I must protect my village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0049.text:
If you teach us the way,
we will do it ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0050.text:
Are you sure you should be moving around
when you've just recovered after fainting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0051.text:
We'll have to let her do what she wants.
She's a stubborn one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0052.text:
The best way for all of us
is to take care of this problem as quickly as possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0053.text:
Around the Primal Volcano
stand the totems of our tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0054.text:
They have been raised long ago
by our ancestors to subdue the Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0055.text:
If you breathe in a little power into them,
the power of Primal Flames may calm down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0056.text:
Finding a totem in a jungle.
More like a needle in haystack... But oh well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0057.text:
We shall do it.
But another urgent task lies at hand:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0058.text:
finding the road to Oda
and battling the monsters on the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0059.text:
Luckily our company counts a fair number,
so we shall be able to divide the party.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0060.text:
Ooh, then I want to fight!
I'm getting sick of the jungle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0061.text:
As you wish.
Then please take Saiga and Susanoo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0062.text:
I shall go find the totems of the Woopa Tribe.
Mamba, will you guide me through the jungle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0064.text:
Okay, then I'll go with you.
I'll leave the fighting to you, Anut.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_4_0065.text:
And you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Who will you follow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0002.text:
Yep. We didn't get hurt, but...
It's too hot here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0003.text:
Woopa was right.
This power... does not feel pure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0004.text:
Yes, it feels different from when I guarded the place.
How dare they... I'll show those revenants who's boss!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0006.text:
If Oda is still consuming the power of Primal Flames,
fighting him as it is will not solve anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0007.text:
Goddess Bella.
Can you feel where the power is the strongest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0008.text:
I can feel the general direction, yes.
Why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0010.text:
Woopa may not have come with us,
but he did teach me how to oppress the Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0011.text:
I ask the goddesses and {PLAYER_NAME}
to go battle Oda as planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0012.text:
I will go seal the Primal Flames back into
the Volcano and thus cut off Oda's source of power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0013.text: ... Will you be alright? It is a foul power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0014.text:
I will go with you, 
Priestess Himiko.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0016.text:
would you be kind enough to lead our way?
We are not yet familiar with the Mountain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0017.text:
Yes. I go with you.
I will not abandon my home this time-woompa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0018.text:
... Then I'll go see Oda.
I can't leave the stupid fool to his death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0019.text: Then I wish you luck, Saiga.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0020.text: Well, I suppose I can't help it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_5_0021.text:
Good, leave the fighting to us!
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0001.text:
The power of the Primal Flames... 
they are being absorbed by something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0002.text: Is that Oda standing there before us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0003.text:
That's Oda?
Hey, did he always look like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0005.text: I don't think that thing's human at this point...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0006.text:
The power within that man... is no ordinary power.
It is... hundreds of spirits... rotting and foul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0007.text:
Oi, Oda. I don't know if you can hear me,
but let's stop all of this and go home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0008.text:
Honor... Titles... We needed nothing like that,
don't you remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0010.text:
Give him up. Not a single sliver of Oda's soul
will be remaining among all those rotting souls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0013.text:
Only those who sacrifice all
shall be admitted to the Sixth Heaven...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0014.text:
... where all shall be at peace,
for there all shall become whole within me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0015.text:
... Oda.
Why did everything come to this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0016.text:
I am Purity, cleansing the mortal world,
and Guidance, leading it to the door of the Sixth Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0017.text:
Yeah, yeah, knock it off. Stop bragging when
you've only harmed people and animals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0018.text:
I don't know anything about Sixth Heavens,
but you're nothing but some evil overlord!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0019.text:
Hence the name 'Demon Lord 
of the Sixth Heaven,' I guess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0020.text: Huh! So you want a piece of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0021.text:
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I don't like him. I'm going to show him who's boss!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_6_0022.text:
Anut, we don't know the extent of his power.
Don't forget our original purpose - calm down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0002.text:
Yes, I can feel the dark powers fading.
It seems the Priestess has done her job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0004.text:
But... Why did you wish for such power
when everything would end like this, Oda...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0005.text:
Oh yeah, you three used to be friends...
Uh... Comfort... How do I comfort him in this situation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0006.text:
How surprising.
Anut actually has learned proper social interaction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0007.text:
Eh? Why do they remain standing
when the body has fallen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0008.text:
Something is off.
Anut, let's try purifying them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0010.text:
Hey, that's Himiko!
When did you start flying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0014.text:
They've got her, like Oda!
The spirits have possessed Himiko!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0015.text:
Susanoo, that idiot...
What was he doing? Tsk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0016.text:
A purifying flame, to cleanse
the mortal flesh and spirit...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0017.text:
What should we do?
I mean, we can't attack her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0018.text:
There you are.
Will you please explain this situation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0019.text:
Himiko has eaten the spirits
that were in Oda's body!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0021.text:
During the purification process, Priestess Himiko
could not stand the force of the flames and lost consciousness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0022.text:
... and the evil revenants seized at the chance
to possess her body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0023.text:
I tried to stop them, 
but I could not... hurt her with my own hands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0024.text:
Has the Priestess become another
Demon Lord of the Sixth Heaven...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0025.text:
I see...
But your injuries are severe, too. Go and rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0026.text:
We will stop her.
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0028.text:
That is not the Priestess!
Haven't you learned from the battle with Oda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0030.text:
Alas! Wake to your senses, 
Priestess Himiko!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0031.text:
Why...?
Why do you refuse purification?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0032.text: Who do you think you are 'purifying'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0033.text:
You spirits should have disappeared.
Why do you remain and cause disorder in the world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0036.text:
I too wished for eternal peace...yet could not leave 
for the bitterness that I had been wronged in life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0037.text:
I shall now cleanse those wrongs with these Primal Flames
and depart this mortal world for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0039.text:
If only departure from this world is your objective,
then you wouldn't have stolen the Priestess's body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0040.text:
Burning the earth? Slaughtering the innocent?
Were you merely looking for company back then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0041.text:
... You are uncommon mortals,
and perhaps you shall understand me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0042.text:
Do you believe that all life is happy
simply for being alive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0043.text:
Of course! We have to be alive 
if we want to do anything, idiot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0045.text:
I am not I, but thousands, tens of thousands of 'we.'
All of 'us' have been wronged by the foolishness of humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0046.text:
A history of meaningless war repeated itself
under the ever-hungry greed for more land, for more territory...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0047.text:
A history of war in which thousands, tens of thousands of 
'we' were sacrificed without meaning, like cattle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0049.text:
We will now be freed
from the shackles that bind us to this mortal world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0050.text:
We have the power and body to burn these lands
bloodied by meaningless war...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0051.text:
Only now we are allowed to break the chain of suffering...
Yet why do you stop us...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0052.text:
We understand your pain, we really do!
But this isn't the way to do things!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0053.text:
Yes, life is full of suffering and pain. But it is humans 
who find meaning and hope within the darkness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0054.text:
Don't think you can erase
the meaning and hope of all humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0055.text:
Yet is this not a gift, from all of 'us' to you?
A road to eternal peace, without war, without pain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0056.text:
Let us go now...
To the Sixth Heaven...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_7_0057.text:
I am sorry. All is my doing...
It is late, but I shall... with my own hands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0001.text:
Huh?
You were waiting for us here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0002.text:
The swordsman is sleeping, so don't worry.
Are you okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0003.text:
Yes, thank you.
I actually... feel good. Very good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0004.text:
Really? Uh... You wouldn't remember,
but at the Volcano... um...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0005.text:
I heard from Saiga.
The revenants possessed my body....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0007.text:
Hey, don't be sorry.
You didn't mean it, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0008.text:
May I ask... may I ask
how I was freed from the bind of the revenants?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0009.text:
Um... What to say...
We actually don't really know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0011.text:
Frankly speaking, we were in no condition
to stop you in your possessed state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0012.text:
I lost consciousness in despair, but when I woke up 
I discovered everybody had fainted. Including you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0013.text: Is that so? What had happened...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0014.text:
Well, being alive is the most important thing right now.
You're free to do what you want only if you're alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0015.text:
Now, now. Since everybody's had a tough day
why don't we eat something and rest for awhile?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0017.text:
Let's go to Chocolat's Bakery!
Himiko, you're coming with us, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0018.text:
Let's take {PLAYER_NAME}, too!
Chocolat's bread's reaaally good! So eat up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0019.text: Huh. Anut's the same as ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0020.text: Free to do what you want only if you're alive...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_8_0021.text:
Yes. It is time to live.
I will not regret my life, as the wanderng revenants did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0001.text:
Such is my greatest sin,to have the powers of 
the heavens but the heart of a mortal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0002.text:
It was my wish to remain mortal and keep one
than become a god and receive all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0003.text:
Not once did I falter in my choice,
and so I walked only forward to my belief

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0004.text:
yet when I chanced to take a look behind
I discovered that I had only been walking a trail of blood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0005.text:
And so I shall cleanse myself with these flames of repentance
and so sacrifice myself in turn to the souls I have wronged.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0006.text:
Yet the heavens have told me
that my sins will not depart this earth

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0007.text:
and my descendant in days to come
shall suffer in my stead. So my soul shall remain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0008.text:
I, a bearer of the ring,
have been allowed to see what cannot be seen

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0009.text:
and should the descendant of my blood and advisors of true heart
follow the sword of Primal Flames to stand before my grave,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_1_0010.text:
the shackles of my sins will finally break, and free me.
And so I end my elegy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0001.text:
Memories engraved into one's body do not fade.
Even if they do not truly belong to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0003.text:
For days after returning from the Primal Volcano
I could not forget the sorrows of the souls that had entered my body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0004.text:
And so I locked myself in the library, wishing to know
the true history the souls had spoken of, the history of blood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0005.text:
The first three families, who had founded Ryu...
The history they had recorded out of oblivion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0007.text:
It has been some time, Kurenai.
How do you fare?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0010.text:
I do not think you will be interested,
but I will tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0011.text:
Did you that Susanoo and I
had returned from the Primal Volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0012.text:
Spirits still remained there,
in the form of revenants who did evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0013.text:
Yet they were wronged souls all the same, and so I have
chosen to return to hold a prayer ceremony for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0015.text:
I would not have stopped here if I was going alone.
I need your help, Kurenai.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0017.text:
The revenants... desire to be exorcised
by the power of Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0018.text:
It would be easier to help them
if you could accompany me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0020.text:
I care not 
the fate of those revenants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0022.text:
Haha... I had expected thus, but...
Well, we shall depart then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0025.text:
We studied it closely,
but nothing came of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0028.text: I asked you what it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0029.text:
We discovered it at the Primal Volcano
when we went to battle Oda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0030.text:
I sensed it was not an ordinary artifact,
and so had been researching into it. Do you feel anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0032.text:
(as if my heart was aching...
or perhaps sinking into despair...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0035.text: I will go to the Primal Volcano as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0037.text:
Perhaps I could... learn.
What that ring is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0039.text:
What do you think
came over Kurenai?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0040.text:
She is always an odd one,
but she is worse today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0041.text:
It is the first time I have seen Kurenai so shaken...
Perhaps it has to do with the ring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0042.text: Mm... Perhaps she simply likes it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0043.text:
(Perhaps... perhaps it is that
the ring is related to her powers...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0044.text:
(For was she not born of the flames
of the Primal Volcano?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0045.text:
But it is still a relief
that Kurenai has agreed to accompany us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_2_0046.text:
We should hurry as well.
Susanoo, I will carry the ring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0002.text:
Huh.
I never knew she could run so fast.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0003.text:
You were the ones who asked me to come.
Then what is wrong with making haste?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0004.text:
It is not wrong.
But why do you hasten so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0006.text:
Ever since I saw that ring
I have had strange feelings. They are worse here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0007.text:
My heart aches...
as if yearning for something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0008.text:
I wish to shout
and flee at the same time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0009.text:
What is this feeling?
Why does it torment me so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0010.text:
(Kurenai has lived all these years
without once feeling a single emotion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0011.text:
What is this ring indeed
to make her feel such things...?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0012.text:
It is wrong, it is wrong
for such things to disturb the peace of my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0013.text:
I shall find the source of this disturbance
and cut it down with my blade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0015.text:
I will not stop you from going quickly.
But I am worried about you forgetting the important things!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0018.text:
The woman...!
She has a similar feeling to the ring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0019.text: That woman will know about the ring!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0021.text:
Himiko.
You promised you wouldn't intervene!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0022.text:
That woman was not a human. She was a spirit!
Have your eyes been blinded by your desperation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0024.text:
The Primal Volcano is still
a precarious place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0025.text:
Even I, a Priestess of a country,
lost possession of my body to these revenants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0026.text:
That spirit may be such a revenant.
You must be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0027.text:
That spirit was no revenant.
I must follow her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0028.text:
... This is the first time I have seen
Kurenai so adamant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_3_0029.text:
But we must follow our original plans.
Think carefully.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0001.text:
Who are you?
What have you done to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0003.text:
There you are.
We were searching for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0005.text:
... And so everyone has come.
Including my own descendant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0006.text:
... Is it just me,
or does she look like... Kurenai...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0007.text: There is something similar between them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0008.text:
Revealing yourself as if you had been waiting...
You led us here on purpose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0009.text:
... I will cut you if you do not answer.
The blade of flames can cut through even one's soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0010.text:
Who are you? What is that ring?
Why do you confuse me so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0011.text:
I had guessed, but...
I see you do not know anything, Kurenai.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0016.text:
Clear eyes and a straightforward gaze.
A little too bold, perhaps, but mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0017.text:
'Descendant'?
You talk as if you were...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0018.text:
Yes. I am the founder of the house of Tsukino,
as well as the Primal Priestess of Ryu:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0021.text: Should I prove my words to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0023.text:
As a child I studied for years about you,
Primal Priestess. I know who you are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0024.text:
... It is a bold question, Primal Priestess, but I was taught 
that you passed away after the founding of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0025.text:
Yet why has your soul remained
for all these long years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0026.text:
... For still my sins remain,
the wrongs I made during the founding of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0027.text:
The founding of Ryu...
Surely you cannot mean the revenants!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0028.text:
... In the war I sacrificed many innocent humans
for what I wished to call 'the greater good.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0029.text:
I attempted to free their souls through my death,
but it was not enough to bring them peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0030.text:
And thus I have chosen to remain
until the souls depart to eternal peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0031.text:
The revenants we defeated
in our battle against Oda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0032.text:
Oda Nobunaga. Yes.
It was... a sad turn of events.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0033.text:
But there still remain other revenants
outside those who dwelled within Oda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0034.text:
They... especially resent me.
That is why they did not go to Oda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0035.text:
My powers, weakened by years of existing as a spirit,
could only hold those revenants at bay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0036.text:
Oda... was too much for me in my state.
I have wronged you, my descendants, in my error.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0037.text:
That matters little!
Why did you call me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0038.text:
... It is my last request.
Please help me pass into the afterlife.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0040.text:
But how could I ever
exorcise my own ancestor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0041.text:
Himiko. You do not need
to use your powers upon me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0042.text:
I am a mere spirit shackled by the revenants.
I too shall depart the mortal world once they are purified.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0043.text:
But Kurenai, it is you I need.
You have the same powers as I once did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0044.text:
I understand. The revenants
had to be purified anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0045.text:
Thank you, daughter of my blood.
But you must be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0046.text:
With these long years my soul have weakened,
and the revenants have taken pieces of my spirit and strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0047.text:
Do you mean that we could engage
in battle with your own spirit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0048.text:
Yes. Be careful...
The revenants... are calling me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0049.text:
Wait!
You did not answer my questions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0050.text:
Why do we have the same names?
Why do we look alike?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0051.text:
Kurenai... Remember.
Remember that you are needed....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0052.text:
It is not now
that we must speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0053.text:
... I'm not really sure what's what,
but let's go. We need to clean up some things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_4_0054.text:
... I understand. I shall fight,
for I was born to do so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0001.text:
It is as the Primal Priestess said -
it is thanks to Kurenai that we won.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0002.text:
... I would choose to remain by your side
then to spend all my years as a Goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0006.text:
My head.... my head....!
The man, the new empire, war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0007.text:
These are not my memories.
Yet why do I remember them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0010.text:
... Himiko. Do you know how
Kurenai came to be born?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0011.text:
She is the incarnation of flame,
the embers of Primal Flames put into an empty body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0013.text:
... Yes. Kurenai's body
was mine, in the beginning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0014.text:
Although chosen as a goddess, I used my powers
instead for war, and accepted death to atone for my sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0015.text:
Our country of Ryu was devastated, of course.
They could not lose their Priestess in such unsteady times...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0016.text:
They still needed a symbol of strength,
and so dug up my body from my grave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0017.text:
That body, infused with strength of the Primal Flames
and charms of Ryu, became you, Kurenai.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0018.text: Nobles. I will never understand them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0019.text:
Is that why my house looked after Kurenai 
generation after generation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0022.text:
With no memory was I born,
simply existing for I needed to exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0023.text:
For decades I have lingered, and fought.
For I am the guardian of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0024.text:
Yet my body is another's,
and my birth a simple desire for power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0025.text:
... Why am I here...
Why must have it been me...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0026.text: Kurenai! It is nothing like that...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0027.text:
I can only ask for your forgiveness...
For everything began from human greed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0028.text:
And yet, Kurenai. The embers of your life
may have begun in my flesh,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0029.text:
but the long years you spent henceforth
are certainly yours, and not mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0030.text:
It is you, not I, who made
such good friends - as Himiko.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0033.text:
I too was born with powers surpassing human
and used them for both good and bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0034.text:
I could not and did not
live a normal life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0035.text:
It matters little whether you are
human or flame to live a full life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0036.text:
Kurenai, thank you for meeting good people
and bringing change to this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0037.text:
I ask you to continue to  see and hear and feel 
what I could not in my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0039.text:
My descendant, and those who stand by her side.
It is with your aid  that I finally depart this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0040.text:
You must not... follow in my...steps...
and tread... in the blood of... the innocent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0044.text:
...
Let us return for the time being, Kurenai.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0046.text:
Kurenai, you saved the kingdom of Ryu
many times throughout the years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0047.text:
You are our Guardian.
What matters your origins?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0048.text:
... And I confess that I had been 
thinking you different from other humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0050.text:
I cannot explain it well, but... I realized 
that you are not very different from the rest of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0052.text:
Let us return together, Kurenai.
We all need you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0053.text:
Mm. I do feel like going home.
I haven't eaten for awhile...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0056.text:
It seems that this ring
has been completely forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_KURENAI_HIDDEN_5_0057.text:
But I suppose it is unneeded, now.
Kurenai is Kurenai, and nothing more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_1.text:
Captain Lednas? 
Who is the person behind you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_10.text:
Black Order...? Hmm {PLAYER_NAME}, 
have you heard of them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_11.text:
I can explain. They are a heretical group
seeking dark power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_12.text:
We don't know much about the ruins, but
if they're after it, you can bet something's up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_13.text:
I know about the Black Order, 
but how about asking someone else for help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_14.text:
I've already tried that. We've already lost
a lot of volunteers in the ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_15.text: I need someone who can handle themselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_16.text:
... I guess that it's worth investigating. 
But I cannot abandon my duties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_17.text:
If you're okay with it, {PLAYER_NAME}, 
may I ask for your and Sera's help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_18.text:
Okay! I am excited to see the ruins! 
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_19.text:
Let me warn you about the ruins: It's
constantly changing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_20.text:
Really? Then how do we know where we're
going?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_21.text:
I materialize the memory particles with mana
and BLAH BLAH BLAH BLAH BLAH

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_22.text:
BLAH BLAH BLAH BLAH BLAH 
magical wave. Overcoming the limitation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_23.text:
Hmm!? I wasn't sleeping! 
So... what about mana?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_24.text:
I can explain later. Anyway, we can 
use the spell to track the lost heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_25.text: I'll explain more as we go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_3.text:
My name is Celine, a wizard! Let me invite 
you to the ancient ruins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_4.text:
I am currently exploring the ancient ruins.
But I need more people to help me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_5.text:
So I am requesting all your help!
How does it sound? Great, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_8.text: Sounds like fun, but I'm really busy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_1_9.text:
The problem is, the Black Order is 
preparing to scour the ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_1.text: Mel? This can't be real... She's dead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_10.text:
Hmm.. I don't know what's happening,
will you explain, Black Sister?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_11.text: Seems like you're a major player here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_12.text:
Everyone here thinks that the Black 
Order an evil religion and that I'm a traitor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_13.text:
But you don't know why I left the Order of the
Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_14.text:
Yeah... I've never thought about it. 
We were only told to capture the evil Demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_16.text:
An Ancient Evil is sealed in this tower.
The Order of the Goddesses is after its power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_17.text:
So Demona and I were trying to stop the
Order of the Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_18.text:
This is ridiculous. Do you think we 
would believe such thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_19.text: Roland, this is the truth you asked for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_2.text:
Finally, Black Sister! 
Explain what's happening. Now!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_20.text:
If you don't want to believe it, don't. 
Me and Melissa will bring down Apostle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_21.text:
Don't be silly Demon,
What have you done to Mel?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_23.text:
We can't solve this problem by 
ourselves. We need your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_24.text:
Why don't we work together, at least 
for now, to stop the evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_26.text:
But I do believe there is an evil power sealed here.
And that is something I cannot ignore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_27.text:
Oh Roland, you're becoming tolerable.
Oh well, I always follow beauties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_31.text:
Demona. I don't feel good.
Watch out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_32.text:
I can't. The Apostle is right in front of me! 
I'll bring it down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_34.text: Goddess... How can it be so strong...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_35.text:
Don't black out!! 
I think the building is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_38.text:
We have to escape from here!!
The building is falling apart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_5.text:
Seems like everyone knows each other.
Something big is going on here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_2_7.text:
We'll protect you! 
That Demon is dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_1.text:
I was waiting for you {PLAYER_NAME}.
We are safe thanks to you and Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_10.text:
Well he left, saying that he's worried 
about someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_11.text:
And Rochefort... He hasn't woke up yet. 
He's seriously wounded.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_13.text:
Well, I learned something about 
the tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_14.text:
I visited the tower with Celine, and 
snuck a look into the tower's memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_15.text:
It wasn't an easy task but with 
Celine's power it was possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_16.text:
It was such a great experience!
What a long journey...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_17.text:
The one who have built this tower and sealed Manacar 
was not human. Perhaps... It was a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_18.text:
And that mechanical soldiers in front of the tower...
They were the guardians of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_19.text:
I'm not sure about this, but those 
soldiers consume the Apostle's power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_2.text: ... Thanks for rescuing Mel and Cano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_20.text:
Are you saying that we helped 
release Manacar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_21.text:
No one's fault. We meddled in things we
didn't understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_25.text:
Yep... Cheer up! Sobbing doesn't 
change anything, right, Teresa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_27.text: Anyway, the Apostle has been released.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_28.text: The Black Sister's objective is the same.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_29.text:
Me and Demona will investigate 
the missing Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_30.text:
We'll soon have to fight the Apostle 
again. See you then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_31.text: Sorry Teresa. But I've got to go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_34.text: No. I belong to the Night Witches with Cano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_36.text:
So, is it the Night Witches' turn? Our 
primary goal was to eliminate Demona.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_38.text:
So we will return to base and 
report what happened here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_39.text:
But if there's a showdown against the Apostle, 
We'll come back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_4.text:
I just woke up. Demona might
know what happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_42.text:
First I'll write down what I've seen and 
heard. If not I might forget everything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_44.text:
Of course! But I'm worried that we 
might have to fight with the Order of the Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_45.text:
I'm not sure yet... Why do we have to
fight against the sisters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_47.text: It's the people in charge of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_3_9.text:
When I woke up, Roland was preparing to leave. 
He's too tough to be a normal human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_1.text:
Thank you all for your effort!
Let's summon the memories of the past!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_10.text:
She's a famous pop star!
I'm amazed to see her here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_11.text:
She must be here with the Night Witches, 
the demon slayers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_12.text:
Wolfram of the Wind, one of the 4 witches,
created the Night Witches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_13.text:
They accept requests and slay evil
with great pride.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_14.text: Oh I'm sorry, I dozed off...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_15.text:
How can you possibly fall asleep like this?
More research must be done...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_17.text:
You're funny. Anyway, who are
the Night Witches after?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_2.text:
Finally arrived! Let's start working!
I am a Night Witch, the slayers of evil!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_3.text:
This won't be easy.
You could die during this mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_5.text:
I will never submit to evil so long as
my dear fans exist!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_1_8.text:
... Nevermind. Let's go.
I want to see how you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_11.text:
Oh I am sick of that. Have you even 
seen real evil?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_12.text:
Listen, I'll handle this. 
You just stand by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_14.text:
Quit the team if you don't like it.
I'm working on my own from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_17.text:
Yeah, and now we have to decide who
to follow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_18.text: Hmm... Okay this way. Come on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_2.text:
I don't feel like it. I'm so tired.
I want to see my fans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_3.text:
Teresa, I was wondering. Why 
are you being even more fussy today?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_4.text:
You have that look on
your face. What's the matter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_7.text:
Teresa. We're a team!
You have to let me know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_8.text:
Whatever.
Why should I tell you about myself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_2_9.text: So I can understand you better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_3_2.text:
I... have to... avenge my sister...
Oh Mel...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_3_6.text:
I don't know anything about you, or
even the evil you're facing alone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_3_8.text:
Why do you want to know?
You'd be safer not knowing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_10.text:
Did you guys save us? Thank you.
I thought we were going to die...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_11.text:
I was afraid of dying...
I decided to confront it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_12.text:
Though I'm still afraid, I am the
Magical Guardian of world peace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_14.text:
We will keep the world safe!
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}, Celine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_15.text:
Cano, can you move? 
You just woke up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_16.text:
I'm fine! I never fail when 
I'm with my fans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_18.text:
...Let's go.
We're a team, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_2.text:
Cano...?! 
Can you hear me Cano!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_3.text:
Please calm down.
I think she just fainted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_4.text: Who are you? What do you want?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RAGE_4_6.text: Hmm? We're just investigating the ruins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_1.text:
I will show my power this time!
Hmm, this should be about right...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_2.text:
Are you sure?
What's at the end of this tower...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_3.text:
Yes, there is an Apostle at the top of 
this tower. We have to get there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_4.text:
My head's starting to hurt...
We don't have much time left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_5.text:
How about having some sweets? 
Hmm, I guess we ran out of snacks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_6.text:
Oh come on, I'm not some kid.
Let's hurry to the end of this tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_7.text:
Magic is always amazing!
Maybe I'll be able to use it someday...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_8.text:
It is not easy to do so, haha.
Anyway, the Black Sister is after it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_1_9.text:
There must be something in this tower!
Let's go keep tracking the Black Order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_1.text:
Hmm, Demona fought the Order of the
Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_10.text:
Hmm? What's that?
Sniff sniff... Candy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_12.text:
Hmm? Your mouth is full. I also smell 
something sweet when you talk to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_13.text: Huh? I thought you hated sweets!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_14.text:
I don't think that's the point. 
Let's move up, long way to go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_15.text:
Hmm? I feel so tired all of a sudden. 
I want something sweet too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_16.text:
Demona stop being so childish. 
We really need to hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_17.text: But I am a child... Obviously...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_18.text:
Oh fine. How about this? I will give you 
some when we finish our job here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_19.text:
Come on, it's just candy. 
Let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_2.text:
It wasn't exactly a "fight", it was 
self-defense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_20.text:
I don't know how to say it, 
but they don't seem to be bad people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_21.text:
I'm sure that there's something big going on. 
Let's move!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_3.text:
There was no such place for the demons,
so all the demons were hiding in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_4.text:
Demons living together in 
Hasla... I can't imagine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_6.text:
Anyway, they're the ones behind the
Order of the Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_7.text:
They'll reveal themselves when the time is right.
First they have to defeat this Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_2_8.text:
I'm still confused...
That's not the Order of the Goddesses I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_3_1.text:
This power...!! 
It's beyond our wildest expectations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_3_2.text: This is odd. It wasnt like this before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_3_3.text:
Wasn't it supposed to be kept sealed? 
What happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_11.text:
Whatever. Some people have 
a lot to hide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_13.text:
Celine, {PLAYER_NAME}, let's go.
The Apostle is corrupting the heroes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_14.text:
I'm not strong enough but I can't 
just ignore the Apostle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_15.text:
Good! This ancient evil... 
This is what I came here for!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_16.text:
Thank you all. 
I'm sure we're all fighting for peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_17.text:
We have lot of people now, 
we'll find the way faster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_18.text: We'll go this way. Melissa, let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_3.text:
Yes... Thank you. 
Demona... She seems to be OK too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_4.text: Hmm? Why are you all staring at me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_6.text:
Well, no need to hide anymore. 
We're after the Apostle in this tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_8.text:
I'm not an expert on this, but Demona says 
that the evil was created long, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_RUIN_4_9.text:
Humans don't know. Obviously. 
But it seems like someone else knows about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_1.text:
Hmm, great. 
I'll tap into the memories of the past here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_10.text:
Wh-what are you talking about! 
I'm a faithful paladin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_11.text:
And why do you keep following me!
I lost the Black Sister because of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_12.text: Why do you keep disturbing me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_13.text:
Because I am certain that the Black Sister 
is not guilty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_17.text:
Paladins... They seem to be 
chasing the Black Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_18.text:
Hmm. The Paladins got lost in the ruins. 
Interesting. Let's go this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_2.text:
Black Sister... How dare you.
No wonder you betrayed the Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_3.text:
Fine, let's finish this and go back to
Saintess Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_4.text:
Hmm? What is this place?
It's amazing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_5.text:
Wow, look at this place Roland. 
These ruins are priceless!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_6.text: I don't know who this beauty is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_7.text:
Do not besmirch this sacred place with
your lewdness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_1_9.text: Or perhaps your mind is elsewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_1.text:
This maze never ends. I wish I had some more
charming company.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_10.text:
So her name was Maria? 
The lady you honor like a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_12.text:
No, it's you insulting her. Don't abandon 
the truth in the name of loyalty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_15.text:
That one-eyed man with sword... He's 
Rochefort, the captain of the Tristan musketeers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_16.text:
A Tristan admiral opposing a paladin 
to protect the Black Sister? Interesting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_18.text:
Oh, nothing. 
Celine you're always working so hard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_19.text:
Good researchers are always busy. 
Let's go upstairs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_2.text:
Go back if you want. I am 
going to stop the Black Sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_3.text:
This dark power is proof enough for me of
her crimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_4.text: You had fought the Black Sister, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_5.text:
Yes, and I would be with Saintess Maria 
if it wasn't for you. What about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_6.text: Are you sure you had the right person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_7.text:
She was different from the ordinary priests 
but she didn't abuse her power, did she?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_8.text:
Don't insult my intelligence.
I will not waiver.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_2_9.text:
You're so stubborn. 
No wonder you don't have a girlfriend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_3_1.text:
This dark power...! It's not human. 
Goddess, is there really a devil here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_3_2.text: Sigh... This won't be fun at all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_3_3.text:
We must gather together! 
For the light of the Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_3_4.text:
Light of the Goddess, Hmm...
I have my own Goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_10.text:
It would be my honor to hear from
the lovely ladies here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_11.text:
I will explain! 
We are the here to investigate the ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_12.text:
We're not only investigating the ruins, 
we're tracking down those who have been lost in it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_13.text: I see, so are we the lost I suppose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_14.text:
Thank you for saving us. We would still be 
wandering in the dark if it weren't for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_15.text:
The dark power which attacked us... 
That was...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_16.text:
... Definitely not the power of 
the Black Sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_17.text: ... That's true. What's going on here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_18.text:
We can't trust anything until 
we see it with our own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_19.text: Will you join me in uncovering the truth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_20.text: I will, though it pains me to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_23.text:
Thank you for your help. But this place is 
too dangerous, you must leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_25.text:
Hmm? I can't do that! 
I'm here to research the ruins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_26.text: I don't mean to offend you but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_27.text:
Mind your own business! 
We'll work by ourselves. Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_28.text: Haha, I guess you're left behind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_29.text:
I might have made a mistake.. but at least
someone else is here with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_5.text: My mistake, I was a bit confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_VOID_4_7.text:
Hmm? Is that the sign of a new love? 
The lady is cute but a bit too young.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_1.text:
Gathering here brings up old memories...
It has been a long battle. Thank you, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_10.text:
Had it not been for Roman,
our plan would not have succeeded.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_13.text:
It is not with a hasty heart that I wish to depart...
...but I fear I must return to our motherland at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_14.text:
I must report to Athena,
and I worry for Atalante's condition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_15.text:
Perhaps a day shall come when we meet again...
Someday, perhaps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_19.text:
The seals of the Tower have been activated,
and the Guardians of the Tower have started to move,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_2.text:
You too, Melissa!
Hmm? But where's Mister Rochefort?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_20.text:
so Manacar will once more sleep, if fitfully.
...Under the premise, of course, that nobody else destroys the Guardians.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_21.text: Which reminds me,  how were the seals activated...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_23.text:
By all means, we have stopped Manacar for now. But I cannot rest. 
I must look into something that has been weighing heavily on my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_25.text:
I tried contacting Roland to alert of him of our situation,
but to no avail.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_26.text:
I do not think it was due to undelivered mail
that we did not hear from him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_27.text:
Our original goal is to divulge the shadows of the Order of the Goddess. 
We can search for Roland on the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_28.text:
Yes... 
I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_29.text:
Then Mel, I'll be returning to the Night Witches.
I have this one partner who'll cry out her eyes otherwise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_3.text:
I hear he's going around town
drinking and buying on credit, like some good-for-nothing fool.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_30.text:
Huhu, alright, Teresa.
As you wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_33.text:
Huhu, is it alright if we make our little escape
before it gets too crowded, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_34.text:
I will be waiting for the day we meet again.
Until then, I wish you the best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_35.text:
Why didn't you tell me right away that you'd returned?
I've been waiting to hear and record every detail of your adventures!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_36.text:
Wait, where are the others?
I need to hear everyone's memories to create the perfect log...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_37.text:
W-well... I...
Oh, look! A flying strawberry donut!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_5.text: What about that annoying demon who keeps sticking around Melissa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_6.text:
Demona has not recovered all her powers as of yet.
She did lose much mana to the Apostle, after all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_7.text:
She does not seem to be too injured, 
save her feelings, perhaps. She is rather embarassed. Huhu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_8.text: Hmmph. I guess she has some self-respect, at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_10_9.text:
I shall dare to call this a victory on our part, if only temporary.
For we fought side by side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_1.text:
(Here is the headquarters of the mercenary who contacted 
Manacar. It seems like the common village though...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_10.text: Eh, you know something about the tower?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_12.text:
I'm so glad to meet someone who is interested in Manacar...
My studies were indeed not useless!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_13.text:
Well, let's start from the beginning.
It was a month ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_14.text: (Information obtained here is not completely reliable.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_15.text:
(I think I can dig something up
if I keep investigating this village.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_18.text:
Hey, Celine.
Are you poking the passerby again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_19.text:
No, man!
He asked me something about Manacar first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_2.text:
(But we will never know what they are concealing.
Well, let's start!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_20.text:
Hmm? Coming all the way to this countryside
and asking about Manacar? Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_21.text:
I'm Hector, the General under Athena, the Saintess of Roman.
You are... Rochefort from Trista's musketeers, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_22.text: Oh... I'm glad to be recognized by a Roman General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_23.text:
I hope all the villagers see this. 
That I am this popular!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_24.text:
I'll be concise.
I heard something about Manacar

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_26.text:
Wow, you are very patient!
Enduring the redundant stories of Celine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_28.text:
Whatsoever her story is true. 
I'm still recovering from the injury I got there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_29.text:
By the way, how does the Roman 
know about Manacar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_3.text:
Excuse me.
I would like to ask you something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_30.text:
Stories about the Apostle 
have been passed down secretly in Rome too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_31.text:
The legend became a reality, so Athena's people are
investigating about Manacar all across the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_32.text:
I was looking for the one who let Manacar go...
But it seems like that person doesn't even exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_33.text: Well. I think I should leave now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_35.text:
Oh Sera! What's up?
I like you calling me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_36.text:
You've got a letter!
Dear. Rochefort and {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_37.text:
This is from Melissa asking for our help!
She said she found Manacar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_38.text:
Huh? You are talking about Manacar too.
Well I think I should take part now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_39.text: And there is another letter from someone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_4.text:
Huh? Stranger here right?
I always welcome questions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_40.text:
It is said that Hector must have 
arrived at this village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_41.text:
That we sould come with Hector...
Do we have him in this village....?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_42.text:
I'm the guy.
Can I have a look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_43.text:
Um... My colleague who found Manacar
has formed an ally with the Black Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_44.text: I will join you guys until this case is closed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_46.text:
Then, let's move on.
We should save those ladies from fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_48.text:
Ah... It happened.
It must be dangerous so I suggest Celine to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_5.text:
I heard that there is a mercenary here in this village.
I would like to hear about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_50.text: You don't want to see Manacar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_51.text:
Well I do, desperately... But I know 
it will be really dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_52.text:
I don't fight. I won't be any help.
I'll stay in the village waiting for you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_53.text:
I will be waiting for the long, detailed story of
what happened during the journey!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_55.text: Good luck and have a safe trip!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_6.text:
The mercenary?
That's where {PLAYER_NAME} is residing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_7.text: I indeed have close ties with {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_8.text:
We are like comrades. 
I remember when we fought together at the tower of Manacar...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_1_9.text:
Wait, did you say the tower of Manacar?
I would like to hear that specific story, if you don't mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_11.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, I think it's the perfect time for revenge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_12.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Cheer up!
I'll be your guidance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_2.text:
What? What is?
I don't see anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_3.text:
It's a broken arrow. It must have been buried in the ground.
You have good eyesight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_4.text:
(Arrow is here, but I don't see Atalante.
What does this mean...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_5.text:
Hmm. We've come here as told
but there is nothing. Strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_6.text:
That's right. I expected someone to explain 
the circumstances other than talk about Melissa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_7.text:
And it seems like there was a big battle here. 
How about investigating this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_2_9.text:
(Now I see... Very strong indeed.
But I don't move back.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_1.text: Did... did we just knock Manacar down...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_13.text:
And don't worry.
We won't let the Apostle go crazy again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_15.text:
Then let's move on.
I think this is the right way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_2.text:
I hope so... ouch...
At least it will be calm for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_3.text:
Everyone seems exhausted,
but I don't think we have time to rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_4.text:
We've just gained some time.
We should find my colleague.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_5.text: You mean we leave Apostle here...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_6.text:
Well... I don't think that is a good idea...
It's right in front of us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_7.text:
Sera.
I think the Roman General is right this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_8.text:
There is no possibility of winning 
when we know nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_3_9.text:
We should join the existing party so that 
we can make a strategy based on the information they have.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_1.text:
Look, another arrow!
It seems like someone keeps dropping them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_10.text:
I was waiting for you but 
Manacar was faster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_11.text:
Don't push her. She's injured.
She is shivering too! We should comfort her first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_13.text:
She is a soldier on duty.
Stop that messy flirting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_15.text:
Hector is right.
I have a mission to complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_16.text:
You've got my letter right?
Me and the Black Order decided to knock Manacar down together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_18.text:
Um... we are trying to lure Manacar in to the tower 
so that we can seal it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_2.text:
Maybe... 
An archer is not aware of the open quiver!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_20.text:
How can you?
Put a collar and haul it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_21.text:
We might be able to lure Apostle in to the tower 
by using its trait, seeking for Mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_22.text:
A Demon called Demona will be on charge. 
We should make Manacar exhaust its Mana first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_23.text:
Ah ha! If it's that little Demon lady, 
Manaca will indeed be lured.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_24.text:
We were afraid that we might fail the mission...
But we are all here now...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_26.text:
We should be ready for the battle!
Manacar will soon be here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_29.text:
This is the first place where Demona is 
luring Manacar to!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_3.text:
I think she is doing this on purpose.
Some kind of mark telling her location.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_30.text:
We planned to have a first battle here
after preparation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_33.text: (We might not win this time but...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_35.text:
We should protect 
the injured lady in advance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_36.text:
Please get her somewhere safe.
Thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_4.text: Yes. She might be looking for us too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_5.text:
The footsteps seem new. 
She must have passed here recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_4_8.text: I did expect you to come...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_1.text:
...Not an easy task to fight against
Apostle twice in a row.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_10.text:
(Atalante should rest in the village...
but that means a shortage of power for us.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_11.text:
(We cannot even expect when the 
battle will begin...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_14.text:
Yeah. 
{PLAYER_NAME} and a sly guy is here too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_16.text:
By the way. How is the plan going on.
I met Demona and was told to come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_19.text: I'm Hector, the Roman General, an ally. And you are?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_20.text:
I don't know about the ally.
I'm here to kill Manacar. Mel asked me to do so. That's it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_21.text:
Then, I will take this lady
to the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_23.text:
Is there a problem?
You don't seem to be happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_25.text:
Then you want to kill her because you don't trust me?
This lady doesn't have much time left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_27.text:
I don't think you want to leave here 
without killing Manacar anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_28.text:
Leaving here means loss of power. 
Someone with low impact should leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_29.text:
You think you are?
You are the well-known musketeers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_3.text:
Not that bad.
That Apostle is not moving now

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_30.text:
It might sound like a joke,
but indeed I haven't recovered fully from the injury yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_31.text:
And this unexpected battle...
I'll be honest. I don't think I can fight now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_32.text:
So I think I'm the best man to leave.
Not you or {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_35.text:
I don't know what you are worrying for,
take it easy. I will be a gentle knight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_36.text:
...Fine.
Please take her safely to the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_38.text: So, what should we do now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_39.text:
We should get to Manacar tower,
then the battle will be waiting for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_4.text:
so we should move on now.
I'm sure there is another spot for a battle plan...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_41.text:
We should get there faster than Manacar
so we have time to prepare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_42.text:
Chit chat is over then!
Let's move right away! Mel is waiting for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_6.text:
Hey, Roman General. Come here.
I think we should transport her to the village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_7.text:
She is severely injured.
She can barely move.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_5_8.text:
Hector... Go to... Manacar... Tower...
We should all get together and... fight there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_10.text:
Ah...ha...
I hope she is okay...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_11.text:
We fought against Manacar twice 
during the way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_12.text:
It keeps malfunctioning. 
I think the power is exhausted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_13.text:
We couldn't explain everything, 
but nevertheless you did a good job! Thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_14.text:
Manacar will be trying to take away Demona's power
to restore it's power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_15.text:
Demona will lure Manacar to the tower,
and when it arrives,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_16.text:
I will turn on the ancient sealing device
at the right time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_17.text:
While I'm doing so, you should make 
Manacar use its power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_18.text: I know it's a tough mission... sorry. And thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_19.text:
People! I think Manacar is coming!
I feel the aura of Apostle...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_2.text:
Teressa! 
And you all have arrived safely. Thank god.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_20.text:
...!
Mel, leave her to us and start the sealing process!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_22.text:
I hope this is the last battle 
with that infernal Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_23.text: I will make it the last battle this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_3.text:
I see someone missing.
Something happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_4.text:
Kano seems busy.
I think I can do the job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_5.text:
Haha, are you?
And... what about Rochefort and Atalante?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_7.text:
You are... Hector, right?
I heard about you from Atlante.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_8.text:
Yes.
Atalante got injured from Manacar

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_6_9.text:
so we decided to send her to the village.
Rochefort is escorting her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_1.text:
I destroyed it this much.
It won't function well. I bet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_10.text:
Go ahead, Demona.
Relieve the mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_12.text:
(Finally we are sealing Apostle...!
But what is this feeling... Anxiety...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_19.text:
And this power... 
is way stronger than before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_2.text:
(Whether or not that sister succeeds, 
sealing will be a crucial point...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_21.text:
Bah! We will knock it down 
whenever it stands up again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_22.text:
No... We don't know what is wrong with our plan...
We can't just fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_3.text:
Melissa! Demona!
We've knocked Manacar down again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_4.text:
Thank you so much.
I can now try to seal Manacar again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_5.text:
We've done quite good!
Greetings for later. We are busy now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_6.text: Melissa, I think this is enough, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_8.text:
I found this among the ruins of altar 
where Manacar was sealed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_7_9.text:
I think this is the core of what captured Manacar.
I'm sure Demona's mana will be enough to wake this up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0001.text:
... First... I must ask for your forgiveness.
It seems that there has been a miscalculation in my plans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0003.text:
Tis not the hour for blame.
There is no other among us who know better about Apostles...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0004.text: A solution, not incrimination, is sorely needed at this moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0005.text:
You weren't wrong in making your choice.
And I'll continue to follow you, whatever choice you make.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0006.text:
...Thank you, everyone.
As for the solution to our current predicament...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0007.text:
We must reactivate the seals of the Tower.
There is no other way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0008.text:
I... I need some time to rethink our plans, 
and find out where we made our mistake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0009.text: ...do once more what has already been done, and failed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0011.text:
I entrust Demona to you.
She has only lost consciousness due to the drainage on her mana,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0012.text: and will soon wake up if you lay her down in a safe place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0013.text:
Don't worry! 
I'll take care of Demona!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0014.text: Hmmph. I don't shoot unconscious people. Even her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0016.text:
Then we too must prepare for the final battle.
... But whether it will be the final battle for the Apostle, or for us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0017.text:
Don't say anything about dying, or fighting to the death.
I didn't fight for my life all these years to die in this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_8_0018.text: I'll try my best as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_12.text:
I... I shall be direct, if only to save precious time.
This plan... was bound to fail from the start.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_14.text:
The plan to reactivate the ancient seals of the Tower
and restrain Manacar was, in itself, possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_15.text:
Yet... 
the seals cannot be activated with simple mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_16.text:
But how...?
By what other force shall the seals move?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_17.text:
We had forgotten the most important factor:
that the master, the Tower had been a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_18.text:
I followed the powerful stream of mana streaming from the Tower
and reached one final point of destination -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_19.text: - and there, only the will of the Goddess remained.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_20.text:
A power surpassing any mana of any human alive or dead:
Only... only the power of the Goddess can move the seals of the Tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_21.text:
Ha... So we shall fail in our endeavors
if a Goddess does not suddenly appear from the heavens!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_23.text: (And so it is revived once more... Is it here that I die?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_25.text:
I... I am sorry, everyone.
It seems... that we were bound to fail here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_27.text:
(What should I do, Prestina?
 At this rate, everybody will...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_28.text:
(Melissa said that she needs
the power of the Goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_29.text:
I... I don't know how I can help,
but I have the power of the Goddess too... so I'll... I'll try...!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_30.text:
... Oh. I... I did it. I activated...
{PLAYER_NAME}... Pres...tin..a....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_4.text:
Yes. My head hurts a little, but...
What happened...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_5.text:
(Ah, yes... We were hit directly by Manacar's shockwave
during the final battle...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_6.text: Everyone. Shouldn't you wake up now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MANACAR_WORLD_9_9.text:
It is only due to heaven's will that we remain among the living.
Has your investigation borne any fruit?
