TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_6_004.text: In such a situation it would be best to ask him in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_001.text:
It has been some time since our last meeting, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
How have you fared?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_002.text:
Since then I have been researching about 
the evil aura that I felt from David...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_003.text:
It was Saintess Maria who gave me the answers. What I am about to
tell you is related to you and your companions as well, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_004.text:
According to the information that I obtained on my own 
and from Saintess Maria...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_005.text:
Currently the Cobalt Knights have joined the Order of the Lion at Elandia, 
and are being controlled by the dark aura, of which is that of the Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_006.text:
Only the power of the Goddesses or the prayer of the Saintess 
can expel the darkness from their minds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_007.text:
Saintess Maria has asked to be sent the Cobalt Knights, 
saying she would purify the darkness for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_008.text: She added that we must be careful, since the Cobalt Knights would be stronger due to the shadow of the Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_009.text:
I have discovered the current locations of several Cobalt Knights.
The problem is that the whereabouts of half of them are still unknown...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_010.text:
Well, saving one is better than saving none. 
The first Cobalt Knight we must retrieve is Vius.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_7_011.text: Let us depart to rescue him at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_8_001.text:
The next Cobalt Knight with known whereabouts... would be Jacie. 
Her location is not too far from the Holy City.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_001.text:
I have received word that Vius and Jacie are awake and in their right minds. 
Once asked why they were in Elandia with the Order of the Lion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_003.text:
It is a shame that they cannot give more detailed information, 
but I believe it is best that they do not remember anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_004.text:
To remember what they did, under the influence of the Apostle... 
would taint their honor as knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_005.text:
Let us go find the remaining Cobalt Knights.
The knights whose whereabouts are the clearest are David and Lawiya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_006.text:
I lost David due to my ignorance of this... being called the Apostle... 
but this time I shall be prepared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_START_1_.text:
Ah. So you are {PLAYER_NAME}. 
I am David, Cobalt Knight of the Order of the Blue Blood.

I come bearing a message from His Majesty, 
to be delivered directly to {PLAYER_NAME}...
From hereon are the words of His Majesty:

{PLAYER_NAME} you have aided us greatly in the last war, 
and it is with great faith that I wish to entrust to you a mission.
Remnants of the Neth Army are still active in the city of Edenberg.

Their numbers are not great, and their misdeeds are not serious in degree, 
but if left unchecked they may gather to wage another war.

They must be suppressed before such misfortune strikes, 
and it is you that I trust the most. I give you my thanks in advance.

And I have also sent as aid a knight who is your greatest fan. 
Hence writes Alexander, Emperor of Grancia.

Cough... As Emperor Alexander has written in his letter... 
I have been assigned the task of aiding you in this mission!

Once you are ready, 
I will explain the basic plan of this mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_START_2_.text:
The number of remnants have decreased 
thanks to our last mission...

Yet according to the reports of other Cobalt Knights, 
there are still a few hiding out of our sight, waiting for a chance.

Fortunately their numbers are few, but they are the remnants of an army 
who once waged war against the entire continent. We cannot rest.

This time we must root them out to the core 
and expel them from the city of Edenberg completely.

Tell me once you are ready, {PLAYER_NAME}.
We will then depart for the location of the mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_1_002.text:
That there are those who threatened our precious Miss Sera...
and lived to tell the tale?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_1_003.text:
Simply unforgivable!!!! 
You must punish them for their impudence...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_2_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. A shade in the form of Hellad... 
is continuously reviving in the place where she fell.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_2_002.text:
Perhaps her fixation for the Soul Stone keeps her lingering. 
At any rate... We cannot afford to ignore it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_3_001.text: Ah! Are you the one the world calls {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_3_003.text: It is as Goddess Anut said!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_3_004.text:
Yes, yes! I believe I can entrust you with my request: 
defeat those Order of the Goddess villains lingering in the desert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_4_002.text:
Ah, {PLAYER_NAME} 
I hear you visit Elandia often these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_4_003.text:
Then could you by any chance obtain for me 
some weapons the Order of the Goddess use?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_4_004.text:
I've heard that they are of very, very, very, very good quality. 
I simply wish to see them with my own eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_6_002.text:
Despite everything... our Hero Town continues to prosper in peace, 
all thanks to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_6_003.text:
But I digress. 
The defense line of the Alliance at Elandia is currently failing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_6_004.text: I wish to ask for your aid in reinforcing them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_7_002.text:
Those villains! Trying to destroy the world.
How could they? I can't understand them at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_7_003.text:
Show them what we are made of, {PLAYER_NAME}! 
Show them what the world is made of!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_7_004.text: I'll try to help the world in my own way, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_7_005.text:
Of course... I may not be of much help when you consider everything... 
But it's better than doing nothing, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! 
I hear you're doing great things for the world these days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_002.text:
Of course I expected it all along. 
After all, you're a hero, aren't you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_003.text:
Haha, no need to be humble! 
Who else could be called a hero if not you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_004.text:
Now, now... Talking of heroes... 
I hear there's a very heroic-looking robot where you go to save the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_005.text:
I-it is supposed to be controlled from a driver's seat located within... 
Is it not exciting that there is technology that allows such things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_006.text:
Could you bring back that robot for me? 
I too wish to ride it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_007.text: From childhood all men dream of one thing, controlling a transformer robot from the inside!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_8_008.text: And so have I! I beg of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_1_0.text: Even after its destruction Hellad's shade continues to appear.

... I will look into the situation as well, 
but for the time being I will entrust you with its elimination.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_2_0.text: Ah, I have forgotten to tell you this...

Even after destruction my illusion continues 
to revive and attack the residents of Elandia...
Go and shake things up. Think of it as training.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_3_0.text:
El Thalnos may have been defeated, 
but this land remains tainted by his vile malice.

El Thalnos...a being derived of a darkness that existed before
the creation of the world. His malevolence shall not be so easily overcome.

Until this land is purged of the venom he left behind in his death, 
his shadow will continue to revive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_SUB_QUEST_START_4_0.text:
But those devoted to the darkness remain at the Holy City, 
and are attacking the innocent.
Let us quickly settle their rampage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SEA_QUEST_0001_1.text:
I mercenari perlustrano regolarmente l'area
per scoprire eventuali tracce di mostri.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SEA_QUEST_0001_2.text:
Gli eroi che partecipano alla ricognizione saranno ricompensati.
Perché non ci provi,  {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_BOX_1.text:
Il kit di supporto viene consegnato per posta.
Controlla la casella dei messaggi!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_RESULT_2.text:
Uhm... Ok, denaro ricevuto!
Tieni, è per te.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_WAR_1.text: What is going on right now? A war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_WAR_2.text: I am suffering a great loss due to the war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_WAR_3.text:
What? Why am I not closing the shop? I can't do that.
I still have some customers, like you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_DEFAULT_1.text: Do you wish to speak to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_DEFAULT_GROUP_1.text:
The past, you ask... 
Not such a happy memory, I fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_DEFAULT_GROUP_2.text: There is one particular memory I have...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_11_1_0002.text:
Thank you for trusting me 
even when to you I was but a stranger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_11_1_0003.text:
But you are not a stranger to me, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
And neither is Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_11_1_0004.text: A time will come when the truth shall be revealed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_11_1_0005.text:
I can do nothing but ask for your trust 
when that day comes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0001.text: ... Is it that you wish to know about the Chaos?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0002.text:
He is the last of the first three Apostles to tread the land of Hasla... 
And yet no remaining record of him can be found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0003.text:
Only the Daughters of Cora 
who engaged him in battle knew of his existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0004.text:
All I know of the Chaos is that he lost both his life and powers to Destalos,
and thus perished before the Apostle's War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0005.text: The Soul of Chaos contained an immense amount of darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0006.text:
... and it was with this darkness that Destalos 
raised up a myriad of Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_12_1_0007.text:
The barren body of Chaos was thrown away in the desert... 
That is all we know of his end. A pitiful end indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0001.text:
I had been expecting the day of truth to arrive 
but not this soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0002.text:
I must introduce myself again, 
you already know me as Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0003.text:
Yes, this is not our first meeting.
We have already made our acquaintance... rather badly, I fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0004.text: I cannot and will not expect forgiveness for my actions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0005.text: My past does not justify what I have done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0006.text:
As for my identity... It cannot be helped for those who already know, 
but I implore you to keep it a secret for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_22_1_0007.text:
The day will come when I shall, with my own words, let everyone know, 
but today is not that day... when such revelation will only cause chaos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0002.text:
You have no reason to fear me any longer. 
No doubt tarries in my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0003.text:
Should the sins of my past still haunt me in days to come, 
I shall accept them and repent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0004.text: For that would be the price to pay for recovering my light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0005.text:
A long time ago... when I first fought in the Apostle's War, 
I foolishly thought that my light would save the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0006.text:
I had set out only with concern for my sister's wellbeing... 
only to soon discover the cruelty of war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0007.text:
I realized that what I had thought to be the pain that only I knew
in reality pervaded the world, in all kinds of suffering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0008.text:
It was then that I came to desire... a way to end all wars once and for all. 
Yet I had not realized that the path would lead me to darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0009.text: ... I fear our talk has turned rather grim.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_27_1_0010.text:
This is not the time to recount and regret the folorn past. 
We must advance towards the light... Let us go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0001.text: ... Is it that you are still curious about my past?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0002.text:
You are strange, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
But I shall tell you, for it is no secret... not any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0003.text:
Where did we stop last time? 
... Yes. The Apostle's War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0004.text:
The one who awakened the light within me 
was Goddess Elanuma...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0005.text:
...but the one I accompanied the most during the war 
was Goddess Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0006.text:
Goddess Chronos... wished to confine every Apostle within 
the Soul Stones and so prevent, for ever, the onset of war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0007.text: My faith in her words was what drove me to continue fighting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0008.text:
... But it was not long before 
that faith became, in itself, an obsession.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0009.text:
I must admit... recounting the past 
rather gives me a headache.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_28_1_0010.text:
No, do not apologize. 
But the rest of the story must be told another time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0002.text:
Ah... It's you, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
No, you did not disturb me. I was merely thinking...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0003.text:
Have you come to hear the rest of the story? 
... I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0004.text:
After the war, Goddess Chronos abruptly changed her mind
and appointed me as guardian of the Soul Stones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0005.text:
I was disappointed, because I could not 
understand her sudden change of heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0006.text:
I thought that our days of war and suffering 
could not be compensated through such moderate measures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0007.text:
That was why I... attempted to finish what Goddess Chronos did not. 
I ran away with the Soul Stones...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0008.text:
...even as I was reminded, at the final moment before
merging myself with the Soul Stones, of Aubrey...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0009.text:
I thought to myself that I could not stop then, 
if I wanted what I had thought to be the greater good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0010.text:
Despite my vow, as you already are aware, 
I failed in my attempt…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0011.text:
My... memory afterwards... is too horrible to speak of. 
I felt myself fill with inexplicable hatred and rage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0012.text:
...and, imprisoned for my sin of stealing the Soul Stones, 
slowly deteriorated into despair and darkness for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0013.text: Time passed without distinction... until there came one wizard

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0014.text:
by the name of Hellad. 
That meeting was to become the beginning of everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0015.text:
... Now you know everything there is to know about my past. How
surprisingly comforting it is, to relieve to another the burden of my heart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0016.text:
To move forward into the future...
I must face my past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_29_1_0017.text:
Huhu... You may have had different motives in asking about my past, 
but I must thank you anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0001.text: ...? Why are you giving me that look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0002.text:
You seem quite startled... 
as if I returned from the dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0003.text:
I suppose it does appear as if I am returning from the dead, 
for it was several days that I lay unconscious after the final battle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0005.text:
...Yet I have a vague notion...
on how I survived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0006.text:
At the very moment I pushed El Thalnos into the crevice of dimensions, 
I felt a... a presence departing from me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0007.text: It was then that I lost consciousness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0008.text:
I... think it may have been the soul of Goddess Elanuma. 
There is no other possibility.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_EP7_ST_30_1_0009.text:
As long as I live... I shall never forget her grace 
that returned me to the world of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_10_2.text:
Ah ah ah.
Uh? In che senso non è il momento di ridere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_10_4.text:
So che sarà un viaggio difficile,
ma non intendo smettere di ridere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_10_5.text:
Io sarò me stessa e lo stesso vale per te.
Giusto?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_10_6.text: Non vedo l'ora di passare del tempo con te,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_11_2.text:
Wandering around Nosgard is much tougher 
than the Volcano or underwater.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_11_3.text: I just want to take a nap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_11_4.text: No matter what I do, I'm always tired after going to Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_12_001.text:
The Super Smash Battle! Sounds so Awesome!
We get to ride a huuuuge beast in the battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_12_002.text:
I can't wait to start a battle!
I've rarely seen a huge beast in the desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_12_003.text: A huge beast in the desert... Hmm... Sandworm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_12_005.text: Well, let's forget about the bad memories!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_1_1.text:
Ehi,  {PLAYER_NAME}!
Chiamami Anut. Sono la dea del deserto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_1_2.text:
Il deserto mi mancherà, ma
il dovere mi chiama.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_1_3.text:
Oh beh, non facciamola più tragica
di quanto non sia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_2_10.text:
Prima di tutto, la dea Prestina.
Uhm, dunque, era...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_2_2.text:
Abbiamo bisogno di più soprannomi.
Vediamo... Prestina... Pressy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_2_7.text: Nah, il tuo nome è già abbastanza corto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_3_1.text:
Ehi, ricordi quegli squali?
Non avevo mai visto un pesce parlante!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_3_4.text:
Come? Che c'è?
Sono l'unica che vuole vedere qualcosa di straordinario?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_3_6.text: Dai, smettila di guardarmi in quel modo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_4_2.text: Il fatto è che... credo di aver mangiato io il budino di Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_4_3.text:
E credo di aver sentito qualcuno dirmi
che non dovevo mangiarlo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_5_1.text: La dea del mare... Si chiama Aubrey, vero?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_5_2.text:
Ha un'aria così tetra...
Ma non sembra cattiva.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_5_3.text:
Ho una strana sensazione...
Magari è più vecchia di noi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_5_4.text: Non so, ha un che di misterioso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_6_1.text:
Vedere i mostri corrotti...
Mi fa venire in mente quando sono diventata un mostro-insetto...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_6_2.text:
Non che lo volessi...
Ma non posso fare a meno di pensarci.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_6_3.text: Ehi, ehm, potresti tenermi la mano un secondo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_6_5.text:
... Fiuu. Quando mi sento a disagio,
ho bisogno che qualcuno mi stringa la mano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_6_6.text: Mi fa sentire molto meglio. Grazie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_7_2.text: Scusa se te lo chiedo, ma che ne pensi di me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_7_4.text: In effetti, sono un po' preoccupata...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_7_5.text:
Scherzo sempre
e non mi comporto mai seriamente...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_7_6.text: Ma so che non è giusto...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_7_8.text: Dici che dovrei solo essere me stessa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_8_1.text: Aubrey è la sorella di Sylunis...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_8_2.text:
Il che significa che Aubrey è la dea del mare da oltre
100 anni? Per cui deve avere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_9_1.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, ricordi quello che mi hai detto?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_9_4.text:
Ho riflettuto su cosa significhi essere "me stessa"...
Ora sono un po' più sicura di me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_9_5.text:
Ed è tutto merito tuo,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Sento che posso davvero fidarmi di te.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_DEFAULT_1.text:
Ehi!  {PLAYER_NAME}!
Che cosa ti porta qui?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_DEFAULT_2.text:
Hai l'abitudine di entrare nella stanza
di una signora senza preavviso?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_DEFAULT_GROUP_1.text: What? You would like to hear old stories?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_1.text: Mmm, arrivano sempre pessime notizie dal deserto...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_10.text: Il mio biglietto della lotteria! Dove sono i miei soldi?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_11.text: Ok, la prossima volta farò centro!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_3.text:
Stavo leggendo il giornale.
Il mondo è ancora un luogo pericoloso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_5.text:
Oh! La classifica PvP di questa settimana!
Passami quel giornale!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_PVP_3_8.text: Uffa, non ne ho azzeccato neanche uno!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_1.text: In questo mondo ci sono altre dee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_2.text:
Le Schegge degli Apostoli si trovano nella foresta, nel deserto,
nel mare e sul vulcano e una dea deve proteggerle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_3.text: Ovviamente, Prestina è una di queste dee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_4.text:
Ma ho sentito che, nelle terre al di là del continente,
ci sono anche altre dee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_5.text:
Però non possono spostarsi perché devono
proteggere le loro schegge...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_6.text: Nessuno sa cosa stiano facendo di questi tempi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_7.text: C'è un modo per chiedere il loro aiuto?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_8.text:
Mmm, Hasla e il continente oltre il
Mare meridionale hanno firmato un trattato.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_10_9.text: Però non abbiamo i mezzi per metterci in contatto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_3.text:
Uh? Che c'è, Sera?
Cosa guardi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_4.text: Aha! Ho capito! Stai osservando le ragazze, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_6.text:
C... Come ti viene in mente?
Non mi importa di queste cose: il mondo è in pericolo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_7.text: Eh? Ehi, a me non dispiace se qualcuno mi guarda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_8.text: Spero di non diventare mai come te...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_11_9.text:
Va bene, fai come vuoi.
E allora cosa stavi guardando?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_12_2.text:
Che c'è, Sera?
Sono ancora quegli imbecilli?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_12_3.text:
N-No... Veramente...
Qualcuno ha mangiato il mio budino.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_12_6.text: S-Scusa! So che è una cosa da nulla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_12_7.text:
Tranquilla, troverò il colpevole.
Non preoccuparti.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_13_3.text: Come ho fatto a bloccare l'attacco di Sylunis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_14_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, ricordo... 
Di aver sentito la tua voce nell'oscurità...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_14_2.text:
Come? Non hai detto niente?
Non mentire! Sono sicura di averti sentito.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_14_3.text:
Comunque, non vedo l'ora di essere di nuovo con te,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Non mi farò più prendere dal nemico.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_14_4.text:
Lo stesso vale per me,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Non lascerò mai più Sera da sola.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_14_5.text: Uh, non ho bisogno di essere protetta tutto il tempo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_1_2.text: Mi chiamo Sera e sono l'apprendista della dea della foresta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_1_3.text: Mi sto allenando per diventare una dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_1_4.text: Non posso combattere, ma posso proteggerti,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_1_5.text:
Lascia che te lo dimostri.
Ti proteggerò da questa pentola che sto per lanciare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_1_8.text:
S-Scusa...
Non è andata molto bene...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_2_13.text: Tornate tutti al lavoro, datevi una mossa!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_2_3.text: Wow, è perfino più carina di quanto si dice in giro!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_2_5.text:
Sono il tuo fan numero uno!
Sposami! Ho qui l'anello!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_2_6.text: Ehi, lei è mia, razza di imbecille!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_2_8.text:
È così carina anche quando fa la timida!
Altro che la nostra leader!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_3_1.text: Sera, abbiamo scoperto degli esseri corrotti in città.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_3_2.text: Cosa?! Si sono già infiltrati in città?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_3_5.text: Ma loro non lavorano per te?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_3_6.text:
Non più: ora sono dei semplici cascamorti
che hanno tentato di introdursi in casa tua.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_3_8.text: Capisco... Credo che abbiano bisogno di una purificazione speciale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} guida un gruppo di 
mercenari, giusto?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_10.text: Inoltre, sono sempre occupati a combattere contro altre nazioni.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_11.text:
Così l'Impero ha consentito la costituzione di gruppi
mercenari che si occupano dei problemi a livello locale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_12.text:
In effetti, sono nati fin troppi gruppi di mercenari da allora,
il che è un problema, ma... Eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_15.text:
Uh, oh? C-Che succede? Sì, ti stavo ascoltando!
Dunque, stavi dicendo... Ehm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_3.text: Vorrei sapere che cosa fa un mercenario.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_6.text:
No, ero solo sorpresa che qualcuno
si interessasse a quello che facciamo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_7.text:
Allora, lascia che ti spieghi.
I mercenari sono delle specie di soldati.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_8.text:
Vengono assunti per eliminare i mostri in
tutto l'Impero, al posto dell'esercito imperiale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_4_9.text:
Spesso lo schieramento dell'esercito imperiale
richiede molto più tempo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_5_3.text:
AAAH! Devo allenarmi di più!
AAH! IIIAH! AAAH!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, potresti parlarmi del portale
dimensionale appena fuori città?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_2.text: Non avevo mai visto niente del genere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_4.text:
Molto tempo fa, la nazione fu squassata
da una guerra di enormi proporzioni.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_5.text:
Per trasferire agilmente le armate, l'Impero realizzò un portale
usando ogni scienza e tecnologia conosciuta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_6.text:
Ma al giorno d'oggi, i portali vengono usati come mezzo
di trasporto tra le città e altre aree...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_7.text:
Ciononostante, c'è chi richiede la loro distruzione,
in quanto si tratta di monumenti alla guerra.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_6_8.text: Wow, Lednas, tu sì che sai un sacco di cose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_7_1.text: La dea della foresta mi raccontava sempre una storia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_7_2.text:
Diceva che, quando il mondo si trova in grave
pericolo, viene prescelto un eroe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_7_3.text:
Sosteneva che da sempre vi sono degli eroi che
assistono le dee nella lotta contro l'oscurità.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_7_4.text: Credi che comparirà un nuovo eroe leggendario?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_8_12.text: Quegli idioti sono ancora fuori di testa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_8_13.text: Mi domando come abbiano fatto a entrare!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_8_3.text:
Negli ultimi giorni svengo spesso...
Spero di non disturbarvi troppo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_8_5.text:
Noi viviamo per proteggere Sera!
Sei svenuta per dare un senso alla nostra vita!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_8_9.text:
Ehi, un momento! Ci arrestano sul serio?
Lednas, stai scherzando, vero? Lednas? NOOO!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_9_1.text: La dea Prestina è stata come una madre per me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_9_2.text:
Sono orfana e ho vagato nella
foresta finché non l'ho incontrata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_9_3.text:
Da allora, ho imparato molto da
Prestina, soprattutto riguardo alle dee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_9_4.text:
La dea Prestina dice che non era intenzionata
a fare di me una dea, ma...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_9_5.text:
Da grande, voglio diventare proprio come lei!
Sarò la nuova dea della foresta!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_DEFAULT_GROUP_1.text: Do you want to hear the old stories?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_DEFAULT_GROUP_2.text: Stories I used to tell have just come across my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0002.text: Are the other Chrona Heroes coming as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0003.text:
Yes. Sigruna, Kriemhild, and Dorothy have 
stopped by the forge to check their weapons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0006.text:
Aren't the Chrona Heroes seven in total? 
Even if you add you and Archon to the number, it's only five people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0008.text: I-I can do sums too, you know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0010.text:
The Chrona Heroes are seven in number, 
but only five have gathered as of yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0012.text:
Of the two, one is the Hunter of Iron Will... 
She is in Trista at the moment, and it'll be some time before she joins us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0013.text: I hear the situation in Trista is quite complicated as well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0014.text:
I see! 
Who's the last Chrona member?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0016.text:
The last member of the Chrona heroes 
is the Saintess of the Order Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0017.text:
But we have lost all contact with her... 
There is a possibility that she has been accused as a heretic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0018.text: Oh no! Then she's in danger, isn't she?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0019.text:
I don't think she would have fallen so easily. 
After all... She's one of the Chrona Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0020.text:
But we must find her quickly. 
There is a high possibility she is still in Elandia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0021.text:
I see! 
Well, I should help you find her as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_3_1_0022.text:
The help of a Goddess would be helpful indeed. 
Thank you, Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0002.text:
Ah, Sera. 
It seems a long time since you visited this room.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0003.text:
Yes! That's why I want to stay all day today! 
I brought some tea and pudding as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0004.text:
Oh, thank you. 
Teatime is always welcome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0005.text: Hehe. It's good to be home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0006.text:
Drinking tea with Goddess Prestina, 
fighting side-by-side with {PLAYER_NAME}...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0007.text:
I didn't know that the people from the Black Order and the
Order of the Goddess would be here as well, but it was fun meeting them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0008.text:
Hmm? 
Have you met them before, Sera?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0009.text:
Ah! Didn't I tell you? 
I guess I forgot...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0010.text:
A few months ago we heard rumors of people disappearing 
at a place called the Tower of Manacar, so we went to investigate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0011.text: And it turned out that an Apostle had been sealed within the tower!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0012.text:
So everybody was in great danger, 
but I protected them with my powers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0014.text: Yes, because I'm a Goddess too! Ehehe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0015.text:
Anyways, the people I met in the tower 
were from the Order of the Goddess and the Black Order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0016.text: Huhu... It seems that you're doing fine without me by your side, Sera!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0017.text:
Eh! No! 
I don't want you gone, Goddess Prestina!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0018.text: I like being with you the best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0019.text: Yes. I am happy that I can drink tea with you, Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_1_0020.text: Speaking of tea, could you give me another cup?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0001.text:
Leon! 
You seem very happy today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0003.text:
We had been worrying about her for a while... 
Fortunately she's safe, and it is always good to meet an old comrade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0004.text:
Wow, I guess all the Chrona Heroes are really good friends! 
Have you fought together for a long time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0005.text:
Eh? No. 
This is our first meeting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0006.text: What! But... you were searching for her for a long time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0007.text: Mm. Because I heard from Archon that we had to come together to fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0008.text: But how do you recognize a person you've never met before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0009.text:
Hmm... Well... 
I guess I just had a familiar feeling as soon as I saw her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0010.text:
Haha. Now that I think about it, it really is strange. 
I just saw her and thought, I know her, and we're close.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_EP7_ST_7_2_0011.text:
Maybe you were unconsciously remembering your past life! 
How remarkable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_PVP_3_2.text:
Beh, è il luogo in cui il regno organizza
dei tornei di combattimento.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_PVP_3_3.text:
Una volta lì ho affrontato molti potenti guerrieri.
Ho imparato molto da quell'esperienza.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_PVP_3_4.text: Ti interessa davvero tanto, eh, Sera?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_PVP_3_5.text:
Sì! Sono stata in città e non si parlava d'altro che
del vincitore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDOG_PVP_3_6.text:
Al terzo posto si è piazzato {PLAYER_3rd}, al secondo {PLAYER_2nd}...
e chi ha vinto...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_10_1.text:
Cora's power was powerful enough to bring 
down the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_10_2.text:
Dionne said that we might be able to use
that power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_10_3.text:
The light you felt when purifying Sera
might be the power of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_001.text:
Anut.... 
How could she find that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_003.text:
Oh fine. Everything is going well.
So I won't make a big deal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_004.text: Hmm, shall I tell you a bit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_005.text:
As Anut said, the Berry which can make you stronger
might really exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_006.text:
I've found a similar description in the documents about
Divine Beasts from my master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_11_007.text:
Well, we just found a small clue about it.
But it may be worth some excitement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_12_001.text:
Sylunis, soulstone, and apostles....
How should we solve all these issues...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_12_002.text: If I just had more power... like my master...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_12_003.text:
What's that look on your face?
Are you trying to cheer me up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_12_004.text:
I..I wasn't really feeling dejected.
So don't look down on me like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_13_001.text:
Hmm? Are you curious about my master?
My master is Ar'rat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_13_002.text:
She was the former Goddess of Volcano and judgment.
She was strong, beautiful, and confident.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_13_003.text:
If anyone messed with her, 
that person would have to be burnt to death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_13_004.text:
She was a great scholar as well, leaving numerous
research results behind. But those are all lost.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_13_005.text:
If we could restore those...
It would have been a lot of help to us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_1_1.text:
Ho sentito parlare di te dalle altre dee,
 {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_1_2.text:
Mi chiamo Bella. In segno di rispetto per la
mia posizione, chiamami dea Bella.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_1_5.text:
Chi sono quegli sciocchi?
Sto chiedendo a  {PLAYER_NAME} di chiamarmi dea Bella.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_2_2.text:
Se è stata imprigionata e Aubrey ha preso
il suo posto, come può essere ancora viva?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_2_3.text: Possiede ancora il potere di una dea...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_3_1.text:
Un tempo, gli Apostoli erano governati da un re.
Ma quando li abbiamo affrontati, non c'era alcun re.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_3_2.text:
Credevo che fosse solo una leggenda, ma ora...
Non ne sono più tanto sicura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_4_1.text:
Perché ci stai aiutando? Non hai
da guadagnarci né oro né onore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_4_2.text:
Le altre dee hanno detto che le hai aiutate molto.
Per un essere umano, hai delle grandi capacità.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_4_3.text:
Approvo la tua abilità...
E ho pensato di farti l'onore di comunicartelo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_4_4.text: E ora suggelliamo queste parole con un bel bacio!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_4_5.text: Cosa..? Non è affatto quello che intendevo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_5_2.text:
Temi di guidare la spedizione?
Ti ho già detto che approvo la tua abilità.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_5_4.text:
Non ti ho raccomandato a cuor leggero.
Hai le qualità del leader.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_5_5.text:
Dovresti avere maggiore sicurezza...
Io credo in te. Ti terrò d'occhio.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_5_6.text: Nutro un interesse personale nei tuoi confronti, quindi...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_5_7.text: Ignora quello che ho detto! Te lo ordino!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_1.text: What is it! I don't feel good right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_10.text:
She's so beautiful.
I think I'm in love...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_12.text: I'll find this guy and kill him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_2.text:
What? You've got information about 
the Northern country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_3.text:
Hmm... I saw the report from the scout
Lednas sent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_4.text: I also saw the report from Lednas...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_5.text: Well maybe, this could be helpful anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_7.text:
The Emperor in the North is Thor. 
Apparently, he's bald.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_6_9.text:
I met a girl in Nosgard. 
She went North to write fairy tales.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_1.text:
Me? I was just looking through the data 
the expedition had collected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_10.text:
According to Lednas, she came when
she needed help for the Central Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_11.text:
Wait, this handwriting seems familiar...?
Oh my, it's the guy who wrote the Nosgard report.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_2.text:
I commanded them to collect every clue 
about Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_3.text:
So now there's a lot of rumors I have
to sort through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_4.text: Why don't you help me out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_5.text: It's not a secret or anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_6.text:
It's just a record on conversations 
Lednas had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_8.text:
Daughter of the Colosseum Master and
Weapon Hunter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_7_9.text:
We have no records of a female wizard
before she arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_8_1.text:
The Former Volcano Goddess used to 
know 'Chronos', the daughter of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_8_2.text:
I heard that there were 3 daughters 
of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_8_3.text:
Chronos the Fate, Elanuma the Light, 
and last but not least, Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_8_4.text: I've never thought that I would meet one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_9_1.text: Stupid Anut, always making me worried.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_9_2.text:
I've been made at her since she 
lost those parts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_9_8.text:
When she collapsed... I could only think
about saving her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_EP7_ST_30_1_000.text:
Whew... 
I was rather afraid back there that you wouldn't manage it.

I hadn't realized how simply my powers would return. 
If I had known, I would have helped you sooner.

D-don't you dare think I care the tiniest bit for you! 
It's just that I care about the world, that's all!

What I mean is... you're still the captain of the fellowship of the Soul Stones.
Be careful not to throw away your life and ruin everything for the rest of us.

The Soul Stones may have been destroyed, 
but there are still a lot of things left for the fellowship to do.
Don't you ever think of leaving, or dying, or anything of the sort. Got it?
D-don't ask me what we have left to do right this moment!
H-hhmph! If I say a lot, it is a lot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_PVP_3_1.text:
Guerrieri di Hasla!
È iniziato il torneo per scoprire chi è il guerriero numero uno!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_PVP_3_2.text: Chi sarà il vincitore di questa settimana?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_PVP_3_5.text:
Un torneo PvP?
Sembra divertente. Magari dovrei partecipare...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_10_1.text:
Ricordo una sola cosa della dea del deserto
precedente: mi prendeva in giro.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_10_2.text: E poi Anut si unì a lei.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_10_3.text:
Ero furiosa che un'apprendista osasse
sbeffeggiarmi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_10_4.text: Ma la precedente dea della foresta mi insegnò a dominarmi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_10_8.text:
Eh eh, sorpresa!
Che c'è, Prissy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_1.text:
Vi sono molti luoghi misteriosi a Hasla,
a cui i comuni esseri umani non hanno accesso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_2.text:
La Città celeste, l'Oltretomba, ecc...
Il fondo dell'oceano è uno di questi luoghi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_3.text: È un peccato che non possiamo ammirarlo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_4.text:
Davvero? Beh, in verità io ho recuperato
alcuni reperti locali.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_5.text:
Oh sì, quello sembrava una stella.
Qualche cattiva creatura l'avrà trovato gustoso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_11_6.text: Io però non ce l'ho fatta a mangiare quel pesce. Era troppo disgustoso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_12_1.text: Ne abbiamo viste di tutti i colori,  {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_12_2.text:
Mi vergogno di alcune delle azioni che ho
compiuto durante il tempo trascorso insieme.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_12_3.text:
Ma grazie alle tue gesta, ho scoperto il significato del coraggio,
 {PLAYER_NAME}: tu fai ogni cosa senza mai lamentarti.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_1_1.text:
Il mio nome è Prestina e sono la dea della foresta.
È mio dovere proteggere la foresta.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_1_2.text:
Ma ora ho una missione più importante.
Devo proteggere le Schegge degli Apostoli.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_1_3.text:
Inoltre, posso scatenare il potere della foresta dal
terreno in modo da intrappolare i nemici.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_1_4.text: Spero che il mio potere possa tornarti utile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_1.text:
Ah,  {PLAYER_NAME}.
Dunque vuoi sapere della Pietra dell'anima?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_2.text: Seppure per un soffio, vincemmo la guerra contro gli Apostoli...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_3.text:
In seguito raccogliemmo le loro anime
nella Pietra dell'anima e la rinchiudemmo qui ad Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_4.text:
Nei nostri santuari, custodiamo
i frammenti della Pietra dell'anima.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_5.text:
Se qualcuno dovesse ripristinare la Pietra dell'anima,
sarebbe una catastrofe inimmaginabile...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_6.text: La Pietra dell'anima in sé non è pericolosa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_2_7.text:
Ma le anime degli Apostoli al suo interno
infetterebbero e corromperebbero Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_10.text: Hai ragione, non si può stare sempre in ansia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_11.text:
Ma non posso fare a meno di pensare a tutti
gli esseri umani che vengono corrotti...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_15.text: Oh no, è di nuovo preoccupata...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_6.text:
Oh, sei tu, Sera. Scusami.
Stavo pensando a una cosa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_8.text:
Non temere, dea Prestina!
Andrà tutto bene!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_3_9.text:
Sera, sei sempre così ottimista.
Mi metti allegria, eh eh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_4_3.text: Di cosa stanno parlando quei due sciocchi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_4_5.text:
Sceglierai Sera, vivace e ottimista,
oppure Prestina, matura e aggraziata...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_4_6.text: Una domanda che non trova risposta...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_4_9.text: E io ti seguo a ruota!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_5_2.text:
In genere dedico la mia vita alla protezione della Scheggia,
ma ho già visitato altre cittadine in passato.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_5_3.text:
È stato così che ho scoperto il significato
della vita di una dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_6_1.text:
Quando il mondo è in pericolo
e nessun altro se ne rende conto...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_6_3.text: Sera se ne renderà conto... un giorno.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_7_1.text:
I guerrieri guardiani servono le dee.
Quelli che abbiamo visto nel deserto sono guerrieri guardiani.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_7_2.text:
Per tutto il tempo in cui servono la dea,
si preparano a offrire la propria vita...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_7_3.text:
Ma credo che sia sufficiente avere un cuore nobile
e svolgere il proprio dovere per il bene superiore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_7_4.text:
Vorrei che i miei soldati mi dimostrassero
la stessa lealtà.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_7_7.text: Le battute non sono il mio forte...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_8_1.text:
Noi dee viviamo molto a lungo,
ma non siamo immortali.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_8_2.text:
Con il passare del tempo, i nostri corpi
ritornano alla loro condizione umana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_8_3.text:
Prima che ciò accada, troviamo un successore
che erediti questa carica.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_8_4.text:
Poi dobbiamo guidarla in modo che possa
risvegliare il suo potere di dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_8_5.text:
Ecco come siamo riuscite a proteggere
il mondo per tutto questo tempo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_1.text:
La Grande guerra...
La Guerra degli Apostoli.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_2.text:
È come se il mondo avesse preso fuoco.
Ricordo ancora le urla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_3.text:
Per sconfiggere gli Apostoli, radunammo un esercito
insieme agli umani.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_4.text:
Guerrieri della luce, Cavalieri del giuramento, Arcieri arcani,
Streghe nere... Tutti lottarono contro gli Apostoli.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_5.text:
Affrontarono gli Apostoli...
E, uno dopo l'altro, furono uccisi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_6.text:
I Guerrieri della luce caddero durante
lo scontro finale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_7.text:
Al tempo ero giovane e non sapevo molto
di loro, però conosco una leggenda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_9_8.text:
Secondo la leggenda, essi torneranno
quando il mondo sarà in pericolo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_DEFAULT_GROUP_2.text: We should value the old stories too, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_10_1_2.text:
Do you remember the scientist from the
Neth Army that we met recently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_10_1_3.text:
The scientist told us about the helmet... 
and after I researched the Neth Army, 
I found out that they were all wearing helmets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_10_1_4.text:
I'm bet that the helmet secretly 
controls the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_10_1_6.text:
But I'm sure that technology and magic 
beyond this century is involved...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_10_1_7.text:
How could the Neth Army have 
access to such technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_18_1_1.text: Hellad... She talked about her study...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_18_1_2.text:
Maybe it was about controlling 
the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_18_1_3.text:
There is only one person who knows 
so well about the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_18_1_4.text:
If Hellad knows about the Dark energy 
and even knows how to controll it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_18_1_5.text: I'm so sure that there is Sylunis in the back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_1.text:
I found a suspicious document 
from soldiers in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_2.text: Seems like a instructions, shall I read it out loud?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_3.text:
Secure the target.
Fighting and using Dark energy is approved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_4.text:
It's a mission document!
What or who would be the target?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_5.text:
I'm sure that it's related to 
Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_1_6.text:
We should find out all the 
dirty secrets of the Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_2.text:
Did I ever tell you that I saw an ancient 
Goddess from long ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_3.text:
I was the guardian of the former Goddess 
during the war agianst the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_4.text:
Her name is Prima. She was named the 
Goddess of the Forest after the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_5.text:
Prima and I went through a number of battles, 
and met many brutal Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_6.text:
The ancient Goddess had come to help 
us during the crisis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_7.text: I saw her from a distance, so she may not have noticed me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_2_8.text: Thanks to her, I'm standing here talking with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! Welcome!
I was looking for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_10.text:
I'm Celine. I'm a wizard from the empire, 
but please consider me as the seeker of knowledge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_11.text: I'll be staying here until I'm ordered to return!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_13.text: I'm Prestina. Nice to meet you Celine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_15.text:
By the way, what's your role in 
this village, Prestina?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_16.text: You don't look like a warrior...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_18.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! Please be quiet!
I'm listening to her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_19.text:
Oh really? You would like to know what 
I've been studying? Then I'll explain 
to you briefly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_20.text:
After that incident in Manacar, I started to 
research Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_24.text: ... So I'm continuously studying about it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_25.text:
But I found out that the Goddess is always in 
relation to what I've uncovered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_26.text: Who is this Goddess?! I'm dying to know the truth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_27.text: Prestina! Please help me find out the truth about the Goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_28.text: Well... Yes I hope you find out the truth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_3.text:
Ah, you don't remember right?
I'll refresh your memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_4.text:
The Order of the Goddess and the Black Order have 
fought over discovered ruins several months ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_5.text: We first met then, here in this village...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_7.text: Well she won't stop talking... So it went like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_1_3_9.text: Then, let me introduce myself again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_2.text:
that we can't change our destiny.
So we have to accept it and walk forward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_3.text:
The road of Light will open based on 
number of sacrifices.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_4.text: But I can't find any light on the way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_5.text:
People make their own desitiny.
The way to the light is not fixed yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_6.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, you did not give up and rescued Sera!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_22_1_7.text: Me too. I won't give up no matter what.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_24_1_1.text:
When I rescued Yuria, 
I felt a mysterious power near her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_24_1_3.text:
The light that surrounded {PLAYER_NAME} 
when Sera was captured by the Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_11.text:
Are you worried about me {PLAYER_NAME}?
I'll cheer up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_2.text:
How could she thought of capturing 
Goddess and take away the power of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_3.text: What could they earn from doing so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_4.text:
Ah, do you remember when we saw the 
mission documents when we 
first faced the Neth Army?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_5.text: The target was also mentioned in the document.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_6.text: I'm sure that the target was me right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_7.text:
It was a trap.
Even when Hellad brought me to Edenberg...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_25_1_8.text: ... From when had she planned all of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_1_1.text:
I remember that the capital of the Neth Empire 
was Edenberg...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_1_2.text:
I was always curious about the place.
I wanted to visit Edenberg someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_1_3.text:
I heard that the two most popular schools 
on the continent were located in Edenberg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_1_4.text:
The campus was so beautiful that many 
people came to visit there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_1_5.text: But why am I here... In this flaming city? It's so sad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_2_1.text: So lucky that there is Portal near Edenberg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_2_2.text: Be sure to retreat when you are in danger {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_2_3.text:
It's just a small portal. We can protect 
it with a small force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_2_4.text:
It seems like the Neth Army has been using a
large portal for the invasion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_2_2_5.text:
How dare they abuse portals...
It was for the sake of convenience...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_4_1_2.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I was just thinking about something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_4_1_3.text:
The Neth Army was using Dark energy but 
they were very cautious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_4_1_4.text: However, the alliance armies were wandering around like zombies, soaked by Dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_4_1_5.text:
How can this happen?
I'm certain that there are some secrets beneath all of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_1.text: Chronos, does Elard designate Goddesses like us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_10.text: So now we are destined to protect the Shard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_11.text:
Then, there are 5 Goddesses in this universe
including me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_12.text: Well there is one developing Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_13.text:
I heard that there are other Goddesses all over the 
continent, but I don't know the details.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_14.text: All over the continent... Were they exiled?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_17.text:
There are only 5 Elard remaining. 
Way fewer than those during the Apostles War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_18.text:
Well we should do something! 
Let's do our best, Elard Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_2.text: I assumed so, but I've never heard of it before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_3.text: Hmm... Indeed it might be unfamiliar to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_4.text:
There were no other Goddesses other than 
Cora's daughter like me in this universe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_6.text:
Elanuma, the daughter of Cora also had 
the great power that Cora had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_7.text:
She awakened humans with suitable 
conditions to be a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_8.text:
You have the power of the Goddess through inheritance
but it's not as strong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP6_ST_5_1_9.text: The result of that are you guys, Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_10_1_000.text:
Goddess Prestina... 
We came as soon as we could.
Ah... I am doing well, but...

Did something occur
while we were guarding the rear?

Yes, you two deserve an explanation as well. 
There... is a wizard, a servant of the Apostle.
She has been infiltrating the Order of the Goddess as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_10_1_001.text:
Luring us to this place... was all a part of her plan
to seize the power of the Goddess.

Hellad... 
To what extent does her shadow reach?

Wait. Hellad... Did you say Hellad? 
Saintess Maria, that name...

I... I remember meeting in the Order of the Goddess
a wizard who went by the same name...

She was a wizard of the Empire, 
but always used to visit the Order on the grounds of diplomacy...

Had she been infiltrating the Order from the beginning? 
Then Hellad and the Order of the White Lion...
that the Order of the White Lion began to change...
...around the time the wizard started visiting the Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_10_1_002.text:
... So the Order of the Lion 
has been working for Hellad for all this time.
But I cannot understand it, nor can I accept it!

The Order of the Lion may have been radical from the start, 
but how could they ever renounce their faith to a single wizard?
It may not be a single wizard that we must deal with.

The Order of the Goddess once attempted
to use the power of the Apostle...

...the darkness of which we have only scratched the surface...
may have dominated the heart of the Order itself.
...could a spy who works for Hellad.

Yes. And before we discover who it is, 
the darkness surrounding the Order shall not lift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_10_1_003.text:
Goddess Prestina... 
This may not be the right time,

but when the day comes, 
will you help the Order of the Goddess?
Saintess! Once again you put yourself in danger.

Yes. The duty of the Order of the Goddess...
is to spread the will and teachings of the Goddess Elanuma.

For it was Goddess Elanuma who continues the will of Cora. 
Yes. I certainly will help you.

Huhu... Thank you. 
But you must rest for the time being, Goddess.

Roland.
Let us return so that Goddess Prestina can recover.
I want you to have a good rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_30_1_000.text:
Well done, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
You have defeated the final evil, the greatest evil of them all.

She is growing up. 
We shall have to see how she does.

Sigh... The greatest battle may be over, 
but there are still many tasks left behind.
The shadow cast by the Order of the Goddess....

The Apostles who were not bound within the Soul Stone, but instead
woke from their long slumber throughout the lands of Hasla...

Darkness will prevail once more 
if we do not continue to protect what we must protect.

It shall be a long journey ahead, {PLAYER_NAME}, 
but together we shall carry on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0001.text:
Goddess Prestina. 
I wish for some of your time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0003.text: I heard that you and Archon fought with the revived Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0004.text:
Yes. It was there that we heard the story of Oren... 
the identity of your past life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0006.text:
I only learned very recently of Soltar's revival. 
My memory of my past life is still unclear as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0007.text: Will you tell me about Soltar's end?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0009.text: It all started when Archon suddenly visited our town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0010.text:
We later realized that Goddess Chronos had sent her, 
but we did not know it back then, and so we were very surprised.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0011.text:
Yet it was clear that the Fortress of Souls was a dangerous place,
and so we decided to fight Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0012.text:
Normal weapons do not hurt Soltar. 
It is the reason, only we Chrona Heroes battled him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0013.text: Yes. We had to retreat many times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0014.text:
But did you know, Leon? 
It was you who left us the greatest gift of hope:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0015.text: The Crystal Sword Danan that you, as Oren, wielded in your past life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0016.text:
But Danan was shattered one hundred years ago. 
How could it have been a gift?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0017.text: Its fragments were left in the fortress, still retaining some of their power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0018.text:
We gathered the fragments 
and forged them into a power that could defeat Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0019.text:
... That comes as a surprise... 
that my broken sword served to help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0020.text:
Yes. You may not have had all the memories of your past life... 
But you still helped us, even in ways you didn't realize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0021.text:
We may have failed in restraining Soltar permanently, 
but there will come a day when he shall be vanquished once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0023.text: Thank you, Goddess Prestina, for restraining Soltar for all this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0024.text:
I feel that it is now my turn to protect the land of Hasla 
and you as well, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0025.text:
Oh my. 
I feel rather embarrassed, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_1_0026.text: I too will do my best, Leon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0002.text:
Ah, {PLAYER_NAME}. I ask for your forgiveness. 
I fear I have been rather - unseemly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0003.text: Yet I cannot help but worry for the other Goddesses...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0004.text:
Don't worry about me. Goddess Chronus has put her trust in us, 
and I will do my best to protect it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0005.text:
Speaking of Goddess Chronus...
Have you noticed, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0006.text: Goddess Chronus seems to have opened up to us as of late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0007.text: She always calls us Goddesses the Elard...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0008.text:
At first I was rather discouraged,
because I thought she was reluctant to acknowledge us as true Goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0009.text:
Yet I know she is different now. 
Had she not changed her mind about us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0010.text:
she would not have trusted us enough to divide us into groups, 
especially with the Soul Stone before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0011.text: I daresay... she trusts us a little more now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0012.text:
Huhu, yes. I would like to believe that. 
It is a good feeling, to be trusted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_3_2_0013.text:
Shall we depart now? 
We must go save our comrades.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0001.text: Ahaha. Are we late for teatime, Goddess Prestina?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0002.text: Ah. Welcome, Saintess Maria and Sir Roland.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0003.text:
Please end the conversation quickly, 
the Saintess must rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0005.text:
Haha... 
But I suppose it's time to get to the point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0006.text: I heard from Sera what happened in the Tower of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0007.text:
I do not think it was a sudden whim 
on the part of the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0008.text:
Can you tell me more about what you witnessed 
of the Order of the Goddess in the Tower of Manacar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0010.text:
The Order of the Goddess has been uncovering 
various mystical artifacts under the excuse of assessing their danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0011.text:
The Tower of Manacar was one of them. 
But... it was there that I realized the true intentions of the Order...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0012.text:
... to seize the power of the Apostle 
and wield it for their own motives!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0013.text:
After my realization I returned at once 
to alert Saintess Maria of the danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0014.text:
But Saintess Maria... 
Sometimes I only marvel at her selflessness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0015.text:
Oh, Roland. Elandia is the holy land blessed by Goddess Elanuma. 
I couldn't simply let the darkness be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0016.text:
Saintess... I warned you in the hopes 
that you would seek safety, not put yourself in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0017.text:
You worry too much, Roland. 
Well, I'm sure you can guess the rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0018.text:
We were attacked by the Order of the White Lion
in the midst of our investigation... We barely escaped and came here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0019.text:
It is a great relief that you are safe. 
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0020.text:
Does this mean you do not know who is behind this scheme,
 to seize the power of the Apostle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0022.text:
Now that I think about it... you are right. 
I was thinking only of the Order of the Lion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0023.text:
But they are not so powerful as to retain such ambitions. 
They are merely a branch of the Order...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0024.text:
Then are the Order's intentions to seize the power of the Apostle, 
and the defection of the Order of the Lion unrelated?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0025.text:
I am not completely certain... But it bothers me that 
the Order of the Lion acted as if they had someone they could trust...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0026.text:
It seems that there are many mysteries yet to be solved,
even those that are unrelated to the matter of Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0027.text:
We cannot jump to any conclusions just yet. 
We do not have enough information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0029.text:
But the Order of the White Lion is a branch of the Order of the Goddess. 
Chasing after them may reveal important clues to our predicament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0031.text: Huhu... We must work together, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_EP7_ST_8_1_0032.text:
Saintess Maria. Let us return to your quarters, you need your rest. 
Farewell, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_PVP_3_1.text:
Eccoti qui,  {PLAYER_NAME}. Uh?
Oh, questo foglietto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_PVP_3_2.text:
Lednas è venuta qui per assistere ai combattimenti
al Colosseo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_PVP_3_3.text:
E mi ha dato questo biglietto.
Ah, ma non è un biglietto!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_PVP_3_6.text:
Chi sarà il vincitore di questa settimana?
Chi indovina vince un premio!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_1_2.text:
Al momento non mi va di parlare...
Vorrei stare da sola, ti prego di andartene...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_1_4.text:
Che ci fai ancora qui?
Su, vai via.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_10.text:
Ma non potevo odiare Sylunis. Per cui odiavo le dee
che l'avevano cambiata...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_3.text:
Sai come ci si sente a essere
soli al mondo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_4.text:
Ho sempre vissuto con Sylunis, noi
due sole. Facevamo tutto insieme.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_5.text:
Era dura, ma... non ce ne rendevamo conto.
Ci bastava stare insieme...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_6.text:
Poi un giorno Sylunis ha detto di essere stata
scelta per succedere a una dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_7.text:
Era felice perché, se fosse diventata una
dea, non avremmo più dovuto lottare, ma...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_2_8.text:
Una volta diventata dea, pian piano
Sylunis è cambiata. Non abbiamo più trascorso del tempo insieme...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_1.text:
Dopo la guerra, le dee mi dissero che Sylunis era stata
imprigionata... e serviva una nuova dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_2.text:
Avevano preso Sylunis e l'avevano trasformata in una
dea... e ora volevano me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_3.text:
Volevo stare vicino a Sylunis,
così accettai e diventai una dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_4.text:
Decisi di proteggere la Scheggia degli Apostoli.
Sapevo che lei sarebbe tornata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_5.text:
E il mio desiderio si realizzò.
Ma non fu l'incontro che speravo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_3_6.text:
Credevo che fossimo ancora una famiglia, ma...
Temo che fossi l'unica a pensarlo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_10.text:
Uh?
Qualcuno si sta divertendo senza di me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_12.text:
L'ultima volta che è stata in città, non sono riuscito a
vederla perché ero in prigione...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_13.text:
Ah ah ah. Interessante...
Torneresti in prigione per me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_14.text: Voialtri sareste disposti a morire per noi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_16.text: Eh eh, wow! Mi ci potrei abituare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_17.text: Sigh, quei tizi mi fanno impazzire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_18.text:
Se per te va bene, puoi venire nella mia stanza.
Mi sembri l'unica persona normale qui...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_2.text: Chiedo scusa per l'intrusione, dea Aubrey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_5.text:
Questa dea è altera e bellissima.
Oh, ogni dea ha una bellezza diversa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_6.text: Come si può resistere al loro fascino?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_8.text:
Chiedo scusa, dea Aubrey.
Andatevene da qui o vi faccio decapitare!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_4_9.text:
No, vattene tu piuttosto!
Abbiamo il diritto di visita!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_5_2.text:
Avevo già incontrato altri esseri umani,
ma in te c'è qualcosa di diverso.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_5_3.text:
Mi fai sentire... calma e rilassata.
E mi fai venire voglia di parlare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_5_4.text: Ti va se parliamo ancora, qualche volta?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_6_2.text:
La dea del vulcano imprigionò mia
sorella. Bella è succeduta a quella dea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_6_3.text:
Ho percepito un grande potere in lei. Se anch'io acquisissi
lo stesso potere, potrei presentarmi al cospetto di mia sorella?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_7_1.text: Alla fine, non ho avuto notizie di Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_7_2.text:
Credevo che, quando alla fine avessi visto mia sorella...
Ma non sono riuscita a dire nulla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_7_3.text: Eppure non posso e non devo arrendermi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_7_4.text:
La ritroverò...
E quando sarà di nuovo di fronte a me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_8_1.text:
Divine beasts... sounds wonderful.
I had forgotten this feeling...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_8_2.text:
...What's that look on your face?
I was a normal human before I became a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_8_3.text:
I used to love animals...
but I could never play with them due to my leg injury.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_8_4.text:
So every time I became upset,
my sister......

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_001.text:
The incident in Roman...
... was somewhat... odd.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_002.text: However, Aquinas always stayed by my side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_003.text:
I wouldn't had been able to find the relic in the culvert
if it wasn't for Aquinas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_004.text:
Are you curious about happened in the culvert..?
That's...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_005.text:
.... a secret between me and Aquinas.
So I cannot tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISKRAKEN_9_006.text: That is what a true friend is... right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_27_1_0001.text:
...I remember that I once told you...
about what happened between Sylunis and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_27_1_0002.text:
The belief that I would one day see her again...
was the only reason that I continued to live as I did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_27_1_0003.text:
Yet upon meeting Sylunis in the Deep Sea...
we couldn't tell each other what we truly thought and felt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_27_1_0004.text:
I have been regretting it ever since. 
And so I promised myself... that I would never run away from the truth again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_27_1_0005.text: I am very happy... to meet my sister once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0002.text:
A world from which the darkness has retreated... 
For some reason, I can't believe it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0003.text: But Sylunius is really here, by my side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0005.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. 
Thank you. Thank you so much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0006.text:
Had it not been for you 
the world would have still been engulfed in darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0007.text: And Sylunis wouldn't have been able to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_EP7_ST_30_1_0008.text:
For that I thank you. 
... from the bottom of my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SIS_DESERT_EP7_ST_30_1_00.text:
Why, do you ask? Well, it's been only a couple of days 
since I returned from the battlefield!

And I was simply great, if I do say so myself. 
Nobody could doubt that I was a Goddess, when I helped out everyone!
You should have seen me recover my powers...

Oh, yeah! Thanks a lot back there, in Elandia. 
I almost forgot to thank you, seeing as it was such a long time ago.

I dunno what happened afterwards 
but I bet it's an interesting story. Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_BIGRESULT_1.text:
Wow! Hai ottenuto un livello superiore rispetto
a quanto indicato nel libro segreto!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_BIGRESULT_CELINE_1.text:
Great accomplishment! I wonder what led to
this result. It is worth the research!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_LEVELUP_1.text:
L'abilità è salita di livello! Quanto è migliorata?
Fammi sapere quando l'avrai provata!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_LEVELUP_2.text:
L'abilità della pergamena si è evoluta!
Ora puoi apprendere un livello superiore di questa abilità.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_LEVELUP_CELINE_1.text:
Development...! What a wonderful term.
Interesting, experience the strengthened skill.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_LEVELUP_CELINE_2.text:
Upgraded skill has been recorded in the spell book.
How about learning it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_MAXLEVEL_1.text:
Hai raggiunto il livello massimo dell'abilità.
Con un Grande successo, potresti ottenere un livello addirittura superiore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_MAXLEVEL_2.text:
Puoi raggiungere questo livello solo con la pergamena.
Ma magari, con un Grande successo...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_MAXLEVEL_CELINE_1.text:
Skill upgrade had been fully developed!
But still, you must work on great success of skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_MAXLEVEL_CELINE_2.text:
This is the final skill level recorded in the spell book.
But you can develop further through great success!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_RESULT_2.text:
Complimenti per aver acquisito una nuova abilità!
Perché non la collaudi subito?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_RESULT_CELINE_1.text:
You've acquired a new skill. Perfect!
No point criticizing, theoretically.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_RESULT_CELINE_2.text:
Yes, the transfer is compete. It's ordinary.
Hmm... ordinary is not bad at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_UNLOCK_1.text:
Hai sbloccato una nuova abilità.
Vorrei provarla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_UNLOCK_2.text:
Hai trovato una nuova pergamena abilità.
Che tipo di abilità possiede?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_UNLOCK_CELINE_1.text: New knowledge develops human beings, so does new skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_UNLOCK_CELINE_2.text:
Aha! New spell book.
It inspires so much academically.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_WAR_1.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}! Hello there.
Long time no see since the Manacar affair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_WAR_2.text:
The magician in charge of this village is
vacant for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_WAR_3.text:
So I will be filling the position for a while
as a temporary magician.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_WAR_4.text:
I am not sure how long I'll be here,
but my service is open to you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_1.text:
How come... I just wanted power to defend my country...!
How come you are always getting in my way...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_15.text:
I will revive again and again...
As long as depraved souls exist in the world...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_3.text:
It's too soon to relax. Soltar is revived again and again
as long as we are in this fortress!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_4.text: Urgh... If I just had my weapons...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_6.text:
Huff huff... Am I too late?
I... brought the weapon... as soon as possible...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_7.text:
It's alright! Let me seal Soltar now!
All of you step back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0009_8.text:
What... What are you doing...
You cursed wizard..!! Again...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_1.text: About Soltar... It is just so regretful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_10.text: Of course, as long as you are okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_2.text:
It is my bad, my power was too weak.
If I just had my original weapon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_3.text:
However, as we've failed to completely seal Soltar
he will revive again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_4.text:
We should get ready for the next battle. 
The battle won’t end until he falls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_5.text: How long would the fight last for..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_6.text:
Until the chosen one returns,
and sets free the captured souls and Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_7.text:
I guess it's time to say goodbye again.
Thank you all for everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_8.text: We can fight together again someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_0010_9.text:
Sure. It is our common goal 
to defeat the evils in the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0001.text:
The Lord of Souls has hidden his body in the darkness
but he will come back any time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0002.text:
As long as there is rage, sadness, 
and tenacity remaining in this world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0003.text: There is only one way to get rid of the wicked desire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0004.text:
The Dark Knight who hates the world
and the Young Lady of Starlight who lights up his way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0005.text: And the wizard who came back after 100 years of suffering...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0006.text:
If we gather those fragments of affinity...
The story will begin...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HIDDEN_1_0007.text:
...and when they stand in front of the master of time,
