We just wanted to tease Sworden. My husband can become a
little too serious at times. It seems we’ve gone tooo far, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_19.text:
We meant well.
Thank you for guiding me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_02.text:
I came to see if there really is a #magistrate# stationed in the
Taebaek Mountains, carrying out some government operation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_03.text: Would you happen to know anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_05.text:
I understand - you are being chased by him...
May I accompany you on your way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_06.text: There is something I must tell him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_1.text:
Goblins and Ogres are cooperating in order to attack humans.
Please defeat them and protect our people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_10.text:
My spies in the Shadow Rose base have just sent a report.
A high-ranking official of the Order shall be passing this very spot today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_01.text:
Ah, I see. So he finally found the Legendary Berry
to break his curse… I mean, lesson...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_02.text:
… Oh? You found them?
I specifically told him that he had to work for it himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_03.text:
And he left behind a girl named #Lenny# with you?
He still hasn't learnt his lesson!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_04.text:
I should pay him another visit very soon. Hmm... If bunny ears
don't do the trick, what other animal ears would he appreciate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_05.text:
Anyway... You must have spent a long time in Hero Town
indeed to be acquainted with Arjuna.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_06.text:
Oh? Denying any knowledge of him, are we?
Well, if you say so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Did you not say that you came from Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_02.text: There was something I meant to ask you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_03.text: Have you ever met a young man named #Arjuna#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_04.text:
He is quite the eye-catching type,
even without the bunny ears on the top of his head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_05.text: You'd remember him if you've ever seen him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_01.text:
What's all this?
Boo! Where did you find these chicken skewers? They smell delicious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_02.text:
I found a food vendor that was still open.
I remembered you saying that you had a craving for these.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_03.text:
Thank you so much! They look delicious!
Let's share them with the rest of the group. Snack time, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_04.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}. Um, did you see the face of the vendor
from whom we bought the chicken skewers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_06.text:
Erm, never mind.
Thank you for all your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_02.text: Could you do me a small favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_03.text:
Rebecca had been looking forward to the night market.
She was so disappointed to hear that it was closed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_04.text:
I thought that I could buy her some chicken skewers to cheer her up.
There should be at least one food vendor around here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_06.text:
... What? You found one in that alleyway?
Please show me where!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_01.text:
Sob... They're so cruel... Tell me the truth, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Am I really no better than a piece of luggage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_02.text:
Sob... If they don't need me, I'll just run away.
I've done it once; who says I can't do it again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_03.text:
... Huh? Are you sure? They... wanted me out of danger?
That's why they scolded me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_05.text:
You may be right,
especially when I consider Clan Brother's temperament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_06.text:
Fine, fine. I'll trust them one more time.
With any luck, the next time we meet, I'll be a little stronger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_07.text: Thank you for your help. Good luck on the battlefield!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_01.text:
Sigh... It's a relief that you agreed to help me,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_02.text:
Although I had come runnning to the capital in search for
Master and Clan Brother Luhe, I hadn't known what to do after that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_03.text:
Oh, we're not THAT close! Hee hee!
All Ethereals are bound by close ties of mutual trust and respect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_02.text:
… That was too close for comfort.
Was that a real gun back there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_03.text:
‘Diao Chan the Fairest,’ huh… 
She's rumored to be the most beautiful lady in all of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_04.text:
I knew it. The answer to all of the world's problems...
is pure brute strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_05.text:
I'm confident of my own strength, so I have no problems there.
I've had my fists compared to bullets - that's how good I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_06.text:
Okay, I'm going to find Altair, point my Flower of Ten Thousand Roots
at him, tell him that I love him, and demand an answer! Like a real lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_01.text:
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
Can I ask you something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_02.text:
Even by your standards,
I’m not really ‘ladylike,’ am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_03.text:
Oh, you can tell me the truth! I can see you trying to come up
with a lie on the spot. It's true, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_04.text:
Sigh... I was always scolded by my parents for being so
'unruly' all the time... But I was born this way! I can't help it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_05.text: And I never wanted to change who I am, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_06.text:
Buuuut... After meeting my boo, I'm a little scared
that he'll prefer someone more... girly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_08.text: I've made my decision! I'm going to become a 'real' girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_09.text:
I'll become a real lady or die trying!
By my honor as a warrio- I mean, a lady of Chen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_02.text:
My Book seems to have found their parents difficult to approach,
when all they had to do was 'talk' to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_03.text:
They always complain that they do not wish to return yet,
that they want to see more of the outside world before they did...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_04.text: Perhaps it is time to pay a visit to the Abyss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_02.text:
My #Book# tells me… that they sense from you the reaches
of the #Deepest Abyss#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_03.text: Do you too serve the Abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_04.text:
...
You’re… friends with the Deepest Abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_06.text:
I had heard that they were a lonely being... The only 'pure' being
in all of Hasla, in fact, who had reached perfection in their solitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_01.text: Hey, you're the famous {PLAYER_NAME}, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_02.text:
Don't bother to figure out who I am.
I'm not worth the trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_03.text:
Maybe we can meet under better circumstances,
one day. Strictly non-business, of course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_01.text: Ugh... Since when has there been a curfew in the capital?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_02.text: I'm tired enough as it is from my last mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_03.text:
And then it turns out that the idiots from the Army of the Armored Ghosts
never received the secret agents' password. Must I wait until the morning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_04.text:
Huh? What are you doing on the streets at night?
You know what? It doesn't matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_05.text:
Because you can now take me to the Imperial Palace!
Don't worry. I can pay - and generously, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_01.text:
Sigh... Both General Hansheng and General Zilong
don't appreciate me for what I'm worth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_02.text:
They always leave me out of the most important missions!
From their planning to their execution!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_03.text:
They still think I'm the baby of the group!
When I'm clearly not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_04.text:
It's been years since I was appointed a Tiger General! It's
embarrassing to be treated like a kid when you're 30 years old.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_01.text:
Now that we've arrived at the Imperial Palace, it's more than
likely that we'll meet another Tiger General soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_02.text: {PLAYER_NAME}... Let me give you a piece of advice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_03.text:
All the Tiger Generals are a force to be reckoned with,
but Zilong, you should be especially careful of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_04.text:
I personally don't trust that man at all.
I'd even go so far as to say that I outright dislike him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_05.text:
What do you mean, why I hate him?
He just... gets on my nerves, that's all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_04.text: You were almost hit by my fan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_05.text:
So what, want me to call an ambulance?
And you call yourself a Hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_06.text: Huh? What about that stone statue?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_07.text:
Hmm... Something's lodged in it...
... Erm, is that my fan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_08.text:
That's weird...
I wonder what it's doing there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_03.text:
Where did you come from?
It's not easy to meet visitors to the Palace these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_04.text:
Well, it doesn't matter.
Do you have some free time, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_05.text:
I recently choreographed a new dance for the imperial banquet,
and I need an outsider's perspective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_06.text:
Oh, come on. You don't need to be an expert or anything.
And it won't take up too much of your time, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_01.text:
I understand now. He always seems very angry towards me,
so I had not suspected his true feelings:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_02.text:
that he trusts me much more than what he reveals,
and that he felt left out by General Hansheng and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_03.text: Hmm. Thank you; that was helpful information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_04.text:
The next time I talk to Mengqi,
I will try to make the necessary improvements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_05.text:
What are you two talking about?
Having a secret chat now, are we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_06.text: Mengqi. We were discussing our relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_07.text: I apologize for not noticing your discomfort sooner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_08.text:
I promise to suggest to General Hansheng
to include you in our discussions from the very beginning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_09.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}.
We're going to have a little talk now, just between you and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_02.text: I had a question I wished to ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_03.text:
I saw you having a conversation with Mengqi a little while ago.
It seemed that you two were on quite good terms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_04.text:
It has been ten years since I first met Mengqi,
but he still remains quite wary of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_05.text:
You seem to know some secret way
of becoming better friends with him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_01.text:
Oof... Yide would be proud of his son,
if he could see him now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_02.text: I will have to teach him his manners again, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_03.text:
Zhang Bao must learn how to respect his elders,
not attack them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_02.text: Ah, so you are curious about Zhang Bao and Guan Yin Ping’s fathers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_03.text:
What can I say? They were simply the strongest warriors
in the history of the Kingdom of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_04.text:
Their spears fell mountains and cracked open the earth,
and no man could best them in strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_05.text:
Yet they were also the best tacticians in Chen -
both of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_06.text:
His Majesty was especially close to them among the Tiger Generals,
and the three even took an oath of fraternity to become sworn brothers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_07.text:
It was also openly acknowledged that they were the primary reason
Chen was able to occupy the largest territory

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_08.text:
among the three Eastern Kingdoms over the past thirty years.
Everyone agreed on that, at the very least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_09.text:
And when, one day, the two went missing...
Utter confusion ensued.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_10.text:
Where and why had the heroes of Chen disappeared? Rumors spread
that they had become Ethereals and departed for paradise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_11.text: Oh, what I just told you is strictly confidential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_12.text:
Be careful not to let out a slip of your tongue,
or chaos will spread like wildfire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_10_2.text:
...
Surely you have better things to be doing than loitering?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_11.text:
The Shadow Rose are dragging away innocent civilians. Once captured, 
most are never heard from again. We must rescue them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_01.text:
The truth is, I have come a long way
to avenge my family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_02.text:
But now, with the Throne Room before me,
my heart only feels empty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_03.text:
I have dedicated the past few decades of my life
to revenge...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_04.text: The end of everything came near, once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_05.text:
I lost my reason for living
after being intercepted by an anonymous court dancer, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_06.text:
I understand everything, now that I have returned to the Imperial Palace
and am steps away from facing the Emperor again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_07.text:
Back then, I hadn't lost the meaning of my life.
I had gained an opportunity to find a new purpose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_08.text:
... I will return now.
I hope you too understand the value of your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_01.text:
Not this room... Not that one either... Ah!
It's been some time since I came upon another person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_02.text:
Hmm? What do you mean, who am I?
Haha… I don’t believe it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_03.text:
People usually recognize me by my mask. And why should I hide? 
I am the lord of bian lian, the master of masks: Wang Dao!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_04.text:
Still don’t recognize me? Maybe it's time for me to return to the stage.
It doesn’t matter anyway; I’ve already thrown away that old name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_05.text:
I came to the Palace
to request an audience with the Emperor His Majesty...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_06.text:
But I haven't seen a single courtier,
let alone the emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_07.text:
Besides, it feels like I am walking around in circles...
Could you help me find my way back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_01.text:
The Kalard of Oblivion... Lethe.
Her powers were terrifying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_02.text:
That fearful sensation of your memory and experience
being pulled out of your entire being...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_03.text: I never want to experience such sense of loss ever again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_01.text: We've reached the Throne Room at last, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_02.text: What truth awaits us within those gates?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_03.text:
I admit that I feel a little frightened...
It's a good thing you're by my side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_12.text:
So they reveal their true colors at last!
We must stop the Shadow Rose and rescue our people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_13.text:
And in the middle of all this, a demon appears.
Please keep the demon busy while the citizens are being evacuated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_14.text:
A Shadow Rose member that I kidn... I mean, helped last time
mentioned that a cleric of the Order would be passing by today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_14_2.text:
...
Why do you stare at me so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_15.text:
The city is in turmoil with the sudden ambush of the demons and
the Heaven Cavalry's rampage. We must put an end to this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_16.text:
A more powerful demon has appeared.
Please buy us some time while we lead the civilians to safety.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_17.text:
I received a report that the demon we defeated has revived.
We must go back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_18.text:
How strange. I do not remember the Ratmen as being particularly 
belligerent... We must attempt to speak to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_19.text:
We must linger here for the time being...
Let's be careful not to draw the attention of any angry Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_2.text:
Goblins are cutting down trees to create catapults. 
Please stop them and destroy their monstrosities!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_20.text:
I found suspicious tracks around that corner.
It may be one of the Cardinal's pursuers... We must check to be sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_21.text:
That is one large Ratman! Perhaps he has to do something
with the sudden aggression of the Ratmen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_22.text:
Oh, he's a Ratman as I remember them! He may know what we do not.
Let us follow him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_23.text: I, I thought all Ratmen were nice like Rata! But they weren't!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_23_2.text:
Bad, strange Ratmen were the ones bullying the nice Ratmen!
We have to stop them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_24.text:
Sniff, sniff... There are other humans around here, squeak!
If they aren't your friends, we have to catch them, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_25.text:
Hee hee, I just found a really big and cute Ratman!
Someone so snuggly and fluffy couldn't possibly be a bad person, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_26.text:
There is an especially unpleasant henchman under Rudrat, squeak!
Help me stop him from plundering the sewers, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_27.text:
We must stop Rudrat from contaminating the water with the mana waste!
If we don't, the rest of the Ratmen of the sewers will be in danger, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_28.text:
We're in trouble, squeak! It seems Rudrat has dug new paths 
in the sewers! We must go stop him, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_29.text:
Huh? There are forks and knives floating in the air! And an entire
bookshelf bobbing up and down! How can that be possible?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_3.text:
A champion of the Goblins have appeared!
Please defeat him and vanquish the threat of the Forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_30.text:
The demons we saw in the city are here as well. We must slay them
before they escape and start harming civilians.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_31.text:
There has been a stranger infiltrating the Palace.
We must check to see if they work for the Cardinal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_32.text:
The stranger must have been conducting some suspicious experiment.
Another person seems to have escaped with the related documents.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_33.text:
We must go find the origin of the mana pervading the Palace
before it leaks out into the city. Who knows what could happen then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_34.text:
The ground we are about to tread is unknown territory.
Watch your steps - we know not what lies before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_35.text:
My men have reported strange occurrences while sealing the Palace.
I can only guess that the Cardinal... ... No, pay me no mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_35_2.text:
Could you patrol the Palace once more?
I shall compensate you for your trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_4.text:
A botanist who frequented the Forest has gone missing
several days ago. Please help me find the scholar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_5.text:
We discovered the Goblin Chief at the frontlines. 
If we defeat their chief, we could confuse the rest of the Goblins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_6.text:
Oh, no! A new Goblin Chief has appeared!
We must defeat them before they increase their numbers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_7.text:
Impelis, capital of Grancia - how it has thrived in the course of 
a few decades! We could visit and see if it helps recover Ellie's memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_8.text:
The Order of the Shadow Rose are making civilians nervous.
You would be doing me a favor by, ahem, landing them a punch or two.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_9.text:
There is no end to the Shadow Rose's roguery, is there?
You must teach them a lesson about proper behavior in the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_1_01.text: Hello, Captain. I hear that you plan to change your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_1_02.text: What shall we call you from now on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_2_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}... Your new name suits you perfectly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_2_02.text: Let's continue keeping the peace together, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0001.text:
Hmm, I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
These small country towns are sure hard to find.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0002.text:
Hey there, Lady Knight! Is this Hero Town?
Where a captain by the name of {PLAYER_NAME} lives?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0003.text: Yes, it is. And... you are?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0005.text:
An airship pilot...?
I'm afraid you won't find much work around our town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0006.text:
We did have a small airship port built by a wealthy man named Arjuna,
but it fell into disuse some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0007.text: Hee hee, of course I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0008.text: I used to be Arjuna's personal airship pilot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0009.text:
That silly rabbit thought he could simply pull the plug on a decent business 
just because he completed his 'original mission'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0010.text: I was forced out onto the streets overnight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0011.text:
... by my urge to go shopping with my new fortune
that I received as severance pay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0013.text:
But! I soon discovered that while you can never have too much money,
honest work is what makes life worth living.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0014.text: That's why I'm here, {PLAYER_NAME} to make you an offer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0015.text: Won't you lend some labor for my new business?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0016.text: I'll make it worth your while!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0017.text: Orchard...? Do you mean to grow Berries?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0018.text:
Yep! I managed to collect all kinds of magical seeds
on our previous explorations through Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0019.text:
I just need more people as I can't manage the whole farm on my own.
And I heard that you have the most Heroes at hand, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0020.text: I-I'm afraid {PLAYER_NAME} has more, er, important business at hand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0021.text:
Hey, I just saw some of your Heroes loitering around on my way here.
They'll be happier working than doing nothing at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0022.text:
You know what, I'll show you around the Orchard right away.
Maybe this will persuade you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0023.text: Well... She seems a force to be reckoned with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0024.text: Let us at least hear what she has to say {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_2_01.text: For now... it looks like it's gone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_2_02.text:
... Looks like it saw the book being restored and came.
I'm sure it was related to why you were all here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_3_01.text:
Then... this time for sure we'll send you back to 
Orsterra. You'll forget ever being in Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_3_02.text:
It was a short while but it was a pleasure.
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_01.text: I thank thee for thine help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, this is our first and last time 
meeting... but may the Sacred Flame guide you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_03.text:
Ah, even if we'll forget everything from here...
If the fates will have it, I'll see you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_04.text:
As a merchant, I wanted to see the shops here...
What a shame we have to leave just like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_05.text:
I understand where you're coming from Tressa.
Another dimension... that in itself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_06.text: Stop there. Another lecture will start...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_07.text:
... Don't look so sad. We'll listen to all your...
theories or whatever, after we return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_08.text:
I'm grateful for that.
But... won't we forget everything when we return?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_11.text:
Hehe, anyway, thank you.
Farewell, everyone from Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_01.text: They all got back safely right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_02.text:
Yeah. The book, their records, the dimensional rift...
Everything is back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_03.text:
It was supposed to be a quiet day...
I'm tired from running around so much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_05.text:
Hehe. {PLAYER_NAME} and the others
took care of me well so I'm fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_06.text:
That's a relief. Then we should go back and get
some rest ourselves too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_07.text: I agree. It's been so chaotic since the morning...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_08.text:
Rest well everyone.
Good work again, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_6_01.text:
It will be erased from the other side...
But as a record keeper it would be a waste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_6_02.text: Let's see, where should we record this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_1_01.text: ... I don't remember leaving a book here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_01.text:
Wow~ I didn't know there was such a huge library
in this kind of place! So many books...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_02.text: Ah, Prestina! What book is that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_03.text:
Sera, you have to be quiet in the library.
I'll tell you later, so come this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_04.text:
Ah, yes!
I got too excited seeing something like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_05.text:
So, what is it?
Even calling {PLAYER_NAME} here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_06.text: You said it was important so I came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_07.text:
Everyone's here... then, let's get started.
An incident only you all can solve happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_01.text:
To keep it simple, something #otherworldly#
was detected invading Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_02.text:
I don't know the cause... but I think something
caused an enormous twist in the dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_03.text:
If the dimensional rift is left open,
We don't know what will spill over into Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_04.text:
We have to solve this as quickly as possible,
which is why I called you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_05.text:
I thought you would've already sensed some
foreign energy. No?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_01.text:
Ah, I had a headache this morning for some
reason... Maybe it's because of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_02.text:
You idiot, that's probably because you hit your
head on that bookshelf yesterday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_03.text:
But I could sense the foreign energy too.
There was a lot of it coming from the west.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_04.text: I thought I was misreading... but I guess not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_05.text:
So, how can we help?
You called us here because you have a plan right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_01.text:
Here, this book. This is the key.
I found it when I found the dimensional rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_02.text:
Since its contents are from another dimension,
I can't fully tell you what it's about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_03.text:
But I confirmed there are eight #pages# of records
that were torn out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_04.text:
Due to the shock from the rift, they 
scattered throughout Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_05.text: Since you all can detect otherworldly energies...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_06.text:
I'd like you to find the scattered pages with
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_07.text:
If we restore the book, we should be able to close
the dimensional rift and send the intruders back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_01.text:
Finding pages scattered throughout Hasla... Sounds
ridiculous but we're the only ones that can do it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_02.text:
It would be best if we all split up then. I'll head west
towards #downtown Trista#. Anut, what about you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_03.text:
Hmm... the #desert# sounds good to me!
I'll check there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_04.text:
I felt some energy coming from the #forest# area
so I'll check around there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} should check the #Tundra#.
There should definitely be a page there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_7_01.text:
Ah, if {PLAYER_NAME} is headed that way,
I'll go too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_7_03.text:
But if you go with {PLAYER_NAME} it shouldn't
be a problem, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_02.text:
Come back to me once you find #pages#. Oh, also...
The pages might be with otherworldly people too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_03.text:
You should be able to recognize them right away.
They're very different... maybe how they look...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_05.text:
You'll know it when you see them. Anyway, if you
find those people, bring them back with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_10_02.text: You're saying this is not the land of Orsterra?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_10_04.text:
Don't worry too much! If we bring these #pages#
back to Pandora, you'll be able to go back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_01.text:
Eight scattered pages... that means the others
might be wandering around somewhere too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_02.text:
Sera, {PLAYER_NAME}, would it be okay
if I joined you in finding the pages?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_03.text:
If it's to help find my companions...
I cannot stand idly by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_04.text: I would like to help in whatever way I can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_01.text:
We'd love to have you come with us, Ophilia!
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_02.text:
Thank you both!
Then, let's get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_03.text:
Yeah! Let's go find the remaining pages,
{PLAYER_NAME} and Ophilia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_2_01.text:
This is troublesome, how did I lose consciousness
in a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_2_02.text: ...This will not do. I can't remember anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_4_01.text:
I've never seen these characters.
Is it enchanted? In a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_01.text: Are you okay? You're safe now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_03.text:
Ah, I'm Sera! And this is {PLAYER_NAME}.
Are you hurt anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_04.text: I'm okay thanks to you. Thank you for saving me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_01.text:
Ah, I didn't introduce myself. I am Ophilia.
Cleric of the Church of Flamesgrace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_02.text:
Church of Flamesgrace?
Mmm... It's my first time hearing that name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_03.text:
You don't know the Church of Flamesgrace?
... Sorry, could I ask where we are right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_05.text:
It's a pretty dangerous place...
What were you doing here, Ophilia?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_01.text:
Nosgard?
I've never heard of a place like that before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_02.text: Well, I don't know how I woke up in a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_03.text:
I think I just got lost... Could you point me in the
direction of the Frostlands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_04.text:
Frostlands?
Mmm, I've never heard of that place either...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_8_02.text:
Paper?
...Um, are you talking about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_01.text: Ah!! This #page#, where did you find it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_02.text: We came here to look for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_03.text:
It was right next to me when I came to my senses.
As I thought... it's no ordinary piece of paper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_06.text:
Hehe, don't worry about it.
Mmm... so what happened is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_01.text:
You little... who are you calling a kid...!
... No, this isn't the place to be like this... Sigh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_02.text:
Look, this person is my friend from another town.
They just ended up wandering in here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_03.text:
Let's not make this tiring for either side, why not just
let him go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_11_01.text:
This guy, that guy! It's my job to make sure NO ONE
gets in here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_11_02.text: Both of you come with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_01.text: Argh, what do you not get!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_02.text:
Look, let's go quickly.
There's someone looking for you and that page.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_03.text:
Thank you, I owe you one.
But... can I ask what your name is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_04.text: I'm Bella. Who did you say you were earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_06.text: Right, Cyrus. You look lost, so just follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_07.text:
This isn't your world. I'm taking you to someone
who can send you back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_01.text:
I'll explain it to you slowly later, so let's get out of
here firs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_02.text:
Hasla? First time hearing of it. Perhaps...
Another piece of evidence for my theory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_04.text:
I was thinking the buildings here look a little different,
and that guard's appearance was bothering me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_05.text:
The defined shapes of this stone and arch, and these
pillars might look like they're from the Flatlands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_06.text:
The difference in how the bricks are stacked is
pretty clear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_08.text:
Furthermore the varnish on the exterior is also quite
different from that of the Flatlands. Additionally...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_02.text:
... is what I'm saying. To think I came to another
world! My, how astonishing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_03.text:
What a valuable experience! My apologies, but won't
you tell me more about this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_04.text:
The name of this city? What land are we in? What
do you call yourselves? And...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_05.text:
That way! A guard is on the ground!
Arrest the intruders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_06.text: Mm? Looks like colleagues of that guard from earlier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_07.text:
Ugh, we can talk about this all you want later!
For now, run!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_2_01.text:
What a troublesome situation. Where am I?
My memory is hazy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_3_01.text: My my, looks like we have a new riddle here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_3_02.text: Then, we should survey our surroundings first...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_4_01.text:
(A familiar-looking building. At first glance, it
looks like architecture from the Flatlands...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_4_02.text:
(But the materials used to build this, and the
patterns on it... are not the same.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_5_01.text: This is... a page from a book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_6_03.text:
Oh my, my apologies.
I'm Cyrus. A scholar passing by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_6_04.text:
A scholar? Just wandering around here like this,
you got guts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_7_01.text:
Trista? There must be a misunderstanding.
Mmm... Looks like this place isn't the Flatlands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_7_02.text:
Sounds like a buncha excuses to not get caught.
Flatlands? What's that? Give up and come with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_8_01.text: Hmm, I definitely feel one around here somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_9_02.text:
What, who's this child?
Where did you come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_9_03.text:
You a neighborhood kid? Don't get in the
way! We're taking away a criminal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_02.text:
What do you mean where? You're in the middle of
the road. Don't just stay lying down here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_03.text:
Th-that's not what I meant... but is this somewhere
far from the Coastlands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_04.text:
Coastlands?
Oi, you know what that is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_05.text:
Aye? In my 10 years of sailing I've never heard
of that kind of name aye?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_06.text:
Ehhh?!
Then where are we right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_01.text:
(Was I... shipwrecked? What was I doing before
this...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_02.text:
Ughhh, what is this? My memory...
... hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_03.text: Paper? This looks like it was ripped out of a book...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_4_01.text:
Heh, what is this.
Just looking at it gives me a mysterious energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_5_03.text:
What, you guys know each other?
No no, just keep running! We don't have time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_5_04.text:
Why are you being chased?!
Hey! Cyrus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_01.text: Great, looks like we can catch a breather now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_02.text:
Ha... ha... what a surprise...
Please explain what kind of situation this is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_03.text: Ah, my apologies. It's a pretty long story...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_04.text:
Ah, but first, Tressa.
Do you have something like this paper too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_01.text:
Ah! Yeah! I was gonna ask you about it.
It just appeared with me too when I woke up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_02.text:
This piece of paper, is it important?
It looked important so I brought it with me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_03.text:
As expected, you have a good eye for these things.
Indeed, I think this paper... is quite important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_04.text:
Surprisingly, it looks like we were dropped
into another world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_05.text:
And collecting these pages seems to be the
key back home to Orsterra.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_02.text:
Yes. And it looks like it's not just us here, but the
others are also scattered somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_03.text:
W-wait a minute! This story is so nonsensical, I
don't understand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_04.text:
Wait! Are you gonna give another long lecture?
We can't waste time here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_05.text:
Talk while we're moving.
Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_01.text:
... and for these 8 reasons we can conclude that
we ended up in this place called Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_06.text: N-nothing... I was just thinking how you never change...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_07.text:
It hasn't been long since I met you guys... but I think
I can get a feel for what your lives are like...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_01.text: So you're here. That was faster than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_02.text:
Hello, I'm Pandora. And you...
must be Cyrus and Tressa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_03.text:
Relax and rest for a while, since I have a lot of
questions to ask you after.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_01.text:
Oho, that's a welcome idea.
I also have a lot of things to ask about this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_02.text: Yikes... I'm getting outta here before he goes off again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_03.text:
Then, I'll leave them to you.
I'm gonna go look for the other pages!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_04.text: ... Hmm? But the other Goddesses already...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_01.text:
Woah... amazing! Pandora, what's this book?
It's like it goes back hundreds of years!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_02.text:
You wouldn't think of selling it to me would you?
I'll make sure you get your worth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_03.text:
Oooh... there are so many books here.
Let's see now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_04.text:
... Now I know why she ran away.
Hah... I hope {PLAYER_NAME} comes back soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_1_01.text:
The tracks are still here. That means...
It went this way towards these trees.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_2_01.text:
Mm. It's certain. This dry herb...
#It's# without a doubt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_3_03.text:
I'm Prestina. It got quite noisy so I came by...
It's good that you're okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_01.text:
I'm Olberic Eisenberg.
Thank you for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_03.text:
There are a lot of monsters in this forest making it
dangerous. I think it would be best to go to town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_04.text:
Sorry, I cannot do that. I think one of my
companions is also in this forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_05.text:
Companion? Hmm...
Then let's look together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_06.text: Since I came here looking for something too...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_08.text: Well... it might sound weird but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_09.text:
I'm looking for a piece of paper.
A page from a book giving off mysterious energy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_01.text: A page... are you talking about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_02.text: Oh yes! Where did you find it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_03.text:
When I came to my senses, it was floating next to me.
I thought it would be good to take it with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_04.text:
Floating next to you?
Ah, now that I look at you... are you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_01.text:
... An outrageous story.
But if true... it explains a lot of things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_02.text:
Yes. It might be confusing... but if we can collect all
the pages, you should be able to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_03.text:
Then let us hurry.
There are tracks this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_04.text: Weird. I felt something this way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_05.text:
The other Goddesses said they already found one or
two pages each, but why can't I find anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_06.text:
... Eh, why worry! Let's check one more time and go
somewhere else if it's not here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_2_01.text:
Ahh!
Who said you could just appear like that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_3_01.text:
Veil of the dark night,
fend off disaster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_4_01.text: Are you okay? It's good I wasn't too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_4_02.text:
Oof~ I owe you one!
S-so... uh... your name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_4_03.text:
Primrose. I was wandering lost... then I heard this
commotion and rushed over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_4_04.text:
Thanks, Primrose! I'm Anut. But why were you 
wandering around in the middle of the desert?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_01.text:
Well... I just opened my eyes and somehow ended
up here. I don't remember how.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_02.text:
I was making my way to town. I'm glad I
bumped into you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_03.text:
Hehe, I see! Where do you have to go?
I can show you the way to return the favor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_04.text:
Oh my. Really? I would be so grateful.
Do you know the way to... Noblecourt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_05.text:
Noblecourt? I've never heard of that place before...
... Huh. Could you be...?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_5_07.text:
H-hey, Primrose! Don't you maybe have this piece of
paper with a mysterious light surrounding it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_7_01.text:
Yikes, looks like it's not the best time or place to
explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_7_02.text:
I agree. I have a lot of questions...
But let's get out of here first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_10_01.text:
You're right! I felt like I was missing something...
But who's the person next to you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_10_02.text: She's the person who will help us get out of here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_10_03.text:
Nice to meet you. I'm Prestina.
Olberic, is this the person you were looking for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_11_02.text: Then this will be easy to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_12_02.text:
Yes, but if you think about it, it makes sense.
Alfyn, you have a page too, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_12_03.text:
Well yes...
But I can't read a single thing on it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_12_04.text:
That should be enough.
Then... let us return to the library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_12_05.text:
Mmm...
It's hard to just easily trust her but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_12_06.text:
If your lordship decides it is fine, then I'll follow! 
We'll be in your care, Prestina!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_1_01.text:
Ahhh, this is troublesome.
Didn't I already pass this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_2_02.text: Hang in there! The town's just ahead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_3_01.text: Hey! You two, are you okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_4_02.text: I'm no one suspicious. I'm an apothecary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_4_04.text:
Yes. You're hurt, right?
Here, let me see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_5_01.text:
Fortunately it's not fatal.
Hang on, let me get you some first aid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_6_01.text:
There, done.
How is it? Can you move a bit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_01.text: It's true... the pain is gone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_03.text:
Here, I'll give you this, so take care of yourself!
Don't let it get infected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_04.text: Th-thank you. How can I repay this kindness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_05.text:
Kindness? I was just helping someone in need.
Isn't that a given?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_06.text: Take this person carefully with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_7_07.text: Thank you! We'll repay you later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_8_01.text:
Oh right, I forgot to ask where I am.
If I follow them right now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE6_01_9_02.text:
Hm, it looks like your bag was open.
You left a trail of these concoctions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_10_01.text: Oh? Then I'll go with y... and she's gone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_10_02.text: ... Hey. This isn't the time to be zoning out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_10_03.text:
Ugh, when did they gather like this already?
Alright, to the library!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_1_01.text:
... Hmph. What a pain.
What did I get caught up in this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_2_02.text: Good timing. Let's go get some intel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_3_02.text:
They keep coming without any breaks. We can't let
our guard down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_01.text:
Oh, is this someone you know?
You guys do look like you belong in the same world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_02.text: Therion! To think I'd see you here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_03.text:
... is what I should be saying.
What are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_04.text: But Therion, do YOU know why we're here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_06.text:
Same here.
And this person... is here to help us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_07.text:
... Help, huh.
How is she going to help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_4_08.text:
So you're from another world too?
It would be a long explanation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_01.text: You want me to believe that nonsense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_02.text:
I know it sounds impossible!
But if you think about it, it makes sense doesn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_03.text:
Your memories are hazy, you don't know where you
are, and this paper...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_04.text: ... Huh? The page Primrose gave me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_05.text: A-ahh! No! Did I drop it while fighting? What do I do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_5_06.text:
Bella won't stop yapping at me if she finds out I lost
another thing today...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_6_01.text: Haha, Therion. Stop teasing her, why don't you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_7_01.text:
Well, I'm not exactly just playing...
... I just wanted to check with my own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_7_02.text: I-I didn't even notice... when did you take that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_7_03.text:
Hmph, there's no question we're in the same
situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_7_04.text:
Right? It's hard to believe this but...
But it would be good to listen to her for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_8_01.text:
Anut! So here you are.
So, did you find any pa...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_8_02.text: No!! I didn't lose anything, don't worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_9_01.text:
Ah, ahaha... I mean... nothing.
I already found two pages!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_9_02.text: Say hi! This is Therion, and this is Primrose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_9_03.text:
Oh my. Looks like your senses were right?
Everyone's at the library so head back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE7_01_9_04.text: I'm going to go check on {PLAYER_NAME} first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_1_01.text: This...doth not seem a footprint of a living creature...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_1_02.text:
This madeth things harder, but there are human 
footprints here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_1_03.text:
A habitat is not too far awayeth. I should get a better
grasp of the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_2_01.text:
So anyways, have you seen any unique-looking 
people with maybe a special looking piece of paper?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_2_02.text: Ah let's see, I'm in town all day so I can't really say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_2_03.text:
Hmm, weird... I definitely thought someone would be
here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_2_04.text: Unfortunately you might have to look elsewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_4_02.text: I was following tracks of humans... what coincidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_4_03.text:
It must be the guidance of the Sacred Flame.
We were just looking for everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_4_04.text:
Ah, this is Sera and {PLAYER_NAME}.
They helped me get all the way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_4_05.text:
Hello! So... you're H'aanit? Would you happen to
have a #page# with you too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_4_06.text:
Pageth?
Ah, is this what thou be speaking of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_5_02.text:
I woketh up and it was next to me.
I felteth the needen to taketh it with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_5_05.text:
The faster we move the better, so let's explain while
we're going. Would you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_6_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Sera! So you were here.
Huh. These two...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_01.text: Oh? That means we have all eight pages then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_02.text:
Six of them are already waiting at the library.
Of course, with their pages too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_03.text: We just need to head back then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_04.text:
... I do not understanden, but it looketh like matters
are moving quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_05.text:
Woah. Other companions of Ophilia and H'aanit, I
wonder what they're like!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE8_01_7_07.text: I thank thee for thine help. Then, leadeth the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_1_01.text:
Good work everyone. Now that we have eight pages...
We can turn everything back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_1_02.text:
If we restore the memories, and complete the book...
You'll return to your homes, and the rift will close.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_1_03.text: Could you give me the remaining two pages?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_02.text:
To think I forgot such important things...
We definitely...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_03.text:
Hold it. Don't say any more. Bad things could happen
if this dimension learns about whatever it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_04.text: ... Looks like your memories have come back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_05.text:
Yes, but I still don't know how we all ended up in
a place like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_06.text:
It's not that I don't remember... maybe something
just happened somewhere we don't know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_07.text: I was justeth thinking the same thingen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_08.text:
Perhapsen we will findeth the cause once we
returnen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_3_09.text:
Right! Now that we restored the book, can we
go back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_4_01.text:
Yeah, I can slowly feel the interdimensional cracks
and distortions going back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_4_02.text: Soon you all will be able to go ba...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_6_01.text:
My, I kicked you out of Orsterra on purpose,
but to think you'd regain your memories...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_6_02.text:
Even if you return, the result will be the same...
How futile... I will kill you here then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_6_03.text:
No, I can't stop this...!
Everyone, watch out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_6_04.text:
What an unusual power.
This being, what in the world...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE9_01_6_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, please give us your strength
once more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_6_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I have always acknowledged your strength...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_6_002.text:
This, however, is an impressive feat.
Procuring victory amongst the strongest warriors of the continent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_6_003.text:
I too wish I could fight.
Won't you come and duel with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_6_004.text:
Haha, I jest.
... Still, we could do it someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_7_001.text:
Sigh... What drives people to obsess over the Colosseum games?
Especially in these chaotic times...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_7_003.text:
And yet, {PLAYER_NAME},
hearing of your victory and prowess against the other opponents...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_7_004.text:
I felt the blood coursing through my veins as it hasn't for many years.
... Is this passion what people seek at the Colosseum?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_7_005.text:
Haha, I digress. Congratulations once more.
I will look forward to your next performance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_8_002.text:
Truth to be told, I'm not too surprised.
Judging from our last battle, your victory seemed the obvious outcome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_8_003.text:
You were indeed a foe to be reckoned with.
... I almost felt sorry for the other challengers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK1_8_004.text:
Oh, I was only joking.
Well done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_6_001.text:
Well done in the Colosseum.
It was a close match.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_6_002.text:
The lands of Hasla reach far... and the strength of its people
know no bounds. Who ever knew someone could be stronger than you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_6_003.text:
Haha, stop grimacing.
I'll help you train for your next competition - and ensure that you win.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_7_001.text:
I heard of your recent achievement in the Colosseum.
In fact, everyone seemed intent on telling me, regardless of my will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_7_002.text: Why do people obsess over such horseplay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_7_003.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Is my acknowledgement of your strength not enough?
Do you not think the war at hand is more worthy of your time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_7_004.text:
Do not trouble yourself with the results,
and prepare for the oncoming battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_8_001.text:
Hmm. I watched your game.
You were humble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_8_002.text:
Were you holding yourself back?
Your opponents were ordinary human beings...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_PVP_RANK2_8_003.text:
Well, I know from experience what you're capable of.
Huhu, I hope to witness your full potential again, someday - as a friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0006_2.text:
We shall go deeper into the forest this time.
Remember what I told you last time, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0006_3.text: You should make the best of preparations for this battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0007_1.text: I heard that you frequent the forest these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0007_2.text: I have a favor to ask of you, dearie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0007_3.text: I want to research these monsters called Ents!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0007_4.text:
What do you say, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Will you do me a teeny tiny favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0007_5.text: Please collect Ent fragments for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0016_1.text:
The recent rampage of monsters has scared away merchants
from the Empire! I'll be bankrupt if this continues!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0027_1.text:
How are you finding the desert?
It is exotic… but dangerous for all its beauty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0027_2.text:
Why don't you take a look around
and see for yourself what the desert is like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0033_1.text:
The region around the Desert Temples 
are reported to be swarming with monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0033_2.text:
I fear they are plotting some dangerous scheme
within the temple grounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0033_3.text: We must secure a safe path before we go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0034_1.text:
We have secured a path to the Temple of the Goddess.
Normally it should be protected by Warriors of the Desert, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0034_2.text:
It seems they too have been corrupted by the darkness.
We must defeat them if we wish to enter the Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0046_1.text: We have received a report on the whereabouts of the Head of the Cult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0046_3.text: We must stop the ritual at all costs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0047_1.text:
We have found the Anubisis Temple
fallen under the same darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0047_2.text:
The Guardians of the Temple… have also been corrupted.
They are now attacking any who dare to go near.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0048_1.text:
Our scouts report that the corrupted chiefs
are gathering together with what remains of their sects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0048_2.text:
I received a report that the leaders of the cult have gathered
to start a ritual that will spread the Apostles' power over the entire Desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0048_4.text:
Should they succeed the ritual,
the Desert shall fall under the Apostles' shadow…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0058_3.text:
Hmm... Well, some people could want it...
Sera, for instance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0058_4.text:
But it doesn't make it any less of a crime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0003.text:
Hero Town? Grancia? I've never heard of such places…
Are the others okay…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0004.text:
"Others?"
Do you, by chance, have companions with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0005.text:
That's right.
My friends should be somewhere around here, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0006.text:
Which means…
I need to find them before the Witch Cult does!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0007.text:
Witch Cult? Are you talking about the bandits
that have appeared near the forest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0008.text:
So you met them already, huh. Yep, they're villains, alright.
... I know this is really abrupt, but can I ask for your help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0009.text:
I don't really know what's going on right now.
But I'll tell you everything I know about the Witch Cult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0010.text:
Indeed… we have also been in danger due to this
"Witch Cult."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_2_0011.text:
We accept your offer, Sir Subaru.
We will help you find your companions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_3_0001.text:
Okay! Everything's decided, then!
Let's go and find my friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0001.text:
I have been waiting for you,
believer in love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0003.text: That man seems to be the leader of the Witch Cult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0004.text:
Hmm-? I had thought this was our first meeting...
But perhaps not? Perhaps, perhaps not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0005.text:
Oh, dear!
It seems the situation calls for an introduction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0006.text:
I~ am the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing
Sloth: Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti-!! ☆Death☆⬆

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0007.text:
The Gospel tells me the half-devil we see is around here.
Were you not aware?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0008.text:
Shut up! I'm not letting you anywhere near Emilia!
Get lost, you moron!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0009.text:
Aah, aah! I see, I see! 
You are obstacles, you are obstacles to the Ordeal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_4_0010.text:
Good, good! I will prove my diligence! Come! I will
earn Her love with my diligence! Come fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_1_5_0001.text: Okay, let's go and show him what he's dealing with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_2_1_0001.text: It's the end for you, Petelgeuse!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_2_1_0002.text:
Stupid, stupid, stupid, stupidstupidstupidstupidstupidstupid!!
My body, my body, how could I let it become like thiiiiiiiisss?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_2_2_0001.text: Aah, aaaahhh!! My brain, it trembles, it trembles trembles trembles!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE1_2_4_0001.text:
I cannot forgive you, no forgiveness shall I grant you!
No forgiveness, no forgiveness...! ☆Death☆⬆

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_2_0001.text: Lednas, you see those hands, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_2_0002.text: No, but I can sense some presence around us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_2_0003.text:
You. What did you say?
Just now, you saw my Unseen Hands... Did you not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_2_0004.text:
That will not do, that will not do at all.
It is strange, it is wrong, it is wrong, it is WRONG!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_2_0006.text:
The Authority of Sloth, Her favor bestowed unto ME!
It is MINE! No one else is allowed to see them!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_3_0003.text:
So THAT's the first thing you say?!
I guess that means you're alright. What about the others?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_3_0004.text:
I am afraid I can only say that I do not know.
I found myself in this place when I came to my senses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_3_0005.text:
So everyone was sent here to this world!
We'll have to discuss this more later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_3_0006.text: Just leave this place to us, Ram!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_3_0007.text:
Well, then. I will entrust the situation to your hands.
Do your best, Barusu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_1_4_0001.text: Great! Then let's clean up some enemies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_2_1_0001.text: Hey there, Gramps, are you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_2_2_0001.text:
Aah, truly, truly, truly, truly...!
You. You are slothful, no?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE2_2_3_0001.text:
Aah… my brain!
It trembles, it trembles, it tremblessss!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE3_1_1_0002.text:
Subaru-kun! Are you alright?
Are you hurt anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE3_1_1_0003.text:
I'm okay, I'm okay. 
Even if I got hurt, you would've healed me, right, Rem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE3_1_1_0004.text:
It makes me happy to hear that, Subaru-kun.
By the way, where are Sister and the others?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE3_1_1_0005.text:
Ram is at the village. The others haven't been found yet...
You too should go back and stay at the village, Rem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE3_1_1_0006.text:
If you say so, Subaru-kun, then I suppose I must.
Please be careful, and return to me safe and sound.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_1_0003.text:
MY BRAIN IS TREMBLING -
trembling, trembling, trembling...!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0001.text:
Bea-ko! You're safe!
What a relief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0002.text: Do NOT call me by that infantile name so loudly, I suppose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0003.text:
... Did you come alone?
So the others were not with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0004.text:
Ram and Rem are back in the village,
but... Emilia is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0005.text:
I'll go and find Emilia, no matter what.
You should go back to the village for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0006.text:
How do you so easily assume that you will receive
the aid of your two new friends, I suppose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_2_0007.text:
Yet your words ring with truth,
in this particular situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_1_3_0001.text: Wait for me a little longer, Emilia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_1_0002.text: Great! Now I need to go and find Emilia -...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_2_0001.text:
What is the matter, Sir Subaru?
Is it your injuries, or -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_2_0002.text:
D-don't come near me!
Stay away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_2_0003.text: Or so I would say, but it seems it's too late~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_3_0002.text:
Yes... 
I am the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_4_0001.text:
Aah - so we join together, together, together!!
It's a very, very, very, very fine body - indeed!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_4_0002.text: Sir Subaru! Come to your senses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_4_0003.text: No use, no use, no - u-s-e!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE4_2_4_0004.text:
This body is already a 'finger,'
under my command and consciousness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_10_0001.text: Why are you so persistent, Petelgeuse?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_10_0002.text:
Unfortunately for you, but my best friends are with me!
Your 'diligence' ends here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_10_0003.text:
Let's go, everyone! 
We're gonna finish him off for good this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_1_0002.text: Great! Now I need to go and find Emilia -...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_2_0001.text:
What is the matter, Sir Subaru?
Is it your injuries, or -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_2_0002.text:
D-don't come near me!
Stay away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_2_0003.text: Or so I would say, but it seems it's too late~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_3_0002.text:
Yes... 
I am the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_4_0001.text:
Aah - so we join together, together, together!!
It's a very, very, very, very fine body - indeed!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_4_0003.text: No use, no use, no - u-s-e!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_4_0004.text:
This body is already a 'finger,'
under my command and consciousness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0002.text:
Yes, but what about you, Subaru?
Are you okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0003.text:
Of course!
This little puppy girl saved me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0005.text:
Don't tease her, Subaru.
Sera saved my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0007.text:
I told them to wait in the village.
We can't risk splitting up again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0008.text:
Then everyone is alright.
You did well, Subaru. Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_1_9_0009.text:
No, no, no, no, no! It can't end like this!
Not yet, not yet, not yet, NOT YET!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_1_0002.text:
This love, this love belongs to me! It surely belongs to ME!!
Why, whywhywhywhywhywhywhywhywhyyyyyyy...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_1_0003.text:
Why, when I am loved by the Witch?
The Witch, the Witch, the Wiiiiiitttcchhhh!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_1_0004.text: This... is.... the end... for... you!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_2_0002.text:
Well done, Subaru.
Thank you for your help, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_2_0003.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas,
thank you for helping me to the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_2_0004.text:
Now, then. Everyone should be waiting for us.
It's about time we go back to the village!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RZ_STAGE5_2_2_0005.text: Yes, let's return home. To where everyone is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0001.text:
That structure is what we think is the "Temple of Illusions."
It was supposedly built 100 years ago, during the Apostles' War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0002.text:
That does go for the other temples around the area as well,
such as the Anubisis Temples, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0003.text:
This Temple is quite special, as it is said to contain records 
of the history of the Lost Kingdom within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0004.text:
But try as we might, we failed to find the entrance.
It was then that Goddess Anut arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0005.text:
I came because I felt a strange rumble at my Sanctuary.
It's the first time I've seen anything like this, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0006.text:
So I sent a letter to ask you and Prestina
if anyone knew anything about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_10_0007.text:
Well, seeing your expressions...
I guess... You guys don't have a clue. Darn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_11_0002.text:
Huh? Yes! I.. I'm okay.
I - I was a little surprised, but -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_11_0003.text:
Look!
Maybe this is the entrance to the Temple!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_12_0001.text: Oh..! How did you find the entrance, Miss Ellie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_12_0002.text: I - I just touched the wall, like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_12_0003.text:
Huh? It didn't react anything like that when I touched it,
and I'm the Goddess of the Desert. Rude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_12_0004.text:
At least we found the entrance.
Why don't we enter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_13_0002.text: It seems as if it is guarding the ruins...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_13_0003.text:
A guardian of an ancient kingdom, how fascinating...!
I wonder what secrets could be hidden here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_13_0004.text:
Lorelei, as much as I understand your fascination,
I do not think it is the time to be so - distracted...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_13_0005.text:
Fight first, talk later! 
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0001.text: How strange. All the evidence points to this very location, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0002.text:
Even the Seeker of the Truth can't find this temple of yours, Osiris.
The Prophecy of the Rosetta Stone must be wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0003.text: Let's give up this temple nonsense and go back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0004.text: Set, will you EVER stop complaining?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0006.text: Are there any other places you suspect, Lorelei?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0007.text: No... It should be here. It's definitely here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_1_0008.text:
My archaeologist senses are tingling!
This is where the Temple of Illusions should be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_2_0002.text:
Yes!
That should be the Temple of Illusions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_3_0002.text: I can't find the entrance anywhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_3_0003.text:
Isn't it time that we go back?
We have been searching these stone walls for hours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_3_0004.text:
The Temple of Illusions is the only clue we have 
to the Lost Kingdom of the Desert. We can't give up now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_4_0002.text:
It's not every day Anut writes a letter.
I only hope it isn't bad news...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0001.text:
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}! Just writing a quick note
to ask you and Prestina for some help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0002.text:
Writing takes too much time, so I'll tell you the details 
when we meet up. Hee hee, see you soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0003.text:
Oh, is that all?
How very Anut-like, haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0004.text:
But for her to send us an actual letter...
It does worry me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0005.text:
I fear I cannot leave due to the situation in Trista.
What to do, what to do...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0006.text:
Oh, I know!
Why don't you take Ellie along with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0007.text:
The journey itself should be experience for her,
and you should be glad to have some company with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_5_0008.text:
It's my first time traveling to the desert!
And I wanted to see Goddess Anut, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_6_0001.text:
You should start for the road at once.
Give Anut my love, as always.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_7_0001.text:
Oho! {PLAYER_NAME}! 
It's been a while. You haven't changed at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_7_0002.text:
Well, neither have I, since I am a Goddess, so...
Don't worry. Hey, what about Prestina? Hasn't she come?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_7_0003.text: Prestina was busy, so I came instead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_7_0004.text: Hmm... I don't remember seeing you before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_7_0006.text:
Aha! You're the child that Prestina talked about! 
You really do bear a lot of resemblance to Sera...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_8_0001.text:
Oh, and as for my reason for calling you all the way here - 
Well, an expert will explain the whole thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0001.text:
Ah, there they come! 
Goddess Anut, are they the ones you talked about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0002.text:
Yep. This is {PLAYER_NAME}, and this is Ellie.
Prestina had some other business of her own, so she couldn't make it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0003.text: Is that so... Well, I suppose it can't be helped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0004.text:
I'm late to introduce myself. 
I am Lorelei, archaeologist and writer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0007.text:
Hmm, but where are the other two?
You know, the two who keep fighting all the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0008.text:
I asked Isis and Set to investigate nearby regions.
There could be more than one temple, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_1_9_0010.text:
Ah, I asked you to come out all the way to the desert
because of this temple that we are investigating.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_1_0003.text:
What, again?!
How many times do we have to stop this thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_2_0002.text:
All these years and you remain blissfully ignorant.
Come here, my child. I shall protect you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_2_0003.text:
N-no! I don't understand what you are, but...
I don't like you! You're - you're not a good person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_3_0001.text:
Oh, you foolish child...
You don't know a thing, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_3_0002.text:
Fear not, my child.
Ignorance is no sin. For I bring salvation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_3_0003.text:
I am what they once called Camilla Banoub,
born to scourge the foolish human race.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_4_0001.text:
What is it saying? I can't understand anything!
It's asking for a fight, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_2_4_0002.text: Be careful! I sense great power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0001.text:
There has been reports of strange incidents
occurring all throughout the continent,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0002.text:
to which leaders of all nations
have called for a meeting to discuss a plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0003.text:
We need all the information we can gather before the summit.
I will be sending an investigation party before long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0004.text:
It would be well for you to lead the party, 
{PLAYER_NAME}, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0005.text:
You will not be useful to anyone
if you keep going without rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0006.text: Prestina, Ellie, you must leave {PLAYER_NAME} to rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_10_0007.text:
You are right, Goddess Chronos.
Rest well, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_1_0001.text:
Is this body too at its end? 
A shame indeed... I had grown rather fond of it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_1_0002.text:
Then I shall take the strongest of you
as a companion to the underworld...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_3_0002.text:
What love do you have for the humans...?
Foolish, foolish child...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_3_0003.text: Yet you will realize, one day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_3_0004.text:
Their will... the truth...
Humans will... repeat...same...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_4_0001.text:
I STILL don't know what all that meant.
Good riddance it's over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_4_0002.text:
Well... At the very least,
we can properly enter the temple now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_4_0003.text:
Everything still seems a little fishy, but...
I guess you're right. Let's see what's so great about this temple!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_7_0001.text:
Sigh... What a relief.
Do you have any idea how worried  we all were?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_8_0001.text: Oh, Anut and Osiris went to find Set and Isis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_8_0002.text:
Now that you are awake, {PLAYER_NAME},
I suppose it is time to join them. Research awaits!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_8_0003.text:
I'll tell everyone that you're alright.
Until next time, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_9_0001.text:
I heard everything from Ellie and Lorelei.
The 'Temple of Illusions,' was it...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_9_0003.text:
There have been reports throughout Hasla
of various unheard occurrences that seemingly have no cause.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_3_9_0004.text:
The sudden appearance of that Temple of Illusions...
could be a part of this as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP1WB_REPEAT_01_0001.text: Please scout the area around the entrance to the Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_10_0001.text:
Greetings, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I am Lakias of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_10_0002.text:
Urgent matters are at bay,
so I fear I must be brief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_10_0003.text:
I am the Chieftain of the last descendants of a Tribe
dedicated to protecting the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_10_0004.text:
Nay, I am wrong.
No longer am I a Chieftain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_10_0005.text:
... For all of my people have crossed over to the noble halls
of King Snorri and the old heroes, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0001.text: For many generations, we, the Tribe of the Winter Wind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0002.text:
had been protecting the Sanctuary. 
Centuries it had been, with the legend of old guiding us:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0003.text:
'...The Guardian of Utgard fell,
and the Great Storm consumed the city.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0004.text:
'Yet came down the Goddess of Light and sealed the
Being of Ice and Snow within these Sacred Grounds,'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0005.text:
'...bestowing the Winter Wind divine power and four
Guardians to guard the Being and prevent tragedy to come.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0001.text:
Hundreds of years have passed since then.
No descendant of my people remains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0002.text:
