It's been some time since I last saw her...
Perhaps that too is part of Cora's scheme...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_40_0001.text:
Brothers and sisters?
Do you mean to say there are more beings like you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_40_0002.text:
Perhaps. There were some... Whether they are alive or dead,
I'm not too sure... Maybe you can find them yourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_40_0003.text:
Now, sleep calls me...
Farewell, small humans... for a little while...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_40_0004.text:
If you are still alive when I wake back up...
then maybe... I'll play along to your needs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_41_0001.text: Haw haw, so he's gone... Leaving me only with this odd laughter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_41_0002.text: Is that it? That was a little anticlimactic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_41_0003.text:
He is not gone.
For Utgard Loki is the land of Nosgard itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_42_0001.text: This... I've seen this flower before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_43_0001.text: ... The bloom of a Frost Drop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_43_0002.text:
The blessing of the earth, that awakens those who have
succumbed to the Cold Dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_44_0001.text:
For hundreds of years, death covered these lands
and no new life was born.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_44_0002.text:
Yet with this single bloom...
Life will return to Elder Edda once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_44_0003.text:
As all stories, even once forgotten,
are always remembered by its descendants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_01_0001.text:
I'm BORED! I want to go on adventures, too!
Adventures full of excitement! Suspense! Action!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_01_0002.text: After the whole adventure with you and Baldie, I realized something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_01_0003.text: I need more hands-on experience to test out my babies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_01_0004.text:
Where are you going for your next adventure?
Roman? Valencia? I've never seen the ocean!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_02_0001.text: Our business at hand is no mere picnic, Raven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_02_0002.text: We may know now that the monsters are Gullveig's illusions,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_02_0003.text: but we still have not discovered where the Kalard has fled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_03_0002.text:
Ahh! What in the world..?! 
Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_03_0003.text:
My name is Lyudmilla, I...
I came in search of Captain {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_03_0005.text: Nope, that's {PLAYER_NAME} right over there - not me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_04_0001.text: Please - you must help me, it's urgent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_04_0002.text:
Urgent you may be, but it would help us considerably
if you explained yourself and your business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_04_0003.text: Sasquatch... has been kidnapped by the Neth Empire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_04_0004.text:
Eh? We met him a few days ago after everything ended -
and he was fine then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_05_0001.text: ... And he got caught on the way back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_06_0002.text:
The Neth Empire is capturing people with magical talent
and secretly using them in human experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_06_0003.text:
If we don't hurry, Sasquatch...
There's no knowing what will happen to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0001.text:
Raven. Did you not just say
that you wanted to go on more adventures?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0002.text:
Ha...Ha... 
Erm, I think I've faced enough armies for a lifetime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0003.text:
You've done it once already,
you'll be even better at it now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0004.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! You and Raven
should go and help Lyudmilla here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0005.text:
I too worry for Sasquatch,
but I must stay and continue to search for Gullveig.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_07_0006.text:
I shall ask Chronos for reinforcements
to help you on your journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_08_0002.text: Well, you should hurry, if you wish to save the young man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_08_0003.text:
Of course. 
Then, Captain {PLAYER_NAME} - this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_08_0004.text:
Well, I guess there's no helping it.
I'm going with you guys!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_09_0002.text:
Humans... Neither naturally good nor evil...
Even without Disciples, they commit such atrocities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ED_09_0003.text:
They're such fascinating creatures.
... Isn't that so, Dionne?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_01_0001.text: ... Thankfully, King Thor His Majesty has recovered his throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_01_0002.text:
Even Odin Snorrison is no match
for His Majesty, the REAL king who overcame the storm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_01_0003.text: Anyway, what exactly happened in the Sanctuary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_01_0004.text:
It's a pity Raven and I were busy with Odin
and couldn't see the spectacle for ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_02_0001.text: Haha... That is a long story.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_02_0002.text: There will be time to tell it later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_02_0003.text:
For the time being,
I'm happy there will be no further conflict.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_02_0004.text: And what has become of Odin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_03_0001.text: His Majesty has no wish to punish his brother, despite his betrayal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_03_0002.text:
Instead of punishment, he has put Odin in charge of
the restoration of Elder Edda, as well as its rule...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_03_0003.text:
... Under the conditions that Wolfgang oversees the
restoration as His Majesty's agent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0001.text:
His Majesty may have been gracious enough,
but I won't be so nice! One wrong move, and he'll be sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0002.text:
... Anyway, that's why His Majesty
couldn't see you off today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0003.text: He was sorry and sent his best regards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0004.text:
That's understandable - 
many things have happened these past few days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0005.text:
And that is why we Guardians have decided
to remain here and help King Thor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0006.text:
With the chains of the Sanctuary gone, we felt that it would
be meaningful to rebuild our home with our own hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0007.text: I too have chosen to remain in Elder Edda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_04_0008.text:
For there must remain someone who can
pass on the truth of the Sacred Being of this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0001.text:
As for Sasquatch... The storm has passed,
but there is still no word from him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0002.text: I fear some trouble may have befallen him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0003.text:
Perhaps he's still in hiding.
He did mention he was being pursued.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0004.text:
Raven has started for Elder Edda before us.
She should receive any news that goes her way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0005.text: Raven? Er, will she be accompanying us to Elder Edda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0006.text:
Haha, yes. If I remember correctly - 
do you have to buy her drinks for the rest of your life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0007.text:
Yes. Dammit, who would have thought the real poacher
had already been captured and imprisoned in Snorri Edda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0008.text: Sigh, I may go bankrupt soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0009.text:
Aren't you exaggerating?
She doesn't seem the type to drink much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0010.text:
You should see for yourself.
You'll doubt your own eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0011.text: Then does everyone have business in Elder Edda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_05_0012.text: Good, then I will accompany you lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0001.text: Hmm? Do you have business in the city?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0002.text:
I received a report from Randgrid that monsters are still
appearing in the area, even after the storm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0003.text: She requested for us to look into the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0004.text:
How odd. After Loki fell back asleep,
the Creatures of Snow should have withdrawn their rage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0005.text:
It is not just the snow creatures. Randgrid reported
attacks from Einherjar soldiers and frozen bodies as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CL_ST1_06_0007.text:
Well, we will look into the matter.
{PLAYER_NAME}, we got more business to take care of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_10_01.text:
The Oracle of Water?
I think I've seen that name on Arart's records.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_10_02.text:
But it said that it was not confirmed
whether that being really exists?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_10_03.text:
I think I heard of it in an old fable.
Something about a water crystal ball or something...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_10_04.text:
No way. The Oracle of Water is a being that
promises the interaction between humans and Habaek.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_10_05.text:
There's now way she has vacated her place
for that long…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_11_02.text:
So you were in Neth, {PLAYER_NAME}...
You are everywhere there's a conflict.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_11_03.text:
Leon? Where have you been for 3 years?
And why are you here now?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_12_02.text: Don't touch me with those dirty hands, usurper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_12_03.text:
What? Who are you calling dirty?! Are you going
to be like this? You don't know who I am?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_13_03.text: I feel a strange energy from him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_13_04.text: I guess we don't have time to talk nonchalantly…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_13_05.text: I'll take care of this, so go find Habaek.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_14_01.text: You think I'll let you go so easily?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_15_02.text:
The Flame of Cora...! This human?
You were not just a normal warrior.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_15_03.text:
Galatea... The native god of Hasla that
the traitor Arart was researching, is it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_15_04.text:
…You got in my way.
You better not think I'll let you die in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_15_05.text: Oh, I would like to see you try.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_16_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!!!
W-we have to go after him...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_17_03.text:
Bella, we should help Galatea
face Warrior Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_19_01.text:
…So it was you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Long time no see. I saw correctly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_19_02.text: Why are you down in a place like this by yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_1_01.text:
There's a grand vision in the flow of time,
so I shall remember all this for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_01.text:
So that happened...
I had no idea...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_02.text:
I'm sorry. Because of my personal reasons...
I wasn't able to help you when you needed it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_03.text: …You must be worried about Bella and the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_04.text:
But {PLAYER_NAME}. If what you told me is true,
we have no time to be in sorrow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_05.text:
We must find that guardian Habaek for
a chance to save the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_06.text:
I've never heard of Habaek or the Sacred Ground
where he's supposedly fallen asleep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_07.text:
But I asked the Shark Warriors
to bring a mermaid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_20_08.text: She should know something about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_21_01.text:
…Oh, it seems like I only asked you about yourself,
but didn't tell you what I did the past 3 years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_21_02.text:
For the past 3 years… I've been looking for traces of
my sister #Sylunis# who has gone missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_21_04.text:
My sister's energy turned into something completely
different for inheriting the remaining power of Goddess Elanuma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_21_05.text:
I was able to find some traces after years of
tracking her down…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_21_06.text:
But I felt a disturbance in the Deep Sea recently,
so I had no other choice but to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_22_01.text: I'm still not sure what the disturbance is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_22_02.text:
It's not like I can know everything
that is going on in the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_22_03.text:
That's why I called a mermaid that might know that
information. The #Elder Sister of the Sea#, Maré.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_22_04.text:
I may be the Goddess of the Sea...
But she's the one protecting the peace of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_22_05.text:
We can ask her about the Oracle of Water
that you must find.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_23_01.text: Aubrey, I'm sorry for making you wait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_23_05.text:
When we went to find the Elder Sister of the Sea,
she had lost her fins and had become human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_23_07.text:
Yes. I'm not sure what happened. And human
guests who had come earlier were by her side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_23_08.text:
She said that her meeting with them was more
important, so she couldn't come to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_23_09.text:
She said to tell you that if it's so urgent,
to come yourself…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_24_02.text:
Yes, a young lady and an old pirate.
The lady had a mysterious aura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_25_01.text:
…I think you are thinking the same thing as
me, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_25_02.text:
It looks like the guest is the Oracle of Water
that you were looking for, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_26_01.text:
…I guess something really is
going on in this sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_26_02.text:
Alright, we'll go see her.
Please take me to the Elder Sister of the Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_26_03.text:
But… how dare a mere mermaid tell you to
come to her yourself...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_26_05.text:
Hmm… Alright.
Come this way, please.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_01.text:
We are almost there. The place where Habaek is
asleep… The #Sacred Ground of the Mythical Sea#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_02.text:
Oh... So it was here.
I passed by here so many times. How didn't I know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_03.text:
Maré, wouldn't you dislike it if someone
came into your room when you are sleeping?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_04.text:
It's the same for the Sacred Ground. It's hidden with
Habaek's power to prevent any unwanted guests.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_05.text:
The only one who can find the way and wake him up
is me, the Oracle of Water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_06.text:
Habaek… He disappeared without a word, and had
no idea if he was alive for the past hundred years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_07.text:
And the reason why was because he was hiding
in order to not be awakened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_27_08.text:
While I lost my voice trying to
guard the seas?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_28_01.text:
I'm not sure what is going on, but please calm down.
The air is already so dreary that I'm afraid something might come out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_28_02.text:
Ugh, shut up, old man!
Do you even know what I've been through?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_28_03.text:
…It's all my fault.
I'm really sorry, Maré.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_28_04.text:
I didn't transfer the memory correctly,
so there was no one who could wake Habaek up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_28_05.text:
Err... It's fine.
If you are so sorry, I can't get mad at you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_01.text:
By the way, do you still feel that ominous energy?
It's the Sacred Ground where Habaek is asleep…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_02.text:
…I wish I mistook it, but the closer we are getting to
the Sacred Ground, the stronger that energy is getting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_03.text:
The ominous energy from the oldest of my
memories…We better hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_04.text:
Then why did you bring this old man? You should
have just dropped him somewhere on the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_05.text:
The yacht flipped over, so how could I leave him
there. I heard he helped you before too, Maré?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_07.text: Hahaha! Thank you for saying that, young lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_08.text:
Tsk, how could a pirate be a good man… I'm not
responsible if something happens to the Sacred Ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_29_09.text:
But Maré. You and I...
Are both human now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_01.text:
…One day, a woman named #Lete#
appeared in Impelis and in the Holy City of Elandia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_02.text:
She said that they were the true successors
of Cora…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_03.text:
The forces of the fake goddess, they said they came to
give judgment to you and your Heroes, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_04.text:
At first, no one believed her.
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_05.text:
Lete mentioned Hellad, who was the mastermind of the
Neth War and the revival of El Thalnos, was in Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_06.text:
She also said the corrupted Elard Sylunis was not punished,
and that you are the dark claiming to be the light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_07.text:
And as proof of being the true successor of Cora,
she showed them the #Flame of Cora#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_08.text:
…Because of that, the leaders of Grancia and most
members of the Order have taken Kalard's side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_09.text:
Goddess Chronos and Prestina have been detained
in Impelis,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_2_10.text:
and Emperor Alexander's bounty will soon be
issued all throughout Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_30_01.text:
Aren't you the Shark Warriors from earlier?
I told you I'm busy, so why did you come again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_30_02.text:
I told you to tell that closet crock!
To come find me if she has business with me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_30_03.text:
...
Uh, the one behind you, can't be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_31_01.text:
Ahem, err, sorry about that. Goddess of the Sea,
Aubrey. We meet for the first time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_31_02.text:
Nice to meet you. Elder Sister of the Sea. Maré.
I heard about your legs… Sorry to hear that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_31_03.text:
Tsk, those Sharks acted as though they didn't see
them, but they must have told you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_31_05.text:
I came to ask you about the 'Oracle of Water'.
But… it looks like there is no need to. Is that her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_32_01.text:
Aubrey. I'm still thankful that you purified the mermaids who
were tainted by darkness when the monsters attacked a few years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_32_02.text:
But isn't it the unwritten rule that we
don't trespass each other's domains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_32_03.text:
I hope you are looking for the Oracle of Water
for a wholesome reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_32_04.text:
Don't worry.
I don't have business with her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_01.text:
Wait.
I think I've seen that face before...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_02.text:
Oh, I remember now!
Isn't that {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_04.text:
The most famous person in the continent. You don't
know? Some impersonator of a goddess or the light…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_05.text:
You would be surprised to find out the bounty
that Emperor Alexander of Grancia has announced.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_07.text:
…We've been framed and are being chased right now.
But what is happening right now is not just our problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_08.text:
Oracle of Water.
I heard you are the only one who can talk to Habaek.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_33_09.text:
Please help us. We need his help.
For all of Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_34_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
I feel a mysterious energy from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_34_02.text:
...{PLAYER_NAME} is not a dangerous person.
I can vouch for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_34_03.text:
Maré, put your weapon away.
They are not enemies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_35_02.text:
I'm Haerang, the Oracle of Water.
I serve Habaek, the master of the Mystical Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_35_03.text:
I introduced myself earlier, right? Pass. This old
man is an old pirate passing by. Don't worry about him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_35_04.text:
How can you treat me like this? Don't worry?
I'm White Beard Drake, Admiral of Valencia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_35_05.text:
So what? What do I care about some random ranks
that men created amongst themselves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_35_06.text: Ugh… I should just shut up…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_02.text:
Of course.
I have a lot I want to ask you too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_03.text:
In the one hundred years that I couldn't reincarnate, people
have completely forgotten about the 'Oracle of Water'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_04.text:
Not just their memories,
but all records...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_05.text:
Only the mermaids who live in the Deep Sea far
away from people remembered us, Habaek.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_07.text:
That no one remembers the contract with
a guardian?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_08.text:
I'm sorry... But not even I know about the
guardians and the contract.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_09.text:
I became the Goddess over a hundred years ago...
But I don't have any memories of the time I lived as a human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_10.text:
…According to {PLAYER_NAME}, those fuzzy
memories may also have to do with Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_11.text:
So in order to solve that mystery, we have to get
Habaek's help and fight Kalard, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_12.text:
I… see… I felt an ominous energy near the Sacred
Ground where Habaek is, so I was about to go there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_15.text:
…I did feel a disturbance somewhere in the Deep Sea so
I was about to ask Maré... I guess this is how it is related.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_36_16.text:
We better be careful. It's different from the Apostles,
but I can feel the darkness within this being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_37_02.text: D-did that mermaid from before follow us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_37_03.text:
I thought I lost her! More than that, how did she
get to the Sacred Ground?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_37_05.text:
Alright. You guys go and ask those around to
run away somewhere far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_37_06.text: How could we leave you, Goddess…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_37_07.text:
…From here on, {PLAYER_NAME} and I
might not be able to protect you. Go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_02.text:
Yes… This is the Sacred Ground of the Mythical
Sea. Can you see Habaek sleeping over there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_03.text:
I thought the ground was shining oddly,
so it was Habaek's body, and not just silver sand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_04.text:
…That big thing?
Were you looking for a monster instead of a person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_05.text:
A monster? Habaek is a dragon.
The last dragon of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_06.text:
The last dragon? No way. Don't you know that there
are dragons in the Peaks of Glory of Roman?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_07.text:
You can't even talk to those lizards. They are not
dragons. We should be glad if they don't attack humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_09.text:
Anyway... Haerang!
This energy… It is hers, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_38_10.text:
Yes, it is that mermaid's.
Be careful. She must be nearby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_39_02.text:
T-this energy...?
In the entire Sacred Ground? How!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_39_03.text: …Watch out. Someone is coming from over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_01.text:
We are the dark?
Alexander actually believed that nonsense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_02.text:
The authorities of Grancia were suspicious of all of
you since you fought the Apostle without any compensation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_03.text:
And the Flame of Cora that Lete showed
actually radiated the same power of Cora we had felt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_04.text:
Actually, it felt even more pure.
…It was painful to look at it directly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_05.text: I see. I understand the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_3_06.text:
But Lednas. How can we trust that information?
Aren't you also a knight of Grancia?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_40_01.text:
Oh my, so many visitors to the Deep Sea...
Nice to meet you. I'm Shub. Who are you all?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_40_02.text:
…It's not that one.
Who are you! How did you enter this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_40_03.text:
I was trying to be nice, you know...
You didn't even tell me your name. How rude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_40_04.text: Rude? You think this is your home?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_40_05.text:
It's not my home… But the one I serve is here,
so shouldn't I greet guests as a follower?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_41_01.text:
…This is Habaek's Sacred Ground, and I'm his
Oracle. That's an unpleasant joke.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_41_02.text:
Oh, you are that Oracle of Water? Haha… I heard
you vacated your place for a very long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_41_03.text:
That's how we were born.
Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_41_04.text:
…I don't know what you are talking about,
but please leave the Sacred Ground immediately.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_41_05.text:
Oh, please don't look at me like that. We'll become
family in the end… We should get along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_42_01.text:
Worship the Deepest Darkness! Drive out the
untruthful light, and the true master that will grant us freedom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_42_04.text:
…The dark energy is getting stronger
because of her prayer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_02.text:
No. They fear the dark
so they don't come to the Deep Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_03.text:
And there's more than ten.
Isn't that… a person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_04.text:
Hmm? Right.
Wait, they are looking this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_05.text:
Hey, Tatters. What is going on?
Why are there a bunch of humans in here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_06.text:
Plaga… Why did you come out?
I prayed to Master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_07.text:
You called for nothing,
so I came instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_08.text:
…But the Oracle of Water is here.
If this isn't important, then what is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_09.text:
You overthink too much.
Who cares about the Oracle of Water?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_10.text:
She's just a lowly human.
We better remove her before she makes trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_11.text: …Well. It looks like she's not even willing to listen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_43_12.text:
I'm sorry everyone.
We just met, but it is time to say goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_44_02.text:
Haerang! These bastards… They were talking
nonsense, and they dare to attack first?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_44_03.text: Alright, come at us! We'll pulverize you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_44_04.text:
So energetic. Hm?
You shall be my next host. Look forward to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_44_06.text:
It's the same as the Apostles we faced...
But I can feel a deeper darkness than them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_44_07.text:
If you are captured, you won't just fall into the
darkness, you might lose yourself completely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_4_01.text:
I've helped {PLAYER_NAME} and the
goddesses for years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_4_02.text:
How could those who put their lives on the line to
fight the Apostles be the dark...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_4_04.text:
Even if I have to quit being a knight,
I will prove your innocence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_4_05.text: Lednas… I'm touched that you trust us so much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_5_01.text:
We will soon receive a request for cooperation
from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_5_02.text: You must take refuge before that happens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_5_03.text:
No need for that. Do you think we'll let them take
{PLAYER_NAME}, who has greatly helped us not once, but twice?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_5_04.text: Even if we must go to war with Grancia…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_01.text: Hey, Yuria. Then we've fought all along for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_02.text:
And besides, if an impoverished country like this
goes to war with Grancia, you won't last very long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_04.text:
But what? As long as you're the head of this country,
you can't put your country in danger for personal feelings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_06.text:
According to {PLAYER_NAME}, one of Arart's research projects
included a monster that used the Flame of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_07.text:
If we start a war with Kalard and those creatures are
awakened, everyone in Hasla will be in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_6_08.text:
We are surrounded.
What can we do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_02.text:
Now that the Kalard have shown their true intention,
my brothers are the only ones who can help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_03.text:
Loki and I have lost to Cora, but there are those who
have gone into hiding without losing their powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_04.text: You must go find #Habaek#, who is one of those.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_05.text:
Brother...? Galatea,
there are more beings like yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_06.text:
Yes, besides Loki of Utgard like {PLAYER_NAME}
mentioned, and me, there are two others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_7_07.text:
Excuse me, Commander Yuria.
May I enter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_8_02.text:
An envoy has come from Grancia. It doesn't seem
like a good situation… I think you'll have to meet them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_8_03.text: T-they chased us this far already?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_8_05.text:
The last traces of {PLAYER_NAME} that Impelis has
is that you were headed to Nosgard to help Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_8_06.text:
They probably came to deliver a notice.
But… it definitely is a dangerous situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_9_01.text:
Galatea. Where should we go to find this Habaek
you mentioned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_9_02.text:
He's sleeping in the Sacred Ground of the
#mythical seas#, to the east of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_9_03.text:
I'll open the portal that will lead you to the
Deep Sea near the Sacred Ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_1_9_04.text:
Only the #Oracle of Water# knows the way, so you
should ask the mermaids of the Deep Sea to find her for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_1_01.text:
Ugh... What is that thing?
What is its identity?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_1_02.text: Plaga... You were bragging, and look at you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_1_03.text:
You saw what happened. How strong they are!
Are you... {PLAYER_NAME}?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_1_04.text:
Wow… Even the monsters from the deep sea know
your name, so you must be one amazing fella?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_1_05.text:
Seriously. I almost fought you when I first met you.
I'm glad I didn't...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}… I only heard you from rumors,
so I didn't recognize you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_02.text:
I tried so hard to go undetected by you and the
goddesses, bug I guess it was all in vain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_03.text:
…Shub, was it? It seemed like you know about the
Elards. Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_04.text:
Well… Who am I.
A little girl from a small village who liked reading?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_05.text:
Or maybe someone who obtained the forbidden knowledge to
control a being of darkness and has become its agent to create war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_06.text:
Or maybe a poor puppet who wanted to borrow the
power of demons because she couldn't trust the goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_07.text:
So… you are not human.
Are you dwelling in that book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_08.text: Yes. Plaga and I are in the book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_09.text:
I'm a tool that has wandered the world for a long time,
in order to carry out my mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_10.text:
The end of my mission is right before my eyes.
I can finally return to Master...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_2_11.text: But… but if you decide to stand in the way…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_3_01.text:
I will do what I must
to get rid of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_4_01.text:
H-hey! What are you doing?
Why are you taking my power...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_4_02.text:
It can't be helped, Plaga.
I must do this to deal with {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_4_03.text:
Balrog...
Blame it for not returning on time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_4_04.text: Ugh… Your sibling also didn't answer his summon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_4_05.text:
No! Do you know how I gained that power...
Don't take it from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_5_02.text:
Mwahaha... I can feel the power. It would have been
better if everyone had come together...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_5_04.text:
So you are the magic book that taught Hellad the
forbidden magic… The one that revived El Thalnos?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_5_05.text:
Why did you do that? Do you know how much
sadness was brought unto Hasla because of you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_6_01.text:
If you say it like that,
it sounds as if I did something really bad

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_6_02.text:
I only gave the adequate knowledge
to someone who needed it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_6_03.text:
So what's wrong with taking some power
in exchange?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_6_04.text:
I was just a useful tool...
Tools have no sins, do they?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_7_01.text:
Well, I'm about to get rid of you all on my own will,
so if you do survive, you can blame me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_8_02.text: Oh! So this is the power of the Goddess of the Sea!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_8_03.text:
H-how could a mere Elard
stop Master's power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_8_04.text:
I've been using this power
for over a hundred years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_2_9_01.text:
Alright… We'll teach this tentacle monster
a lesson!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_1_01.text: We barely managed to defeat her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_1_02.text:
Yea. I'm pretty confident in my skills...
But we wouldn't have been able to do it without {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_1_03.text:
I have a lot of questions… What should we do?
We should wait until she wakes up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_1_04.text:
Won't she wake up if we slap her a few times?
Let me try...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_01.text:
Your nightmare has arrived… To the darkness of
the deep sea where no light reaches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_03.text:
You are… the dark being!
So you were the one behind that ominous energy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_04.text:
…I'm Lasirenne. You are as ill-mannered as ever.
Shouldn't we introduce each other first?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_05.text:
What do I care about your name.
It's not like we met in a good way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_06.text: Get lost from this Sacred Ground!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_07.text:
Hmph. It looks like you are puffed up because of
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_08.text:
You lost your fins and lost your powers,
and still dare to raise your voice. How funny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_10.text:
The Elder Sister of the Sea Maré...
Is now standing on unsightly human legs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_11.text:
It's as if I'm looking at my old incompetent self!
Haha… hahahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_12.text:
You wanna die? Want me to beat you up until
you can't laugh anymore? Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_2_13.text:
Eek! I-I'm so sorry!
I dared to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_01.text:
Eek… This is not what you are thinking!
My body is doing it on its own...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_02.text:
On its own... I see.
You never had an actual body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_03.text:
I sense the memories of the previous Oracle of
Water. That energy… I hadn't mistaken it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_04.text:
The one who has walked the Deep Sea of the
mythical seas since ancient times. The Deepest Darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_05.text:
So much time has passed,
and you are still after Habaek's power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_07.text:
Oracle of Water. I haven't seen you for over a hundred
years, so I thought I would never see you again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_3_08.text:
You returned at such an inadequate time
to get in my way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_4_01.text:
By the way...
Elder Sister of the Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_4_02.text: What, why are you calling me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_4_03.text:
This shell's memories and knowledge
were pretty useful...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_4_04.text:
But she got scared enough to 
break away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_5_01.text: I must get rid of the cause.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_5_03.text:
Why are you just standing there!
Move, young lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_6_02.text:
O-old man! You idiot! Why did you do that? I'm
stronger than you, so why would you get hit in my place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_6_03.text:
Ugh... You are probably right… But what kind of
gentleman of the sea would just stand there and watch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_6_05.text:
Ugh... I think I got hit in a bad spot...
My eyes are closing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_6_06.text:
I'm telling you this since it's my last, but...
Maré... I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_7_01.text:
N-no way!
My wound is all gone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_7_03.text:
Alright...
Since you are alive, wanna try finish what you were saying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_7_04.text:
…I don't know what you are talking about.
I'm getting old, so my memory fails me sometimes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_7_05.text:
Ugh, you moron! Just stay behind this Elder Sis
and don't do anything stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_8_01.text:
The power of the Blue Pearl.
How useless...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_3_8_02.text:
Well... It should be entertaining.
Let's see what you got.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_01.text:
Phew… All talk.
That was nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! You really are amazing.
It's like seeing the legendary Hero Oren reincarnated!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_03.text:
Hey, old man! I fought too,
so why don't you say anything to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_04.text: You were just dodging the attacks, weren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_05.text: Just because you got a mouth…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_06.text: Y-you were… b-better than I thought…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_07.text: What are you mumbling about now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_1_08.text:
It's a delightful miscalculation.
So that {PLAYER_NAME}... Hahaha...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_2_02.text:
The energy that had dispersed... Don't tell me,
all the ones we faced earlier are gathering into one...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_02.text:
I knew you would be somewhere out there.
The agent of Goddess #Hasla#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_03.text: I didn't think you would actually come to me first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_04.text:
That's the true form?
…It's just a kid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_06.text:
No way, this energy...
I feel a god-like energy. How in the world…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_07.text:
W-what? I don't get it… But it's some kind of god?
Aubrey, she's the Goddess of the Sea?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_08.text:
It's on another level from me, since I received the
power from Goddess Elanuma to become a goddess…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_09.text:
I didn't feel this kind of despair even when
El Thalnos had resurrected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_10.text:
Who are you?
How come you were at the bottom of the Deep Sea?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_11.text: …I forgot how long I've been like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_12.text:
The one truth I remember is that #Cora# burned down my
hometown, and confined me here at the bottom of the Deep Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_13.text:
…I'm a god that has lost everything, so I'll tell you
the name by which my followers call me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_15.text:
Umrat... Why are you after {PLAYER_NAME}'s
power and Habaek's body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_3_16.text:
How come a powerful being like yourself is trying
to take someone else's power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_4_02.text:
Do you also not remember what #Cora#
has done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_4_03.text:
…? You mean the goddess of the religion
that was created recently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_4_04.text:
Hm... Did you also forget?
Well, that's not what is important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_01.text:
What? A light all of a sudden...
Is everyone okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_02.text:
I-it's so cold!
Where is everyone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_04.text: It's part of what I felt for hundreds of years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_05.text:
Does it hurt? If I had no ego… I wouldn't have
known that darkness, that solitude is painful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_06.text:
But I saw you, the light,
through #Habaek's dreams#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_07.text:
I... Just want to interact with others.
But for that, I need power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_5_08.text:
The power to destroy the untruthful truth
that Cora created!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_6_01.text: I'm not sure what you are thinking…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_6_02.text:
But Cora just sent her
daughters to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_6_03.text:
To stop those like yourself trying to
taint the world with darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_6_04.text:
How pitiful... You were thrown into a
cruel destiny at the cost of that petty power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_6_05.text:
You may not understand now,
but you will thank me in the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_01.text: I-it won't go the way you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_02.text:
Impossible. How… How can a human still move
after feeling my solitude?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_04.text:
For all these years… I have lived a repetitive life
in order to remember the promise with Habaek.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_05.text:
My life was also... A succession of painful events.
So this is nothing...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_06.text:
…I see. But if you are barely withstanding it,
you won't be able to stop me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_7_07.text:
Fortunately... I can help someone
who can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_8_01.text: Why don't you understand it's vain resistance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_4_8_02.text:
The body of a mortal...
Cannot fight back Cora, me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_10_02.text:
Kalard? You mean Cora's minions.
Do you have any ideas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_10_04.text:
It is said that they have been working
to neutralize the ancient guardians.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_10_05.text:
If they knew that the veins of Hasla
and Habaek are linked...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_10_06.text: They must have tried to weaken them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_01.text:
If it's as you say,
it might be true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_03.text:
Hmph. It was probably their scheme to make Hasla
into a land fitting of that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_04.text:
To confine the true master of this land,
and erase the traces of darkness… A prison of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_05.text:
Now that you say that. You said Goddess #Hasla#
or Cora did something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_06.text:
But the only goddesses of Hasla are
Elard and Kalard. The daughters of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_07.text:
Please tell me. What happened from the time
the memories were erased a hundred years ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_08.text:
…I was in the Deep Sea, so I don't exactly
know what happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_09.text:
But from the information my followers gave me,
I could infer one thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_10.text:
That #some Kalard# is erasing the proof of the
wrongdoings of Cora on this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_11.text: And what's the proof that you are not lying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_12.text:
…What if you lied like those Apostles
in order to bring darkness to Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_13.text: Don't compare me to those lowly beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_14.text:
My hometown and village move by different rules.
That's why you feel my power is disparate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_15.text:
If you are so suspicious, try purifying me and my
followers. That's your specialty, Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_16.text: …Alright. Don't blame me if something goes wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_17.text: I-I have a bad feeling about this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_11_18.text:
…Almighty Umrat, please protect me with eternal
darkness. Lead me with glorious wisdom...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_02.text:
I didn't feel any traces of corruption.
You really are different from the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_04.text:
Umrat. Won't you come with us?
Though I can't trust you 100% yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_05.text:
If I talk to my fellow goddesses,
we might be able to find clues about your past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
I have great expectations of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_08.text:
The day you come to fight Cora,
I shall help you by your side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_09.text:
Well, then... Where could we go find out the reason
the veins of the lands have weakened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_11.text:
First, I'm thinking of going to #Han#, which is one of
the three eastern countries close to the mythical seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_12.text:
There, animals who have received supernatural powers from the
energy of the land have settled down as masters of the mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_13.text:
If the lands have weakened, I'm sure the patron
saints of Han are trying to find out the reason why.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_14.text:
So our destination has been decided.
Let's get moving.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_13_15.text:
Umm, before that...
I was curious about something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_14_02.text:
When you first showed yourself,
you looked like a little kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_14_03.text:
If you are going to look like a human,
how about looking a little stronger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_14_04.text:
I do concede many things...
But isn't looking cute better?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_14_05.text:
Makes sense.
Appearance is a skill too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_14_06.text:
I think this is better than having
a macho monster as a companion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_15_01.text:
Hmm… is it?
Am I the strange one?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_15_02.text:
Tsk, tsk... What's the use of just looking young.
You act like an old man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_16_01.text:
Old man... You barely managed to stay alive,
how about you value your life a little more? Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_16_02.text: Were you really curious about something so trivial?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_16_03.text:
Hmph, never mind. Everyone looks stupid now.
Let's get going!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_17_01.text:
Alright. Let's go.
To my home… To meet the sages of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_1_01.text:
How... How could I...
Reach my limit first?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} ...
Don't tell me you are not a pure human...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_2_02.text:
…So you used that to see
his dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_3_02.text:
Umrat, you said you don't actually have an ego...
And came to feel solitude through Habaek's dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_3_03.text:
Since the influence of the scales is gone, you
will now return to be the darkness without an ego.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_3_05.text:
N-no!... I don't want to!
I don't want to go back to the darkness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_4_01.text:
It's just a black lump.
Is that its true identity?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_4_02.text:
Ahhh... My powers... My memories are fading...
I'm going back to the darkness, to be alone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_4_03.text:
No... No!
Please give it back...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_4_04.text:
Ugh... Who's yelling.
I can't sleep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_5_03.text:
Oh, did the brainwashed people wake up?
Hey, how are you feeling?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_5_04.text:
A-ahhhh! E-elder Sister?
Why are you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_04.text:
Don't worry. I'm here, so I won't let those
unfaithful bastards lay a finger on you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_05.text:
Why… are you still following me? The Book of Magic
and the Magic Sword are all normal objects now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_06.text:
I no longer have the knowledge of the Book of Magic,
nor the magic power of darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_07.text:
What are you talking about.
I don't need anything in return for my faith.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_08.text: I will follow your teachings for the rest of my life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_09.text:
W-we've been together all this time.
And since you are the same as Plaga…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_6_11.text:
What is going on... I don't get it.
Hm? Why am I crying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_7_01.text:
…You said you wanted to leave the Deep Sea
to soothe your solitude…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_7_02.text:
But I guess you didn't need to.
Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_7_03.text:
…Yes, it looks like it.
I already had what I had wanted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_7_05.text:
…Umrat. If you promise you won't go after {PLAYER_NAME}
and Habaek... I'll return the scales.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_01.text:
…Are you sure?
I tried to destroy you all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_02.text:
Yes. I don't want you to wander the darkness of the
Deep Sea once again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_04.text:
Now we are talking.
I'll accept you as an honorary follower of our Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_06.text:
Ugh... What are you guys talking about.
Why am I here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_07.text:
Ah, Lasirenne. I'm sorry for leaving you.
Don't worry too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_08.text:
You just don't have any memories of the years
I've been using your body. About… 3 years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_8_09.text: W-what? What did you do to my body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_02.text:
Is there anything I could do to repay you?
I'll help you with anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_03.text:
Though I'm powerless now...
I'll recover in time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_04.text:
Thank you, but we came here to ask
Habaek for help...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_05.text: Hm? Wake up Habaek? What are you talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_06.text:
He's not just asleep.
He is actually unable to wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_08.text:
You didn't know? Habaek is slowly dying.
Though I'm not sure of the reason why...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_09.text:
If it wasn't because of that,
I wouldn't have been able to come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_10.text:
No way.
Habaek rules the veins of this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4WB_5_9_11.text:
The fact that he is unable to wake
means that the veins of the lands are weakening...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_01_02.text: and embraces all light and darkness as one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! Everyone!
I became so worried when your signals broke off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_04.text:
Of course!
We got the evidence AND saved the kidnapped wizards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_05.text:
The bad news is... They've already begun mass-producing
magical engineering weapons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_06.text: Had we gone in by ourselves, they would have demolished us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_07.text:
It's fortunate that {PLAYER_NAME} joined our operation
before we commenced with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_02_08.text:
But isn't that Benjamin, the Chief Research Officer of Rapture Science?
What is he doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_03_01.text: We received his help when escaping from the Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_03_02.text:
We still don't exactly know what's going on...
Which is why he's going to explain the situation for us, starting now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_03_03.text:
Before that, we must take care of the patients!
Commander Yuria, is there a place where they can rest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_04_01.text: The wizards are thankfully not too hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_04_02.text:
They lost a lot of mana, though,
so it'll be some time before they recover consciousness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_04_03.text: I thought I'd lost Sasquatch forever... Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_04_05.text: ... And what exactly did you do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_05_01.text:
Now. Benjamin, did you say your name was?
Why did you help us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_05_02.text:
Hmm. Let me just say...
Your courage opened my eyes to the true meaning of justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_05_06.text:
Elard, and {PLAYER_NAME}.
I've known about you for a very long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_05_07.text:
The hidden players in the last war... I'd thought if anyone sought to clear
the Empire of its darkness, it would have been you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_05_08.text: I helped you because I have a favor to ask of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_01.text:
With Doctor Stein's research, the technology of magical engineering
started, after years of stagnation, to develop at a revolutionary pace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_02.text:
Fascinated by his achievements, the House of Nobles
gave Stein full authority of Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_03.text:
However... While going through the research records,
I discovered something strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_04.text:
The research data Stein used in his experiments
didn't come from Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_05.text:
It wasn't even magic engineering technology,
as developed in the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_06.text:
But only the Neth Empire can do experiments like this
throughout the entire continent, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_07.text: Where could have he acquired the data?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_08.text:
Well... I don't know. What's clear is that an anonymous accomplice
is helping him from the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_09.text:
My request... is to help me uncover
the identity of that accomplice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_10.text:
Doctor Stein's whereabouts are unclear...
A hooded warrior disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_06_11.text: How will we gather any other information if we don't know where he is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_07_01.text:
As I had thought something like this might happen,
I put a tracking device on him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_07_03.text:
Does it matter?
Stein does more terrible things than you can imagine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_07_04.text:
Anyway...
He currently should be at the #Road Industry Headquarters#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_07_05.text: We should be able to gain some information there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_08_01.text:
This is difficult. #Levine Ludovico#, the head of Road Industry,
also leads the Empire's House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_08_02.text:
In other words, you are asking us
to start a full-fledged war against the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_08_03.text:
Commander Yuria... Or rather, temporary Commander.
Haven't you been waiting for the chance to overthrow the House?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_08_04.text:
They are currently directing all their attention to the Second Laboratory.
A chance like this won't come again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_01.text:
Commander Yuria.
I have an urgent report to make.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_03.text:
Private troops belonging to Rapture Science
have taken control of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_04.text:
In addition, some of the imperial troops have been confirmed
to be acting with them. This is a clear act of rebellion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_05.text:
The House of Nobles has started to move.
They will find you, even if they must overturn Edenberg in the process.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_07.text:
...
I see that we had no choice in the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_09_08.text: Viper. Prepare to subdue the rebels.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_10_01.text: I don't like being dragged around from problem to problem like this, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_10_02.text:
For some reason, I have a feeling that 
the recent events in Neth are not irrelevant to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_10_03.text:
The hooded warrior bothers me as well...
Maybe we should go along with what he says.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_01.text:
Good! I knew you would agree,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_02.text:
So, what do we do now?
Do you have any plans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_03.text:
Make a breakthrough through the chaos.
That is the only option available.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_04.text:
My soldiers and I will try to hold back the pursuers as much as possible.
With some luck, you won't be detected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_05.text:
Sigh... I did say I wanted an adventure,
but I'm not too keen on facing another army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_06.text:
I will help {PLAYER_NAME} as well.
After all... I too am responsible for all of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_09.text: The entire city of Edenberg will fall in danger soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_10.text: We need someone to stay and protect the wizards we rescued.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_11_11.text:
I understand you're feeling guilty,
but they are the ones to whom you truly need to atone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_02.text:
Are you sure you'll manage?
There's so few of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_03.text: It'll be easier to move in small numbers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_04.text:
And after all,
all battles will be fought by {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_05.text:
He's not wrong,
but for some reason, he annoys me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Goddess Bella!
Don't worry about us. Be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_07.text:
I swear on my witch's code of honor
to protect the others, no matter what!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_08.text:
I'll go with you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I still have some business with the old geezer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_12_09.text:
If you've finished deciding every petty detail, let's move it.
We don't have enough time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_13_01.text:
Wow. He's so full of himself.
Can we really trust him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_13_02.text:
Well, if he really wanted to harm us,
he wouldn't have saved us in the Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_OP_13_04.text:
Officer Benjamin may not be evil, per se,
but there's not a lot known about his past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_01_02.text:
Yuria's soldiers must be doing their job well.
It'll be an easy job if things continue like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_02_02.text:
We secured... pssh... a safer route.
Follow us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_02_04.text:
Huh? Oh, yes ma'am!
We will guide the way from now on, ma'am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_03_01.text:
You there. You're a fully converted cyborg.
Aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_03_03.text:
Yes. That unusual sound you make when you move your joints.
A characteristic signature found in Doctor Gunther's works.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_03_04.text:
And Doctor Gunther is the head scientist of Road Industry.
Which would mean...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_01.text:
I'm sorry, Commander Spyro!
I didn't expect for us to be discovered like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_02.text:
No... Pssh... It's not your fault... 
No one expects to be discovered like that, from the sounds of your joints...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_03.text:
Officer Benjamin... Pssh...
You are even stranger than the rumors say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_04.text:
Ah, it's nothing, Commander Spyro. The technology is not new to me;
we collaborated on a project some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_05.text:
Wh-what's happening?
I thought they were helping us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_06.text:
They are members of N.D.D., a secret organization of the Empire.
Apparently, they've become the new dogs of the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_07.text:
Anyway...
How did you know we were heading to the Headquarters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_04_08.text: Pssh... I have no reason to tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_05_01.text:
Officer Benjamin...
You should... pssh... give yourselves up to us now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_05_02.text:
This is not the only laboratory... pssh...
that has been conducting such experiments outside your knowledge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_05_03.text:
Pssh...
This is the last chance of mercy... you will receive from us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_05_04.text:
Thank you for the advice.
Then {PLAYER_NAME}, will you do us the honors?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_06_01.text: That guy... The nerve of bossing you around like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_06_02.text:
Is it a meme of some sort?
I noticed the old geezer doing that as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_06_03.text:
Pssh... {PLAYER_NAME}.
Your achievements in the last war have all been recorded in our database.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST1_06_04.text:
Let us measure... pssh...
how much stronger you've become in that time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_01.text:
You've proven your so-called loyalty
to the House of Nobles enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_03.text:
Pssh... I cannot do that.
The life of my cherished subordinate... pssh... is at stake, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_04.text: The cyborg girl by your side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_05.text:
Pssh... Yes. Levine Ludovico possesses
the rights to Spiny's body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_06.text:
That is why... pssh...
I cannot defy her orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_01_07.text:
It is my fault... pssh...
that this child became a cyborg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_02_01.text: You should have said so before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_02_03.text: Pssh... Benjamin! What is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_03_01.text:
I unplugged the control unit.
It was connected to the power reactor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_03_02.text:
What? That was anticlimactic.
Why have we been fighting all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_03_03.text: Oh, it's actually more complicated than it looks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_03_04.text:
If you don't know a lot about technology, it may seem simple,
but it's a very delicate job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_03_05.text: It was just a single wire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_04_01.text:
Now that the problem has been solved...
I don't think we have any more reason to be confronting each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_04_02.text: Can you let us go now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_05_01.text:
R-0?
What are you doing here... No!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST3_06_01.text:
W-wait!
Where are you going all by yourself?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_01.text:
That android... She's on the small side, but she looks powerful.
Who made it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_02.text:
... I designed her, and the idiots at Road Industry
stole my blueprints to construct her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_03.text:
However, my original designs did not intend for her
to be so... advanced.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_04.text:
R-0...
Have you upgraded yourself again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_05.text:
Benjamin. It is good to see you again.
It has been 2987031 seconds since our last encounter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_06.text: I apologize for the delay of 30 seconds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_01.text:
Ugh... R-0...! And even after I received the latest upgrade
to defeat you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_02.text:
Why can't I ever defeat you?
What makes you so special?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_03.text:
V. Why do you obsess over
defeating me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_04.text:
I don't know! When I look at you,
I just get this incredible urge to destroy you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_05.text:
V. Do you not wish to use your passion
to pursue some other meaning in life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_07.text:
... Help? The only help you can give me
is to let yourself be destroyed at my hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_08.text:
I'll demolish you, no matter what it takes!
I must receive the next order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_03_01.text:
Dammit... R-0...
Stop staring at me with pity in your eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_03_02.text:
... I am sorry, V.
Rest well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_01.text: I failed to save her. Again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_03.text:
The CODE-VV that we defeated just now...
is the fourth replica of the original V.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_04.text:
They do not know that their emotions too are mere shadows.
Their blind rage has led them to attack me continuously.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_05.text:
I wanted to help them escape
the confines of their rage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_01.text:
Benjamin. After receiving your advice,
I have been thinking for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_02.text: And yet I could not find the answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_03.text:
We were created for battle.
Then why have we been equipped with emotion modules?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_04.text:
What is the meaning of our suffering?
Is there a true purpose to our being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_06_01.text:
So that was the prototype of the personality chip
the old geezer was talking about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_01.text:
She could have been a good companion, once.
Now - all this depressing talk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_02.text: Fine. I will answer your question.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_03.text:
I destroyed your blueprint.
I had no intention of actually creating you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_04.text:
Do you understand? There is no true 'meaning' to an artificially
constructed personality. Your anguish, your pain... They are all illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_05.text:
So stop wasting the life that has been given you.
Do whatever you wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_09_02.text: Hey, I told you to leave and do whatever you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_09_03.text:
What I want to do is to accompany you.
Is there a problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_01.text:
What a temper... That was rude.
Now, R-0, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_02.text:
I don't know what your story is,
but why do you want to follow us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_03.text: ... I confess I do not know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_04.text:
... The highest possibility is...
His agitation interests me. It is an uncommon state for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_05.text:
Hahaha!
Okay, that was really funny just now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_06.text:
You're right, it's more fun to tease someone
who's not used to being teased.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_07.text:
I like her!
{PLAYER_NAME}, she can come with us, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_11_01.text:
Good, then let's chase after that idiot
before something happens to him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_01_01.text:
There's no one here.
It is safe to come out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_01.text:
So this is the Road Industry Headquarters.
Clean, bright - hmm, the opposite of Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_02.text:
It's thanks to you we got here without much trouble, R-0.
How did you find this hidden path?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_03.text:
Before it was closed down,
the passageway was used for delivering supplies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_04.text:
When my registration code was still R-9999, my sisters and I too 
were first delivered to the place of our mission through that passageway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_05.text: Oh, really? And where are your sisters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_06.text:
All R-9999 models except for myself
have been destroyed after they failed our mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_07.text:
Oh, erm...
I'm so sorry to hear that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_03_01.text:
Sensing unidentified movement.
Something is headed our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_01.text:
Gunther... Isn't that the passageway you built in
so that you could play with your precious dolls?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_02.text:
All that hard work of upgrading our security system - down the drain.
Or rather, down your stupid rabbit hole!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_03.text:
Pant... pant... I-I'm so sorry,
Director Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_04.text:
It's alright. You can do better next time.
Three months of cut wages should teach you a lesson.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_06.text:
Hello, everyone. My name is Levine.
It is such a pleasure to meet all of you! You look much better in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_07.text:
Would you like some tea?
I received a nice batch of oolong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_01.text:
No, thank you.
You seem in good spirits, Levine Ludovico.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_02.text:
Oh, Officer Benjamin, it's you. Does it show?
Of course I'm in good spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_03.text:
Thanks to Yuria so easily taking the bait,
we can truly make her transitional government... transitional.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_04.text:
I can imagine her embarrassment, her despair...
Who'd known the tail of the snake would lead to the head of the dragon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_05.text:
I only regret not seeing the expression
on her usually annoyingly calm face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_06.text:
This confirms my suspicions... You really were the one who
spread the information about the Second Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_07.text:
Does your scenario go something like this? The evil company
Rapture Science, after years of immoral human experiments,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_08.text:
finally rebels against the Empire. Yuria, Commander of the interim
government, is killed in the ensuing chaos... There is no hope to be found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_09.text:
Then amidst the tragedy comes forth the savior of the people: Levine 
Ludovico! Shall I start calling you Commander Levine from now on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_10.text:
Oh, that would be nice. You could also do me another favor
by offering up your lives as the organizers of the rebellion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_11.text:
Our technology is now far more advanced than yours.
We have no use for you now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_12.text: Because you found use in something else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_13.text:
Levine Ludovico.
Surely you haven't gotten your hands on... the #Gates of Heaven#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_06_03.text:
Haha... hahaha...
I've always wondered about your true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_06_04.text:
Here's one more reason to
get rid of you once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_07_01.text:
As we're indoors,
I regret not being able to use my beloved bombs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_07_02.text:
No matter.
I'll make good use of you as my latest test subjects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_01.text:
I see you've been hiding
some crucial information from us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_02.text:
... Let's talk more after
we defeat the enemy before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_03.text:
Sigh... Okay, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's make this quick!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_01.text:
Now that things have finally settled down,
explain everything. Now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_02.text:
I don't know what's going on with you,
but whatever it is, it better be persuasive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_03.text:
Yes. Before that...
I must first reveal my true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_04.text:
I am one of the Kindred,
banished from #Heaven# down to earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_02.text:
No, I am not. A few years ago...
I broke one of Heaven's laws and was banished for all eternity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_03.text:
I've been searching for a way
to return ever since.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_04.text:
After gathering information on the current situation, I predicted that
the hidden mastermind would be related to Heaven in some way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_05.text:
Judging from Levine's reaction just now,
it seems I was correct.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_06.text:
Heaven was a real place?
I thought it was just a thing of legends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_07.text:
You know, the land flowing with milk and honey...
With beautiful winged angels playing harps everywhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_08.text:
... I'm not sure why and how people came up with that image,
but I can most definitely assure you, 'Heaven' is no such paradise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_09.text:
The Kindred... are a race of clones created from a single gene
by the scientist #Arart# decades ago, to use in various experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_10.text:
Heaven is, much like the Second Laboratory of Rapture Science,
a living hell created for her own dark objectives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_01.text:
Wait...
Who did you just say it was?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_02.text:
#Arart#.
It seems the name is familiar to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_03.text:
No... It can't be.
It... must be someone with the same name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_04.text:
The Master Arart I know...
would never do anything like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_05.text:
And... She passed away
decades ago. I buried her myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_01.text:
You... You found records in the Temple of Illusions that
the Goddess of Judgement researched the forbidden magic of the Desert?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_02.text:
But if those records had been written one hundred years ago...
That would have been in the middle of the Apostle's War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_03.text:
Can it be that Master Arart...
really dealt with the forbidden magic...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_04.text:
If we consider the period in which the Kindred were 'created'...
This would mean that she acquired forbidden magic

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_05.text:
from the Temple of Illusions one hundred years ago,
then continued her research on artificial gods in Trista and Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_06.text: An ordinary human would have died in that time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_07.text: Just as I thought... She wasn't at all whom she claimed to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_05_01.text: What do you mean by that, Benjamin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_05_02.text:
Master Arart... She was the spiritual leader of the Elard.
This... this suspicion you have against her - it's literal blasphemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_01.text:
It does not matter whether Arart was truly your old master
or an imposter who simply succeeded her name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_02.text:
I only seek to save 'Mother' from her clutches. 
Even as we speak... 'Mother' suffers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_03.text:
Aren't you the same? If you only seek to defeat the mastermind behind
the Neth experiments, our objective is the same. No use for arguing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_04.text:
If she really is the Arart you know...
Will you be able to forgive her for all her sins? Do you really wish to know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_06.text: Hey now, let's not get all riled up -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_01.text:
Benjamin... The scientist called Arart.
Is she in Heaven right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_02.text: Yes. She was the one who banished me a few years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_03.text:
Then I'll go and judge for myself
whether this scientist of Heaven is the real Master Arart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_04.text:
If this Arart is truly my old master,
it's my duty to stop her myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_02.text:
A created being...
Benjamin, do you mean to say that you are the same as me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_03.text: Yes. I am not trying to make excuses for myself, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_04.text:
The things that I said to you...
They are the same words I continuously repeated to myself in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_05.text:
I believed that the purpose, the meaning of my 'artificial' existence...
only lay in freeing 'Mother.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_06.text: ... As someone who still cannot free himself from that belief...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_07.text:
I would like for you to... find your own meaning of the life
that has been given to you. Discover for yourself what you truly wish for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_01.text:
Ugh... Goddess... {PLAYER_NAME}...
What have you been up to over the past three years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_02.text:
This is out of my calculations...
According to the data, this shouldn't have happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_03.text: Hmm, let's just say - it's the power of reading and adventuring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_04.text: Now, hand over the #Gates of Heaven#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_05.text:
As if I'd ever tell you!
I hid it in a safe place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_01.text:
Found it! Yup, just as I thought.
Important stuff can always be found on the person themselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_03.text: Do you really think I would?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_04.text:
... Detecting approaching heat source.
Stanya, move out of the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_01.text:
Kee kee kee...
All that waiting pays off at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_04.text: So you've been hiding all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_05.text:
I - I wasn't hiding! I've been waiting!
As according to my genius plan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_07.text:
Levine Ludovico. A talented young lady,
but without much backbone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_08.text:
Don't worry. I'll go up to Heaven instead,
and make your dreams come true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_11.text:
Stanya, they are not the heat source I warned you about.
Please be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_05_02.text:
Oh... Oh!! Yes, you detected the danger I'm in
and came to my rescue!
