when we don't know what lies ahead of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_4.text:
This may be our only chance to…
"go through the basics," as people say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_5.text:
Hmm… You do have a point, Rochefort.
I'll be on the lookout while you explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_6.text:
Thank you as always, darling.
Now, let's get this over with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_7.text:
As you already know, the city district of Trista
is already controlled by the Order of the Shadow Rose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_8.text:
They are vigilantly guarding the streets,
and loud noise will alert them of our presence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_9.text:
The smoke grenade that you just used
should help to divert their attention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SHOP_ITEM_1.text:
Your purchase has been delivered directly to your inventory.
Please check your Storage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_001.text:
Thank you so much for stopping this… uh…
Wave… thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_002.text: We brought it into this world anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_003.text:
We could have supported you more if you
asked for help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_004.text:
Let's just say that I like to clean up my 
own messes unlike a certain idiot trio I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_005.text:
So… now what? You're not thinking about 
going back in that Wave thing are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_006.text:
I think we may have to do just that. It's giving off a 
similar energy to the Wave that brought us here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_007.text:
It's kind of sad to see you go, really. You guys
seem like such great people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_008.text:
On the contrary, I don't know where else I will
meet someone who would trust me so readily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_009.text:
Haha, I told you didn't I? 
It was reflected in your eyes. Your kind heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_1_011.text:
It was an honor to have met you.
I wish you and your companions a safe journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_001.text: All done over there, Mr. Naofumi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_002.text: Yeah... it's time to go home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_003.text:
Filo had lots of food and fun here, but…
Filo wants to pull her cart, Master!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_004.text: You're looking a bit... forlorn, Shield Hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_005.text:
Heh… I'd be lying if I said I wasn't, since this 
world treated me far better than ours ever did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_006.text:
Fuee… but we HAVE to go back… 
I have to return to Mr. Itsuki's side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_ENDING_2_007.text:
Yes, let's hurry back.
I have a score to settle with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_1_001.text: Another Wave of Calamity feels imminent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_1_002.text: Mr. Naofumi, you seem more nervous than usual…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_1_003.text: What are you thinking about, master?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_1_004.text: Huh? Oh, nothing. Something just felt off, that's all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_2_002.text:
I hoped I was wrong about this... 
I guess I'm right again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_2_003.text: Master doesn't have to worry! Master has Filo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_3_001.text: Greetings Shield Hero, have you been well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_4_002.text: How… did you all know to show up here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_4_003.text:
I felt a strange energy like that time with the
dragon fragments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_4_004.text: I… thought I might be useful to you... Fuee…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_5_001.text: Hmph, I guess it doesn't hurt to have more allies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_5_002.text:
Everyone get ready.
We have to deal with this Wave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_6_001.text: Mr. Naofumi! Something isn't right here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_6_002.text:
Shield Hero, wait.
This does not feel like any Wave I've experienced.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_6_003.text: I… it's okay, Master! Filo will protect you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_6_004.text: Fueeee..! I should've just stayed by Mr. Itsuki…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_6_005.text:
Damn, why does everything always have to go
wrong? Everyone hold onto something, NOW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_7_002.text:
No way… I went to another world from another
world!? Ugh! Unbelievable!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_7_003.text:
Tch, where is everyone anyway… They better
be alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_7_004.text: I guess I'll start looking by scouting this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_8_001.text:
Oh... oh no… it's happened again… 
You're… not from Hasla are you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_8_002.text:
Hasla, huh? Is that what this place is called? 
Well, I'm Naofumi, from Jap… I mean, Melromarc.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_8_003.text:
Sigh… I don't think I'll ever get used to this
no matter how many times it happens…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_8_004.text: Hey, if it's alright, I may need some assistance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_8_006.text:
This world, "Hasla," was it? Well, I didn't come
here alone, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_9_001.text:
Right. Let's go look for them right away.
We can't abandon someone in need, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_9_002.text:
Huh… well, I won't look a gift filolial in the beak,
but how are you so sure you can trust me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_9_003.text:
Let's just say that I pride myself on being a 
good judge of character. It's in your eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_INTRO_9_005.text: Okay! Let's get a move on, before it gets any later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_1_003.text: I knew Mr. Naofumi would find me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_1_004.text: You're not hurt or anything right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_1_006.text: Is she one of your companions, Naofumi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_1_007.text: That is correct. Here, let me introduce you two.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_1_008.text:
Raphtalia, say hello to Lednas and the
mercenary Captain. They will be helping us out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_2_001.text: Thank you so much for helping us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_2_002.text: I'm just glad that you aren't hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_02_2_004.text:
Oh no, it was nothing. Alright then,
why don't we return for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_1_003.text: Filo knew that Master would find her. Yup!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_1_004.text: You seem to be in good spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_1_006.text: Is she another of your companions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_1_008.text:
Filo, say hi to Lednas and the mercenary
Captain helping us here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_2_002.text: I'm just glad that you aren't hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_03_2_004.text:
Oh no, it was nothing. Alright then,
why don't we return for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_1_004.text: How have you been holding up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_1_006.text: Is she another of your companions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_1_007.text: She's more of an acquaintance… but yes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_1_008.text:
Fitoria, this is Lednas and the mercenary
Captain guiding our journey here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_2_002.text: I'm just glad that you aren't hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_04_2_004.text:
Oh no, it was nothing. Alright then,
why don't we return for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_1_003.text: Fuee… I thought I was left behind again…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_1_006.text: Is she another of your companions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_1_008.text:
Rishia say hello to our guides in this world,
Lednas and the mercenary Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_2_001.text: Fuee… Thank you so much, Miss Lednas...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_2_002.text: I'm just glad that you aren't hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_LIMIT_QUEST_05_2_004.text:
Oh no, it was nothing. Alright then,
why don't we return for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_1_002.text:
Shield Hero, it seems like Waves are occurring 
here as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_1_004.text: Master! Filo will help master stop this Wave!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_2_001.text:
Waves, here?? Hm… no, it doesn't make sense.
I think we're at fault for bringing Waves to this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_2_002.text: Which means it's our responsibility to defeat it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_2_003.text:
Also, since an abnormal Wave brought us here…
I think it might also be our ticket back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_2_004.text:
I feel bad that I dragged all of you into this,
but please help me fight off this Wave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_3_001.text:
You don't have to ask me something like that,
I've said it before. I am your sword.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_3_002.text:
And I am Filo! 
Who will stand by Master's side!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_3_003.text: If it will ensure the safety of this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_3_004.text: Fuee… well, if I can return to Mr. Itsuki's side…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE1_1_4_001.text:
Thanks everyone. Don't anyone get hurt,
you hear me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_001.text: Glass…?! Even you have come to this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_002.text: How serendipitous… maybe we should duel again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_003.text:
I thought you'd say that… But seriously? 
You'd follow us into uncertainty just for that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_004.text:
"Follow," isn't quite right. This is but a coincidence
and I want to conclude our unfinished business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_005.text: Tch, there's REALLY nothing I can say to that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_1_1_006.text: Good, then let us not dally any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_001.text:
Why don't we stop here. Any more and you
might actually get hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_002.text:
I don't need your pity!
Raise your weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_003.text: Is this really necessary? Here and now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_004.text:
I've already told you!
I must defeat you at all cost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_005.text: Why are you SO obsessed with ending me!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_1_006.text:
It is all to save my world from destruction!
What would YOU know about the weight I carry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_2_001.text:
Yeah, well maybe you're right, and I don't know
what that's like, but this…? This ISN'T worth it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_2_002.text: What are you trying to say??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_2_003.text:
I'm saying that you shouldn't pointlessly lose
your life here. Live to fight another day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_2_005.text:
Are you really going to blow your chance to
save your world, here of all places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_001.text: So what then? What do you suggest??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_002.text:
Let's have a truce.
Now isn't the time to fight each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_003.text:
There's no such thing as peace between
you and I. If you keep talking nonsense…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_004.text:
I don't mean for it to last forever. I only want
to postpone our duel until we return to our world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_005.text: Why… are you going out of your way to do this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_006.text: Because I want to return… to where we belong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_007.text:
It's not like you enjoy being here either, right?
I just want to go back first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_010.text: …understood. I will do as you say Naofumi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_011.text:
But make no mistake.
It will only be until we go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SH_STAGE5_2_3_012.text:
Yes, that's right.
Now give it a rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_1.text:
Elise... It's been so long since I've heard that name. 
Here of all places, too... She was once my Master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_10.text:
If we hadn't discovered this temple,
I would never have believed it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_11.text:
But now that you mention it, it's rather strange! I
never actually thought about these things until now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_2.text:
Master Elise taught me everything to know
about being the Goddess of the Desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_3.text:
The best way to sneak into the Forest Sanctuary
and surprise Prestina in the middle of her training...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_4.text: How to annoy Lizardmen from a safe distance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_5.text:
Now that I think about it, most of the stuff she taught
me had nothing to do with becoming a Goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_6.text:
Hmm?
Any mentions of the Desert Kingdom, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_7.text:
Well... that's the weird part. If I HAD heard anything 
about a desert kingdom, you'd think I'd remember it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_8.text:
Even as far back as when I was born, Elise said
there was only ever sand in this desert region.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH1_6_9.text:
You can imagine my confusion when we found that
a Desert Kingdom had existed here for 100 years!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH2_6_1.text:
I did hear... that Ar'rat was the most talented Elard
ever, with both brains AND brawn to back it up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH2_6_2.text:
With her powers, she contributed the most
during the Apostles War one hundred years ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH2_6_3.text:
It's also rumored that, when Sylunis fell into dark-
ness, Ar'rat was the one who stopped her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH2_6_4.text:
She's a real big deal among us Goddesses, you
know? A true role model and all that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH2_6_5.text:
Bella got it good. I bet she's only stronger than me 
cuz she received her training from Ar'rat. Hrrmph.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_2.text:
Hmph. I didn't like her at all.
All proud and hoity-toity and ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_3.text:
The nerve! Calling herself the 'true' heir of Cora and
whatnot in front of me, THE Goddess of the Desert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_4.text: But... I can't help but wonder...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_5.text:
If Goddess Cora really did send the Kalard to kill
us all.... What are we going to do then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_6.text:
...
Haha, I'm sure she was lying! Ha...ha....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_7.text:
And even if I worry about it,
I can't do anything anyway. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDESERT_S2_EP2_CH3_6_8.text:
I'm sure someone smart like you or Chronos
will reveal the truth soon enough. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_1_2.text:
Sigh...
The storm grows stronger with every passing hour.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_1_3.text:
For long years I have roamed
the snowy plains of Nosgard,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_1_4.text: but I have never encountered such a storm until now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_1_5.text:
Was it such a storm, I wonder,
that destroyed the Old Capital of this kingdom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_1_6.text:
If we fail to stop the blizzard,
Nosgard shall suffer great damage, as it did long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_1.text:
In the many legends passed down in the northern lands,
just as many mythical beings appear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_2.text:
Yet not once have I heard of 
'the Being of Ice and Snow.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_3.text:
The tradition of telling stories and remembering legends
is one of great importance for the people of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_4.text:
It is strange that there is not one story about the storm
that put an end to the city of Elder Edda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_5.text: Hmm? How do I know all this, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH1_6_6.text:
Haha, I must confess I learned everything from Lakias.
I never did have the patience for reading.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_1.text:
Long ago, northerners lived dispersed
throughout these lands, in small, divergent tribes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_10.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. You've grown quite cunning
in the time I haven't seen you, haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_2.text:
The barren earth yielded no crop, and they barely survived
the winters by fighting as mercenaries for other countries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_3.text:
One day, a certain mercenary captain
came forth with new ambitions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_4.text:
He roamed the lands, persuading the scattered tribes
to join him, conquering them if the need arose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_5.text:
The captain thus united all the tribes of the north
and led them here, seeking to start a new kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_6.text:
The northerners, brought as one, overcame the raging
storm and built a castle: the start of their kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_7.text:
That captain was the first king of Nosgard,
the Great King Snorri.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_8.text:
Out of respect and gratitude, the people of Nosgard
named the new capital after their king.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_1_9.text:
...
This is the story that I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_1.text:
For generations, Nosgard has been 
ruled by the House of Snorrison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_2.text:
Every sovereign who rose to the throne
was a noble and powerful warrior.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_3.text:
The descendants of Snorrison were loved by their people,
and always succeeded the line with their blessing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_4.text:
... There is one exception, however:
Thor's brother - Odin Snorrison!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_5.text:
He gave up his right, abandoning his place and his kingdom,
and left for the borderlands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_6.text:
I hear he is gathering radicals to his side
to create a sacred land for warriors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_7.text:
Hrrmph. I just know that the souls of our glorious ancestors
will beat their hearts out of rage in the halls of Valhalla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH2_6_8.text: Ah, it's you. Where did you come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_1.text:
The Kalard of Truth, eh?
I see she has taken a grand name for herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_2.text:
In truth they are nothing more than young cowards who
fled from battle with the Apostles a hundred years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_3.text:
What did Jeraphim call herself?
I am curious. The Kalard of Wings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_4.text:
Ha, even if Cora has bestowed upon them her will, 
I do not think we will have to worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_5.text:
For in these lands...
Even in the chaos of darkness and light,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_6.text:
You and the people of Hasla
have fought for truth with honor and pride.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CH3_6_7.text:
Even pearls that roll in the mud
are still pearls, and nothing else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDIONE_S2_EP3_CHALLENGE.text:
Mm~ Kah kah. Is everyone gone? Dionne,
you know how bored I was back there?

After falling into the Rift of Dimensions, we found ourselves 
being crushed by the gravity of the surrounding worlds.

We endured and endured,
and after what seemed to be eons and eons...
We woke up to find ourselves back in Hasla.

At first, we took on the qualities of an Apostle
due to the darkness spread by El Thalnos.

Even after we fell at the hands of that accursed Sylunis,
my consciousness still remained intact in Dionne's body.

We had been fused as one:
two separate minds in one body.
... We decided to coexist, as things are.
Well, I'm perfectly satisfied with the current arrangement.

This power! This beauty! All mine, kah kah kah!
Well, not exactly 'all' mine, but what does it matter?
Kah, if only Destalos and Chaos could see me now!

Trying to keep my temper among all those
serious, borin - agh!

Who's the last surviving Apostle? The winner of the lot?
That would be me, Nemesis!
Mm~ Katkahkahkahkah!

You've had your turn.
Now stay down, Nemesis.

Kah kah, of course, of course~
Your wish is my command, lovely Dionne. Katkahkah!

Sigh... I wish you hadn't needed to see that,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

It was not my intention to mislead you,
but I apologize for keeping this a secret.

I know my sisters think
that they have defeated all the Apostles of Hasla.

It would be... embarrassing, at the very least,
to confess of my current condition.

Do not worry. Even if Nemesis decides to break his pact
and revert to his ways, I will stop him.

Sigh... Please keep this a secret from Chronos,
if no one else.

Ugh... {PLAYER_NAME},
I-I can explain everything.

Resolute as she is,
I fear she will not understand.

Kah kah kah! Oh my, oh my.
I thought that if anyone found out about us, it would be you.

It's been a while, {PLAYER_NAME}.
How long has it been? A hundred years? More?

My mind drifts now and then, so it's difficult
to keep track of the time in the outside world.

Nemesis! Silence!
Give me some time to explain ourselves!

Hrrmph. Look at that face, Dionne.
It seems your precious human friend has already known.

Yes, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I did not die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_01.text:
Long time no see, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Has it been... Three years, I think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_02.text:
For us Goddesses, time flows differently than for humans.
When I stay by myself in my Sanctuary, I lose all track of time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_03.text:
I've been trying to recover Master Arart's records from her library,
so I have to confess I don't remember the last few years passing by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_04.text:
Still, I remembered to send you a few letters now and then...
And for all my efforts, you never bothered to send even a short reply!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_05.text:
... Hrrmph. Well, don't mind me - you explained it to me well enough.
Maybe they were misdelivered somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_06.text:
Anyway, I discovered something important during my research.
It seems that there is a secret ruin of the Ancient Desert Kingdom

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_07.text:
deep in the Desert, south of Trista. It's called "Illusion" something, but
some letters were erased. It might be worth checking out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_08.text:
What! You already found the Temple?
And it's being excavated?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_1_09.text: Ugh... All my time and effort, gone to waste...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_01.text:
What? And you even found Master Arart's journal
in the Temple of Illusions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_02.text: Show it to me at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_04.text:
A forbidden magic? Monster... mutations...?
No, it can't be! Master Arart would never do anything like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_05.text:
I can prove it. For more than a hundred years
she protected her Soulstone fragment in the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_06.text:
Even after I was chosen as her successor,
she never left the Volcano, not even once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_07.text: ... Up to her death, some years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_08.text:
... Anyway. She's innocent. The time periods
during which these records were written don't match up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_09.text:
I don't know who would go so far as to slander Master Arart like this...
But I'll never forgive them for tainting her honor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_2_10.text:
But I swear, after all this trouble in Neth comes to an end,
that person will burn in my flames!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_01.text:
Stanya... She doesn't seem like a bad person,
but she definitely is hot-tempered - to a fault.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_02.text: Sometimes she reminds me of Anut. Well, a smarter version of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_03.text:
How did we meet, you ask?
I'd rather call it a one-sided invasion than a meeting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_04.text:
A couple of months ago, I was cooped up in Master Arart's library
as usual, when the ceiling suddenly gave in and she fell on top of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_05.text:
All the while she was battling a robot
named... Sentry? No, Sentinel, I think she called it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_06.text:
Thanks to all their scuffling about,
my precious research data almost went up in flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_07.text:
Sigh... I should have kicked them out there and then.
But I thought of you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_08.text:
You would have at least heard them out... Or so I told myself.
And that's how I became entangled in this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_09.text:
Afterwards... We wandered around until Celine insisted on joining us.
After arriving in the Neth Empire, we managed to enlist Yuria's help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISDRAGON_S2_EP3_WB_3_10.text:
Who knew the life of a Hero Captain would be so busy and self-sacrificial?
How do you do it, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH1_ST1_.text: It's so nice to see everyone again.

Are you done moving?
How do you find life in Impelis?

It's the greatest! On the way here I saw many things
worthy of research… like those interesting architectural styles…
Heehee, I see a lot of potential customers…

There are so much more people than in Hero Town.
I need to bake a lot more often, in bigger batches!

I only hope to do at least half as well as the great 
Master Schula, the previous owner of this workshop.
I see everyone is getting used to their new stores.

Hero Town, and now Impelis.
It will be difficult to keep two stores open at once.

Thank you for agreeing to move to the capital.
It must have been a difficult decision.

Who else would keep
{PLAYER_NAME}'s weapons in mint condition?

When together with {PLAYER_NAME},
there is always much to research! Of course I followed you!
I can't lose by best customer!

I'll bake you my best bread everyday!
And study new recipes!

(You thank everyone,
hoping for a great new life in the city.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH1_ST3_.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
You're here!

Haha, Mr. Sentry wished to see you so badly
that I couldn't help but introducing him to you.

{PLAYER_NAME}!
I've been your greatest fan since the War of the Holy City!

I've heard that you're a hero of few words,
so it's an honor that I'm talking to you personally!

If it is alright, I have a few questions I've wished to ask you:
How do you normally train in your spare time?

(You answer that you train through duels with other heroes,
or practice sessions at the training grounds.)

Oh…! Thank you for your answer!
Then the next question: what is your favorite weapon?

What is your favorite food?
Would you say you are an early bird or night owl?

Which Goddess do you like the best?
Do you prefer eggs sunny-side-up or over-easy?
And…

Oh, dear.
Are you alright, {PLAYER_NAME}?

What is your motto in life?
How is your romantic life?

What do you think of this beard style?
Should I go after the newest fashion or keep it classy?

Um, Mr. Sentry.
I think this is enou-
Oh, not at all!
I have many more questions…

… Sentry.
I have a message from Lady Joan of Arc.

She warns that if you loiter any longer, she will 
court martial you for absence without leave.
Hrrmpph… That woman is supernatural, I tell you.

{PLAYER_NAME}, it's a pity to leave so quickly…
But there will be other times. Tell me about El Thalnos next time!
See you again!

Haha, you are… 
quite popular, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH1_ST5_.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
What's wrong? You seem rather pale.
(Ellie has gone missing.)

What?
Could it be that she ran away again…!
Let's go search for her at once!
She's not here…
…Nor here…
… It doesn't seem like she's in the city.

Let's go out to the forest, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I'll make preparations as quickly as possible.

Now, my cloak…
Ahh!
Prestina…?

Ellie!
W-why were you hiding in my closet?
I-I… I had a nightmare, and…
… Did you have trouble falling asleep again?

Yes… B-but if I sit in your closet, your clothes feel
as if you're hugging me and…

I..I thought you wouldn't like it if I bothered you.
I was going to stay only for a few minutes, but I.. I fell asleep.
P-please don't be angry…

No, Ellie. I'm not angry at all.
But please don't hide in my closet from now on.

Everyone was very worried about you…
We all thought you had gone missing.
Worried… about me…?

Yes. If you ever have nightmares from now on,
please don't hesitate to wake me up.

I won't be bothered at all.
Actually, I'm even looking forward to our very own slumber party!

…Okay!
Thank you, Prestina!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH2_ST10.text:
Pr-Prestina!
There are people blocking the corridor to your room!
Why are there so many people?!

Oh, they're here again. Haha…
Um… Could you be my… admirers, if that's the word?

Yes!
We're your biggest fans, Prestina!

Your beautiful hair, green as the symbol of the Green Apples…
Your enchanting purple eyes…
I would die for you, Miss Prestina!
Haha, thank you. I'm very grateful.

But… It would be nice if you could refrain from
blocking the corridors, or visiting with no warnings.

I appreciate your intentions,
but I don't think they are as well received by others.

Not well received….
That means that they were bad.
I would not call them exactly "bad," Ellie -

If they are bad people,
then they must be punished.
El-Ellie?

Judgment awaits those who are bad.
I will carry out immediate execution.

E-execution!
I haven't done anything wrong!
And anyway, who are you to…

Surrender, or else.
Obstruction of justice will result in more punishment.

I-I'll be going now,
Miss Prestina.
Me too!

They-they went away!
Did… Did I do well, Prestina?
Well… Um…

{PLAYER_NAME}, we should consider giving Ellie
some lessons on nuance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH2_ST1_.text:
Then, {PLAYER_NAME}, I trust you will do well in Trista.
I shall join you as soon as I finish my own business.

Now, as for Neth…
There are no more revolts, but…

There is still Hellad's demon to think of.
I must take care of it as quickly as possible…

Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}. Summon for me
Victoria, of the Order of Blue Blood, on your way out.
I must discuss with her the knighthood funds.

Ah, Chancellor.
Hahaha, busy as always, I see.

If you know it,
you would be well not to bother me in my work.

Working at that pace
will do no good for anyone in the end.

Come, come. You deserve rest, even as a Goddess.
Will you deny a lonely king his pastime?
Explain yourself.
By my pastime, I mean… this bottle of fine wine!

I have never felt the need nor the desire to drink alcohol,
and I do not intend to start now.

Pish tosh, you know not what you speak of!
Do you not find yourself stressed these days?

In carrying out my duties, I found that a sip from the bottle
now and then helps to clear your mind.
It will help. I give you my word.

… Is that so.
Hm. Then I will take only one sip.
It is not as terrible as I imagined it to be.

Ah, we have a sommelier in the making!
Now, one more sip won't hurt you!
…Mm.

And another bottle!
Cheers, Goddess!

…Wait. Something is not right.
My body feels very… heavy...

…What is this?
Alexander. Is this…poison…?
…Zzz…
Huh. Imagine, a Goddess who cannot hold her drink.

All has turned out for the best, I would like to think.
She needed her rest.

Is that not so, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH3_ST1_.text: (You ask her why she is so downcast.)

I was thinking about the time back in the city district,
when we were accused as demon worshippers…

I…I'm… I'm frustrated. We have been fighting evil 
for such a long time, and yet…

Worshippers of demons, they called us.
I'm… I'm angry at them. Even when I try to understand.

Do you really? Then… I'll be angry, just for one day.
Would that be okay, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Then you have to help me feel better!

First, I want to go try Chocolat's newest cakes.
I hear they're delicious. Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH3_ST2_.text: {PLAYER_NAME}. A letter has arrived from Anut.
Do you want to read it?

Hey! You haven't forgotten about me, have you?
It's a little embarrassing writing a letter to you guys!

How's everyone doing?
How's Hero Town?
I'm doing great here in the Desert.

Suntanning all day long, under the desert sun!
It's like they say: there's really no place like home.

Come to the Desert when you have the time!
We'll go sandbathing together!

Hmm, now that I think about it, it might be too hot for you.
Okay, bad idea. I'll just enjoy this on my own. See you later!

Haha, Anut is the same as ever.
She seems to be quite well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH3_ST3_.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
I received a letter from Bella this time.
Here, I will read it to you.

How-how do you even go about writing letters?
Ugh, it just feels awkward and overly sentimental and -

Anyway, this letter doesn't mean anything.
I simply thought you would appreciate a regular report.

As I told you last time…
I came to read more into Master Ar'rat's records.

There are many stories, including that of a Goddess
of the Ancient Desert, other continents, hidden energies…

Well, it's too much to write in a single letter.
I, gracious as ever, will let you know after I find out more.

Have I mentioned how much I admire Bella?
She is the strongest of us, and yet also very intellectual.
She continues to inspire me to this day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP1_CH4_ST5_.text:
P-Prestina!
{PLAYER_NAME}!
Ellie?
H-help me!
…What's wrong?

I-I'll explain later!
I need to hide first!
Alright, alright. Come here quickly.

Miss Hero! Where are you!
I'm sure I saw her coming in here…
Have you come to look for {PLAYER_NAME}?
Oh, no! I'm looking for Ellie!
Ellie? But Ellie is not a hero.

We heard everything:
Ellie took great part in your most recent adventures!

I heard that she has become a great hero,
the best one after {PLAYER_NAME}.

I wanted her opinion
on how to become a great hero.

… Now, now. Ellie is not here.
I must ask you to leave.

Hmm… Maybe it was trick of the light.
If you see her, please tell her I've been looking for her!

…
Ellie, you can come out now.
Prestina, {PLAYER_NAME}…
Ellie… Can you explain this situation?

I, I was so glad to have become {PLAYER_NAME}'s student,
so I went around telling people…

But then everybody thought me a great hero,
and kept chasing me with questions and requests.

I couldn't say anything, because I thought that if people found out
the truth, they would laugh at {PLAYER_NAME} too.

I see now…
It is alright, Ellie.

You may not be a great hero yet,
but you can always learn from {PLAYER_NAME} to become one.
Isn't that so, {PLAYER_NAME}?

Okay! I'll be the best student
that {PLAYER_NAME} could ever want!

You have done especially well this time,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

I had not expected you to discover
the true mastermind behind the demons.

With such success in our endeavors,
I deem it safe to take some well-deserved R&R.

Chronos! Chronos!
I require your assistance!
What is it?

I made a purchase at the local store,
but it seems I have left my wallet at the palace…

Could you pay the young lady her money?
I will pay you back! Okthankyoubye~!
…What?

Excuse me! Is there a Ms. Chronos here?
That friend of yours hasn't paid for his purchase!

I'll have that money now!
I can't leave the shop for long!
… I see. Wait here.

Your Majesty.
You cannot continue leaving the palace at whim.
Eh, watchful as ever, Joan.

Yet some fresh air is all an old king asks for.
Why don't we stay outside a little longer?
You must return, Your Majesty.

Where is the money?
Can someone, anyone please pay up?

Chronos---!
Help!
The m - o - n - e - y!

…
I cannot tolerate this any longer.

Are you all children?
Are you not ashamed of yourselves?

I will refuse my seat as Chancellor
until further notice, Alexander. Until you act like a king.
C-Chronos…

I give you my deepest apologies in His Majesty's stead,
Lady Chronos.

I want everyone out of my chambers.
No one is allowed in until further notice.
Haha… Well, then! Excuse me!

Humans… 
They never seem to know their place.

What are you doing here, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You are not an exception. Now, out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISFOREST_S2_EP2_CHALLENG.text:
For the past 100 years I have lost many friends...
Yet farewells never seem to be any less painful.

I cannot help but wonder - had I stopped Ellie when
she insisted on following you, {PLAYER_NAME},

To the Temple of Illusions, would Ellie have lived, 
and I, free of this guilt weighing on my soul?

I suppose I will never know. And she would not 
have listened to me, at any rate...

She wanted to learn about herself. Who she was,
where she came from, what she could become…

Haha... Let us not wallow in our guilt, 
{PLAYER_NAME}.

Ellie... only walked the path she chose for herself. 
And in her choice, she was happy.

The Kalard... Jeraphim, did she call herself?
The other 'Goddess' we met in Trista.

It may sound strange... but during our confrontation,
I did not sense anything sinister or evil from her.

I would even venture to say that she felt... Much 
closer to the will of Cora, than us Elard.

I tried to ignore it back then, convincing myself
that I was just confused by the ensuing chaos.

Yet if what she says is true....
Then what could be the 'true' will of Cora...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_01.text:
Did you say it's your first time in the three eastern 
countries, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_02.text: I thought you'd have been everywhere in the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_03.text: You may already know this, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_04.text:
The three eastern countries refer to the continent's 
three easternmost countries: Han, Chen, and Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_05.text:
The three countries are surrounded by the Peaks of Glory
to the northwest, between the Roman Empire and Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_06.text:
And the Primal Volcano to the south. The mountains are 
treacherous, so interaction with others is limited.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_07.text:
A long time ago, Grancia failed to expand its
territory to the east,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_08.text:
and that's why Trista tried so hard to engage in war
through the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_09.text:
…The Sacred Ground was filled with the sound of cannons
back then… I'm glad that has stopped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_10.text:
Anyway, this is why the three countries were able
to develop their own cultures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_1_11.text:
They look very different from the other countries you've
been to in the continent, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_01.text:
The three countries are next to each other, and they've
been isolated from outside, so they are even closer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_02.text:
They may seem similar from the outside, but they
have different cultures and histories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_03.text:
Hm, since it's your first time here, I'll tell you
a little about each country for your journey ahead...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_04.text:
Chen has gone to war with the Roman Empire a few times
for the Peaks of Glory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_05.text:
I guess that's why they have a strong military,
and the army is very structured as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_06.text:
And it's the only country out of the three that calls
their leader an 'emperor'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_07.text:
Ryu is to the south and close to the Primal Volcano, so
it has a sad history related to the Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_08.text:
The priestess that has trained her body and mind
with the Primal Flames is the heart of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_09.text:
From what I heard, Bella probably knows about the
Primal Flames better than you and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_10.text:
This place, Han, has even more treacherous
mountains than Ryu and Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_11.text:
That's why the veins of Hasla that go through the three 
countries seem to have manifested stronger in Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_12.text:
That's why the animals of Han have come to wield
mysterious powers from the energy of the earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_13.text:
These 'patron saints' rule the mountains as beings
that go from animals, humans, and spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_14.text:
Halla is also a patron saint… And you also met
that #rabbit patron saint# in Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_15.text:
The people of Han need the help of patron saints in 
order to survive in the treacherous mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_16.text:
They say that the soften the flow of the veins…?
I'm not sure either.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_17.text:
That's why I read so many books for the past 100 years.
I've also been to many places during my search for my sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_18.text:
… Anyway, I was curious since it was so close to the
Sacred Ground of the Deep Sea that I protected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_19.text:
I wanted to know about the secret of the #mystical sea#,
but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_20.text:
Every time I tried to find out, the #Elder Sister 
of the Sea# didn't like it because I was
intruding their territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_21.text: ... Even though she herself intruded the Sacred Ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH1_3_22.text:
Boundaries and borders are not applied that
strictly in the sea, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_02.text:
Our jurisdiction in Hasla is not that big,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_03.text:
Cora's power comes from light. And in the deep sea,
there are parts where light cannot reach...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_04.text:
Maybe there are many more places out in the world
that we still don't know about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_05.text:
Umrat was created from darkness, so I cannot
trust her completely, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_06.text:
I couldn't sense the traces of corruption with my 
power of purification.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_07.text:
Though I definitely felt 'something' opposite of from the
power of light that us Elards have…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_08.text:
It was definitely different from the darkness of the apostles
that could swallow and corrupt everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_10.text:
My sister and I accepted our missions
as Elards to protect each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_11.text:
No matter how lonely I was... And even as I felt
something was wrong after my sister left,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_12.text:
the truth that our position and mission as goddesses
would guarantee our future and that of Hasla's…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_13.text:
I never doubted that light was good and darkness was
evil. Well, I never had the time or reason to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_15.text:
The solitude that Umrat feels from the deepest
of places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_16.text:
That solitude that has nothing to do with light or dark…
Or good and evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_17.text:
The fear to want to remember, to live,
to not die and be forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_18.text:
Those things... Don't feel foreign to me.
I actually feel a sense of kinship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_19.text: Umrat and I… are essentially the same.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_20.text:
… {PLAYER_NAME}, the story of light and darkness that
we have known. How much do you think it's true?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_21.text:
I can't stop doubting. What is the 'evil' 
that we are fighting against?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_22.text:
And once we find out that everything
we have known so far wasn't the truth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_1_23.text: Will I be able to cope with that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_02.text:
Even the thing that the 'Deepest Abyss' feared the most
was losing her memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_03.text:
After losing to you, Umrat lamented the fact that
she was #losing her memory#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_05.text:
The being with that endless power will be able to
remain alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_06.text:
But she wouldn't have been able to maintain the
identity of 'Umrat' that we had seen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_07.text:
Just with the remnants of her conscious, she will roam
the floors of the abyss as a shapeless darkness…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_08.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. If we think about Umrat's fear, 
the essence of existence might be memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_09.text:
The time and space that each one perceives,
and if the thoughts and emotions within disappear…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_10.text: We won't be able to live as ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_11.text:
But I gess all is well that ends well.
It turned out alright for Umrat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_12.text:
Anyway, with the scales of Habaek that Haerang returned, 
she was able to remain in existence,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_13.text:
and made #friends# that wanted to stay
by her side no matter what.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_14.text:
…Well, the encounter with the Book of Magic and the 
Magic Sword wasn't that nice,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_15.text: so I wonder how much we can trust those 'friends', but still…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_16.text:
They looked busy trying to show Umrat 
what's out there in the world, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_17.text:
If they have no malice, I don't want to look for
a reason to hate them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH2_6_18.text: I just hope they find peace in the hearts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_01.text:
I wonder where my sister disappeared to.
For what… Without saying anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_02.text: We spent 100 years trying to protect each other,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_03.text:
so 3 years is just an instant…
But somehow it feels even longer for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_04.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}. Do you know how us Elards
are different from normal humans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_05.text:
…Well, just as you've seen, it's not like we have some
extraordinary power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_06.text:
The #daughters of Cora# really do have some
amazing powers, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_07.text:
If you consider just simple power, there are many
beings out there that are stronger than Elards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_08.text:
You've seen the witches of Pumpkin City and the science
of Neth. They can do similar things like us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_09.text:
The real special ability we have is in our ability
to not forget even the smallest thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_10.text:
I've lived in this body for over a hundred years,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_11.text:
And I remember every single moment of those
one hundred years very clearly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_12.text:
Elards aren't allowed the eternal rest of oblivion. 
Our body and mind… remain in this 'present'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_13.text: It's a blessing… but also a curse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_14.text:
... Especially since we went through wars that
caused many deaths and a lot of pain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_16.text:
Throughout these eternal memories, my sister
and I couldn't let go of the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_18.text:
But my sister received the soul of
Goddess Elanuma and left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_20.text:
... My sister... I wonder if she really
was the person I knew?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_21.text:
In that light of Goddess Elanuma's memories that
continued for hundreds and thousands of years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_22.text:
Will my existence no longer have any meaning
to her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_23.text: I've wandered so long to find my sister,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_24.text:
but sometimes I wonder if it would be
better if I don't find her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_1_25.text:
I'm scared that my sister might forget about me,
{PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_01.text: A Kalard with the power of oblivion…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_03.text:
Like the Temple of Illusions and the Oracle of Water,
and the ancient Sacred Beings...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_04.text:
The reason why things that must be remembered
disappeared from the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_05.text:
I didn't know that the memories of the daughters of Cora
and Elards could be altered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_06.text:
I understand now, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Kalard's 'light' just blinds the eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_07.text:
Is there a difference between indiscreet light and
corrupted darkness?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_08.text:
They tried to steal our realized pasts,
and our futures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CH3_6_09.text:
We must remember. That there's no future if
you forget history.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SISSEA_S2_EP5_CHALLENGE_3.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. 
I'm only confessing this to you...

The past 3 years I spent looking for my sister,
… It wasn't that bad of an experience.

I was worried about my sister, but it was
the first time I went around the world by myself.

When I was human, I only stayed in my
hometown because of my health..

After receiving my mission as an Elard, I could not leave
the Sacred Ground because of the Soulstone.

That's why everything was new to me.
All those sights.

The last sunlight shining on the summit of the
Peaks of Glory…

The golden plains sprawling to the
southeast of Grancia.

The sound of the melting river at the start
of spring in Nosgard.

The fog across the mountains of Han
around dawn.

Those memories... Will remain as precious memories,
no matter how much time passes.

Oh, I met a lot of people too. For them, it was
just a passing encounter…

But I learned there were many beings
leading different kinds of lives.

Isn't it strange, {PLAYER_NAME}? I'm a goddess
that is in charge of part of that broad abyss,

but I only realized how big this world
really is.

When I look back now, I was trapped in the regrets and 
lingering attachment to my sister for all that time.

I was sad, so I had the excuse that I had to guard the
Soulstone, and refused to see anything else.

In the changing sights during the past 3 years...
I was at the center of it, changing myself.

I was able to start this journey thanks
to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

If I hadn't left the Sacred Ground… I would have
remained trapped in my past.
I'm no longer just chasing my sister's past.

I'm looking for my sister for the times ahead
to continue our memories.

I'm still afraid of being forgotten, {PLAYER_NAME}.
But… I don't want to miss the future.

Like the flowing river… Thank you for
giving me the courage to change, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SKILL_RESULT_1.text:
It feels like… Success! Superb!
This Hero can now use a new Special Skill.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_1_03.text:
I've been searching for you for a long time,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_1_04.text:
I am Archon.
I come to warn you of a danger that threatens Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_2_01.text:
... The portal is unstable -
I cannot stay here for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_2_02.text:
Come to the southern tip of Valencia,
and look for an ancient fortress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_2_03.text:
I will be waiting for you there
to tell you everything you need to know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_3_01.text:
The wizard just now...
She said her name was... Archon, didn't she?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_3_02.text:
She could have been more
specific in her warnings, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_1_3_03.text:
I do think it's worth investigating, judging from her tone.
Shall we seek out the Fortress, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_01.text:
I am glad to see you here.
Thank you for trusting me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_02.text:
... There was something familiar about you.
Something almost resembling {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_03.text:
Now, please tell us.
What is this place? Why are we here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_05.text:
This is the #Fortress of Souls#.
Within dwell Lord #Soltar# and his army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_06.text:
Soltar? I've heard of that name.
He led the Army of Souls during the War of the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_07.text:
The Apostles were all sealed away one hundred years ago.
Soltar shouldn't have been an exception.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_08.text: Yes. It is true that the Apostles were vanquished by a 'certain power.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_09.text: And yet - not all of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_11.text:
There were a few Apostles who managed to hide from 'their' eyes.
Soltar, I fear, was one of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_12.text:
We... 'They' succeeded in hunting down Soltar
and sealing him within the Fortress, after much struggle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_13.text:
But a recent disturbance throughout the continent
destabilized the seal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_14.text:
Soltar is now awake once more,
reaping souls of Heroes to rebuild his army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_1_15.text:
I cannot stop him alone.
Will you help me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_2_03.text:
'A recent disturbance'... She must be relating to
the revival of the Soulstones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_2_04.text:
The corruption must have spread over the continent
and aroused the dormant Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_2_05.text:
Soltar's revival... would never have happened 
if we had successfully stopped Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_2_06.text:
We must help Archon
and stop Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_3_01.text:
Archon, you are right - Soltar must be stopped at all costs.
We will help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_3_03.text:
Thank you. Then I must first tell you of a weapon
necessary to defeat him once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_4_01.text: What bold soul dares to breathe of life in my Fortress...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_4_02.text:
The living have no place in the Fortress of Souls.
Abandon your weighty flesh... and join me in glorious death!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_2_4_04.text:
Be careful,
we cannot fight him as we are now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_1_02.text:
It is still not enough to fell me,
Soltar, Overlord of Souls!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_1_04.text:
Normal Weapons cannot penetrate
even the armor that protects him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_1_05.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Goddess Prestina.
We should turn back for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_02.text:
That shadow we just faced now...
... Do you think we can really defeat him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_03.text: We have not made all the necessary preparations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_04.text:
If we are to confront Soltar,
we need the power of the Crystal Sword #Danan#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_06.text:
Yes. It is a sword crafted out of the purest light
that can resist the darkness of Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_07.text:
One hundred years ago, a Hero by the name of #O'Ren#
wielded that sword against Soltar, together with his companions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_08.text:
In the last battle, Soltar, knowing that he was defeated, 
destroyed the sword with the last of his strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_09.text:
Danan shattered into fragments... which yet remain within the Fortress.
The Army of Souls is also aware of this and seeks to obtain them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_10.text:
We must gather the fragments away from Soltar's eyes
and restore the Crystal Sword.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_11.text:
Danan, the Crystal Sword...
The weapon Apostles fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_12.text:
This will help us fight against not only Soltar,
but any remaining Apostles we may have to face in the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_3_2_13.text:
Then we have no time to waste. {PLAYER_NAME},
let's free those tortured souls and collect Danan's Fragments!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_1_01.text:
A weapon newly forged with the Fragments of Danan...
It seems a better choice than restoring Danan itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_1_02.text: But this - this is not enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_1_03.text:
We need more Danan's Fragments
to our weapons are to be strong enough to be borne against Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_1_04.text:
Soltar has already recovered much of his power, and he will begin 
moving soon. We do not have enough time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_1_05.text:
At this rate, all of Valencia
will lose their souls to Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_2_01.text:
'Lose their souls'... Goddess Prestina...
Does this mean another Apostle has revived?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_2_02.text:
Don't worry, Sera.
I promise that will never happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_3_01.text:
Archon, is there a way to buy some time
until the weapon is complete?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_3_02.text: Even in this state, the blade itself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_3_03.text:
If infused with the power of the Goddess,
it may succeed in dealing a blow to Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_3_04.text:
It's a temporary solution at best,
and a dangerous one. It will only buy us some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_4_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, this is a difficult decision we are facing, I know.
But a victory that costs innocent lives is a worthless one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_4_02.text:
With your help, {PLAYER_NAME},
we may be able to forestall Soltar's revival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_4_03.text:
I'll protect you!
Let's go together, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_5_01.text:
I agree with you all.
We cannot leave Soltar to rampage like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_5_02.text: Let us return now to the Fortress of Souls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_5_03.text: Okay! I'll go and get ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_6_01.text: No. Sera, you will remain here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_6_02.text: Goddess Prestina! I can fight, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_6_03.text:
I am not trying to keep you from fighting. In fact, it's the very opposite -
I have a very important task that only you can do, Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_7_02.text:
We can't afford to wait any longer, but we really do need
the weapon of Danan's Fragments to face Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_7_03.text:
Sera, your task is to wait here in Hero Town,
and bring the weapon to us once it's complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_5_8_01.text:
Yes, Goddess Prestina. I'll do what I can!
Don't worry, I'll be soon to follow with the weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_01.text: ... The corruption is stronger in the air.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_02.text:
It seems Soltar has gathered more souls from the nearby regions.
His army is nearing completion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_03.text:
A hard battle ensued a century ago
when Soltar was not stalled in time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_04.text:
We will defy him by turning his attention to us. That will hold him
for the time being and keep souls from further corruption.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_05.text:
Archon... You seem to know a lot.
Almost as if... you've experienced the Apostle's War yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_1_06.text:
Did you... Did you have anything to do with
the binding of Soltar one hundred years ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_3_01.text:
You return, those who have fled before.
Are you prepared to surrender your lives to my abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_3_04.text:
I will tell you everything -
in time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_6_3_05.text: We must first face the evil at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_1_01.text:
This power... Yes... The very same that bound me to accursed slumber...
For a slow century I have been waiting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_1_02.text:
So now you remember, Soltar.
We'll have to do without greetings, this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_1_03.text: Yes, that face... I had thought it looked familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_1_04.text:
Hahaha... I see.
So you made 'that choice.' Restless souls, if not of my army...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_2_01.text: I will be waiting at the end of the Fortress! Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_4_01.text:
Please tell us. Who are you, exactly?
How do you know Soltar from a century past?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_5_01.text:
Do you remember when you first arrived here?
I spoke of those who opposed Soltar, one hundred years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_5_02.text:
Yes, the Heroes of the past...
O'Ren and his companions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_5_03.text:
Yes. The Heroes chosen by the Goddess of Time...
The legendary Heroes who protected the peace of the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_6_01.text:
The Goddess of Time?
... Chosen Heroes... You can't mean...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_6_02.text:
I am Archon, here and now. But I am also the reincarnation of #Arcana#,
O'Ren's companion and a Hero from a century past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_7_01.text:
We vowed that we would vanquish evil once and for all...
Yet evil knew no bounds, and our lives, being mortal, were too short.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_7_02.text:
We thus swore on our deaths and our lives to be: if the world should ever 
need us, we would choose reincarnation and fight. Again - and again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_7_03.text:
Why...
Why do you choose to go through such torment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_7_04.text:
Your souls... Unable to seek eternal peace,
forever waiting, without any sign or promise this war will ever end...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_7_05.text:
For that is our calling.
It is what we vowed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_8_8_01.text:
... I understand.
I too will follow you to the end and aid you anyway I can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_01.text:
That's strange, she should have fully recovered by now...
And she's still not waking up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_02.text:
Both of you recovered a day after the battle, Margrave, even with
all your injuries. Well, maybe that's not so surprising for an idiot prince...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_03.text:
Idiot prince...?
Aria, please, not in front of the Margrave...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_04.text:
What do you call an idiot but an idiot?
Lionel, you do realize that you were almost killed, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_05.text: But you heal me back to health every time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_1_06.text: Hrrmph, there could be no next time! Try to do without me for once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_01.text:
The soul of my child...
was once captured within the Fortress of Souls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_02.text: I do not think it fully escaped its control since then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_03.text: Then... Is there nothing we can do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_04.text:
According to the old records, corrupted souls 
will be found within the Fortress in crystallized form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_05.text:
We may discover such fragments in the Fortress 
while purifying the remnants of the Apostle within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_2_06.text:
So it's a matter of time.
That's a relief to hear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_3_02.text:
Thank you for saving my life
and my granddaughter's.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_3_03.text:
Oh, you don't need to thank me!
I was only cleaning after Lionel's mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_3_04.text:
And I only did what I should do
as the future king of Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_4_01.text: Yes, I expected you to be so modest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_4_02.text:
This oath of gratitude and fealty, however,
is foremost for you, Lionel, not the future king of Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_4_03.text:
No matter what lies ahead,
this greatsword of mine will always pave the path for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_5_02.text:
I will try my best
to become a ruler worthy of your allegiance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_6_02.text:
A happy day this is! Perhaps the happiest one as of yet.
Long live King Lionel, the new lord of Valencia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_6_03.text:
I could die right here and now
without any regrets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_6_04.text:
D-don't say that.
And with your age and all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_7_02.text:
No, I must live until I see the day
when Valencia comes to relish its former glory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_10_7_03.text: I ask for your courage, O King, and you shall have mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_1_001.text:
Never shall I forgive you,
you who have stolen everything from me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_2_001.text:
My kingdom of Valencia, my beautiful land,
dishonored once by Soltar and his madness of shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_2_002.text:
It was the lineage of my sires that restored life to Valencia,
and I - the last of that noble line.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_2_003.text:
I deemed it my role and fate to protect my people
from the doomed Lord of Souls,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_2_004.text:
through years and years of fruitless war,
the only victory being one more day of living.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_3_001.text:
It was I - was it not? - I who reclaimed the lands
that Soltar's shadows had drenched in doom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_3_002.text:
And... before the final battle before the Fortress of Souls,
the one I had fought countless others to face,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_3_003.text: a knight appeared with the name of Lionel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_3_004.text:
Lionel, Lionel! The nameless knight who struck the last blow
and so easily ended the war I had fought so long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_3_005.text:
Lionel - the hero of Valencia.
Lionel - the light of the people. Ha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_4_001.text:
Even when the 'hero' revealed his dark lineage
and his fate as the descendant of the enemy we had so loathed

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_4_002.text:
no one, not one, spoke their mind 
and judged him for his forefather's sin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_4_003.text:
No, they had grown weak with years of war.
They wanted a king. And so they found one in this hero of theirs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_4_004.text:
Even my own comrades, 
whom I had deemed my own kin as we fought together side by side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_5_001.text:
Ha! Only I see the tainted truth, O Lionel -
bane of our people, bearer of sin that cannot be forgotten!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_5_002.text:
No right do you have to the love of my people!
No right do you have to the love of my country!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_5_003.text: No king can you be. For Valencia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_5_004.text:
Valencia is mine!
And I shall reclaim its throne as its loving ruler.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_6_001.text:
There were those who followed me to the end,
true men they were. And we attempted our revenge against the false heir...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_6_002.text:
But we failed, and I was branded traitor.
I, who had fought so long - so long...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_6_003.text:
I could only flee,
chased like a dog by the ones who saw Lionel as their king.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_6_004.text:
...the ones... whom I had once fought together.
My once-comrades. My once-kin...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_7_001.text:
And now I stand here, in this accursed place,
unable to flee any farther.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_8_001.text:
Lionel, false light of Valencia, I curse you to my death - 
nay, I curse you even after death claims me for its own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_8_002.text:
And so I am left to die where Soltar met his own fate in the dark.
Is this your final taunt, Lionel?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_8_003.text:
Are you so cruel to wish me such a bitter end?
...And yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_8_004.text:
Yes... Yes... Is this not fate, then? 
A last chance to punish the thief who has stolen my right...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_9_001.text:
Yes, this strength...
Through the strength of your ancestor

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_1_9_002.text: shall I reclaim what is rightfully mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_1_02.text:
Thank you for your concern, Margrave.
... I wish you would stop calling me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_1_03.text:
The coronation hasn't been held yet,
and I feel rather... overwhelmed by such formality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_1_04.text:
You are the true king of Valencia, no matter what others may say.
Only a slight misfortune has postponed your rightful claim.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_1_05.text:
And isn't it to discuss this 'slight misfortune'
that we have gathered here today?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_1_06.text:
I have no plans to claim the throne
before solving the matter at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_2_02.text:
I have found out many things about your granddaughter, Margrave.
The one who attacked me and fled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_2_03.text:
#Rael#... I heard that she proved herself the kingdom's greatest knight
especially after Soltar's revival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_2_04.text:
Not only that, she was also the most popular candidate
to ascend to the throne before my arrival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_2_06.text:
Why do you treat me as your king, and not her? 
Is it only due to my bloodline?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_3_01.text: You know as well as I do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_3_02.text:
Soltar... He has left behind a darkness over that kingdom
that does not easily dissolve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_3_03.text:
Valencia needs a true king.
A king who will heal his kingdom of past sins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_3_04.text:
Only you can do this - 
Lionel, last descendant of the House of Ferdinand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_4_01.text: Is that... the reason you accepted my existence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_4_02.text:
Yes. I believe that the century's worth of remorse and hatred
that enshrouds this kingdom...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_4_03.text:
... can only be truly faced and absolved by Soltar's heir.
Only then will Valencia reclaim its former glory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_01.text:
You may think it mere obstinacy of an old man.
At the very least, my granddaughter seemed to think so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_02.text: No, it isn't that. I was foolish to think...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_03.text:
... that I would be instantaneously forgiven
for defeating Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_04.text:
As long as the darkness that looms over Valencia remains,
I won't be able to rule the kingdom as its people deserve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_05.text:
Yes. Let's turn to the matter at hand -
the problem of Rael.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_5_07.text:
A special troop has been assembled to pursue her. 
A report should arrive any mome -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_6_02.text:
We have received numerous reports 
that a new darkness is rapidly obscuring the Fortress of Souls!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_6_03.text: I-it's almost as if Soltar has been resurrected again, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_6_05.text:
...
What of the vanguard and Rael?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_2_6_06.text:
They... Well, no news has been heard
since they chased her into the Fortress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_1_01.text:
The Fortress... Something feels off.
Almost as if it's screaming with rage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_2_02.text:
They do not retain any serious wounds...
Their souls must have been reaped by Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_3_02.text: But this shadow I feel within the Fortress...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_4_02.text:
Lionel, Soltar must be attempting to seduce you into surrender!
Be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_4_03.text:
... That was a disturbing thought. Calm down, Aria.
That isn't Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_4_04.text: Rael... What is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_5_01.text:
Oh, Grandfather.
Fancy meeting you here, at the edge of the kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_5_02.text:
It seems I won't have to trouble myself and my troops
with a long journey home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_5_03.text: Now, look. Look at this strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_5_04.text:
Look at Soltar's hateful power, this Fortress!
Everything is in my grasp.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_5_05.text:
I... have become more worthy
than that beloved Lionel of yours!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_6_01.text:
Why do you not realize that there are more important virtues
than strength in ruling over a kingdom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_6_02.text: You are treading the same dark path as Soltar, Rael!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_6_03.text:
... 
Your age must be catching up with you for you to be so blind to the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_6_04.text:
Fine.
I had no intention of gaining your approval...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_3_6_05.text:
Even if you disapprove of me, Grandfather,
all I have to do to prove you wrong is to kill off your king.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_1_02.text: Rael, I don't know how you acquired that dark power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_1_03.text: ... but continue like this, and you will be bound forever to this Fortress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_1_04.text:
It is not too late.
Won't you leave the Fortress with us, together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_2_01.text:
...
With you... the one who has stolen my life away from me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_2_02.text:
Such nonsense... I see you still don't understand the direness of your
situation. I should have silenced you for good when I had the chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_2_03.text:
Wait and see. With the strength bestowed by your own ancestor...
I will lead you to your doom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_02.text:
How can she have inherited
Soltar's powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_03.text:
Didn't the Goddess banish Soltar
beyond this dimension?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_05.text:
I wish I could ask for their help,
but Rael won't let us leave the Fortress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_06.text: There is no time to waste wallowing in our thoughts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_07.text:
We must stop her before
she gains full control of her newfound strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_08.text: Even if we must kill her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_3_09.text:
We must keep another Soltar 
from threatening the kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_4_01.text:
Laertes.
It is too early to think of last measures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_4_02.text:
If only we can make her
abandon Soltar's powers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_5_01.text:
Have you forgotten that you almost had your lungs pierced
thanks to that Rael you want to rescue?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_5_02.text:
The vanguard soldiers were all sacrificed by her hand...
Even now, your life is in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_5_03.text:
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're in a position
to put the Margrave's needs before your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_5_06.text:
If you think I'll allow you to risk your life like that, you're wrong.
And what about all that hard work you put in for years and years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_6_02.text:
A lionhearted lady.
... And she is essentially right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_6_03.text:
Lord Lionel. I do not expect you to forgive Rael
only on the account that she is my granddaughter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_6_04.text: You must decide for the future of Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_4_6_05.text:
... I understand.
We must hurry then, before anything else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_1_02.text:
Why is it you and not me
who earned Grandfather's approval?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_1_03.text:
I'll never forgive you.
I swear to destroy you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_1_04.text:
If only... this power from the Fortress of Souls...
If I only had a little more...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_3_02.text:
Rael... I can feel your rage...
deepening... darkening... advancing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_4_01.text:
Soltar!
But you were defeated by Lionel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_4_04.text:
Did you arrange the whole affair
to return the throne to your descendant?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_5_02.text:
I am your reflection in the mirror, Rael...
Soon, you will come to see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_5_5_03.text:
You will understand that all this...
is but a meaningless, orchestrated puppet show...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_1_01.text: Rael... What are you doing in a place like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_1_03.text:
Won't you abandon Soltar's power
and return home, together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_1_04.text:
Lord Lionel has agreed to absolve you of your past faults
in favor of the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_01.text: Grandfather, I have one last thing I want to ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_02.text:
If it hadn't been for Lionel's appearance,
would you have allowed me to rule Valencia?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_03.text: ... No. Nothing like that would have happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_05.text:
So, everything had been decided, regardless of my will or effort.
My destiny... had already been chosen for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_06.text:
A destiny doomed to spend out its days at the borders of this kingdom,
waiting for the Ferdinand heir who may or may not have returned!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_07.text:
You do not understand. I merely wished a better life for you -
a life not spent on a throne burdened with regret and remorse!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_08.text:
Wished? And where is my choice in the matter?
What can I decide for myself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_09.text:
... So what the ghost of Soltar said was true.
Everything really was an orchestrated puppet show...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_11.text:
Ha... haha... hahaha!!
All that sacrifice... for nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_12.text:
Have I been chasing after an illusion,
bound to disperse at the mere words of an old man?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_2_13.text:
So be it. I had no real interest
in the throne of a small country like Valencia anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_3_03.text:
If you won't acknowledge me,
then I'll force you to follow me, at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_3_04.text:
That blind loyalty of yours...
will serve me well, when you become a soldier of my Army of Souls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_4_01.text: And do you think I'll stand by and watch?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_5_01.text: As for you, I'll take some time with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_6_5_02.text:
You'll become my prized general,
honored with the right to burn down all the major cities of this kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_1_04.text:
Why is it that... despite sacrificing everything...
I still can't exceed you...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_02.text: Why you can't exceed Lionel, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_03.text:
Is it not obvious? Even in that state,
Lionel is still my own descendant and heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_04.text: As for you... You have no making of a ruler in you.
