Just drop by my orchard and take whatever you need.
However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_14.text:
Erm, the trees MAY try to attack you due to a teeny tiny
side effect of a special fertilizer I use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_16.text:
BUT! You should be okay - probably!
{PLAYER_NAME} will keep you safe. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_17.text:
Lednas...
Are you sure this town is safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_18.text:
... It all contributes to our daily training.
Let me show you the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_02.text:
Durian? As in the stinky fruit?
Why on earth would you want that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_03.text:
What do you mean, why?
To use as fruit filling for my chocolate, of course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_05.text: Judging from your response, I think you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_07.text:
Uhm, I really want to say that the fruit you're looking for
is the #critical chance berry#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_08.text:
It resembles durians
but has considerably less of an odor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_09.text:
I don't recommend using it for desserts and sweets. The
distinct pungent odor, while weaker, is still present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_10.text:
Why don't you choose a more... ordinary fruit? We
have plenty more that are delicious and fragrant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_11.text: No, I specifically want durian. Only durian. Durian all the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_12.text:
Sigh... Fine, fine. Whatever the client wants, whatever the
client gets. But don't say that I didn't warn you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_13.text:
I only hope we don't have to fight you for the berries,
like we did for chocolates and bread.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_14.text:
What? Of course not.
I'm not ridiculously strong like Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_15.text:
Just drop by my orchard and take whatever you need.
However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_17.text:
Erm, the trees MAY try to attack you due to a teeny tiny
side effect of a special fertilizer I use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_19.text:
BUT! You should be okay - probably!
{PLAYER_NAME} will keep you safe. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_20.text:
Lednas...
Are you sure this town is safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_21.text:
... It all contributes to our daily training.
Let me lead the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_3_EN.text:
Whew... It's finished at last.
The ultimate #Valentine's Day chocolates#.

I know I was the one who chose to make them,
but I have to say, they smell revolting.

Hmm? Oh, yes. I did have my reasons
for choosing such unconventional ingredients.

As you helped me out, {PLAYER_NAME},
I suppose you have a right to know.

I'm planning to give these to Susanoo and put an end
to my infatuation with him once and for all.

As the Priestess of Ryu,
I have duties that come before anything else.

Duties that... may prove to be a heavy burden
not only for me, but for those around me as well.

I like Susanoo. I won't deny that. But that is the exact
reason I can't burden him, a shogun of Ryu.

As Kaguya is fond of Susanoo,
and Susanoo seems to reciprocate her feelings...

There's no place for me between them. So to end any
chance I ever had with him, I ruined my chocolates.
... It does seem that I have outdone myself, however.
Himiko!
Oh? Susanoo?

You disappeared after leaving only a note.
You had me worried.

I heard from Lady Kaguya, that you two came to make
a western confectionery called chocolates.

... Yes. You're an important person to me, Susanoo...
And so I made these chocolates for you.
Y-you made these... for me...?
Here you go.

Thank y-
W-what's this smell?!

They aren't good as Kaguya's. They emit a strange
smell... And they are oddly shaped as well...

No. You made these, Himiko. They are special for
that reason. Thank you.
... Chomp...

... Cough, cough!
Ugh, my t-tongue...!

A-are you all right?
Susanoo, spit it out!

N-no, it's quite... good...
... ...!!! Cough, cough! Ugh...!

Look, they were so delicious that I swallowed them
whole, in a single mouthful. Thank you, Himiko.

...
I can see your legs trembling.

Go see Kaguya. I'm sure her chocolates won't
harm you, like mine did.

I visited the town bakery before coming here. I am
already aware of the significance of these chocolates.

I'm sorry that I will disappoint Lady Kaguya, but your
chocolates are the only ones I would like to receive.

... If it pleases you, I would like to make chocolates
for you, next time.
S-Susanoo...
Himiko...

I-it's not like this means anything, you idiot! I-I-I'm
going back home! You can follow me if you want!

H-Himiko! Please walk more slowly.
My stomach hurts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_01.text:
Himiko, Kaguya.
I see both of you have gotten your chocolates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_02.text:
Now, it's time
to choose the fruit topping and filling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_03.text:
Hello! I'm Lenny, owner of the Hero Town orchards
and your assistant for the day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_04.text:
My orchards are overflowing with rare fruit that can't be
found anywhere else, even the capital of Impalis!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_05.text:
What are you looking for? Just tell me, and I'll show you
my freshest produce!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_06.text: Ooh~ Then do you have strawberries? I love strawberries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_08.text:
Hmmmm... For all your talk of rare fruit, you don't have
strawberries? I find that hard to believe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_09.text:
C-Chocolat orders most of my stocks for her desserts!
That's the only reason I don't have any on hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_10.text:
I do have fresh #critical damage# and #attack power#
berries that are delicious, if I do say so myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_11.text:
I've never heard of such berries before.
Why are they named after... battle stats?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_12.text:
Oh, most of my regulars are battle-hardened heroes
who want to spice up their training a little with my wares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_START_13.text: Oh, come on, give them a try!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_01.text:
Oh. 'Plain old chocolates.' How straightforward.
They will do the job, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_02.text:
Gifts that are too expensive could be interpreted to
have unintended political messages.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_03.text:
Oh? {PLAYER_NAME}.
Why do you reach for your blade?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_04.text:
We have to... defeat the baker if we wish to obtain
the ingredients from her storage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_05.text:
No, this is definitely NOT a tradition of Grancia!
I have never heard of such a ludicrous custom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_06.text:
... Then again, it could be a rural practice
I have had no prior knowledge of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_07.text:
Mm. You must excuse my ignorance
of the traditions of the common folk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_08.text:
When in Roman, do as the Romans do,
as the saying goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_1_EN.text:
Oh, what a tragedy.
The storage has been utterly depleted.

The town pâtissiere told me that there is an unidentified
stack of #gourmet chocolates# in her storage.

Apparently, the wild goblins in the vicinity of the town
mainly feed on the expired bread from her bakery.

And their... palate has become so extravagant that
they developed a taste for.. gourmet chocolates...?

Sigh... We managed to obtain some of the #plain
chocolates# in the midst of the uproar, but...

This is hardly enough
for all the Cobalt Knights.
I need some time to think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_02.text:
I must admit, I had not expected to find
such fine delicacies in the country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_03.text:
... How much did you say these were?
Surely they must cost more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_04.text:
You recently imported a large supply, you say. Yet
chocolates of this quality should be harder to come by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_05.text: Hmm. Well, all merchants have their secrets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_06.text:
At this price, I will be able to purchase chocolates
for everyone within the allotted budget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_07.text: Yes... I have decided on these.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_08.text:
Oh? {PLAYER_NAME}.
Why do you reach for your blade?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_09.text:
We have to... defeat the baker if we wish to obtain
the ingredients from her storage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_10.text:
No, this is definitely NOT a tradition of Grancia!
I have never heard of such a ludicrous custom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_11.text:
... Then again, it could be a rural practice
I have had no prior knowledge of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_12.text:
Mm. You must excuse my ignorance
of the traditions of the common folk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_13.text:
When in Roman, do as the Romans do,
as the saying goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_16.text:
... Hee hee hee… So you choose the gourmet
chocolates, as I expected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_17.text:
My beloved goddess. Too well do I know that you
do not bare your heart to mere mortals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_18.text:
For you are only mine to shower with adoration. Your
words to {PLAYER_NAME} are façade...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_19.text:
Those chocolates are destined
for me and me alone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_20.text:
I shall be waiting with a joyful heart.
Hee hee hee...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_2_EN.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
what were those monsters we saw in the storage?
Goblins? They were different from the ones I've seen.

One shot #whirlwind arrows#...
Another had a full #armory# of different weapons...

The one who shouted commands in that barbaric goblin
language was terrible... It was as if he was their king.

I don't understand why these goblins invaded the town.
They cannot have waged war just for chocolates!

... This is a normal day at Hero Town?
By the Goddess...

You defeated those goblins unassisted, so I have no
choice but to take your word for it, {PLAYER_NAME}.

But the gourmet chocolates
have been ruined by the goblins.

Sigh... We managed to obtain some of the #plain
chocolates# in the midst of the uproar, but...

This is hardly enough
for all the Cobalt Knights.
I need some time to think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_01.text:
Haslean chocolate letters'?
I've seen these somewhere before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_02.text:
How adorable. Each little chocolate
has been engraved with a different letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_03.text:
A popular sweet among the common folk, you say...
Oh. I remember now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_04.text:
During one of our trainings, Caeneus gave some to
me, saying that they would supplement our energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_05.text:
The sweet taste of the chocolate in between our
training… remains a fond memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_06.text:
Yes, I have made my decision. I will make little gift
bags and fill them up with these chocolates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_07.text:
I hope these chocolates will remind my comrades of the
golden days when we stood together as one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_08.text:
Haha, I can see Caeneus's gleaming face
like it was yesterday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_CHOICE_3_EN.text:
Oh, what a tragedy.
The storage has been utterly depleted.

The town pâtissiere told me that there is an unidentified
stack of #gourmet chocolates# in her storage.

Apparently, the wild goblins in the vicinity of the town
mainly feed on the expired bread from her bakery.

And their... palate has become so extravagant that
they developed a taste for.. gourmet chocolates...?

Sigh... At least they left the #Haslean chocolate
letters# behind. It is quite ironic, if you think about it.

Do they taste so bad for the sweet-toothed goblins
to abandon the entire pile?

Hmm. While they are edible,
they are not special, by any standards.

I must admit, I am worried that my friends will not find
these to their liking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}. You seem to have completed
the first client's order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_02.text:
Our next customer has already arrived
and is waiting for you to take her order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_03.text:
Oh! I had not realized that the employee you spoke of
was {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_04.text:
Haha, I always find you at the heart of the
strangest circumstances, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_05.text: Oh? Do you two know each other?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_06.text:
Yes, {PLAYER_NAME} helped me appease #Uncle#
and one of his many, many whims.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_07.text:
Ah, then you already know how business-savvy
{PLAYER_NAME} is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_08.text:
As there's no need for introductions, why don't you 
two get started? See you at the checkout!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_09.text:
I must be in the countryside indeed if the town
merchant does not recognize me for who I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_10.text: Oh? The reason for my coming to Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_11.text:
Mm. As you have earned my trust, {PLAYER_NAME},
I shall confide in you and you only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_12.text:
I am sure you already know that I originally come
from the Order of the #Cobalt Knights#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_13.text:
It is where I first received my knighthood… And which
I departed soon after my quarrels with Uncle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_14.text:
My current subordinates, the knights of the Central
Order, serve me well, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_15.text:
You never forget your first chivalric order. The Cobalt
Knights will always hold a special place in my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_16.text:
That's why I have been searching for a gift that can be
given freely, without any political repercussions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_17.text:
That is when I came across the advertisement on
Neth Web. Valentine's Day…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_18.text:
A seemingly harmless and enjoyable foreign custom.
And these #obligatory chocolates#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_19.text:
... seem a perfect way to express my gratitude
for all the memories with the Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_20.text:
And if they are handmade, as was advertised, they
will not be interpreted as having an ulterior motive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_21.text:
I will be gifting chocolates to every knight of the Cobalt
Order, so I need your help in placing a large order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_1_START_22.text:
I will be gladly accepting any recommendations that
you have. Do you have a catalogue?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_01.text:
I'm making chocolates for my old companions, the
Cobalt Knights. Do you have any recommendations?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_02.text:
The Cobalt Knights...
Aren't they led by #Sir Caeneus the Valiant#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_03.text: Then #HP Berries# is your best choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_05.text: Yup. Blue, like... ahem... blue blood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_06.text:
They are also full of nutrients. One berry will keep any
warrior energized for the entire day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_07.text:
Hmm, what great potential.
They could be developed as military rations...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_08.text:
Oh, you are right.
I am here to purchase gifts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_09.text:
Either way, they sound excellent.
I would like the HP Berries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_10.text:
An excellent choice!
Then shall we head to the orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_11.text:
Our previous guests should have tired out the trees
by now! Now is your chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_12.text: ... And what do you exactly mean by that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_13.text:
Oh? Haven't you heard?
Due to the effects of my special plant fertilizer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_14.text:
Let us cut to the chase. Are you trying to say that we
must fight another monster in the orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_15.text: Erm. I'm afraid that you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_16.text:
What a quaint little town!
Now I am more interested than shocked.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_17.text:
I must have a scholar investigate this town. There seem 
to be many secrets hidden here that could be useful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_1_EN.text: Sigh... Finally, they are complete.

... Although they are only three in number. I had not
expected the berry trees to fight back with such force.

Haha... Oh, this is no state for a princess. I must admit,
however, that I found our escapades quite enjoyable.
Now, what to do...

Please, spare me a moment,
my goddess!

... This voice… It must be Inquisitor Uriel from the
Order of the Goddess.

How full of mirth this joyous day! My soul is blessed,
for the goddess remembers my name!

Why are you here, in Hero Town?
Have you been following me?

Your faithful servant shall forever follow in your
footsteps! That is my duty to you, my fair goddess!

I cannot let the golden Lady Victoria brave the dangers
on the road to Elandia only to pay me a visit!

...? And exactly why
must I pay you a visit in Elandia?

The chocolates that you eternally blessed with the
touch of your hands… Are they not meant for me?

Ha! Even children know that one must look before one
leaps. These are not yours. You will receive nothing.
If not mine... Then... whose...?

These chocolates were originally meant for my old
comrades in the Order of the Cobalt Knights.

However, due to several unforeseen events, I ended up
with too few, and didn't have enough for all of them.
Then... I could - !

No. These are for... {PLAYER_NAME}. They helped
me greatly and deserve these chocolates.

... That can't be. My chocolates...
to {PLAYER_NAME}...?

They were not yours in the first place.
As I told you many times.

Do not meddle in my personal affairs,
lest #Uncle# hears of your insolence.

It need not even come to that. As the captain of the
Order, I can command for your banishment.

Ugh...! Forgive me for my transgressions.
Until the day... ...
... He is gone.

Sigh... {PLAYER_NAME}. I apologize for the commotion.
Although I greatly enjoyed my visit...

That inquisitor is quite bothersome. He may endanger
the villagers in his blind obsession, so I must depart.

On your next visit to Impalis,
I will teach you some more... normal dessert recipes.
Then, farewell!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_01.text:
Hmm, what are 'almighty berries'?
That is an interesting name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_02.text:
Oh, you have great taste.
As expected of the Centr-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_04.text:
... Ahem. As I was saying, #Almighty Berries# are
THE ultimate fruit, cultivated by yours truly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_05.text:
Not only are they sweeter than any other fruit in all of
Hasla, they also heighten and develop one's senses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_06.text:
If it is everything you say it is,
this berry must be expensive indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_07.text:
Of course, but they are worth every gold coin. And I
only offer them to the most honored guests.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_08.text:
Well, I'll take it. I will take your entire stock. But you
must deliver them to the Royal Palace of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_09.text:
They seem too valuable to be used for trifling occasions
like this. I will choose another fruit for my chocolates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_10.text:
If you say so.
Then may I recommend the #HP Berries#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_12.text: Yup. Blue, like... ahem... blue blood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_13.text:
They are also full of nutrients. One berry will keep any
warrior energized for the entire day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_14.text:
Blue blood, you say?
Well, then I must have these.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_15.text:
A fine, fine choice!
Then shall we head to the orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_16.text:
Our previous guests should have tired out the trees by
now! Now is your chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_17.text: ... And what do you exactly mean by that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_18.text:
Oh? Haven't you heard?
Due to the effects of my special plant fertilizer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_19.text:
Let us cut to the chase. Are you trying to say that we
must fight another monster in the orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_20.text: Erm. I'm afraid that you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_21.text:
What a quaint little town!
Now I am more interested than shocked.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_2_22.text:
I must have a scholar investigate this town. There seem 
to be many secrets hidden here that could be useful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_02.text:
S-strawberries?
Erm... We don't have any.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_04.text:
C-Chocolat always takes the strawberries for her
desserts! That's the only reason I don't have any!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_05.text:
We have plenty of other fruit for sale
that will satisfy your needs just as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_07.text: Or is there a particular reason you want strawberries?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_08.text:
Well, it is a simple one.
Everyone of the Cobalt Knights loves them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_09.text:
Especially my Vice Captain, Caeneus.
He has quite the appetite for strawberries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_10.text:
He was an avid patron of the patisseries of the capital...
He would buy strawberry desserts for all the knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_11.text:
... I wanted to make everyone happy
with delicious chocolates...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_12.text:
... and these will simply not do, not by themselves. That
is why I asked whether you had any strawberries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_13.text:
... … Ugh! I am a sucker for touching backstories
like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_14.text:
I do have one - and only one! - box of strawberries
that I've been saving for an emergency.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_15.text: Will you do that for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_16.text:
There should be a pink box at the far end of the orchard.
They're yours for the taking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_17.text:
Be careful of the trees, although our previous guests
should have tired them out by now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_18.text: ... And what do you exactly mean by that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_19.text:
Oh? Haven't you heard?
Due to the effects of my special plant fertilizer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_20.text: Let us cut to the chase. Are you trying to say that we must fight another monster in the orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_21.text: Erm. I'm afraid that you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_22.text:
What a quaint little town!
Now I am more interested than shocked.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_23.text:
I must have a scholar investigate this town. There seem 
to be many secrets hidden here that could be useful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_CHOICE_3_EN.text:
Who would've thought that the tree would fall straight
onto the box? Now we have not a single strawberry.

The only chocolates that remain are the Haslean
chocolate letters. I did not plan for this!

What do you think of these chocolates, {PLAYER_NAME}?
They seem so... plain. They hardly make for a gift of gratitude.

Sigh... I must return to Impalis
and search for a more acceptable pres-
Oh? What is this noise?

Let me be!
I must go see my goddess!

As if I ever would!
What were you doing here?! Explain yourself!

Caeneus?
What brings you here?

L-Lady Victoria.
The training camp grounds this year were nearby...

I heard from the knights that you would be visiting
Hero Town, and thought I would pay you a visit.
... I met this fanatic on the way.

O Goddess! Brightly shineth
your golden crown to the envy of the sun!
... Inquisitor Uriel.

How full of mirth this joyous day! My soul is blessed,
for the goddess remembers my name!

Why are you here, in Hero Town?
Have you been following me?

Your faithful servant shall forever follow in your
footsteps! That is my duty to you, my fair goddess!

You scoundrel! Any more impertinence from you
shall cost you your tongue!

Even the most noble members of the clergy dare not
speak to Crown Princess Lady Victoria in this manner!

Halt, Caeneus.
While I greatly appreciate your concern...

You are the captain of the Cobalt Knights. You must
think of the other knights who follow your command.

B-but... Huh?
Lady Victoria. Are those...

O-oh. These are nothing of importance.
Please forget that you ever saw them.

Are those not... Haslean chocolate letters?
Haha, they are not so easily found in the capital.

... I remember it as clear as day.
That time, during training...

... You handed them to me, Caeneus. Despite the
passing of the years, I still remember the sweet taste.
Lady Victoria...

I am relieved. I treasure my memories with the Cobalt
Knights, and I am happy to know I am not the only one.
Now I feel foolish. I should never have doubted you.
A gift? What do you mean?

Here, Caeneus. #'Obligatory chocolates.'#
Although they are store-bought...

I'm sure they contain precious memories, the memories
we shared as one, as the Order of the Cobalt Knights.

... Yes, Lady Victoria. Although I am still unsure
about the concept of 'obligatory chocolates'...
I will protect them with my life, to the end of my days.

L-Lady Victoria! Were those divine confectionaries
not destined for my own hands? Why -

They were not yours in the first place.
As I told you many times.

Do not meddle in my personal affairs,
lest #Uncle# hears of your insolence.

It need not even come to that. As the captain of the
Order, I can command for your banishment.

Ugh...! Forgive me for my transgressions.
Until the day... we meet again, my goddess.

Sigh... {PLAYER_NAME}.
I apologize for the commotion.

That inquisitor is quite bothersome. He may endanger
the villagers in his blind obsession, so I must depart.

He is a madman.
His delusions grow stronger with each passing day.

Caeneus. Stay here for a few days. Come back only
once you are certain he will cause no harm here.
You have my word, Lady Victoria.

Haha, that I will, Caeneus.
Then, {PLAYER_NAME}...

I greatly enjoyed your visit, and while I am loath to
depart so soon, I have duties to which I must return.

On your next visit to Impalis,
you must visit me at the Order of the Central Knights.

I will introduce you to many wondrous patisseries of
the capital. Until then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_01.text: Oh, did you get your chocolates?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_02.text:
Yes, but the goblins made it difficult to find ones
that can be used.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_03.text:
Ah, I thought it was noisy outside.
The goblins are back again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, can you go deal with them if you
have the time? I'll pay for any expenses, as I always do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_05.text:
She asks you to fight a horde of goblins easily as she
would ask you to stop by the marketplace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_07.text:
... Nothing of consequence.
What is the next step?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_08.text:
You have to choose the fruit
for the filling or the topping!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_09.text:
H-h-h-hello...
I mean, good afternoon, Lady Kni-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_10.text: Oh, you seem to know who I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_11.text:
Uh... I-I used to work as a pilot for a merchant airship,
milady, and I must say that it is an honor to behol-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_12.text:
If you know me, then I am sure you know that my
whereabouts is to be confidential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_13.text: I hope you will be wise. For your sake as well as mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_15.text:
What secret conversation
are you two having there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_16.text:
N-nothing!
Now, then... You said you needed berries, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_17.text:
My orchards are full of rare and delicious berries
that can't be found even in the grand city of Impalis!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_18.text:
What kind of berries do you want?
Just name it, and I'll get it for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_19.text:
Oh, rare berries that can't be found even in the capital?
You pique my curiosity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_2_2_START_20.text:
Well... M-maybe not that rare...
Here is a catalogue of all the berries in store...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_01.text:
Hullo there, {PLAYER_NAME}. This must be the second
time we're meeting like this, isn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_02.text:
I saw what happened
at Chocolat's Bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_03.text:
Cupid Committee'...
What were you thinking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_04.text:
You may be a hero of unparalleled prowess in your dimension,
but you clearly underestimated the power of love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_05.text:
Especially unrequited love. NEVER meddle in other people's
relationships, or pay the price - like you did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_06.text:
However, I do think that the end of the world
is a rather harsh price to pay for a stupid mistake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_07.text:
As this episode was a #technological singularity# caused
by external factors... I will reverse it this one time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_08.text:
We can't reverse the rise of the Cupid Committee, so you'll
have to try to avoid the bad ending you experienced.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_09.text:
Once you return to Hero Town, you'll find yourself back
in the beginning of this episode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_10_10.text:
Good luck. Don't die. Ugh, I hope you know how many
rules I'm breaking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_11_01.text:
Valentine's Day is an interesting concept, to be sure,
but I feel that it's little too soon for the people of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_11_02.text:
Too many variables, too much risk. The catastrophe of the
Christmas-imbued assassins still haunt my nightmares...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_11_03.text: Thank you for your cooperation, earthlings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_01.text:
Oh, it was our pleasure.
I found the unfolding fiasco quite entertaining.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_02.text:
And this space-time of yours - fascinating as always. Do
these rows of bookshelves even end somewhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_03.text:
Your omnipotence is not new to me. Are you sure you
haven't seen a pink-haired goddess anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_04.text:
Yes, I'm sure. As I've said before, the outer limits of space
lie outside my perspective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_05.text:
But don't worry. You and that goddess are tied by #fate#.
Destiny will guide your footsteps in each other's direction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_07.text:
H-haha, yawn! Let's stop with the boring talk
and head back, Nari-chan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_12_08.text:
Boring? I am searching for my nemesis who irreversibly
pushed my life into turmoil, and you say it's boring?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_13_01.text:
Sigh... Never mind. At times I forget you too are still young
and must miss your home dearly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_13_02.text:
You are a good boy, Haruki. Once we return home, I will
treat you to all the sweets you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_13_03.text: I hear that nylon? cologne? thingamajig is quite tasty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_01.text:
Huh, I knew you had many talents,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_02.text:
Judging from the events of this week,
you have a bright future as a salesperson.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_03.text:
Not everyone receives chocolates for themselves
when they're put in charge of selling them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_04.text:
However, I feel that we have lost sight
of our original goal as the 'Cupid Committee.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_05.text: Who cares? We made good profit. That's all that matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_06.text:
And look! We attracted a lot of publicity thanks to our
previous clients, and now orders are flooding in!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_07.text:
The Cupid Committee was supposed to last only a few days,
but I think this could be a permanent business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_08.text:
In fact, I think we should go ask Nari and Haruki
what other holidays they celebrate on #Earth# -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_1_09.text:
Huh? Did you feel that just now?
The earth seemed to shake for a moment there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_2_01.text:
E-eek!
It must be an earthquake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_3_01.text:
Eek! I'm sorry!
I'll help you with the refund, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_3_02.text:
Refund? For what?
That is not my business here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_3_04.text:
I am Susanoo, shogun of the kingdom of Ryu. I serve
Priestess Himiko, whose heart you cruelly misled!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_3_05.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I know you are here. Come out immediately!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_01.text:
Yes, give up that traitor {PLAYER_NAME}.
They deserve to be punished for their crimes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_02.text:
Such blasphemy! Such sacrilege against my goddess!
You must be burned alive for your sins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_03.text:
And YOU! I didn't forget about you and your unhealthy
obsession with Lady Victoria! She is no one's goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_04.text:
And exactly WHY would I need YOUR permission
in worshipping my one true goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_05.text:
Sir Caeneus, Captain of the Cobalt Knights?
May I ask the reason for your visit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_06.text:
Ah, I know you... Sir Galahad's future successor.
What are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_07.text:
Do not tell me you have been cooperating
with that foul {PLAYER_NAME} in their evil deeds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_08.text:
Evil deeds? I must admit,
the reasons for your anger still escape me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_09.text:
Didn't you spread word of 'Valentine's Day'? An otherworldly
holiday on which one gifts chocolates to one's beloved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_10.text:
... A day on which Himiko had been planning
to give me chocolates! Making me her beloved!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_11.text:
And my spie-... my knights also reported to me that Lady
Victoria had also ordered several boxes of chocolates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_12.text:
Those chocolates...
were meant for our comrades of the Cobalt Knights!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_14.text:
Ha! You must excuse this hotheaded knight and his illusions.
Lady Victoria obviously meant to bestow them on me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_15.text:
You test my patience
with your inanities, Uriel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_16.text:
... I do not accept your accusations,
but I understand the reasons behind your indignance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_4_17.text: And the lady behind you, is she with you as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_5_01.text:
Er, is this not the Cupid Committee?
I heard that you provide romance concierge services?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_5_02.text:
We do, but... If you haven't made a reservation, I'm afraid
we're at full capacity and can't receive any more orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_5_03.text:
What? But I've come all the way from Nosgard!
On a wagon! For the last few days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_5_04.text: And I didn't know you were taking reservations!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_6_01.text:
Erm, I'm sorry to have inconvenienced you, but we did
post an announcement on our Neth Web account.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_6_03.text:
Why do you hipsters always insist
on being so exclusive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_6_04.text:
Do you know how much I've been waiting for the opportunity
to give Sasquatch handmade chocolates?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_6_05.text:
You are the root of all evil! 'Cupid Committee'?
I shall reveal you all as the blackguards you are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_6_06.text:
Yes. This demons' lair
must be annihilated!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_7_02.text: Help! Rogue heroes are destroying everything in sight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_7_03.text:
Why are they so angry at us?
Who cares about stupid chocolates, anyway?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_8_03.text:
Erm, sir?
Please calm down and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_9_01.text:
... And thus, the adventures of {PLAYER_NAME},
hero of Hasla, came to an untimely end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_9_02.text:
Their brilliant feats, tarnished by 
their insignificant demise,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_1_9_03.text:
were soon forgotten as Hasla fell into despair and darkness
following {PLAYER_NAME}'s death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_10_01.text:
I know I've wished you luck in this dimension,
{PLAYER_NAME}, but you've outdone yourself this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_10_02.text:
Truly. You've earned unconditional support of not only Ryu,
but also the most powerful groups in Grancia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_10_03.text:
Which should lead to particular consequences in the future.
This was meant to be a fun, cross-cultural festival…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_10_04.text:
But with events unfolding at this scale, we'll have unwanted
intruders barging in. So, I'll need to reset this current timeline.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_02.text:
I have been observing the world of Hasla for much longer
than anyone can imagine. And this is the first time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_03.text:
... that I have received a present. I'll archive this, and
preserve it until the universe collapses to a single point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_04.text:
Haha, I'm joking! Of course I don't know what will happen
at the inevitable end of the universe as we know it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_05.text:
I... I'm at a loss for words, to be frank. Thank you from
the bottom of my heart, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_06.text: Well, now... Off you go, back to saving the world and whatnot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_12_07.text:
Come by and visit me when you have the time.
I'll have collected many more stories by then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_13_03.text: Oh, I forgot to give them my gift in the ambush.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_01.text:
Huh, I knew you had many talents,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_02.text:
And it seems shopkeeping
is one of them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_03.text:
Every one of our clients checked 'very satisfied'
on our customer service survey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_04.text:
Hmm, they were certainly patient with {PLAYER_NAME}
and their mistakes, if they did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_05.text: Who cares? We made good profit. That's all that matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_06.text:
And look! We attracted a lot of publicity thanks to our
previous clients, and now orders are flooding in!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_07.text:
The Cupid Committee was supposed to last only a few days,
but I think this could be a permanent business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_08.text:
In fact, I think we should go ask Nari and Haruki
what other holidays they celebrate on #Earth# -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_1_09.text:
Huh? Did you feel that just now?
The earth seemed to shake for a moment there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_2_01.text:
E-eek!
It must be an earthquake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_3_01.text:
Eek! I'm sorry!
I'll help you with the refund, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_3_02.text:
Refund? For what?
That is not my business here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_3_04.text:
Ah, there you are.
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_3_05.text:
With your help, I could realize Himiko's feelings towards me -
and mine towards her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_3_06.text: How shall I ever repay you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_01.text:
I envy your good fortune.
Love has not blessed me with her gentle grace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_02.text:
While I did receive chocolates
from the fair Lady Victoria...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_03.text:
She clarified that they were... #'obligatory chocolates.'#
Everyone in the Order received a box.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_04.text:
Do you still not understand? My goddess loves each and
every one of us equally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_05.text:
As evinced by the fact that the chocolates I, her dearest
disciple, received were no different from the others'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_06.text:
... You only scavenged what she left behind. Admit it,
your delusions blind you to the glaring truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_07.text:
Hrrmph! Your lies will never drive me from my faith.
I, for one, am the happiest I've ever been in my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_08.text:
Sir Caeneus, Captain of the Cobalt Knights?
May I ask the reason for your visit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_09.text:
Ah, I know you... Sir Galahad's future successor.
What are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_10.text:
I have been helping the Cupid Committee
along with {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_11.text:
Haha,
I fear this isn't very 'knightly' business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_12.text:
Of course it is. In fact, all of you here reminded me
what it truly means to be a knight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_13.text:
What is a knight but one who keeps the peace
and protects the happiness of others?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_14.text:
Thank you for your kind words, Sir Caeneus.
I am glad you understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_4_15.text:
And as for the lady in the back?
Is there something we can help you with?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_5_01.text:
Er, is this not the Cupid Committee? I heard that you
provide romance concierge services?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_5_02.text:
As soon as I heard the news, I hastened here all the way
from Nosgard by wagon over the last few days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_5_03.text:
Oh, yes, you're in the right place!
Welcome to the Cupid Committee!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_5_04.text:
We used to provide personalized services only for
customers who made reservations in advance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_5_05.text:
but as sales skyrocketed with {PLAYER_NAME}, we have
decided to expand our business! This is our first day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_01.text:
Oh, is that so? Does this mean that I can give my
sweetie those gourmet chocolates?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_02.text:
Of course! If you would be so kind as to wait outside
while we make the preparations, we should be grateful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_04.text:
Then, {PLAYER_NAME}... If trouble ever finds you in the
future, remember that you have my blade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_05.text:
I will do my best to improve my relationship with Lady Victoria
and receive even more than her chocolates next year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_06.text: Lednas, I wish you luck in your endeavors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_6_08.text:
Oh, it seems the perfect time to end with a sermon.
A true faith in the one and only Goddess -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_7_02.text:
And the guests who left just now - the shogun of Ryu,
the captain of the Cobalt Knights... Whew!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_7_03.text:
This is why I love doing business with {PLAYER_NAME}. Sell
chocolates, gain high-end customers, go viral, and PROFIT!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_01.text:
The original clients were the High Priestess of Ryu and the
Captain of the Central Knights. Did you not know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_02.text:
Oh, I've been living in this country town for years now.
How should I have known who those bigshots were?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_03.text:
Anyway, what's important is that we have some leverage to
expand our business and open retail stores in the capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_04.text: A-a retail store? Of my bakery?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_05.text:
Of course! Your magical berries
are a crucial selling point as well, Lenny,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_8_06.text:
and by signing a contract with Rainbow Delivery, we don't
have to limit ourselves to Grancia. We could expand -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_9_01.text:
Oh, did I surprise you, {PLAYER_NAME}? Your ears still
work fine. I put the world on mute before stopping it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_ED_2_9_02.text:
However, we do need to talk about the timeline you've
taken. Is there no middle road with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_10_01.text:
Anyway, as you can see, still waters run deep. Who would
have known that you were losing your sleep over a man?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_10_02.text:
You have no right to say that.
I knew Susanoo before you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_10_03.text:
This hardly seems business
that requires either my or {PLAYER_NAME}'s help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_10_04.text:
As for myself, I must return to my patrol duties.
Then I'll see myse-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_01.text: Bridget...! And Lenny, too? How did you find us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_02.text:
Huhuhu... There's not much that escapes my notice. My
faithful agents alert me of everything that happens here -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_03.text:
- which is hardly classified information. By 'agents' she
means the town guard. He told us of your arrival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_05.text:
This 'Valentine's Day' sounds like fun and an opportunity to
do business! You can't leave us out on this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_06.text: Fun? The guests are simply here to purchase some chocolate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_07.text:
It's not just 'some chocolate'!
There are many things to consider, you know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_09.text:
Of course it is! I mean, if you were buying chocolate for
yourself, we wouldn't have gone through all this fuss. BUT!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_10.text:
Love is at stake here! And that calls for chocolate
craftsmanship, pretty packaging, and so much more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_11.text:
Hmm. You may be right.
I don't know much about love and whatnot...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_12.text:
What if we get more clients? We could receive bigger orders
and start mass producing chocolates, go wholesale maybe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_13.text:
I know a delivery service we could hire:
'Rainbow Delivery.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_14.text:
You're always so prepared, Bridget! If we're receiving
bulk orders, I may need new molds from Mr. Fergus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_15.text:
Don't you need fruit toppings for your chocolate? You may
be interested in new varieties of berries I recently cultivated!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_16.text: I feel things are getting out of hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_11_17.text:
Oh, but it's all in good fun!
Don't spoil the mood, Himiko!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_01.text: Welcome to... the one and only #Cupid Committee#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_02.text:
Huh, the interior of the shop… changed completely over
the course of few hours. Amazing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_03.text: Wizards aren't the only ones who perform magic around here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_04.text:
... 'Cupid Committee'?
Things really HAVE blown up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_05.text:
We put up an announcement through the Neth transmitter,
and a lot of people signed up for the event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_06.text:
Who could have guessed
that so many people were suffering from the love bug?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_07.text:
That's why we decided to officially hold a committee
and receive even more clients!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_08.text:
The Neth transmitter is an efficient method to gather a crowd.
But won't most of them get their order through the mail?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_09.text:
Oh, no! People are serious when it comes to unrequited
love. Many wished to visit our shop in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_10.text:
So we'll be providing personalized services including
customized chocolates and even a support system!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_11.text:
Aaaand of course Lednas and {PLAYER_NAME} will be
helping us out! Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_12.text:
... Sigh... You make it sound like we have a say
in the matter. I resign to my fate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_13.text:
Hee hee, I knew you'd understand. Looks like all those
years together haven't been for nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_12_14.text: Now then, shall we go meet our first client?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_1_01.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Are you going for a walk?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_1_02.text:
I have been patrolling the town.
I can sense trouble in the air...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_1_03.text:
... which may have something to do with the carriage from
Ryu parked in front of the town gates. Who can it be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_01.text:
Huh, you must be {PLAYER_NAME}.
I recognized you at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_02.text:
I see your fame is not for nothing. The ki energy that flows
through your body is well-balanced, pure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_03.text:
Eh~? Are you sure, Nari-chan?
THAT slowpoke is THE legendary hero of this dimension?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_04.text:
Pfft, one taste of my 'Darkness Devastating Blizzard'
would blow their pants off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_05.text: Haruki... The adults are speaking. Be quiet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_07.text:
Did you not understand? Children should be seen, not heard.
Do we have to go through what we went through again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_09.text:
You must be... guests from the Kingdom of Ryu?
If you have business with {PLAYER_NAME} -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_10.text:
Oh, yes. I did have business here.
That boy always manages to distract me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_2_11.text:
But that pure energy is too tempting for me to let you go
without a fight. Don't worry, I'll go easy on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_3_02.text:
Hmm, how disappointing.
I took care to hold back my full power, and yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_3_03.text:
Oh, Nari-chan. How many times did I tell you, most people
pass out when they're punched in the stomach?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_3_04.text: Ugh... This was NOT supposed to happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_3_06.text:
Nope, I am not dealing with this mess.
Excuse me, milady, while I take care of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_5_01.text: I'm so glad you woke up! You had me worried back there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_5_02.text:
Yes... This is Chocolat's Bakery.
What happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_5_03.text: I'm sorry, {PLAYER_NAME}. Things... got out of hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_01.text:
You are... Himiko.
And the one next to you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_02.text:
Hello there! I'm Kaguya! I'm Himiko's younger sister!
It's so nice to meet you at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_03.text:
We're close 'like' sisters, but we aren't related by blood.
I apologize for the inconvenience we've caused you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_04.text:
Nari and Haruki are guests of Ryu, and I must assume
responsibility over their actions, foreseen or otherwise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_05.text:
They ran out of the carriage as soon as we arrived,
clamoring to see {PLAYER_NAME} for themselves...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_06.text:
Hrrmph. 'One of the strongest beings in this world' -
that's what I was promised. I'm disappointed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_08.text:
You ALL should be treating me, your elder by at least a few
decades, with more respect. What is the world coming to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_09.text: A few decades? How exactly old are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_6_10.text: ... Let's just go with seventeen. Sorry about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_7_01.text:
I see. But what is the purpose of your visit,
Saintess Himiko?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_7_03.text:
We came to see you, Miss Chocolat! Please help us
confess our feelings to our friend! Please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_7_08.text:
Haha, time for me, Haruki,
to step in and clear up the situation as I always do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_01.text: ... and that's why we came all the way here to find you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_06.text:
Yawn... I'm sorry, but... Eighty percent of what you just
said was boasting over your own accomplishments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_07.text: Y-you can be so mean sometimes, Nari!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_08.text:
In short, they informed you of an otherworldly tradition called
#Valentine's Day# that celebrates love and romance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_09.text:
... and, in accordance to its practices, you both decided
to confess your love to the same person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_8_10.text: THIS is how you tell a story, Haruki. Short, simple, sweet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_01.text:
I-I wouldn't call it love, per se, but...
Yes, that sounds about right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_02.text:
Oh, Himiko. Everybody knows you have feelings for Susanoo.
Except yourself, I guess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_03.text:
If 'everybody' knows about my feelings, what about you?
If you were more considerate, you wouldn't have intervened!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_04.text: Love isn't first come, first serve! All's fair in love and war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_05.text:
But what does this 'Valentine Day' have to do with Chocolat?
You have traveled a long way to come to Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_06.text:
Everyone knows that Chocolat's Bakery
sells the most delicious desserts in all of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_07.text: If I'm going to play the game, I want to do it right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_08.text:
That's why I need chocolate sweet enough
to open that slowpoke's eyes to this new side of me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_09.text:
Oho, Chocolat. Did you hear that?
'Most delicious desserts in all of Hasla'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_OP_1_9_10.text: Hee hee. I won't deny it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_EXSHOP_1.text:
Welcome! We have various packages
of 'Magic Markers' available at our store!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_EXSHOP_COMPLETE_1.text: Thank you for purchasing our 'magic Markers'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_001.text:
Markers can be acquired various ways, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Or do you have a question about the festival?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_001.text: Let me explain you the rules of the "Pumpkin War."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_002.text:
It's quite simple: the team who captures the most pumpkins
wins the festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_003.text:
The winning team will receive a special prize
at the end of the event.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_004.text:
Don't be disappointed if you lose, however - you can also receive
a Participation Reward based on your contribution to your team.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_005.text:
The festival is divided into several turns, each lasting 1 hour.
You may make your move any time during the first 59 minutes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_006.text:
Each team's score is calculated during the last minute of the round.
You must wait for the result before the next turn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_007.text:
The team with the most Markers in a field at the end of each round
will capture that patch as their own territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_1_008.text:
If you succeed in capturing a Special Field as your team's territory,
you will receive special rewards with each round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_2_001.text: How do you use "Markers," you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_2_002.text:
"Markers" can be used only in patches you already own
and those that share a border with your team's territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_2_003.text:
Once a Marker is used, it can't be dug up again.
So make your decision wisely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_2_004.text:
After using a Marker, you can see whether
you have captured that field at the end of the round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_2_005.text:
Be careful: you must defend your territory to the last round
in order to earn pumpkins from that patch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_001.text: Oh, and more information on the Markers:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_002.text:
You can capture another team's territory by using your Markers,
but be aware that this can be only done to fields next to your territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_003.text:
This works the other way around as well, so remember to
defend your own territory by using Markers when necessary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_004.text:
At the end of the round, each field becomes territory
of the team who drove in the most Markers in the area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_005.text:
Keep in mind that all Markers you use
are reset at the end of each round,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_3_006.text:
and that captured patches become free territory the next turn
if they lose connection to your team's base.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_4_001.text: Now, about the different pumpkin fields in Pumpkin City.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_4_002.text:
There are two types of patches you will find:
"Normal Fields" and "Special Fields."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_4_003.text:
If you manage to capture a 'Normal Field' Pumpkin Patch
and keep it to the end of the Festival,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_001.text:
Special Fields are exactly as their name suggests:
capturing them will earn you special rewards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_002.text:
There are three types of 'Special Fields': 'Large Pumpkin Patches,'
'Magical Pumpkin Patches,' and 'Treasure Pumpkin Patches.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_003.text:
Capturing a 'Large Pumpkin Patch' to the end of the Festival
will reward you with 3 Pumpkins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_004.text:
Capturing a 'Magical Pumpkin Patch' to the end of the Festival
will reward you with only 1 Pumpkin,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_005.text:
but you will also receive a special reward
at the end of every turn you manage to keep it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_006.text:
Capturing a 'Treasure Pumpkin Patch' to the end of the Festival
will reward you with 5 Pumpkins,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_5_007.text:
and an even more special reward
at the end of every turn you manage to keep it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_001.text: You'll want to know what a Consecutive Victory Reward is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_002.text:
Consecutive Victory Rewards are given when you occupy 
the central 'Treasure Pumpkin Patch' and keep it for consecutive rounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_003.text:
Occupying the Patch for a particular number of rounds will 
add on to your rewards. Of course, more rounds mean better rewards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_004.text:
and an even more special reward
at the end of every turn you manage to keep it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_005.text:
Failing to keep your hold on the Treasure Pumpkin Patch
will reset your Consecutive Victory count, remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_006.text:
For example, let's assume that your team captured the
Treasure Pumpkin Patch for three consecutive rounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_007.text:
If you lose the Treasure Pumpkin Patch to another team
on your fourth round, the Consecutive Victory count will reset.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_6_008.text:
Even if you recapture the tile on the fifth round, the count will still be 1.
But remember to balance your strategy - other tiles are important as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_7_002.text:
The Captain who uses the most markers in one turn
will become the Team Leader of their team for the next round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_7_003.text:
Team Leaders will receive 3 Signposts they can use to signal 
to their team members their opinions concerning the strategy of the team.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_7_004.text:
Signposts can be added to a tile, which then can be seen
by other members of the same team.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_7_005.text:
Signposts will be reset every round, 
as another Captain will be chosen as the new Team Leader.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_HELP_7_006.text:
It is not necessary to use Signposts, but keep in mind that
a Signpost cannot be moved to another tile once used.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_1_001.text:
So you are {PLAYER_NAME}, the famous hero captain?
I am Arita, the Witch of the Forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_1_002.text:
Your presence feels familiar...
Is this truly our first meeting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_1_003.text:
Well, no matter.
I came to ask you a favor regarding the festival of Pumpkin City.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_2_001.text:
I see you don't know what it is.
I'll start by explaining about the Four Great Witches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_2_002.text:
We four Great Witches are those who have each mastered
the four elements of magic: fire, water, wind, and earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_2_003.text:
Excluding myself, the other three Great Witches are
Shasha of Fire, Vesper of Water, and Wolfram of the Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_2_004.text:
You will meet everyone soon enough,
so this is all I will tell you for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_3_001.text:
Now, about the Pumpkin City Festival...
Every year, the witches of Pumpkin City hold a grand Pumpkin Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_3_002.text:
Our pumpkins are grown with us Great Witches' magic, you see.
This year we had the best harvest in decades.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_3_003.text:
To commemorate the occasion, it was decided that
one witch would be chosen as this year's PumQueen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_3_004.text:
As expected, Vesper, Wolfram, and Shasha have each
declared herself as the best candidate... and begun fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_4_001.text:
I really don't know why I bother, but to save the festival,
I proposed them a solution:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_4_002.text:
The witch who conquers the most pumpkin 
patches will be crowned PumQueen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_4_003.text:
But thanks to the three idiots' fighting,
most people have already deserted this year's Pumpkin Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_4_004.text:
So you see our predicament, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You must join the festival and bring everything back to order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_5_001.text:
Now, let me explain to you the rules
of "The Great Pumpkin War."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_5_002.text: Huh, where did I put that pamphlet...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_1_6_002.text:
Start for Pumpkin City
before you're late to the festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_2_002.text: I found the pamphlet at last. Ahem...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_2_003.text:
If you find the game too difficult,
come find me any time. I will explain to you the basics.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_INTRO_2_004.text:
And... Don't forget to enjoy yourself.
It is a festival, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_SHASHA_1_1_001.text:
YES! This is what I call a party:
fighting, fighting, and more fighting! Woohoo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_SHASHA_1_1_002.text:
Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for this festival!
I'll show those idiots who's the greatest witch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_SHASHA_1_1_003.text:
Now all I need is more team members
and we can finally begin the battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_VESPER_1_1_001.text:
O lovely pumpkins rolling in the fields...
Be mine, and I shall adore you forever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_VESPER_1_1_002.text: Now, who shall help me claim them...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_VESPER_1_2_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I declare you my knight in battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_WOLFRAM_1_1_001.text:
Sigh...Remind me why we're fooling about like children.
Still, losing won't do me any good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WARGAME_WOLFRAM_1_1_002.text:
This strategy will surely bring me victory...
But I will need more people to ensure success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WEAPON_NOTYET_ADDSLOT_INL.text:
Amazing! I've discovered a way to enhance Soulbound Weapons even
further! I'm still honing the necessary skills, however, so come back later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_1.text:
Whew… Had it not been for you, Goddess Chronos,
we would have fallen into great danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_2.text:
Use this flash grenade
should the Ratmen attempt another attack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_3.text:
You should not find 
the number of flash grenades lacking,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_4.text: We have enough on hand, so use them whenever you need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_5.text:
As these flash grenades activate by mana,
they can also deal damage to other monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_6.text:
I hear of some monsters that
are uniquely affected by this weapon…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_7.text: …but you must find this out on your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_END_1_8.text:
Thank you, Goddess Chronos.
We should have no problems if we follow your instructions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_START_1_1.text: It has grown dark all of a sudden!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_START_1_2.text: This must be the work of the Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_START_1_3.text:
From what I know
of my research on the sewers,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_START_1_4.text:
Ratmen render the passages completely dark
before attacking, to gain advantage over their foe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_START_1_5.text:
I have prepared some equipment
in preparation for such traps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BOMB_GUIDE_END_1_1.text:
I heard that this bomb has a hidden effect
that only activates when attacking certain monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BOMB_GUIDE_END_1_2.text: Let's try to find it out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BOMB_GUIDE_START_1_1.text:
Oh, I just remembered that 
I brought some bombs to help with the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_BOMB_GUIDE_START_1_2.text: Why don't we try using it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_1_START_1_2.text: (You reply that you feel a strange power pervading your senses.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_1_START_1_3.text:
I feel it too…
This power…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_1_START_1_4.text:
Well, it's a good thing because we're stronger, right?
Let's use it to fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_START_1_1.text:
Squueeak?! Everyone, take a look at this!
There's a strange power coming out from this machine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_START_1_2.text:
Maybe it's due to my keen senses of the wilderness,
but I can feel it, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_START_1_4.text: No… It is much more than that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_START_1_7.text:
Okay, okay. We're getting stronger, case closed.
I choose you! Now go defeat the enemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_START_1_9.text:
It does not feel right… But there is no choice.
I am sorry, Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_3_START_1_1.text:
Hmm? This machine is the same one we saw last time!
I could move it…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_3_START_1_2.text:
Ah… The mysterious power in the Palace
belonged to Avenir. That is why it did not work on her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_3_START_1_3.text:
This mana could 
have an effect on Avenir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_MANA_BLOCK_3_START_2_1.text:
As for the brilliant light that Avenir uses…
I think it robs us of our abilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_END_1_1.text: How is it? Do you find it useful?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_END_1_2.text:
This smoke grenade was specially constructed
to deal the most damage to our Shadow Rose friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_END_1_2_1.text:
So use it carefully.
If you waste it, it would be messy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_END_1_3.text:
I will explain later.
Let's finish the battle first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_START_1_1.text:
Oh, wait.
I have what may be a key to turning the tide of the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_START_1_2.text:
This is hardly the time to talk, Rochefort.
There will be time to explain later.

TEXT_DIALOGUE_OCTOPATH_EASTEREGG_1.text:
Saving data in selected slot.
Continue?

TEXT_DIALOGUE_OCTOPATH_EASTEREGG_4.text:
Continent map... Travel records... Items...
Abilities... Equipment...

TEXT_EASTSEA_FISHERY_DESC.text:
The waters of the Far East Sea are very deep.
Look out for some big waves ahead, nya!
Show them who's the best fisherman in Hasla!

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0017_5.text:
My core memory system was damaged
after I saw an unidentified object at the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0017_6.text:
Going to the Primal Volcano seems the best course of action.
There may be data useful to my current state.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0030S_2.text: I know! It needs a pretty stone for decoration.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0030_1.text: Great! Now I finally have enough Spirit Stones to make a necklace.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0030_2.text:
Now I need some leather cords to tie these together.
You can get them for me, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0033_4.text:
Standing around will do no one any good.
Let us take a look around.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0034_1.text:
I have long dreamt of crossing the vast ocean
and discovering new horizons yet unknown to our eyes.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0035_1.text: I hear there are deeper and more dangerous waters.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0037_1.text:
There are stories of creatures
yet unknown to mankind deep under the sea.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0038_1.text:
This shall be our last journey.
We will travel to the deepest abyss this time.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0041_5.text:
I came to guide the lost souls myself,
but they are trapped under some sinister force…

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0041_9.text: First, we must guide the Red Star's soul. Let's go!

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0042_1.text: The next one on the list… is a Mermaid.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0042_2.text:
Hmm… The darkness seems to grow
the deeper we go.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0043_1.text: Next we must guide the souls of Blue Jellyfish.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0043_2.text:
Oh, did you know that
the souls of Blue Jellyfish are quite strange?

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0043_3.text:
Each one is shaped differently.
No soul is the same.

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0044_1.text:
Now we must go find the souls of the Hermit Crabs.
We're almost there!

TEXT_EPIC_DIALOGUES_QUEST_0045_3.text:
We've found almost everyone.
This time we must guide the souls of Shark Warriors.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_1_QUEST_DESC.text: Thank you for offering to help.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_2_QUEST_DESC.text:
The Celebration Ball is far from over.
Let us at least enjoy the time left us.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_2_READY_DESC.text:
How strange everything seems...
To be preparing for a festival as a guest and not a knight.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_3_READY_DESC.text:
I hear the Royal Ball 
is the crown of the festival.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_4_QUEST_DESC.text:
... I do not know yet.
I need some time to clear my mind.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_4_READY_DESC.text: I wonder why His Majesty has summoned us.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_5_QUEST_DESC.text:
Maria may be…a little too mischievous,
but she is a truly good person.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_5_READY_DESC.text: What is this dread that fills my heart?

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_6_QUEST_DESC.text:
I have heard a lot today.
I must have some time to think it over.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_7_READY_DESC.text: I have made up my mind.

TEXT_EVENT_FOURTH_SEQUENCE_8_READY_DESC.text: It is a little complicated, so please focus.

TEXT_FOREST_FISHERY_DESC.text:
There is a pond nearby where you can practice casting your rod.
The fish there should be relatively easy to catch, nya.
The journey of a thousand fish starts with a single minnow, you know!

TEXT_GOAL_S2_MAIN_QUEST_M0001_1.text: Talk with Prestina in the Goddess Room

TEXT_GOAL_S2_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_1.text: Talk with Chronos in the Goddess Room

TEXT_GOAL_S2_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_2.text: Talk with Chronos in the Goddess Room

TEXT_GOAL_S2_MAIN_QUEST_M0009_1.text: Talk with Chronos in the Goddess Room

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_365_1.text: Echidna, you must keep out of other people's sight.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_365_2.text: I'll suffocate if I need to hide any longer!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_367_1.text: Oh, what an adorable lamb. Come here, little one.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_367_2.text: For some strange reason my body moved of its own accord...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_368_1.text: Thor! You were wrong to banish her!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_368_2.text: ... It is not too late. She can return, when the time comes.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_369_1.text:
I do not desire wealth nor power.
I appreciate your offer but must decline it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_369_2.text:
So the rumors are true - you have indeed slain a dragon!
Join me and I promise you riches and glory.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_370_1.text: Hey, Gramps! You're Hansheng, right? I hear you're not too bad at weiqi!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_370_2.text: Hoho, it is as He Xiangu said... You have much to learn, young one.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_371_1.text: You... You are one of those beings who 'cheat Death.'

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_371_2.text: And I shall do so whenever necessary.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_372_1.text: As I've said before, I'm not going to return to that place.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_372_2.text: Don't be so stubborn - why don't you give it another thought?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_373_1.text:
Lady Victoria, every day only increases the empty space
left by your presence...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_374_1.text: ... I will do my best, sire.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_374_2.text: I expect great things from you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_375_1.text: I may not fully agree with you, but it is a beautiful statue...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_375_2.text:
Vice Captain, do you truly understand the beauty of this
statue of our Lady of Light?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_376_1.text: Teresa! How dare you run off! This isn't over yet!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_376_2.text:
What do you mean, 'run off"? You're persistent as ever,
Carol.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_377_1.text: Marpei, wasn't it? Have you gotten some sleep since camp?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_377_2.text:
Who could it be, who could it be... Oh! The girl who always
came in second!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_378_1.text:
Everyone said you were dead! The new Heaven's Cavalry
captain, at your service!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_378_2.text: Oh, you must be Teresa's friend. What are you doing here?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_379_1.text:
Are you so innocent as to believe the dead? They will do
anything to escape their natural fate.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_379_2.text:
You shouldn't be so cruel in guiding the deceased! It's their
last journey.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_380_1.text: This is clearly a western ghost. So it is my soul to take.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_380_2.text: Oh please, I claimed it first!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_380_3.text:
East VS West! Which harbinger of death will win?! 
Find out next time, on Crusaders Quest Z!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_381_1.text: A legendary beauty indeed! A feast for one's eyes!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_381_2.text: Ugh. I feel like something disgusting is looking at me…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_382_1.text: H-ha, ha... Lying? Of course not! T-this is nothing!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_382_2.text:
What graceful steps! I could almost accuse you of
lying about your loss of sight...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_383_1.text: T-that goes for me too, lad. Blind as a bat, I am.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_383_2.text: I... can only see darkness on the path before me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_384_1.text: Oh, dear... Your current host looks especially pathetic, Plaga.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_384_2.text: I say the same goes for you, with all your tattered pages.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_385_1.text: The makings of a true disciple! Master would be glad to know you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_385_2.text: Disciple? Ha! I only came to say that a certain 'blade' seeks you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_386_1.text: Your presence feels familiar. Did you receive Master's blessing, as I did?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_386_2.text: A different... darkness... And yet... It's the same...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_387_1.text: Look upon your tyranny! Is this what our forefathers taught you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_387_2.text: Pride alone cannot keep out the cold. This is for the greater good!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_388_1.text: Patience is a virtue. Masterplans take time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_388_2.text: Odin! When will you keep your promise to find and bring back our captain?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_389_1.text: Wolfgang! Long have I heard of your might! Join me and together we shall pave history!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_389_2.text: I may have departed his army, but my loyalties still lie with King Thor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_390_1.text: You plotting tyrant! Your riches will blind neither me nor my people.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_390_2.text: Haha... You misunderstand me, Prince Odin. Much do I treasure my friendship with your brother, King Thor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_391_1.text: You... It was because of you I ran from my past. Stop laughing like that!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_391_2.text: Lyudmilla? Is that really you? Are you alright?
