TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_392_1.text: I... I am truly sorry. I do not think I can follow the Empire any longer.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_392_2.text: Ksssshh... Soldiers must always follow orders... For the greater good... Ksssshhh…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_393_1.text: Ha ha! Your face! You - you look so serious with all that armor, and - haha!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_393_2.text: ... You really want to be laughing at such a time, Roskva?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_394_1.text: I'm sorry, Vernil. If only I had been a little faster...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_394_2.text: You saved my life, Roskva. I could have been dead - thank you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_395_2.text: Wow, it's Mr. Basquiat! Could I get your autograph?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_396_1.text: You can't suppress art! Let go of my friends!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_396_2.text: Ksssshh...  More... chaos... this mission is of the highest confidentiality... Kssssh…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_397_1.text: Y-you're the legendary mercenary, Viper! I'm a big fan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_397_2.text: You seem to be a young man of much talent! Won't you join us?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_398_1.text: STOP RIGHT THERE! I'm gonna make some top quality bacon out of you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_398_2.text: EEK! It's the butcher! I need to run away! Oink oink!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_399_1.text: Ah, the priestess of the battlefield. You took back many lives that were meant for me, that day.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_399_2.text: Isn't it a given to do whatever you can to save even one more life?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_400_1.text: I only wished to stop it before it killed any more people.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_400_2.text: A dragon hunter, you say. My kinsmen and I are in your debt.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_401_1.text: I do not regret the path I have chosen, sir.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_401_2.text: Ah, Bellerophon. I had the highest hopes for you as one of the Zodiacs.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_402_1.text: I am looking for a lord to whom I can wholeheartedly devote my loyalty.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_402_2.text: Only Lady Athena had the decency not to call me a monster. Won't you go serve her together?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_403_1.text: Long have I heard of your noble name, Lady Athena.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_403_2.text: A hunter with a keen aim and a heart of gold to go with it. Will you not join my forces?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_404_1.text: Huh, a squirrel who can perform magic tricks! Hey, can you even talk?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_405_1.text: You refused to fight for glory! And you call yourself a warrior of Nosgard?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_405_2.text: I only fight to protect. Bloodshed does not hold joy for me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_406_1.text: Death and glory! Life holds meaning only in noble deaths and battles won!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_406_2.text: The heat of the battlefield, the bittersweet taste of blood! Why live if we do not fight?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_407_1.text: If you join the 'Master,' you could fill your remaining nights with eternal youth and beauty.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_407_2.text: Seductive words from a cursed book. And yet... I cannot ignore the sweet offer.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_408_1.text: Ooh, another dragon! It's nice to meet you, rawwwr rawr rawrrr rawr!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_408_2.text: Hmm... I should really tell her I'm not a real dragon.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_409_1.text: Achoo! Even if it's freezing, I still can't give up ice fishing!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_410_2.text: Aah! My fin! Someone save me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_411_1.text: Hrrmph! It's not all about the size, you know!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_411_2.text: Haha, my fish is bigger than yours! Are you sure you're happy with that goldfish?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_412_1.text: Hmm? These are simply 'in' at the moment.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_412_2.text: Those ears...! I had not known that our kin lived to the north.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_413_1.text: Your hat... Its ears move so naturally! How did you make that?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_413_2.text: Hmm... How do I explain this...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_414_1.text: Why do you want to know?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_414_2.text: E-excuse me. Where did you buy your hat?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_415_1.text: The world of dice cuts more sharply than ice and is colder than the deepest winter.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_415_2.text: But isn't that life? HEE HEE!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_416_1.text: You there. Care to play a game of dice by the fire?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_416_2.text: You bet! I never pass up a chance to earn a few coins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_417_1.text: Hrrmph! Stop bossing me around, Sfera! Princesses can do anything these days!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_417_2.text: Echidna, where are you going? You must keep your dignity as royalty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_418_1.text: You're really a bad person, you know that? How did you ever become king?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_418_2.text: How dare the prodigy of a degenerate line talk to me thus! Off with her head!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_419_1.text: Wow, it's an honor to meet you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_419_2.text: Ahem, ahem! Make way for the First Demon Queen!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_420_1.text: Wow, she's wearing cat ears in everyday life. What a weirdo.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_420_2.text: Ooh! I didn't know there was another cat-human, meow!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_421_1.text: Hrrmph! I'm going to beat you with my next album release!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_421_2.text: Wow, what a cute costume! You look so pretty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_422_1.text: Eew! Get off me, creep! This is just a stage thing!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_422_2.text: Kawaii desu ne!!! My waifu just looks so cute with neko-ears!! >-<

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_423_1.text: The vast plains are my kingdom.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_423_2.text: Yet the earth cannot be owned by a single person.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_424_1.text: I have no interest in ruling. I simply wish to live a quiet life with my sister.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_424_2.text: I too had such a dream, once...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_425_1.text: Ooh, this must be one big fish! ... P-p-p… IT'S A PERSON?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_425_2.text: Kek, kek... I fell into the river while reading. You saved my life!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_426_2.text: Oho, you must tell me the secret of your youth!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_427_1.text: Ugh. Pop phonies are the absolute worst.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_427_2.text: You mark my words, you won't survive a single DAY in this world!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_428_1.text: Express your love with this delicious box of chocolates!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_428_2.text: Sob... Romantic holidays make me cry...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_429_1.text: Nobody will refuse this beautiful bouquet of fresh flowers!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_429_2.text: Perhaps your love interest shall appreciate sweet chocolates and cakes!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_430_1.text: These delectable chocolates must be the best dessert in all of the Empire.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_430_2.text: Hmm, this candy could easily represent the culinary culture of the Empire!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_431_1.text: L-Lady Victoria! I have a question to ask you...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_431_2.text: Oh, there you were, Caeneus! I've been meaning to give you these obligatory chocolates.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_432_1.text: W-wait! I'm not a bad dragon! Rawr!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_432_2.text: I-is that another evil dragon? I should go get my GUN.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_433_1.text: RAWR! ... I, I'm a good dragon. Don't hunt me, please!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_433_2.text: Dragons used to be divine creatures of wisdom and magic... There is no need to commit unnecessary slaughter.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_434_1.text: I'm not supposed to take stuff from strangers...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_434_2.text: We all float down here! HEE HEE!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_435_2.text: Was it a cat I saw? Nya!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_436_2.text: Stop that! Come up here and fight me fair and square!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_437_1.text: Wake up, sleepyhead! ... Hmm, I do feel a little tired after today's training...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_438_1.text: Those ghosts... aren't regular ghosts at all! They must be Death Gods!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_438_2.text: Wait, can that girl see us?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_438_3.text: She does not seem an ordinary human… she has spirits obeying her every word.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_439_1.text: Much magic can be found by the moon. Waxing its magic increases, waning it fades away...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_439_2.text: It is only a curse to me. If only I could control this power...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_440_1.text: A girl who can hear the true voices of flowers... She could become a powerful druid!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_440_2.text: If I listen carefully, it almost feels as if I can hear the flowers whispering to me...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_441_1.text: W-wait! I summoned that!! You can't just eat that!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_441_2.text: Ooh, that flower looks really tasty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_442_1.text: I like rain, but none my friends can come out to play. :(

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_442_2.text: Hi there, do you want to share this umbrella?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_443_1.text: I told you to pack more clothes for this trip, Set, so stop complaining!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_443_2.text: We're all going to freeze to death in this bloody climate. Let's go home now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_444_1.text: Vacations are meant to be spent in a warm cabin in the snowy woods!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_444_2.text: Vacations are meant to be spent idly sunbathing at the beach!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_445_1.text: Osiris, you should have dressed more warmly! Stop making me worry!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_445_2.text: B-brr... The northern lands are cold indeed! Yet, the aurora is truly beautiful.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_446_1.text: Well, I was dragged out of my home, so I guess you could say that?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_446_2.text: Were you forced to become a guardian as well?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_447_1.text:
The Shaman of the country of Ryu, are you not?
A heavy burden you carry, the sins of your ancestors...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_447_2.text:
I feel an aura completely
opposite from Kurenai's from you…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_448_1.text:
O King of a Great Kingdom, the sea speaks to no mortal.
It only exists to exist.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_448_2.text:
The legendary seas of the East…
Long have I wished to meet its master.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_449_1.text:
You are a strong man.
May the Sea God always protect you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_449_2.text:
The sea has always remained by my side,
even when my people did not.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_450_1.text:
I see the blessing of water graces us both.
Let's get along well!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_450_2.text: Oho~? A familiar presence! We've met before, haven't we~?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_451_1.text:
...I ended the drought only for my people to drive me out,
accusing me of devilry.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_451_2.text:
The Oracle of Water? Records have you as an
evil witch who used magic to fool people.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_452_1.text: P-please, I can only answer one question at a time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_452_2.text:
Can you really remember your past life? Where, when,
how?! What happened in the past? I must know!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_453_1.text:
Thank you for the ride.
May the sea bless your passage, Captain.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_453_2.text:
Haha, 'tis nothing when you saved my ship and my crew
from the tempestuous waves! Har har har!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_454_1.text:
W-what's happening to me? I'm supposed to get my
revenge, but... My heart's beating so fast!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_454_2.text:
T-that Oni somehow looks familiar…
Did she follow me all the way from the island?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_455_1.text: Aunt Demona! Hee hee, you're still so small.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_455_2.text:
Ah, you must be Ura's daughter! You're all grown up now!
It feels like only yesterday I changed your diapers...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_456_1.text: Ooh, interesting! A squirrel in a human body!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_456_2.text: I sense an evil Oni around here somewhere...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_457_1.text:
I-it's not like that!
Well, I do want Papa's fortune back, but...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_457_2.text:
Why do you approach Lord Momotaro?
Perhaps... you seek to entice him out of his fortune?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_458_1.text: Papa told me not to speak to strangers.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_458_2.text:
Excuse me, miss, but... 
Where did you make such cute animal friends?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_459_2.text:
Huh, I haven't seen an Oni around these parts before!
Where are you from?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_460_1.text: 'Three Kings'... I can't believe the Sun King just let them do that.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_460_2.text: The Sun King? The records we uncovered mentioned no such being.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_461_1.text: The last heir to the royal line of necromancers... Why don't you become a king yourself?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_461_2.text: Ha... It's only bygone history. I'm content with standing by their side.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_462_1.text: You were chosen by the Rosetta Stone. Now you must find your king.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_462_2.text: King? Out of those two? Hahaha!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_463_1.text: Hey there, I've forgotten a LOT after all these years. That's why I came to ask you things!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_463_2.text: History before the Three Great Kings? You must tell me everything!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_464_1.text: This isn't what I wanted. I don't remember how I became like this.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_464_2.text: ... Your heinous crime of stealing life from others shall not go unpunished.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_465_1.text: Erm, perhaps you should look more to the front. I was born a long time ago.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_465_2.text: Huh? Your name isn't documented! This is impossible!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_466_1.text: Yes... Winning IS everything! Master Achilles sure knows everything!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_466_2.text: All is fair in war! Do not hesitate to win, no matter the cost!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_467_1.text: O-one of the leaders of the Resistance Army! Has he figured out about the stolen equipment...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_467_2.text: Woompapa... A flaming axe, interesting. I wonder what materials she used?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_468_1.text: Oh wow, I can't believe you made a freezing grenade with nothing but basic equipment!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_468_2.text: Hee hee, this is nothing. Maybe we can go back to my workshop and talk?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_469_1.text: Hrrmph, you're Master Achilles's archenemy! Like I'll ever trust you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_469_2.text: You have an interesting style. With some proper training, you could become a great fighter.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_470_1.text: I saw some educational programs on a scrapped TV.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_470_2.text: Ooh, your equipment's not half bad! Did you teach yourself?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_471_1.text: I'll become...! The greatest gladiator of all time...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_472_1.text: Oh, Lady Victoria! How kind of you to remember me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_472_2.text: Ah, we've met - the last ball, was it not? I see Jarvis is gallant as always.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_473_1.text: Marry that old geezer? Hrrmph, my Jarvis is a thousand times cuter!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_473_2.text: ... I should have foreseen the trouble that comes with arranged marriage.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_474_1.text: Jarvis and I are properly in love! Don't you dare compare us to you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_474_2.text:
A fellow pursuant of forbidden love, I see. 
Shall we become friends?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_475_1.text:
Who is that eyeing my Jarvis!? ... Maybe I 
should shoot her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_475_2.text:
Ooh, a cat in a suit, nya!
So very handsome, nya!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_476_1.text:
Mamba, how could you have forgotten me? 
I'm never going to forgive you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_476_2.text:
What a beautiful lady. Malkah might resemble 
her if she took off her mask...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_477_1.text:
Grrr... That old man... How dare he take 
Mamba away from me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_477_3.text:
Mamba, do you have any idea why that lady 
is glaring at me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_479_1.text:
Thanks for the agreeing with me, but I think it's 
a fundamentally different matter?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_479_2.text:
Gon know how your heart hurt... Foxy leave home, 
and no come back. I go find him.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_480_1.text: Huh, I sense a large snake nearby.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_480_2.text:
Erm... That's weird. I feel compelled to do 
whatever that lady says…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_481_2.text: Anzu... I-I'm actually a raccoon in disguise! I'm sorry I hid the truth from you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_482_1.text: I don't even remember it properly. It still makes me sad to think about it, but it's alright... I have a new home now, as well as a new friend.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_482_2.text: The flames of sin that covered all of Ryu... would have burned down your village as well. I am sorry I couldn't stop them in time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_483_1.text: Huhu, no, thank you. I already have a good teacher back home.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_483_2.text: Hey, you're not half bad! I hadn't expected someone like you back home. Why don't you try applying for a foreign scholarship, like me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_484_1.text: Oh, it's not a scary place at all. It's just too comfortable and cozy so that you simply don't want to leave.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_484_2.text: The Forest of Eternal Autumn... I hear that once you step in, you can't get out again. If I succeed in conquering it, I'll become even more famous!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_485_1.text: D-did she see through me? But my transformation should be perfect!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_485_2.text: You have a strange aura about you. Almost as if you were... not exactly human...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_486_1.text: The same goes for you! Why are you in a human body, little squirrel?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_486_2.text: Oh, you're a transformed raccoon! Huhu, you can't fool me~

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_487_1.text: Ooh~! Whatever that man's holding... It smells really delicious!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_487_2.text: Huh, I wonder why that ninja's drooling over this dog treat?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_488_1.text: So it is you, the one who sent Vaisravana to me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_488_2.text: 'The son of ghosts'... So I was called in my childhood. I wish to help you, for we share the same fate.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_489_1.text: Huhu... You remain innocent, for all the spirits you have guided to the Other Realm.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_489_2.text: It's not too late. You must get out of the land of the dead!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_490_1.text: Is that so? Try us - if you dare.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_490_2.text: Hrrmph. I knew I would have trouble with you. I'd always said that you needed to be led away at once...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_491_1.text:
They are my only kin. 
I thought you, of all people, would understand.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_491_2.text: T-the ghosts around you... They're not friendly at all. I don't think I can even listen to what they have to say...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_492_1.text: The life I have led is mine, and mine alone. Dare not deem it yours to seek your own peace of mind.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_492_2.text: The lands of our people... have been disturbed due to my absence. How will I ever atone for the sorrows I have caused you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_493_1.text: Output: Comparison shows my artistic techniques are superior to yours.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_493_2.text: Robots doing 'art', ha! There are some things in the world that only human hearts can understand!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_494_1.text: Output: Signals are incomprehensible and cannot be analyzed. Asking for assistance.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_494_2.text: I detect strange signals from you. Signals of... guilt...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_495_1.text: Output: Do you understand the value of this painting?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_495_2.text: Positive. Colors used in image: 82. Patterns analyzed in form: random.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_496_1.text: Output: In the middle of conversation. Do not interrupt.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_496_2.text: What's this stupid shield?! Get it out of face right now!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_496_3.text: V... Gueronica. Have you too developed 'emotions'?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_497_2.text: ... I refuse that title. P-00? It seems to be a model equipped with the A.I. of the R-series...

TEXT_INTERACTION_LIBRARY_1_1.text: You aren't causing any trouble to the Captain, are you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_LIBRARY_1_2.text: I'm doing much better than you, all alone in this library.

TEXT_ROMAN_FISHERY_DESC.text:
Near the Peaks of Glory are some old ruins, near which is a lake.
There should be bigger fish here than in the forest,
so prepare well before you go, nya!

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0002_0001.text:
Who would have thought of meeting a girl in the woods?
Perhaps this is also destiny as ordained by Cora.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_0001.text:
Let's think of the places she could have run off to
before we decide where to go.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0002.text:
I wonder what I would have done without you.
Now, let's quickly make preparations for departure.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0001.text:
Well… I would have never expected, in all my life,
to be accused of being a criminal.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0002.text:
First a suspicious laboratory,
now the tyranny of the Shadow Roses…

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0003.text:
I must admit, Trista is a little different
from the kingdom in the stories I have heard.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0001.text:
It is thanks to Rochefort that we are alive.
Whoever knew we would be accused of being demon worshippers…?

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0002.text: Yet now, everything is clear to me.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0003.text:
The kingdom of Trista… has fallen far below
the teachings of Elanuma.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0001.text:
It is a relief that we found Ellie safe and sound.
But it is true that we cannot leave the Ratmen as they are.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0002.text:
We must fix what the human race has done wrong,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0008_0001.text:
How are you feeling?
I too have recovered after some sleep.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0008_0002.text:
Artificial gods, other Elards…
I can only wonder what is coming of all this.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0009_0001.text:
There are still many things for us to do, but…
At the very least, Ellie seems much happier now.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0009_0002.text: And that is one joy that we must be grateful for.

TEXT_S2_COMPLETE_MAIN_QUEST_M0009_0003.text:
In the meantime… We must not forget about the lost children,
and the woman who called herself the Kalard.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0002_0001.text: It has been some time since I left the forest…

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0002_0002.text: …and had adventures that I would not have dreamt of having.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0002_0003.text:
Do you think the forest will have remained the same?
Or will it have changed? Either way, I am glad to return.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_0001.text:
Oh! That reminds me - we have forgotten a very important task
in the confusion of moving to Impelis.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_0002.text:
Yes - paying a visit
to the current Chancellor of Grancia.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_0003.text:
We should have visited sooner,
after finishing our move.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0003_0004.text:
Should we go together to see her, 
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0001.text: The city is large. How will we find her?

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0002.text:
You are right. As you need passports for identification
to go farther inwards to the center of the city…

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0003.text:
As the child does not have any,
she should still be near the outskirts of the city.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0004.text:
(You suggest that she may have returned to
the forest where it is familiar, since she is not used to the city.)

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0005.text:
Yes, I think that as well.
Let's go in the direction of the Eastern Woods, then.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0004_0006.text:
If she has indeed returned to the forest,
it will be easier to track her steps.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0002.text:
The kingdom of Trista is renowned in Hasla
for its exquisitely luxurious culture.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0003.text:
Yet it is also a city of religious faith: the founding king of Trista
was a devoted believer of the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0004.text:
People used to say that if Cora had blessed 
Elandia with her right hand, she blessed Trista with her left.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0005_0005.text:
I don't know whether to be worried or excited to be visiting.
Perhaps I am both.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, 
we have received a message from Rochefort.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0002.text:
The Shadow Roses are punishing innocent civilians
without discretion in the Central Square of Trista…

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0003.text:
How can this be…?
Do you think the king has truly ordered this?

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0004.text:
The Central Square was once called Elanuma Square.
It was built as an offering to the Goddess.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0005.text:
I cannot believe it can be the setting
for such a massacre.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_0006.text:
Let us leave for Trista.
We may be fugitives, but we must help them.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0001.text: We should go join the Musketeers.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0002.text:
I do not wish to hide
when we have done nothing wrong…

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0003.text:
But our presence may endanger the others.
Meeting them and absolving our names is our priority.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0007_0004.text: Should we go to the sewers, then?

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0008_0002.text:
I am afraid of what may be awaiting us
in the laboratory…

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0008_0003.text:
No. Do not mind me.
I must not be nervous when my path is so clear.

TEXT_S2_DIALOGUES_MAIN_QUEST_M0009_0001.text:
Let us go see Chronos.
We must consult with her of what has happened.

TEXT_S2_MAIN_QUEST_M0006_TITLE.text: The Truth of the Shadow Rose

TEXT_S2_SUB_QUEST_Q0030_TITLE.text: The Last of the Shadow Roses

TEXT_S2_SUB_QUEST_Q0031_TITLE.text: The Last of the Shadow Roses

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_001.text:
Gasp... W-we didn't just die, right?
Please don't tell me we've died and come to the real hell.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_002.text:
... No, it seems we are still alive.
In Hell Island, and not hell.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_003.text:
The beanstalk provided protection
against serious injury, as Lady Rachel predicted.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_004.text:
That was fun♡
Can we pleeeeaase do that one more time?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_005.text:
... No, it's dangerous!
Anyway. Is this it? Is everything over?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, thanks for everything. I really 
wasn't expecting... well, everything that happened today.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_008.text:
I'll ask His Devilship
to give you an ample reward.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_009.text:
Tell that old geezer to come and find me
before he tries anything else!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_010.text: Princess Vivian, please stop being so angry...!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_011.text:
Haha, the Devil folk
are always so cheerful.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_END_1_012.text:
Well done, {PLAYER_NAME}.
We too should head back home.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_001.text: M-m-milady! I, I mean, Princess Vivian!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_002.text: Huh? Jack! Wow, it's been a while.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_004.text: How did you know where to find us?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_005.text: W-well, I did have orders from Lord Gordian, His Devilship.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_006.text:
His Devilship is always aware
of your whereabouts, Princess Vivian...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_007.text:
Ugh, that creep. 
And when are you going to stop calling me 'princess'?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_008.text: I'm the new Devil King, you know! The Prime Devil!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_009.text: Then I want to be the princess!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_010.text: ... Anyway, what did the old man want?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_1_011.text: His Devilship wanted me to deliver a letter to you...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_2_001.text:
A letter? Tch, if he wanted something from me,
he should have come in person…

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_001.text:
My darling daughter Vivian.
How are you doing?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_002.text:
I hear you're being called
'the Absolute Devil' these days.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_003.text:
Daddy's so proud that you've finally
come to your senses, sweetheart.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_005.text:
The reason I'm writing to you is...
Jack has made a mess of things there.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_006.text:
Let me explain what exactly happened,
before you jump to conclusions...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_10_0.text:
You mean... You traded our prized King Cow
for merely... three... beans...?

Hold up. Let's say that we really do plant these beans.
Then what will we live on until they finish growing? Hmm?
U-um, maybe we could try... photosynthesis?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_11_0.text:
Calm down? CALM DOWN?
Do you have any idea how dearly I cared for that cow?

I raised him like one of my own... It tormented me to part with him!
And for what? Beans! Sob, my poor King Cow!
Throw these away! I don't want to see them!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_12_0.text:
Wah! Bo, Beanie, Sweet Pea!
Lord Gordian! You can't just throw them away!

... You NAMED them? Stop sobbing, Jack!
I'm the one who feels like crying!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_13_0.text:
This feels like... as if
something gigantic is growing from underground!

C-could it be that the fertilizer and the earth of Hell Island
are affecting the Royal Beans in some way...?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_1_00.text: Bloody Rose Jack. Your quest is one of utmost importance.

King Cow... My prized beast.
He is the last remaining treasure of the House of Devilius.

Although I must part with this beloved creature
due to... financial difficulties,

You must ensure that he at least... Sob...
meets a good owner in my stead.

O-of course, Your Devilship!
I'll make sure to get a good price for her!

Oh, and don't forget to buy something delicious to eat
on the way home. ... Now, go forth, O Bloody Rose.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_2_00.text:
... Whoever knew the Fearsome Four
would eat out my hearth and home?

I should have suspected the reason behind
my financial difficulties...

Sigh... Well, at least with the money I get for King Cow,
we won't have to live on bean dishes for some time.

I'm so sorry, my pretty King Cow...
It's not as if I could ever eat you...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_3_00.text: Umm... What to do, what to do...

How am I supposed to know
how to sell a cow?

Sob... And I can't just ignore a quest
ordered by Lord Gordian himself...

Hey, you there!
Are you going to the market to sell that fine specimen of a cow?

W-well, yes, but...
Who are you?

My name's Lenny! A farmer by trade.
And it seems it's your lucky day!

I'm thinking of opening a new business soon,
you see.

The last piece of my operation relies on animals:
farm animals that will help me plow and grow!

How about it? I'll give you a good price for that cow there.
Won't you sell him to me?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_4_00.text:
R-really? Wow!
I-I was at a loss as what to do, to be honest. Thank you so much!

Hee hee, no problem. I couldn't ignore a Haslanian in need,
and it's a win-win situation for both of us!

Um, how much will you give me for the cow?
I-I don't really know much about the prices of farm animals...
Hmm... Let me take a look at him.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_5_00.text:
Healthy... An bull of the Holstein breed...
Lustrous hide... Strangely striking presence full of bovine dignity...

I'll be generous with you, since you seem nice.
Say... How about five grand?

Five... Five thousand Gold?
T-that doesn't sound right...

Sigh... I'm sorry,
but I don't think this is going to work out.

Hey, hear me out!
I haven't finished telling you about the... additional perks.

I did say five grand, but that's just the commission fee.
You didn't hear me out on my REAL offer.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_6_00.text:
Huhuhu... So you know what these are.
I knew you had a good eye as soon as I saw you.

Royal Beans! The legendary beans protected as a royal secret,
known and grown only by the most secretive Elves of Hasla!

So, how about it? You do know these beans are so rare, 
they can't be bought for all the money in... a small kingdom.

Purchase now and you'll receive an exclusive package of
special plant fertilizer, developed by yours truly!

Just a few drops, and you'll end up with more Royal Beans
than you know what to do with!
I-I'll take them! Here, here's the cow!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_7_00.text:
...
Hee hee... It's MY lucky day, indeed!

Has she been living under a rock? It's been ages since
the Golden Archers revealed the Royal Bean specimen to the public.

I'd thought I'd pack some extra to bargain with the Dryads...
But now, this is a MUCH more profitable deal!

Now, time to go back to Hasla
with this beauty of a cow!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_8_00.text: Lord Gordian! Your Devilship! I've returned!

O Bloody Rose Jack. Have you returned at last?
You have done well.

...
Where's the food I asked for?

Here they are, Your Devilship!
You'll love them!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_3_9_00.text: Beans? And there are only three.

Ha... ha... ha... Very funny. Now stop joking around
and show me what you really bought.

I-I'm not joking. T-these are Royal Beans,
I was told they are very valuable, Your Devilship.

And if we use this fertilizer, we'll end up with more Royal Beans
than we know what to do with! That's what the farmer told me!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_4_002.text:
What?! Are you serious??
You sold our cow, planted some beans, then what came out?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_4_003.text: And what do you want us to do about it?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_4_004.text:
W-well... That is...
Erm, to summarize...!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_001.text:
The beans received too much fertilizer,
and now the beanstalk won't stop growing.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_002.text:
Please cut down the beanstalk!
It's literally growing out of hand!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_003.text:
THIS is what he wants help with?
And dragging {PLAYER_NAME} into the mess, no less?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_004.text:
Can't believe the old man has grown this lame.
I mean, he's still a former Devil King!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_005.text:
Forget it!
You guys take care of it on your own!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_006.text:
Erm, it is technically a beanstalk, but...
You'll have to see it for yourselves.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_5_007.text: I... I really think you should see for yourselves...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_001.text: Vivi, Jack was one of the Elite Four, right?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_002.text:
Yeah, though I definitely prefer the 'Bloody 
Rose Jack,' from way back when.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_003.text:
Well, to see Jack this worried...
I think it might be worth checking out.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_004.text:
And anyway, it's been years since I last visited Hell Island!
It'll be a nice trip back home with you, Vivi!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_005.text:
Hmm... It doesn't sound too bad when you put it like that.
Rachel, you're too sweet for your own good!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_007.text: Tee hee, call me Princess, please!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_008.text:
So, {PLAYER_NAME}.
How about you? You gonna come with us?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_009.text: ... It may turn out to be a more serious problem than we expect.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_INTRO_6_010.text:
We should accompany them,
lest the problem grows out of hand, so to speak.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_001.text:
Whew.. That was one big beanstalk.
With its equally big spores and annoying roots...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_002.text:
How did it become so monstrously big in the first place?
It's literally touching the clouds.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_003.text:
Whew~ It's still a relief, though.
I couldn't have stopped it without your help!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_004.text:
I don't think it will move any more,
so we can cut it down now!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_005.text:
The sheer size of the plant did surprise me,
but I'm glad it didn't provide too much trouble.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_006.text:
It's time for us to return now.
Well done, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_1_007.text:
Still can't believe our stupid old man didn't even show 
his face after causing this much trouble for us!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_002.text: Ugh, that caught me by surprise!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_003.text:
Judging from the size of the tree,
it will be dangerous for us to remain here when it falls.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_004.text:
We should leave the premises immediately
and return later to take care of the rest!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_005.text:
I think so too! Let's leave right now!
I'm really tired.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_006.text:
But, Milady... Look!
The way back has been blocked with vines.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_007.text:
When did that happen?
What should we do now?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_008.text:
Hmm... We could climb up the tree
and attempt to check our whereabouts.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_2_009.text: We should be able to find a way out more easily.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_3_002.text:
Hnnngh... I don't think I can walk another step.
Vivi, I'm tired~

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_3_003.text:
Oh, no! Hang in there a little longer, Rachel!
I'll give you a piggyback ride on the way down!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_3_004.text:
...Hmm. I think we're high enough.
Time to search for a way back.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_4_001.text:
I-it really is huge.
It's grown all the way up to the sky.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_4_002.text:
I see. We've come a long way...
And it's still a long way to the top.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE2_4_003.text:
Jack!
Something's coming your way, watch out!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_001.text: ... Whew. It seems to have stopped for now.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_002.text: Do beanstalks of Hell Island have arms?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_003.text:
Erm, n-not at all!
We grow the same plants as people of the continent.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_004.text:
Sob... I still can't believe my dear Beanie
turned into a monster.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_005.text: Beanie? You gave the bean a name?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_006.text:
Of course. Growing plants requires
not only hard work but also love and affection.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_007.text:
I named them Beanie, Sweet Pea, and Bo!
Aren't they cute little names?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_008.text:
... Please don't tell me that we're going to have to
fight the other bean-monsters.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE3_1_009.text:
Please, Vivi! Don't raise any flags!
Things like that always come to pass!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_1_001.text: ... We did it, right? Is it finally over?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_1_002.text: Jack. How many beans did you say you'd planted?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_1_003.text:
Huh? Erm, there was Beanie... We just defeated Sweet Pea...
And... There's Bo. Bo's still left.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_1_006.text:
Erm, Bo's reaaaally nice.
Maybe she'll just send us off nice and quiet...?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_1_007.text: ... Oh, dear. It seems we'll have to fight another battle.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_2_002.text: Argh, it's pelting us from above!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_2_003.text:
I've had enough, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's climb above and put an end to this mess!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_3_001.text: Whew... Seems we've finally reached the top.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_3_002.text:
The buildings below seem small as ants.
Who knew plants could grow so tall? I can only marvel.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_3_003.text:
Erm, h-how are we going to get down?
I... I don't think I ever told you about my fear of heights...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_3_004.text:
Hmm~ We could slide down the beanstalk
when it topples over!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_HW1_STAGE4_3_006.text:
Where is that thing anyway?
Bo, did you call it?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_036_EN.text: The Artificial Goddess Avenir... and Ellie.

What could be the significance of the Temple of Illusions 
reacting to the two of them?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_036_ST.text:
While researching the appearance of the Temple of
Illusions, we learned there was a strange pulsing of power.

We succeeded in tracing the pulse back to its point of 
origin... It came from the Hidden Palace of Trista.

It must have something to do with our fight with the
Artificial Goddess.

{PLAYER_NAME}. Could you return to the Hidden Palace
and see if you can discover the cause of this?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_037_EN.text:
It is old and threadbare, but I can tell... 
This is the braveman our tribe has worn for generations.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_037_ST.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, have you ever taken a close look at 
the clothing worn by the mummies of the Temple?

It is the custom of our tribe for the bravest warriors to wear 
a single piece of cloth around their waist.
The name of the cloth can be translated into 'braveman.'

On our way, I noticed the mummies wearing something 
akin to the braveman of our people.

Please bring back the attire of the mummies. 
I... I must see them more closely.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_038_EN.text:
It's as I thought... They were being controlled through 
necromancy. But nobody seems to be controlling them...

As tiring all this is, I guess I'll have to free them from their 
curse. If you defeat any more monsters, bring them to me.

... I wonder if this was the role meant for me
mentioned in the prophecy of the Rosetta Stone...

Huh! Look at you smiling, Set!
So you DID want to be a part of the prophecy! Ha!
Haha, you're one of us now!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_038_ST.text:
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}. Go and catch some monsters if 
you're not too busy. There's something I need to check.

Set! {PLAYER_NAME} isn't your friend! 
You should ask nicely, with manners!
Ugh, fine, fine. So are you going to do it or not?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_039_EN.text:
The Tomb King's robes were but an elaborate copy
of the real royal robes.

How dare he assume the name of the King. Don't under-
stand why he'd go unpunished in a Temple of a Goddess.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_039_ST.text:
How strange... The Tomb King is wearing formal clothes 
only worn by the kings of the Desert Kingdom.
Surely the throne wouldn't have succeeded underground...

{PLAYER_NAME}, we should defeat the Tomb King
and look at his clothes more closely.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_040_EN.text:
Hmm... It seems they were somehow transformed through 
a refining skill that's usually only used for sand and stone...

They probably grew in order to fit their expanding outer 
layers. But why did our ancestors leave them like this?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_040_ST.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, do you have a minute? Have you ever 
seen scarabs and cobras that big before?

I thought so. They are common pets for people of 
the Desert, but I've never seen any of THAT size.

I wish I could know why - or how - they became so massive. 
Could you catch a couple for me?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_041_EN.text:
Yes... These patterns are the traditional tattoos of the
Desert Tribe.

These mummies... are our ancestors.
Or were our ancestors, once.

Was it their fate to become such monsters
after the falling of the Kingdom?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_041_ST.text:
The 'bravemen' worn by the mummies...
The closely copied robes of the Tomb King...

Everything seems too much of a coincidence.
I have a bad feeling about this...

{PLAYER_NAME}, go and bring back some monsters for
me.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_042_EN.text:
... This is ... It is the true lioness mask, 
the mask that belonged to Queen Sekhmet herself.

Has she been lingering here as a mere sentry all these
years?

Who could have done this to the Three Kings of the 
Desert?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_042_ST.text:
The lioness mask is a symbol of Queen Sekhmet,
one of the Three Great Kings of our people.

She was called the 'Queen of Vengeance'
for her fierceness in vanquishing enemies of the Kingdom.

The Queen disappeared when the Kingdom fell to ruin. 
A century has passed since then; that cannot be her.

She must be false, like the Tomb King we encountered
before.

{PLAYER_NAME}. 
Please defeat her and bring back her mask.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_043_EN.text:
Who would've guessed that the shadows in the distance
were human beings?

They must be descendants of the original workers of the
Temple.
But how did they grow to be so tall...?

Maybe something within the Temple had to do something
with it.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_043_ST.text:
This quarter of the Temple truly is beautiful.
I can't help but be awed by our ancestors' craftmanship.
... Except for that pillar blocking my line of sight over there!
{PLAYER_NAME}, won't you go with me and see what it is?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_044_EN.text: ... Now that was a BIG bird.

First a giant, now a bird of that size...
Everything seems to be out of proportion in this place.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_044_ST.text:
Oh, look! It's a heron!
... Here in an underground Temple, of all places.

One of the most beautiful birds I have ever seen. Haha, it's
coming our way. Maybe I should feed it something.
Huh? W-wait a minute. That heron is bigger than I thought...!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_045_EN.text:
This is a chimera, a hybrid creature artificially created 
through the body parts of various animals.

I find it rather fitting that such a creature had been guarding 
the vile secrets of the Kingdom. Don't you?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_045_ST.text:
The Ammut is a mythical beast said to devour the hearts of 
the dead, especially those of sinners. It is a desert legend.

In my childhood, I couldn't sleep at night after hearing tales 
about the Ammut, who would eat up naughty children.

And to see a childhood fear physically exist before my
eyes...

If it were not for you, {PLAYER_NAME}, I really might have
run away.

I must admit, I am still rather uncomfortable. I suppose it is 
one of the dangers I must overcome on our path.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_046_EN.text:
I'd thought that they had too lavish decorations for mere
dogs.
This is a mark belonging to the Protectors of Anubisis.
I'd heard that they all disappeared when the Kingdom fell...
Could these dogs be the former warriors of the Royal Army?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_046_ST.text: Ugh. These dogs are a nuisance.
I'll teach them who's the alpha around here.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_047_EN.text:
This wing decoration belongs to the Priests of Horus.
There is no mistaking it.

Could it be... that all the monsters we fought on the way
were, in truth, our ancestors?

It doesn't make sense.
The Goddess would not have left them like this.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_047_ST.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, I have to find something out.

Those birds might be our transformed ancestors, like the
Protectors of Anubisis.
You'll help me examine them, right?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_048_EN.text:
... With this, all of the Three Kings are lain to rest among
the golden sand of our fallen kingdom.

It is time that we too take a step from our dark history
towards a brighter future.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_048_ST.text:
King Anubisis... Like Queen Sekhmet,
he too has become a slave to this Temple.
We, as their heirs, must break the chains of their sins.

{PLAYER_NAME}. Help us find our sires
the eternal rest they rightfully deserve.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_049_EN.text:
Their bodies must have grown to this size
in order to adapt to the mana controller devices.
It must have been painful... I can't bear to look at them.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_049_ST.text: We must investigate the test subjects' bodies more closely.

{PLAYER_NAME}, could you help me
defeat Test Subjects Alpha and examine them?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_050_EN.text:
They must have been trying to increase its tolerance 
to mana through continuous exposure...

It seems the experiment was a failure. The test subject 
must have lost its mind due to the high levels of mana.
What did our ancestors think to do such a thing...?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_050_ST.text: Do you see the stone slab that test subject is holding?

It seems different from the mana controlling devices
embedded in the others.
Could it be made of obsidian?
{PLAYER_NAME}, go and bring me a few.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_051_EN.text:
If it had been guarding the Temple entrance together with 
Camilla Banoub, we may have never entered the Temple.

It seems just as strong, at the very least.
Why was it not made a Guardian, then...?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_051_ST.text:
Be careful, {PLAYER_NAME}. That test subject seems far 
stronger than any other that we encountered on the way.

Perhaps it was close to becoming the other Guardian of
this Temple.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_052_EN.text: Oh no... It's exactly like test subject Alpha.

The overflowing mana couldn't find a way out and gathered 
to his legs... which disfigured under the pressure.

How could a human being do such things to another?
The conductors of this experiment are the true monsters.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_052_ST.text: That silhouette... It didn't look human at all.

A-ahhh! It's back! 
Help me fight, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_053_EN.text: Ugh... At times like these I loathe my imagination.

I can't believe they were alive all these years in that
condition.
It may be just as well that we helped them finally die.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_053_ST.text:
That thing in the glass case... 
It shouldn't be... No...
It can't be... what I think it is...?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_054_EN.text: I do not know whether Jeraphim was 'good' or 'evil.'

Yet I know one thing for certain - Ellie's sacrifice to save 
both us and the continent of Hasla was an act of pure good.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_054_ST.text:
Wait, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I sense a great surge of mana before us.
Now the time has come to unveil the last of the truths.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_042_END.text:
Thanks! Ugh, thinking of them still gives me the creeps.
I would rather fight a vicious monster than do that again.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_042_STA.text:
Ugh. Some weirdos seem to be copying us for some
reason!
How in the world did they make those clothes?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_043_END.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
One moment more and it would have been too late.

... I know it's a sudden request,
but could I follow you on your journey, {PLAYER_NAME}?

I know that the Desert is dangerous, and I have a feeling 
you'll be good company, {PLAYER_NAME}.

I'd like to see the world with you, {PLAYER_NAME}, and 
see all the architecture of different civilizations.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_043_STA.text: Hello! I hear you are the great {PLAYER_NAME}.

A friend of mine entered the Temple some time ago. 
He wanted to see the embalming skills of the Kingdom,

but it's been a few days and I'm growing worried for him.
Can you help me find him?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_044_END.text:
Thank you for aiding us in protecting 
the honor of our people, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_044_STA.text:
For the last hundred years, we have refused to choose 
a new king out of reverence for the Three Great Kings.

This 'Tomb King,' as he so calls himself, is a disgrace to our
heritage. Any remains of him must be destroyed.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_045_END.text:
Thank you. One of my fingers is a little short, you see,
and I always wear a glove to attract less attention.
As a sign of my gratitude, let me lend you my strength.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_045_STA.text: I am Keyab, a wandering warrior of the Desert.

I found an adorable little puppy... ahem, a stray dog
while exploring the Temple of Illusions.

I was about to pet it when it suddenly bit off my glove
and ran away with it.

I can't find it anywhere, and that glove is very special to
me. Could you look for it together?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_046_END.text:
I had been guessing that the man had been bitten by 
a scarab, but it seems I was wrong.

I'd never known that you can acquire special powers
through insect bites. Especially tarantula bites.
I wonder where the tarantula came from? Hmm.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_046_STA.text:
An archaeologist in my crew told me something strange
today.

He saw a man creating a ruckus in the Temple. Apparently, 
he was shouting something about being bit by an insect...

Perhaps he contracted some strange disease? 
{PLAYER_NAME}, why don't we go and take a look?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_047_END.text: That's more like it, {PLAYER_NAME!} Now, let's see...

"Queen Sekhmet was one of the Three Great Kings,
the leader of the enchanters of the Desert Kingdom...

... Unlike the two Kings who were born into it, the Queen
received the crown through the respect of her people."

An impressive figure indeed.
Yet her title of '"the Queen of Vengeance" seems rather off.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_047_STA.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! 
Have you heard of the Royal Records of the Desert?

It is said that the scribes of the Desert Kingdom took 
close notes on important affairs of the state...

...and collected them into volumes. I am sure that there is 
a volume on the Three Kings somewhere...

Good luck? What do you mean?
You're coming with me, aren't you {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_048_END.text:
"The Queen was ruthless when defeating the foes. She 
punished them so cruelly even her own people feared her.

"Yet the Queen only thought her cruel visage was a good 
shield against her foes in order to protect the Kingdom.

"And so Queen Sekhmet hid her face behind a lioness 
mask and chose to be called the 'Queen of Vengeance'."
It was her own choice to be called the Queen of Vengeance.

I find it rather tragic. She chose what she thought was best 
for her people. And the truth lay hidden all these years...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_048_STA.text:
There seem to be more pages after this. Since you're
helping out already, we could search for them together!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_049_END.text: May the souls of our ancestors find peace at last...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_049_STA.text:
The Tribe of Anubisis are warriors by blood. They fought by 
the side of kings as their guards for generations.

Needless to say, they sought honor in battle beyond any 
other thing... It hurts me to see them in their current state.

...Set is a descendant of the Anubisis Tribe. He has not said 
much, but I think he may be upset. More so than myself.

{PLAYER_NAME}, please help our ancestors break 
their curse and find dignity in eternal rest.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_050_END.text: Perhaps this will make him feel better.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_050_STA.text:
Hey there, {PLAYER_NAME}.
If you aren't busy, come over here for a second.
The Priests of Horus... are Osiris's people. His ancestors.

Look at them. Neither dead nor alive,
with their bodies converted into flying machines...

He may not have known them personally, but he probably
feels... uncomfortable seeing them like that.

Help me fight.
Let's give some long-needed rest to his ancestors.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_051_END.text:
With this, the Ammut has become a creature
found only in the legends of old.

Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}! 
Now I should be able to sleep better at night!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_051_STA.text:
Ugh... I know it was artificially created by humans,
but just looking at that Ammut is very disturbing.

{PLAYER_NAME}, could you help with 
cleaning up the remains of Ammut?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_052_END.text: Thanks to your help, I took a good look around the Temple.
Huh? You want to know how I hurt my leg?

Haha, stop looking so worried! This is a wound of honor.
A battle-wound that I got on my adventures. I'm keeping it.

You know, I realized something during our travels, 
{PLAYER_NAME}.

If I go with you, I have a feeling I'll be able to go places.
Interesting places. Care if I join you for a while?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_052_STA.text:
I'm traveling throughout Hasla
in search of adventure.

I heard about the Temple of Illusions and came all the way 
to see it for myself, but you see, my leg's not helping...

You know, we probably met for a reason.
Could you help me enter the Temple of Illusions?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_053_END.text:
Hmm... Their skills were admittedly good, but digging holes 
in the ground does not exactly equal fine architecture.
I wish to build a tower that reaches the heavens.

Building a temple so deeply underground simply isn't what I 
am looking for. Nor is it good for your lungs.

Perhaps the architecture of other civilizations
will provide more... inspiring.

{PLAYER_NAME}, can I accompany you
so as to gather more references for my tower?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_053_STA.text:
I am Nebuchadnezzar, an architect with a dream
of building the tallest tower in the world.

I heard that the architecture of the Ancient Desert Kingdom
is highly refined and worth studying.

Could you take me inside the Temple of Illusions so that I
may see if there are any notable references within?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_054_END.text: Oh, you found it! Let's see...

"King Anubisis was one of the Three Great Kings,
the leader of the necromancers of the Desert Kingdom.

"His deadly twin knives were the bane of many a foe in the 
battlefields. Yet one day, King Anubisis proclaimed...

that he had received a prophecy. He threw away his knives 
and built a laboratory, locking himself in."
What could King Anubisis have studied in his laboratory?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_054_STA.text: The royal scribe must have left records on him somewhere...

Perhaps they will speak of the last of the Three Kings.
Let's go and see!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_055_END.text:
"...In his underground laboratory, the King and his necroma-
ncers developed technologies that refined sand and stone,

providing the foundation of our Kingdom in the Desert. It is 
considered one of King Anubisis's greatest feats.

Yet his utter secrecy rendered him incomprehensible to 
most of his people. He spent his days alone and feared."

King Anubisis must have been a great king indeed to have
advanced the technology of his kingdom to such levels.

It's ironic that such a magnificent civilization
fell to ruin in such a short period of time.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_055_STA.text:
I wonder what King Anubisis researched...?
Aren't you curious, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Let's hurry and find the next page!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_056_END.text: What a disaster. The desk broke due to its age...

Now the journal entries are scattered everywhere.
Should we start reading the ones we already have?

"Entry - 1 : Year ---, Month -- Day --. After many failures,
we finally succeeded in attaching a mana controller
to Test Subject 512 without further complications.

It also assumed a stable, physical form
even after taking in all mana from Storage 2.

My colleagues have named Test Subject 512 'Omega' and 
are celebrating. Could this be our final experiment?"

Could Test Subject 512 be referring to Camilla Banoub?
Things are getting more and more interesting.

I'd seen a test subject with a label in the 700's. It seems 
that the experiments went on for a while afterwards.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_056_STA.text:
So this is the place where they researched 'the forbidden 
power.' I want to know how the studies were condunted.

Perhaps there are records or journals somewhere around
here containing details on the experiments.

Hmm... {PLAYER_NAME}, do you see that desk there?
Those shelves may contain what we're looking for.
Let's go and see for ourselves!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_057_END.text: ... Perhaps... Perhaps my theory was wrong all this time.

I had thought that evolution was a linear process
in which subjects changed only to become superior.

But to find out that evolution was in fact a process of ada-
ptation! A drive for harmony with the environment!

Mm... I must start from the beginning.
Perhaps begin on some completely new work.

I must see more of the world, {PLAYER_NAME}.
May I travel the world with you, together?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_057_STA.text:
I am a scholar traveling the world to prove my theory.
It is my life's work! Perhaps you have heard of it.

I am here because I must go in the Temple of Illusions 
for some references I need to study...

Embarrassing as it is, my theory is yet incomplete.
I must have some real samples of evolution, you see.

I heard that much biological research took place within 
the Temple. Could you accompany me down there?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_058_END.text:
Oh dear... That must have been Omega, one of the test
subjects.

"Concluding that any further attempt would be futile, we 
shut down 512 and use its data to create a new Guardian.

"To prevent similar disasters, the next Guardian should 
have a controlling device that fosters complete obedience."
... Test Subject Omega... was Camilla's prototype.

Is it strange that I rather pity them?
Omega, Camilla... All those beings created out of greed...
What a formidable being... Much like Camilla.

It seems that the experiment was a success. I wonder what
happened? Let's quickly read the entry!

"Entry - 2. Year ---, Month -- Day --.
Test Subject 512 was taken out of its tube.

"After it assumed consciousness, the first thing out of its 
mouth was a calm question asking what would happen to it.

When we said it'd become the Guardian of the Temple, it 
nodded, then started slaughtering the nearby people."

"It was only after losing many colleagues
that we finally succeeded in sedating it.

"---... days have passed since Test Subject 512's rampage. 
It woke up several times only to refuse submission.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_058_STA.text:
Agh, I'm so curious!
Let's look for the scattered journal entries!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_059_END.text:
There's nothing here... except the tattered cover of a book
titled, "The End of Despair Is the Beginning of Hope."

Ha... There never was a device, was there?
I did think it was too good to be true.

Yet the title... It's oddly comforting, that phrase.
I'll continue my research with hope, from now on.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_059_STA.text:
I am a scholar studying the ancient civilizations of the
Desert.

I heard that there is an ancient device used to overcome
despair and discouragement within the Temple of Illusions.

It seemed too dangerous to venture in alone. 
Could you please accompany me into the Temple?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_060_END.text: What? A survivor of the experiments?
He must have been hiding behind the pillar this whole time.
But... How could have he survived all these years?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_060_STA.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I found a strange space
while investigating the laboratory.

Who knew there would be this much space behind the
pillars?
Follow me - I'll show you myself!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_061_END.text:
Interesting. I just found a journal entry left by the Goddess
of Judgment.

"We have succeeded in using the forbidden power
to change the Desert tribesmen into monsters.

"It is still an unstable process, however, and the test sub-
jects can only maintain physical form within the Temple.

"We must solve this issue if we want any meaningful
results."

Hmm... It seems Ar'rat wrote this after taking charge of the
Temple. There may be more entries like this.
{PLAYER_NAME}! Let's go and see if we can find more!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_061_STA.text:
As you already know, the bountiful levels of holy power 
in the Temple have revived the monsters back to life.
It's strange, but they seem... stronger than before.

Most monsters don't revive through the holy power of light.
In fact, it's usually the opposite way around.

There are so many things to discover, aren't there? Let's 
take one step at a time and investigate everything there is!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_062_END.text:
"I had expected the lifespan of the monsters to be very sh-
ort, as their physical bodies are lacking and incomplete.

"Yet even after days of going without food,
I found them alive and well in their quarters.

"I must find out the cause and see if it can work to our 
benefit."

I had thought that the monsters had formed 
some sort of an ecosystem underground,

But I suppose I was wrong. The monsters we fought could
be the very ones created a century ago.
This is becoming even more and more interesting!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_062_STA.text:
... Next to those stairs
with all those revived monsters crawling over them.

And of course, I would appreciate your help as always.
Hehe! Onwards, my dear friend!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_063_END.text:
"A small amount of holy power had escaped from powering 
the Flame of Cora, and filled the Temple.

Monsters created through the forbidden power seem to 
react positively to holy power - increasing their lifespan.

A new possibility has shown itself.
Perhaps there is an easier way of carrying out our plan..."
So, this is the reason why monsters revived...

What could be this new possibility that the records ment-
ion? What kind of experiment did they attempt?

The results may be already out. 
After all, this was written a century ago.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_063_STA.text: Oh, dear. Queen Sekhmet is awake as well...
But why is she holding one of Ar'rat's journals in her hands?

Erm, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Do you think you could fight one more time?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_064_END.text:
"If all goes as the Kalard plan, the Flame of Cora shall sp-
read its holy power throughout Hasla on the judgment day.

"Before that day comes, we will place the monsters
created through the forbidden power across the continent.

"Should there be any resistance to our plan,
the monsters will prove a benefit in suppressing them."

Just as we feared. Considering the time of the journal, most 
of the preparations for their plan must've been done.

It's rather grotesque if you think about it. All these mon-
sters sleeping down here, and we never knew a thing...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_064_STA.text:
Hmm... Don't you think the revived monsters
are becoming stronger the deeper we go?

According to the journal, the effects of the holy power shou-
ld be stronger the closer we get to the site of the explosion.

I would hate to encounter one of the Three Kings 
in this state of affairs. Imagine how strong they would be!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_065_END.text:
"I will hand over the Temple to Jeraphim and return to the 
battlefield. Elanuma is suspicious, and I do not want to risk.
"Any later than this, and our entire plan shall be found out."

Hmm... It seems as if there should be more pages, but they 
aren't here. I wonder if somebody took the rest before us?

Elanuma...
I remember Goddess Chronos mentioning her before.

If we want to know more, 
I suppose we have no other choice but to go and find her.
Now, let's go back up to the surface, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_065_STA.text:
If what Ar'rat wrote in her journal is true,
we have to return as quickly as possible.

... You don't think... that Jeraphim revived, do you?
She's a Kalard, after all. Not a monster...
I better knock on wood, don't I…

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_066_END.text: She...is not coming back, is she?

Anut told me Ellie decided to save you, {PLAYER_NAME}... 
Decided to save everyone with her own will.

She may have been born out of human greed,
but in the end, she was more human than any other.

I cannot forgive them, {PLAYER_NAME}.
The Kalard who sacrificed Ellie for their own greed...
They will pay for their sins... Soon. Very soon.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_066_STA.text:
That you're going back into the Temple of Illusions
to look for any remains of Ellie...

Could I... ask you a favor? If you do succeed in finding her
remains, could you bring them back to me?

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_5.text: Heroes will die upon contact with the thorn wall.

TEXT_TRISTA_FISHERY_DESC.text:
Deep sea fishing yields different joys than from freshwater fishing!
There is a fishing spot on the rocky outcrops near the beaches of Trista
that seems perfect to try out your line, nya.

TEXT_TUNDRA_FISHERY_4TH_DESC.text:
Schools of salmon are swimming up the streams of Nosgard, nya!
A fishing competition is held every year in time for salmon season.
Salmon are caught more easily if you use special bait
that I hear you can obtain from various places around Hasla.
This year, we put some salmon figurines into the river
to make up for the recent decrease of salmon, nya!

TEXT_TUNDRA_FISHERY_DESC.text:
Schools of salmon are swimming up the streams of Nosgard, nya!
A fishing competition is held every year in time for salmon season.
Salmon are caught more easily if you use special bait
that I hear you can obtain from various places around Hasla.
Keep that in mind, nya! Let's catch some salmon!

TEXT_WESTSEA_FISHERY_DESC.text:
Let's go out to the middle of the ocean this time, nya!
As the waters aren't very deep, there aren't a lot of big fish,
but you'll see a bigger variety than from the beach, nya.
I'll rent the boat for you from the Hasla Fishing Association.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_18_01.text:
Everyone ran away...
... Did I do something wrong?

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_1000_2.text:
Hahaha! A man as old as time,
but as experienced as one can be!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_1000_3.text:
You continue to grow stronger.
With all that power, you could... Never mind.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_1000_4.text:
Ha, fine.
All these treasures will surely cheer her up.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_193_5_02.text:
Now, let’s sharpen some blades!
Where’s my whetstone...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_199_6_01.text:
Woah... I didn’t think hitting them in the head
would be so effective at controlling them!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_C_199_6_02.text:
You taught me something new.
Thank you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_E_1000_1.text: I hope our alliance is blessed with the likes of you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_E_1000_2.text:
Jeez! All of them were useless!
The streets of Neth were filled with technicians...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_L_1000_1.text:
Yes, you tried hard.
...do you want a bite?

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_L_1000_2.text:
Thank you for trusting and helping me.
I could save a lot of people thanks to you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_L_85_3_02.text:
Nyah, I can’t focus on my research without these.
Thank you so much.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_L_85_3_03.text:
... ...
Hyah... So good... My mind is now filled with ideas!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_1000_1.text:
I still have a lot to learn from you.
Thank you for the lesson.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_1000_2.text:
The bread is no longer warm.
I could warm it up myself, but I shall ask Chocolat.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_1000_3.text:
Hehe! I tried.
Did I do well? A compliment, please!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_1000_4.text:
Hm...
I guess you are better than I expected...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_182_4_02.text:
We were able to capture the castle gates
thanks to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_7_01.text:
Wow... you actually brought them.
Thank you.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_7_02.text:
I should ask Lakias to freeze the flowers
so that I can preserve their beauty...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_7_03.text:
If she likes them,
I will instead give them to her as a gift...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_7_04.text:
... Why are you giving me that look?
What? Huh? What?

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_8_02.text:
Just as the rumors say, you are indeed skilled in battle!
Do you want to become my henchmen?

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_8_03.text:
No? Well, that’s a shame.
But you still did well. Here’s your reward!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_8_04.text: It’s time to strike Alexander now...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_8_05.text:
Wait, what? Why is this hall
crawling with Central Knights?

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_8_06.text: Hey! Wait! Darn it! Was this a trap?!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_185_4_01.text:
Thank you. Although it will remain unstable for a while...
I will ask for your help again if the situation arises.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_001.text:
Hm~ I’m a little annoyed, {player_name}.
Why are you taking so long to come get these?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_002.text:
Going back and forth, do you know how much money I
could’ve made acquiring talent in other dimensions?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_004.text:
Hmph forget it. You’re not very good at
reading social cues.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_006.text: Anyway, how did you get them so fast somewhere else?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_007.text: Oh, that. I happened to bump into PoPo in the Tundra.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_008.text:
You ran into PoPo? Really?
Ho- ahem, how is she? Did she mention me at all?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_010.text:
Fight? Pfff, of course not! No. We just don’t talk.
No news is good news, don’t you know?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_011.text: How long has it been since you guys talked?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_012.text:
Not long. Like 8 years...
But, that’s normal for families.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_014.text:
D-don’t look at me like that! Don’t pity me!
Some families are like that!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_016.text:
Wait, did you...
Did you tell PoPo you saw me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_017.text:
No, I didn’t.
I thought it might make you uncomfortable.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_018.text:
Really? G-good job!
If you see her again next time, don’t mention me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_019.text:
But, you can tell me about PoPo!
If she’s doing well, if there’s someone bothering her!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_020.text: If there is, are you gonna hunt them down?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_021.text:
Of course I’m gonna sell them to a scary dimensi...!
I mean... as her older sister I can’t just let it go!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_022.text: Because anyone that can be mean to PoPo is a bad person!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_024.text:
Eek! You’re looking at me like that again!
Am I the weird one?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_025.text: No, I wasn’t looking at you in pity.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_026.text:
I think I was jealous that, even if you don’t talk,
you guys are connected by your hearts.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_028.text: I don’t have anyone like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_029.text:
Err, eek!!!
So-sorry. I didn’t know.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_030.text: Of course you didn’t know. I’ve never told anyone.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_033.text:
...
How about you just contact her?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_034.text:
I think she’d be really happy to hear from you.
Your absence must be big.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_035.text:
I dunno if she’d be happy...
To be honest I don’t have the courage yet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_036.text:
Why would she be glad to hear from her older sister
who hasn’t contacted her in 8 years.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_037.text:
I dunno...
PoPo’s said something like that to me before.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_038.text:
That her older sister is an amazing person,
who knows everything about business.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_039.text:
From packing neatly to knowing items for profit,
and dealing with people from hagglers to ruffians,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_040.text:
she said she learned it all from her older sister.
That thanks to her, she always found work fun and engaging.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_041.text:
She said that her heart races thinking about that
older sister, out in the big world, doing amazing things.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_042.text: I’m not that amazing of an older sister...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_044.text: I didn’t know she thought like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_045.text:
I’m sure she’s waiting for you. For you to come back and
teach her all sorts of things and to be together.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_047.text:
I miss PoPo, too.
But I’m still...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_048.text:
Yeah, I’m not saying to meet her right away.
But whenever you’re ready, let me know.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_049.text: If you want I can set up a meeting.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_050.text:
Hmph, wait a minute.
Why are you meddling in our sister affairs?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_051.text: I just want to help you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_054.text:
Why?
Who do you think you are!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_057.text:
Ne-never mind!! Don’t say more!
Just take this ticket and go! Hmph!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_058.text:
This is free just this once!!
Since I was gonna throw it away anyway!!! Got it!?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_060.text:
I’m busy! Super busy!
