TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_089.text: Before I go, can I see the chihuahua, just once?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_002.text:
Did it move?
Did its mother show up?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_003.text: It didn’t move an inch. Its mother didn’t show up either.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_004.text: Something’s wrong then. Let me see.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_006.text:
You’re right, it’s not moving at all.
There can only be one reason for this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_007.text:
It hurt its legs. There’s blood near its legs, too.
I think it fell from some place high up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_008.text: Its mother might’ve abandoned it, seeing its condition.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_010.text: It probably fell from the rest of the pack.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_011.text: Who knows, maybe she was being chased by a predator.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_012.text:
Don’t say that! We don’t know what really happened.
Don’t insult the mother based on your assumption!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_013.text:
I’m not insulting her. For a cat who has many kittens,
abandoning one can often save many.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_014.text:
No, there has to be another reason.
Maybe she just... lost track of it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_015.text:
You do have... a point.
We don’t know what REALLY happened.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_016.text:
We should take it to a vet.
Its legs are in terrible condition.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_017.text: What if our scent rubs off on it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_018.text: We have no choice. It’s dying.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_019.text: Is there an animal hospital nearby?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_021.text: Good thing I brought her then.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_022.text:
Mew! I heard a cat is in trouble!
It took me some time to prepare my tools!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_025.text: Oh, nice! Okay! Thank you for your help!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_026.text: Nyah! You wait here! Let me see it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_028.text: I hope it isn’t too hurt...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_029.text: Don’t worry. I’m sure it’s fine.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_030.text: Mew! It’s not too hurt! Don’t worry!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_031.text: But there’s a bigger problem at hand!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_032.text: You two... can one of you keep the kitty?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_033.text: I’m too busy to take care of a pet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_034.text:
You’re definitely a busy captain.
I understand.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_035.text: I also travel a lot. I’m not sure if I can keep it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_036.text: Then I’ll take it and find it an owner.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_037.text: Can you release it into the wild?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_038.text: I don’t think it wanted to become a pet...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_039.text: Nyah... A kitten cannot survive on its own.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_040.text:
There’s also a human that captures stray cats
and sends them to the Cat Forest.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_041.text: I guess there’s no other choice...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_042.text:
Thank you so much for everything.
I will pay you for your services.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_043.text: Both humans and demons really care about cats, nyah?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_044.text: Are you saying humans and demons are the same?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_045.text: Do humans also care about other lifeforms?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_046.text:
Of course! Humans love cats!
Pumpkin City is overflowing with them!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_047.text:
We can’t take Mew too seriously here.
No two humans are the same after all.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_048.text: Sfera, you met great humans during your travels, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_049.text:
Yeah...
That’s why I liked traveling so much.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_050.text: And like that, there are also bad humans.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_051.text: But you can’t generalize the entire species.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_053.text: I saw many bad people. And there might be more.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_054.text: But right now, we’re all worrying about this one cat.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_055.text:
Nyah!
Everyone’s the same when a cute cat is involved!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_057.text:
Well then,
I’m off to heal this cat!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_060.text:
Mew did everything.
You shouldn’t thank me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_061.text: Your presence alone was a big help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_062.text: Now that the problem’s solved, I’m heading back as well.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_063.text: Have a safe trip back home! YAH!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_064.text:
Huh? Uhm...
We got to do that in real-life as well?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_018_6_065.text:
The mood is calling for it!
Don’t you think so?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_001.text:
Over here.
You arrived later than I thought.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_003.text:
Don’t give me that sass!
You should always come 30 minutes earlier!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_004.text:
Wait, no, ehem.
I’m sorry, I lost control again.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_005.text: It’s just an old habit of mine. I’ll try to stop.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_006.text: I’m used to it, so it’s fine.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_007.text: Did you perhaps show up late on purpose to test me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_008.text:
You truly are the best captain there is.
To test me like that... it was unexpected.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_009.text: ...I didn’t mean to. Don’t judge me like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_010.text: Showing up 5 minutes early to an appointment is common.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_011.text:
This is common practice?!
I really can’t understand the kids nowadays!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_012.text:
How dare they arrive at the same time as their superior?!
The thought of it makes me shiver!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_015.text: But even if I was, you shouldn’t think that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_016.text:
I might’ve slept in, ran into an accident,
or had something urgent come up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_017.text: That’s why you show up to an appointment an hour early!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_018.text:
No, even an hour is too little! Back then,
I used to show up two days early just in case!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_019.text:
S-sorry.
I almost went off again.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_020.text: It’s fortunate that you’re capable of stopping yourself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_021.text:
I’m doing my best to “understand” the younger generation.
I have to keep it together.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_022.text:
Deokpal, this isn’t the workplace.
Keep yourself together.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_024.text: Let’s go eat now, shall we?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_027.text:
You fool! We’re not on some date!
You should be the one to pick one out for us!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_028.text:
Ugh! No!
Got... to... stop... my... habits...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_029.text: Your fight against yourself is interesting...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_030.text: The principle I used to live by has me in chains...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_031.text: This challenge proves to be harder than I anticipated.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_032.text: Let’s just consider it your training and pick a menu.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_033.text:
Do I have to?
It’s the subordinate’s duty to pick the food...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_034.text:
You recommended this restaurant, remember?
I don’t know the menu here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_036.text: Then whatever I pick out, you eat. Like a good subord-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_039.text: You should’ve placed the utensils down... Ugh!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_040.text: Why isn’t the waiter bringing me my water...Ugh!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_041.text: The children are so loud! Where are the parents... Ugh!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_042.text: Is that a fly in my soup... Ugh!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_043.text: You don’t have to hold back for the last one...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_044.text:
I can’t do this.
I didn’t think it would be this hard...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_046.text: I’m just not going to talk at all until I finish eating.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_047.text: I thought you were going to strive to be a better man...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_048.text: It’s better than worsening the situation!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_053.text: Your entire body is shaking... are you okay?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_056.text:
I can’t do this!
I can’t just sit and ignore!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_057.text: You! Waiter! If you have nothing to do, clean the tables!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_058.text: The restaurant is a mess! You should clean up!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_059.text: And you! Why do you chew so loudly? Where’s your manners!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_060.text: You’re going to scare away all the fortune!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_061.text: And you children! This isn’t an amusement park!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_063.text: And you, fly! Get out of my soup!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_064.text: You should hunt for your own food!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_065.text:
Why is everyone such a mess?!
You should learn to respect people!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_066.text: They only care about their own comfort!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_067.text: The world is doomed I tell you, doomed!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_069.text: Whew, I feel so much better now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_070.text: Why the glare?! I only said that so that you’d improve!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_071.text: ...I guess you won’t change after all.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_072.text:
I learned that it’s unhealthy to hold everything in.
But I didn’t give up completely.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_073.text:
And besides. Why am I the one that has to change?
Can’t the young ones change instead?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_074.text: ...So it comes to this in the end.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_075.text: Well, I suppose you were way too miserable.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_076.text:
Just do as you please.
Though your subordinates won’t like this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_077.text:
Haha! Good!
Yelling got rid of all my stress!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_019_6_078.text:
Order and eat everything you want!
Let’s talk about today’s generation...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_001.text:
Ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order...
Ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order, ding, QuickDash order...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_002.text:
Ding... Dididi Ding... Ding... Dididi Ding... Ding... Dididi Ding...
Ding... Dididi Ding... Ding... Dididi Ding... Ding... Dididi Ding...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_003.text:
Tramontana! I’m here to receive my pizza.
I wanna have it before it gets cold.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_004.text:
Ah, {player_name}...
Pizza... your pizza is here. Delivery... complete...? C-c-c-completed...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_005.text: Ah, my pizza is already cold.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_006.text:
Ahh... Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling...
Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling... Rating is falling...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_007.text:
My apology... My apology... My apology... My apology... My apology...
My apology... My apology... My apology... My apology... My apology...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_008.text:
Snap out of it. You've completely lost your cool to the
point where jokes wouldn’t work.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_009.text:
I came because I’m worried. What is going on?
Is there anything I can help you with?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_011.text: Then, could you not give me a bad rating?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_012.text: What? Would that resolve the issue?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_013.text:
How about...
Can you take care of the delayed delivery for me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_014.text:
My bike is broken. This never happened before. I visited
Neth Repair Shop and Mr. Fergus. No one can fix it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_015.text:
If things continue like this, I... I... My ratings.
My credibility. My sense of accomplishment... it's over.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_016.text:
Deliveryman Tramontana will become a one-star rider
and no one will ever want to request her service again...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_017.text:
Collect yourself.
There must be a solution.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_018.text:
Let's tackle the root cause first. It might be a good
idea to ask for help from Ku-Klip, just in case.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_019.text: They couldn’t even fix it in Neth... How will that scrap Ogre manage to fix it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_020.text:
He won’t be able to fix it. It’s hopeless... It’s all
over... My life is ruined... ruined... ding... ding...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_021.text: Hey {player_name}. Why did you bring me here...for what purpose?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_022.text: Ah, Ku-Klip. Can you fix bikes?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_023.text: Uh-um... A bike? Why do you ask?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_024.text:
Yes, as you can see, the bike’s owner is in that
state and needs help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_025.text:
Hopeless... Ding... QuickDash... Ding... My life is
ruined... Ding...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_026.text:
Well... sometimes just giving it a good whack is enough
to make it cooperate...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_027.text:
I already tried... Ding... I’m hopeless... Ding...
QuickDash... Ding... My life’s ruined... Ding...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_028.text: As an expert, this is indeed the solution.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_030.text: Would hitting it like that really fix the issue?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_031.text:
Hmph, if you’re skeptical, why don’t you try
starting the engine?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_032.text: Ohh? Ding! The engine actually started!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_033.text:
I’m not sure how you did it, but thank you so much! I’ll
give you a coupon next time! Ding! QuickDash order! Ding! QuickDash order! Ding! QuickDash order!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_034.text:
No matter when, where, or what. From day-to-day
items to missiles, deliveries guaranteed within 3 minutes!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_038.text: Do you think it’s really okay to bother someone as busy as me with something like this?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_039.text: Want some pizza before you go?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_020_6_040.text:
Well of course! Did you just try to dismiss my hunger?
What’s the pizza?! Ah, it’s cold!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_001.text:
{player_name}.
It is I. And I... have arrived.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_002.text: Hm? It seems this is the wrong house. Ew, what’s that smell...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_003.text:
We’ve arrived at a pigsty, not a house.
Please guide us to an actual house.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_004.text: We *are* at an actual house. This is where I live.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_005.text:
Wh... What?
You mean you live in a hovel even though you’re some big shot captain?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_006.text:
I had no idea you lived in a dump.
Tell me, how do you live like this?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_007.text:
Well that’s rude. It’s a normal house.
Anyway, since you’re here, sit on this couch here. Want a drink?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_008.text:
No, that’s alright. I... I’ll just stand.
That’s more comfortable.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_009.text:
It makes *me* uncomfortable.
I’ll give you some comfy clothes. Hang on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_011.text:
You want me to wear this undignified rag?
Are you well in the head?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_012.text: You said you’d teach me about “relaxation,” but you only suggest the most ridiculous things!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_013.text:
I am teaching you, right now.
Make yourself comfortable. Now, put these on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_014.text:
I refuse! I cannot!
I would rather die than wear these ragged tatters!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_015.text:
Oh, is that so? Vivian would have changed right away.
I guess you’re far from becoming like her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_017.text:
Fine then. Since I am here to study Vivian’s strength.
Even though it’s disgraceful, if I must endure this humiliation for the sake of becoming stronger... Bleh...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_018.text:
Bah!
I... I... I shall wear it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_019.text:
Good, good. That’s the smart choice.
Go change and come back out!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_021.text:
Hmph... There. I changed. What do you think?
Do I look “relaxation?”

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_022.text:
In my opinion,
I look like nothing more than a pitiful scoundrel.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_023.text:
It suits you. You finally look a bit relaxed.
Now, make yourself comfortable over there. I ordered takeout for us to eat.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_025.text:
Pizza, fried chicken, hamburgers, things like that.
It’s when you order food to be delivered to your house.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_026.text:
Pizza... Fried chicken? What crude names.
And who flies about, delivering that type of food?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_027.text:
There’s this person, Tramontana,
who’ll deliver your things within 3 minutes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_028.text:
Tramontana...?
Sure... That’s not that important I guess, but

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_029.text:
hearing about all this, it doesn’t seem like it’s proper
food. Even if it’s only for 3 minutes, how can you ask me to eat plebeian food that’s been contaminated by outside air.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_030.text:
It’s absolutely unacceptable.
I tell you I won’t eat it, I swear it on the Guardian Beast’s name.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_032.text:
Here already?
Please go tell them that I will not be eating.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_036.text:
Always come here, go there, I’m tired! You ordered fried
chicken right? Oh, Evgenia’s here, too. Long time no see.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_037.text: Who... Who is this I’m seeing? Vivian???

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_038.text:
Yeah, I invited her over.
The fastest way to learn about Vivian is to learn from Vivian, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_039.text:
I can’t believe Vivian saw me like this!!
Argh, {player_name}. Just kill me now!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_040.text:
Miss Evgenia, it’s so good to see you here!
Oh, this is a new style for you. It looks good!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_041.text:
Huh, that’s right. Evgenia, have you ever dressed like
this? It looks good!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_042.text:
Erm... It looks... g-good?
Th... th... thank y-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_044.text:
Chicken delivery! Enjoy your meal!
I’m off, then!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_045.text:
Wow, Vivian, look at that! She’s super fast.
She’s already all the way over there.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_046.text:
Dang, that is fast. I wonder if she delivers to our
realm.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_047.text:
Evgenia! Let’s eat fried chicken.
Have you ever eaten this? You’ll probably pass out.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_048.text: Pass out? Umm... Yeah, I think I really might.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_049.text:
Come on, hurry hurry! You have to eat it while it’s hot.
This chicken leg is for Rachel!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_052.text:
And the other leg,
I’ll give it to you, Evgenia. Since it’s been so long since we’ve seen each other.
If you eat this, it means we’re friends! Wahaha!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_053.text:
Woow♡! You know they say giving someone the leg means
luuurve! Lucky you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_054.text:
Hmph... Chicken leg... Love...
Then, for Vivian, I shall partake...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_055.text:
Oh ho ho! Excellent! Since you ate it,
we’re friends now!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_057.text: This is your guys’ first time hanging out like this, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_058.text:
Huh... Yeah, it is.
We’ve only ever fought when we met, this is the first time sharing a meal.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_059.text:
Evgenia, have you seen Rachel’s performance
live recording 125-B?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_061.text:
Niiice. It’s really a masterpiece. I’ve already seen it
a million times. Hey, {player_name}, let’s all watch it together!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_063.text:
I knew you’d say that, so I brought it!
Ta-daaa! Play it for us! Turn the volume all the way uuup!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_066.text:
Miss Evgenia, sit up here! Make yourself comfortable.
I’ll give you the special V.I.P. seat, closest to the screen♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_067.text:
Wait... This is the V.I.P. seat?
You want me to sit on this dirty floor...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_068.text:
Yep, that’s the best seat in the house.
You can see Rachel’s acting up close.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_069.text:
... Vey well then.
I shall sit.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_070.text:
Can you move a bit? I can’t see.
You could also just plop yourself down.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_071.text:
Plop...? Sigh... Ok then.
I... Is this how I do it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_072.text: Lie down more. More. More more more.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_074.text:
Yes, very good.
Oh, it’s starting. {player_name}! You come lie down, too!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_077.text:
Wow. No matter how many times I watch it, that last
scene gets me bawling like a baby. It was super fun, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_078.text:
Yes, it was♡ It was even more fun today because we all
watched it together!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_080.text:
Evgenia, let’s hang out again next time.
We’ll have spicy tteokbbokki, you down?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_081.text:
Spicy ttoppokki...?
I mean... I’m quite busy so I don’t know what my schedule will look like at that time, but I suppose there is a high chance I will be free...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_082.text: Ok then! Call me! I’m out.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_083.text:
I’ll see you again next time, Miss Evgenia!
Byee!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_085.text:
So? Do you think you’ve learned about relaxation?
You picked it up faster than I thought you would.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_086.text:
P-picked it up, pff! What are you even saying...
This is all solely for the purpose of research...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_087.text:
And you, {player_name}!! How could you invite Vivian and Rachel without saying anything!
I won’t forget this!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_089.text:
Er, erm... It seems I’ve learned all I can, so I shall
take my leave! Make sure you keep a tight lid on the events of today!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_091.text:
Change out of your glasses and sweatsu...
Oh she’s gone.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_092.text: I guess she’s already gotten used to them?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_096.text:
?
I haven’t ordered anything. What could it be?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_097.text:
Quick delivery, sent by a Ms. Evgenia.
Personal pickup complete! I’m off, then!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_099.text:
Is this to say thanks?
She didn’t need to do that. Let’s see...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_100.text:
[See here, {player_name}.
For your efforts, I have enclosed #a reasonable compensation#.]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_101.text:
[As we are now even, I #am not indebted# to you.
Do you agree? I will assume you do.]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_102.text:
[PS: If you tell anyone about the events of the other
day, I will have you #executed# so it would be wise to #act with discretion#.]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_103.text:
[PPS: I will be keeping the glasses and sweatsuit, as
research materials. Don’t worry, I have included the cost of those as well.]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_104.text:
[PPPS: Let me know when plans for the #ttoppokki
hangout# are set. #I did not have fun. I simply wish to keep my promise.#]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_105.text:
[PPPPS: Try to get it set up as #quickly# as possible.
I have to debut my #new pajamas#. -Evgenia- ]

TEXT_DATE_TALK_021_6_106.text:
.......
It seems she really enjoyed herself last time.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_002.text:
Let go of what?
This fat head of yours?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_003.text:
Ahh! Stop pulling on my head!
Who are you? Why are you doing this to me?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_004.text:
There is a demon that doesn’t know who I am?
What a surprise!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_005.text: I think I need to teach you a lesson!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_007.text:
Sis, let’s... let go of her head for a minute.
It’d be so sad if she loses her head;.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_008.text: Ugh...! So at least one of you is normal!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_009.text:
Since you have blue skin, I guess you won’t mind bruises.
Okay, I’ll just settle this with my fists♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_011.text:
Someone help me! Gustav!
Where are you! Save me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_012.text: What in the world is going on here?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_014.text:
The girl you’re holding by the head is a friend of mine.
I promised lunch with her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_015.text:
Hmm? {PLAYER_NAME}?
When did we promise lunch...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_016.text:
I realize now...
You secretly had a crush on me, didn’t you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_017.text:
So you are here to try and interfere with my love life!
To stop me from advancing on that cute teen boy.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_018.text: Stop calling my father by such cringe names!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_019.text:
F-father?!
What are you talking about?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_022.text: No!!! Gordian, don’t look at me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_023.text:
I’d rather bite my tongue and die
than to show myself in this unsightly situation!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_024.text:
Father! Who is this girl?!
Explain yourself. NOW!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_026.text:
RUCKUS?! You first leave step mom by herself at home...
and now you have the audacity to cheat on her?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_027.text:
You know I’m better than that.
I adore #Nia# and you children.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_029.text:
Uhm... Excuse me?
You are not a teenage boy?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_030.text:
Asmodeus, I didn’t think that a demon wouldn’t know
who I am. So I didn’t tell you. I’m sorry.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_031.text:
I am the previous Demon Lord, Gordian.
A faithful husband and father.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_032.text:
You are a married man?!
With that beautiful face?! No way!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_033.text: Seeing how you are so unaware of the Demon Realm...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_034.text:
You used to live a secluded life, right?
It looks like you just recently emerged.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_036.text:
I had a feeling.
You are a 1st generation demon, like Demona and I.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_037.text:
So... Asmodeus is as old as Gordian?
And that’s how she dresses...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_038.text:
Wait...
I saw her at the Succubus Troupe audition.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_039.text:
So you really thought my father was a teenage boy?
And you tried confessing to him? Isn’t this illegal?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_040.text:
Don’t you dare mock the feelings of a teen girl!
I’m... forever teen!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_041.text:
You better shut your mouth!
Or I’ll do it myself!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_043.text: Huh? Father! Ahh! What are you doing?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_044.text:
You are the Lord of this realm now.
You should treat your citizens better!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_045.text:
You are always laying around in your room doing nothing!
And now you beat people? I’m very disappointed!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_046.text:
I need to teach you again from scratch!
The responsibility of being a leader!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_047.text:
Ah! Stop! No! I-it hurts!
I don’t want to be the Demon King!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_048.text:
That is one weird family.
Right, Asmo?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_049.text: Sshh! Don’t talk to me, I’m thinking.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_022_6_050.text: What can I do to make Gordian take me in as a concubine?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_002.text:
Hina told me she’d wait for me here...
She’s not here. Am I at the wrong place?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_006.text:
?
Did I just hear an Oztalk notification?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_008.text:
Where is she?
I don’t see anyone...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_010.text:
Captain! Over here!
I’m hiding in here!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_011.text:
You should hurry and hide too!
We can’t be out in the open!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_012.text:
Uhm... alright.
But why are we hiding?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_013.text:
Sshh! It’s because you told me
Seimei is around this area!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_014.text:
Yeah, I did.
But something is keep poking me...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_015.text:
Oh! That’s Suzume’s beak. Stop Suzume!
I think Suzume is a bit nervous right now, because I dragged him out all of a sudden.
Sorry Captain.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_017.text:
So when will Seimei arrive?
All I see is that #dumb-looking squirrel#!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_018.text:
Dumb-looking squirrel?
All I see is Seimei.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_019.text:
What?! Then... that squirrel...
You’re right! Seimei doesn’t look evil at all!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_020.text:
But what if Seimei uses that appearance to lure people?
What if Seimei lures then eats people?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_021.text:
I need to learn more!
I need to look at Seimei from up close!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_026.text:
If it wasn’t for me... this body would be #dust#...
The people do not know of my #great help#...
The people of Ryu treat me like a #parasite#... Annoying...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_027.text:
I’m tired of being pushed around by the #exorcists#...
I’m now stronger than ever...
I shouldn’t be #pushed around and treated so badly#...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_028.text:
Keke...
I should #defeat# the annoying scoundrels...
And #take full control# of this body... Kekeke...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_030.text:
Captain... did you hear that?! Suzume was right!
I think Seimei is really trying to hurt uncle Yuki and our people!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_031.text: Suzume... I’m sorry for doubting you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_032.text:
You’re right... I also heard what Seimei said.
I’ve never seen Seimei act like that before...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_034.text:
But Captain! You heard!
That’s Seimei’s true nature! It must be!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_035.text: What are you going to do?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_036.text:
I don’t have a plan yet...
But I will use everything I’ve learned to defeat it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_037.text:
The things I’ve learned during the 11 years of my life!
I will teach it a lesson! Root for me Captain!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_038.text:
This is... a problem.
I can’t help Seimei after hearing what it said.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_039.text:
Sorry, Seimei.
I’m on Hina’s side on this one...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_040.text:
Hina, can you come here for a second?
Let me tell you Seimei’s weakness.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_041.text:
Oh? Okay Captain!
What...? I can defeat Seimei that easily with that?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_042.text:
Okay then...
It’s not hard at all!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_043.text:
Watch Captain!
Hiya! Riding the wind to your location! Good bye Seimei!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_045.text:
Am I seeing things?
What... AGH! Get away from me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_046.text:
I hate eagles! They’re scary!
I’m sorry! I’m sorry! Let me live! I’ll be nice!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_047.text: Look Captain! Seimei ran away in fear!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_048.text:
Did Seimei really mistake Suzume for an eagle?
Ugh... the smell of alcohol... I think it was just really drunk.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_049.text:
Hmm?
Captain, did I just stop the doom of Ryu?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_050.text: Yeah, I think so. I don’t think Seimei will do anything.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_051.text:
And if Seimei tries something again, I will stop it!
Seimei is trapped in my palm!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_052.text:
I finished the work entrusted to me
by the people of Ryu! I’m a free soul now!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_053.text:
Right Suzume? Wait, what? Not even close?
Hmph! The Captain is my guardian today! I don’t have to listen to you!
Bleh! I don’t have to listen to you! Go tell grandma, like I care!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_054.text: Uhm Hina? Suzume is pecking at me again...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_055.text:
Captain, run!
Lead the way! I want to experience freedom!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_056.text: Huh? You’re not heading back home?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_057.text: Huh? You’re not heading back home?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_058.text: My day out is just beginning!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_059.text: Okay then, tell me where you want to go.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_023_6_060.text:
I got my allowance today, so I’m super rich!
Let’s go have a jelly party!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_003.text: Oh? {PLAYER_NAME}, were you friends with Lime?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_004.text: Don’t come too close, it’s dangerous.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_005.text: Vesper and I are immune to Lime’s mana.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_006.text: But you aren’t. You’ll be absorbed if you come too close.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_008.text: I want to ask the same question...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_009.text: It looks like Lime tried mimicking my summoning magic.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_010.text: And... she did it perfectly. Why is she so sad?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_011.text: I wanted them as family... but they all left me...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_012.text: No matter how many times I try, it’s always the same!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_014.text: You wanted a family of familiars...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_017.text: Vesper, you always quarrel with your Veslimes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_018.text: Every Veslime I summon has a different spirit.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_019.text: The principle of life and death doesn’t exist with familiars.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_020.text: Once they run out of mana, their binding to our summon ends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_021.text: Their spirits return to their realm once they serve their purpose.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_022.text: Providing them with a physical form in our realm means little to them.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_023.text: But... I don’t want to die...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_024.text: If the familiars had my memory and flesh, I thought they’d understand.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_025.text: I don’t know if saying this will comfort you...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_026.text: But that’s what makes you special, my apprentice.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_027.text: You are the only familiar in the world that fears death.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_028.text: The only one in the world...? I hate that!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_029.text: I’m surrounded by people I can’t even touch!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_030.text: What good is it being alone?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_033.text: You said they go back to their realm once they run out of mana, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_034.text: What if I seduce the entire continent and absorb everyone’s mana?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_036.text: My, you really sound like a practitioner of ‘Night Magic’ now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_037.text: ...Lime really grew strong... I don’t think I can stop her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_039.text: {PLAYER_NAME}? What are you doing?! Step back!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_041.text: C-Captain...? Did you just grab my hand?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_045.text: I asked Oz... Ku-Klip to make me equipment that can neutralize Lime’s acidity.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_046.text: But Ku-Klip only had enough time for one pair of gloves...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_047.text: You are holding my hand... I can feel your warmth through the gloves...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_048.text: Lime, I’m truly sorry about your clones.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_049.text: But absorbing everyone’s life force won’t change anything.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_051.text: But... I don’t want to be alone for the rest of my life...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_052.text: Why do you think you are alone?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_053.text: Look around you. We all care about you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_054.text: So don’t go around causing trouble, you hear me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_055.text: Captain’s right, Lime. I still have many seduction skills to teach you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_057.text: Hey, read the atmosphere will ya?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_060.text: Okay, I will listen to you Captain.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_062.text: I’m really touched. Thank you for everything.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_063.text: I won’t try to suck the life out of everyone in Hasla.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_064.text: Uhm... Lime? I only have a pair of gloves...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_065.text: Can you back away a little?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_067.text: You prevented me from making a family.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_068.text: So I’m going to bother you a lot from now on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_069.text: You better look forward to it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_070.text: Okay! Okay! Just step back a little bit! My clothes are melting off!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_071.text: She’s surpassed me, her master... being forceful seems to work well...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_024_6_072.text: I’d like to return home now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_001.text:
Ugh, your house is like a pigpen.
Just as I imagined, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_003.text: And we just had a conversation about security.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_004.text:
Your door wasn’t even locked. An incompetent door, just like its owner.
You should just keep it wide open at this point.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_005.text: You know, a person “can” forget to lock the door once in a while...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_006.text: Whatever. Did anyone visit you before I arrived?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_009.text:
*Sigh*
Okay fine, ‘I have no friends that’ll visit me, ever.’ Happy?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_012.text: Oh my, is that a new gun?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_013.text:
...You are such an idiot.
I still can’t believe you haven’t realized yet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_014.text: Uhm... why are you pointing that gun at me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_015.text:
You have a bounty on your head.
The price on your head can buy an entire country.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_016.text:
Isn’t it funny? You are quite expensive.
The person who put the bounty on you must be blind.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_023.text:
???
What are you doing? Why are you firing your gun at the air!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_025.text: Flies that are attracted to money.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_026.text:
Trash like these tend to gather around
people like you, who care little for security.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_027.text: So... you weren’t after my head like these people?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_028.text:
Hmph. How dare you compare me to these trash.
You are foolish as always.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_029.text:
Well... the money placed on your head is quite enticing...
But there’s matters that’s more important than money.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_031.text:
Uhm... my beloved Milady the 2nd resides in this... ‘house.’
Of course I have come to protect her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_032.text: And save her butler in the process.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_034.text:
Yes. Even the most smallest of bugs can be of use.
You are quite talented at being a plant butler.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_035.text: It would be annoying to find someone new for this job.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_036.text: When did I become a butler...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_037.text:
Oh? The moment you received Milady the 2nd.
Be responsible and take good care of her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_038.text:
Anyways, I came to warn you.
Try avoiding open areas. Bounty hunters are looking for you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_039.text:
I’ll come visit from time to time.
And I’ll give you a compliment. Good job.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_040.text: I’ll rescue you if you’re in trouble. Good bye.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_025_6_042.text: She didn’t even check on Milady the 2nd.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_004.text: There was a field of grass here in the Wastelands?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_005.text: I also see some bright light over the horizon...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_006.text: Haha! My men worked hard to find this spot for me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_007.text:
Legends say that a giant meteorite fell here.
Or some heavenly being or something like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_008.text:
Anyway, it has a cool story behind it.
It was called “Star Crater” or something.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_009.text:
Well, that’s not important.
Do you feel the clean ki emanating from this place?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_010.text: It’s the perfect spot to unlock my full potential!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_012.text: Pft, well you’re a loser♡ after all♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_013.text:
But don’t worry♡ Once I become invincible,
I will teach you everything about ki, step by step!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_014.text:
You will become stronger in no time!
You can also help me fight Nari!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_015.text:
Wait, what? Nari is in my mercenary group too.
I can’t just fight against her...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_016.text: What? You’re on HER side? Why did you even come?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_017.text: Well, you told me to come.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_019.text:
I knew you were a loner with no social skills,
but to think you were this big of a dunce♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_021.text: So, what do I need to do?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_023.text:
I’m the cutest and the strongest in the world...
but I’m defenseless while gathering ki.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_024.text: I do have my men guarding me, but they aren’t reliable♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_025.text: That’s a harsh thing to say to your crew...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_026.text:
Look at their facial expression.
They love it when I insult them. Perverts♡

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_031.text: The air is swirling around Tian Mo...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_033.text:
Good... GOOD...!
I’m filling up with energy!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_034.text:
I feel my mind coming back!
All the impure energy is being pushed out of my body!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_035.text:
Tian Mo, is it okay to talk like that
while you’re meditating?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_036.text:
Hmph, of course. I’m a ‘master’ you know.
I can even eat while meditating.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_037.text:
Y-your body is growing, too.
You’re 10 years old, aren’t you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_038.text:
My body is reshaping to better
harness the ki that I’m absorbing.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_039.text: It’s not a female body, but Nari, too, is a woman!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_040.text:
Once I finish this process,
no one will be able to defeat me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_041.text:
Your parents are going to be shocked!
To see their cute 10-year old daughter become an adult!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_042.text:
I already told them that this day would come when I was 5.
Now hush and let me focus!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_044.text:
Huh? An earthquake?
No! I’m losing my footing!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_045.text: No! The ki is escaping my body!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_047.text:
No!!! My hands and feet are getting smaller again...!
I failed, AGAIN!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_048.text:
Ugh! My ki is becoming tainted again...♡
No♡ This immense urge to make fun of someone...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_050.text:
Tian Mo, you’re a kid again.
What happened?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_051.text: Did another meteorite fall or something?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_052.text:
Hmm? {PLAYER_NAME}.
What are you doing here?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_056.text:
I felt an energy that is not of this world here.
I thought maybe it was that #Pink-haired Goddess#.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_057.text:
I guess I made a mistake.
How embarrassing.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_058.text: Wait it was you that just fell from the sky?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_059.text:
This crater didn’t form because of my weight.
I gained too much speed flying over a thousand miles.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_061.text: Hmm? Who’s that girl behind you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_062.text:
...She lost consciousness
when you crashed here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_063.text:
Ah... sorry about that.
I can’t believe I made such a mistake.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_064.text:
The girl here lost all her ki because of me...
How pitiful...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_065.text:
This granny will nurse you back to health.
I’m sorry for hurting you, child.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_067.text:
Yeah, of course.
I’ll take care of the injured men here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_068.text: Thanks. I’ll take her back home with me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_071.text:
Wow... she can fly so fast.
She’s... already gone.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_026_6_072.text:
Sorry Tian Mo.
Please forgive me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_003.text:
I’m so sorry, Captain! I didn’t think
the showcase rehearsal would be this long.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_004.text:
I came running as soon as it was over.
Did you wait long?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_005.text:
No it’s okay, I could’ve wait all day.
FYI, I was hoping to wait until the karaoke closed.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_008.text: You sure have strange tastes, Captain.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_009.text:
So am I really the only one here with you?
I was hoping there’d be more people.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_010.text: I want to share the pai- I mean gain with more people.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_011.text: Well, I did try to invite more people...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_012.text:
Cano told me her entire schedule for this month
is packed full with work.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_013.text:
I sent an Oztalk to Yuna, but she hasn’t seen my message yet.
She brought down her profile picture, too...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_014.text:
And Meri told me that she made reservations at the
hospital for her legs that’re planned to break today.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_018.text:
But Meri is regularly very busy, always performing.
It’s completely believable that she’d hurt herself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_019.text: She told me to not even visit her because she needs rest.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_020.text: ...Maybe I should’ve said the same thing.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_021.text:
So did you sing anything before I arrived?
It’s unfortunate I couldn’t hear you sing!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_022.text: No, I was just preparing my mind for what’s coming.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_023.text:
If you press this button on the remote, the machine
makes the sounds of wind blowing. It calms me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_026.text: Oh wow, it really does make the sound of wind!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_027.text:
Uhm, Captain? Why are you holding the remote so firmly?
You’re acting like someone’s trying to steal it from you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_028.text:
I don’t mind, you can sing all day.
But... can you press that ‘New Songs’ button?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_029.text:
You’re going to sing already?
We should save the best for last, Uzume.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_032.text: It should be... Oh! There it is!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_033.text:
Tada! This is the title of my mini-album!
All Haslan karaokes added my song to their machine!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_034.text:
That’s crazy, the album was released just yesterday!
I really underestimated your popularity as an idol.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_036.text: Anyways, can you hand me the remote?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_039.text: Oh look! They have all my other songs, too!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_040.text: *Stands Up* Time to sing to my heart’s content!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_041.text:
Wait! Wait! Uzume!
Calm down and drop the mic.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_042.text: Do we really need to sing?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_043.text: What are you talking about Captain?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_044.text:
There are so many things we can do!
Things way more productive than singing!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_046.text:
That’s an old way of thinking. Mannerism is a no, no.
Let’s try something new together, Uzume...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_047.text:
We can dance under this disco ball!
Or shake these tambourines to the drum beat!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_048.text:
Or, we can try pressing the many different buttons
on this remote! It’d be so fun, don’t you think?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_049.text: There are so many things we can do!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_050.text: Hahaha! What are you even saying?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_051.text:
{player_name}, do you perhaps not enjoy singing?
You should’ve told me beforehand.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_052.text:
No that’s... yeah okay, that’s exactly it.
I should’ve told me sooner.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_053.text:
I’ll just turn this night into a personal concert,
just for you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_054.text:
While I sing, you should dance, shake the tambourine,
and press the many buttons on the remote!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_056.text:
T-thank you for your consideration.
I think I’m tearing up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_057.text:
Haha, Captain, but you haven’t even heard my song yet!
How are you already moved?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_060.text:
Thanks for coming!
Let’s sing the night away with UZU-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_062.text:
Uhm Captain?
Did you just cancel my song?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_063.text:
Oh, sorry! I accidentally pressed the cancel button!
Hahaha...! How clumsy of me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_064.text:
Aha. I see.
I understand! I’ve done that before too!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_065.text:
Let’s just start over!
UZUME IS BACK! LET’S SI-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_070.text: Haha... that’s all in your head Uzume.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_071.text: No! You’re definitely acting weird! Perhaps...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_072.text:
Relax Uzume.
Whatever you’re thinking, is probably not true.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_074.text:
I was about to send you home if you’re feeling sick.
I guess you can stay!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_076.text:
Let me take that remote so you don’t “accidentally”
press cancel again!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_077.text: Aw...my fingers were planning to slip just one last time.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_078.text:
Then let’s begin!
Give me an applause!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_027_6_079.text: Scream with me! Let’s Sing a Song♪

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_001.text:
W-welcome to our Mercenary Group!
W-why are you visiting us today?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_002.text:
Do you have an inquiry...? P-please let me know...!
Oh and... uh

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_003.text:
I will inform the Captain right away!
No, I need to register your inquiry in our network first... no?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_005.text:
O-oh, I-I don’t know.
I’m sure the Captain will think of something...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_006.text: Please fill this form and... OOPS!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_007.text:
W-wait! Let me clean this up first...!
C-Captain! Can you grab those papers...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_010.text:
Eye contact -10. Stuttering -20. Speaking nonsense -30.
Being scared to speak -100. Dropping documents -50...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_011.text:
And adding up the other mistakes, you’re at -300 points.
Do you have an excuse, Jack?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_013.text:
Ok, you’re not working at the front desk for sure.
This is too risky... for all of us.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_014.text: Sorry for being so helpless, Captain...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_015.text:
No, it’s not your fault.
We just need to find a job that suits you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_016.text:
I’m glad I tested you before having you start.
Let me find you a different job.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_017.text: Okay Captain! Your wish is my command!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_018.text: Do you want to try cleaning?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_019.text:
It’s been a while since we cleaned the Hero Home.
We need to dust and mop the floors.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_020.text:
Leave it to me! I’m a fantastic janitor!
My room is always sparkling clean by the way!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_021.text: ...That’s because you never have any visitors.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_023.text:
Okay then, I’ll leave the cleaning to you.
I’ll check on you once I’m done with my work.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_026.text:
Jack, did you finish cleaning?
I’m coming in.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_031.text:
Was our Hero Home always this... empty?
Well, it does look clean... VERY clean...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_032.text:
Sorry... I thought tapping ‘Clear All’ would
speed up the cleaning...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_033.text: I was trying to be efficient... hehe...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_036.text:
...No. I can always redecorate the home.
Hmm... I don’t think cleaning suits you either.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_038.text: I’ll do the cleaning. Let’s find you another job.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_039.text:
How about taking care of our inventory?
It’s a simple and repetitive task.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_040.text:
All you have to do is receive items from mail,
open boxes, and sell unnecessary items.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_041.text:
Simple, right?
Your experience at the Demon Market should be helpful.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_042.text: But I was a cashier at the Demon Market...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_044.text:
Let’s get you started right away.
I’m sure it’ll be easy.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_045.text: Okay! I will do my best to be of help!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_046.text:
I’m headed off to the Alchemy Lab now.
I’ll check up on you later.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_048.text:
Jack? How is it?
I’m hoping you did well this time.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_049.text:
Welcome back Captain!
I was doing my best to organize your inventory!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_051.text:
Hmm? You actually did a great job!
You opened all the chests I just made at the Lab.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_054.text:
Huh? A warm heart?
Do I look that menacing to you...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_055.text:
No, I’m talking about the sigil.
It’s an orangey ball of energy.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_060.text:
Well... I saw it and thought you didn’t care for it...
So I sold it...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_062.text: Did I make a grave mistake?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_065.text:
No, it’s my fault for not telling you about it.
Let’s... have you do something else, again.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_066.text:
What else is there...?
What can Jack do...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_067.text:
Can’t have her working in the kitchen that’s for SURE,
or in the financial dept either...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_068.text:
...I guess I have no choice.
Jack, your new job is to stay incredibly still.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_069.text:
Oh! I’m actually very good at that!
I’m a plant after all...! Hehe...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_070.text: But can I really receive payment for staying still?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_071.text:
Isn’t this unpaid work...? No wait, it’s the opposite.
Work unpaid? No, wait.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_072.text:
Something doesn’t feel right...
I want to work and “earn” my money captain.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_073.text: ...You’d actually help me more if you stay still.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_074.text: Oh, sorry! I’m in no position to complain...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_075.text: T-then I’ll do my best to stay incredibly still!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_076.text: Okay, I’ll be over there doing paperwork.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_079.text:
So you’re telling me...
You fell, despite having been seated and not moving?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_080.text:
I’m glad you weren’t hurt,
but we’ll need to buy a new chair...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_081.text: I was unconsciously trying to face the sun and fell...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_083.text:
You keep causing trouble, Jack.
We need to do something about this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_085.text: This is no time to laugh.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_087.text:
When I was working as a florist at the Demon Realm...
Everyone was afraid of me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_088.text:
I was always wearing my armor, watering my plants.
No one came to my shop, so I was always alone.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_089.text:
When I do occasionally get visitors,
they’d run at the first sight of me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_090.text:
I was so sad about that.
Like a flower blossoming during a blizzard...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_091.text:
But... once the winter passes, it’s spring...
You’re like spring to me, Captain...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_092.text: I feel like I changed a whole lot after I came here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_093.text: Not a single person is afraid of me here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_094.text: So I’m very happy that I can work alongside you, Captain.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_096.text: Hehe... I hope what I said wasn’t embarrassing...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_100.text:
Wait, hold on.
I almost fell for it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_102.text:
This isn’t something we can just ignore, Jack.
Your time as a florist means nothing right now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_103.text:
I’m glad you’re happy,
but we really need to train you properly.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_105.text:
You’re going to become the poorest Dryad ever.
Jack, we’re doing special training.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_106.text:
S-special training? I thought you were busy...
I can’t rob you of your time any longer...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_107.text:
I emptied out my entire schedule.
Lednas will cover for me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_108.text:
What if you suddenly get busy?
You never know when a villain will show up...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_109.text: We also never know when Jack will make another mess.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_110.text: Hng... You’re acting like Sir Gordian...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_111.text:
How in the world is this girl an Elite Four...?
Gordian...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_113.text:
It’s not a compliment.
Sit up straight!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_028_6_114.text:
Repeat after me.
“I will not make a mistake!”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_001.text:
Ask me anything regarding the Auction!
I’ll answer them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_02.text:
Every turn, the auctioned item changes.
You can make a bid on an item that you wish to buy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_03.text:
However, in order to win the item, you need
to bid above the #Minimum for Winning Bid#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_04.text:
The ‘Minimum for Winning Bid’ is shown as a percentage.
At 50%, bid more tickets than 50% of all bidders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_05.text:
If you successfully make a winning bid, you win the item.
If you don’t win the item your tickets are returned to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_06.text:
But don’t ever drop your guard! Your rank will constantly
change throughout the turn!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_07.text:
So remember to manage your rank throughout the turn!
Don’t forget that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_1_08.text:
And you #can’t bid during the last 5 minutes of a turn#.
It’s a calculation period to decide the winners!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_01.text:
There are two Auction types!
#Normal# and #Special#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_02.text: Both auctions require bidding tickets to participate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_03.text:
You can acquire bidding tickets by using meat, keys,
and colosseum tickets during the event period.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_04.text:
Play the game more to earn more tickets!
If you do, you’ll have the edge during an auction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_05.text:
Check the Auction Schedule and see if there’s an item you
want. If there is, go collect them tickets!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_2_06.text:
Only one of the two auctions are run each turn.
Remember that when you’re checking the schedule!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_02.text:
The basic rules apply for both auctions!
Make a bid and score above the Minimum Bid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_03.text: But the difference comes from the #display of the rank#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_04.text:
#Normal Auctions# show you the rank leaderboard.
You can use this feature to bid accordingly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_05.text:
Then there’s the #Special Auction#!
It works a bit differently!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_06.text: Did you see the OX Signs on the Auction screen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_07.text:
If you are above the Minimum Winning Bid, the O,
and if not, the X will light up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_08.text:
During a Special Auction, information regarding the
Minimum Bid is provided through these signs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_09.text:
So all the participating captains will have no idea
whether they should raise their bid or not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_10.text:
Instead of solely relying on the signs for information,
try communicating with other captains for info!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_3_11.text:
These are the two types of auctions!
They are played different so be ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_01.text:
Auction Tokens are provided to you
when the turn you bid on ends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_02.text:
If you make a winning bid, you are given 50 tokens.
If you fail, you will be given 10 tokens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_03.text:
The grade of the auction, or the item you win,
have no effect on the number of tokens received.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_04.text:
You can exchange these tokens for items at the event shop
once the event ends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_05.text:
This event shop has some S Grade items in stock, too!
So make sure to check them out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_06.text:
Struggling to win in an S Grade Auction?
Try collecting tokens from lower grade auctions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_4_07.text:
Check the schedule and plan accordingly
before participating in the Auction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_5_01.text:
S Grade Auction rewards are truly splendid!
They are items everyone wants!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_5_02.text:
However, there is a #limit to how many of them you can win#
during the event period!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_5_03.text:
That means, if you end up winning too many S Grade items,
you might not be able to get the one you really want!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_5_04.text: So keep your eyes on the #S Grade Bidding Limit#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_6_02.text: When the event ends, remember to #claim your won items#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_AUCTION_EVENT_HELP_6_03.text: If you don’t, they will be added back into the Auction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_1.text: My body is not on par with yours, but I’ll catch up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_2.text: Well, you must have made up your mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_3.text: Absolutely! I will try only harder and never give up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_4.text: Because that is the Nosgardian spirit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_5.text: ...That is the heated passion to win over the onlooker.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_10_6.text: Perhaps this is the spirit Odin wanted to distill in me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_1.text: Made up your mind, so be it! I will root for you then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_3.text: I cannot help but respect your indomitable spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_4.text: Give your sweat to achieve the strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_6.text: But first. The broken wall needs mending, no?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_7.text: Oh, my transformation magic will do the...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_8.text: No magic! It has to be done by hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_11_9.text: Talk the Nosgardian talk, and walk the Nosgardian walk!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_12_1.text: Winston is turning into a Nosgardian within and without.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_12_2.text: Thor is a very mature Nosgardian. ...truly a worthy king.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_1.text: By the way, have you heard of a strange rumor recently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_2.text: Rumors never end. Maybe another mother wolf appeared?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_3.text: This one is of a human running naked across the snowy field.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_4.text: A bulky muscular man, scaring the children away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_5.text: Must be a villager. We rarely have an outsider here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_6.text: Not even a Nosgardian. A man with a large wizard hat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_1_7.text: A large wizard hat? Wait, that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_2_1.text: Holy cow! Why not use a door but bust through a wall?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_2_2.text: I take the road less taken. That is who I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_2_3.text: We call such a person an unevolved ape!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_2_4.text: Ha! I’m a Nosgardian man wielding unbridled strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_2_5.text: What exactly do you think a Nosgardian is...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_1.text: The Winston I know was an innocent-looking man...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_10.text: Oh! No need! My fists will teach this fool a lesson!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_11.text: The Nosgardian disciplining? Yes! I accept that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_12.text: Wolfgang. I will talk to Winston here, so leave us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_2.text: He came to me not so long ago and asked for advice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_3.text: Motivated him and he created fake muscles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_4.text: So he used magic to look like that? Interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_5.text: I learned a lot from you and changed my appearance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_6.text: I’m transformed now! In celebration, I ran for days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_7.text: No wall can stand in my way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_8.text: Look at this fool all excited. Why not fix the wall now?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_3_9.text: I will tell him to fix it. But leave us alone for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_4_1.text: Talk about what? My crazy muscles and manliness?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_4_2.text: I am all ears to whatever Thor the great king has to say!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_1.text: The muscles are... from transformation spells?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_10.text: F-forgive me! I was getting way too ahead of myself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_11.text: No apology needed. Hot, young blood can do that to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_12.text: But return to normal stature for my neck is aching.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_2.text: Not real muscles then. Used a spell to break the wall?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_4.text: No lie. I have ways of finding things out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_5.text: To show the new, better me, I used a little bit of magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_6.text: I planned to mend the wall with magic anyway. Forgive me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_7.text: Running naked in snow, that was magic as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_8.text: Yes. I warmed the fake muscles with magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_5_9.text: It was all magic then. A warrior depending on magic?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_1.text: Yes, now that's the man I remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_2.text: I wanted to cast away my feeble appearance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_3.text: Love yourself! My tea got cold. Warm it up with magic?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_4.text: I beg your pardon? Why all of a sudden...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_5.text: I want to see your magic myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_6_6.text: If your Highness wills it... Yes, sire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_1.text: Perfect. See, you are an excellent mage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_2.text: Why is such a superb mage so in love with our traditions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_3.text: Because that is the true essence of human beings!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_4.text: I depended too much on technology and magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_5.text: But you withstand cold! You eat beasts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_7_6.text: Your way awakened me! That’s what men should be like!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_1.text: We had to survive in the cold without clothes

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_10.text: You've spent enough time with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_11.text: Our warriors all have to brave the cold here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_12.text: But weaker ones and kids are allowed to stay at home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_13.text: Valor and pride? No, they just need warm tea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_14.text: So, learn to appreciate your own gifts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_2.text: and fire. We prefer cooked meat over cold meat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_3.text: If we have better options, our traditions can change.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_4.text: But they are still marvelous to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_5.text: We are proud of ourselves. No need to deny our essence,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_6.text: but no need to reject a better option.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_7.text: You can admire us, but never fantasize about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_8_8.text: I already know one that does... Quite a headache.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_9_1.text: I understand since you should take care of all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_22_9_2.text: But your strength is real! Allow me to be one of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_10_01.text: Uh... Was I not supposed to eat him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_10_02.text:
O-of course not! He may have been a louse,
But he is still Lionel's ancestor... Mmmph!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_10_03.text:
... Pay no mind to it. We were merely a bit surprised.
I am glad you’re unscathed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_10_04.text:
Hmph, a mortal, concerned about my safety?
I, Livea the Master of the Void, will reveal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_11_01.text: W-what was that? What was that noise?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_11_02.text:
Use caution, Lacrimoso!
Get behind my back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_11_03.text:
Um... Livea, that sound actually
came from your stomach.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_11_04.text:
After all, you didn't eat for dozens of days
in your mortal form... You must be hungry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_11_05.text:
That sound came from my belly?
Utter nonsense!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_12_01.text:
Livea. If it is agreeable,
would you help yourself to these?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_12_02.text:
Ah!!! Lionel! That is the sandwich
I made for your lunch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_12_03.text:
Aria, be generous to your guest.
She hasn't eaten for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_12_06.text:
... Hmph, whatever.
Do what you will!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_13_01.text:
Hmm... Peculiar to the touch.
The mortal food...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_02.text:
Soft bread and crispy cabbage,
fresh tomato, and ham in exquisite harmony!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_03.text:
It has been a while since I had mortal food...
Is this what they call "tasty"?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_04.text:
You must have been famished, Livea.
Speaking like a "fish out of water" cliche...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_06.text:
Ah, please pay no mind to it.
I don't know either, it just came to my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_07.text:
I am so truly grateful for this palatable food.
This will not go forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_08.text:
Well... Seeing you enjoy it so much
got me stop complaining.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_09.text: You can show gratitude by helping us make more of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_11.text:
Yes. While you stay with us.
Beats being stuck alone in this dreary fortress, no?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_12.text:
Actually, I need the atmosphere of this fortress.
I wish not to return to the sunny royal palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_13.text:
For that, we will turn a guest room just for you
with absolutely no light in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_14.text:
Lacrimoso's request or not,
we can't just leave you alone in this desolation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_15.text:
And you will be allowed back to the Fortress regularly...
So won't you please come with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_16.text:
... If you so insist,
it would be unbecoming to decline.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_14_17.text: Fine. I am in your good hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_01.text: Wow, so we stay together now? Yay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_02.text:
It’s going to be fun.
I even made a list of friends' activities!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_03.text:
… Do not make me regret my prudent decision,
will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_04.text:
Phew, shall we head back then?
Catering to your capriciousness is quite tiring...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_05.text:
Treating guests of the state is part of your duty,
so do not complain too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_06.text:
These people are guests of the state?
I thought they were just your friends?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_07.text:
Come to think of it, I only met
Lacrimoso looking into the backwater anomaly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_08.text:
Why am I helping with all my might and heart?
Well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_09.text:
Because his Highness the king is very compassionate!
I am truly grateful. Lionel, Aria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_10.text: Thanks to you, I am now together again with my friend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_11.text:
... Not at all. I am honored we could help.
Right, Aria?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_12.text:
Oh, Lionel. Your good nature will get the best of you.
But it can't be helped, Lacrimoso's request and all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_15_14.text:
Oh, I just remembered I have some business to attend to.
I'll be with you shortly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_16_01.text: Well... Will you come out of hiding now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_02.text:
... What are you exactly?
Some apostles I do not know of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_03.text:
Apostles? Hmm, I'm not sure, but probably no.
Neither Livea nor I have memories whole...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_04.text:
I seem to have troubled someone living quietly,
my sincere apologies...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_05.text:
Forget it. I feel stronger now
thanks to this aura you imbued me with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_06.text:
I would like to test this power outside the Fortress...
Will you step aside?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_07.text:
I'm very sorry, but the answer would be no.
We have a request for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_09.text:
Livea derives her power from the void,
and she just had her fill but will be hungry again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_10.text:
You may not like it, but you have to be here awhile...
So will you treat her to a #meal# on her visit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_11.text:
B-by a meal, you mean what happened just before?
Why would I grant that request?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_12.text:
You will not have a choice. The #entity inside you#
seems to be in agreement. Well, until then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_17_13.text: What... What did you say? Wait!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_18_01.text: The old, forgotten horrors have awoken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_18_02.text:
Ones older than death, now in human flesh.
That’s very intriguing… and horrifying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_18_03.text:
What will they be doing in Hasla...
...one can only wonder.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_1_02.text:
A familiar aura of darkness.
Phew, that calms me down finally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_1_03.text:
Why am I so far out here in this physical plane?
And this physical body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_1_04.text:
What scrawny arms and legs.
They could break at a single hit...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_2_01.text:
Anyway... I know I was in a hurry,
but it is a peculiar place indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_2_02.text:
To see that a structure full of darkness could be
so close to a human city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_2_03.text:
Perhaps the view on dark magic has
recently changed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_2_04.text:
How audacious to step foot into the Fortress of Souls!
My vengeance draws near, thanks to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_3_01.text:
You are no living human.
What are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_3_02.text:
You dare step into the Fortress of Souls
and ask who I am... Have you gone mad?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_3_03.text:
Haha, it’s all good. You awakened me, so I’ll tell you.
I am #Soltar, the Lord of Souls#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_3_04.text:
The true ruler of Valencia,
and the future master of all living beings in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_02.text:
I was hoping you would entertain me
with your fear and beg for mercy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_03.text:
Sorry to fall short of your expectations...
But that’s a bit of a cliche

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_04.text:
to claim the true ruler of... this land and continent...
Dreams befitting only the lesser beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_05.text:
Why not just hand over the Fortress
and be my humble minion?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_06.text:
Lesser beings? Minion?
You dare insult me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_4_07.text:
Will you not get it twisted? I just thought it would be
more polite to offer advice while I take your power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_01.text:
Ugh... Gah! W-what is this...
Ooh... You! What are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_02.text:
My memories are not whole either,
so I only remember my name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_04.text:
Fate-Twister?
Never heard of such a name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_05.text:
Ahem, I cannot expect all
backwater denizens to know of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_06.text: How about the #Master of the Void#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_07.text: None I know of. That's a first too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_08.text:
Uh... #The Subspace Horror#!
#The One Who Smiles from the Rift#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_09.text:
What a bunch of cringy names...
Is that trending in the outer dimensions now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_10.text:
... Enough.
I will hear no more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_6_11.text:
W-wait! With just a bit more time,
I could remember...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_7_01.text:
How much time has passed?
Even the denizens of darkness have forgotten me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_7_02.text: Darn it, only if my memories were intact...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_8_02.text:
Lacrimoso.
Why did you follow me here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_8_04.text:
Since you came from the #cave#,
you were unconscious for dozens of days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_8_05.text: You know how worried I was?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_8_06.text:
Hmph, do not feign friendship.
I have no such thing as friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_8_07.text:
Huh...? I don't remember well,
but we've been friends for a long time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_01.text: ... G-giving me that eye does not change things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_02.text:
Well... Livea, was it?
I have a question to ask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_03.text:
Before we entered the Fortress of Souls,
we did feel an ominous aura of an Apostle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_04.text:
The intrusion must have awoken Soltar,
but the aura is nowhere to be felt now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_05.text: Do you, perhaps, know anything thereof?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_23_9_06.text:
Whatever you are getting at,
I just swallowed that Soltar whole...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_10_01.text:
No. Humans are pitiful beings, Djura.
They are always suspicious and afraid of others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_10_02.text:
The #humans# who programmed you to eradicate
any non-humans should’ve had the same mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_11_01.text:
... An android who pities its creators?
You should be malfunctioning somewhere for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_11_02.text:
Well, your line of thinking is surely not normal,
but interesting. Not bad at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_11_03.text: I want to observe you more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_11_04.text:
I am sure that if I analyze you and your routines,
I will be able to figure out my own answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_01.text:
Hey, are you all right?
You just made a very unusual facial expression.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_02.text:
What? Oh, I am fine.
Rejoice, non-human beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_03.text:
After a long discussion that lasted 0.3 seconds,
I decided to postpone orbital bombing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_04.text:
What a happy miscalculation.
I thought you'd behave as you were programmed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_05.text:
Did the thought processes of R - 0
help you in any way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_06.text:
Yes. Your daughter is good.
You should be proud of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_12_08.text:
I will temporarily disable my primary mission
and collect data from this world. Sounds good?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_01.text: Wait. Are you going to stay here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_02.text:
Why not?
We were destined to encounter each other here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_03.text:
We already got our hands full with the problems we have.
Can handle no more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_05.text:
Surely, you wouldn't mind
having one more android daughter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_06.text:
I do.
Go down to the lower world and find a hotel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_07.text:
Hmm. So that's how you want to play it?
Orbital bombing anyone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_09.text:
If necessary, yes. Like I said earlier,
it’s not canceled but postponed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_11.text:
It’s okay, Benjamin.
We have enough room for more guests.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_12.text:
I know, but I just can’t trust that android.
What if she harms our mother or anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_13_13.text: It will be all right. She doesn't seem that unstable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_24_14_01.text:
Welcome to Heaven, Djura.
