TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_04.text:
I-I just really like high places, that’s all!
I’m not looking for a quiet place to eat lunch...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_05.text:
Anyway, is something going on?
I heard someone yell, so I came running...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_08.text:
W-what do you need help for?
I’m a busy ogre, y’know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_09.text:
Jack caused trouble again. Her plants are out of control.
The two of us won’t be enough to stop them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_10.text: Hng... I told you I didn’t do anything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_11.text: Isn’t {PLAYER_NAME} the most qualified person for that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_12.text:
I’m just a weak ogre, hehe...
You should ask Captain for help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_13.text:
...The Captain is missing.
We need your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_15.text:
D-do I have to?
Is my help 100% really, really necessary...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_16.text:
I’m not entirely sure myself.
But I heard that Jack’s plants are no joke.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_17.text:
Hmm... I guess I have to help, then.
No choice for the ogre...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_19.text:
If Vivian hears about this, she’ll force me to help
anyway. Time to get to work, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_20.text: Ahh... Vivian is going to scold me again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_21.text: Is THAT what you’re worried about?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_22.text: Anyway, so we need to calm the plants down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_6_01.text:
Kuhaha! This destructive power!
I can’t hold it in! And I don’t want to either! Haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_7_02.text: You want me to fight that thing? For reals?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_01.text:
Berserker mode, OFF.
Opponent is too powerful for me to handle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_03.text:
N-no! What do you take me as?!
I’m not big enough to fight that thing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_04.text:
I will need bigger tech to fight it off!
I’ll use my best weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_05.text: I’m sorry, Popo, but I need to use your friend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_06.text:
Hangar No.1, unlock! Enhancement System, ON!
Safety, OFF! Friend Kit ACTIVATE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_9_03.text:
Pinnacle Ogre Tech! Friend Kit will do the job for sure!
That dummy won’t stand a chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_02.text:
Did you report the event of that scarecrow?
It was a very odd thing to happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_03.text:
I wanted to tag along, but I thought it’d be
better for me to remain and watch over Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_04.text: ...I was doing my best to keep the town safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_05.text:
Stop giving me the squinty-eyes!
You might be more established, but I’m a captain too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_07.text:
After the war, the crown was passed on to a new emperor.
I’m sure the Empire is in disarray at the moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_08.text:
But... I believe Victoria will become an amazing Empress.
She will put everything back to order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_02.text:
I was thinking of the old days.
This is where we first met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_03.text:
Who would’ve imagined that the rookie Captain
from then will one day become a hero that saves Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_04.text:
I’m getting emotional talking about the future of Grancia
with you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_06.text:
...I got too chatty.
Let’s head to the town square, shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_01.text:
Didn’t I tell you? We’re
having a party to celebrate the end of the war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_02.text:
It’s a special party, just for you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
The people of Hero Town worked hard for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_03.text:
You never heard about this beforehand?
No way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_04.text:
Well, at least you know now.
I know you aren’t busy right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_06.text: I thought you were done talking in parentheses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_02.text:
Why are you so late?!
Hurry and sit down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_03.text: Anut! Keep quiet and hold still!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_04.text: And {PLAYER_NAME} is going to sit next to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_05.text: Both of you guys are so loud...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_06.text:
It’s been a while since we all gathered together.
Who cares if it’s a bit loud!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_07.text:
I agree. Remember when we were tasked with protecting
the Apostle’s Soulstone? Time sure flies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_08.text:
We don’t know what’s awaiting ahead of us.
But let’s stop and enjoy ourselves once in a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_09.text:
Oh yeah. We have someone we want to introduce
to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_10.text:
Ellie, come and say hi. You were waiting for
{PLAYER_NAME}, weren’t you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_11.text:
Uah... Prestina...
You didn’t have to say that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_13.text:
When I was with Galatea, I saw you!
But I didn’t get a chance to say hello.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_14.text: How many years have passed since then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_15.text: I was watching your adventure with Galatea...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_16.text:
I saw your struggle against the evils of Hasla...
You overcame your adversaries to save the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_17.text: (“It was all thanks to you, Ellie,” you reply.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_18.text: You’re the captain I know and remember!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_19.text:
If I didn’t help you at the Temple of Illusions,
the Kalards might’ve won instead, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_20.text: I guess I played a pivotal role in saving the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_21.text:
Of course Ellie. But don’t put yourself in that type of
position again. We don’t want to lose you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_22.text: Uhh... I want compliments not scolding...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_23.text: Of course you deserve compliments. You were very brave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_24.text: ...Everyone played a role in bringing peace to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_25.text: But I was a corrupt Goddess... Do I deserve to be here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_26.text:
Kukuku. Cheer up Sylunis.
Elanuma would laugh at what you’re saying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_27.text:
Don’t dwell in the past.
Learn to be better and become better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_28.text:
Once this party is over, let’s head to Elandia.
We have a lot of rebuilding to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_29.text: I have to help rebuild the buildings that I destroyed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_30.text:
...I’m sorry, but Sylunis have plans with me. Habaek
and Haerang asked us to help recover the veins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_31.text:
Kukuku! I see!
Then I guess I’ll drag {PLAYER_NAME} along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_32.text:
Wait! I was going to ask {PLAYER_NAME} to help me
dig up and uncover the Temple of Illusions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_33.text:
Hey! I was going to ask {PLAYER_NAME} to
give Ellie a ride to Trista!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_34.text: I’m sure Rata wants to see Ellie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_35.text:
Woah, Rata! That’s a name I haven’t heard in a while!
He’s a mouse-human! I mean, Ratman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_36.text:
It’s more urgent to read over what our teac-
I mean, Arart left behind for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_38.text:
As the minister of the Empire,
I can summon Grancia scholars to help us with that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_39.text:
Captain, since you just came back from the capital,
can you help me-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_41.text:
What are you doing?!
We’re here to party, not work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_42.text:
Look at {PLAYER_NAME}!
The Captain looks miserable!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_43.text:
Let’s enjoy the party,
and talk about work later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_44.text:
Yes! Please enjoy this fantastic party brought
to you by none other than the Merchant’s Guild!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_45.text:
F-fine.
I guess I was being a bit annoying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_46.text: Sera seems to have become very bossy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_47.text: I think I like this Sera better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_48.text: Here comes the food! Tidy up the table please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_49.text: Whew, finally, the party has kicked off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_50.text:
Sorry about all of that, {PLAYER_NAME}.
They were getting on your nerves, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_51.text:
But don’t worry. Deep inside,
everyone appreciates and adores you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_52.text:
A lot of things happened since we first met
at Hyro Forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_53.text:
But before our truly big adventure,
a little relaxing won’t hurt us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_55.text:
...Now, let’s sit down and enjoy the party.
Let me go reserve the seats over there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_01.text:
With this final chapter, the second book
of the Hasla Chronicles is finally complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_02.text:
How was the adventure, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}?
Was it fun?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_04.text:
Your expression seems to have an odd mix of emotions.
I’m sure it was filled with hardships and struggles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_05.text: Then... I guess it’s goodbye for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_06.text:
I will always be here waiting for you.
Here at the #Library#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_SCARECROW_END.text: And the World came to an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2022_FOOLSDAY_NEW_O.text:
Defeat...
A word I did not know. A familiar word now.

Monsters were driven from forests and beaches to
deserts and snowy lands, pushed all the way.
The Heroes were greedy and we've made the same mistake.
But Hero of Monsters, we’re not done yet.
We will fight to the end!

We will fight in the air and
on the land to protect what’s ours.
We will get through the darkest hours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_AUCTION_SHOP_LOCK_0.text: We aren’t open yet! Come back later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_1_.text:
He wasn't a Tiger General for no reason.
He was a worthy opponent.

Ugh... (Groans) You bunch of food discriminators...
You will be judged someday.

If you want some respect,
don't force it on others. Just enjoy it yourself.
Guan Yin Ping! Guan Yin Ping! Guan Yin Ping!

Good job.
We eliminated another mint chocolate lover today.

I would like to reward you.
What about delicious food?

Surely... You were full an hour ago,
but you must be hungry after such an intense battle.

Whatever is fine!
We will follow your food wisdom, General!
Fine. Let's head to my favorite restaurant then.

It is a traditional Valencian restaurant.
Famous for #pineapple pizza#.

They also offer #mango rice# as well.
Isn’t it exciting? Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_2_.text: See? See the power of my well-defined muscle!

Easy come, easy go, boy.
Remember today's lesson.

Devote yourself to weight training
for better muscle gain.

Anyway... You have perfect muscle.
Considering your age...

I'm ashamed of myself for slacking off leg days
always making an excuse.

Oh, you’re mistaken. I am working at a construction site
and my body is just swollen a bit.
Mine is not as developed as yours or Wolfgang's.

Hahaha! You make me blush. When you return to Elder Edda,
try my routine with me.

Oh, that sounds good.
Let’s go back with this buddy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_3_.text: Wow! I relied on this too much!

Nearly invincible! The Taoists finally
created something formidable!
These things may drive us from our job!

What is happening?
Why are they all lying dead here?
You over there! Are you a new sacrifice?
This... Are you responsible for this?
Yes. Our Taoist Mask did it all to be exact.

Little urchins like you can never defeat
Taoist Mask, the ruler of the skies!
Tell me it’s a joke! You got bashed for good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_START_.text:
Ugh... I am full.
You had enough?
Yes, sir! General Zhang Bao!

Heh, good. The boss in the palace is in a good mood
and it’s okay to have a regiment dinner night.

I would like to have some ice cream
for dessert, what say you?
Excellent, sir! We’d love to have some, sir.

I found a good place in the market.
A new place selling ice cream.
The best is #mint chocolate#.

Well... Oh, boy.
Mint chocolate?
Hmm? What’s the matter?

General... I am very disappointed. I have never
thought that you'd enjoy such blasphemy!
Please, tell us it was a joke!

We can't serve an officer
who is delighted with mint chocolate!

Wha- What? What’s wrong with mint chocolate?
It goes well with meat.

Argh! Just brush your teeth!
Toothpaste tastes like mint!
How foul-mouthed! Toothpaste is not mint chocolate!

Oh, I see.
I can't tolerate your tyranny anymore!
General Guan Yin Ping!
General Yin Ping! What are you talking about?

Zhang Bao... I knew we’d fight each other someday,
but didn’t expect it to be like this.

I am disappointed.
I even regarded you as my rival. Shame on me.

As a Tiger General serving Emperor Chen,
I must dispense justice.
Good soldiers, are you with me?
We will fight for you, General!
Are you all serious?!

Our Hero guests will join our fight
against mint chocolate lovers!
(Warcry)

... Total insanity here! You want to cause mutiny over
such a trivial thing?

Fine. Come get some! I will lock your arms and legs
and shove mint chocolate into your mouth!

He strikes his true colors!
Everyone! Kill that mint chocolate addict!
(Warcry)

I am troubled these days. No matter how much I exercise,
I don't gain any more muscle.

Big brothers suggested me
to change the routine, but...
Ah... This is splendid!

Sadly, I can't stop thinking about
having the top-tier muscles with magic already.

Nothing less is acceptable now.
The problem is that it won't last long.

I hear that there is an elixir that promotes
quick muscle growth in #Heaven#.
Oh?

I refuse to believe it! This is outstanding!
Are you the Master of Workout in Heaven?
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

Oh, you must have trained even your tongue muscle?
I am deeply impressed! You are a master of workout!
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

You will teach me right now?
That's exactly what I wished for! Inject it now!
(Muffled sound) Uhh!
(Muffled sound) Ooh...

You! Winston! You’re a proud Norsgardian!
Don't you walk the path of a roid junkie!
Huh?

A spell temporarily enhancing muscle is acceptable,
but injecting steroid is a totally different matter!

A proud Norsgardian would never degrade
his health over a short-term muscle gain!

I will give you a lesson the hard way!
With my natural muscle!
Winston. Steroids rob you of your hair.
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

What are you dallying for? Hurry. A brat named
{PLAYER_NAME} entered the streets.

Captain threw me a fit to
have me send familiars quicker.

Hold on. Did you forget how much
we worked to create this bad boy?

Deva King Version 5.2. You’re our lifetime masterpiece.
And I have to deploy you for such a trivial thing...

... I know how you’d feel, but we have no choice.
Orders are orders, you know.

Sigh... Failures like Taoist Mask
is not good enough even for a cannon fodder.

It does nothing but float.
Even Phantom Army rejected to operate it. Useless.

It's a shame of our regiment.
The hole in budget review.
Hey, hey. Cut that out and move.
Well... What?

Deva King Version 5.2!
NO!!
Huh? There are still monsters?
This is annoying.

Well... What?
It spits the bullets from the bottom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_10_01.text:
Ah... It’s seeping through again...
That’s it…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_10_03.text:
Stop! 
Your body can’t take it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_11_02.text:
Why…? The magic powers are leaking.
Why... can’t I handle it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_11_03.text: I only just earned this body of the Absolute...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_01.text: Finally, the real thing at last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_03.text:
Finally... 
I've been waiting for you children...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_04.text: Persephone, the culprit behind all this misfortune!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_05.text:
I shall put an end to your evil doings 
in the name of my father... and the Styx members!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_06.text: Today shall be the end of our ill-fated relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_07.text:
Hmm. I did nothing wrong.
All I did was eliminate an outlaw.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_08.text: Huhu... Reckless, just like your father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_2_04.text:
Kneel before me, 
bow down, and worship me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_06.text: We can free you from Manacar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_07.text: ...I heard that a thousand times in my 100-year sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_08.text: I’m sick of the hypocrisy of you #Heras#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_09.text:
Persephone!
Please don’t give up on yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_4_01.text:
Persephone!
Please don’t give up on yourself...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_5_03.text:
No more sacrifice like this... 
So stop it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_02.text: You've... You’ve been protecting me all this time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_04.text:
The mental bodies of former Senators? Are those what’s 
residing in the rings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_05.text:
Serving their duties even after death, 
how... ridiculous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_07.text:
Medea... 
The time has come to fulfill your wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_08.text: Please, free yourself from the agony.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_01.text:
I could care less.
Look at you making a last-ditch effort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_02.text: Look at you making a last-ditch effort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_04.text:
I’ll devour them... 
as I devour everyone’s wishes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_02.text:
Ugh... I’m the Absolute with undying magic powers.
These wounds don’t bother me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_03.text:
Give me blood and magic powers...!
I can grow stronger once again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_04.text:
No, Persephone,
we won’t let you suffer any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_06.text: Give me your blood and magic powers... Now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_01.text:
It’s worse than I expected.
Re-living the nightmare of the past...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_02.text: I feel like walking straight into a monster’s den.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_03.text:
Yes, the unstable current is disturbing
the magic powers. It’s worse than I expected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_04.text:
The Tower is specifically built
to interfere with Manacar’s recovery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_05.text:
That magician girl from Hero Town
taught me how to survive the Tower. You just...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_06.text:
go with the flow and move constantly
without trying to go against the energy. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_07.text:
That’s right. Lady Athena!
You are well-versed in magic as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_08.text:
... Don’t flatter me. Anyway, will you lead the way
since you feel the energy better?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_1_02.text: What is the matter, Lady Athena?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_1_03.text: I feel like we’re being watched.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_1_04.text:
Huh? Are you saying
that we are being followed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_1_05.text:
It’s probably all in my mind.
Don’t mind it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_2_01.text:
I can sense a special energy.
Everyone, get ready.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_01.text:
... This is weird. Among the monsters
were enemies I have defeated before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_02.text:
Did that happen to you too, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I don’t know what's going on...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_03.text:
It seems like we’re seeing #apparitions of monsters#
we've killed before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_04.text:
We have no trouble getting rid of them
as we’ve done so before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_05.text:
but they’ll keep appearing until we get exhausted,
at which point we will be helpless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_06.text: Indeed... they're trying to exhaust us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_2_3_08.text:
It would be a catastrophe if power as strong as this
is released from the Tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_04.text:
It’s a Styx member
who entered the Tower before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_06.text:
Are you alright?
Macaria... I mean, where’s Senator Hades?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_07.text:
Kuh, Lady Macaria...
she went after the ‘Hermit Queen’...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_08.text:
...! I knew I would find her here.
Is Senator Hades okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_09.text:
I do not know, My Lady. I was following her
when I fell into a trap...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_10.text:
I wanted to follow Lady Macaria,
but a monster attacked me right then and there..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_3_2_11.text:
Senator... I can’t afford to lose Captain Hades
again at the hands of Persephone... (Groans)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_2_01.text: Her heart is still beating, faintly however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_2_02.text:
All this blood and the ripped uniform
tells me she’s hurt badly... Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_3_01.text:
Look at this.
She’s been patched up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_3_02.text:
I think someone gave her first-aid treatment.
Do you think she did it herself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_3_03.text:
Too meticulous to be done by herself.
Do you see traces of other Styx members?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_3_04.text:
None...
Wait, I think Senator Hades just moved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_4_03.text:
What are you doing inside the Tower?
This can’t be, am I dreaming?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_4_04.text:
No, wake up.
You aren’t dreaming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_4_05.text:
No way this is happening.
‘That’ Senator Athena came to save me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_4_06.text:
This feels too real to be a dream.
Can you pinch me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_4_07.text:
Like I said, you’re not dreaming. Phew...
Okay, I’ll wake you up if I must.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_02.text:
Does it?
You could have died just now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_03.text:
I thought I told you to wait for backup force 
before going up the Tower,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_04.text: but you chose to pursue Persephone on your own!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_06.text:
Do you realize we had to come in such small numbers
all because of you, Senator Hades?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_07.text:
But... I couldn’t let 
#my father’s killer# flee before my own eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_08.text:
Even so!
Did you think you could stop her on your own?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_09.text:
I... wasn’t acting reasonably...
I was overcome with a surge of anger...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_11.text:
But... if you are so well aware of the danger, 
why come here with such a small number of men?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_12.text: Don’t tell me you did this... all for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_13.text:
Sigh... What, you think I have some kind of death wish?
You should really thank the Expedition indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_14.text:
Senator Hades, I hope you remember 
that many could’ve died protecting your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_5_15.text:
Yes… I will. 
Thank you, Senator Athena

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_01.text: How did you patch me up anyway?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_02.text:
Patch you up...? I did no such thing. 
I assumed it was you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_05.text:
Come to think of it, I think I recall seeing someone. 
Who was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_07.text:
A Styx member?! Oh! By the way, 
what happened to the members? Have you not met them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_08.text:
I did...
“Please find Senator Hades” were the last words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_11.text:
Many lives were lost all because of me...
I shouldn’t have pushed through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_12.text:
...I don’t deserve to lead them 
in the name of my father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_13.text: Senator Hades, how dare you sound so weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_14.text:
The Styx members didn’t sacrifice their lives 
so that they could listen to you blaming yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_15.text:
If you don’t think you deserve it, 
now is the time to prove that you do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_16.text:
... You're right. Neither my father nor the Styx members 
would've been pleased to see me like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_6_17.text:
I will get to the top of the Tower,
and see Persephone fall with my own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_4_7_02.text:
That’s right. 
The darkness becomes deeper...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_1_02.text: What is the matter, Lady Hades?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_1_03.text:
It just #feels like someone’s following us#...
I would’ve noticed if it was a Styx member...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_1_04.text: Hmm. I felt the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_01.text:
Athena, Hades. I’m glad you two are okay.
I came as soon as I received the letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_02.text:
It’s a relief to see you alive!
I came to lend a hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_03.text: Listen, Senator Athena. Are you out of your mind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_04.text:
Hera's still a child, 
she’s not cut out for this job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_05.text:
She is a member of the Council, after all.
It’s her duty to help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_07.text: But still, this is too dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_08.text:
I brought Zeus with me, so no worries. 
Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_10.text:
Athena! Why didn’t you send me the letter?
Did you intentionally leave me out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_11.text:
What are you talking about?
Why would I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_12.text:
Were you afraid
I would take the lead in the battleground?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_13.text:
Well, too bad. I had asked my brother Zeus
to keep an eye on Athena!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_14.text: There must be a misunderstanding. That’s...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_15.text:
Let me stop you there. I know you wanted to take credit
for eliminating the Hermit Queen all by yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_2_16.text:
As if! I, the War God Achilles,
shall steal the thunder! Ba ha ha ha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_02.text:
Hector. What is this about?
Didn’t you send the letter to Achilles?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_05.text:
You told me to send the letter
to the Senators that wore the ring...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_06.text: and Achilles wasn’t one of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_07.text:
I thought it would be risky
to let him know about the secret behind the rings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_08.text:
And?
It seems like there’s more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_09.text:
... And, I knew he would incite trouble
and try to pick a fight with you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_12.text:
... Hector. Do you realize you’re responsible 
for Achilles’ acting this way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_13.text:
You should know by now that
leaving him out is the same as besmirching my name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_14.text:
He is still a valuable asset.
Please leave your personal feelings out from now on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_3_15.text:
Yes... I should have thought it through.
My apologies, Lady Athena.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_01.text:
But they arrived sooner than I thought.
I wasn’t expecting them for another day or so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_02.text:
How were they able to rally in just a few hours?
The capital is quite far from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_03.text:
A few hours? We brought our troops here
after receiving your letter two days ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_04.text:
Two days ago?
That can’t be... Hector, what's going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_05.text:
I sent out the letters right before I left for Hero Town
to bring {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_06.text:
Two days ago, I hadn’t even purchased the papers
to write those letters on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_4_07.text:
... Something odd is going on.
I brought the letter with me. Take a look.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_01.text:
Huh? It’s gone...
Hera, did you bring yours?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_04.text:
Come to think of it, 
the letter came with a pot as always.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_05.text:
Letters that come with a pot 
always disappear after I read them. A coincidence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_06.text:
Huh? A pot?
The pot that you don’t even know who sent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_07.text: Athena, are you the one who's been sending Hera pots?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_5_10.text:
Sorry to interrupt,
but I think the Tower is shaking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_6_01.text:
What matters 
is that we’re all here together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_6_02.text:
It’s now our duty to keep Persephone 
from gathering the power of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_5_6_03.text:
Now that we’ve reached the middle of the Tower, 
there's no going back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_01.text:
(Pant)... (Pant)... The higher we go up
the stronger the monsters are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_04.text:
I won’t give up 
until I see Persephone collapse with my own eyes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_05.text:
Of course, I’m right here for you. 
Let’s hang in there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_06.text:
Thank you, Hera... You bear a striking resemblance 
to the First Hera... The kindness, above all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_07.text:
Is that true? Haha... I've never met her,
but it feels like I've known her for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_08.text:
What do you say, Zeus?
Do I really look like her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_1_10.text:
He always changes the topic 
whenever we talk about the First Hera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_6_2_04.text: Soon... there will be a complete union...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_7_1_01.text:
Senator Hades, are you alright?
Your face is pale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_7_1_03.text: Blood is seeping through the bandage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_7_2_03.text:
Subdued by Manacar,
doing all these vile acts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_7_2_05.text:
That won’t happen.
We’ll stop you at all costs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_1_02.text:
How arrogant of you to think that!
You believe you can really stop me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_1_03.text:
Huhuhu... Alright. Your blood and Mana
should be enough to quench my century-old thirst.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_2_03.text: until this place reeks of its smell.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_3_01.text:
Huhuhu... No rush.
You think this is my real body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_3_02.text:
I’ll be waiting at the very top.
Just a little farther. Hang in there kiddos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_3_03.text:
I’ll be waiting
to suck the fresh blood and Mana out of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_4_02.text:
Yes, we have no choice but to get rid of the obstacles
and advance all the way up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_4_03.text:
Hades... Please, hang in there.
We’re almost there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_4_04.text:
The fact that Persephone just appeared before our eyes
could only mean that she’s nearby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_8_4_06.text: I’ll share you my energy, Hades.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_1_01.text:
Huh? What's going on?
Why is everyone else beaming?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_1_03.text: This never happened before! What’s going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_2_02.text:
Ah... I’m alright.
I just got dizzy for a minute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_2_03.text:
That never happened to me...
It was as if I heard the ring speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_2_04.text:
Do you think you can continue?
We shouldn’t have come here in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_2_05.text:
Let me know if you want to turn back.
I’ll...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_2_06.text:
Zeus, it’s alright.
I was just dizzy, that’s all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_3_01.text:
They’re coming close.
Fresh blood and Mana...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_4_03.text:
Hera, your legs are shaking.
You should take care of yourself first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_4_04.text:
This is too much for both of you. You two, wait here.
We’ll deal with Persephone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_4_07.text:
I won’t put you out, I promise. 
So please let me come...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_9_5_01.text: It’s about time I put an end to this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_10_02.text: Why would you do that? Zeus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_10_03.text:
I... I was worried you would get into danger! 
I was worried about you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_11_01.text:
I... I see! I’m glad it wasn’t anything dangerous!
And I’ll be over there... if you need me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_11_03.text: Not you Hera, I was talking to {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_11_04.text: Zeus is still pretty bad at this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_01.text:
Medea,
I was very happy to receive those pots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_02.text:
I knew someone with a kind heart
sent them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_04.text:
... Irises were my sister’s, or should I say, 
the First Hera’s favorite flowers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_05.text:
Even when she was being tormented 
by the magic powers of her ring,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_06.text:
she would say she felt stronger 
just by looking at the small lives inside the pots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_07.text:
I wanted to send those pots to the little girl
who succeeded in my sister’s duties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_08.text: Sorry if they looked suspicious, like Zeus said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_09.text:
No, I found them comforting,
just as the First Hera did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_10.text:
If it’s not too much to ask,
could you keep sending them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_12.text:
Yes,
I’d love to get them delivered in person,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_16.text:
I would like that very much as well.
Come to the Council and share what you’ve found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_17.text: Huh? Does that mean you won’t punish Medea?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_12_18.text:
Yes, she did plot all this in secret,
but it was for the greater good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_13_01.text:
It feels weird to no longer have to guard the ring
after more than a half century.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_13_03.text: I would be lying if I said I wasn’t.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_13_04.text:
But the Council has condoned too many sacrifices 
to protect the rings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_13_05.text:
Everyone from Persephone to the first Heras 
had to live in torment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_13_06.text: I’m just relieved that we’re liberated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_02.text:
I heard about what happened, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You saved everyone from the resurrected Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_03.text:
Manacar might have collapsed, 
but his shattered pieces

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_04.text:
have not been completely eradicated, 
and they continue to breathe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_05.text:
When the broken pieces come together,
its #corporeal form# might appear again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_06.text:
I may be worrying too much, 
but I've experienced this twice already.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_07.text:
I think it’s best to get rid of the pieces 
just to be safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_14_08.text:
Do you mind periodically sending Expeditions
to eliminate all the shattered pieces?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_1_03.text:
You managed to survive that explosion?!
I shall end you for good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_02.text:
She’s not the hideous Persephone from earlier.
I know you want to take your long-awaited revenge,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_03.text:
but you do understand
that she didn’t do it out of her own will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_04.text: But even so, I can’t let her live!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_05.text:
She slept her entire life trying to protect the ring,
and when she awoke, she was controlled by insanity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_06.text:
Don’t you think it’s a little harsh... 
to hold her responsible?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_2_07.text:
I know... but still...
My father... My dad! He can never come back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_02.text:
I can only guess that I did awful things
while I was possessed by evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_03.text:
Every breathing moment will be torture,
knowing that many shed their blood because of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_04.text:
I would like to make atonement in any way possible,
even if it means giving up my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_05.text:
Oh, yeah? Well said. Kill yourself here and now.
That's the atonement I want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_06.text:
That’s the only way you can pay
for the lives of my Father and the Styx members.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_08.text:
I know my dispensable life
is nowhere near enough to pay for the sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_3_09.text:
But, if that can avenge the wrongful deaths,
I would gladly do so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_04.text:
Persephone, you don’t even remember
anything you did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_05.text:
Don’t you think it’s too cowardly and irresponsible 
to end everything by deserting your own life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_07.text: Live. Live and face the consequences of your wrongdoings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_08.text: What? You are going to let her live?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_09.text:
Yes, the Olympus Council shall decide 
what shall be done with her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_10.text:
And we will make sure she pays
for the lives that were sacrificed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_13.text:
I have faith that you will follow the Council’s decision
as a respectful member of the Olympus Council,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_14.text:
since you are no longer a stubborn child
who can’t put her personal feelings aside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_18.text:
I hope you remember every single thing you did.
And I hope those memories haunt you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_19.text:
Live and pay for them.
I shall watch what you do until you die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_21.text:
...
Hector, please take Persephone to the Council.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_23.text: Achilles, do you mind coming along?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_24.text: Me? You want me to escort her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_25.text:
Exactly. 
You’re the only one who's right for the job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_26.text:
Hmm... Well said! 
Fine. I’ll come along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_4_27.text:
Lady Athena, does it have to be this guy?
He’s rather...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_5_02.text:
Huh? Come to think of it... 
I know her face from somewhere... Where was it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_5_03.text:
... 
She’s Medea, the sister of the First Hera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_5_04.text:
I see! 
Lady Medea, this way please.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_5_06.text:
Don’t be shy.
Please come this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_02.text:
Medea, what happened?
You suddenly appeared out of nowhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_03.text:
Where in the world have you been
all these years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_04.text:
Are you... the one who notified me of 
Manacar’s impending resurrection?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_06.text:
I was the one who stole your seal and name 
to send everyone those letters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_09.text:
I was studying about the rings in Pumpkin City,
when I noticed that Manacar was about to resurrect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_10.text:
And I thought it was the last chance 
to put an end to the endless bondage of the rings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_11.text:
Why didn’t you just come and tell me?
I still would've come even if you told me the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_13.text:
To be honest, I didn’t trust the Council enough 
to ask you in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_14.text:
What do you mean 
that you didn’t trust the Council?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_15.text:
It has been holding the Heras responsible for 
everything, leading them to even more sacrifices.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_16.text:
And you, Lady Athena, is one of the Senators
who condoned the sacrifices of Heras.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_17.text:
So I couldn’t trust you enough
to share my plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_18.text:
...
Why used my seal if you didn’t trust me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_19.text:
Regardless of my lack of trust,
the Senators of the Council trust your words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_20.text:
... I see. It makes sense now,
everything that seemed a little off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_21.text: But I would like to apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_23.text:
I realized only later that you 
made efforts to make things right for Heras.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_25.text:
I appreciate that.
My sister and I were able to finally free ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_6_26.text: I shall pay for stealing the seal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_01.text: What are you doing, Senator Hades?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_03.text:
She’s the one who patched me up 
when I was pursuing Persephone’s apparition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_04.text:
I thought it was a dream, 
but seeing your face made me realize it wasn’t!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_06.text: Are you the one who treated Senator Hades, Medea?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_07.text:
Yes. I called the Senators together 
to gather the power of the rings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_08.text:
But I was worried anything might happen, 
so I was watching from behind in secret.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_09.text:
When I saw Hades was injured,
I couldn’t just leave her. I had to do something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_7_10.text: I see. You saved Senator Hades’s life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_8_01.text: You are the one who always sends me irises, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_9_01.text: Medea was the one behind those mysterious pots!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_9_02.text:
Why did you have to send it in that way?
You made me anxious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_9_03.text:
Do you have any idea all the trouble I went through 
to get rid of them before Hera found out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_EPILOGUE_9_05.text: Is that why my pots kept disappearing...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_02.text:
I’m Hector, a Roman General.
Do you recognize me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_03.text:
I came here for urgent business
at #Athena#’s request. So...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_04.text:
Something unusual happened
soon after the Manacar Tower was re-sealed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_05.text:
We had some Styx members look into it,
but we lost contact with all of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_06.text:
So Athena went to the Tower herself
with a rescue team...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_07.text:
and there she saw the apparition of Manacar.
Something must’ve gone wrong with the ring...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_08.text:
Well, we should talk about this somewhere else.
... We're in deep waters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_09.text:
Athena believes we need your help, {PLAYER_NAME},
and so do I.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_1_10.text: Please come with me to Roman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_02.text:
So the records were true! 
I knew it! I knew they were true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_04.text:
I knew you'd be nearby.
We should have adjourned to somewhere else...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_05.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, please let me briefly explain
what happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_06.text:
Chronos prepared something else to seal Manacar
which extends beyond the secrets of its Tower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_07.text:
Supposedly, the Roman #Olympus Council# has its hands on
the 6 #rings# that hold down Manacar’s energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_08.text:
The rings rely on the energy from the Olympian senators
that strengthens the seal of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_09.text:
Those duties are passed down through
the #name# of each senator.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_2_11.text:
it could only mean that Manacar’s strength
amplified to the extent that it broke the seal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_02.text:
Roman’s rings...
were created by the #First Hera#,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_03.text:
and the duty of restraining the strength of Manacar 
was passed down to secret #successors#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_04.text:
The rings grant formidable power
to their possessors,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_05.text:
but in the hands of the unworthy,
they can madden the ego of the possessor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_06.text:
The Olympus Senators have so far controlled
the power of the rings very well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_07.text:
but we don’t know what will happen to the rings,
if the strength of Manacar is amplified.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_09.text:
If Athena were to get seized by the power of the rings,
or if something were to happen

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_3_10.text:
to the rest of the Olympus Council,
we won’t be able to stop Manacar on our own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_4_01.text:
We don’t have any time to waste
if it were to get resurrected!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_4_03.text:
I shall go look for records
on the succession of rings!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_4_04.text:
I will send you a message if I find anything!
Keep your best foot forward!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_4_05.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Now, please #dispatch your Expedition#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_4_06.text:
Once you are done forming the Expedition,
come with me to the outpost by the Tower of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_5_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, long time no see. 
You got the message, it seems. That's a relief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_5_04.text: I shall brief you, {PLAYER_NAME}, on the current state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_6_01.text:
The two of you must have noticed
that our strengths have weakened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_6_02.text:
Yes, I do feel a little disoriented.
Is it because of the energy of the Tower?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_6_04.text:
My energy fluctuates from time to time.
My power isn’t so strong as usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_6_05.text:
I asked for backup forces
because we can’t handle this on our own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_6_06.text: I assume you've been briefed about the rings by Hector.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_01.text:
Let me get into the details.
Of the rings, six are the most important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_02.text:
#5 successors# including me inherited the First Spirit.
All of us wears a ring to protect them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_04.text:
It’s the ring of the #First Persephone#, 
also known as #the Hermit Queen#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_05.text:
Persephone fell into a deep sleep wearing the ring,
which purified the magic power of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_06.text:
But a while ago, she awoke to a state of insanity
and attacked the Council.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_07.text:
She disappeared after extorting fresh blood and Mana
in the indiscriminate slaughter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_08.text:
By the look of it, it seems that 
the Tower of Manacar has become her new abode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_7_10.text:
Hm. We should stop that from happening
at all costs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_8_01.text:
But... why is it that
your troops are the only ones to have gathered?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_8_02.text:
Other troops we requested are yet to arrive, 
and #Senator Hades# and her troops,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_8_03.text:
who had supposedly arrived earlier, 
have gone AWOL.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_8_04.text:
Do you think they could've broken in already?
With what happened to her father...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_8_05.text:
it’s totally possible... but I can’t go in rashly
in search of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_9_01.text: That scream just now, from inside the Tower?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_9_02.text:
I heard it, too. 
That sounded like the voice of Macaria...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_9_03.text:
Hmm... I wanted to wait until we had all the forces,
but it seems we don’t have time to waste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_INTRO_9_04.text:
We shall advance to the Tower 
with {PLAYER_NAME}’s expedition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_SHOP_COMP.text: Come back when you need anything else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_1_02.text: Ah... Goodbye to those days of overworking!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_1_03.text: All that’s left is to sit on a pile of money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_01.text:
Why so loud...?
What’s all the fuss about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_02.text: Oh, director! Come check this out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_03.text:
Load Industry’s #mobile game# masterpiece...
#Crusaders Quest# is complete now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_04.text: Crusaders... Quest? That’s the name of the game?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_05.text: Is it about a goddess and her holy knights?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_06.text:
Um... No, it’s about a hero captain who helps goddesses
to defeat some evil apostles to save Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_2_07.text: It's a kind of an alternate history fiction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_01.text: Who do you think our main enemy is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_03.text:
And what? Becoming a hero captain... and saving Hasla?
Is this some kind of a joke?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_04.text:
Why don’t you give it a try?
I recommend ‘The Legend of Primal Flames’...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_05.text:
It’s about true friendship between Saiga and Oda.
It even comes with interviews of the protagonists.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_06.text:
Nonsense! I thought we were making a rhythm game
about Hasla music festivals featuring me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_07.text:
Well... According to our market research,
most countries don’t love rhythm games...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_08.text: How dare you! Never talk down rhythm games before me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_09.text:
No more Crusaders Quest project as of today!
Everyone, pack your stuff and move departments!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_10.text:
What? That’s so unfair...!
At least let us release it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_3_11.text:
No more talk about this! You'd better not be holding onto
that crappy game when I come back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_01.text:
(Sigh) I can’t believe my employer doesn’t have
an eye for works of art...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_03.text: I guess we should pack our things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_04.text:
... No way. We can’t just abandon our masterpiece.
We should at least let it see the light of day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_05.text: Let’s release it over Nethnet for free!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_06.text: Hold up... I don’t want to end up in the dungeon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_07.text:
What have we got to lose?
I’m all in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_10.text: ... Okay... It’s up on the server.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_11.text:
Now everyone with access to Nethnet
can play Crusaders Quest for free.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_12.text: Our bodies may perish... but the game will live on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_4_13.text: Ah... That was a good life...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_5_03.text: It’s that wizard we captured to use as a test subject.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_5_04.text: Director Levine liked the bunny-ear fireworks, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_6_01.text:
Crusaders Quest...
Did you make this game?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_6_03.text:
Something’s weird... I’m inside the game...
and yet I feel a gaze from above me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_1_6_04.text: And if I press this button...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_2_1_01.text:
Meow... I’m here now, meow...
Don’t get angry...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_2_1_02.text:
But no grass-colored paper
again today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_1_01.text:
Sigh... We managed to keep the situation under control.
We uploaded it without the Enlarge button.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_1_02.text:
Huhu... My shrunken self...
It looks like a burst balloon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_1_03.text:
(Deep breathing) But I don’t mind how
people are looking down at me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_1_04.text: ... Who brought that thing and why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_1_05.text:
I would gladly get rid of it immediately...
were you not a valuable test subject...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_2_01.text:
Why did this happen?
All we wanted to do was make a fun game...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_2_02.text:
How strange. Why did the enlargement function
for the game work in real life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_2_03.text:
Um... Maybe...
We are living in the world inside the game...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_2_04.text:
which is why the enlargement function
worked in this world, I guess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_2_05.text:
So what we made was a game inside a game,
and we’re all game characters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_01.text:
Hahaha! You've read too many science fictions!
What a wild imagination...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_02.text: R... Right? I was just saying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_03.text:
Now that we fixed the giant bug,
let’s grab something to eat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_04.text:
Yeah, I’m hungry!
Get me some black bean noodles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_05.text:
Zip your mouth! You don’t deserve to eat.
Just sit tight and wait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_06.text:
(Panting) You’re mean. You should at least feed me...
if you brought me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_07.text:
... Let's feed her.
It might be her last meal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_08.text:
You're always too nice.
Hey. Flasher! Just eat whatever I give you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_3_09.text:
Ooh... Deal.
I know a good place that delivers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_4_01.text:
... Surprisingly, the laws that make up this world
are determined by the observer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_4_02.text:
If those developers hadn’t made a joke about the truth,
the fate of Hasla could have been in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_4_03.text: Oh? What if that has already happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GIANT_3_4_04.text:
Well then... I can only hope that gamers
have excellent gaming skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_PA_34_1.text: Stopping the machine.  Stop the machine. It doesn't work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_PA_34_2.text: Ku-Klip's control system is not following my command!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_PA_34_4.text: That's insane. I'm getting out of here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_38_1.text: Everyone! Is everyone following me well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_38_2.text: Reach that full moon, my voice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_38_3.text: Look! Next stage! Hang in there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_38_4.text: For the pigs who look after me...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_38_5.text: Even if I’m no werewolf... I can be something similar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_02.text:
The sky is blue with beautiful birds singing...
Don't you think this is a lovely day for a walk?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_04.text:
Besides, the demons need sunshine
to generate the essential nutrients.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_05.text:
Vi... Vi... I forgot the term.
Anyway, it's something essential to the demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_08.text:
W-what?! What is it?
What's up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_09.text:
You lazy fungus!
It's already mid-day, shouldn't you get up by now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_10.text:
If your father were here, he wouldn't have let you
sleep till now, you know that better than I do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_11.text:
*Yawning* Tsk... Ozma.
Why do you care whatever I'm doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_12.text:
Because you are the Devil Overlord of Hell!
You have daily matters to take care of, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_13.text:
Pfff. Everything runs just fine
even without me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_14.text:
This throne was passed to me without my consent.
You may revolt if you have problems with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_15.text:
T-that's... ...very irresponsible of you.
Lord Gordian has never...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_16.text:
That's enough. Well, you are waking me up at this hour,
which means you've finished my order?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_17.text:
... Yes, #the cooling machine that lets out the heat#
is ready. Here you are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_18.text:
Please remember you have to make a lame joke
every two hours to keep it running.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_19.text:
Ozma, you never disappoint me. The Neth Empire had that.
They look alike, and now... I can drink coke cool.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_20.text:
W-what? Coke? That's why you needed this?
I've worked on this day and night!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_21.text:
... I can't bear no more! The damage to the village
has been repaired long ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_22.text:
You threaten me to reveal my identity to others,
and make me keep inventing stuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_23.text: All for your own sake and idle interest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_24.text: Uh... Ozma, calm down and listen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_25.text:
No, I can't calm down.
And I told you to call me #Ku-Klip#, not Ozma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_26.text:
I thought you are a true authentic Devil Overlord,
but you're just a lazy freeloader.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_27.text:
Go reveal my identity. I don't care anymore.
I'm leaving this Hell! Ku-Klip, rocket booster on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_29.text:
# Ku-Klip rocket booster, system on.#
#Countdown.# 3... 2... 1... Lift off.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_31.text:
... *Cough*
Oh, you punk... You've destroyed the roof! Stop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_32.text:
Urgh... Agh... A-acceleration of gravity is...
way stronger than... I... Ugh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_1_1_34.text:
... ... #System notification. Booster flight time 4H32M.#
#Approaching the ground.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_02.text:
Ouch! My back! Ah...
Dang, it hurts so much? Did I sleep wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_03.text:
W-where... am I?
What am doing here lying on the forest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_05.text:
Eek! G-goblin! I've gotta wear my suit...
Ku-Klip! Open the hatch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_06.text:
#Fuel depleted due to long flight.#
#Currently in standby mode.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_07.text:
#For fast recovery,#
#open the fuel cover and insert 50k Gold.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_08.text:
You know I forgot to grab my purse
because I was in a hurry. Put it on my tab!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_09.text:
#No matter how close... we are,#
#you need to pay now.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_11.text:
Kek kek. Got you, gobble!
A young and weak ogre, gobble!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_12.text:
Well, that iron ogre there,
it doesn't seem to move, gobble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_13.text: Let's get rid of the weak one first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_15.text: Go away, you bunch of rascals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_17.text:
Kyyyaaa!!! R-run!
That's a kidnapper riding a Deerdog, gobble!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_19.text:
It's not 'Popo-nya' but 'Popo, nya'!
Huh? I'm quite familiar with this talk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_20.text: Are you a daughter of Ku-Klip?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_21.text:
Are you kidding me?
I'm Ku-Klip! You've seen real me before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_22.text:
I was just pulling your leg.
Of course I know you, meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_23.text:
Oh, well. Thanks anyway.
You saved me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_24.text: What brought you to Hyro Forest though?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_25.text:
Hm? Hyro Forest? I'm in Grancia right now?
Oh, gosh! How far did I fly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_26.text:
Nya Nya... You look troubled.
What happened? I'm ready to listen, meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_2_1_27.text:
You've helped me before,
so it's my turn to return you a favor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_02.text:
Mm... To sum it up, that Devil Overlord was
threatening you to keep you there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_03.text:
O-of course, I'm not free from blame either...
but she went too far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_04.text:
She was taking advantage of me every day
while she virtually was doing nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_05.text:
I understand. Because of human trafficking...
I get a body search every time I enter the gate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_06.text:
So bothersome every single time... I'm not a fool.
I wouldn't visit the town with illegal stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_07.text: Uh… That's not the same case as mine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_08.text:
Not the same, of course. Our difference is
confidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_10.text:
Of course-meow. Confidence! Ozma is much smarter than
your other folks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_11.text:
Why then hide in Ku-Klip avoiding eye contact,
is that because you have no confidence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_13.text:
Since when I was young,
I interacted with others in Ku-Klip.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_14.text: If I expose my feeble little body to others now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_15.text:
Nya Nya... Ozma. Look at me.
I'm as small as you are, but I don't act shy

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_17.text:
Alright, I'll teach you a lesson. Ozma!
I'll allow my time to boost your confidence!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_18.text:
... Maybe you are confident because...
you have Toto with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_19.text:
Quiet. You think too much.
Are you in or not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_21.text:
My training is hard.
You think you can withstand this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_23.text:
Fine. Then let's do the first training.
Go to Hero Town and get me some ready-made meal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_24.text: Buy some food? That doesn't sound hard at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_25.text:
... Who said you can ride Ku-Klip?
Do it without Ku-Klip.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_26.text: What! Then this is an extremely difficult mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_27.text: Ah, zip your mouth and go now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_31.text:
Hello. Welcome to Hero Town.
What can I do for you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_33.text:
Are you okay?
Relax and take a deep breath.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_35.text: Ready-made meal? Want to buy some ready-made meal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_37.text:
Ready-made meals are sold at
Bridget's store...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_38.text:
Oh, there she goes.
Miss Bridget!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_39.text:
Oh, Lednas!
What can I do for you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_40.text:
This lady is looking for
some ready-made meal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_41.text: Could you walk her through your store?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_42.text: Oh, yes. Leave it to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_43.text:
Huh? Walk me through...? It's okay! I can help myself!
I can look around myself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_44.text:
Come this way! I'll help you with choosing your meal.
I won't force you into buying anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_45.text:
I recommend this meal and beef jerky for camping.
Buy now and you get complimentary chips too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_46.text:
The recent trend is
to make a meal tastier by adding more stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_47.text:
In this regard, this meal kit is gaining popularity!
If you don't have any kitchen utensils...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_3_1_48.text:
Huh? Miss?
Where did she go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_01.text:
Nya Nya... Ozma. You came back early!
Much faster than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_03.text: Huh? You brought nothing with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_04.text:
The store clerk kept talking to me...
so I ran away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_06.text:
Well... You can't run away like that.
That doesn't do you any good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_08.text:
Well, you can learn from mistakes. The next training.
Toto! Bring it here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_12.text:
That's my #product#.
I caught it on the outskirts of Edenberg,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_13.text:
but I couldn't tame it.
You have to help me with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_16.text:
That product of mine cannot move since it's tied.
Which means even you can talk to it freely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_17.text:
Good if it's tamed
and good for speech practice. A win-win situation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_19.text:
What?! You don't like this either?
Then how do I help you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_21.text:
Okay, if you can't do this training, why don't you make
another #Make Your Own Friend Kit# as before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_22.text: Something not so wild as Mecha-Toto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_23.text: ... Wait, What did you say? Make Your Own Friend Kit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_24.text:
Oh, I get it. Popo, nya. Your training is just an excuse.
You are tricking me into creating an invention!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_25.text:
C-cough...! Don't get me wrong.
I'm just charging you a bit for this training.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_26.text:
I thought you'd grown up,
but you are just as silly as Devil Overlord!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_27.text: Why is everyone around me trying to use me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_28.text: Ah, you are too noisy! Toto! Get Ozma now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_30.text:
Whoooah! Stay away!
Ku-Klip! Help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_31.text:
#For fast recovery,#
#open the fuel cover and insert 50k Gold...#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_32.text: I said I'll pay you later...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_34.text:
Ahh! Get off me! Help!
Gordian! Vivian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_35.text:
You hear that? Found you!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Over there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_37.text:
I'm in big trouble then. If I get caught now,
the blonde knight will put me in prison!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_38.text: Toto! Leave that kid and run!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_40.text:
Huff and puff... Am I still alive?
Who helped me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_42.text:
Vi... Vivian?
How did you get…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_43.text:
You fool! I've been looking for you all over Hell.
What are you doing here?! I worried about you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_4_1_45.text:
... Thank you for helping me, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Let's get back to town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_01.text:
Oh, you came back, {PLAYER_NAME} and Vivian.
Did you find her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_02.text:
Yes, she is with us.
Your report helped us find her. Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_05.text:
E-eek! Please don't hit me!
Take pity on me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_06.text:
Huh? Don't be frightened. I... Shame on me...
to hit you like that. I apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_08.text:
... I didn't look for you
to punish you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_09.text:
When you complained to me,
I just realized that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_10.text:
I shouldn't use my friend like that
for my selfish needs. I'm really sorry for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_11.text:
P-please don't, Vivian!
I'd rather have you treat me as before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_12.text:
And don't call me your friend for you're my lord.
I'm not in the same class as you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_13.text:
What the heck are you talking about? Why am I your lord?
You're serving my father, not me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_14.text:
I'm just hanging out with you as a friend.
With you and Jack and the other Elite Four.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_15.text: ... Well, maybe not with that #grumpy old man#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_16.text:
Vivian, please!
Don't treat a petty ogre like me as your equal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_17.text:
Listen. You know you made every demon's life easier.
You should be proud of yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_18.text:
You are not a mere ogre.
You are the genius ogre of no equal in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_20.text:
Now shall we get back to our castle?
Get on your Ku-Klip. Let me know if you need fuel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_21.text: ... Sob... Well... I'm not going back yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_22.text:
What? Why? You think
I'm going to exploit you again once I get back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_23.text:
I swear by the name of Rachel, my sister,
that I'll never exploit you again. I swear!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_24.text: No, not that... I just realized the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_25.text:
The way you were dealing with me,
The way Popo tried to use me,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_26.text:
it's all because of me,
because I wanted to avoid interaction with others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_27.text:
I really want to change now. Although Popo-nya's
confidence training was a fraud,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_28.text:
in Hero Town where all the different races gather,
I think I can find and become who I really am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_29.text:
... Fine. If that's your will, so be it.
Just remember that I always welcome you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_31.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I'm relieved that you are here.
I leave Ozma in your care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_32.text:
Good to see such friendship. I admire you.
Now, then... Ozma, is that your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_34.text:
If you are going to stay here for long,
you need to fill out some forms...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_37.text: S-sorry, it's still hard to talk with a stranger...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_38.text: Can I live as Ku-Klip for a while... Can I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_PA_34_5_1_42.text: You have a long way to go...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_02.text:
Wow, what a cheer!
Everyone is shouting as if crying for quarter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_03.text:
Love ya all!
Thank you for coming all the way just to see me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_04.text: We’ll go anywhere you go Charlotte!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_05.text: We are at your service! Servants! Livestock, even!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_06.text:
Huhu, that’s right.
I appreciate your servitude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_07.text: Well, then, can I have everyone’s attention for a minute?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_08.text: I have bad news to share at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_09.text:
I’ll be on holiday for a few days starting tomorrow.
It’s not that I’m sick or anything, so no worries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_12.text: Don’t worry! I’m not going away forever! Just a few days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_13.text: In fact! I'm always in your hearts, so it's no parting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_14.text:
Don’t forget to say hi to my poster
every morning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_15.text:
Of course, Charlotte!
We won’t forget you even for a second!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_16.text: Charlotte, you’re always in our hearts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_17.text:
Thank you! And you, in mine!
Until we meet again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_19.text:
See ya soon, everyone!
Make sure to stay clean!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_24.text:
By ‘manager’, does she mean that thing 
who was knocked out trying to block Devil Overlord?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_25.text: Huh, when did you get here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_26.text:
I allow your audience with me, but no autographs.
Too many autographs lead to value depreciation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_27.text: Is this how my former subject should treat me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_28.text: I’m Gordian’s daughter after all. I deserve some respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_29.text: I wouldn’t want to cut a lucky Devil Overlord some slack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_30.text:
Gordian is the only one I follow.
I don’t care if you are his daughter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_31.text:
The only difference between you and his feces 
is that you don’t smell.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_32.text:
Yeah, yeah. Whatever you say, you filthy dog.
I don’t understand what you see in that old buffer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_33.text:
What brings you here anyway?
I thought my celeb life bores you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_34.text:
I figured I’d pay you a visit on your holiday.
I guess all that performing finally exhausted you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_35.text:
I couldn’t help it.
I get so many questions if I take even one day off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_36.text:
People asking if I’m dead or hurt or whatever...
They even bring me medication to my house.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_37.text:
You mean your fans, the so-called #Red Cape Squad#?
I bet there are enough of them to build a nation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_38.text:
That kind of life is pretty tough, isn't it?
Why don’t you quit and come work under me again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_39.text: That’s the last thing I want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_40.text:
With Jack and Ozma gone, I've got no one to work for me.
Just help me live a comfortable life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_41.text: That's what you came here for? Go away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_42.text:
Fine. Okay.
You prefer small talk, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_43.text:
You shocked me when you said you would become an idol.
But here you are, much adored by your fans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_44.text:
I’m used to training and leading.
It’s my area of expertise to lead my servants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_45.text: I thought you hated it initially. Not anymore, I guess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_46.text:
Of course, I hated the idea of becoming an idol at first.
I only did it because it was Gordian’s last order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_47.text:
Turns out, it’s not as bad as I imagined it.
You saw... how they screamed at the sight of me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_48.text: People screamed when you were leading the army as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_50.text:
That difference, to me, is huge.
It’s like I’ve completely dominated their spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_51.text:
How they flatter and be all submissive
is almost cute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_52.text: They would cry their eyes out if I go AWOL.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_53.text:
Oh, they would be heart-broken without me 
if I don't take care of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_54.text:
Are you the same person who used to hate being seen
so that you covered your face with a red cape?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_55.text: Well, I had to live up to the name of the Elite Four.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_56.text:
Just look at me.
I couldn’t intimidate anyone with this face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_57.text:
If I were to fight with enemies who threaten Gordian,
I had no choice but to cover my face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_58.text: I would have hated ruining his dignity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_59.text:
Well, you did earn the nickname
bloody cape, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_60.text:
I’ve had enough of this chitchat.
I should go pack up for my holiday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_61.text:
Going where?
To Grancia? To Chen? Or to Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_62.text:
I'm going to Hero Town.
Where you frequent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_63.text:
That’s so random.
Such a remote place! There’s nothing but a bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_64.text: I heard there’s someone who calls herself a #werewolf#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_65.text:
Hmm? Ah.
You mean #Fenrir#? There indeed is,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_66.text:
but don’t do anything stupid.
She’s got nothing to do with Demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_67.text:
Remember you used to be one of the Elite Four.
Messing with an outsider could put you in trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_68.text:
Don’t worry.
I have a reputation to protect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_69.text:
But you know something, Vivian?
I value my notoriety as a werewolf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_70.text:
There aren’t that many of you,
so you guys are a mystery to many.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_71.text:
Exactly. So I think it’s my duty to make sure that
she's behaving okay as a disciplined werewolf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_73.text:
I just want to make sure!
I've never seen another werewolf!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_74.text: Well, if that’s the reason, I won’t stop you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_75.text:
Enough now.
I’m short on time. No more chitchat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_76.text: Your knocking out my manager has delayed my time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_77.text:
Okay, okay.
I hope you enjoy your vacation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_79.text:
Wait!
What if she settles there like Jack or Ozma?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_80.text:
Hm, it’s unlikely with all the fans waiting for her.
But if it happens, that's a big minus to my army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_1_81.text:
I can’t help but worry.
Should I follow her silently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_01.text:
Did you hear, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Charlotte is paying a visit to Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_02.text: It's a rare occasion. Would you want to accompany me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_03.text:
Please don’t tell me... 
you don’t know who Charlotte is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_04.text: Well, please allow me to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_05.text: Charlotte is a werewolf and a former Elite Four.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_2_06.text: She retired when Gordian stepped down.
